records.title_en: AI and Our Economic Future
records.title_cn: 人工智能和我们的经济未来
records.abstract_en: Artificial intelligence (AI) will likely be the most transformative technology of the modern era. What if machines—AI for cognitive tasks and AI plus advanced robots for physical tasks—can perform every task a human can? This essay makes three main points. First, even though US growth rates have been stable at roughly 2 percent per year for 150 years, it is distinctly possible that automating intelligence leads economic growth rates to accelerate. Second, this acceleration is likely to be slowed by the presence of "weak links." While we each have access to 100 million times more transistors on our desktop computer than people in the 1970s, we are not 100 million times more productive. Computers can invert matrices at lightning speed, but we humans must still decide what matrix to invert, what hypothesis to test, and so on. Accelerating economic growth requires the vast majority of the weak links to be automated away, which delays the large gains. Finally, even though weak links slow the benefits, they may actually speed up the risks. When a chain is only as strong as its weakest link, damaging one link in the chain can be very costly. A powerful AI that is superhuman at software engineering could be misused by a bad actor to do substantial harm by hacking the financial system or a virology lab.
records.abstract_cn: 人工智能 (AI) 可能是现代最具变革性的技术。如果机器（用于认知任务的人工智能和用于物理任务的人工智能加上先进的机器人）能够执行人类可以执行的所有任务，会怎样？这篇文章主要讲了三个观点。首先，尽管美国的增长率在2%年里一直稳定在每年大约150，但自动化智能显然有可能导致经济增长率加速。其次，这种加速可能会因“薄弱环节”的存在而减慢。虽然我们每个人在台式计算机上使用的晶体管比 100 中的人多 1970 万倍，但我们的生产力并没有 100 万倍。计算机可以以闪电般的速度反转矩阵，但我们人类仍然必须决定要反转什么矩阵，要检验什么假设，等等。加速经济增长需要将绝大多数薄弱环节自动化消除，从而延迟了巨大收益的实现。最后，尽管薄弱环节减缓了收益，但它们实际上可能会加速风险。当一条链条的强度取决于其最薄弱的一环时，损坏链条中的一个环节可能会付出高昂的代价。在软件工程方面超人的强大人工智能可能会被不良行为者滥用，通过入侵金融系统或病毒学实验室来造成重大损害。

records.title_en: The Emerging Market for Intelligence: How Firms Buy and Sell AI
records.title_cn: 新兴的人工智能市场：企业如何买卖人工智能
records.abstract_en: We describe the emerging business-to-business market for large language model (LLM) inference and document key empirical patterns in its supply, pricing, and dynamics, using data from OpenRouter. First, supply has expanded rapidly: the number of commercially available models, model creators, and inference providers has grown sharply, driven heavily by open-source entrants. Second, the price of intelligence has fallen roughly a thousandfold, and open-source models now cost about 90 percent less than comparable closed-source ones. Third, the market is highly dynamic, with frequent turnover among leading models and creators. Fourth, we document substantial horizontal and vertical differentiation: no single model dominates across use cases, and demand for intelligence varies widely across applications. We place these patterns in historical perspective alongside earlier general-purpose technologies.
records.abstract_cn: 我们使用来自 OpenRouter 的数据描述了大型语言模型 (LLM) 推理的新兴企业对企业市场，并记录了其供应、定价和动态方面的关键经验模式。首先，供应迅速扩大：在开源进入者的大力推动下，商业模型、模型创建者和推理提供商的数量急剧增长。其次，情报的价格已经下降了大约一千倍，开源模型的成本现在比同类闭源模型低约 90%。第三，市场活跃度高，领军模特、创作者更替频繁。第四，我们记录了显着的水平和垂直差异：没有单一模型在用例中占主导地位，并且不同应用程序对智能的需求差异很大。我们将这些模式与早期的通用技术放在历史的角度来看。

records.title_en: US Tariff Policy since 1789
records.title_cn: 自1789以来的美国关税政策
records.abstract_en: We use a newly assembled, tariff-line-level dataset spanning the full history of US trade policy to revisit the evolution of tariffs since 1789. We document the institutional shift from Congressional setting to multilateral negotiation, the steady growth in granularity of the tariff code alongside expanding administrative capacity, and the under-appreciated role of specific tariffs, which feature prominently throughout US history and whose ad valorem equivalent moves mechanically with prices. We discuss the implications of this relationship for how we interpret past liberalization episodes and for empirical identification of tariff effects. Finally, we outline how the new data can advance research on the political economy of tariff-setting and on the macroeconomic and distributional consequences of trade policy.
records.abstract_cn: 我们使用新组装的涵盖美国贸易政策完整历史的关税线级别数据集来重新审视自1789以来关税的演变。我们记录了从国会设置到多边谈判的制度转变、关税法规粒度的稳步增长以及行政能力的扩大，以及从量关税的作用被低估，这些关税在美国历史上占据着突出的地位，其从价等价物随着价格机械地变化。我们讨论了这种关系对于我们如何解释过去的自由化事件以及关税效应的实证识别的影响。最后，我们概述了新数据如何推进关税设定的政治经济学以及贸易政策的宏观经济和分配后果的研究。

records.title_en: Labor Market Responses to Tariffs: Frictions, Dynamics, and Policy Responses
records.title_cn: 劳动力市场对关税的反应：摩擦、动态和政策反应
records.abstract_en: This article introduces the evidence and associated modeling frameworks contemporary economists use to understand the effects of trade and trade policy on labor markets, with a particular emphasis on labor-market frictions and adjustment dynamics. The effects of trade shocks differ across industries, regions, and occupations, implying the presence of important adjustment frictions in labor markets, and these effects evolve slowly over time, implying the need for dynamic frameworks rationalizing slow transitions. After reviewing the key insights from this literature, we discuss policies aimed at mitigating costs to workers and ensuring that the gains from trade are shared more equitably.
records.abstract_cn: 本文介绍了当代经济学家用来理解贸易和贸易政策对劳动力市场影响的证据和相关模型框架，特别强调劳动力市场摩擦和调整动态。贸易冲击的影响因行业、地区和职业而异，这意味着劳动力市场存在重要的调整摩擦，而且这些影响随着时间的推移缓慢演变，意味着需要动态框架来合理化缓慢的转型。在回顾了这些文献的主要见解后，我们讨论了旨在降低工人成本并确保更公平地分享贸易收益的政策。

records.title_en: Should We Tax Trade? A Pigouvian Perspective
records.title_cn: 我们应该对贸易征税吗？庇古的观点
records.abstract_en: We develop a simple and intuitive Pigouvian perspective on optimal trade policy. Our approach unifies a wide range of rationales for taxing trade, from the classical optimal tariff argument to contemporary debates about global carbon emissions and geopolitics. We also clarify when trade policy intervention is warranted and when alternative domestic instruments should be used instead.
records.abstract_cn: 我们对最优贸易政策提出了简单直观的庇古观点。我们的方法统一了对贸易征税的广泛理由，从经典的最优关税论点到当代有关全球碳排放和地缘政治的辩论。我们还澄清何时需要进行贸易政策干预以及何时应使用其他国内工具。

records.title_en: The Incidence of Tariffs: Rates and Reality
records.title_cn: 关税的发生率：税率与现实
records.abstract_en: In 2025, statutory tariff rates on US imports rose to levels not seen in over one hundred years. What were the implications for prices? On the one hand, shipping lags, exemptions, and enforcement gaps kept the actual implemented rates at only half of the statutory rates, moderating the tariffs' impact. On the other hand, tariff pass-through to US import prices reached 92 percent, so the United States bore a large share of the costs. We study the incidence of the 2018–2019 and 2025 US tariffs and discuss implications for US sourcing, domestic manufacturing costs, and the dollar.
records.abstract_cn: 2025，美国进口产品的法定关税税率升至一百多年来未见的水平。这对价格有何影响？一方面，运输滞后、豁免和执法差距使实际执行的税率仅为法定税率的一半，减轻了关税的影响。另一方面，关税对美国进口价格的转嫁达到92%，因此美国承担了很大一部分成本。我们研究 2018-2019 和 2025 美国关税的发生率，并讨论对美国采购、国内制造成本和美元的影响。

records.title_en: Global Imbalances, Tariffs, and Industrial Policy
records.title_cn: 全球失衡、关税和产业政策
records.abstract_en: Global imbalances denote the distribution of countries' current account balances, identically equal to the difference between two forward-looking aggregate variables: national saving and domestic investment. Industrial and trade policies have traditionally not been considered important drivers of aggregate saving or investment, and therefore of current account balances. The former because most industrial policies are small in scope; the latter because permanent tariffs have no intertemporal effect in the textbook model, with an offsetting appreciation of the real exchange rate. The rapidly growing use of both industrial and trade policies in recent years calls for a reassessment. This paper presents a framework to think about the role of both policies. For industrial policy, we make the important distinction between the traditional sector-specific policies via subsidies or other targeted instruments ("micro industrial policy") and broader policies ("macro industrial policy") that aim to promote industrial developments and competitiveness through the deployment of more aggregate instruments such as financial repression, foreign reserve accumulation, or capital controls. A key finding is that micro industrial policy tends to increase external balances if it fails to raise aggregate productivity. By contrast, macro industrial policy can, under some conditions, boost the current account, forcing other countries to adjust. Yet, these policies often come at the cost of suppressed domestic consumption and possibly domestic welfare. Our analysis confirms that tariffs are a weak tool to improve current account balances. Finally, traditional macroeconomic drivers—such as fiscal policy, demographics or credit cycles—remain critical drivers of global imbalances, especially for the United States and China.
records.abstract_cn: 全球失衡是指各国经常账户余额的分布，同样等于两个前瞻性总体变量：国民储蓄和国内投资之间的差额。传统上，工业和贸易政策不被视为总储蓄或投资的重要驱动因素，因此也不被视为经常账户余额的重要驱动因素。前者是因为大多数产业政策的范围较小；后者是因为大多数产业政策的范围较小。后者是因为永久关税在教科书模型中没有跨期效应，并会抵消实际汇率的升值。近年来，工业和贸易政策的使用迅速增加，需要重新评估。本文提出了一个思考这两项政策作用的框架。对于产业政策，我们对通过补贴或其他有针对性的工具（“微观产业政策”）的传统特定部门政策（“微观产业政策”）和更广泛的政策（“宏观产业政策”）进行了重要区分，后者旨在通过部署金融抑制、外汇储备积累或资本管制等更多总体工具来促进产业发展和竞争力。一个重要的发现是，如果微观产业政策不能提高总生产率，它往往会增加外部平衡。相比之下，宏观产业政策在某些情况下可以增加经常账户，迫使其他国家进行调整。然而，这些政策往往是以抑制国内消费和可能的国内福利为代价的。我们的分析证实，关税对于改善经常账户余额来说是一个较弱的工具。最后，财政政策、人口结构或信贷周期等传统宏观经济驱动因素仍然是全球失衡的关键驱动因素，尤其是对美国和中国而言。

records.title_en: Evaluating the Fiscal and Distributional Implications of Tariffs
records.title_cn: 评估关税的财政和分配影响
records.abstract_en: The Trump administration has enacted a series of significant taxes on imports, including an across-the-board tariff on nearly all imports. Tariffs are now expected to raise nearly 1 percent of GDP in revenue. Given tariffs' growing importance as a source of revenue, it is important to understand their implications for federal finances and the wellbeing of households. This paper describes and reviews current revenue and distributional analyses of tariffs.
records.abstract_cn: 特朗普政府对进口产品征收了一系列重大税款，包括对几乎所有进口产品征收全面关税。目前预计关税将增加近 1% 的 GDP 收入。鉴于关税作为收入来源的重要性日益增加，了解其对联邦财政和家庭福祉的影响非常重要。本文描述并回顾了当前的收入和关税分配分析。

records.title_en: Correct (and Incorrect) Inference with a Single Instrumental Variable: Practical Takeaways from the Weak Instruments Literature
records.title_cn: 使用单个工具变量进行正确（和不正确）的推断：弱工具文献的实用要点
records.abstract_en: Most empirical economists have encountered the warning that instrumental variables can be "weak," but the underlying issues—what makes an instrument weak, why weakness distorts inference, and what to do about it—are less widely understood. This article offers an accessible introduction to the weak instruments problem for the common just-identified case of a single endogenous regressor and a single instrument. We explain why the usual two-stage least squares t -ratio and its "±1.96 times the standard error" confidence interval can yield incorrect inferences, much as homoskedasticity-only standard errors do when errors are not homoskedastic. We then describe practical, robust-to-weak-instrument solutions—including the Anderson-Rubin and tF methods—that deliver valid confidence intervals whatever the instrument's true strength, and we offer some do's and don'ts, notably why the popular " F greater than 10" rule has no theoretical justification in this setting.
records.abstract_cn: 大多数实证经济学家都遇到过工具变量可能“弱”的警告，但根本问题——是什么导致工具弱，为什么弱会扭曲推论，以及如何应对——却不太被广泛理解。本文针对刚刚确定的单个内生回归量和单个工具的常见情况，对弱工具问题进行了简单易懂的介绍。我们解释了为什么通常的两阶段最小二乘 t 比及其“±1.96 乘以标准误差”置信区间可能会产生错误的推论，就像当误差不是同方差时仅同方差的标准误差一样。然后，我们描述实用的、稳健到弱的仪器解决方案（包括 Anderson-Rubin 和 tF 方法），无论仪器的真实强度如何，它们都能提供有效的置信区间，并且我们提供了一些注意事项，特别是为什么流行的“F 大于 10”规则在这种情况下没有理论依据。

records.title_en: Leniency Designs: An Operator's Manual
records.title_cn: 宽大设计：操作员手册
records.abstract_en: We develop a step-by-step guide to leniency (a.k.a. judge or examiner instrument) designs, drawing on recent econometric literatures. The unbiased jackknife instrumental variables estimator (UJIVE) is purpose-built for leveraging exogenous leniency variation, avoiding subtle biases even in the presence of many decision-makers or controls. We show how UJIVE can also be used to assess key assumptions underlying leniency designs, including quasi-random assignment and average first-stage monotonicity, and to probe the external validity of treatment effect estimates. We further discuss statistical inference, arguing that non-clustered standard errors are often appropriate. A reanalysis of Farre-Mensa et al. (2020), using quasi-random examiner assignment to estimate the value of patents to startups, illustrates our checklist.
records.abstract_cn: 我们借鉴最近的计量经济学文献，制定了宽大处理（又称法官或审查员工具）设计的分步指南。无偏折刀工具变量估计器 (UJIVE) 是专门为利用外生宽大变异而构建的，即使在存在许多决策者或控制的情况下也能避免细微的偏差。我们展示了如何使用 UJIVE 来评估宽大设计背后的关键假设，包括准随机分配和平均第一阶段单调性，并探讨治疗效果估计的外部有效性。我们进一步讨论统计推断，认为非聚集标准误差通常是合适的。 Farre-Mensa 等人的重新分析。 （2020）使用准随机审查员分配来估计专利对初创企业的价值，说明了我们的清单。

records.title_en: Stefanie Stantcheva, 2025 Clark Medalist
records.title_cn: 斯蒂芬妮·斯坦切娃 (Stefanie Stantcheva)，2025 克拉克奖章获得者
records.abstract_en: The American Economic Association awarded the 2025 John Bates Clark Medal to Stefanie Stantcheva of Harvard University. Her research ranges widely in the field of public economics. It includes theoretical contributions to optimal income taxation, empirical contributions to the study of how income tax rates across countries and states affect the mobility of inventors and the level of innovation, and contributions in the development and execution of on-line surveys to measure respondents' beliefs about economic primitives, such as the distribution of income or the rate of inflation, and the way these beliefs influence policy preferences. She has demonstrated that randomized controlled trials can be embedded within on-line surveys and used to the way informational interventions and other treatments affect economic beliefs and policy preferences.
records.abstract_cn: 美国经济协会将2025约翰·贝茨·克拉克奖章授予哈佛大学的斯蒂芬妮·斯坦切娃。她的研究广泛涉及公共经济学领域。它包括对最佳所得税的理论贡献，对研究不同国家和州的所得税税率如何影响发明者流动性和创新水平的实证贡献，以及对开发和执行在线调查的贡献，以衡量受访者对经济原语的信念，例如收入分配或通货膨胀率，以及这些信念影响政策偏好的方式。她证明，随机对照试验可以嵌入在线调查中，并用于研究信息干预和其他治疗方法影响经济信念和政策偏好的方式。

records.title_en: Ad Valorem Taxation in a Multiproduct Monopoly
records.title_cn: 多产品垄断中的从价税
records.abstract_en: We study the pass‐through of ad valorem taxes with a multiproduct monopolist. We characterize two mechanisms whereby an ad valorem tax on one good reduces all prices (Edgeworth's paradox), depending on the goods being substitutes or complements. We also find that the tax can increase the supply of all goods. Hence, consumer surplus and welfare can increase even when the goods are underprovided compared to the social optimum. We provide several applications where these results hold. Our findings indicate that in a multiproduct setting the effects of unit and ad valorem taxes on market outcomes and welfare are fundamentally different.
records.abstract_cn: 我们研究了多产品垄断者下从价税的转嫁问题。我们刻画了两种机制，通过这两种机制，对一种商品征收从价税会降低所有价格（埃奇沃思悖论），这取决于商品是替代品还是互补品。我们还发现，税收可以增加所有商品的供给。因此，即使商品相对于社会最优水平供给不足，消费者剩余和福利也可能增加。我们提供了几个这些结果成立的实例。我们的发现表明，在多产品环境中，单位税和从价税对市场结果和福利的影响根本不同。

records.title_en: Multi‐Product Monopolist and Information Design
records.title_cn: 多产品垄断者与信息设计
records.abstract_en: We study the information design and pricing decision of a multi‐product monopolist who faces a buyer with unit demand. Under omniscient disclosure, we show that one profit‐maximizing menu reveals the identity of the highest quality product and allocates that product, provided a type‐specific quality threshold is met. This menu remains optimal under private disclosure if the buyer's value has constant differences in quality and type, or if the value has non‐decreasing differences in quality and type and the threshold type is independent of quality. We also characterize the conditions under which an ex‐ante and non‐discriminatory posted price mechanism is optimal.
records.abstract_cn: 我们研究了一个面对具有单位需求买方的多产品垄断者的信息设计与定价决策。在无所不知的披露下，我们表明，一个利润最大化的菜单会揭示最高质量产品的身份，并在满足特定类型质量阈值时分配该产品。如果买方价值在质量与类型上具有恒定差异，或者价值在质量与类型上具有非递减差异且阈值类型独立于质量，则该菜单在私人披露下仍然最优。我们还刻画了事前且非歧视性的标价机制最优的条件。

records.title_en: Network Competition in the Airline Industry: An Empirical Framework
records.title_cn: 航空业中的网络竞争：一个实证框架
records.abstract_en: This article proposes an empirical framework and a novel equilibrium concept to analyze network competition in the airline industry. A two‐stage entry model links direct and indirect flights, using a technological relationship estimated from data to mimic the hub‐and‐spoke network. It employs revealed‐preference arguments to bound fixed cost parameters, estimated using state‐of‐the‐art econometric methods. Ignoring network externality undervalues the benefits of additional flights by 13.2% and leads to 21.5% fewer one‐stop flights. A hypothetical merger between Alaska and Virgin in 2014 could increase consumer surplus as the merged airline would offer more flights with muted post‐merger prices.
records.abstract_cn: 本文提出了一个实证框架和一个新颖的均衡概念来分析航空业中的网络竞争。一个两阶段进入模型将直达航班与间接航班联系起来，利用从数据中估计的技术关系来模拟枢纽辐射型网络。它采用显示性偏好论证来界定固定成本参数，并使用最先进的计量经济学方法进行估计。忽略网络外部性会低估额外航班的收益达13.2%，并导致21.5%更少的中转航班。2014年阿拉斯加航空与维珍航空的假设合并可能会增加消费者剩余，因为合并后的航空公司将提供更多航班，且合并后价格涨幅有限。

records.title_en: Asymmetric Platform Oligopoly
records.title_cn: 不对称平台寡头
records.abstract_en: We propose a tractable model of asymmetric platform oligopoly with logit demand in which users from two distinct groups are subject to within‐group and cross‐group network effects and decide which platform to join. We characterize the equilibrium when platforms manage user access by setting participation fees for each user group. We explore the effects of platform entry, a change of incumbent platforms' quality under free entry, and the degree of compatibility. We show how the analysis can be extended to partial user participation.
records.abstract_cn: 我们提出了一个具有logit需求的不对称平台寡头的可处理模型，在该模型中，来自两个不同群体的用户受到群体内和跨群体网络效应的影响，并决定加入哪个平台。我们刻画了当平台通过为每个用户群体设定参与费来管理用户访问时的均衡。我们探讨了平台进入、自由进入下在位平台质量变化以及兼容性程度的影响。我们展示了该分析如何扩展到部分用户参与。

records.title_en: Purchase History and Product Personalization
records.title_cn: 购买历史与产品个性化
records.abstract_en: Product personalization opens the door to price discrimination. A rich product line allows firms to better tailor products to consumers' tastes, but the mere choice of a product carries valuable information about consumers that can be leveraged for price discrimination. We study this trade‐off in an upstream ‐ downstream model, where a consumer buys a good of variable quality upstream, followed by an indivisible good downstream. The downstream firm's use of the consumer's purchase history for price discrimination introduces a novel distortion: The upstream firm offers a subset of the products that it would offer if, instead, it could jointly design its product line and downstream pricing. By controlling the degree of product personalization the upstream firm curbs ratcheting forces that result from the consumer facing downstream price discrimination.
records.abstract_cn: 产品个性化为价格歧视打开了大门。丰富的产品线使企业能够更好地使产品适应消费者的品味，但仅仅是产品的选择就携带着关于消费者的有价值信息，这些信息可以被利用来进行价格歧视。我们在一个上游-下游模型中研究这种权衡，其中消费者在上游购买一种质量可变的商品，随后在下游购买一种不可分割的商品。下游企业利用消费者的购买历史进行价格歧视，引入了一种新颖的扭曲：上游企业提供的产品子集，如果它能联合设计其产品线和下游定价，则会提供不同的产品。通过控制产品个性化的程度，上游企业抑制了因消费者面临下游价格歧视而产生的棘轮效应。

records.title_en: Stable Price Dispersion under Heterogeneous Buyer Consideration
records.title_cn: 异质性买家考虑下的稳定价格离散
records.abstract_en: We study the pricing of homogeneous products sold to customers who consider different sets of suppliers. We identify prices that are stable in the sense that no firm wishes to undercut a rival or to raise its price when rivals are able to respond by offering special deals. We derive stable and dispersed prices across several price‐consideration specifications. We contrast the implications against those of conventional approaches.
records.abstract_cn: 我们研究了向考虑不同供应商集合的顾客销售同质产品的定价问题。我们识别出在竞争对手能够通过提供特别优惠来回应时，没有企业希望削价低于对手或提高自身价格的价格，这些价格是稳定的。我们在多种价格考虑规格下推导出稳定且离散的价格。我们将这些含义与传统方法的含义进行了对比。

records.title_en: Horizontal Mergers and Incremental Innovation
records.title_cn: 横向并购与增量创新
records.abstract_en: We study the impact of horizontal mergers on the incentives of merging firms to invest in incremental innovation. We provide a decomposition of this impact that clarifies the various forces at work and the differences between demand‐enhancing and cost‐reducing innovation. Moreover, we derive sufficient conditions for a merger to either reduce or raise the merging firms' incentives to innovate, and show that the comparison of the price diversion ratio and the innovation diversion ratio can help screen mergers. We also uncover a useful connection between the level of production synergies induced by a merger and its impact on innovation.
records.abstract_cn: 我们研究了横向并购对并购企业投资于增量创新激励的影响。我们提供了这种影响的分解，以阐明各种作用力以及需求增强型创新与成本降低型创新之间的差异。此外，我们推导出并购降低或提高并购企业创新激励的充分条件，并表明价格转移比率与创新转移比率的比较有助于筛选并购。我们还揭示了并购引发的生产协同效应水平与其对创新影响之间的有用联系。

records.title_en: Fossil Fuels and Renewable Energy: Mix or Match?
records.title_cn: 化石燃料与可再生能源：混合还是匹配？
records.abstract_en: This article investigates the influence of technological ownership on pricing strategies and productive efficiency. Our motivation comes from the evolving landscape of electricity markets where firms are transitioning from diversified to specialized portfolios, focusing on renewable energy or fossil fuels. Our theoretical model demonstrates that diversified firms compete more vigorously than their specialized counterparts. Conversely, specialized firms exhibit higher productive efficiency but only when thermal sources dominate. The magnitude of our theoretical predictions is assessed through simulations using data from the Spanish electricity market. Methodologically, our analysis offers novel insights for studying multi‐unit auctions with cost heterogeneity and privately known capacities.
records.abstract_cn: 本文研究了技术所有权对定价策略和生产效率的影响。我们的动机来自于电力市场不断演变的格局，其中企业正从多元化组合转向专业化组合，专注于可再生能源或化石燃料。我们的理论模型表明，多元化企业比专业化同行竞争更为激烈。相反，专业化企业表现出更高的生产效率，但仅在热源占主导地位时如此。我们通过使用西班牙电力市场数据的模拟来评估理论预测的幅度。在方法论上，我们的分析为研究具有成本异质性和私人已知容量的多单元拍卖提供了新的见解。

records.title_en: Search and Competition in Expert Markets
records.title_cn: 专家市场中的搜索与竞争
records.abstract_en: We analyze a model where consumers sequentially search experts for treatment recommendations and prices, facing either zero or a positive search cost, whereas experts simultaneously compete in these two dimensions. In equilibrium, experts may “cheat” by overstating the severity of a consumer's problem and recommending an unnecessary treatment, prices follow distributions depending on the problem type and the treatment, and consumers employ Bayesian belief updating about their problem types during search. Paradoxically, as search cost decreases, expert cheating and prices can both increase stochastically. However, if search cost is sufficiently small, competition will force all experts to behave honestly.
records.abstract_cn: 我们分析了一个模型，其中消费者依次搜索专家以获取治疗建议和价格，面临零或正的搜索成本，而专家则在这两个维度上同时竞争。在均衡状态下，专家可能会通过夸大消费者问题的严重性并推荐不必要的治疗来“欺骗”，价格根据问题类型和治疗方式遵循分布，消费者在搜索过程中对其问题类型进行贝叶斯信念更新。矛盾的是，随着搜索成本的降低，专家的欺骗行为和价格都可能随机增加。然而，如果搜索成本足够小，竞争将迫使所有专家诚实行事。

records.title_en: Optimal Job Design and Information Elicitation
records.title_cn: 最优工作设计与信息 elicitation
records.abstract_en: When managers rely on their subordinates for local information but cannot commit to how such information is used, the incentives for effort and information elicitation become intertwined. This incentive problem influences the firm's job design decision, that is, whether to assign all tasks in a job to one worker (“individual assignment”) or split those among a group (“team assignment”). Team assignment facilitates information elicitation but suffers from diseconomies of scope in incentive provision. The optimal job design is driven by the workers' likelihood of being informed (about local conditions) and the noise in the performance measure used to reward them.
records.abstract_cn: 当管理者依赖下属获取局部信息，但无法承诺如何使用这些信息时，努力激励与信息 elicitation 便相互交织。这一激励问题影响企业的岗位设计决策，即是将一项工作中的所有任务分配给单个工人（“个人分配”），还是将其在团队中拆分（“团队分配”）。团队分配有助于信息 elicitation，但在激励提供方面存在范围不经济。最优工作设计取决于工人了解（局部条件）的可能性以及用于奖励他们的绩效衡量指标中的噪声。

records.title_en: Optimal Refund Mechanism With Consumer Learning
records.title_cn: 消费者学习下的最优退款机制
records.abstract_en: This article studies the optimal refund mechanism when an uninformed buyer learns about their valuation over time. We consider various refund mechanisms including simple return policies (no returns or free returns), and stochastic return policies, which allow the buyer to keep the product with some probability upon receiving a refund. We show that the optimal refund mechanism is deterministic and takes a simple form: either the seller deters buyer learning by offering a low price without returns, or encourages maximal learning by setting a high price with free returns. Interestingly, free returns are optimal only for intermediate prior beliefs.
records.abstract_cn: 本文研究了当不知情的买方随时间了解其估值时的最优退款机制。我们考虑了各种退款机制，包括简单的退货政策（无退货或免费退货），以及随机退货政策，后者允许买方在收到退款时以一定概率保留产品。我们表明，最优退款机制是确定性的，并采取简单形式：要么卖方通过提供低价且无退货来阻止买方学习，要么通过设定高价且免费退货来鼓励最大程度的学习。有趣的是，免费退货仅在中间先验信念下才是最优的。

records.title_en: Redistribution Through Efficiency: Theory and Evidence from Three Electricity Markets
records.title_cn: 通过效率实现再分配：来自三个电力市场的理论与证据
records.abstract_en: Using micro‐data on over 160 million bids to buy and sell from three major electricity markets, we study efficiency improvements resulting from technologies such as storage. Consumer benefits arise not from stabilized prices but from changes in general price levels. To unpack the findings, we develop a set of price‐theory results, demonstrating that the convexity of market excess demand, derived from the bids, serves as a novel measure that strongly predicts consumer benefits across all markets. This analysis highlights that even small allocative improvements can lead to significant redistributions of surplus, ultimately benefitting consumers.
records.abstract_cn: 利用来自三个主要电力市场的超过160亿条买卖报价的微观数据，我们研究了诸如储能等技术带来的效率改进。消费者收益并非源于价格稳定，而是源于总体价格水平的变化。为了揭示这些发现，我们发展了一套价格理论结果，证明由报价推导出的市场超额需求的凸性是一个新颖的度量指标，能够强有力地预测所有市场中的消费者收益。这一分析强调，即使是微小的配置改进也可能导致显著的剩余再分配，最终使消费者受益。

records.title_en: Reserve Price Signaling With Public Information: Evidence From Online Auto Auctions
records.title_cn: 公开信息下的保留价信号传递：来自在线汽车拍卖的证据
records.abstract_en: This article considers an auction model in which a seller's choice of reserve price signals her private information about the object's quality. We show that the signaling incentive would lower the seller's payoff and the probability of sale. We estimate the model using a novel dataset from a large online auto auction platform. Counterfactual simulations suggest that a secret reserve price could shut down the signaling incentive and improve both the seller's payoff and the probability of sale, which supports the prevalent use of secret reserve prices in practice.
records.abstract_cn: 本文考虑了一个拍卖模型，其中卖方对保留价的选择传递了她关于物品质量的私人信息。我们表明，信号传递激励会降低卖方的收益和成交概率。我们使用来自大型在线汽车拍卖平台的新数据集来估计该模型。反事实模拟表明，秘密保留价可以消除信号传递激励，并提高卖方的收益和成交概率，这支持了实践中普遍使用秘密保留价的做法。

records.title_en: Urban community-led total sanitation: opportunities, barriers and lessons from Nanded, India
records.title_cn: 城市社区主导的全面环境卫生：印度南德的机遇、障碍与经验教训
records.abstract_en: This article focuses on the sanitation challenges of rapidly urbanizing localities in the global South by drawing on the case of Nanded city in Maharashtra, India. Nanded had a short-lived experiment with urban Community-led Total Sanitation (CLTS) between 2011 and 2012 and is today officially considered to be highly successful in urban sanitation according to India’s Clean India Mission. However, in reality many challenges remain, especially for its marginalised residents especially around sewage, waste and faecal sludge management (FSM) (considered to be second and third generation challenges). The article thus seeks to: (1) Trace the story of CLTS implementation, its successes, legacy and limitations; and (2) Examine urban sanitation challenges that are often missed in official programmes especially with respect to marginality, waste, co-production and community action. Through qualitative research methods and two phases of research, first in 2012 and then between 2022 and 2024, we explore past and current perceptions and experiences of diverse communities around sanitation, waste and CLTS. We argue that while there is strong potential for urban sanitation programmes inspired by CLTS to positively improve sanitation in urban areas, they need to recognise historical and current drivers of marginality around class, caste, gender and geography that continue to shape sanitation access and safety. The focus of urban sanitation programmes also need to go beyond toilets and behaviour change programmes, largely targeted at poor and marginalised residents, to also address waste and faecal sludge management problems which cannot be tackled at the community level. Finally, to systematically tackle second and third-generation sanitation challenges, community action must be accompanied by institutional change, state buy-in, investment and co-production engaging different actors, from state agencies to citizens and other stakeholders. The findings have relevance for everybody seeking to achieve safe and equitable urban sanitation for all in rapidly urbanising contexts.
records.abstract_cn: 本文通过印度马哈拉施特拉邦南德市的案例，关注全球南方快速城市化地区的环境卫生挑战。南德在2011年至2012年间进行了一次短暂的城市社区主导的全面环境卫生（CLTS）实验，如今根据印度的清洁印度使命，该市在官方上被认为在城市环境卫生方面非常成功。然而，现实中仍存在许多挑战，尤其是对其边缘化居民而言，特别是在污水、垃圾和粪便污泥管理（FSM）方面（被认为是第二代和第三代挑战）。因此，本文旨在：（1）追溯CLTS实施的故事、其成功、遗产和局限性；（2）考察官方计划中常被忽视的城市环境卫生挑战，特别是在边缘性、垃圾、共同生产和社区行动方面。通过定性研究方法和两个研究阶段，第一阶段在2012年，第二阶段在2022年至2024年间，我们探讨了不同社区过去和现在对环境卫生、垃圾和CLTS的看法和经历。我们认为，虽然受CLTS启发的城市环境卫生计划在改善城市环境卫生方面具有巨大潜力，但它们需要认识到围绕阶级、种姓、性别和地理的历史和当前边缘性驱动因素，这些因素继续塑造着环境卫生的可及性和安全性。城市环境卫生计划的重点也需要超越主要针对贫困和边缘化居民的厕所和行为改变计划，以解决无法在社区层面解决的垃圾和粪便污泥管理问题。最后，为了系统性地应对第二代和第三代环境卫生挑战，社区行动必须伴随着制度变革、国家支持、投资以及涉及不同行动者（从国家机构到公民和其他利益相关者）的共同生产。这些发现对于所有在快速城市化背景下寻求实现安全和公平的城市环境卫生的人都有参考意义。

records.title_en: Inequality and social unrest in India
records.title_cn: 印度的不平等与社会动荡
records.abstract_en: We show that inequality can lead to social unrest in rural India. We develop a theoretical framework in which civilians rationally engage in social unrest to oppose the (unfair) distribution of surplus by the elite. Our model predicts that the likelihood of observing social unrest in a village increases with the sum of distances between the (log) average and the lowest incomes. We test this prediction using unique microdata on bank account information covering 2197 Indian villages. Guided by our theoretical framework, we propose an instrumental variable strategy based on the idea that positive water shocks disproportionately benefit the highest incomes in a village. Our analysis then shows that a 10% increase in our inequality measure leads to a 6.5% rise in the unconditional probability of social unrest in a given village and month.
records.abstract_cn: 我们表明，不平等可能导致印度农村地区的社会动荡。我们构建了一个理论框架，其中平民理性地参与社会动荡，以反对精英对剩余（不公平）的分配。我们的模型预测，村庄中观察到社会动荡的可能性随着（对数）平均收入与最低收入之间距离的总和增加而增加。我们利用覆盖2197个印度村庄的银行账户信息独特微观数据来检验这一预测。在理论框架的指导下，我们提出了一种基于正向水冲击不成比例地惠及村庄最高收入这一思想的工具变量策略。我们的分析随后显示，我们的不平等度量每增加10%，在给定村庄和月份中社会动荡的无条件概率上升6.5%。

records.title_en: Trade openness, global value chain integration and firms’ adoption of environment-friendly strategies
records.title_cn: 贸易开放度、全球价值链整合与企业采纳环境友好型策略
records.abstract_en: This paper investigates whether firms that are more open to international trade engage more extensively in efforts to reduce the environmental impact of their activities by adopting environment-friendly strategies (i.e., implementing new practices and technologies that reduce pollution and resource use). In particular, we examine the direction of this relationship for different levels of industry integration in Global Value Chains (GVCs) and different degrees of GVC trade partners’ environmental performance. Our econometric analysis uses data from 4,886 manufacturing firms from 21 lower and upper middle-income countries in Central Asia, Eastern Europe and the Middle East and North Africa. The results suggest a positive association between firm openness to international markets and intensity of use of environmentally friendly practices and technologies. This relationship becomes stronger for higher levels of environmental performance by industry GVC partners and weaker levels of industry integration in GVC.
records.abstract_cn: 本文研究了国际贸易开放度更高的企业是否更广泛地采取环境友好型策略（即实施减少污染和资源使用的新实践和技术），以降低其活动对环境的影响。特别地，我们考察了这种关系在不同行业全球价值链（GVC）整合水平和不同GVC贸易伙伴环境绩效程度下的方向。我们的计量经济分析使用了来自中亚、东欧以及中东和北非地区21个中低收入国家的4,886家制造业企业的数据。结果表明，企业国际市场开放度与环境友好型实践和技术的使用强度之间存在正相关关系。这种关系在行业GVC伙伴环境绩效较高时更强，而在行业GVC整合程度较低时较弱。

records.title_en: Toward a clean drinking water act for India: A review of drinking water quality standards
records.title_cn: 迈向印度清洁饮用水法案：饮用水水质标准述评
records.abstract_en: Access to clean and safe drinking water is fundamental for human well-being, public health, and economic growth. While India has made substantial progress in expanding household tap water coverage under the Jal Jeevan Mission (JJM), challenges remain in ensuring water quality. This paper provides a comprehensive review of India’s drinking water quality policy - examining its evolution and legislative frameworks, scope for policy improvements and judicial affirmations for safe drinking water. The paper highlights key improvements needed in the existing water quality regulatory framework, including strengthening enforcement and remedial mechanisms, regular revision of standards, and greater attention to emerging contaminants. The analysis situates these issues within the institutional architecture of JJM, assessing both the strengths and constraints of JJM’s Water Quality framework. Drawing on comparative experience from global contexts, the paper distils lessons relevant for India. Building on these insights, the paper outlines key elements for a future Clean Drinking Water Act for India, emphasizing clearer legal status for quality standards, structured revision mechanisms, accessible grievance redress, and the key role of a robust water quality monitoring system.
records.abstract_cn: 获取清洁安全的饮用水是人类福祉、公共卫生和经济增长的基础。尽管印度在“Jal Jeevan Mission”（JJM）下扩大家庭自来水覆盖方面取得了显著进展，但在确保水质方面仍存在挑战。本文对印度的饮用水水质政策进行了全面回顾——审视其演变和立法框架、政策改进空间以及司法对安全饮用水的确认。文章强调了现有水质监管框架中需要改进的关键方面，包括加强执法和补救机制、定期修订标准，以及更加关注新兴污染物。分析将这些议题置于JJM的制度架构中，评估了JJM水质框架的优势与局限。借鉴全球背景下的比较经验，文章提炼了对印度具有借鉴意义的教训。基于这些见解，文章概述了未来印度清洁饮用水法案的关键要素，强调质量标准更明确的法律地位、结构化的修订机制、可及的申诉救济途径，以及健全的水质监测系统的关键作用。

records.title_en: Development and interdisciplinarity: additional insights on the ‘economics silo’
records.title_cn: 发展与国际交叉学科：关于“经济学孤岛”的进一步见解
records.abstract_en: Recent scientometric evidence published in this journal (Mitra, S., Palmer, M, Vuong, V. (2020). Development and Interdisciplinary: A citation analysis. World Development, 135, 105076; hereafter MPV) suggests that development is not an interdisciplinary field as it predominantly references mainstream economics and shows limited interaction with other disciplines. This article validates the study of MPV and extends it in several ways. First, it introduces an alternative method for identifying the economics background of development scholars by matching bibliometric data with the Research Papers in Economics (RePEc) author database. Second, it applies an extensive multi-level citation analysis, based on all journal references available from the Web of Science database. A replication of the cited-reference analysis of 29,619 articles across 17 development journals confirms MPV’s findings: the lack of interdisciplinarity in development is driven primarily by research by authors with an economics background. However, this study estimates a much larger share of such research than MPV. Third, a regression analysis reveals that works authored by economists receive significantly more citations. Fourth, a comparative analysis of author affiliations shows that articles with an economics background are predominantly associated with renowned (international) policy institutions, particularly the World Bank. Fifth, a discursive analysis of article abstracts based on structural topic modeling identifies research topics associated with (non-)economists, and thus, higher or lower levels of interdisciplinarity. Overall, the findings highlight several policy implications as development research conducted by economists differs significantly across multiple dimensions, with these differences being even more pronounced among ‘top-five’ economists.
records.abstract_cn: 近期发表于本刊的科学计量学证据（Mitra, S., Palmer, M, Vuong, V. (2020). Development and Interdisciplinary: A citation analysis. World Development, 135, 105076；以下简称MPV）表明，发展领域并非一个跨学科领域，因为它主要引用主流经济学，并与其他学科的互动有限。本文验证了MPV的研究，并在多个方面进行了扩展。首先，通过将文献计量数据与经济学研究论文（RePEc）作者数据库匹配，引入了一种识别发展学者经济学背景的替代方法。其次，基于Web of Science数据库中的所有期刊参考文献，进行了广泛的多层次引文分析。对17种发展期刊中的29,619篇文章的引文参考文献分析复制证实了MPV的发现：发展领域缺乏跨学科性主要由具有经济学背景的作者的研究驱动。然而，本研究估计此类研究的比例远高于MPV。第三，回归分析显示，经济学家撰写的作品获得的引用显著更多。第四，对作者所属机构的比较分析表明，具有经济学背景的文章主要与知名的（国际）政策机构相关，尤其是世界银行。第五，基于结构主题建模对文章摘要进行的话语分析识别了与（非）经济学家相关的研究主题，从而反映了跨学科性的高低。总体而言，研究结果凸显了若干政策含义，因为经济学家进行的发展研究在多个维度上存在显著差异，这些差异在“五大”经济学家中更为明显。

records.title_en: Catalysts for third-country market entry: The role of preferential trade agreements
records.title_cn: 第三国市场进入的催化剂：特惠贸易协定的作用
records.abstract_en: Preferential trade agreement (PTA) membership is known to divert trade volumes away from nonmember (third) countries along the intensive margin of trade, yet much less is known about its effects on third-country market entry along the extensive margin of trade. This paper examines whether PTAs catalyze market entry into third countries, and more broadly whether PTAs create spillover effects beyond member countries that matter for development. Using bilateral trade data from 1948 to 2020, we employ a difference-in-differences strategy, and find that the third-country market entry rate rises by 2.1% when the origin country has a PTA partner in the destination region, even after accounting for prior regional export experience. This effect is comparable in magnitude to both the origin and destination countries joining the WTO. We further show that this effect is stronger when the destination and the origin’s PTA partners are more closely linked through deep integration, common language, and colonial ties, and when products are differentiated or regulation-intensive. Beyond these heterogeneity analyses, we shed light on the underlying mechanism by showing that preferential PTA provisions enhance regional market access. The resulting scale effect appears to be an important channel through which higher variable profits help exporters cover the costs of entering third-country markets. Overall, our findings highlight the quantitative importance of the third-country entry effect of PTAs in explaining trade growth and offer broader implications for choosing optimal PTA partners.
records.abstract_cn: 已知特惠贸易协定（PTA）成员资格会在贸易的集约边际上将贸易量从非成员（第三）国家转移走，但对其在贸易的扩展边际上对第三国市场进入的影响知之甚少。本文考察PTA是否催化进入第三国市场，以及更广泛地，PTA是否产生超越成员国、对发展重要的溢出效应。利用1948年至2020年的双边贸易数据，我们采用双重差分策略，发现当原籍国在目的地地区有PTA伙伴时，第三国市场进入率上升2.1%，即使在考虑了先前的区域出口经验之后也是如此。这一效应在量级上与原籍国和目的地国加入世界贸易组织（WTO）相当。我们进一步表明，当目的地与原籍国的PTA伙伴通过深度一体化、共同语言和殖民联系更紧密相连，以及当产品是差异化或监管密集型时，这一效应更强。除了这些异质性分析之外，我们通过显示特惠PTA条款增强区域市场准入来阐明潜在机制。由此产生的规模效应似乎是重要的渠道，通过该渠道，更高的可变利润帮助出口商覆盖进入第三国市场的成本。总体而言，我们的发现强调了PTA的第三国进入效应在解释贸易增长方面的数量重要性，并为选择最优PTA伙伴提供了更广泛的意义。

records.title_en: Land tenure conflicts in Ghana and Zimbabwe: An institutional perspective
records.title_cn: 加纳与津巴布韦的土地权属冲突：一种制度视角
records.abstract_en: Land frontiers in Africa are closing rapidly, with significant implications for family, clan, and chieftaincy conflicts. This study examines the evolution of land tenure systems and related conflicts in Ghana and Zimbabwe using a neocustomary and statist archetypal exploratory framework, drawing on national survey data, the Social Conflict Analysis Database (SCAD), and qualitative interviews in conflict hotspot regions of both countries. While both nations inherited British colonial land management systems with some similarities, their postcolonial trajectories diverged: Zimbabwe adopted a statist approach, while Ghana pursued a decentralised neocustomary model, shaping their flagship reforms—the Fast-Track Land Redistribution (FTRP) and the Land Administration Project (LAP) respectively. The results indicate that neither regime type inherently possesses effective conflict management mechanisms, as both fail to safeguard the rights of the marginalised. While conflicts in Ghana tend to be localised and protracted, often with high mortality, Zimbabwe’s statist mechanisms can suppress disputes quickly, though often without guarantees of fairness. For policy and research, the study underscores that neither statist nor neocustomary regimes deliver egalitarian outcomes in conflict resolution by design; both require robust accountability mechanisms and safeguards to protect vulnerable groups. Decentralisation may allow deliberative and inclusive outcomes, but evidence of the numerous conflicts, lengthy dispute resolution processes, and high conflict mortality shows this is not guaranteed. Similarly, centralised systems may be expeditious but risk politicisation, top-down bureaucratic inefficiencies, and inequitable outcomes. Ultimately, the effectiveness of conflict resolution depends less on regime type and more on the legitimacy and capacity of embedded institutional safeguards.
records.abstract_cn: 非洲的土地前沿正在迅速关闭，对家庭、氏族和酋长领地冲突产生了重大影响。本研究利用新习惯法和国家主义原型探索框架，基于全国调查数据、社会冲突分析数据库（SCAD）以及对两国冲突热点地区的定性访谈，考察了加纳和津巴布韦土地权属制度及其相关冲突的演变。尽管两国都继承了英国殖民时期的土地管理制度，存在一些相似之处，但它们的后殖民轨迹分道扬镳：津巴布韦采取了国家主义方法，而加纳则推行了分散化的新习惯法模式，这塑造了它们各自的旗舰改革——快速通道土地重新分配（FTRP）和土地管理项目（LAP）。结果表明，两种制度类型本身都不具备有效的冲突管理机制，因为两者都未能保障边缘化群体的权利。加纳的冲突往往局部化且旷日持久，常常导致高死亡率，而津巴布韦的国家主义机制能够迅速压制争端，但往往无法保证公平。对于政策与研究而言，本研究强调，无论是国家主义还是新习惯法制度，都不会在设计上实现冲突解决的平等结果；两者都需要强有力的问责机制和保障措施来保护弱势群体。分散化可能带来协商性和包容性的结果，但众多冲突、冗长的争端解决过程以及高冲突死亡率的证据表明，这并非必然。同样，中央集权制度可能迅速高效，但存在政治化、自上而下的官僚低效和不平等结果的风险。最终，冲突解决的有效性更多取决于嵌入制度保障的合法性和能力，而非制度类型本身。

records.title_en: Feeding the accelerator: A metabolic historical analysis of the US food regime
records.title_cn: 喂养加速器：美国食物体制的代谢历史分析
records.abstract_en: This study combines food regime analysis with a metabolic accounting approach to reconstruct the long-run viability conditions of the US “cheap food” regime. We compile a harmonized dataset for 1840–2017 (census benchmark years) and apply Multi-Scale Integrated Analysis of Societal and Ecosystem Metabolism (MuSIASEM) together with Impredicative Loop Analysis to quantify the co-evolution of agricultural output, labor time, and societal reproduction requirements. The results reveal a recurrent pattern of surplus generation and reconfiguration that supports a three-phase periodization: (i) accumulation by appropriation (1840–1890), (ii) accumulation by capitalization (1930–1970), and (iii) reorganization (1990s onward). Within the metabolic indicators used here, the 1930s stand out as the clearest systemic rupture, whereas later crises are associated with re-stabilization strategies that maintain surplus rates through technological change, state regulation, and evolving capitalization dynamics. The analysis also highlights the central role of commodity frontiers—most notably cheap oil—in sustaining postwar agro-industrial productivity, and it discusses the emergence of “cheap information” as a potential new frontier layered onto persistent petro-farming. By operationalizing food-regime narratives through a formal metabolic grammar, the study offers a reproducible way to interpret agrarian crises as expressions of contradictions between appropriation and capitalization, and to link regime stability to the biophysical and labor conditions of social reproduction.
records.abstract_cn: 本研究将食物体制分析与代谢核算方法相结合，重建美国“廉价食品”体制的长期可行性条件。我们编制了一个涵盖1840-2017（人口普查基准年）的协调数据集，并应用多尺度社会与生态系统代谢综合分析与不可预测循环分析，量化农业产出、劳动时间和社会再生产需求之间的共同演化。结果揭示了盈余生成与重构的反复模式，支持三阶段分期：（i）通过占有的积累（1840-1890），（ii）通过资本化的积累（1930-1970），以及（iii）重组（1990至今）。在本文使用的代谢指标中，1930年作为最清晰的结构性断裂脱颖而出，而随后的危机则与通过技术变革、国家监管和不断演变的资本化动态维持盈余率的再稳定策略相关。分析还强调了商品边疆——尤其是廉价石油——在维持战后农业工业生产力中的核心作用，并讨论了“廉价信息”作为潜在新边疆的出现，叠加在持续的石油农业之上。通过正式的代谢语法操作化食物体制叙事，本研究提供了一种可复制的方式来解释农业危机，将其视为占有与资本化之间矛盾的表现，并将体制稳定性与社会再生产的生物物理和劳动条件联系起来。

records.title_en: Public support for military conservation: Understanding public opinion to the ‘war on poachers’ in three countries
records.title_cn: 公众对军事化保护的支持：理解三个国家对“反偷猎战争”的舆论
records.abstract_en: The efforts made by states to curb wildlife poaching increasingly involve the deployment of military forces, especially in countries of the Global South. This shift towards a “war on poachers” can include measures such as shoot-on-sight policies, raising concerns about civil and human rights. While previous research has emphasized the perspectives of local communities, law enforcement, or hunters, to the best of our knowledge little is known about broader public support—an important factor for policy legitimacy and effectiveness. In this article, we examine public attitudes towards: (a) private and public protected areas managed by the military, (b) stronger criminal sanctions against poaching, and (c) granting expanded authority to the military to combat poaching. Using original national surveys from India, Indonesia, and South Africa—countries that have implemented aspects of militarized conservation—we found generally positive attitudes for military management of protected areas. In India and Indonesia, however, respondents still preferred non-military management when given a direct comparison. Across all three samples, people tended to support increasing military powers, particularly against commercial poaching. Respondents also favored maintaining or strengthening punishments for poachers. We conclude by identifying avenues for future research into the drivers of public support for militarized conservation.
records.abstract_cn: 国家为遏制野生动物偷猎所做的努力日益涉及部署军事力量，尤其是在全球南方国家。这种向“反偷猎战争”的转变可能包括诸如“见即射杀”政策等措施，引发了对公民权利和人权的担忧。尽管以往研究强调了当地社区、执法部门或猎人的视角，但据我们所知，对更广泛的公众支持——这一政策合法性和有效性的重要因素——知之甚少。在本文中，我们考察了公众对以下方面的态度：（a）由军方管理的私人和公共保护区，（b）对偷猎行为更严厉的刑事制裁，以及（c）授予军方更大权力以打击偷猎。利用来自印度、印度尼西亚和南非的原始全国性调查——这些国家已实施了军事化保护的某些方面——我们发现公众对军方管理保护区普遍持积极态度。然而，在印度和印度尼西亚，当直接比较时，受访者仍偏好非军事管理。在所有三个样本中，人们倾向于支持增加军事权力，尤其是针对商业偷猎。受访者还赞成维持或加强对偷猎者的惩罚。最后，我们指出了未来研究公众对军事化保护支持驱动因素的途径。

records.title_en: Measuring forest-related depth in preferential trade agreements: the forest provisions depth index
records.title_cn: 衡量优惠贸易协定中的森林相关深度：森林条款深度指数
records.abstract_en: Trade agreements have become a vehicle for environmental commitments, but existing measures of environmental provisions in preferential trade agreements do not distinguish forest-specific content from general environmental architecture. This paper introduces the Forest Provisions Depth Index (FPDI), a composite indicator measuring the depth of forest-related commitments in preferential trade agreements across three dimensions: explicit forest content, implementation and compliance capacity, and normative anchoring. The index covers 778 agreements involving 213 countries from 1947 to 2021, uses geometric aggregation with a targeted discount when forest-specific clauses are absent, and is stock-based, accumulating provisions across a country’s in-force agreement portfolio. Country rankings are stable across 11 alternative weighting schemes, and the composite shows moderate correlation with a cumulative forest-clause count, indicating it captures treaty architecture beyond clause frequency. Panel estimates on 150 countries over 2002 to 2021 associate governance capacity, forest rents, and wood product imports with higher FPDI scores, while tree-cover loss and agricultural land expansion associate with lower scores. Persistent cross-country governance differences account for more FPDI variation than within-country changes, and agricultural expansion operates through the within-country margin. The FPDI provides a benchmark for cross-country comparison of treaty design and for research on trade-forest linkages.
records.abstract_cn: 贸易协定已成为环境承诺的载体，但现有的优惠贸易协定中环境条款的衡量标准并未区分森林特定内容与一般环境架构。本文介绍了森林条款深度指数（FPDI），这是一个综合指标，用于衡量优惠贸易协定中森林相关承诺的深度，涵盖三个维度：明确的森林内容、实施与合规能力以及规范性锚定。该指数覆盖了从1947年到2021年间涉及213个国家的778项协定，采用几何聚合方法，并在缺乏森林特定条款时进行有针对性的折扣，且基于存量，累积一个国家生效协定组合中的条款。国家排名在11种替代加权方案下保持稳定，该综合指数与累积森林条款计数呈中等相关性，表明它捕捉了条约架构而不仅仅是条款频率。对2002年至2021年间150个国家的面板估计显示，治理能力、森林租金和木材产品进口与较高的FPDI得分相关，而树木覆盖损失和农业用地扩张与较低的得分相关。持续的跨国治理差异比国内变化解释了更多的FPDI变异，农业扩张通过国内边际发挥作用。FPDI为条约设计的跨国比较以及贸易-森林关联研究提供了基准。

records.title_en: Strategic Influencers and the Shaping of Beliefs
records.title_cn: 战略性影响者与信念塑造
records.abstract_en: Influencers, from propagandists to sellers, expend vast resources targeting agents who amplify their message through word‐of‐mouth communication. While agents differ in network position, they also differ in their bias: Agents may naturally read articles with a particular slant or buy products from a certain seller. Absent competition, an influencer prefers targeting central agents and those biased against it. If agents are unbiased, competition leads to influencers targeting more central agents. However, when agents have heterogeneous biases and competition is intense, the incentive to deter one's rival dominates. Influencers protect their base, targeting those with similar beliefs in equilibrium.
records.abstract_cn: 影响者，从宣传者到销售者，投入大量资源针对通过口碑传播放大其信息的代理人。尽管代理人在网络位置上存在差异，但他们在偏见上也存在差异：代理人可能自然倾向于阅读带有特定倾向的文章或购买某个卖家的产品。在缺乏竞争的情况下，影响者倾向于针对网络中心的代理人以及那些对其持有偏见的代理人。如果代理人是无偏的，竞争会导致影响者更多地针对更中心的代理人。然而，当代理人具有异质偏见且竞争激烈时，阻止竞争对手的动机占主导地位。影响者在均衡中保护其基础，针对持有相似信念的代理人。

records.title_en: Buyer‐Optimal Platform Design
records.title_cn: 买方最优平台设计
records.abstract_en: A platform matches a unit mass of sellers, each owning a single product of heterogeneous quality, to a unit mass of buyers with differing valuations for unit‐quality. After matching, sellers make take‐it‐or‐leave‐it price‐offers to buyers. Initially, valuations of buyers are only known to them and the platform, but sellers make inferences from the matching algorithm. The efficient matching is positive assortative, but buyer‐optimal matchings are stochastically negative assortative when there are few low‐value buyers (i.e., compared to lower‐quality sellers, high‐quality ones are matched to buyers with lower expected valuation). Although everyone trades, generating rents for the side lacking bargaining power results in inefficient matching.
records.abstract_cn: 一个平台将单位质量的卖家（每个卖家拥有单一异质质量的产品）与单位质量的买家（对单位质量的估值不同）进行匹配。匹配后，卖家向买家提出“要么接受要么放弃”的价格报价。最初，买家的估值仅为买家和平台所知，但卖家通过匹配算法进行推断。有效匹配是正向配对的，但当低价值买家较少时，买方最优匹配呈现随机负向配对（即与低质量卖家相比，高质量卖家匹配到预期估值较低的买家）。尽管所有人都进行了交易，但由于为缺乏议价能力一方产生租金，导致匹配效率低下。

records.title_en: On the Optimality of Full Disclosure
records.title_cn: 关于完全披露的最优性
records.abstract_en: A privately informed sender can commit to any disclosure policy toward a receiver, whose actions affect the utility of the sender. We show that full disclosure is optimal under a sufficient condition with some desirable properties. First, it speaks directly to the parties' utility functions, as opposed to the sender's indirect utility function; this makes it easily interpretable and verifiable. Second, it does not require the sender's payoff to be a function of the posterior mean state. Third, it is weaker than the conditions obtained in the literature for some specific settings.
records.abstract_cn: 一个拥有私人信息的发送者可以承诺对接收者采取任何披露政策，而接收者的行为会影响发送者的效用。我们证明了在一个具有某些理想性质的充分条件下，完全披露是最优的。首先，该条件直接针对各方的效用函数，而非发送者的间接效用函数；这使其易于解释和验证。其次，该条件不要求发送者的收益是后验均值状态的函数。最后，该条件比文献中针对某些特定情形得到的条件更弱。

records.title_en: The Political Economy of Patent Buyouts
records.title_cn: 专利回购的政治经济学
records.abstract_en: Incentivizing innovation through buyouts may alleviate the social costs associated with patent power, but the political economy and feasibility of this potentially important financing mechanism have been understudied. We study an international setting of countries with different innovation and financing capabilities, and where financing governments rely on taxes to fund buyouts and care about the electoral popularity of their decisions. Subsequent distributional conflict arises between countries as some may benefit from the now‐public knowledge without contributing equally to financing, whereas taxpayers within a country may disagree over the desired extent of tax financing for buyouts. We show that these conflicts reduce the feasibility of buyouts relative to patents, identify the conditions under which this harms global welfare, and discuss possibilities for overcoming these constraints. The international public good and public financing dimensions of buyouts emerge as essential for understanding their potential to supplant patents and to improve social welfare.
records.abstract_cn: 通过回购激励创新可能缓解与专利权力相关的社会成本，但这一潜在重要融资机制的政治经济学及可行性尚未得到充分研究。我们研究了一个国际环境，其中各国创新和融资能力不同，且融资政府依赖税收为回购提供资金，并关心其决策的选举支持率。随后，各国之间产生分配冲突，因为一些国家可能在未等额贡献融资的情况下受益于现已公开的知识，而同一国家内的纳税人则可能对回购的税收融资程度存在分歧。我们表明，这些冲突降低了回购相较于专利的可行性，确定了在何种条件下这会损害全球福利，并讨论了克服这些限制的可能途径。回购的国际公共物品属性和公共融资维度成为理解其取代专利并改善社会福利潜力的关键。

records.title_en: Storage games
records.title_cn: 储存博弈
records.abstract_en: We study a long‐horizon, oligopolistic market with random shocks to demand that can be arbitraged by two storage operators with finite capacity. This problem applies to any storable commodity—that is, most commodities. Because the arbitrage spread is so sensitive to market power, storage operators face strong incentives to restrain quantities by tacitly colluding. This cooperation takes new forms thanks to the multiplicity of actions they must take: selling, buying, or both. We construct payoff‐maximizing equilibria of this stochastic game, and uncover a new form of Partial Cooperation that trades off quantities and delay. While collusive, Partial Cooperation delivers higher consumer surplus thanks to the market power effect. Head‐on competition is not always an equilibrium of the long‐horizon game when market power becomes large enough. We draw implications for policy and suggest poorly competitive storage is a negative externality to the development of the underlying commodity—for example, renewable energy.
records.abstract_cn: 我们研究了一个长期视角的寡头市场，该市场中需求存在随机冲击，且可由具有有限容量的储存运营商进行套利。该问题适用于任何可储存商品——即大多数商品。由于套利价差对市场力量极为敏感，储存运营商面临通过默契合谋限制数量的强烈激励。由于他们必须采取多种行动：卖出、买入或两者兼有，这种合作呈现出新的形式。我们构建了该随机博弈的收益最大化均衡，并发现了一种新的部分合作形式，该形式在数量和延迟之间进行权衡。尽管具有合谋性质，部分合作由于市场力量效应带来了更高的消费者剩余。当市场力量足够大时，正面竞争并不总是长期博弈的均衡。我们提出了政策启示，并指出竞争不足的储存对基础商品的发展构成负外部性——例如，可再生能源。

records.title_en: Dynamic Pricing With Recommendation and Consumer Feedback
records.title_cn: 结合推荐与消费者反馈的动态定价
records.abstract_en: A long‐lived seller sells a new product of unknown value by offering prices and recommendations to short‐lived consumers in continuous time. The seller receives consumer feedback about the product at a rate that increases with the instantaneous sales volume. The optimal selling mechanism features episodes of price discounts, during which the seller discontinuously lowers the price and offers unwarranted recommendations to consumers. The optimal pricing strategy depends on the nature of consumer feedback and may involve early or late discounts, dynamic price backtracking, and below‐cost pricing.
records.abstract_cn: 一位长期存在的卖家通过向短期存在的消费者提供价格和推荐，在连续时间内销售一款价值未知的新产品。卖家以与即时销售量成正比的速率接收关于该产品的消费者反馈。最优销售机制包含价格折扣阶段，在此期间卖家会不连续地降低价格并向消费者提供无根据的推荐。最优定价策略取决于消费者反馈的性质，可能涉及早期或晚期折扣、动态价格回溯以及低于成本的定价。

records.title_en: Inflated Recommendations
records.title_cn: 虚高推荐
records.abstract_en: Biased recommendations arise naturally in markets with heterogeneous consumers. We study a model in which a monopolist offers an experience good to a population of consumers with heterogeneous tastes and makes personalized purchase recommendations. We provide conditions under which a firm makes welfare‐reducing purchase recommendations with positive probability, resulting in inflated recommendations. We extend this insight to a setting in which an intermediary makes the recommendations, whereas a seller sets the retail price. Regulatory interventions that forbid inflated recommendations may lead to higher social welfare or may backfire.
records.abstract_cn: 在具有异质消费者的市场中，存在偏向性推荐是自然而然的现象。我们研究了一个模型，其中垄断者向具有异质偏好的消费者群体提供体验型商品，并做出个性化购买推荐。我们给出了企业以正概率做出降低福利的购买推荐（即虚高推荐）的条件。我们将这一见解扩展到一个中介做出推荐而卖方设定零售价格的情形。禁止虚高推荐的监管干预可能提高社会福利，也可能适得其反。

records.title_en: Acquisitions, Innovation and the Entrenchment of Monopoly
records.title_cn: 收购、创新与垄断的巩固
records.abstract_en: We analyze a dynamic model of repeated innovation where inventors may either be acquired by an incumbent or else resist takeover and challenge for leadership. In the short run, acquisitions always spur innovation because of the invention‐for‐buyout effect. In the longer run, however, they may stifle it because of a countervailing effect, the entrenchment of monopoly. The latter occurs when the incumbent's dominance depends on past levels of activity and is therefore reinforced by recurrent acquisitions. We show that if the entrenchment effect is sufficiently strong, forward‐looking policymakers should prohibit acquisitions in anticipation of the long‐run negative impact on innovation. This argument sets out a new theory of harm that can be used to block acquisitions that could otherwise go unchallenged.
records.abstract_cn: 我们分析了一个重复创新的动态模型，其中发明者可能被现有企业收购，或者抵制收购并挑战领导地位。短期内，收购总是促进创新，因为存在发明以换取收购的效应。然而，从长期来看，收购可能抑制创新，原因是存在一个相反的效应，即垄断的巩固。当现有企业的主导地位依赖于过去的活动水平，并因此被反复的收购所强化时，就会出现这种情况。我们表明，如果垄断巩固效应足够强烈，具有前瞻性的政策制定者应禁止收购，以预防其对创新的长期负面影响。该论点提出了一种新的损害理论，可用于阻止那些本可能不受挑战的收购行为。

records.title_en: Why Is Exclusivity in Broadcasting Rights Prevalent and Why Does Simple Regulation Fail?
records.title_cn: 为什么广播权的排他性普遍存在且简单监管为何失败？
records.abstract_en: Pay‐TV firms compete both downstream to attract viewers and upstream to acquire broadcasting rights. Because profits inherited from downstream competition satisfy a convexity property, allocating rights to the dominant firm maximizes the industry profit. Such an exclusive allocation of rights emerges as a robust equilibrium outcome but may fail to maximize welfare. We analyze whether a ban on resale and a ban on package bidding may improve welfare. These corrective policies have no impact on the final allocation but lead to profit redistribution along the value chain.
records.abstract_cn: 付费电视公司在下游争夺观众的同时，在上游争夺广播权。由于下游竞争所继承的利润满足凸性特性，将权利分配给主导企业能够最大化行业利润。这样的排他性权利分配作为稳健的均衡结果出现，但可能无法最大化福利。我们分析禁止转售和禁止套餐竞标是否能够改善福利。这些纠正性政策对最终分配没有影响，但导致价值链上的利润重新分配。

records.title_en: Strategic Trading and Blockholder Dynamics
records.title_cn: 战略交易与大股东动态
records.abstract_en: We study strategic trading by a privately informed blockholder who monitors a company and trades its shares. Private information results in larger block sizes in good states, but by increasing the speed of the blockholder's selling, it can result in lower block sizes in bad states. Despite the heterogeneous impact on expected block size, we show that asymmetric information leads to Pareto improvements: it raises stock prices, benefits small uninformed shareholders, and benefits the block owner, despite the negative impact on liquidity.
records.abstract_cn: 我们研究了一个拥有私人信息的大股东的战略交易行为，该大股东监控一家公司并交易其股票。私人信息导致在良好状态下大股东持股比例更大，但通过加快大股东的卖出速度，可能导致在不良状态下持股比例更低。尽管对预期持股比例的影响存在异质性，我们证明了信息不对称带来了帕累托改进：它提高了股票价格，有利于小型无信息股东，并使大股东受益，尽管对流动性有负面影响。

records.title_en: Physicians as Persuaders: Evidence from Hospitals in China
records.title_cn: 医生作为说服者：中国医院的证据
records.abstract_en: I estimate a Bayesian persuasion model to examine how financial incentives and asymmetric information shape physician–patient interactions. This approach offers new insights into the role of insurance. First, the model predicts that patients' coinsurance moderates physicians' responsiveness to increases in service fees. This prediction is supported by a difference‐in‐differences analysis using Chinese health insurance claims data with random variation in physicians' reimbursement and patients' coinsurance rates. Second, the model implies that lower coinsurance rates reduce both patient price elasticity and skepticism, increasing the likelihood of physicians misdirecting patients toward unnecessary treatments. Using structural model estimates, I show that for a diagnosis where surgical treatment is discretionary, nearly half of the patients who received surgery would not have done so were they fully informed. Such misdirection from physicians is greater when coinsurance rates decrease, highlighting a new inefficiency channel beyond moral hazard. I decompose the effect of lowering coinsurance into moral hazard and the novel greater misdirection effect. Counterfactual analysis shows that, while patients benefit from lower out‐of‐pocket costs, greater misdirection nearly offsets these welfare gains.
records.abstract_cn: 我估计了一个贝叶斯说服模型，以检验财务激励和信息不对称如何影响医患互动。该方法为保险的作用提供了新的见解。模型预测患者的共付比例调节医生对服务费用增加的响应性。该预测得到了利用中国健康保险理赔数据的双重差分分析的支持，该数据中医生报销和患者共付比例存在随机变异。模型还表明，较低的共付比例降低了患者的价格弹性和怀疑态度，增加了医生将患者误导至不必要治疗的可能性。利用结构模型估计，我展示了对于手术治疗属于自由裁量的诊断，近一半接受手术的患者如果信息充分，原本不会接受手术。医生的这种误导在共付比例降低时更为严重，凸显了超越道德风险的新型低效渠道。我将降低共付比例的效应分解为道德风险和新发现的更大误导效应。反事实分析显示，尽管患者因降低自付费用而受益，但更大的误导效应几乎抵消了这些福利增益。

records.title_en: Opportunity costs of rewetting agriculturally used organic soils in Germany
records.title_cn: 德国农业利用有机土壤再湿化的机会成本
records.abstract_en: Rewetting organic soils used in agriculture to lower GHG emissions makes current land use practices impossible, leading to costs that go beyond the technical aspects of rewetting. Farmers have to forgo the profits that could be achieved with the drained use of organic soils. We estimate these costs at the municipal level based on a crop-type map generated using remote sensing technologies, combined with short-term standard gross margins and long-term tenure fees. We estimate the maximum of average short-term opportunity costs of rewetting one hectare of organic soil to range from €674 in Brandenburg to €2726 in Lower Saxony. Relating the maximum short-term opportunity costs to the GHG mitigation potential of rewetting organic soils yields mitigation costs ranging from €24 to €91 per t CO2eq among federal states. This is substantially below the estimated economic welfare losses of €237 per ton of CO2 emitted (UBA, 2023), even if additional costs of rewetting, such as engineering and management costs, are accounted for. Recently introduced federal state-specific interventions for peatland protection measures under the second pillar of the “Common Agricultural Policy" (CAP) can cover the average short-term opportunity costs of rewetting if combined with other CAP second pillar interventions. However, the interventions do not capture the high variability in opportunity costs across a federal state and have a reliable time horizon of only 7 years. Our results can inform the design of region- and farm-type-specific compensation measures to make rewetting attractive to farmers. Furthermore, they are relevant for a cost-benefit analysis of rewetting agriculturally used organic soils. Finally, they can inform debates on rewetting organic soils in other EU member states.
records.abstract_cn: 为了降低温室气体排放而对农业利用的有机土壤进行再湿化，使得当前的土地利用方式无法继续，由此产生的成本超出了再湿化的技术层面。农民必须放弃通过排水利用有机土壤所能获得的利润。我们基于利用遥感技术生成的作物类型图，结合短期标准毛利润和长期租赁费用，在市级层面估算这些成本。我们估算，再湿化一公顷有机土壤的最大平均短期机会成本范围从勃兰登堡的€674到下萨克森州的€2726。将最大短期机会成本与再湿化有机土壤的温室气体减排潜力相关联，得出各联邦州的减排成本范围为每吨二氧化碳当量€24至€91。这远低于每吨CO2排放的估计经济福利损失€237（UBA，2023），即使考虑到再湿化的额外成本，如工程和管理成本，也是如此。最近在“共同农业政策”（CAP）第二支柱下引入的针对泥炭地保护措施的联邦州特定干预措施，如果与其他CAP第二支柱干预措施结合，可以覆盖再湿化的平均短期机会成本。然而，这些干预措施并未捕捉到联邦州内机会成本的高度变异性，且可靠的时间跨度仅为7年。我们的结果可以为设计针对地区和农场类型的补偿措施提供信息，以使再湿化对农民具有吸引力。此外，它们对于再湿化农业利用有机土壤的成本效益分析具有相关性。最后，它们可以为其他欧盟成员国关于再湿化有机土壤的辩论提供信息。

records.title_en: Transboundary ecosystem service flows in Central Asia: Enhancing global sustainable development goals (SDGs) through the grain–water-carbon-culture network (GWCCN)
records.title_cn: 中亚跨境生态系统服务流：通过粮食-水-碳-文化网络（GWCCN）增强全球可持续发展目标（SDGs）
records.abstract_en: Transboundary ecosystem service flows (ESFs) are crucial links that connect natural and social systems across regions. With its unique geographical advantages, Central Asia serves as a strategic hub for regional and global connectivity, contributing to trade, cultural exchange, and technological development. This study presents a framework for understanding how ESFs support the achievement of SDGs in 7 transboundary countries and 195 nations globally, with a focus on the cross-border and remote effects of the grain–water–carbon–culture network (GWCCN) in Central Asia. Our findings highlight that water yield and soil conservation services in the Syr Darya and Amu Darya Basins were critical for downstream countries, with Uzbekistan and Turkmenistan relying on upstream flows from Tajikistan and Kyrgyzstan (30% and 21% deficits, respectively). Grain production was concentrated in Uzbekistan (35% of total flows), whereas carbon storage and habitat quality services were highly concentrated in the Fergana Valley (40% and 70%, respectively). Cross-border spillovers benefit neighboring countries and global regions. Approximately 20 million people rely on Central Asia–China transboundary rivers. Globally, water exports range from 0.3 to 82.17 billion t, grain exports range from 0.003 to 8.52 billion t, tourism and cultural flows attract 43.86 billion visitors, and carbon and habitat quality services cover 0.09–7.53 billion ha. Importantly, the ESFs of Central Asia significantly support SDG achievement, with contribution rates of 80–90% in China and Russia, 40–60% in Iran and Afghanistan, and < 10% in Pakistan, Azerbaijan, and Mongolia. Globally, the United States, India, and EU countries receive 43%, 36%, and 13–17%, respectively, supporting the SDGs related to food security, climate action, and socioeconomic development. Overall, Central Asia occupies a strategic position in the global ESF network. Its GWCCN-related ESFs are critical for regional and global ecological security, food provision, climate regulation, and SDG advancement, highlighting the need for coordinated management, sustainable utilization, and the promotion of trade, tourism, and cultural industries.
records.abstract_cn: 跨境生态系统服务流（ESFs）是连接跨区域自然和社会系统的关键纽带。中亚凭借其独特的地理优势，成为区域和全球互联互通的战略枢纽，促进贸易、文化交流和技术发展。本研究提出了一个框架，以理解ESFs如何支持7个跨境国家和全球195个国家的SDGs实现，重点关注中亚粮食-水-碳-文化网络（GWCCN）的跨境和远程效应。我们的研究结果强调，锡尔河和阿姆河流域的水产量和土壤保持服务对下游国家至关重要，乌兹别克斯坦和土库曼斯坦依赖来自塔吉克斯坦和吉尔吉斯斯坦的上游流量（分别存在30%和21%的赤字）。粮食生产集中在乌兹别克斯坦（占总流量的35%），而碳储存和栖息地质量服务高度集中在费尔干纳谷地（分别为40%和70%）。跨境溢出效应惠及邻国和全球区域。约20百万人依赖中亚-中国跨境河流。在全球范围内，水出口量在0.3至82.17十亿吨之间，粮食出口量在0.003至8.52十亿吨之间，旅游和文化流动吸引43.86十亿游客，碳和栖息地质量服务覆盖0.09-7.53十亿公顷。重要的是，中亚的ESFs显著支持SDGs的实现，在中国和俄罗斯的贡献率为80-90%，在伊朗和阿富汗为40-60%，在巴基斯坦、阿塞拜疆和蒙古低于10%。在全球范围内，美国、印度和欧盟国家分别获得43%、36%和13-17%的支持，涉及粮食安全、气候行动和社会经济发展相关的SDGs。总体而言，中亚在全球ESF网络中占据战略地位。其与GWCCN相关的ESFs对区域和全球生态安全、粮食供应、气候调节和SDG推进至关重要，凸显了协调管理、可持续利用以及促进贸易、旅游和文化产业的必要性。

records.title_en: Land use change in rural Bhutan – Implications for forest carbon stocks and climate change mitigation
records.title_cn: 不丹农村土地利用变化——对森林碳储量和减缓气候变化的影响
records.abstract_en: Land use in Bhutan has undergone substantial change over the past several decades. Forest cover increased by about 1100 km² and shrubland by about 2000 km² during the 25-year period to 2020, mostly at the expense of agricultural land. Using participatory rural appraisal techniques to assess perceptions of stakeholders on the extent and direction of land use changes and the impacts on forests, revealed that there have been major changes to farming systems in recent decades. Most are associated with changed animal husbandry practices (large reduction in sheep and cattle numbers and shift from open range grazing of local cattle breeds to stall feeding of improved breeds), cessation of shifting cultivation, abandonment of agricultural land and less intensive agricultural practices. An estimated 50–400 ha per village of abandoned grazing land, shifting cultivation areas and other state reserve forest lands are now converting to shrublands and forests. There is a possibility of bringing some or all of this land under Community Forestry management with the explicit aim of increasing forest biomass and carbon sequestration. If each of the existing 839 community forests across Bhutan is increased by about 50 ha, an additional 0.12 million MgCO2 could be sequestered annually, generating a potential annual revenue of about $US 1.2 million if the additional carbon could be sold into the carbon market.
records.abstract_cn: 过去几十年来，不丹的土地利用发生了显著变化。截至1100年的2000年间，森林覆盖面积增加了约25平方公里，灌木地增加了约2020平方公里，这主要以牺牲农业用地为代价。通过参与式农村评估方法评估利益相关者对土地利用变化程度、方向及其对森林影响的认知，结果显示近几十年来农业系统发生了重大变化。这些变化大多与畜牧业实践的改变有关（绵羊和牛的数量大幅减少，从本地牛种的开阔放牧转向改良品种的舍饲）、刀耕火种的停止、农业用地的弃耕以及农业实践的集约化程度降低。估计每个村庄有50-400公顷的废弃放牧地、刀耕火种区域和其他国家储备林地正在转变为灌木地和森林。有可能将这些土地的部分或全部纳入社区林业管理，明确目标是增加森林生物量和碳封存。如果不丹现有的839个社区森林每个增加约50公顷，每年可额外封存0.12百万吨二氧化碳当量，如果额外的碳能够出售到碳市场，每年可产生约1.2万美元的潜在收入。

records.title_en: Land concentration, market regulation, and rural development: Rethinking agricultural land governance in Ukraine
records.title_cn: 土地集中、市场规制与农村发展：重新思考乌克兰农业土地治理
records.abstract_en: Land concentration and the regulation of agricultural land markets are central challenges for equitable and sustainable rural development. This paper examines Ukraine’s agricultural land market through the lens of a human rights-based approach, highlighting the tensions between market mechanisms, social equity, and sustainable land governance. Ukraine represents a unique case, undergoing simultaneous post-socialist transformation, wartime disruption, and prospective accession to the European Union. Using official land market monitoring data (2021–2025), statistical and spatial analyses, and comparative perspectives with EU member states, the study evaluates land distribution dynamics, pricing, and the impact of war on market functioning. Results show that despite wartime conditions, the market remains active but exhibits undervaluation, high inequality, and accelerating concentration of ownership. The Gini coefficient of 0.469 for individual landowners confirms rising disparities, exacerbated by the 10,000-hectare ownership cap. These dynamics threaten small-scale farmers, biodiversity, and rural livelihoods, while existing state support measures remain insufficient to address structural imbalances. The analysis underscores the limitations of markets in securing land rights and the necessity of strong state regulation. Drawing on EU experience, the paper argues that aligning national land policy with principles of human rights, sustainability, and rural development is crucial. Ukraine’s case highlights broader debates on land governance, demonstrating how regulation can balance private property rights with societal interests in food security, ecological stewardship, and intergenerational justice.
records.abstract_cn: 土地集中和农业土地市场的规制是实现公平和可持续农村发展的核心挑战。本文通过基于人权的方法审视乌克兰的农业土地市场，强调市场机制、社会公平和可持续土地治理之间的紧张关系。乌克兰是一个独特的案例，同时经历后社会主义转型、战时干扰以及即将加入欧盟的过程。利用官方土地市场监测数据（2021-2025）、统计和空间分析以及与欧盟成员国的比较视角，本研究评估了土地分配动态、定价以及战争对市场运作的影响。结果表明，尽管处于战时条件，市场仍然活跃，但表现出低估、高度不平等和所有权加速集中的特征。个体土地所有者的基尼系数为0.469，确认了不断加剧的差距，而10,000公顷的所有权上限进一步加剧了这一问题。这些动态威胁着小农、生物多样性和农村生计，而现有的国家支持措施不足以解决结构性失衡。分析强调了市场在保障土地权利方面的局限性以及强有力的国家规制的必要性。借鉴欧盟经验，本文认为将国家土地政策与人权、可持续性和农村发展的原则对齐至关重要。乌克兰的案例凸显了关于土地治理的更广泛辩论，展示了规制如何在食品安全、生态管理和代际正义方面平衡私有财产权与社会利益。

records.title_en: Comparative spatio-temporal and morphological analysis of urban growth using local climate zones in southern Chile
records.title_cn: 智利南部城市增长的时空与形态比较分析：基于局地气候分区
records.abstract_en: Southern Chilean cities have experienced rapid urbanisation at the detriment of agricultural use and native forest cover, but data and documentation describing this transformation are limited. This study utilized the Local Climate Zones (LCZ) framework to contribute to traditional land use and land cover change studies by incorporating urban morphology and surface characteristics into a spatio-temporal analysis. The cities of Temuco, Valdivia, and Puerto Montt, which belong to the southern macrozone of Chile, serve as case studies. To evaluate spatio-temporal change based on LCZ, the WUDAPT method was applied by visual interpretation and supervised classification of satellite images and combined with transition analysis and landscape metrics. The results indicate that LCZ related to low-rise and sparse buildings have increased steadily over a 30-year period. From 1988/90–2020, two urban LCZ stand out with high average annual growth rates: LCZ 9-Sparsely built grew on average by 8%, and LCZ 8-Large low rise by 9%. The study reveals significant rural landscape transformation in the analyzed cities, including loss of farmland and ecological areas. Despite this, about 80% of the landscape remains unchanged due to LCZ persistence across all classes. Urban expansion is occurring at the expense of small forest and agricultural zones. These findings support better urban planning by clarifying patterns of urban growth and fragmentation in medium-sized cities.
records.abstract_cn: 智利南部城市经历了快速城市化，以牺牲农业用地和原生森林覆盖为代价，但描述这一转变的数据和文献有限。本研究利用局地气候分区（LCZ）框架，通过将城市形态和地表特征纳入时空分析，为传统的土地利用和土地覆盖变化研究做出贡献。特木科、瓦尔迪维亚和蒙特港这三个属于智利南部大区的城市作为案例研究。为了基于LCZ评估时空变化，采用WUDAPT方法，通过目视解译和卫星图像监督分类，并结合转移分析和景观指标。结果表明，与低层和稀疏建筑相关的LCZ在30年期间稳步增加。从1988/90-2020年，两个城市LCZ的年均增长率突出：LCZ 9-稀疏建筑平均增长8%，LCZ 8-大型低层建筑增长9%。研究揭示了所分析城市中显著的乡村景观转变，包括农田和生态区域的损失。尽管如此，由于LCZ在所有类别中的持续性，约80%的景观保持不变。城市扩张正在以牺牲小片森林和农业区域为代价。这些发现通过阐明中等城市中城市增长和碎片化的模式，支持更好的城市规划。

records.title_en: Stadium sitings: A before and after look at land use changes and how these reflect urban agendas
records.title_cn: 体育场馆选址：土地利用变化的前后对比及其对城市议程的反映
records.abstract_en: U.S. cities have continuously pursued sport stadium development as an economic development strategy. Meanwhile, there remains little understanding of the actual land use changes that have occurred within stadium areas or how these land use changes reflect stadium-area planning and development goals. We ask, what are the land use changes surrounding stadium sitings? Through spatial analysis of four sports stadiums in three U.S. cities (Chicago, Illinois; Columbus, Ohio; and Minneapolis, Minnesota), we find that stadiums are sited in spaces experiencing or expected to experience development and station areas involved extensive but diverse land use changes. The significance of this study resides in results showing the lack of connection between local visions and land use changes. That is, land use changes did not necessarily reflect local visions or development goals. In addition, we find evidence that stadium sitings increase residential land uses in the surrounding area. The percentage change in area of a land use class reflects local economic development planning efforts. Each stadium’s context, including the planning goals, neighborhood type, and land use classification system varied. Our research highlights the difficulties in accessing land use data and evaluating changes over time–particularly for such substantial public investments. This work is important because it shows that in order for cities to use stadiums to provide targeted outcomes, clear visions and goals must be linked to land use and zoning. As land use determines the activities and developments that can occur within station areas, contextually specific visions and goals of stadium area development tied to land use can greatly influence the types of changes that occur in these areas.
records.abstract_cn: 美国城市持续将体育场馆开发作为经济发展策略。然而，对于体育场馆区域内实际发生的土地利用变化，或这些土地利用变化如何反映场馆区域规划和开发目标，我们仍知之甚少。我们提出疑问：体育场馆选址周边的土地利用变化是什么？通过对美国三个城市（伊利诺伊州芝加哥、俄亥俄州哥伦布和明尼苏达州明尼阿波利斯）中四个体育场馆的空间分析，我们发现体育场馆选址于正在经历或预期经历开发的区域，且站点区域涉及广泛而多样的土地利用变化。本研究的意义在于结果显示地方愿景与土地利用变化之间缺乏联系。也就是说，土地利用变化不一定反映地方愿景或开发目标。此外，我们发现有证据表明体育场馆选址增加了周边地区的住宅用地使用。土地利用类别面积变化的百分比反映了地方经济发展规划的努力。每个场馆的背景，包括规划目标、社区类型和土地利用分类系统各不相同。我们的研究强调了获取土地利用数据和评估随时间变化的难度——尤其是对于如此大规模公共投资而言。这项工作很重要，因为它表明，为了使城市利用体育场馆实现有针对性的成果，清晰的愿景和目标必须与土地利用和分区相关联。由于土地利用决定了站点区域内可进行的活动和开发，与土地利用相关联的场馆区域开发的特定背景愿景和目标可以极大地影响这些区域发生的变化类型。

records.title_en: The double-edged impact of inclusive urban land redevelopment in China: Welfare gains and urban disparities
records.title_cn: 中国包容性城市土地再开发的双刃剑效应：福利增益与城市差距
records.abstract_en: This study investigates the distributional welfare effects of inclusive Urban Land Redevelopment (ULR) under China’s New-Type Urbanization Plan (NTUP). Constructing a novel Spatial Human Development Index (SHDI) for 279 cities (2010–2020) and integrating micro-level migrant data, we employ System GMM and triple-difference models to uncover a trade-off between aggregate development and spatial equity. We find that the post-2014 policy shift successfully reversed the welfare-reducing effects of earlier ULR, generating aggregate gains. However, these benefits are structurally asymmetric. Developed cities leverage superior institutional capacity to convert industrial and public-service redevelopment into welfare improvements, whereas less-developed cities realize limited returns despite substantial migration inflows. Micro-level analysis reveals that ULR drives skill-differentiated sorting. In developed cities, ULR significantly increases the retention of low-skilled labor while compressing high-skilled wage premiums, thereby narrowing within-city inequality. Conversely, it exacerbates between-city disparities by triggering an outflow of high-skilled workers from less-developed areas. These findings demonstrate that ULR enhances aggregate efficiency while widening regional disparities, necessitating differentiated strategies that pair physical redevelopment with institutional strengthening in lagging regions.
records.abstract_cn: 本研究探讨了中国新型城镇化规划下包容性城市土地再开发（ULR）的分配性福利效应。我们为279个城市（2010-2020年）构建了新颖的空间人类发展指数（SHDI），并结合微观层面的移民数据，采用系统GMM和三重差分模型，揭示了总体发展与空间公平之间的权衡。研究发现，2014年后的政策转变成功逆转了早期ULR的福利减少效应，产生了总体增益。然而，这些收益在结构上是不对称的。发达城市利用其优越的制度能力，将工业和服务业再开发转化为福利改善，而欠发达城市尽管有大量移民流入，却实现了有限的回报。微观层面分析显示，ULR驱动了技能差异化的分类。在发达城市，ULR显著提高了低技能劳动力的留存率，同时压缩了高技能劳动力的工资溢价，从而缩小了城市内部的不平等。相反，它通过引发欠发达地区高技能劳动力的外流，加剧了城市间的差距。这些发现表明，ULR在提高总体效率的同时扩大了区域差距，因此需要在落后地区采取将物理再开发与制度强化相结合的差异化策略。

records.title_en: Compact urban development and green space accessibility: Micro-evidence from Chinese cities
records.title_cn: 紧凑城市发展与绿地可达性：来自中国城市的微观证据
records.abstract_en: Green spaces have been proven to significantly enhance physical and mental health, and optimizing urban layouts is widely recognized as a key strategy to improve the accessibility of such beneficial environments. Based on the data of 450,000 individual questionnaires covering 59 cities nationwide, provided by the Ministry of Housing and Urban-Rural Development of China in 2021, this study uses an econometric model to explore the impact of urban compactness on individual green space accessibility and its underlying mechanisms. The findings show that compact urban form exerts a positive impact on green space accessibility, and this positive effect is mainly driven by relatively scattered and sprawling cities rather than already compact ones. The improvement effect of compact development on green space accessibility only has practical significance when the compactness index is ≥ 2. This moderate positive net effect stems from the balance of multiple mechanisms: the positive mediating role of transportation convenience is stronger than that of spatial proximity, while the crowding-out effect on green space scale serves as the primary negative constraint with a more significant impact than density discomfort. Optimizing urban form to improve green space accessibility is crucial for urban air purification, microclimate regulation, and residents' recreational well-being. The research results provide valuable references for policymakers to improve urban spatial structures and advance the construction of green cities.
