A valid objective function is obtained through a simple adjustment on the concentrated quasi loglikelihood with fixed effects being concentrated out, which leads to a consistent estimation of all common parameters. We show that the estimation of threshold parameter has a negligible effect on the asymptotic distribution of the main parameter estimators and thereby regular inference methods apply, though a bias correction may be necessary. The limiting distribution of the threshold parameter estimator is shown to be non-regular and infeasible, and for inference, a likelihood ratio test procedure is proposed. The test for the non-existence of threshold effects faces an identification issue at the null. To overcome this difficulty, we propose a sup-Wald test and a bootstrap method for its critical values. Monte Carlo results show that the proposed methods perform well in finite samples. An empirical application is presented on age-of-leader effects on political competitions across Chinese cities.
records.abstract_cn: 本文在阈值效应随样本量增加而减弱（diminishing-threshold-effects）的框架下，针对具有双向固定效应的阈值空间面板回归模型，提出了一套通用的估计与推断方法。通过对剔除固定效应后的集中拟对数似然函数进行简单调整，我们构建了一个有效的目标函数，从而实现了对所有公共参数的一致估计。研究表明，阈值参数的估计对主要参数估计量的渐近分布影响微乎其微，因此标准的推断方法依然适用，尽管可能需要进行偏差校正。阈值参数估计量的极限分布被证明是非正则的且不可直接用于推断，为此我们提出了一种基于似然比检验的推断程序。关于是否存在阈值效应的检验在原假设下存在识别问题；为克服这一困难，我们提出了一种上确界Wald检验（sup-Wald test），并给出了确定其临界值的自助法（bootstrap method）。蒙特卡洛模拟结果显示，所提方法在有限样本下表现良好。最后，本文展示了一个关于领导人年龄对中国城市间政治竞争影响的实证应用。

records.title_en: Censored partial linear quantile regression with endogeneity
records.title_cn: 具有内生性的截尾部分线性分位数回归
records.abstract_en: This paper considers the estimation of a censored partial linear quantile regression model with endogeneity. Our method extends those for partial linear quantile regression (Lee, 2003, Qu et al. 2024), nonparametric quantile regression (Qu and Yoon, 2015, Belloni et al., 2019), and censored linear quantile regression with endogeneity (Chen, 2018). Our estimation method involves a tractable sequential-multiple-step procedure. We establish the uniform consistency, the uniform representation and the asymptotic normality for the proposed estimators. We further extend our analysis to allow for sample selection. A set of Monte Carlo experiments show that our estimators have a good finite sample performance and an empirical application is given to show the usefulness of our estimators.
records.abstract_cn: 本文探讨了具有内生性的截断（或称“受限”）部分线性分位数回归模型的估计问题。我们的方法扩展了针对部分线性分位数回归（Lee, 2003; Qu 等, 2024）、非参数分位数回归（Qu 和 Yoon, 2015; Belloni 等, 2019）以及具有内生性的截断线性分位数回归（Chen, 2018）的现有方法。我们采用了一种易于操作的序贯多步估计程序，并证明了所提估计量具有一致性（一致收敛性）、一致表示性质及渐近正态性。此外，我们将分析范围进行了扩展，以涵盖样本选择问题。蒙特卡洛模拟实验结果表明，该估计量在有限样本下表现良好；本文还提供了一个实证应用案例，以展示该估计量的实用价值。

records.title_en: MCA: High-dimensional modal component analysis towards the mode
records.title_cn: MCA：面向模态的高维模态分量分析
records.abstract_en: The modal factor model represents a novel statistical framework for dimension reduction in high dimensional panel data analysis. It is specifically designed to capture modal factors which exert a significant influence on the conditional mode of the distribution of the observables. Statistical inference for this model is developed based on a newly proposed modal component analysis, where modal factors and their corresponding loadings are estimated through maximizing a kernel-type objective function. Two computationally efficient and easy-to-implement algorithms—minorization-maximization and alternating maximization—are devised for the numerical computation of these estimators. Furthermore, two model selection criteria are proposed to determine the optimal number of modal factors. Under mild regularity conditions that accommodate both cross-sectional and time-series dependence, the asymptotic properties of the proposed estimators are established. Additionally, the limiting distributions of parameter estimators and forecasts derived from factor-augmented regressions incorporating estimated modal factors are rigorously derived. Simulation studies demonstrate that the proposed estimators exhibit favorable finite-sample performance, even in the presence of heavy-tailed, skewed, multimodal, and heteroskedastic error distributions. Finally, an application to inflation and industrial production index forecasting validates the practical merits and superior predictive power of modal factors in real-world macroeconomic scenarios.
records.abstract_cn: 模态因子模型为高维面板数据分析中的降维提供了一种新颖的统计框架。该模型专门用于捕捉那些对可观测变量分布的条件众数（conditional mode）具有显著影响的模态因子。针对该模型的统计推断基于新提出的模态成分分析方法，通过最大化核型目标函数来估计模态因子及其相应的因子载荷。为实现这些估计量的数值计算，文中设计了两种计算高效且易于实现的算法：小化-最大化（MM）算法和交替最大化算法。此外，还提出了两种模型选择准则，用于确定模态因子的最优数量。在涵盖截面相关性和时间序列相关性的温和正则条件下，确立了所提估计量的渐近性质。同时，严格推导了参数估计量以及基于估计模态因子的因子增强回归预测值的极限分布。模拟研究表明，即使在误差分布呈现重尾、偏态、多峰或异方差特征的情况下，所提估计量仍表现出良好的有限样本性能。最后，针对通货膨胀和工业生产指数的预测应用，验证了模态因子在实际宏观经济场景中的实用价值与卓越预测能力。

records.title_en: A goodness-of-fit test for sparse networks
records.title_cn: 稀疏网络的拟合优度检验
records.abstract_en: The stochastic block model (SBM) has been widely used to analyze network data. Various goodness-of-fit tests have been proposed to assess the adequacy of model structures. To the best of our knowledge, however, none of the existing approaches are applicable for sparse networks in which the connection probability of any two communities is of order n−1logn, and the number of communities is divergent. To fill this gap, we propose a novel goodness-of-fit test for the stochastic block model. The key idea is to construct a maximal statistic from subsampled entry-wise deviations of the adjacency matrix, using the sampling process to alleviate the negative effects of network sparsity. We demonstrate theoretically that the proposed test statistic converges to the Type-I extreme value distribution under the null hypothesis regardless of the network structure. Accordingly, it can be applied to both dense and sparse networks. In addition, we obtain the asymptotic power against alternatives. Moreover, we introduce a bootstrap-corrected test statistic to improve the finite sample performance, recommend an augmented test statistic to increase the power, and extend the proposed test to the degree-corrected SBM. Simulation studies and two empirical examples with both dense and sparse networks indicate that the proposed method performs well.
records.abstract_cn: 随机块模型（SBM）已广泛用于分析网络数据。已经提出了各种拟合优度检验来评估模型结构的充分性。然而，据我们所知，现有的方法都不适用于稀疏网络，其中任何两个社区的连接概率为 n−1logn 量级，并且社区数量不同。为了填补这一空白，我们提出了一种新颖的随机块模型拟合优度检验。关键思想是根据邻接矩阵的子采样条目偏差构建最大统计量，使用采样过程来减轻网络稀疏性的负面影响。我们从理论上证明，无论网络结构如何，所提出的检验统计量都会在原假设下收敛到 I 型极值分布。因此，它可以应用于密集网络和稀疏网络。此外，我们还获得了针对替代方案的渐近幂。此外，我们引入了引导校正检验统计量来提高有限样本性能，推荐增强检验统计量来提高功效，并将所提出的检验扩展到度数校正的 SBM。仿真研究和密集网络和稀疏网络的两个实证例子表明，所提出的方法表现良好。

records.title_en: Estimating individual responses when tomorrow matters
records.title_cn: 当着眼于未来时，评估个体反应
records.abstract_en: We propose an approach to estimate how individuals’ expectations influence their responses to a counterfactual change. The approach relies on average partial effects, which recover counterfactual impacts under conditions that we specify. We propose a three-step estimation method that relies on panel data on subjective expectations. We illustrate our approach in a model of consumption and saving, focusing on the impact of an income tax that not only changes current income but also affects beliefs about future income. Applying our approach to Italian survey data, we find that individuals’ beliefs matter for evaluating the impact of tax policies on consumption decisions.
records.abstract_cn: 我们提出了一种估算方法，用于评估个人预期如何影响其对反事实变动的反应。该方法基于平均偏效应（average partial effects），能够在我们设定的条件下还原反事实影响。我们提出了一种利用主观预期面板数据的三步估算方法，并通过一个消费与储蓄模型展示了该方法的应用；该模型重点考察了所得税的影响，这种税收不仅改变当前收入，还会影响个人对未来收入的预期。通过将该方法应用于意大利的调查数据，我们发现，在评估税收政策对消费决策的影响时，个人的预期起着重要作用。

records.title_en: Noncausal AR processes driven by causal GARCH volatility
records.title_cn: 由因果性 GARCH 波动率驱动的非因果性 AR 过程
records.abstract_en: This paper studies the introduction of causal conditional heteroskedasticity in noncausal autoregressive (AR) models. We demonstrate that, in this framework, large shocks to the innovation process driving the GARCH error term of a noncausal AR model result in heightened volatility immediately before and after a bubble crash. The non-coincidence of the σ-fields generated by past observations and past values of the GARCH process makes statistical inference nonstandard. In particular, the full quasi-maximum likelihood estimator (QMLE) is generally inconsistent. We investigate the asymptotic properties of three-step weighted least squares estimators of the AR coefficient and the QMLE of the volatility parameters. Our findings are illustrated by Monte Carlo experiments and an empirical application to financial data.
records.abstract_cn: 本文研究了在非因果自回归（AR）模型中引入因果条件异方差性的问题。我们证明，在此框架下，驱动非因果 AR 模型 GARCH 误差项的新息过程若遭受剧烈冲击，会导致泡沫破裂前后出现波动率加剧的现象。由历史观测值生成的 $\sigma$-域与由 GARCH 过程历史值生成的 $\sigma$-域并不重合，这使得统计推断变得非标准；特别是，完全准极大似然估计量（QMLE）通常不具备一致性。我们考察了 AR 系数的三步加权最小二乘估计量以及波动率参数 QMLE 的渐近性质，并通过蒙特卡洛实验及金融数据实证分析验证了相关结论。

records.title_en: Asymptotics of CoVaR inference in two-quantile-regression
records.title_cn: 双分位数回归中 CoVaR 推断的渐近性质
records.abstract_en: Measuring systemic risk has been an important topic in recent research on risk management. Adrian and Brunnermeier (2016) pioneered the CoVaR measure for systemic risk, which is defined as the conditional quantile of system loss given some state predictors and one stress event of an individual loss at a certain risk level. They proposed to estimate CoVaR by a two-quantile-regression approach, which is simple and easy to implement in practice, but without stating or developing the necessary asymptotic theory. In this paper, we develop tests to reveal that using the classical regularity condition in quantile regressions for the two-quantile-regression model may be unrealistic by revisiting the datasets in Adrian and Brunnermeier (2016). Under the proposed weaker conditions, we further develop the asymptotic theory of the CoVaR inference and introduce a random weighted bootstrap method to quantify the inference uncertainty. We examine the finite sample performance of the proposed tests in terms of size and power, as well as the coverage probabilities of confidence intervals for CoVaR. Finally, we demonstrate the CoVaR inference across financial institutions and time.
records.abstract_cn: 系统性风险的度量一直是近期风险管理研究中的重要课题。Adrian 和 Brunnermeier (2016) 开创性地提出了用于度量系统性风险的 CoVaR 指标；该指标定义为在给定状态预测变量以及个体损失在特定风险水平下发生压力事件的条件下，系统损失的条件分位数。他们提出利用“双重分位数回归”方法来估计 CoVaR，该方法简单且易于实际操作，但未阐述或推导相关的渐近理论。本文通过重新分析 Adrian 和 Brunnermeier (2016) 使用的数据集，通过构建检验发现，将分位数回归中的经典正则性条件应用于双重分位数回归模型可能并不切合实际。在本文提出的较弱条件下，我们进一步推导了 CoVaR 推断的渐近理论，并引入随机加权自助法（random weighted bootstrap）来量化推断的不确定性。我们考察了所提检验在检验规模（size）和功效（power）方面的有限样本表现，以及 CoVaR 置信区间的覆盖概率。最后，我们展示了针对不同金融机构及不同时间段的 CoVaR 推断结果。

records.title_en: Identification-robust inference for the LATE with high-dimensional covariates
records.title_cn: 具有高维协变量的 LATE 的识别鲁棒推理
records.abstract_en: This paper presents an inference method for the local average treatment effect (LATE) in the presence of high-dimensional covariates, regardless of the strength of identification. We propose an orthogonalized Anderson-Rubin test statistic that maintains uniformly valid asymptotic size. We provide an easy-to-implement algorithm for inferring the high-dimensional LATE by inverting our test statistic and employing the double/debiased machine learning method. Simulation results show that our test achieves better size control under both weak identification and high dimensionality, outperforming conventional alternatives. Applying the proposed method to railroad and population data to study the effect of railroad access on urban population growth, we observe wider confidence intervals than those obtained using conventional methods.
records.abstract_cn: 本文提出了一种在存在高维协变量的情况下推断局部平均治疗效果（LATE）的方法，无论识别的强度如何。我们提出了一种正交的 Anderson-Rubin 检验统计量，它保持一致有效的渐近大小。我们提供了一种易于实现的算法，通过反转我们的测试统计量并采用双/去偏机器学习方法来推断高维 LATE。仿真结果表明，我们的测试在弱识别和高维下都实现了更好的尺寸控制，优于传统的替代方案。将所提出的方法应用于铁路和人口数据来研究铁路通达对城市人口增长的影响，我们观察到比使用传统方法获得的置信区间更宽。

records.title_en: Flexible covariate adjustments in regression discontinuity designs
records.title_cn: 断点回归设计中灵活的协变量调整
records.abstract_en: Empirical regression discontinuity (RD) studies often include covariates in their specifications to increase the precision of their estimates. In this paper, we propose a novel class of estimators that use such covariate information more efficiently than existing methods and can accommodate many covariates. Our estimators are simple to implement and involve running a standard RD analysis after subtracting a function of the covariates from the original outcome variable. We characterize the function of the covariates that minimizes the asymptotic variance of these estimators. We also show that the conventional RD framework gives rise to a special robustness property which implies that the optimal adjustment function can be estimated flexibly via modern machine learning techniques without affecting the first-order properties of the final RD estimator. We demonstrate our methods’ scope for efficiency improvements by reanalyzing data from a large number of recently published empirical studies.
records.abstract_cn: 经验回归不连续性 (RD) 研究通常在其规范中包含协变量，以提高估计的精度。在本文中，我们提出了一类新颖的估计器，它比现有方法更有效地使用此类协变量信息，并且可以容纳许多协变量。我们的估计器很容易实现，并且需要在从原始结果变量中减去协变量函数后运行标准 RD 分析。我们描述了最小化这些估计量的渐近方差的协变量函数。我们还表明，传统的 RD 框架产生了一种特殊的鲁棒性特性，这意味着可以通过现代机器学习技术灵活地估计最优调整函数，而不会影响最终 RD 估计器的一阶特性。我们通过重新分析最近发表的大量实证研究的数据来证明我们的方法提高效率的范围。

records.title_en: Estimation and inference on average treatment effect in percentage points under heterogeneity
records.title_cn: 异质性条件下以百分点计量的平均处理效应的估计与推断
records.abstract_en: In semi-logarithmic regressions, treatment coefficients are often interpreted as approximations of an average treatment effect (ATE) in percentage points. This paper highlights the overlooked bias of this approximation under treatment effect heterogeneity, arising from Jensen’s inequality. The issue is particularly relevant for difference-in-differences designs with log-transformed outcomes and staggered treatment adoption, where treatment effects may vary across groups and periods. This paper proposes new estimation and inference methods for an estimand that accounts for heterogeneity across observable subgroups and can improve upon conventional measures. The estimand provides a lower bound on the ATE in percentage points for the relevant target (sub)population, and coincides with it in the absence of within-group heterogeneity. I establish the methods’ large-sample properties and study their finite-sample performance through Monte Carlo experiments, which reveal substantial discrepancies between conventional and proposed measures when systematic heterogeneity is large. Two empirical applications further underscore the practical importance of these methods.
records.abstract_cn: 在半对数回归中，处理效应系数常被解读为以百分点表示的平均处理效应（ATE）的近似值。本文指出，当存在处理效应异质性时，这种近似方法会产生一种常被忽视的偏差，而该偏差源于延森不等式（Jensen’s inequality）。这一问题在采用对数变换结果变量和交错式处理实施（staggered treatment adoption）的双重差分设计中尤为突出，因为在这类设计中，处理效应可能随群体和时期而变化。本文针对一个能够考量可观测子群体间异质性的待估量（estimand），提出了一套新的估计与推断方法，这些方法优于传统度量指标。该待估量为相关目标（子）群体的以百分点表示的 ATE 提供了下界，且在不存在组内异质性的情况下，该下界与 ATE 相等。本文确立了这些方法的大样本性质，并通过蒙特卡洛实验考察了其有限样本表现；结果显示，当系统性异质性较大时，传统度量指标与本文提出的度量指标之间存在显著差异。两项实证应用进一步凸显了这些方法的实际重要性。

records.title_en: Difference-in-differences with interference
records.title_cn: 干扰的双重差异
records.abstract_en: In many scenarios, such as the evaluation of place-based policies, potential outcomes depend not only on the unit’s own treatment but also on its neighbors’ treatments. Despite this, “difference-in-differences” (DID) type estimators typically ignore such interference among neighbors. I show in this paper that the canonical DID estimators generally fail to identify interesting causal effects in the presence of neighborhood interference. To incorporate interference structure into DID estimation, I propose doubly robust estimators for the direct average treatment effect on the treated under a modified parallel trends assumption. I allow spatially correlated assignments, and later relax common restrictions in the literature, such as immediate neighborhood interference and correctly specified spillover functions. Moreover, this paper focuses on a finite-population conditional-inference framework. Robust inference is discussed based on the asymptotic distribution of the proposed estimators.
records.abstract_cn: 在许多情况下，例如对基于地方的政策的评估，潜在的结果不仅取决于单位本身的待遇，还取决于其邻居的待遇。尽管如此，“双重差分”（DID）类型的估计器通常会忽略邻居之间的这种干扰。我在本文中表明，在存在邻域干扰的情况下，规范的 DID 估计器通常无法识别有趣的因果效应。为了将干扰结构纳入 DID 估计中，我提出了在修改后的平行趋势假设下对治疗对象的直接平均治疗效果的双稳健估计器。我允许空间相关的分配，然后放宽文献中的常见限制，例如直接邻域干扰和正确指定的溢出函数。此外，本文重点关注有限总体条件推理框架。基于所提出的估计量的渐近分布讨论了鲁棒推理。

records.title_en: Dissecting the Phillips curve: Evidence from cross-sectional heterogeneity and regime-dependent nonlinearity
records.title_cn: 剖析菲利普斯曲线：来自截面异质性与依赖于区制的非线性的证据
records.abstract_en: Accurately estimating the Phillips curve remains a significant methodological challenge. Recent panel data approaches reveal substantial cross-sectional heterogeneity, raising doubts about pooled estimates. This paper develops a novel group-based approach that systematically accounts for unobserved heterogeneity in the regional Phillips curve. We identify two distinct groups of U.S. states: one with a steep, significant Phillips curve, and another with a flat, insignificant relationship. Our results show that regional heterogeneity persists across regimes, with parameter nonlinearity emerging during recessions. Much of the flattening of the Phillips curve is region-specific, indicating the importance of both heterogeneity and nonlinearity in Phillips curve dynamics.
records.abstract_cn: 准确估计菲利普斯曲线在方法论上仍是一项重大挑战。近期的面板数据研究揭示了显著的截面异质性，这使得基于混合数据的估计结果受到质疑。本文提出了一种新颖的基于分组的方法，能够系统地考量区域菲利普斯曲线中存在的不可观测异质性。研究识别出美国各州构成的两类截然不同的群体：一类呈现出陡峭且显著的菲利普斯曲线特征，另一类则表现为平坦且不显著的关系。结果表明，区域异质性在不同经济状态下持续存在，且在衰退期出现了参数非线性特征。菲利普斯曲线的平坦化在很大程度上具有区域特异性，这凸显了异质性和非线性在菲利普斯曲线动态演变中的重要作用。

records.title_en: Regression adjustment in completely randomized experiments with many covariates
records.title_cn: 具有许多协变量的完全随机实验的回归调整
records.abstract_en: This paper investigates estimation and inference for average treatment effects in completely randomized experiments when researchers observe potentially many covariates. Within Neyman’s (1923) design-based framework, allowing the number of covariates to grow more slowly than the sample size, we demonstrate that a cross-fitted regression adjustment estimator–adapted from Aronow and Middleton (2013)–exhibits more favorable asymptotic properties than existing alternatives, such as Lin’s (2013) regression adjustment estimator and the bias-corrected estimator of Lei and Ding (2021). For inference, we derive the first- and second-order terms in the stochastic expansions of regression-adjusted estimators, analyze the higher-order behavior of existing inference procedures, and introduce a modified version of the HC3 standard error. The proposed methods extend naturally to stratified experiments with large strata. Simulation studies show that the cross-fitted estimator, in combination with the modified HC3, provides accurate point estimates and reliable size control across a wide range of data-generating processes.
records.abstract_cn: 本文研究了当研究人员观察到潜在的许多协变量时，在完全随机的实验中对平均治疗效果的估计和推断。在 Neyman（1923）基于设计的框架内，允许协变量数量的增长速度比样本大小更慢，我们证明了交叉拟合回归调整估计量（改编自 Aronow 和 Middleton（2013））比现有替代方案（例如 Lin（2013）回归调整估计量和偏差校正估计量）表现出更有利的渐近特性。雷和丁（2021）。为了进行推理，我们推导回归调整估计量的随机展开中的一阶和二阶项，分析现有推理过程的高阶行为，并引入 HC3 标准误差的修改版本。所提出的方法自然地扩展到大地层的分层实验。仿真研究表明，交叉拟合估计器与修改后的 HC3 相结合，可以在各种数据生成过程中提供准确的点估计和可靠的大小控制。

records.title_en: Instrumental variable regression with varying-intensity repeated treatments
records.title_cn: 具有不同强度重复处理的工具变量回归
records.abstract_en: Instrumental variable models with repeated endogenous treatments are popular in empirical research using pooled cross-sectional or short panel datasets. This paper proposes a novel semi-parametric approach that explicitly considers 1) path dependency in the contemporaneous treatment effect and 2) a direct carryover effect from past treatments. We demonstrate that when either of these new features is present, the standard two-stage least squares estimator is generally invalid. We apply the proposed semi-parametric estimation and inference approach to revisit the seminal work of Acemoglu et al. (2016). Using industry-level data, we find that the magnitude of contemporaneous impacts of increased Chinese import competition on US manufacturing employment depends on an industry’s past import exposure. In particular, industries with larger trade shocks in the 1990s tend to experience stronger impacts from contemporaneous trade shocks in the 2000s.
records.abstract_cn: 在利用混合截面数据或短面板数据进行的实证研究中，涉及重复内生处理（repeated endogenous treatments）的工具变量模型应用广泛。本文提出了一种新颖的半参数方法，该方法明确考虑了：1) 当期处理效应中的路径依赖性；以及 二) 既往处理产生的直接滞后效应（carryover effect）。我们证明，当存在上述任一特征时，标准的二阶段最小二乘（2SLS）估计量通常不再有效。我们利用所提出的半参数估计与推断方法，重新考察了 Acemoglu 等人（2）的开创性研究。基于行业层面数据的分析发现，中国进口竞争加剧对美国制造业就业产生的当期影响程度，取决于该行业既往所受的进口冲击暴露情况。具体而言，在 2016 世纪 1990 年代遭受较大贸易冲击的行业，往往会在 2000 世纪头十年受到当期贸易冲击的更强烈影响。

records.title_en: A design-based approach to spatial correlation
records.title_cn: 基于设计的空间相关性方法
records.abstract_en: When observing spatial data, what standard errors should we report? Within a finite population framework, we identify three channels of possible spatial correlation: sampling scheme, assignment design, and model specification. The Eicker-Huber-White standard error, cluster-robust standard error, and spatial-correlation robust inference are compared under different combinations of the three channels. We prove a finite population central limit theorem for weakly dependent random fields that bridges the gap between superpopulation and finite population inference in our unified framework. These limit theorems are then applied to derive the asymptotic distribution of M-estimators and functions of M-estimators. Based on the decomposition of the finite population variance-covariance matrix of M-estimators, standard errors should be adjusted for spatial correlation when effective assignment variables are spatially correlated and/or spillover effects are specified in the model. In the special case where the sampling probabilities approach zero in the limit, the Eicker-Huber-White and cluster-robust standard errors would be close to the spatial-correlation robust standard errors regardless of the spatial correlation among assignment variables.
records.abstract_cn: 观察空间数据时，我们应该报告哪些标准误差？在有限总体框架内，我们确定了可能的空间相关性的三个通道：抽样方案、分配设计和模型规范。在三个通道的不同组合下比较了 Eicker-Huber-White 标准误差、聚类鲁棒标准误差和空间相关鲁棒推理。我们证明了弱相关随机场的有限总体中心极限定理，该定理弥补了我们统一框架中超总体和有限总体推理之间的差距。然后应用这些极限定理来导出 M 估计量的渐近分布和 M 估计量的函数。基于 M 估计量的有限总体方差-协方差矩阵的分解，当模型中指定有效分配变量空间相关和/或溢出效应时，应针对空间相关性调整标准误差。在采样概率极限接近零的特殊情况下，无论分配变量之间的空间相关性如何，Eicker-Huber-White 和聚类鲁棒标准误差将接近空间相关鲁棒标准误差。

records.title_en: Model averaging for time–varying vector autoregressions
records.title_cn: 时变向量自回归的模型平均
records.abstract_en: This paper proposes a novel time-varying model averaging (TVMA) approach to enhancing forecast accuracy for multivariate time series subject to structural changes. The TVMA method averages predictions from a set of time-varying vector autoregressive models using optimal time-varying combination weights selected by minimizing a penalized local criterion. This allows the relative importance of different models to adaptively evolve over time in response to structural shifts. We establish an asymptotic optimality for the proposed TVMA approach in achieving the lowest possible quadratic forecast errors. The convergence rate of the selected time-varying weights to the optimal weights minimizing expected quadratic errors is derived. Moreover, we show that when one or more correctly specified models exist, our method consistently assigns full weight to them, and an asymptotic normality for the TVMA estimators under some regularity conditions can be established. Furthermore, the proposed approach encompasses special cases including time-varying VAR models with exogenous predictors, as well as time-varying factor augmented VAR (FAVAR) models. Simulations and empirical applications illustrate the proposed TVMA method outperforms some commonly used model averaging and selection methods in the presence of structural changes.
records.abstract_cn: 本文提出了一种新颖的时变模型平均（TVMA）方法，以提高面临结构变化的多变量时间序列的预测准确性。TVMA方法通过最小化惩罚局部准则选择最优时变组合权重，对一组时变向量自回归模型的预测进行平均。这使得不同模型的相对重要性能够随着时间推移，响应结构变化而自适应地演变。我们为所提出的TVMA方法建立了渐近最优性，以实现最低可能的二次预测误差。推导了所选时变权重收敛到最小化期望二次误差的最优权重的收敛速率。此外，我们表明，当存在一个或多个正确设定的模型时，我们的方法一致地将全部权重分配给它们，并且在某些正则条件下，可以建立TVMA估计量的渐近正态性。进一步地，所提出的方法涵盖了特殊情况，包括带有外生预测因子的时变VAR模型，以及时变因子增广VAR（FAVAR）模型。模拟和实证应用表明，在存在结构变化的情况下，所提出的TVMA方法优于一些常用的模型平均和选择方法。

records.title_en: Heterogeneous predictability on mutual fund alphas: A sparse clustering GMM approach
records.title_cn: 共同基金阿尔法的异质性可预测性：一种稀疏聚类GMM方法
records.abstract_en: Mutual fund managers’ skills, measured by risk-adjusted alphas, are predictable using fund characteristics identified by machine learning (e.g., Kaniel et al., 2023, JFE; DeMiguel et al., 2023, JFE). However, alpha’s predictive power varies across funds and periods, with most funds exhibiting negligible alphas. To model this heterogeneous predictability, this paper introduces Sparse Clustering GMM, a nonparametric approach for identifying latent fund groups. SCGMM clusters funds using estimated alphas and identifies group-specific parameters tied to market predictors. The method accounts for heterogeneity in cross-sectional grouping and time-varying mechanisms across predictors, without requiring prior cluster information or time-varying specifications. We establish consistency for group recovery and time-varying parameter estimation. Empirically, using monthly U.S. mutual fund data, we find that predictable alpha is concentrated in a small subset of funds, with the majority of funds exhibiting near-zero, weakly predictable alphas. The skilled clusters also exhibit lower benchmark R2, moderate expense ratios, and longer manager tenure.
records.abstract_cn: 共同基金经理的技能，以风险调整后的阿尔法衡量，可以通过机器学习识别的基金特征进行预测（例如，Kaniel等，2023，JFE；DeMiguel等，2023，JFE）。然而，阿尔法的预测能力因基金和时期而异，大多数基金的阿尔法可忽略不计。为了模拟这种异质性可预测性，本文引入了稀疏聚类GMM，一种用于识别潜在基金组的非参数方法。SCGMM使用估计的阿尔法对基金进行聚类，并识别与市场预测因子相关的组特定参数。该方法考虑了横截面分组中的异质性和跨预测因子的时变机制，无需先验聚类信息或时变设定。我们建立了组恢复和时变参数估计的一致性。实证上，使用美国月度共同基金数据，我们发现可预测的阿尔法集中在一小部分基金中，大多数基金的阿尔法接近零，可预测性较弱。技能较高的聚类还表现出较低的基准R2、适中的费用比率和更长的经理任期。

records.title_en: Testing coefficient stability in spatial regression
records.title_cn: 空间回归中系数稳定性的检验
records.abstract_en: This paper develops a test for coefficient variability in spatial regressions. The test is designed to have good power for a wide range of persistent patterns of coefficient variation, be applicable in a wide range of spatial designs, and accommodate spatial correlation in regressors and regression errors. The test approximates the locally best invariant test for coefficient stability in a Gaussian regression model with martingale-like coefficient variation under the alternative, and is thus a spatial generalization of the Nyblom (1989) test of coefficient stability in time series regressions.
records.abstract_cn: 本文开发了一种检验空间回归中系数变异性的方法。该检验旨在对广泛的持续性系数变化模式具有良好的功效，适用于广泛的空间设计，并能容纳回归变量和回归误差中的空间相关性。该检验近似于高斯回归模型中系数稳定性检验的局部最优不变检验，其中备择假设下系数变化具有类似鞅的性质，因此是Nyblom（1989）时间序列回归中系数稳定性检验的空间推广。

records.title_en: Optimal monetary policy with confounding information
records.title_cn: 具有混杂信息的最优货币政策
records.abstract_en: In this paper, we study optimal monetary policy in an economy where firms’ price-setting decisions are distorted by a signal-extraction problem: they cannot perfectly distinguish aggregate from idiosyncratic shocks based on noisy local information. This systematic misattribution of aggregate shocks to firm-specific factors generates an additional price response, implying that strict price stability is no longer optimal. Instead, the optimal policy fully stabilizes the output gap, which necessarily requires accommodating fluctuations in the price level. The cyclicality of the optimal price level depends on the source of firms’ incomplete information: learning from local demand signals implies a procyclical price level, whereas learning from local productivity signals yields a countercyclical one.
records.abstract_cn: 在本文中，我们研究了一个经济体中的最优货币政策，在该经济体中，企业的定价决策因信号提取问题而被扭曲：它们无法根据嘈杂的本地信息完全区分总体冲击和特殊冲击。这种将总体冲击系统性地错误归因于企业特定因素会产生额外的价格反应，这意味着严格的价格稳定不再是最佳选择。相反，最优政策完全稳定了产出缺口，这必然需要适应价格水平的波动。最优价格水平的周期性取决于企业不完全信息的来源：从当地需求信号中学习意味着顺周期价格水平，而从当地生产率信号中学习则产生反周期价格水平。

records.title_en: From means-tested programs to Universal Basic Income - The role of endogenous participation in transfer programs
records.title_cn: 从经济状况调查计划到全民基本收入——内源性参与在转移支付计划中的作用
records.abstract_en: This paper studies the effects of replacing the Earned Income Tax Credit (EITC) with a Universal Basic Income (UBI) in an environment where EITC take-up is incomplete. In contrast, UBI ensures full participation by design, extending benefits to households who do not take up the EITC, at the cost of higher fiscal expenditures. I study this trade-off between expanded coverage and fiscal cost using a life-cycle model with an endogenous EITC participation decision that replicates the observed eligibility and take-up patterns. The results show that a generous UBI ($12,000 annually) reduces welfare due to the substantial fiscal burden it entails, whereas a modest UBI ($3500 per year) improves welfare by reaching previously uncovered households at only a moderate fiscal cost. These findings highlight the importance of the program participation margin in evaluating policy reforms.
records.abstract_cn: 本文研究了在 EITC 尚未完全实施的环境中，用全民基本收入 (UBI) 取代劳动所得税抵免 (EITC) 的效果。相比之下，全民基本收入通过设计确保充分参与，将福利扩大到不参加EITC的家庭，但代价是增加财政支出。我使用生命周期模型来研究扩大覆盖范围和财政成本之间的权衡，该模型具有内生的 EITC 参与决策，该决策复制了观察到的资格和接受模式。结果表明，慷慨的全民基本收入（每年12,000美元）会因其带来的巨大财政负担而减少福利，而适度的全民基本收入（每年3500美元）仅以适度的财政成本覆盖以前未覆盖的家庭，从而改善福利。这些发现凸显了计划参与边际在评估政策改革中的重要性。

records.title_en: Unconventional policy and idiosyncratic risk
records.title_cn: 非常规政策和特殊风险
records.abstract_en: Within a New Keynesian model with heterogeneous households and credit frictions, we show that idiosyncratic uncertainty gives rise to an additional transmission channel that amplifies the effects of balance-sheet policies through consumption risk, making them a key tool for anchoring private-sector expectations. We further show that the optimal monetary policy features a clear division of labor between conventional and unconventional tools: balance-sheet policy should target cross-sectional welfare objectives, absorbing fluctuations in variables with distributional relevance such as private debt, whereas conventional interest-rate policy stabilizes aggregate targets and responds to aggregate shocks, as in the representative-agent benchmark. Thus, the optimal response to a debt-deleveraging crisis is unconventional: it entails a shorter, rather than longer, duration of zero-interest-rate policies relative to conventional inflation targeting, and does not require front-loaded inflation at the effective lower bound.
records.abstract_cn: 在具有异质家庭和信贷摩擦的新凯恩斯主义模型中，我们表明，特殊的不确定性会产生额外的传导渠道，通过消费风险放大资产负债表政策的影响，使其成为锚定私营部门预期的关键工具。我们进一步表明，最优货币政策具有传统工具和非常规工具之间的明确分工：资产负债表政策应以横截面福利目标为目标，吸收私人债务等具有分配相关性的变量的波动，而传统利率政策则稳定总体目标并应对总体冲击，如代表-代理基准。因此，对债务去杠杆化危机的最佳应对措施是非常规的：相对于传统的通胀目标制，它需要更短而不是更长的利率政策期限，并且不需要在有效下限内提前实施通胀。

records.title_en: Public debt in calibrated OLG models: Fiscal arithmetic versus welfare analysis
records.title_cn: 校准的OLG模型中的公共债务：财政算术与福利分析
records.abstract_en: We analyze the fiscal and welfare implications of the size of public debt in stochastic OLG models with distortionary taxation. The government borrowing rate is realistically sensitive to debt issuance and lower than the growth rate. The risky rate is much higher due to convenience benefits of public debt, idiosyncratic return risk, and aggregate risk. Although free-lunch deficits can reduce tax distortions, welfare-maximizing debt (WMD) is considerably lower than deficit-maximizing debt (DMD) in our baseline model calibrated to the US economy. A detailed decomposition of ex ante welfare reveals the forces shaping WMD, the strongest being the positive risk-sharing effect and the negative crowding-out effect. We identify key drivers, such as pension policy or risk premia, and quantify their differential impact on WMD and DMD. Extending the model to account for market power substantially reduces WMD. When wealth inequality is included in the model, the rich favor much higher debt than the middle class.
records.abstract_cn: 我们分析了在具有扭曲性税收的随机OLG模型中，公共债务规模对财政和福利的影响。政府借款利率对债务发行具有现实敏感性，且低于增长率。由于公共债务的便利收益、特质性回报风险和总体风险，风险利率要高得多。尽管免费午餐式的赤字可以减少税收扭曲，但在我们以美国经济为基准校准的模型中，福利最大化债务（WMD）显著低于赤字最大化债务（DMD）。对事前福利的详细分解揭示了塑造WMD的力量，其中最强的是正的风险分担效应和负的挤出效应。我们识别了关键驱动因素，如养老金政策或风险溢价，并量化了它们对WMD和DMD的不同影响。将模型扩展到考虑市场势力会大幅降低WMD。当模型中包含财富不平等时，富人比中产阶级更偏好更高的债务。

records.title_en: Impacts of contemporaneous air pollution exposure on cognitive performance in Kenya
records.title_cn: 同期空气污染暴露对肯尼亚认知表现的影响
records.abstract_en: We estimate the short-term cognitive effects of fine particulate matter (PM2.5) exposure using novel exposure data collected during cognitive testing in Kenya. Unlike most existing studies that rely on satellite-based or fixed monitoring station data, we measure highly localized ambient pollution using portable monitors deployed at cognitive testing sites and link these readings directly to Harmonized Cognitive Assessment Protocol (HCAP) scores. Higher PM2.5 exposure during testing is associated with lower cognitive performance, particularly in executive function, memory, and visuospatial tasks. Binned exposure models suggest a monotonic pattern, with more negative estimates at higher exposure levels. Notably, effects are significantly larger among more educated individuals, possibly due to greater task demands or lower chronic exposure that limits physiological adaptation. Given that cognitive impairment is evident even at PM2.5 levels below Kenya’s mean annual regulatory threshold of 35μg/m3, the findings suggest that short-term exposure may impose underappreciated human capital costs that current regulatory standards fail to mitigate. The results highlight the potential cognitive and economic returns to interventions that reduce air pollution exposures in low-resource settings.
records.abstract_cn: 我们利用在肯尼亚认知测试期间收集的新型暴露数据，估计了细颗粒物（PM2.5）暴露的短期认知效应。与大多数依赖卫星或固定监测站数据的现有研究不同，我们使用在认知测试地点部署的便携式监测器测量高度局部的环境污染物，并将这些读数直接与协调认知评估协议（HCAP）分数相关联。测试期间较高的PM2.5暴露与较低的认知表现相关，特别是在执行功能、记忆和视觉空间任务中。分箱暴露模型显示出单调模式，在较高暴露水平下估计值更为负面。值得注意的是，在受教育程度较高的个体中，效应显著更大，这可能是由于更高的任务需求或较低的慢性暴露限制了生理适应。鉴于即使在低于肯尼亚年均监管阈值35μg/m3的PM2.5水平下，认知损害也显而易见，这些发现表明短期暴露可能带来未被充分认识的人力资本成本，而当前监管标准未能缓解这些成本。结果凸显了在资源匮乏环境中减少空气污染暴露的干预措施可能带来的认知和经济回报。

records.title_en: The effect of health insurance expansion on price and demand for medications among the uninsured
records.title_cn: 医疗保险扩展对无保险人群药品价格和需求的影响
records.abstract_en: Social health insurance expansions can affect not only new beneficiaries but also those who remain outside the program. This paper studies these spillovers in the context of Medicare Part D. Increases in insured demand can raise or lower price depending on market conditions: they may increase price when pharmaceutical firms face less elastic demand, but reduce price when demand concentration strengthens bargaining and pass-through in competitive markets. I find that Part D lowered the out-of-pocket unit price paid by Americans under age 65 without prescription drug insurance. Price declines are larger in therapeutic classes more exposed to Part D and in classes with stronger within-class competition, consistent with a demand-concentration channel. Demand increases mainly for generic drugs and among existing users. The implied consumer-surplus gain is roughly $76 per person per year, comprising about $65 from lower price on inframarginal consumption and $11 from additional consumption. Demand responses appear strongest among lower-income, younger, and healthier uninsured individuals, consistent with greater pre-existing non-adherence. Although price fall across several drug classes, demand does not increase significantly for medications associated with greater overuse in the United States, suggesting potentially positive net health spillovers.
records.abstract_cn: 社会医疗保险扩展不仅会影响新受益者，也会影响那些仍处于计划之外的人群。本文在医疗保险D部分的背景下研究这些溢出效应。受保需求的增加可能根据市场条件提高或降低价格：当制药企业面临弹性较小的需求时，价格可能上升，但当需求集中增强议价能力和竞争市场中的传导时，价格可能下降。我发现，D部分降低了年龄在65岁以下且没有处方药保险的美国人的自付单位价格。价格下降在更受D部分影响的治疗类别和类别内竞争更强的类别中更为显著，这与需求集中渠道一致。需求增加主要发生在仿制药和现有使用者中。隐含的消费者剩余收益约为每人每年76美元，其中约65美元来自边际内消费的价格下降，11美元来自额外消费。需求响应在低收入、年轻和更健康的无保险个体中表现最强，这与先前存在的更大不依从性一致。尽管多种药物类别的价格下降，但与美国过度使用相关的药物的需求并未显著增加，这表明可能存在正向的净健康溢出效应。

records.title_en: Consolidation of Local Health Authorities and mortality in the Italian NHS
records.title_cn: 地方卫生当局的整合和意大利 NHS 的死亡率
records.abstract_en: This paper studies the health consequences of administrative centralization in healthcare, focusing on the consolidation of Local Health Authorities (LHAs) within the Italian National Health Service. This type of reform fits within a broader set of cost-containment efforts aimed at reducing administrative expenditures and exploiting economies of scale. In the Italian case, the reform centralized governance and expanded the scale of health administration, creating authorities with substantially larger catchment areas and shifting decision-making to more heterogeneous jurisdictions. Such changes may affect the responsiveness of healthcare provision to local needs, the coordination of service delivery, and access to care. Using an event-study Difference-in-Differences design, we estimate the policy’s impact on municipal mortality rates, accounting for heterogeneous treatment effects and co-occurring fiscal adjustment policies. We find a significant increase in mortality starting four years after implementation, with an average treatment effect on the treated of 2.1%. The effects are concentrated in municipalities belonging to absorbed LHAs and in those exposed to mergers involving relatively large pre-reform LHAs and substantial post-merger expansions in catchment areas; they are also unevenly distributed, creating new vulnerable areas. Welfare estimates based on life-years lost indicate that the monetary costs of increased mortality exceed plausible administrative savings by roughly an order of magnitude.
records.abstract_cn: 本文研究了医疗保健行政集中化对健康的影响，重点关注意大利国家卫生服务体系内地方卫生当局 (LHA) 的整合。此类改革适合旨在减少行政支出和利用规模经济的更广泛的成本控制努力。以意大利为例，改革集中了治理并扩大了卫生管理规模，建立了管辖范围更大的当局，并将决策权转移到更加多元化的司法管辖区。这些变化可能会影响医疗保健服务对当地需求的响应、服务提供的协调以及获得护理的机会。使用事件研究双重差分法设计，我们估计了该政策对城市死亡率的影响，并考虑了异质性治疗效果和同时发生的财政调整政策。我们发现实施四年后死亡率显着增加，平均治疗效果为2.1%。影响集中在属于被吸收的地方行政区的城市，以及那些受到涉及改革前相对较大的地方行政区合并以及合并后集水区大幅扩张的影响的城市；它们的分布也不均匀，造成了新的脆弱地区。基于生命损失年数的福利估计表明，死亡率增加的货币成本超出了合理的行政节省大约一个数量级。

records.title_en: Hospital Billing Regulations and Financial Well-being: Evidence from California’s Fair Pricing Law
records.title_cn: 医院账单规定与财务福祉：来自加州公平定价法的证据
records.abstract_en: We examine the financial consequences of the 2007 California Fair Pricing Law, which places a price ceiling on hospital bills for financially vulnerable individuals. Using cross-sectional variation in exposure to the law, proxied by county-level uninsured rates, we estimate its impact on individual financial outcomes. We find that the law reduces the likelihood of incurring non-medical debt in collections and the number of non-medical accounts in collections. In addition, we find evidence that credit scores increased and suggestive evidence that the number of delinquent accounts decreased for individuals in more exposed counties. Our results suggest hospital billing regulations can improve targeted individuals’ financial outcomes.
records.abstract_cn: 我们研究了2007年加州公平定价法的财务后果，该法对财务脆弱人群的医院账单设定了价格上限。利用法律暴露程度的横截面差异，以县级未保险率作为代理，我们估计了其对个人财务结果的影响。我们发现，该法降低了产生非医疗催收债务的可能性以及非医疗催收账户的数量。此外，我们发现证据表明，在暴露程度更高的县，个人信用评分有所提高，并且有提示性证据表明拖欠账户数量有所减少。我们的结果表明，医院账单规定可以改善目标人群的财务结果。

records.title_en: Are patents with female inventors under-cited? Evidence from text estimation
records.title_cn: 女性发明人的专利是否被低估？来自文本估计的证据
records.abstract_en: Utilizing leading machine learning techniques to analyze the textual content and quality of patents, we demonstrate that patents with female lead inventors are under-cited relative to what would be expected had the lead inventor been male. Male inventors are the greatest contributors to the undercitation of patents with female inventors, followed by female inventors and male examiners, while female patent examiners appear to be even-handed. Using market reactions to patents suggests no average difference in market value by the inventor’s gender. The results have potential implications for research conclusions that rely on citation-based assessments of patent quality.
records.abstract_cn: 利用领先的机器学习技术来分析专利的文本内容和质量，我们证明，相对于主要发明人为男性的预期，女性主要发明人的专利被引用不足。男性发明人是对女性发明人的专利低估的最大贡献者，其次是女性发明人和男性审查员，而女性专利审查员似乎是不偏不倚的。利用市场对专利的反应表明，发明人性别的市场价值没有平均差异。该结果对依赖于基于引用的专利质量评估的研究结论具有潜在影响。

records.title_en: The impact of introducing a (nearly) redundant security: Evidence from Malaysian corporate bonds
records.title_cn: 引入（几乎）冗余证券的影响：来自马来西亚公司债券的证据
records.abstract_en: We develop a general equilibrium model in which firms issue nearly redundant securities to investor clienteles with participation constraints, with prices and demand determined endogenously in primary and secondary markets. The model characterizes how issuance costs, market frictions, and investor composition shape firms’ funding choices, equilibrium prices, and asset allocations. We test the model’s predictions using data from the Malaysian corporate bond market following the introduction of Islamic bonds. Consistent with the model, issuance decisions reflect trade-offs between collateral and liquidity benefits, Islamic and conventional bonds coexist without crowding out, and the expanded investor base increases access to debt financing.
records.abstract_cn: 我们开发了一个一般均衡模型，在该模型中，公司向具有参与限制的投资者客户发行几乎多余的证券，价格和需求由一级和二级市场内生决定。该模型描述了发行成本、市场摩擦和投资者构成如何影响公司的融资选择、均衡价格和资产配置。我们使用伊斯兰债券推出后马来西亚公司债券市场的数据来测试模型的预测。与该模型一致，发行决策反映了抵押品和流动性收益之间的权衡，伊斯兰债券和传统债券共存而没有排挤，扩大的投资者基础增加了债务融资的机会。

records.title_en: Firm-to-firm financial linkages and dollar risk transmission
records.title_cn: 企业间的金融联系和美元风险传递
records.abstract_en: We study how U.S. dollar fluctuations transmit through domestic supply chains in emerging markets. Large firms borrow in foreign currency and extend trade credit to domestic partners, exposing the supply chain to exchange rate risk. We develop a model where financially constrained suppliers pass through shocks to buyers, while unconstrained firms absorb them. Using quarterly firm-level data from 19 emerging markets, we provide empirical evidence consistent with the model’s predictions. We find that even highly exposed firms reduce trade credit only modestly following a depreciation, while accepting large profit losses, suggesting that firm-to-firm credit relationships partially shield downstream firms from financial shocks.
records.abstract_cn: 我们研究美元波动如何通过新兴市场的国内供应链传导。大公司借入外币并向国内合作伙伴提供贸易信贷，使供应链面临汇率风险。我们开发了一个模型，在该模型中，财务受限的供应商将冲击传递给买家，而不受约束的公司则吸收冲击。使用来自19新兴市场的季度公司级数据，我们提供了与模型预测一致的经验证据。我们发现，即使是风险敞口较高的企业，在贬值后也只会小幅减少贸易信贷，同时接受巨额利润损失，这表明企业与企业之间的信贷关系在一定程度上保护了下游企业免受金融冲击。

records.title_en: Angels, entrepreneurship, and employment dynamics: Evidence from investor accreditation rules
records.title_cn: 天使投资、创业和就业动态：来自投资者认证规则的证据
records.abstract_en: This paper examines the effects of a shock to angel finance on entrepreneurial activity. Using U.S. Census data, we estimate the state-level fraction of households that lost accreditation status from Dodd–Frank’s elimination of housing wealth in determining accreditation. A larger reduction in the pool of potential investors reduces angel investment, firm entry, and employment at small entrants. Employment increases at small and young incumbents, suggesting competitive effects. Though we document partial substitution, angel finance appears to complement other capital sources in the entrepreneurial ecosystem. Our paper offers insight on the impact of angel finance and where it matters most.
records.abstract_cn: 本文研究了天使融资的冲击对创业活动的影响。使用美国人口普查数据，我们估计了因多德-弗兰克法案在确定认证时取消住房财富而失去认证状态的州级家庭比例。潜在投资者群体的大幅减少会减少天使投资、企业进入和小进入者的就业。小型和年轻在职企业的就业人数增加，表明竞争效应。尽管我们记录了部分替代，但天使融资似乎补充了创业生态系统中的其他资本来源。我们的论文提供了有关天使融资的影响及其最重要的方面的见解。

records.title_en: Measuring firms’ capability to absorb external knowledge
records.title_cn: 衡量企业吸收外部知识的能力
records.abstract_en: As the economy has become increasingly knowledge-based, firms’ capability to benefit from external knowledge has grown in importance. We construct a measure of this capability – absorption intensity – from information in firms’ patents. To validate the measure, we exploit the American Inventors Protection Act (AIPA), which exogenously increased patent information availability. A triple-difference design shows that firms with higher absorption intensity experience greater innovation growth when more exposed to the reform. Beyond AIPA, absorption intensity predicts stronger innovation outcomes and firm growth. Our measure offers a tool to study how differences in absorption capability shape returns to external knowledge.
records.abstract_cn: 随着经济越来越以知识为基础，企业从外部知识中受益的能力变得越来越重要。我们根据公司专利中的信息构建了这种能力的衡量标准——吸收强度。为了验证该措施，我们利用了美国发明人保护法案 (AIPA)，该法案从外部增加了专利信息的可用性。三重差异设计表明，吸收强度较高的企业在更多地参与改革时会经历更大的创新增长。除了 AIPA 之外，吸收强度预示着更强的创新成果和公司增长。我们的测量提供了一个工具来研究吸收能力形状的差异如何返回到外部知识。

records.title_en: Blended finance
records.title_cn: 混合金融
records.abstract_en: Blended finance—the use of public and philanthropic funding to crowd in private capital—has emerged as a potential tool for financing sustainable development. Yet little is known about the design of blended finance contracts. We develop a conceptual framework in which development finance institutions (DFIs) allocate concessional capital across projects to maximize societal impact while crowding in private investors. Our framework highlights a trade-off between sustainability impact and the amount of concessionality required to make projects commercially viable and characterizes how DFIs optimally combine different instruments, including concessional debt, junior equity tranches, and risk management facilities. We then provide empirical evidence on blended finance using deal-level data from a major DFI. Consistent with our conceptual framework, projects with higher anticipated sustainability impact receive greater concessionality. Moreover, concessionality is higher in countries with greater political risk and information asymmetries, and these projects are more likely to include risk management provisions. Our findings provide new evidence on how DFIs deploy catalytic capital to mobilize private investment in sustainable development.
records.abstract_cn: 混合金融——利用公共和慈善资金吸引私人资本——已成为可持续发展融资的潜在工具。然而，人们对混合金融合同的设计知之甚少。我们制定了一个概念框架，其中开发金融机构（DFI）在项目之间分配优惠资本，以最大限度地提高社会影响，同时吸引私人投资者。我们的框架强调了可持续性影响与使项目具有商业可行性所需的优惠金额之间的权衡，并描述了发展金融机构如何最佳地结合不同工具，包括优惠债务、初级股权部分和风险管理设施。然后，我们使用主要 DFI 的交易级数据提供混合金融的经验证据。与我们的概念框架一致，预期可持续性影响较高的项目将获得更大的优惠。此外，政治风险较大和信息不对称的国家的优惠程度较高，这些项目更有可能包含风险管理条款。我们的研究结果为发展金融机构如何部署催化资本来动员私人投资参与可持续发展提供了新的证据。

records.title_en: Asymmetric thin markets
records.title_cn: 不对称的清淡市场
records.abstract_en: Using a new equilibrium representation, I characterize dynamic, nonstationary risk sharing in a complete-information setting among strategic traders submitting demand schedules and heterogeneous in risk aversion. In equilibrium, more risk-averse (smaller) traders diversify more aggressively due to endogenously lower price impact. This creates term structure effects, where smaller traders dynamically hedge the persistent order flow of larger, slower traders and become the marginal pricers at short horizons. When pre-announced security issuances (e.g., bond reopenings) or predictable trades take place, the model generates the gradual, V-shaped price response observed around these events and delivers new predictions about institutional trading.
records.abstract_cn: 使用新的均衡表示，我在提交需求计划和异质风险厌恶的战略交易者之间的完整信息设置中描述了动态的、非平稳的风险分担。在均衡状态下，由于内生性较低的价格影响，更多规避风险（规模较小）的交易者会更积极地进行多元化投资。这就产生了期限结构效应，较小的交易者动态地对冲较大、较慢的交易者的持续订单流，并成为短期内的边际定价者。当预先宣布的证券发行（例如，债券重新开放）或可预测的交易发生时，该模型会生成围绕这些事件观察到的渐进的 V 形价格响应，并提供有关机构交易的新预测。

records.title_en: Trade credit and relationships
records.title_cn: 贸易信用和关系
records.abstract_en: Exploiting transaction-level international trade data, this paper documents that long-term firm-to-firm relationships facilitate the use of trade credit, with the strength of this effect varying with firm size, firms’ payment delays, and multinational affiliate status. Effects also depend on the strength of contract enforcement across countries and the complexity of products traded. Because trade credit can reduce the overall need to borrow from the financial sector, long-term relationships may reduce firms’ credit demand. The destruction of trade relationships, for example, through trade conflicts, may hence increase firms’ leverage.
records.abstract_cn: 本文利用交易层面的国际贸易数据，证明长期的企业间关系促进了贸易信贷的使用，这种效应的强度因企业规模、企业付款延迟和跨国附属机构状况而异。影响还取决于各国合同执行的力度以及交易产品的复杂性。由于贸易信贷可以减少从金融部门借款的总体需求，因此长期关系可能会减少企业的信贷需求。例如，通过贸易冲突而破坏贸易关系可能会增加企业的杠杆率。

records.title_en: Changing the board game: Horizontal spillovers of gender quotas
records.title_cn: 改变棋盘游戏：性别配额的横向溢出
records.abstract_en: We examine the effects of mandatory board gender quotas on unregulated firms that are connected to regulated ones via interlocking directorates. After the introduction of quotas, connected firms significantly increase their share of female directors relative to similar unconnected firms. The spillover effects are substantial — at least as large as the direct effects on regulated firms, challenging previous claims that quotas have no broader impact on women in business. Our results suggest that quotas indirectly broaden the supply of candidates for connected firms, along dimensions that include, but are not limited to, gender.
records.abstract_cn: 我们研究了强制性董事会性别配额对通过连锁董事会与受监管公司相连的不受监管公司的影响。引入配额后，与类似的非关联公司相比，关联公司的女性董事比例显着增加。溢出效应是巨大的——至少与对受监管企业的直接影响一样大，这挑战了之前关于配额对商界女性没有更广泛影响的说法。我们的结果表明，配额间接扩大了关联公司的候选人供应，包括但不限于性别。

records.title_en: Forecast bias across horizons: Inflation expectations and the Treasury yields
records.title_cn: 跨视野的预测偏差：通胀预期和国债收益率
records.abstract_en: I show that the overreaction of the long-term yield forecasts to yield news, evidenced in recent studies, results directly from the overreaction of long-horizon inflation forecasts to inflation news. Motivated by this finding, I study how agents form inflation expectations across forecast horizons. Short-horizon survey forecasts underreact, while long-horizon forecasts overreact to inflation news. To reconcile this behavior, I implement a long-run bias, building on the widely shared intuition that agents conflate transitory with permanent shocks, within a realistic trend-gap inflation model. I embed this bias within a yield curve model. The long-horizon inflation expectations overreaction translates into a long-term yields’ overreaction, generating excess yield sensitivity to news. The model implies a long-term bond risk premium substantially less volatile and cyclical than that implied by predictive regressions or estimates imposing full-information rational expectations.
records.abstract_cn: 我表明，最近的研究证明，长期收益率预测对收益率新闻的过度反应，直接源于长期通胀预测对通胀新闻的过度反应。受这一发现的启发，我研究了代理人如何在预测范围内形成通胀预期。短期调查预测对通胀消息反应不足，而长期预测则反应过度。为了调和这种行为，我基于广泛共识的直觉，在现实的趋势缺口通胀模型中将暂时性冲击与永久性冲击混为一谈，实施了长期偏差。我将这种偏差嵌入到收益率曲线模型中。长期通胀预期的过度反应会转化为长期收益率的过度反应，从而产生对新闻的过度收益率敏感性。该模型意味着长期债券风险溢价的波动性和周期性远低于预测回归或强加全信息理性预期的估计所暗示的风险溢价。

records.title_en: Gambling away stability: Sports betting’s impact on vulnerable households
records.title_cn: 赌博破坏了稳定：体育博彩对弱势家庭的影响
records.abstract_en: We estimate the causal effect of online sports betting on households’ investment, spending, and debt management decisions using household transaction data and a staggered difference-in-differences framework. Following legalization, sports betting spreads quickly, with both the number of participants and frequency of bets increasing over time. This increase does not displace other gambling or consumption but significantly reduces savings, as risky bets crowd out positive expected value investments. These effects concentrate among frequent bettors and low-savings households. Our findings highlight the potential adverse effects of online sports betting on vulnerable households.
records.abstract_cn: 我们使用家庭交易数据和交错双重差分框架来估计在线体育博彩对家庭投资、支出和债务管理决策的因果影响。合法化后，体育博彩迅速蔓延，参与者数量和投注频率随着时间的推移而增加。这种增长不会取代其他赌博或消费，但会显着减少储蓄，因为高风险的赌注会挤出正预期价值的投资。这些影响集中在经常投注的人和低储蓄家庭中。我们的研究结果强调了在线体育博彩对弱势家庭的潜在不利影响。

records.title_en: Aggregate corporate savings, economic uncertainty, and future stock returns
records.title_cn: 企业储蓄总额、经济不确定性和未来股票回报
records.abstract_en: I document robust U.S. and international evidence that aggregate corporate cash savings negatively forecast future excess market returns, with economic uncertainty an important driver of this relation. In a calibrated neoclassical dynamic model featuring precautionary savings, I show that fixed financing costs, firm exit, and an uncertainty-driven time-varying price of risk are crucial to replicating this return predictability. The model further implies that the well-known positive return predictive power of aggregate accruals is largely attributable to aggregate cash savings, and the data support this implication.
records.abstract_cn: 我记录了强有力的美国和国际证据，表明企业现金储蓄总额对未来超额市场回报产生负面影响，而经济不确定性是这种关系的重要驱动因素。在一个以预防性储蓄为特色的校准新古典动态模型中，我表明固定融资成本、公司退出和不确定性驱动的时变风险价格对于复制这种回报可预测性至关重要。该模型进一步表明，众所周知的总应计项目的正回报预测能力在很大程度上归因于总现金节省，并且数据支持了这一含义。

records.title_en: Monetary transmission and portfolio rebalancing: A cross-sectional approach
records.title_cn: 货币传导和投资组合再平衡：跨部门方法
records.abstract_en: We show that institutional portfolio rebalancing across asset classes plays a key role in transmitting monetary shocks to the stock market. Around FOMC announcements, ceteris paribus, a stock with 10-percentage-point higher ownership by rebalancing institutions experiences an additional 3.7-basis-point loss following a 10-basis-point surprise rate hike. We corroborate our mechanism by exploiting within-firm variations for dual shares, showing stronger price reactions at quarter- and month-ends when rebalancing is more imminent, and presenting placebo tests contrasting rebalancing institutions with other institutions. A concluding calibration suggests rebalancing could contribute roughly one-third to two-thirds of the aggregate stock market excess return response to monetary shocks.
records.abstract_cn: 我们表明，跨资产类别的机构投资组合再平衡在向股市传递货币冲击方面发挥着关键作用。在 FOMC 公告发布期间，在其他条件不变的情况下，通过再平衡机构持有的股票的所有权增加了 10 个百分点，在 3.7 个基点意外加息后，该股票会经历额外的 10 个基点损失。我们通过利用双重股票的公司内部差异、在再平衡迫在眉睫时在季末和月末表现出更强的价格反应以及将再平衡机构与其他机构进行对比的安慰剂测试来证实我们的机制。结论性校准表明，再平衡可能占股市对货币冲击的超额回报总额的大约三分之一到三分之二。

records.title_en: Board connections, firm profitability, and product market actions
records.title_cn: 董事会关联、企业盈利与产品市场行为
records.abstract_en: A firm’s gross margin increases by 0.8 p.p.after forming a new direct board connection to a product market peer. Gross margin also rises by 0.4 p.p.after a connection is formed to a peer indirectly through a third intermediate firm. Further, using barcode-level data of 2.7 million products, we show that new board connections are related to higher consumer good prices, a greater tendency for market allocation, and slower new product introductions. The effects are stronger when the newly connected peers share corporate customers or have similar business descriptions and hold when controlling for other inter-firm relationships.
records.abstract_cn: 企业与产品市场同行建立新的直接董事会关联后，其毛利率提高0.8个百分点。通过第三方中间企业间接建立关联后，毛利率也提高0.4个百分点。此外，利用2.7百万种产品的条形码级数据，我们发现新的董事会关联与更高的消费品价格、更大的市场分配倾向以及更慢的新产品引入相关。当新关联的同行共享企业客户或具有相似的业务描述时，这些效应更强，并且在控制其他企业间关系后仍然成立。

records.title_en: Reaching for influence: Do banks use loans to establish political connections?
records.title_cn: 争取影响力：银行是否利用贷款来建立政治关系？
records.abstract_en: Using close elections as an empirical setting, this paper examines the drivers and consequences of politically motivated lending by U.S. banks, with a special focus on resulting benefits. We first show that firms with ties to members of Congress receive more favorable loan terms, despite no observable improvements in performance or default risk. The effect is especially pronounced among banks facing regulatory challenges — such as FDIC enforcement actions, corporate misconduct investigations, or low Community Reinvestment Act ratings — which also lend more frequently to connected firms, suggesting that these institutions have a heightened demand for political influence. Crucially, we find that politically motivated lending produces tangible future benefits for banks, including reduced misconduct penalties and easier approval for mergers and acquisitions. These findings provide evidence of a quid pro quo dynamic: banks extend preferential credit to firms with political connections and, in turn, receive regulatory advantages.
records.abstract_cn: 本文以势均力敌的选举为实证背景，研究了美国银行出于政治动机放贷的驱动因素和后果，特别关注由此产生的利益。我们首先表明，尽管业绩或违约风险没有明显改善，但与国会议员有联系的公司却获得了更优惠的贷款条件。这种影响在面临监管挑战（例如联邦存款保险公司执法行动、企业不当行为调查或社区再投资法案评级较低）的银行中尤其明显，这些银行也更频繁地向关联公司提供贷款，表明这些机构对政治影响力的需求更高。至关重要的是，我们发现出于政治动机的贷款可以为银行带来切实的未来利益，包括减少不当行为处罚以及更容易批准并购。这些发现提供了交换动态的证据：银行向有政治关系的企业提供优惠信贷，反过来，获得监管优势。

records.title_en: Investor expertise and private investment selection
records.title_cn: 投资者专业知识和私人投资选择
records.abstract_en: Institutional and individual investors evaluate private market opportunities systematically differently, even facing identical choices. In a survey experiment, 593 institutional and 445 individual investors assess venture capital fund profiles with independently randomized GP characteristics. Institutions heavily weight past fund performance, consistent with risk-averse investor demand calibrated to VC markets. Individuals largely ignore performance, favoring educational credentials instead. A follow-up experiment identifies two independent mechanisms: individuals lack awareness that VC performance persists and discount quality signals for funds they perceive as inaccessible. Performance-based selection alone reduces individuals’ expected returns by approximately 7%, accounting for 20% of the return gap with professionals.
records.abstract_cn: 即使面临相同的选择，机构投资者和个人投资者也会以不同的方式系统地评估私募市场机会。在一项调查实验中，593机构投资者和445个人投资者评估具有独立随机化普通合伙人特征的风险投资基金概况。机构非常重视过去的基金业绩，这与根据风险投资市场调整的规避风险的投资者需求一致。人们在很大程度上忽视了表现，而更看重教育证书。后续实验确定了两种独立的机制：个人缺乏对风险投资绩效持续存在的认识，并对他们认为无法获得的资金的质量信号打折扣。仅基于绩效的选择就会使个人的预期回报减少约 7%，占与专业人士回报差距的 20%。

records.title_en: Carbon VIX: Carbon price uncertainty and decarbonization investments
records.title_cn: Carbon VIX：碳价格不确定性和脱碳投资
records.abstract_en: We study the effects of carbon price uncertainty on firms’ decisions to decarbonize their operations. We first use information on the pricing of options on emission allowances in the European Emissions Trading System to create the Carbon VIX, a market-based high-frequency measure of carbon price uncertainty. Carbon price uncertainty is high, varies substantially over time, and experiences persistent shocks around major climate policy events. To explore the effects of carbon price uncertainty on expected aggregate decarbonization investments, we analyze its effect on the stock returns of firms that help other businesses decarbonize. To identify these “carbon solution providers”, we extract common types of decarbonization investments from a large survey of firms, and then identify companies that offer the associated goods and services. We find that the stock returns of these carbon solution providers vary positively with carbon prices, but negatively with carbon price uncertainty. The effect of increases in carbon price uncertainty on our proxy for expected decarbonization investments is economically large and of similar magnitude as the effect of declines in carbon prices. These findings support predictions from real options theory that firms may delay investments in decarbonization when faced with uncertainty about the future costs of emissions.
records.abstract_cn: 我们研究碳价格不确定性对企业脱碳运营决策的影响。我们首先使用欧洲排放交易系统中排放配额期权定价的信息来创建Carbon VIX，这是一种基于市场的碳价格不确定性的高频衡量指标。碳价格的不确定性很高，随着时间的推移变化很大，并且会因重大气候政策事件而受到持续的冲击。为了探讨碳价格不确定性对预期总体脱碳投资的影响，我们分析了其对帮助其他企业脱碳的公司股票回报的影响。为了识别这些“碳解决方案提供商”，我们从对企业的大型调查中提取了常见的脱碳投资类型，然后识别提供相关商品和服务的公司。我们发现这些碳解决方案提供商的股票回报随碳价格呈正向变化，但随碳价格不确定性呈负向变化。碳价格不确定性的增加对我们预期脱碳投资的影响在经济上是巨大的，并且与碳价格下降的影响相似。这些发现支持了实物期权理论的预测，即当面临未来排放成本的不确定性时，企业可能会推迟脱碳投资。

records.title_en: Hold-up in the absence of individual rationality: Asymptotic efficiency and gradualism
records.title_cn: 缺乏个体理性时的劫持：渐近效率和渐进主义
records.abstract_en: The hold-up problem has given rise to a large and influential literature. We consider a bilateral hold-up problem where bargaining power is asymmetrically distributed among the agents, in particular investing at the efficient level is not “individually rational” for one of the agents. We demonstrate that in the presence of a rich natural setup – that allows for dynamics in transfers, investments and negotiations – there exist subgame perfect equilibria that achieve asymptotic efficiency. This is true both when investments by the two agents are substitutes, as well as when these are complements. Moreover, implementation requires gradualism, with sequential investments and transfers over several periods.
records.abstract_cn: 敲诈勒索问题催生了大量有影响力的文献。我们考虑双边劫持问题，其中讨价还价能力在代理人之间分布不对称，特别是在有效水平上的投资对于其中一个代理人来说不是“个体理性的”。我们证明，在存在丰富的自然设置（允许转让、投资和谈判动态）的情况下，存在实现渐近效率的子博弈完美均衡。当两个代理人的投资是替代性的以及互补性的时候都是如此。此外，实施需要循序渐进，分阶段进行连续投资和转移。

records.title_en: Investment sophistication and wealth inequality
records.title_cn: 投资成熟度与财富不平等
records.abstract_en: I study the stationary wealth distribution in a dynamic model of financial markets in which investors differ in their levels of investment sophistication. Some investors form beliefs rationally but have access to different information, while others hold incorrect beliefs. For all investor types, the stationary wealth distribution exhibits a thick upper tail, whose thickness depends on the higher moments of portfolio returns relative to the aggregate market. The upper tail of the overall stationary wealth distribution is populated by the group with the thickest tail. I show that this group is either a rational group with an undominated information set or the group with incorrect beliefs, despite the latter earning the lowest expected return. To explain the observed degrees of wealth concentration, it is sufficient that some investor groups earn an expected excess return of 0.89% per annum relative to the aggregate economy – consistent with the risk-adjusted returns generated by hedge funds and private equity funds and their portfolio shares among the ultra-wealthy in the United States. A calibration of the model matches the distribution of average returns for Norwegian households documented by Fagereng et al. (2020).
records.abstract_cn: 我研究了一个金融市场动态模型中的稳态财富分布，其中投资者的投资成熟度水平不同。一些投资者理性地形成信念，但获得不同的信息，而另一些投资者持有错误的信念。对于所有投资者类型，稳态财富分布呈现出厚上尾，其厚度取决于投资组合回报相对于总体市场的更高矩。总体稳态财富分布的上尾由尾部最厚的群体占据。我表明，这个群体要么是拥有无支配信息集的理性群体，要么是持有错误信念的群体，尽管后者获得的预期回报最低。为了解释观察到的财富集中程度，只需某些投资者群体相对于总体经济每年获得0.89%的预期超额回报——这与对冲基金和私募股权基金产生的风险调整后回报及其在美国超级富豪中的投资组合份额一致。模型的校准与Fagereng等人（2020年）记录的挪威家庭平均回报分布相匹配。

records.title_en: Classical matching via network formation
records.title_cn: 通过网络形成的经典匹配
records.abstract_en: Despite addressing similar underlying questions, the literatures on network formation and matching have evolved more or less independently. This paper offers a common framework, studying a general model of network formation without externalities—equivalently, a one-sided many-to-many matching model. I give conditions for the existence and uniqueness of stable graphs, I prove a rural hospital theorem, and I highlight a link-by-link conflict of interest across different stable graphs. Special cases contain and extend classic results for the roommate problem and two-sided matching markets. An iterated deletion algorithm adapted from Gutin et al. (2023) furnishes a crucial tool, reducing network formation games to a normal form with helpful properties.
records.abstract_cn: 尽管解决了类似的根本问题，但有关网络形成和匹配的文献或多或少是独立发展的。本文提供了一个通用框架，研究一种没有外部性的网络形成的一般模型——相当于一种单方面的多对多匹配模型。我给出了稳定图的存在性和唯一性的条件，证明了乡村医院定理，并强调了不同稳定图之间逐个链接的利益冲突。特殊情况包含并扩展了室友问题和双边匹配市场的经典结果。改编自 Gutin 等人的迭代删除算法。 (2023) 提供了一个重要的工具，将网络形成博弈简化为具有有用属性的正常形式。

records.title_en: Time use and heterogeneous markups
records.title_cn: 时间使用和异构标记
records.abstract_en: We enrich standard models of imperfect competition by allowing consumer demand for market goods to depend non-separably on off-market time. Consumers value final consumption experiences that require both market purchases and time, which reshapes demand elasticities through two opposing forces. First, because time is an input, changes in market prices translate only partially into changes in the cost of an experience and second, households can substitute time for market purchases in response to price variation. We show how these forces alter the mapping from markups to welfare by distinguishing between markups and a holistic counterpart that accounts for the time cost of consumption. In a monopolistically competitive environment with CES preferences over experiences, firm selection and entry is governed solely by the elasticity of substitution between time use and market purchases, and markup dispersion can be consistent with efficiency when time and market purchases are perfect complements. Extending the analysis to oligopolistic competition, we show that forces that raise markups, like greater market concentration and less competitive conduct, also amplify the gap between the usual and holistic markups.
records.abstract_cn: 我们通过允许消费者对市场商品的需求不可分割地依赖于非市场时间来丰富不完全竞争的标准模型。消费者重视需要市场购买和时间的最终消费体验，这通过两种相反的力量重塑需求弹性。首先，由于时间是一种投入，市场价格的变化只能部分转化为体验成本的变化；其次，家庭可以用时间代替市场购买，以应对价格变化。我们通过区分加成和考虑消费时间成本的整体对应物，展示了这些力量如何改变从加成到福利的映射。在CES优先于体验的垄断竞争环境中，企业选择和进入仅受时间使用和市场购买之间替代弹性的影响，当时间和市场购买完美互补时，加价分散可以与效率保持一致。将分析扩展到寡头垄断竞争，我们发现提高加价的力量，例如更大的市场集中度和竞争性较低的行为，也会放大通常加价和整体加价之间的差距。

records.title_en: When Lasry-Lions meet Krugman: A mean-field game theory of spatial dynamics
records.title_cn: 当拉斯里狮遇到克鲁格曼：空间动力学的平均场博弈论
records.abstract_en: We propose a mean-field game (MFG) approach to study the dynamics of spatial agglomeration in a continuous space-time framework where trade across locations may follow a broad class of static gravity models. Forward-looking intertemporal utility-maximizing agents work and migrate in a two-dimensional geography and face idiosyncratic shocks. Equilibrium wages and prices depend on their common distribution and adjust statically according to the underlying trade model. We first prove existence and uniqueness of the static trade equilibrium. We then prove existence of dynamic equilibria. In the case of a circular economy, we obtain closed-form solutions for small perturbations around the steady state, and we identify the sets of parameters that lead to agglomeration or dispersion. We exploit the MFG structure of the model to explicitly quantify how uncertainty and forward-looking expectations contribute to agglomeration and dispersion. In particular, we show that, regardless of the static trade model, forward-looking expectations always promote agglomeration, but cannot reverse the dominant pattern that would arise under myopic behavior.
records.abstract_cn: 我们提出了一种平均场博弈（MFG）方法来研究连续时空框架中空间集聚的动态，其中跨地点的贸易可能遵循广泛的静态重力模型。具有前瞻性的跨期效用最大化主体在二维地理中工作和迁移，并面临特殊的冲击。均衡工资和价格取决于它们的共同分布，并根据基础贸易模型进行静态调整。我们首先证明静态贸易均衡的存在性和唯一性。然后我们证明动态平衡的存在。在循环经济的情况下，我们获得了稳态周围小扰动的封闭式解，并确定了导致聚集或分散的参数集。我们利用模型的 MFG 结构来明确量化不确定性和前瞻性预期如何影响集聚和分散。特别是，我们表明，无论静态贸易模式如何，前瞻性预期总是会促进集聚，但无法扭转短视行为下出现的主导模式。

records.title_en: Robustly optimal voting rule
records.title_cn: 鲁棒最优投票规则
records.abstract_en: We examine optimal strategy-proof voting mechanisms in environments where the designer lacks precise information about the probability distribution of individual utility profiles. This uncertainty over the true distribution is represented by a set of multiple distributions, and the designer evaluates mechanisms using either the worst-case utility sum or worst-case regret. Departing from the existing literature, we do not assume that utility functions are single-peaked or that the set of possible utility functions is maximally rich. In this setting, we show that the median voter rule is the unique optimal mechanism under both criteria. Our result provides a new justification for this well-known mechanism from a welfare perspective.
records.abstract_cn: 我们在设计者缺乏有关个体效用分布概率分布的精确信息的环境中研究最佳的策略验证投票机制。真实分布的这种不确定性由一组多重分布表示，设计者使用最坏情况效用总和或最坏情况遗憾来评估机制。与现有文献不同，我们并不假设效用函数是单峰的，或者可能的效用函数集是最丰富的。在这种情况下，我们表明中位选民规则是这两个标准下唯一的最优机制。我们的结果从福利角度为这一众所周知的机制提供了新的理由。

records.title_en: Minimum price equilibrium in the assignment market: Structural properties and the Serial Vickrey mechanism
records.title_cn: 指派市场中的最低价格均衡：结构性质与序列维克里机制
records.abstract_en: We study an assignment market where multiple heterogeneous objects are sold to unit-demand agents who have general preferences that account for income effects and market frictions. The minimum price equilibrium (MPE) is one of the most important equilibrium concepts in such settings, as it demonstrates the possibility of designing efficient and strategy-proof mechanisms. Nevertheless, none of the well-known auction mechanisms that find the MPE in quasilinear settings can identify or even approximate MPEs for general preferences. We establish novel structural properties of MPEs and use these properties as the foundation to design a “Serial Vickrey (SV) mechanism.” The SV mechanism finds an MPE for general preferences through a finite number of indifference prices reported by the agents, each of which represents their willingness to pay for a target object based on their tentatively assigned bundle. Furthermore, the SV mechanism also has desirable dynamic incentive properties.
records.abstract_cn: 我们研究了一个指派市场，其中多个异质物品被出售给具有单位需求的代理人，这些代理人拥有考虑收入效应和市场摩擦的一般偏好。最低价格均衡（MPE）是此类设置中最重要的均衡概念之一，因为它展示了设计有效且策略-proof机制的可能性。然而，在拟线性设置中，已知的拍卖机制中没有一个能够识别甚至近似一般偏好的MPE。我们建立了MPE的新结构性质，并将这些性质作为设计“序列维克里（SV）机制”的基础。SV机制通过代理人报告的有限数量的无差异价格来找到一般偏好的MPE，每个价格代表他们基于暂定分配组合对目标物品的支付意愿。此外，SV机制还具有理想的动态激励性质。

records.title_en: On the efficiency of runnable banking arrangements
records.title_cn: 论可运行银行安排的效率
records.abstract_en: Financial arrangements involving illiquid assets financed by liquid liabilities are often viewed as inherently runnable. Diamond and Dybvig (1983) show that this is true when risk-sharing arrangements are not optimally designed. Peck and Shell (2003) and Ennis and Keister (2009, 2016), however, demonstrate that runnable banking arrangements can be constrained-efficient when liquidity demand is uncertain and withdrawals must be processed on a first-come, first-served basis. We show that this insight extends to environments in which redemptions are not subject to a sequential service constraint. Instead, increasing returns to scale in banking-consistent with empirical evidence-can generate regions of the parameter space in which the constrained-efficient allocation is runnable. Runnable banking arrangements can be constrained-efficient when the minimum scale required to realize economies of scale is difficult to attain during large redemption events, when the penalty for failing to achieve scale is small, and when the likelihood of a coordinated run is low
records.abstract_cn: 涉及由流动性负债融资的非流动性资产的金融安排通常被视为本质上可运行的。Diamond和Dybvig（1983）表明，当风险分担安排未得到最优设计时，情况确实如此。然而，Peck和Shell（2003）以及Ennis和Keister（2009，2016）证明，当流动性需求不确定且赎回必须按先到先得的基础处理时，可运行的银行安排可以是约束有效的。我们表明，这一见解扩展到赎回不受顺序服务约束的环境。相反，银行业中与经验证据一致的规模报酬递增，可以在参数空间中产生约束有效配置可运行的区域。当实现规模经济所需的最小规模在大规模赎回事件中难以达到，当未能达到规模的惩罚较小，以及当协调运行的可能性较低时，可运行的银行安排可以是约束有效的。

records.title_en: On preference for simplicity and probability weighting
records.title_cn: 关于对简单性和概率加权的偏好
records.abstract_en: Complexity aversion in choice under risk is well documented. One of its main behavioral effects is the event-splitting effect. It captures how the value of a lottery changes when one prize is split into two prizes, each with half the original probability. We weaken independence and continuity to accommodate the event-splitting effect. The resulting preferences admit either an expected utility representation with an additive entropy cost of complexity or a power-weighted expected utility representation in which probabilities are weighted by a power function. The model also provides behavioral foundations for logit choice.
records.abstract_cn: 在风险下选择复杂性的厌恶是有据可查的。其主要行为效应之一是事件分裂效应。它捕捉到当一个奖品被分成两个奖品（每个奖品的概率是原始概率的一半）时，彩票价值如何变化。我们削弱独立性和连续性以适应事件分裂效应。由此产生的偏好允许具有复杂性的加性熵成本的预期效用表示或功率加权的预期效用表示，其中概率由幂函数加权。该模型还为 Logit 选择提供行为基础。

records.title_en: Managing persuasion robustly: The optimality of quota rules
records.title_cn: 强有力的说服管理：配额规则的最优性
records.abstract_en: We study a sender-receiver game in which the receiver can commit to a decision rule before the sender determines the information policy. We ask how the receiver should commit, in advance, to a rule that maps the information of the sender into decisions-when the receiver knows neither the sender’s true preferences nor the full range of information the sender could supply. To handle this dual uncertainty, we adopt a unified robust framework that nests max-min utility, min-max regret, and min-max competitive ratio as special cases. Across all criteria, the same answer emerges: the optimal rule is always a quota rule.
records.abstract_cn: 我们研究了发送者-接收者博弈，其中接收者可以在发送者确定信息策略之前承诺决策规则。我们询问接收者应如何提前遵守将发送者的信息映射到决策中的规则——当接收者既不知道发送者的真实偏好也不知道发送者可以提供的全部信息时。为了处理这种双重不确定性，我们采用了一个统一的稳健框架，将最大-最小效用、最小-最大遗憾和最小-最大竞争比作为特殊情况。在所有标准中，都会出现相同的答案：最佳规则始终是配额规则。

records.title_en: Informational inertia and the Taylor principle
records.title_cn: 信息惯性和泰勒原理
records.abstract_en: The Taylor principle, a more than one-for-one reaction of the nominal interest rate to inflation, is a central tenet of monetary policy to rule out self-fulfilling equilibria. The standard sticky-price model only holds this principle as a sufficient determinacy bound, with substitutes such as output-gap targeting available. We show that if the long-run Phillips curve is vertical, the Taylor principle is necessary and no amount of output-gap, output-growth, or forecast targeting can substitute for the vigorous response to inflation it prescribes. Sticky price models report determinacy bounds as generically model-dependent, nonlinear functions of model parameters. We find that models with vertical long-run Phillips curves share the same determinacy bounds despite differing short-run tradeoffs. These bounds are more conservative, placing tighter restrictions on monetary policy, and more robust, being independent of model-specific parameters and depending solely on monetary policy’s reaction to current inflation.
records.abstract_cn: 泰勒原则是名义利率对通货膨胀的一对一反应，是货币政策排除自我实现均衡的核心原则。标准粘性价格模型仅将此原则视为足够的确定性界限，并可使用产出缺口目标等替代品。我们表明，如果长期菲利普斯曲线是垂直的，那么泰勒原则是必要的，并且任何产出缺口、产出增长或预测目标都不能取代它所规定的对通货膨胀的积极反应。粘性价格模型将确定性界限报告为模型参数的一般依赖于模型的非线性函数。我们发现，尽管短期权衡不同，但具有垂直长期菲利普斯曲线的模型具有相同的确定性界限。这些界限更加保守，对货币政策施加更严格的限制，并且更加稳健，独立于模型特定参数，仅取决于货币政策对当前通胀的反应。

records.title_en: Government trading and efficiency in imperfectly competitive financial markets
records.title_cn: 不完全竞争金融市场中的政府交易和效率
records.abstract_en: We analyze how public asset purchases affect liquidity, risk sharing and intertemporal smoothing in imperfectly competitive financial markets. Even “neutral” policies, such as budget-balanced trades of risk-free debt, affect liquidity and trading efficiency. Public debt purchases worsen liquidity and risk sharing by increasing price impact, while debt sales improve risk sharing but distort intertemporal trade. “Expansionary” quantitative easing policies can thus reduce trading efficiency. We also derive quantity-based trading rules for optimal public portfolio management. These call for policy to equalize weighted measures of public and private price impact.
records.abstract_cn: 我们分析公共资产购买如何影响不完全竞争的金融市场中的流动性、风险分担和跨期平滑。即使是“中性”政策，例如无风险债务的预算平衡交易，也会影响流动性和交易效率。公共债务购买会增加价格影响，从而恶化流动性和风险分担，而债务出售则改善风险分担，但会扭曲跨期贸易。 “扩张性”量化宽松政策可能会降低交易效率。我们还推导出基于数量的交易规则，以实现最佳的公共投资组合管理。这些要求政策平衡公共和私人价格影响的加权衡量标准。

records.title_en: When can less be more? Inducing dealer responses in RFQ platforms
records.title_cn: 什么时候可以少即是多？在询价平台中诱导经销商响应
records.abstract_en: We show in a model of RFQ trading that customers may admit only a few dealers, even when more are available, to induce maximum liquidity supply—“less can be more.” The number of admitted dealers is pinned down by a competition elasticity, shaped by dealers’ cost to respond to RFQs. For example, higher search (operating) costs increase (reduce) admitted dealers. A social planner would mandate even fewer dealers than the market outcome, because customers induce excessive dealer competition. The model predicts endogenous market power, yields implications for regulation and design of electronic platforms, and speaks to customer-dealer interactions under market stress.
records.abstract_cn: 我们在询价交易模型中表明，即使有更多交易商，客户也可能只接纳少数交易商，以诱导最大的流动性供应——“越少越好”。获准经销商的数量受到竞争弹性的限制，竞争弹性由经销商响应询价的成本决定。例如，较高的搜索（运营）成本会增加（减少）认可的经销商。社会规划者会要求比市场结果更少的经销商，因为客户会引发经销商过度竞争。该模型预测内生市场力量，对电子平台的监管和设计产生影响，并探讨市场压力下客户与经销商的互动。

records.title_en: A folk theorem for finitely repeated games with public monitoring
records.title_cn: 有限重复博弈中公共监督下的民间定理
records.abstract_en: We provide a Folk theorem for finitely repeated games under imperfect public monitoring, under a strengthening of the standard assumptions required for finitely repeated games with perfect monitoring, and of those for discounted repeated games under imperfect public monitoring. Our proof uses standard recursive methods and assumes the existence of a public randomization device. Three counterexamples show in which sense our assumptions are tight.
records.abstract_cn: 我们为不完全公共监督下的有限重复博弈提供了一个民间定理，该定理在加强完美监督下有限重复博弈所需的标准假设以及不完全公共监督下贴现重复博弈所需的标准假设的基础上成立。我们的证明使用标准的递归方法，并假设存在一个公共随机化装置。三个反例表明我们的假设在何种意义上是紧致的。

records.journal_name: Journal of Environmental Economics and Management
records.title_en: Competition between green and blue hydrogen and indirect network effects
records.title_cn: 绿氢和蓝氢之间的竞争和间接网络效应
records.abstract_en: Whereas hydrogen is currently a marginal energy carrier, the aim of the EU is to trigger low-carbon hydrogen production that covers around 10 percent of EU's energy needs by 2050. If this comes true, it will be an energy revolution. We study competition between green and blue hydrogen using an extended Salop model that encompasses the value chains for hydrogen and CCS. For blue hydrogen, we distinguish between exports of blue hydrogen—natural gas is converted into hydrogen close to the extraction site of natural gas and hydrogen is then transported over a long distance to the hydrogen consumers—and local production of blue hydrogen—natural gas is exported over a long distance and then converted into hydrogen near the hydrogen consumers. We find that mark-ups are highest in the case of exports of blue hydrogen production, which implies that total production of hydrogen, supply of blue hydrogen, and share of plants investing in carbon capture facilities are lower in the case of exports of blue hydrogen than in the case of local production of blue hydrogen. We provide numerical simulations of the alternative market outcomes and the corresponding first-best outcomes and identify policy instruments that should be used to sustain the first-best social outcomes in the cases of exports of blue hydrogen and local production of blue hydrogen.
records.abstract_cn: 鉴于氢目前是一种边际能源载体，欧盟的目标是在10%之前启动低碳氢生产，满足欧盟能源需求的2050左右。如果这成为现实，这将是一场能源革命。我们使用涵盖氢和 CCS 价值链的扩展 Salop 模型研究绿氢和蓝氢之间的竞争。对于蓝氢，我们区分出口蓝氢——天然气在靠近天然气提取地点转化为氢气，然后远距离运输到氢消费者；本地生产蓝氢——天然气长距离出口，然后在氢消费者附近转化为氢气。我们发现，出口蓝氢生产的加价最高，这意味着出口蓝氢的氢总产量、蓝氢供应量以及投资碳捕获设施的工厂比例低于本地生产蓝氢。我们提供了替代市场结果和相应的最佳结果的数值模拟，并确定了在出口蓝氢和本地生产蓝氢的情况下用于维持最佳社会结果的政策工具。

records.journal_name: Journal of Environmental Economics and Management
records.title_en: Testing for spillovers in resource conservation: Evidence from a natural field experiment
