records.abstract_en: This paper examines efficient allocations in economies where consumers exhibit heterogeneous smooth ambiguity preferences and face model uncertainty with a common set of identifiable models. Aggregate endowment is ambiguous. We characterize economies where the representative consumer is of the smooth ambiguity type and derive efficient sharing rules. Heterogeneous ambiguity aversion leads to sharing rules that systematically differ from those in vNM economies. The representative consumer's ambiguity aversion differs from that of the typical consumer; this leads to more compelling asset-pricing predictions. We focus on point-identified models but show that our insights extend to partially identified models.
records.abstract_cn: 本文考察了消费者表现出异质平滑模糊偏好且面临具有共同可识别模型集合的模型不确定性的经济中的有效配置。总禀赋存在模糊性。我们刻画了代表性消费者为平滑模糊类型的经济，并推导了有效的共享规则。异质的模糊厌恶导致共享规则系统性地不同于vNM经济中的规则。代表性消费者的模糊厌恶与典型消费者不同；这带来了更具说服力的资产定价预测。我们关注点识别模型，但表明我们的见解可扩展至部分识别模型。

records.title_en: The Effect of Mergers on Innovation
records.title_cn: 兼并对创新的影响
records.abstract_en: We study the effect of a merger on R&D activity in a dynamic model with uncertainty about the feasibility of innovation. The merger has three effects: It may reduce the number of follow-up innovations (cannibalization effect), increase the probability of the first game-changer innovation (appropriability effect), and bring this innovation forward in time (informational effect). The model suggests mergers are more desirable when R&D outcomes are highly uncertain, but less so when the innovation path is clearer. A surprising policy implication is that the benefit of the merger may be higher if the first and subsequent innovations are closer substitutes.
records.abstract_cn: 我们在一个关于创新可行性存在不确定性的动态模型中研究兼并对研发活动的影响。兼并具有多重效应：它可能减少后续创新的数量（蚕食效应），增加具有颠覆性意义的创新的概率（可占有性效应），并使该创新提前发生（信息效应）。模型表明，当研发结果高度不确定时，兼并更具吸引力；而当创新路径较为明确时，兼并的吸引力则较低。一个令人意外的政策启示是，如果颠覆性创新及其后续创新是更为接近的替代品，兼并的收益可能更高。

records.title_en: On Taking a Skewed Risk More than Once
records.title_cn: 关于多次承担偏斜风险
records.abstract_en: Penny-picking refers to the often-observed phenomenon of repeatedly taking negatively skewed risks and seems directly at odds with evidence on (positive-)skewness-seeking as observed in static settings. We show that penny-picking may not only occur despite skewness-seeking, but—seemingly paradoxically—because of skewness-seeking. With sufficient time available, risks with arbitrary negative skewness can be gambled in such a way that, overall, skewness is positive. Therefore, classical behavioral theories like prospect theory straightforwardly explain penny-picking. More generally, we show that the versatile dynamics of skewness reconcile apparent preference reversals concerning the avoidance and acceptance of (skewed and non-skewed) risks.
records.abstract_cn: “捡便宜”指的是反复承担负偏斜风险的常见现象，这似乎与静态环境中观察到的（正）偏斜寻求行为直接矛盾。我们表明，“捡便宜”不仅可能在偏斜寻求行为存在的情况下发生，而且——看似矛盾地——正是由于偏斜寻求行为而发生。在有足够时间的情况下，可以以一种总体上使偏斜为正的方式赌博任意负偏斜的风险。因此，经典行为理论如前景理论可以直接解释“捡便宜”现象。更一般地，我们展示了偏斜的多样动态如何调和关于规避和接受（偏斜及非偏斜）风险的表面偏好逆转。

records.title_en: Dynamic Preference "Reversals" and Time Inconsistency
records.title_cn: 动态偏好“逆转”与时间不一致性
records.abstract_en: We study the possibility of identifying time-inconsistent preferences in empirical designs where preferences are elicited in advance at time 0 and then again at time 1, after the agent receives additional information. For single-peaked preferences, time consistency is rejected only when the time-1 ranking between a pair of alternatives is always the reverse of the time-0 ranking. We establish variations and generalizations of this result. Since such stark reversals are rarely observed, choice-revision designs require stronger identification assumptions than perhaps previously appreciated. But we show that time inconsistency is identifiable in environments where preferences over alternatives can be "priced out."
records.abstract_cn: 我们研究了在经验设计中识别时间不一致偏好的可能性，该设计中偏好先在时间0被引出，然后在代理人获得额外信息后于时间1再次引出。对于单峰偏好，只有当时间1对一对备选方案的排序总是时间0排序的完全相反时，时间一致性才被拒绝。我们建立了该结果的变体和推广。由于如此明显的逆转很少被观察到，选择修正设计需要比之前可能认识到的更强的识别假设。但我们表明，在备选方案的偏好可以被“定价”出来的环境中，时间不一致性是可识别的。

records.title_en: How green is China’s development finance? Power generation and air pollution in Africa
records.title_cn: 中国的发展融资有多绿色？非洲的发电与空气污染
records.abstract_en: China has emerged as an internationally leading creditor of development finance and is now competing with traditional Western donors and lenders. Between 2000 and 2021, Chinese public sector institutions committed more than USD 1.3 trillion to low- and middle-income countries. The flagship Belt and Road Initiative, launched in 2013, has enabled unprecedented infrastructure investment in about 150 countries. Western criticism of a lack of transparency has prompted speculation about the environmental impact of Chinese lending abroad. We examine whether Chinese official finance to Africa between 2000 and 2021 is associated with “greener” electricity generation—which can serve as the backbone for a sustainable energy transition on the continent—and whether it has contributed to emission reduction. To mitigate endogeneity concerns, we employ an instrumental variable approach that relies on the exogenous variation in the availability of Chinese official finance over time. Our findings suggest that Chinese official finance has increased the adoption of renewable energy for electricity generation, although the impact differs between development-oriented and commercial finance and changes over time. Furthermore, while Chinese official finance has contributed to reducing emissions and improving electricity access, commercial projects appear to offset some of the emission reductions.
records.abstract_cn: 中国已成为国际领先的发展融资债权国，目前正与传统的西方捐助者和贷款机构竞争。在2000年至2021年间，中国公共部门机构向低收入和中等收入国家承诺了超过1.3万亿美元的资金。2013年启动的旗舰项目“一带一路”倡议，已在约150个国家实现了前所未有的基础设施投资。西方对中国海外贷款缺乏透明度的批评，引发了对中国海外贷款环境影响的猜测。我们考察了2000年至2021年间中国对非洲的官方融资是否与“更绿色”的电力生产相关联——这可以作为非洲大陆可持续能源转型的支柱——以及它是否促进了减排。为缓解内生性问题，我们采用了工具变量方法，该方法依赖于中国官方融资可用性随时间的外生变化。我们的研究结果表明，中国官方融资增加了可再生能源在电力生产中的采用，尽管影响因发展导向型融资和商业融资而异，并随时间变化。此外，虽然中国官方融资有助于减少排放和改善电力获取，但商业项目似乎抵消了部分减排效果。

records.title_en: The impact of foreign media on political mobilization during the Arab Spring
records.title_cn: 外国媒体对阿拉伯之春期间政治动员的影响
records.abstract_en: We investigate how foreign media influenced political mobilization during the Arab Spring in the Middle East and North Africa (MENA) region. Focusing on two prominent transnational networks, Al Jazeera and Al Arabiya, we use Arab Barometer survey data to track political mobilization and media use indicators in Jordan, Lebanon, and the Palestinian Territories. To address potential endogeneity, we use the frequency of lightning strikes and submarine cable seaquake shocks as instrumental variables, which help isolate exogenous variation in access to foreign media. Our results show that access to foreign media has a positive and statistically significant effect on political mobilization. A one-standard-deviation increase corresponds to a rise in the likelihood of participating in protests of approximately 6.5 percentage points, a gain of approximately 39% at the sample mean. We argue that this effect is primarily driven by the informational dimension of foreign media, rather than its ideological content.
records.abstract_cn: 我们研究了外国媒体如何影响中东和北非（MENA）地区阿拉伯之春期间的政治动员。聚焦于两个著名的跨国网络，半岛电视台和阿拉比亚电视台，我们使用阿拉伯晴雨表调查数据来追踪约旦、黎巴嫩和巴勒斯坦领土的政治动员和媒体使用指标。为解决潜在的内生性问题，我们使用闪电频率和海底电缆海震冲击作为工具变量，这有助于隔离外国媒体可及性的外生变异。我们的结果表明，外国媒体的可及性对政治动员有正向且统计显著的影响。一个标准差增加对应于参与抗议可能性上升约6.5个百分点，在样本均值处约为39%的增益。我们认为，这一效应主要由外国媒体的信息维度驱动，而非其意识形态内容。

records.title_en: Urbanization and decentralization in the Congo: Examining governance in rural towns
records.title_cn: 刚果的城市化与权力下放：考察农村城镇的治理
records.abstract_en: How are rural towns governed in a context of fragility? This paper provides descriptive evidence to describe and quantify urbanization and the local organization of the state in 67 rural towns in four provinces of the Democratic Republic and the Congo. We present rich data on urbanization, state and local governance, taxation, public good provision, and citizens’ perceptions of governance. Three stories emerge. First, rural towns are growing, boosting high levels of ethnic diversity, and local trust, but are still largely agrarian and with unclear property rights. Second, a recent decentralization reform has been poorly implemented ten years on. Less than half the towns have a state administrators, no local elections took place, and revenue sharing is limited. Third, the governance goals of the reform remain largely unfulfilled. We observe a lack of democratic accountability, high levels of corruption, and an acute gap in financing. Finally, we find that these governance challenges are not correlated with levels of urbanization, implementation of the reforms, or levels of state capacity.
records.abstract_cn: 在脆弱性背景下，农村城镇是如何治理的？本文提供了描述性证据，以描述和量化刚果民主共和国四个省份中67个农村城镇的城市化及地方国家组织情况。我们呈现了关于城市化、国家与地方治理、税收、公共物品供给以及公民对治理感知的丰富数据。三个故事浮现出来。首先，农村城镇正在增长，促进了高度的民族多样性和地方信任，但仍以农业为主，且产权不明确。其次，近期的权力下放改革在十年后实施效果不佳。不到一半的城镇设有国家行政官员，没有举行地方选举，且收入分享有限。第三，改革的目标在很大程度上仍未实现。我们观察到缺乏民主问责、腐败程度高以及资金缺口严重。最后，我们发现这些治理挑战与城市化水平、改革实施程度或国家能力水平并不相关。

records.title_en: Fabricated justice: How due process reform enables evidence manipulation
records.title_cn: 伪造的正义：正当程序改革如何助长证据操纵
records.abstract_en: This paper examines how due process reforms enable evidence manipulation. During the past two decades, most Latin American countries have radically reformed their criminal justice systems, with the aim of strengthening rights protections and curbing abuses. Focusing on Mexico, we uncover a paradox of these institutional reforms: confronted with social pressures to punish crimes, police officers and prosecutors with limited investigation capacities fabricate criminal cases that pretend to conform with stricter judicial standards. Using difference-in-differences designs with a representative prison survey and ethnographic fieldwork among criminal prosecutors, we document a decline in torture and a parallel rise in convictions grounded in fabricated evidence, most commonly planted drugs and weapons. This shift toward what we call “fabricated justice” has fueled an increase in drug trafficking convictions. This recent increase in planted evidence suggests that when rule of law reforms are implemented without corresponding investments in state capacity, they can generate new and unexpected forms of abuse.
records.abstract_cn: 本文考察了正当程序改革如何助长证据操纵。在过去二十年中，大多数拉丁美洲国家对其刑事司法系统进行了彻底改革，旨在加强权利保护和遏制滥用。以墨西哥为研究对象，我们揭示了这些制度改革的悖论：面对惩罚犯罪的社会压力，调查能力有限的警察和检察官伪造刑事案件，以假装符合更严格的司法标准。利用具有代表性的监狱调查中的双重差分设计以及对刑事检察官的田野民族志调查，我们记录了刑讯逼供的减少以及基于伪造证据（最常见的是栽赃毒品和武器）的定罪同步上升。这种向我们所称的“伪造正义”的转变推动了贩毒定罪的增加。近期栽赃证据的增加表明，当法治改革在没有相应国家能力投资的情况下实施时，可能产生新的、意想不到的滥用形式。

records.title_en: Balancing efficiency and equity in fiscal decentralization: theory and evidence from China
records.title_cn: 财政分权中的效率与公平平衡：来自中国的理论与证据
records.abstract_en: Fiscal decentralization is widely acknowledged as a pivotal contributor to China’s economic growth. However, there is a paucity of literature examining the underlying drivers of fiscal decentralization in China. This paper examines the drivers of intergovernmental fiscal relations in China: fostering economic development and mitigating regional disparities. After reviewing the evolution of the fiscal system since the Reform and Opening Up, we build a theoretical model to shed light on the objectives of fiscal decentralization and derive two theoretical propositions. By using panel data of prefecture-level cities from 2004 to 2016 and incorporating a newly developed fiscal decentralization indicator, we empirically test the theoretical propositions. The empirical analysis shows that the degree of fiscal decentralization decreases with an increase in GDP growth goals or larger fiscal disparities of subordinate county-level governments. This paper not only shows that balancing efficiency and equity in determining fiscal decentralization, but also offers insights for developing countries on how to build a more effective fiscal decentralization system.
records.abstract_cn: 财政分权被广泛认为是中国经济增长的关键贡献因素。然而，关于中国财政分权背后驱动因素的文献却很少。本文考察了中国政府间财政关系的驱动因素：促进经济发展和缩小地区差距。在回顾改革开放以来财政体制演变的基础上，我们构建了一个理论模型来阐明财政分权的目标，并推导出两个理论命题。通过使用2004年至2016年地级市的面板数据，并结合新开发的财政分权指标，我们对理论命题进行了实证检验。实证分析表明，财政分权程度随着GDP增长目标的提高或下级县级政府财政差距的扩大而降低。本文不仅表明在确定财政分权时需要平衡效率与公平，还为发展中国家如何构建更有效的财政分权体系提供了见解。

records.title_en: Development as multidimensional environmental impoverishment
records.title_cn: 发展作为多维环境贫困化
records.abstract_en: Poverty is multidimensional. Economic growth often implies environmental impoverishment and hence diminished options to choose valuable lives. People who are deprived of access to land, clean water and air because of extractive industries or as victims of waste disposal, often complain accordingly. They have lost freedom of choice regardless possible income increases, if they get them at all. We illustrate this with examples of ecological distribution conflicts collected in the EJAtlas. If you get some extra money but lose access to land, water and clean air because extractive industries grab your place and pollute your family, you are poorer in some dimensions than before, and poverty estimates need to take this into account.
records.abstract_cn: 贫困是多维的。经济增长往往意味着环境的贫困化，从而减少了选择有价值生活的机会。那些因采掘业或作为废物处理受害者而被剥夺土地、清洁水源和空气使用权的人们，常常因此抱怨。无论可能的收入增加与否，他们都失去了选择的自由。我们通过环境正义地图集（EJAtlas）中收集的生态分配冲突实例来说明这一点。如果你获得了一些额外收入，但因采掘业占据你的居所并污染你的家庭而失去土地、水源和清洁空气的使用权，那么你在某些维度上比以前更贫困，贫困评估需要考虑到这一点。

records.title_en: Grievances, greed or tactics? The political ecology of jihadist expansion in West Africa’s WAP complex
records.title_cn: 不满、贪婪还是策略？西非WAP复合体中圣战扩张的政治生态学
records.abstract_en: The role of natural parks and protected areas in fostering peace or exacerbating conflict has gained increasing attention. While early scholarship emphasized their potential in post-conflict peacebuilding, political ecology has highlighted how the securitization of environmental concerns may clash with local resource management, fuelling hidden resistance or overt violence. Specific outcomes arguably depend on contextual features and eschew generalised answers, yet French-speaking West Africa remains underexplored in this debate. This article addresses that gap by focusing on the W-Arly-Pendjari (WAP) transboundary park complex across Burkina Faso, Niger, and Benin. Noting the expansion of jihadist groups in this area, this case selection further helps bridge the divide between conflict studies and political ecology literatures, including conservation amidst counterinsurgency.
records.abstract_cn: 自然公园和保护区在促进和平或加剧冲突中的作用日益受到关注。早期研究强调其在冲突后和平建设中的潜力，而政治生态学则突出了环境问题的安全化可能与地方资源管理相冲突，从而引发隐性抵抗或公开暴力。具体结果可能取决于背景特征，并避免一概而论，但法语西非在这一辩论中仍未得到充分探索。本文通过聚焦布基纳法索、尼日尔和贝宁的W-Arly-Pendjari（WAP）跨境公园复合体来填补这一空白。注意到该地区圣战组织的扩张，这一案例选择进一步有助于弥合冲突研究与政治生态学文献之间的鸿沟，包括反叛乱中的保护问题。

records.title_en: Gender, race and their interplay with economic status: intersectionality and asymmetric jeopardies in Brazilian education
records.title_cn: 性别、种族及其与经济地位的相互作用：巴西教育中的交叉性和不对称危险
records.abstract_en: A large body of research has illustrated how inequalities in educational achievements globally are rooted in a range of demographic and socioeconomic characteristics. However, the sources of educational disadvantages are too often considered in isolation, without addressing how they interplay with one another. Building upon the intersectionality and multiple jeopardy frameworks, in this paper we employ a sequential mixed-methods approach to analyse the role played by economic status, gender and race in shaping education attainment in Brazilian high-stakes secondary education exams. Our specific focus is on how economic status, conceptualised as comprising an absolute and a relative facet, interplays with gender and race. Our quantitative analysis reveals that the two components of economic status interplay symmetrically with gender but asymmetrically with race. Gender attainment gaps shrink with higher absolute and relative status. Race attainment gaps also shrink with higher absolute status, but they expand with higher relative status. We use the insights obtained from the literature as well as from our qualitative interviews to situate and explain these findings. Our work improves the understanding of the multifaceted disadvantage experienced by students from underprivileged households in Brazil, highlighting how economic inequality and discrimination hinder educational attainment and jeopardise social mobility.
records.abstract_cn: 大量研究表明，全球教育成就的不平等是如何根源于一系列人口和社会经济特征的。然而，人们常常孤立地考虑教育劣势的根源，而没有考虑它们之间如何相互作用。基于交叉性和多重危险框架，在本文中，我们采用顺序混合方法来分析经济地位、性别和种族在巴西高风险中等教育考试中影响教育程度的作用。我们的具体重点是经济地位（概念化为包含绝对和相对方面）如何与性别和种族相互作用。我们的定量分析表明，经济地位的两个组成部分与性别的相互作用对称，但与种族的相互作用不对称。随着绝对和相对地位的提高，性别成就差距缩小。种族成就差距也会随着绝对地位的提高而缩小，但随着相对地位的提高而扩大。我们利用从文献以及定性访谈中获得的见解来定位和解释这些发现。我们的工作增进了对巴西贫困家庭学生所经历的多方面劣势的理解，强调了经济不平等和歧视如何阻碍教育程度并危害社会流动性。

records.title_en: Does land tenure security reduce deforestation? Evidence from the Brazilian Amazon
records.title_cn: 土地保有权保障是否减少了森林砍伐？来自巴西亚马逊地区的证据
records.abstract_en: Increasing land tenure security has been advocated as a critical policy to reduce deforestation and promote sustainable development in the developing world. We evaluate the extent to which rural properties with secure land tenure are less prone to deforestation and more likely to comply with environmental rules in the Brazilian Amazon. We use a unique dataset with property-level information for the entire population of private rural properties registered in the state of Acre, Brazil. Our proxy for land tenure security is the absence of overlapping claims to property rights when a landowner registers their land in the federal Environmental Rural Registry. We evaluate the impacts of secure land rights on (i) the property’s share of the deforested area, and (ii) the likelihood that farmers comply with the Brazilian Forest Code, which defines a limit of 20% of deforested area in each property. The non-randomness between the treatment (land tenure security) and control (land tenure insecurity) groups is controlled by using various empirical strategies, including within-landholder fixed effects and matching strategies. Our results demonstrate that land tenure security significantly reduces deforestation and increases compliance with the Forest Code. We also show that even legally titled properties exhibit higher deforestation rates when land tenure rights are not effectively supported by land governance mechanisms.
records.abstract_cn: 提高土地保有权保障已被倡导为减少发展中国家森林砍伐和促进可持续发展的关键政策。我们评估了在巴西亚马逊地区，拥有有保障土地所有权的农村房产是否更不容易发生森林砍伐，并且更可能遵守环境规定。我们使用了一个独特的数据集，该数据集包含了巴西阿克雷州注册的所有私有农村房产的房产级信息。我们对土地保有权保障的代理指标是，当土地所有者在联邦环境农村登记处登记其土地时，不存在重叠的土地权利主张。我们评估了有保障的土地权利对以下方面的影响：（i）房产的森林砍伐面积占比，以及（ii）农民遵守巴西森林法典的可能性，该法典规定了每个房产森林砍伐面积20%的限制。处理组（土地保有权保障）和对照组（土地保有权无保障）之间的非随机性通过使用各种实证策略来控制，包括土地所有者内部固定效应和匹配策略。我们的结果表明，土地保有权保障显著减少了森林砍伐，并提高了对森林法典的遵守程度。我们还表明，即使是有合法所有权的房产，当土地保有权权利没有得到土地治理机制的有效支持时，其森林砍伐率也更高。

records.title_en: Gendered laws and Women’s financial inclusion
records.title_cn: 性别法律与女性金融包容性
records.abstract_en: This paper documents the relationship between legal gender equality and the use of financial services, using individual-level data from 148 developed and developing economies. The analysis, which combines data from the Global Findex and Women, Business and the Law databases, highlights the existence of a significant and positive correlation between gender equality in the law and women’s access to financial products. The results show that greater legal equality alleviates women’s involuntary financial exclusion. The findings also suggest that prevailing adverse social norms can nullify the beneficial effects of legal equality, and that better implementation of the law can facilitate a stronger relationship between legal frameworks and women’s financial inclusion.
records.abstract_cn: 本文利用来自148个发达和发展中经济体的个体层面数据，记录了法律性别平等与金融服务使用之间的关系。该分析结合了全球金融包容性指数（Global Findex）和《女性、商业与法律》数据库的数据，强调了法律中的性别平等与女性获取金融产品之间存在显著的正相关关系。结果表明，更大的法律平等缓解了女性的非自愿金融排斥。研究结果还表明，普遍存在的不利社会规范可能抵消法律平等的有益效果，而更好的法律实施可以促进法律框架与女性金融包容性之间更强的关系。

records.title_en: Economic convergence, intragenerational economic mobility, and inequality in a native Amazonian small-scale society of Indigenous People in Bolivia
records.title_cn: 玻利维亚土著亚马逊小规模社会中的经济趋同、代内经济流动性与不平等
records.abstract_en: Adult intragenerational mobility reflects society’s ability to reward effort and tame society-wide inequality. In developed economies, mobility is modest and correlates negatively with economic inequality. Little is known quantitatively from direct observations about long-term intragenerational mobility in small-scale societies of the Global South. To assess the external validity of findings about patterns of intragenerational mobility from developed economies, we use a yearly survey panel dataset (2002–2010) of adults from a society of native Amazonians (Tsimane’) in Bolivia practicing farming, fishing, hunting, and plant gathering. We estimate (a) convergence rates (or the speed of catch up) of adults in the bottom quintile to the rest of the population sample, (b) mobility defined as the change in quintile rank in economic outcomes between 2002 and 2010, and (c) the associations of economic mobility in rank between 2002 and 2010 with society-wide economic inequality in 2010, measured with the Gini coefficient. Outcomes included flows (income, barter) and wealth measured with the value of livestock, locally produced goods, and commercial goods. We found unambiguous evidence of convergence (those at the bottom were fast approaching the rest) and considerable evidence of both upward and downward mobility among women and men across all outcomes. Mobility and economic inequality correlated negatively. We did not observe the modest economic mobility typical of developed economies, but we found pockets of immobility at the top and an inverse relation between upward mobility and inequality.
records.abstract_cn: 成年人的代内流动性反映了社会奖励努力和抑制全社会不平等的能力。在发达经济体中，流动性适中，且与经济不平等呈负相关。关于全球南方小规模社会中长期代内流动性的直接观察定量研究很少。为了评估发达经济体代内流动性模式发现的外部有效性，我们使用了来自玻利维亚土著亚马逊人（Tsimane'）社会中从事农业、渔业、狩猎和植物采集的成年人的年度调查面板数据集（2002-2010）。我们估计了（a）底层五分之一成年人相对于其余人口样本的趋同率（或追赶速度），（b）流动性，定义为2002至2010年间经济结果五分位排名的变化，以及（c）2002至2010年间排名经济流动性与2010年全社会经济不平等（以基尼系数衡量）之间的关联。结果包括流量（收入、物物交换）和以牲畜价值、当地生产商品和商业商品衡量的财富。我们发现了明确的趋同证据（底层者正在快速接近其余人群），以及相当多的证据表明女性和男性在所有结果中均存在向上和向下的流动性。流动性与经济不平等呈负相关。我们没有观察到发达经济体典型的适度经济流动性，但发现了顶层的流动性停滞区域，以及向上流动与不平等之间的反向关系。

records.title_en: Citizenization and urban–rural income inequality: Evidence from the reform of hukou system in China
records.title_cn: 市民化与城乡收入不平等：来自中国户籍制度改革的证据
records.abstract_en: Amid global income inequality, identity liberalization presents a viable solution. Overcoming traditional data acquisition limitations, this study integrated geographic information systems and gridded satellite dataset, utilizing 1 km-resolution nighttime light intensity, population and township-level administrative data. Theil index quantifies county-level urban–rural income inequality, while the generalized difference-in-differences method, using China’s reform of hukou system as a quasi-experiment, demonstrates that citizenization significantly mitigates urban–rural income inequality, especially under institutional discrimination. The underlying mechanisms operate through two channels: First, dismantling identity barriers enhances rural residents’ access to health security and social mobility, fostering their market integration capacity; Second, eliminating regional constraints optimizes regional market absorption capacity by facilitating the farmland marketization, technology diffusion, and job opportunities. As a complement to informal institutions, regions with deep-rooted Confucian and clan cultures exhibit stronger reform synergy, whereas pronounced dialect barriers hinder effectiveness. Over time, citizenization mitigates urban–rural income inequality exacerbated during early urbanization, accelerates income convergence, and advances the inflection point of urban–rural disparity, fostering societal income equalization.
records.abstract_cn: 在全球收入不平等的背景下，身份自由化提供了一种可行的解决方案。为克服传统数据获取的限制，本研究整合了地理信息系统和网格化卫星数据集，利用1公里分辨率的夜间灯光强度、人口和乡镇级行政数据。泰尔指数量化了县级城乡收入不平等，而广义双重差分法以中国户籍制度改革为准自然实验，表明市民化显著缓解了城乡收入不平等，尤其是在制度性歧视下。其潜在机制通过两个渠道运作：第一，打破身份壁垒增强了农村居民获得健康保障和社会流动性的机会，促进了他们的市场整合能力；第二，消除区域限制通过促进农地市场化、技术扩散和就业机会，优化了区域市场吸收能力。作为非正式制度的补充，儒家和宗族文化根深蒂固的地区表现出更强的改革协同效应，而显著的方言障碍则削弱了改革效果。随着时间的推移，市民化缓解了早期城市化过程中加剧的城乡收入不平等，加速了收入趋同，并推进了城乡差距的拐点，促进了社会收入均等化。

records.title_en: “A snake with no teeth”: Urbanization shifts perceptions of men who support women’s empowerment in Northwestern Tanzania
records.title_cn: “无牙之蛇”：坦桑尼亚西北部城市化改变了对支持女性赋权男性的看法
records.abstract_en: Achieving gender equality requires the support of all genders, but efforts to engage men in women’s empowerment initiatives have been fraught with resistance. Existing research demonstrates that men often anticipate negative consequences for opposing patriarchal norms but has less frequently addressed variability in such perceptions within communities and their modification by socioecological change. Here, we examine the ramifications men face when deemed supportive of women’s empowerment with regard to their social status and prospects for marriage and reproduction, and how these ramifications are shifting with urbanization. Data come from a Tanzanian community, selected because it combines patriarchal norms, with shifting gender roles accompanying urbanization, offering a relevant case for understanding gender norm change in similar low and middle-income settings. Focus groups and in-depth interviews with community members (young men, young women, and elders) confirm severe social costs for men who support women’s empowerment, primarily in the form of reputational damage and social ostracism. Both men and women also frequently question the sexuality, desirability, and reproductive prospects of men engaging in gender atypical behaviors that support women. However, these costs are giving way to emerging incentives for a subset of supportive men who gain social prestige, at least among relatively well-educated peers, via their association with ‘modern’ values, attractiveness to women, access to novel employment opportunities, and adaptability to urban life. Through identifying entrenched costs for supportive men and emerging incentives accompanying urbanization, this study contributes to a deeper understanding of the barriers and pathways to effectively engaging men in women’s empowerment.
records.abstract_cn: 实现性别平等需要所有性别的支持，但让男性参与女性赋权倡议的努力常常遭遇阻力。现有研究表明，男性往往预期反对父权规范会带来负面后果，但较少关注此类看法在社区内部的差异性及其随社会生态变化而发生的改变。在此，我们考察了当男性被视为支持女性赋权时，他们在社会地位、婚姻和生育前景方面所面临的后果，以及这些后果如何随城市化而转变。数据来自坦桑尼亚的一个社区，该社区被选中的原因在于它结合了父权规范与伴随城市化而变化的性别角色，为理解类似低收入和中等收入环境中的性别规范变迁提供了相关案例。与社区成员（年轻男性、年轻女性和长者）进行的焦点小组和深度访谈证实，支持女性赋权的男性会承受严重的社会代价，主要表现为声誉受损和社会排斥。男性和女性也经常质疑那些支持女性、从事非典型性别行为男性的性取向、吸引力和生育前景。然而，这些代价正逐渐为一部分支持性男性带来的新兴激励所取代，他们至少在同辈中受教育程度较高的人群中，通过关联“现代”价值观、对女性的吸引力、获得新型就业机会以及对城市生活的适应性而获得社会声望。通过识别支持性男性面临的根深蒂固的代价以及伴随城市化出现的新兴激励，本研究有助于更深入地理解有效让男性参与女性赋权的障碍和途径。

records.title_en: Social gaps, perceived inequality and protests
records.title_cn: 社会差距、不平等和抗议
records.abstract_en: Latent feelings of economic vulnerability and social stagnation may have catalyzed the unprecedented uprisings that shook Latin America and other parts of the world in 2018–2019. We document this process in the context of Chile, leveraging survey data on protest participation and its potential determinants. Specifically, we construct a “social gap” index, measuring the disconnect between objective and perceived social status. Our findings suggest that this status misperception predicts protest involvement beyond factors such as perceived living costs, the subjective value of public services, peer influence, redistributive views and political demands. Notably, the social gap operates independently of broader feelings of unfairness and anger toward inequalities in explaining protests.
records.abstract_cn: 潜在的经济脆弱性和社会停滞感可能催化了2018-2019震惊拉丁美洲和世界其他地区的前所未有的起义。我们利用有关抗议参与及其潜在决定因素的调查数据，在智利的背景下记录了这一过程。具体来说，我们构建了一个“社会差距”指数，衡量客观社会地位与感知社会地位之间的脱节。我们的研究结果表明，这种地位误解预示着抗议活动的参与超出了感知生活成本、公共服务的主观价值、同伴影响、再分配观点和政治要求等因素。值得注意的是，在解释抗议活动时，社会差距的运作独立于更广泛的不公平感和对不平等的愤怒。

records.title_en: Armed conflict, community-based cash transfers, and social cohesion: Evidence from a randomized intervention in Ethiopia
records.title_cn: 武装冲突、社区现金转移与社会凝聚力：来自埃塞俄比亚随机干预的证据
records.abstract_en: Amid a surge in armed conflicts in Africa, the impact of armed conflicts on social cohesion and potential avenues to rebuild social cohesion in conflict-affected settings remain active areas of inquiry. Most importantly, identifying instruments and interventions that can effectively strengthen social cohesion in conflict-affected settings can inform and facilitate peace-building efforts. We examine whether community-based cash transfer and social protection programs can strengthen social cohesion in settings grappling with the adverse effects of armed conflict. We answer this question using the 2020 civil war in Ethiopia and combining this with a randomized community-based cash transfer program rolled out after the conflict. Exploiting temporal variation in the spread of large-scale armed conflicts (battles) across a two-wave panel survey, we show that battles are associated with a deterioration in social cohesion. Reassuringly, we demonstrate that a modestly sized community-based cash transfer can rebuild and restore social cohesion in communities grappling with armed conflict and deterioration in social cohesion. Heterogeneity analysis shows that households who belong to a minority ethnic group in each community reported a higher loss in social capital associated with their exposure to armed conflict and that the community-based cash transfer appears to be more effective in rebuilding social cohesion among these households.
records.abstract_cn: 在非洲武装冲突激增的背景下，武装冲突对社会凝聚力的影响以及在受冲突影响环境中重建社会凝聚力的潜在途径仍是活跃的研究领域。最重要的是，识别能够有效加强受冲突影响环境中社会凝聚力的工具和干预措施，可以为和平建设努力提供信息和便利。我们考察社区现金转移和社会保护项目是否能够在遭受武装冲突不利影响的环境中加强社会凝聚力。我们利用埃塞俄比亚2020年内战，并结合冲突后推出的随机社区现金转移项目来回答这个问题。利用两波面板调查中大规模武装冲突（战斗）传播的时间变化，我们表明战斗与社会凝聚力的恶化相关。令人欣慰的是，我们证明了一个规模适中的社区现金转移可以在遭受武装冲突和社会凝聚力恶化的社区中重建和恢复社会凝聚力。异质性分析显示，每个社区中属于少数族裔群体的家庭报告了与其暴露于武装冲突相关的社会资本损失更高，并且社区现金转移在重建这些家庭的社会凝聚力方面似乎更有效。

records.title_en: Wealth inequality and economic growth: Evidence from the World Inequality Database
records.title_cn: 财富不平等与经济增长：来自世界不平等数据库的证据
records.abstract_en: Although it is often argued that wealth inequality matters more for economic growth than income inequality, this relationship has rarely been studied empirically, with a few exceptions covering a very restricted country sample or short timeframe. Leveraging hitherto unexploited wealth inequality data from the World Inequality Database, covering a panel of 165 countries between 1995 and 2019, we document a negative and statistically significant relationship between wealth inequality and economic growth. A one standard deviation increase in the wealth Gini coefficient within countries is associated with a 0.34 percentage points decline in growth rates. Instrumental variables support a causal interpretation of the results. The results survive a large battery of robustness checks, and we find no evidence to suggest a heterogeneous relationship.
records.abstract_cn: 尽管经常有人认为财富不平等对经济增长的影响比收入不平等更重要，但这一关系很少被实证研究，仅有少数例外覆盖了非常有限的国家样本或短期时间框架。利用世界不平等数据库中迄今未开发的财富不平等数据，覆盖1995年至2019年间165个国家的面板数据，我们记录了财富不平等与经济增长之间存在负向且统计显著的关系。国家内部财富基尼系数每增加一个标准差，与增长率下降0.34个百分点相关。工具变量支持结果的因果解释。结果在大量稳健性检验中依然成立，且我们没有发现表明存在异质性关系的证据。

records.title_en: Gendering the safety net: Social protection policy and the limits to Decent Work in Cambodia’s garment sector
records.title_cn: 将性别纳入安全网：社会保护政策与柬埔寨服装业体面工作的限度
records.abstract_en: The adoption of the Social Protection Floors Recommendation (SPFR) by the International Labour Conference in 2012 is widely recognised as an “historic” (Deacon 2013) and “radical” (Cichon 2013) reorientation of social protection, promising a new “universal and comprehensive” approach. Despite the SPFR’s bold ambitions, however, the implementation of social protection floors at global- and national-level has proven uneven. In practice, the social protection floors initiative has generally been “subordinate” (Seekings, 2019) to the Decent Work agenda. Particularly in many lower-income settings in the global South, for instance, vertical expansion of benefits to waged workers through social insurance has taken precedence over the SPFR’s more radical promise to horizontally expand the frontiers of social assistance. In Cambodia, for example, entrenched norms of fiscal and social conservativism have focused policy attention on expanding benefits provided to the 700,000 workers in the country’s largest formal industry – the garment sector – rather than expanding the scope of social protection to include the yet more numerous informal or agricultural sector workforce. In this paper, we examine the consequences of this lopsided social protection strategy for its apparent beneficiaries: women working within the garment industry. We argue that the focus on extending support for formal workers, at the exclusion of informal workers is, in fact, detrimental to both groups. To illustrate these arguments, we draw on original data from the GCRF-funded ReFashion project, a longitudinal study tracing the impacts of the Covid-19 pandemic on a cohort of 200 garment workers in Cambodia over 24 months. We use this rich and grounded data to develop an emic perspective on social protection programming that shows how, in the absence of a robust social protection floor, gendered norms in Cambodia compel women to fill the gaps in social protection programming by the state. Women workers in the garment sector effectively fund a social safety net for family members through remittance transfers. However, garment sector salaries alone are insufficient for this task, leading to a “debtfare” (Soederberg 2014) model, in which workers finance these costs through increasing resort to personal debt. The result is a crisis of over-indebtedness among workers in the garment industry that undermines the achievement of Decent Work in the sector. We suggest that Covid-19 offers a moment for reflection, like that which followed the Global Financial Crisis of 2008 and inspired the SPRF itself, to learn from the vulnerabilities exposed by the pandemic and recentre a radical vision of social protection that delivers for all.
records.abstract_cn: 国际劳工大会于2012年通过的《社会保护底线建议书》（SPFR）被广泛认为是社会保护领域一次“历史性”（Deacon 2013）和“激进”（Cichon 2013）的重新定位，承诺采取一种新的“普遍且全面”的方法。然而，尽管SPFR雄心勃勃，社会保护底线在全球和国家层面的实施却证明是不均衡的。在实践中，社会保护底线倡议通常“从属于”（Seekings, 2019）体面工作议程。特别是在全球南方的许多低收入环境中，例如，通过社会保险向有薪工人纵向扩展福利，优先于SPFR更激进的横向扩展社会援助边界的承诺。以柬埔寨为例，根深蒂固的财政和社会保守主义规范将政策注意力集中在扩大该国最大正规产业——服装业——中700,000名工人的福利上，而不是将社会保护的范围扩大到更众多的非正规或农业部门劳动力。在本文中，我们研究了这种不平衡的社会保护策略对其明显受益者——在服装行业工作的女性——的后果。我们认为，将支持重点放在正规工人而排除非正规工人，实际上对这两个群体都有害。为了说明这些论点，我们利用了GCRF资助的ReFashion项目的原始数据，这是一项追踪Covid-19大流行对柬埔寨200名服装工人队列在24个月内影响的纵向研究。我们利用这些丰富且基于实地的数据，发展出关于社会保护规划的本地视角，展示了在缺乏健全社会保护底线的情况下，柬埔寨的性别规范如何迫使女性填补国家社会保护规划中的空白。服装行业的女性工人通过汇款转移，实际上为家庭成员资助了一个社会安全网。然而，仅靠服装行业的工资不足以完成这项任务，导致了一种“债务福利”（Soederberg 2014）模式，在这种模式中，工人通过日益依赖个人债务来为这些成本融资。结果是服装行业工人过度负债的危机，这削弱了该行业实现体面工作的目标。我们建议，Covid-19提供了一个反思的时刻，类似于2008年全球金融危机之后激发SPRF本身的时刻，从大流行暴露的脆弱性中学习，并重新聚焦于一种为所有人提供服务的激进社会保护愿景。

records.title_en: Estimating dynamic macroeconomic effects of exogenous remittances
records.title_cn: 估计外生汇款对宏观经济动态效应
records.abstract_en: We use a local projection instrumental variable approach to estimate dynamic macroeconomic effects of temporary, exogenous remittance shocks. We identify exogenous remittance shocks by instrumenting remittances with the migrant-share-weighted GDP per capita of migrants’ destination countries. Impulse response functions show that the identified remittance shock is temporary and that it has a significant positive effect on remittance-recipient countries’ real GDP per capita on impact, and cumulatively over the medium term, e.g. over periods of 5 and 10 years. Household consumption and investment significantly increase while the ratio of net exports over GDP decreases. We also find that the increase in exogenous remittances causes a significant increase in external debt and a significant decrease, on impact, in the external debt servicing cost as a fraction of GNI. Our empirical results are consistent with the predictions of the model by Bahadir et al. (2018) for the case in which an exogenous, temporary remittance inflow accrues to credit-constrained entrepreneurs.
records.abstract_cn: 我们采用局部投影工具变量方法，估计临时性、外生汇款冲击对宏观经济的动态效应。我们通过使用移民目的地国家的人均GDP（按移民份额加权）作为汇款的工具变量，来识别外生汇款冲击。脉冲响应函数显示，识别出的汇款冲击是暂时的，并且对汇款接收国的实际人均GDP在冲击当期及中期累积（例如在5年和10年期间）有显著的正效应。家庭消费和投资显著增加，而净出口占GDP的比例下降。我们还发现，外生汇款的增加导致外债显著增加，并且在外债偿还成本占国民总收入的比例上，冲击当期显著下降。我们的实证结果与Bahadir等人（2018年）模型中关于外生、临时性汇款流入流向信贷受限企业家的预测一致。

records.title_en: Identification of earnings dynamics using rotating samples over short periods: the case of Chile
records.title_cn: 利用短期轮换样本识别收入动态：以智利为例
records.abstract_en: Due to high informality and sparse longitudinal data, empirical studies often ignore labor income dynamics in developing economies, where earnings inequality is highest and social insurance is weakest. I propose a dynamic earnings process with two distinct shocks: unemployment spells and the wages of workers who stay employed. This income process can be estimated from employment surveys with a rotating sample design, which are available for several countries. Applying this procedure to Chilean data, I show that wage volatility and unemployment rates are highly heterogeneous across workers. Unemployment spells are the most important source of earnings risk for workers.
records.abstract_cn: 由于高度非正规性和稀疏的纵向数据，实证研究往往忽视发展中经济体的劳动收入动态，而这些经济体的收入不平等最为严重，社会保险最为薄弱。我提出一个包含两种不同冲击的动态收入过程：失业期和保持就业的工人的工资。这一收入过程可以从具有轮换样本设计的就业调查中估计，这类调查在多个国家可得。将这一方法应用于智利数据，我表明工资波动性和失业率在工人之间高度异质。失业期是工人收入风险的最重要来源。

records.title_en: Effect of women’s inclusion on conservation and management practices of Water User Associations
records.title_cn: 女性参与对水用户协会保护与管理实践的影响
records.abstract_en: Water scarcity remains a pressing challenge in rural areas of developing countries, making it essential to adopt more effective water governance. This study explores whether women’s inclusion in the executive committees of Water User Associations (WUAs) may enhance both management and conservation activities meant to improve rural water governance. Focusing on rural areas in Colombia, Honduras, Nicaragua and Bolivia, we analyze over 4,000 survey observations from the Rural Water and Sanitation Information System (SIASAR). We use cardinality matching to compare activities by WUAs with more women on the executive committee to statistically comparable WUAs with fewer women on the committee. Our study finds that the presence of women on WUA boards is significantly associated with increased conservation activities, such as protection of water sources, and recommended management practices, such as the formal legalization of the association. These improvements help strengthen both ecological and social systems against environmental degradation. Our findings suggest that promoting women’s inclusion in water governance could improve the effectiveness and sustainability of water management in rural Latin America. These results contribute to the ongoing discourse on gender, water governance, and environmental protection.
records.abstract_cn: 水资源短缺仍是发展中国家农村地区面临的紧迫挑战，因此采用更有效的水治理至关重要。本研究探讨了在水用户协会（WUAs）执行委员会中纳入女性是否可能增强旨在改善农村水治理的管理和保护活动。我们聚焦于哥伦比亚、洪都拉斯、尼加拉瓜和玻利维亚的农村地区，分析了来自农村供水和卫生信息系统（SIASAR）的超过4,000份调查观测数据。我们使用基数匹配方法，将执行委员会中女性较多的WUAs的活动与统计上可比的、委员会中女性较少的WUAs进行比较。研究发现，WUA董事会中女性的存在与保护活动（如水源保护）和推荐的管理实践（如协会的正式合法化）显著相关。这些改进有助于加强生态和社会系统抵御环境退化的能力。我们的研究结果表明，促进女性参与水治理可能提高拉丁美洲农村水管理的有效性和可持续性。这些结果有助于当前关于性别、水治理和环境保护的讨论。

records.title_en: Why embracing uncertainty means rethinking development
records.title_cn: 为何拥抱不确定性意味着重新思考发展
records.abstract_en: Uncertainty – where we don’t know what the future will hold – dominates our world. Climate change, natural disasters, pandemics and financial systems are characterised by deep uncertainties, even ignorance. Yet development efforts try to control, manage, plan and order the world in ways that often backfire. In an age of uncertainty, we need to ask whether development should be a project of control, often drawing on formal expertise and creating order through top-down intervention, or one of flexible, responsive, adaptive caring This Insights essay will explore the implications of taking uncertainty seriously, examining the implications for how we approach perhaps the biggest development challenge of all: adapting to climate change.
records.abstract_cn: 不确定性——即我们不知道未来会怎样——主导着我们的世界。气候变化、自然灾害、大流行病和金融体系都带有深刻的不确定性，甚至无知。然而，发展努力试图以往往适得其反的方式控制、管理、规划和整顿世界。在不确定性的时代，我们需要问，发展是否应是一个控制项目，通常依赖正式专业知识并通过自上而下的干预建立秩序，还是应是一个灵活、响应性、适应性关怀的项目。这篇见解文章将探讨认真对待不确定性的含义，审视这对我们如何应对也许是最大的发展挑战——适应气候变化——所产生的影响。

records.title_en: “I have already died in this PLACE:” livelihood impact pathways of conservation and land use change among highland Indigenous groups in northern Thailand
records.title_cn: “我已在此地死去：”泰国北部高地原住民群体中保护与土地利用变化的生计影响路径
records.abstract_en: International conservation frameworks and targets have increasingly recognised the central role of Indigenous peoples in managing and preserving natural resources. However, a clearer understanding of the land use and conservation policy experiences, and the resulting livelihood impacts, of Indigenous peoples is essential to devise conservation policies that are not only more inclusive but also potentially more effective. This article argues that livelihood impact pathways analysis, operationalised through the activity space framework, can help unravel overlapping, counter-acting, and often invisible pathways of multi-dimensional livelihood that tend to remain fragmented or disconnected in prevailing livelihood research. We employed this approach in four Indigenous communities in northern Thailand, drawing on participatory qualitative research conducted from 07/2019 to 06/2021. The analysis identified five distinct yet interconnected pathways through which land use change and conservation policies interact with the relational systems linking communities, state actors, and local ecosystems. Spanning multi-dimensional livelihood impacts on inter- and intra-community relationships, meaning making, forest degradation, and state-community conflicts, these pathways were also shaped by contextual forces such as rural development processes and international legal developments. We recommend that consultative processes with stakeholders from affected communities and the sectors of policy, development, civil society, and academia employ the activity space framework as a systems mapping tool to identify and prioritise behavioural intervention options along direct and indirect impact pathways on livelihoods and related outcomes of forest health.
records.abstract_cn: 国际保护框架和目标日益认识到原住民在管理和保护自然资源中的核心作用。然而，更清晰地理解原住民的土地利用和保护政策经历及其产生的生计影响，对于制定不仅更具包容性而且可能更有效的保护政策至关重要。本文认为，通过活动空间框架操作化的生计影响路径分析，有助于揭示多维生计中重叠、相互抵消且往往不可见的路径，这些路径在主流生计研究中往往保持碎片化或脱节。我们在泰国北部的四个原住民社区中采用了这种方法，基于从07/2019到06/2021进行的参与式定性研究。分析识别出五个不同但相互关联的路径，通过这些路径，土地利用变化和保护政策与连接社区、国家行为者和当地生态系统的关系系统相互作用。这些路径涵盖了对社区内部和社区间关系、意义建构、森林退化和国家-社区冲突的多维生计影响，同时也受到农村发展进程和国际法律发展等背景力量的影响。我们建议，与受影响社区及政策、发展、公民社会和学术界利益相关者的协商过程应采用活动空间框架作为系统映射工具，以识别和优先考虑沿着直接和间接生计影响路径以及森林健康相关结果的行为干预选项。

records.title_en: Friends or foes? The insurgent’s dilemma of seeking legitimacy while keeping secrets
records.title_cn: 朋友还是敌人？叛乱者在寻求合法性与保守秘密之间的困境
records.abstract_en: Why do some rebel groups seek legitimacy more than others? This article develops a theory to explain that the variation among insurgencies will depend on a trade-off insurgents confront between the interest to obtain legitimacy and the exposure to vulnerability. Inclusive insurgencies disclose information to seek legitimacy, allowing rebels to gain popular support, secure resources, and broader collaboration with non-combatants, thereby enhancing operational efficiency. In contrast, exclusive insurgencies, often emerging from radical factions, emphasize secrecy to protect the insurgency from existential threats, as their leaders are more easily targeted, leaks are relatively costlier, and disclosure increases the risk of detection. Faced with this trade-off and constrained by the likelihood of splintering, insurgencies unleash violent and non-violent actions. The theory is supported by an analysis of Peru’s 1980–2000 insurgencies: the Shining Path and the Tupac Amaru Revolutionary Movement.
records.abstract_cn: 为什么有些叛乱团体比其他团体更寻求合法性？本文提出了一种理论来解释，叛乱之间的差异将取决于叛乱者在获取合法性的利益与暴露于脆弱性之间所面临的权衡。包容性叛乱披露信息以寻求合法性，使叛军能够获得民众支持、确保资源以及与平民更广泛的合作，从而提高作战效率。相反，排他性叛乱通常源于激进派系，强调保密以保护叛乱免受生存威胁，因为其领导人更容易成为目标，泄密的代价相对更高，而披露会增加被发现的风险。面对这种权衡并受制于分裂的可能性，叛乱会采取暴力与非暴力行动。该理论通过对秘鲁1980-2000年叛乱的分析得到支持：光辉道路和图帕克·阿马鲁革命运动。

records.title_en: Who on earth is using Generative AI?
records.title_cn: 究竟是谁在使用生成式人工智能？
records.abstract_en: This paper offers the first comprehensive, global analysis of generative AI adoption by individuals, using novel data sources including website traffic and Google Trends. The paper also examines country-level factors driving the uptake and early impacts of generative artificial intelligence on online activities. As of March 2024, the top 40 generative artificial intelligence tools attract nearly 3 billion visits per month from hundreds of millions of users. ChatGPT alone commands over 80 percent of the traffic, yet its reach remains less than two percent of Google’s. Generative artificial intelligence users skew young, highly educated, and male, particularly for video generation tools, with usage patterns strongly indicating productivity-related activities. Generative artificial intelligence has achieved unprecedentedly rapid global diffusion, reaching almost all economies worldwide within 16 months of ChatGPT’s release. Strikingly, middle-income economies account for over half of global generative AI traffic, a disproportionately high share relative to their economic size, while low-income economies contribute less than 1 percent. Country level adoption intensity is strongly correlated with the share of youth population, digital infrastructure, English fluency, foreign direct investment inflows, services’ share of GDP, and human capital. Finally, the paper also documents disruptions in online traffic patterns and emphasizes the need for targeted investments in digital infrastructure and skills development to fully realize the potential of artificial intelligence.
records.abstract_cn: 本文利用包括网站流量和谷歌趋势在内的新颖数据来源，首次对个人采用生成式人工智能的情况进行了全面的全球分析。文章还考察了推动生成式人工智能应用的国家层面因素及其对在线活动的早期影响。截至2024年三月，排名前40位的生成式人工智能工具每月吸引近3亿次访问，用户达数亿。仅ChatGPT就占据了超过80%的流量，但其覆盖面仍不到谷歌的百分之二。生成式人工智能用户偏向年轻、高学历和男性，尤其是在视频生成工具方面，使用模式强烈表明与生产力相关的活动。生成式人工智能实现了前所未有的快速全球扩散，在ChatGPT发布后的16个月内就覆盖了全球几乎所有经济体。引人注目的是，中等收入经济体占全球生成式人工智能流量的半数以上，这一比例相对于其经济规模而言过高，而低收入经济体的贡献不足1%。国家层面的采用强度与青年人口比例、数字基础设施、英语流利程度、外国直接投资流入、服务业占GDP比重以及人力资本密切相关。最后，本文还记录了在线流量模式的干扰，并强调需要对数字基础设施和技能发展进行有针对性的投资，以充分发挥人工智能的潜力。

records.title_en: Do corruption experiences promote emigration? Observational and experimental evidence from Sub-Saharan Africa
records.title_cn: 腐败经历是否促进移民？来自撒哈拉以南非洲的观察性与实验性证据
records.abstract_en: How does corruption influence emigration decisions? Previous research has focused on the relationship between individuals’ perceptions of corruption and their desire to emigrate internationally. In this paper, we argue that personal experiences of corruption influence the desire to emigrate even more strongly than perceptions in order to escape from extortion and demands for bribes. To explore the relationship between corruption experiences and emigration, we analyse survey data from Afrobarometer alongside an original survey experiment. We use Afrobarometer to model the relationship between different types of corruption experiences on both intentions and specific plans to emigrate. We conduct a vignette experiment in Kenya in which respondents rate the desirability of emigration for a hypothetical countryman with varying experiences of corruption. We find that personal experiences of corruption are a strong push factor for migration, and that this relationship does not vary with education levels. Our study extends the literature by focussing on how personal experiences of corruption shape migration.
records.abstract_cn: 腐败如何影响移民决策？以往研究聚焦于个人对腐败的感知与其国际移民意愿之间的关系。在本文中，我们认为个人腐败经历对移民意愿的影响甚至比感知更强，以逃避勒索和索贿。为探究腐败经历与移民之间的关系，我们分析了来自非洲晴雨表的调查数据以及一项原创性调查实验。我们利用非洲晴雨表数据，对不同类型腐败经历与移民意向及具体移民计划之间的关系进行建模。我们在肯尼亚开展了一项情境实验，受访者对一个经历不同程度腐败的假设性同胞的移民可取性进行评分。我们发现，个人腐败经历是移民的强大推动因素，且这种关系不随教育水平变化。我们的研究通过聚焦个人腐败经历如何塑造移民行为，拓展了相关文献。

records.title_en: Can corporate good deeds reduce environmental injustice? Evidence from China
records.title_cn: 企业善行能否减少环境不公正？来自中国的证据
records.abstract_en: This study explores the role of corporate social responsibility (CSR) in enhancing environmental justice. We argue that CSR helps mitigate environmental injustice, a responsibility stemming from ethical considerations faced by corporations. Furthermore, building on previous studies that identify income disparity as the key factor contributing to environmental injustice, we find that regional economic growth, poverty alleviation among the rural poor, and the enhancement of political power are the primary channels through which CSR influences environmental justice. An analysis of Chinese listed companies provides evidence supporting our view, revealing a more pronounced mitigating effect of CSR on environmental injustice in non-state-owned, environmentally friendly, and large-scale firms. Notably, this contribution of CSR to environmental justice is more evident in the economically developed eastern region of China, which boasts a high level of marketization and a favorable business environment. This highlights the substantive role of CSR in environmental justice. By incorporating CSR into environmental justice studies, our research makes a meaningful theoretical advancement in understanding corporate ethical responsibilities and offers practical implications.
records.abstract_cn: 本研究探讨了企业社会责任（CSR）在促进环境公正中的作用。我们认为，企业社会责任有助于缓解环境不公正，这一责任源于企业面临的伦理考量。此外，基于先前将收入差距视为导致环境不公正的关键因素的研究，我们发现区域经济增长、农村贫困人口的脱贫以及政治权力的增强是企业社会责任影响环境公正的主要渠道。对中国上市公司的分析提供了支持我们观点的证据，显示在非国有、环保型和大型企业中，企业社会责任对环境不公正的缓解作用更为显著。值得注意的是，企业社会责任对环境公正的贡献在中国经济发达的东部地区更为明显，该地区市场化程度高、营商环境良好。这凸显了企业社会责任在环境公正中的实质性作用。通过将企业社会责任纳入环境公正研究，我们的研究在理解企业伦理责任方面取得了有意义的理论进展，并提供了实践启示。

records.title_en: Bringing contact interventions to the lab: Effects of brief bilateral discussions on interethnic trust in Senegal
records.title_cn: 将接触干预引入实验室：塞内加尔简短双边讨论对族际信任的影响
records.abstract_en: The contact hypothesis posits that interaction with outgroup members can reduce prejudice and improve intergroup relations. While the overall effects of contact have been found to be positive, some studies have found null or even negative effects. We aim to contribute to the understanding of the scope conditions of contact interventions, by singling out the effects of a common component of all existing contact interventions, namely bilateral discussions. Our brief contact is found to be effective in increasing interethnic trust toward the individuals met during the intervention, in line with previous results from longer interventions. However, the results do not generalize to the collective level. Our heterogeneity analyses fail to find evidence of heterogeneity in the treatment effect.
records.abstract_cn: 接触假说认为，与外群体成员的互动可以减少偏见并改善群体间关系。虽然接触的总体效应被发现是积极的，但一些研究发现效应为零甚至为负。我们旨在通过单独考察所有现有接触干预中一个共同组成部分——即双边讨论——的效应，来促进对接触干预适用范围条件的理解。我们发现，简短的接触能有效增加对干预中遇到的个体的族际信任，这与先前较长干预的结果一致。然而，这些结果并未推广到集体层面。我们的异质性分析未能找到处理效应异质性的证据。

records.title_en: Institutional Corporate Bond Pricing
records.title_cn: 机构公司债券定价
records.abstract_en: We propose an equilibrium corporate bond pricing model that accommodates the heterogeneity in institutional investors’ preferences and mandates in an empirically tractable way. Our model, estimated on rich holdings data, quantifies investors’ preferences and demand elasticities, with inelastic insurers focusing on the investment-grade segment, and elastic mutual funds substituting across ratings groups. The model offers a novel quantitative perspective of the effect of recent trends in institutional ownership on equilibrium credit spreads and the funding costs of corporations. Overall, our model emphasizes the composition of institutional demand as an important state variable for corporate bond pricing.
records.abstract_cn: 我们提出了一个均衡公司债券定价模型，该模型以经验上可处理的方式容纳了机构投资者偏好和授权的异质性。我们的模型在丰富的持仓数据上估计，量化了投资者的偏好和需求弹性，其中缺乏弹性的保险公司专注于投资级细分市场，而具有弹性的共同基金则在评级组之间进行替代。该模型为近期机构所有权趋势对均衡信用利差和公司融资成本的影响提供了新颖的定量视角。总体而言，我们的模型强调机构需求的构成作为公司债券定价的重要状态变量。

records.title_en: Failure to Share Natural Disaster Risk
records.title_cn: 未能分担自然灾害风险
records.abstract_en: I test whether asset prices reflect risk exposures of financial intermediaries in a setting well-suited to tackling concerns about omitted risk factors. I analyze catastrophe bonds whose cash flows are linked to natural disasters and find that 71% of the security-level variation in expected returns can be explained by a theoretically motivated measure of intermediaries’ marginal utility. Assuming natural disasters are independent of aggregate wealth, this result is inconsistent with any alternative explanation based on unobserved macroeconomic risks. In addition, the aggregate premium decreases and becomes less sensitive to the occurrence of disasters when intermediaries’ access to outside capital improves.
records.abstract_cn: 我检验了资产价格是否反映了金融中介机构的风险敞口，这一设定非常适合解决遗漏风险因素的担忧。我分析了现金流与自然灾害相关的巨灾债券，发现预期收益的证券层面变化中有71%可以由理论上合理的中介机构边际效用度量来解释。假设自然灾害与总财富独立，这一结果与任何基于未观察到的宏观经济风险的替代解释都不一致。此外，当中介机构获取外部资本的渠道改善时，总溢价下降且对灾害发生的敏感度降低。

records.title_en: Getting to the Core: Inflation Risks Within and Across Asset Classes
records.title_cn: 触及核心：资产类别内部与跨资产类别的通胀风险
records.abstract_en: Do real assets protect against inflation? Stocks’ core inflation betas are negative, while their energy betas are positive. Currencies, commodities, and real estate mostly hedge against energy inflation, but not core inflation. These hedging properties are reflected in the prices of inflation risks: only core inflation carries a negative risk premium, and its magnitude is consistent within and across asset classes, uniquely among macroeconomic risk factors. Energy inflation has become more procyclical and volatile since the 1990s, which helps explain the time-varying correlation between stock and bond returns. A two-sector New Keynesian asset pricing model accounts for these facts quantitatively.
records.abstract_cn: 实物资产能否对冲通胀？股票的核心通胀贝塔为负，而能源通胀贝塔为正。货币、大宗商品和房地产大多能对冲能源通胀，但不能对冲核心通胀。这些对冲属性反映在通胀风险的价格上：只有核心通胀带有负的风险溢价，且其幅度在资产类别内部及跨资产类别之间保持一致，这在宏观经济风险因素中是独一无二的。自1990年代以来，能源通胀变得更加顺周期和波动，这有助于解释股票与债券收益之间时变的相关性。一个两部门新凯恩斯主义资产定价模型在数量上解释了这些事实。

records.title_en: How Likely Is an Inflation Disaster?
records.title_cn: 通胀灾难的可能性有多大？
records.abstract_en: Long-dated inflation swap contracts provide widely used estimates of expected inflation. We develop methods to estimate complementary tail probabilities for persistently very high or low inflation using inflation options prices. We show that three new adjustments to conventional methods are crucial: inflation, horizon, and risk. We find that: (a) U.S. deflation risk in 2011–2014 has been overstated, (b) ECB unconventional policies lowered deflation disaster probabilities, (c) inflation expectations deanchored in 2021–2022, (d) reanchored as policy tightened, (e) but the 2021–2024 disaster left scars, and (f) U.S. expectations are less sensitive to inflation realizations than in the eurozone.
records.abstract_cn: 长期通胀互换合约提供了广泛使用的预期通胀估计。我们开发了利用通胀期权价格来估计持续极高或极低通胀的互补尾部概率的方法。我们表明，对传统方法的三项新调整至关重要：通胀、期限和风险。我们发现：(a) 美国在2011-2014年的通缩风险被高估了，(b) 欧洲央行的非常规政策降低了通缩灾难概率，(c) 通胀预期在2021-2022年脱锚，(d) 随着政策收紧而重新锚定，(e) 但2021-2024年的灾难留下了伤痕，以及(f) 美国的预期对通胀实现的敏感度低于欧元区。

records.title_en: Option Auctions
records.title_cn: 期权拍卖
records.abstract_en: Wholesale market makers pay for retail options orders that must be executed on exchanges. Payment for order flow (PFOF) wholesalers compete via price improvement in exchange auctions. To attract retail orders, wholesalers run more auctions when their recent price improvement has been lower. However, auction price improvement lowers market maker revenues. Wholesalers earn revenues to pay PFOF in nonauction trades where their designated market maker status increases their execution priority. While some auctions produce substantial price improvement, most do not have multiple bidders offering meaningful price improvement. Overall, options market structure better promotes competition in auctions than in nonauctions.
records.abstract_cn: 批发市场做市商为必须在交易所执行的零售期权订单支付费用。订单流付款（PFOF）批发商通过交易所拍卖中的价格改善进行竞争。为了吸引零售订单，当批发商最近的价格改善较低时，他们会举办更多拍卖。然而，拍卖价格改善降低了做市商的收入。批发商在非拍卖交易中赚取收入以支付PFOF，在这些交易中，他们指定的做市商身份提高了其执行优先级。虽然一些拍卖产生了显著的价格改善，但大多数拍卖没有多个投标人提供有意义的价格改善。总体而言，期权市场结构在促进拍卖中的竞争方面优于非拍卖。

records.title_en: Common Factors in Equity Option Returns
records.title_cn: 股票期权收益中的共同因子
records.abstract_en: We explore the factor structure in delta-hedged equity option returns. A sparse latent factor model generates a correlation of 0.90 or higher between average and predicted option returns. A comparable performance is achieved with a characteristic-based model containing four factors: the equally weighted option portfolio, a factor based on the difference between historical and implied volatilities, a factor based on the ratio of corporate cash holdings to the total value of the firm’s assets, and a factor based on volatility of volatility. Traditional stock return factors cannot explain these option factors.
records.abstract_cn: 我们探讨了德尔塔对冲股票期权收益中的因子结构。一个稀疏潜在因子模型产生的平均期权收益与预测期权收益之间的相关性达到0.90或更高。一个基于特征的四因子模型也实现了类似的性能，这四个因子包括：等权重期权组合、基于历史波动率与隐含波动率之差的因子、基于公司现金持有量与企业总资产之比的因子，以及基于波动率的波动率的因子。传统的股票收益因子无法解释这些期权因子。

records.title_en: Option Pricing with Time-Varying Volatility Risk Aversion
records.title_cn: 时变波动率风险厌恶下的期权定价
records.abstract_en: We introduce a pricing kernel with time-varying volatility risk aversion to explain the observed time variations in the shape of the pricing kernel. When combined with the Heston-Nandi GARCH model, this framework yields a tractable option pricing model in which the variance risk ratio (VRR) emerges as a key variable. We show that the VRR is closely linked to economic fundamentals, as well as sentiment and uncertainty measures. A novel approximation method provides analytical option pricing formulas, and we demonstrate substantial reductions in pricing errors through an empirical application to the S&P 500 index, the CBOE VIX, and option prices.
records.abstract_cn: 我们引入了一个具有时变波动率风险厌恶的定价核，以解释观察到的定价核形状的时变特征。当与Heston-Nandi GARCH模型结合时，该框架产生了一个易于处理的期权定价模型，其中方差风险比率（VRR）成为关键变量。我们表明，VRR与经济基本面以及情绪和不确定性指标密切相关。一种新颖的近似方法提供了解析期权定价公式，并且我们通过对S&P 500指数、CBOE VIX和期权价格的实证应用，展示了定价误差的显著减少。

records.title_en: Bargaining Foundations for the Outside Option Principle
records.title_cn: 外部期权原则的讨价还价基础
records.abstract_en: We study a bargaining game in which a seller can trade with one of two buyers, who have values h and l (h>l). The outside option principle (OOP) predicts that, as players become patient, the seller trades with the high-value buyer with probability converging to 1 at a price converging to max(h/2,l). While this prediction is supported by the Markov perfect equilibrium (MPE), a wide range of trading outcomes may emerge in subgame perfect equilibria (SPEs): in the patient limit, the seller can obtain any price in the interval [h/2,h] (and no other); moreover, allocative inefficiency and costly delay are possible. We propose equilibrium refinements less restrictive than Markov behavior that guarantee trading outcomes consistent with the OOP. One refinement requires that a buyer’s relative probability of trade does not increase dramatically following a failed negotiation with that buyer. Another refinement posits that the seller does not approach a buyer hoping that negotiations fail. SPEs satisfying both refinements conform with the OOP (but need not be MPEs). Our benchmark model features strategic matching by the seller. We provide a parallel analysis for the random matching protocol. Under random matching, prices in SPEs may also rise above and fall below l, but have a narrower range. A refinement particular to this protocol that restores the OOP requires that a random mismatch should not impact the seller excessively.
records.abstract_cn: 我们研究了一种讨价还价游戏，其中卖方可以与 一 个买方进行交易，这些买方的值为 h 和 l (h>l)。外部期权原理 (OOP) 预测，随着玩家变得耐心，卖方与高价值买方进行交易的概率收敛于 1，价格收敛于 max(h/2,l)。虽然这一预测得到了马尔可夫完美均衡 (MPE) 的支持，但在子博弈完美均衡 (SPE) 中可能会出现多种交易结果：在耐心极限下，卖方可以获得 [h/2,h] 区间内的任何价格（除此之外没有其他价格）；此外，分配效率低下和代价高昂的延误也是可能的。我们提出比马尔可夫行为限制更少的均衡改进，保证交易结果与 OOP 一致。 一细化要求买家的相对交易概率不会在与买家谈判失败后急剧增加。另一项改进假设卖方不会希望谈判失败而与买方联系。满足这两个细化的 SPE 符合 OOP（但不必是 MPE）。我们的基准模型以卖方的战略匹配为特色。我们为随机匹配协议提供并行分析。在随机匹配下，SPE 的价格也可能上涨或下跌至 l 以下，但幅度较小。该协议特有的一项改进是恢复 OOP，要求随机不匹配不应过度影响卖方。

records.title_en: Search Direction: Position Externalities and Position Auction Bias
records.title_cn: 搜索方向：头寸外部性和头寸拍卖偏差
records.abstract_en: We formulate a tractable model of pricing under directed search with heterogeneous firm demands. Demand characteristics drive bids in a position auction and enable us to bridge insights from the ordered search literature to those in the position auction literature. Equilibrium pricing implies that the marginal consumer’s surplus decreases down the search order, so consumers optimally follow the firms’ position ordering. A firm suffers from “business stealing” by firms that precede it and “search appeal” from subsequent firms. We find rankings that achieve the maximal joint profit or consumer surplus by constructing firm-specific scores. A generalized second price auction for positions endogenizes equilibrium orders and bids are driven by position externalities that impact incremental profit from switching positions. The joint profit maximization order is upheld when firm heterogeneity concerns mostly their mark-up potentials. But the consumer welfare order is robust when firms differ mostly over their potential market sizes.
records.abstract_cn: 我们在具有异质企业需求的定向搜索下制定了一个易于处理的定价模型。需求特征驱动头寸拍卖中的出价，并使我们能够将有序搜索文献中的见解与头寸拍卖文献中的见解联系起来。均衡定价意味着边际消费者剩余沿着搜索顺序递减，因此消费者最优地遵循企业的头寸排序。一家公司遭受先行公司的“业务窃取”和后续公司的“搜索吸引力”的困扰。我们通过构建特定于公司的分数来找到实现最大联合利润或消费者剩余的排名。头寸的广义第二价格拍卖会内生均衡订单，而出价由头寸外部性驱动，影响头寸转换带来的增量利润。当公司异质性主要涉及其加价潜力时，联合利润最大化顺序就会得到维持。但当企业在潜在市场规模上存在重大分歧时，消费者福利秩序是稳健的。

records.title_en: Demand Shocks as Technology Shocks
records.title_cn: 需求冲击与技术冲击一样
records.abstract_en: We provide a macroeconomic theory where demand for goods has a productive role. A search friction prevents perfect matching between producers and potential customers. Larger demand induces more search, which, in turn, increases GDP and measured total factor productivity (TFP). We embed the product-market friction in a standard neoclassical model and estimate it using Bayesian techniques. Business cycles are driven by preference shocks, true technology shocks, and investment-specific shocks. Preference shocks have qualitatively similar effects as true productivity shocks. These shocks account for a large share of the fluctuations in consumption, GDP, and measured TFP and can be identified using shopping time data.
records.abstract_cn: 我们提供了一种宏观经济理论，其中商品需求具有生产性作用。搜索摩擦阻碍了生产商和潜在客户之间的完美匹配。更大的需求会引发更多的搜索，进而增加 GDP 和衡量的全要素生产率 (TFP)。我们将产品市场摩擦嵌入标准新古典模型中，并使用贝叶斯技术对其进行估计。商业周期是由偏好冲击、真正的技术冲击和特定投资冲击驱动的。偏好冲击与真正的生产率冲击具有本质上相似的影响。这些冲击在消费、GDP 和测量的 TFP 波动中占很大比例，并且可以使用购物时间数据来识别。

records.title_en: Public Listing Choice with Persistent Hidden Information
records.title_cn: 具有持续隐藏信息的公开上市选择
records.abstract_en: How much does firm intangibility amplify CEOs’ persistent private information and reduce firms’ public listing propensity? We develop a model of competing public and private investors financing firms heterogeneously exposed to persistent private cash flows. Equilibrium financing is driven by information rent differentials in CEO compensation. We validate and structurally estimate the model using firm listing and CEO compensation data. We find private (intangible) cash flows exhibit 63% higher persistence than their tangible counterparts. Further, if firm intangibility levels returned to those of 1980, mean listing propensities would increase 5 percentage points while mean CEO variable pay growth would decrease by 61%.
records.abstract_cn: 公司的无形性在多大程度上放大了首席执行官持久的私人信息并降低了公司公开上市的倾向？我们开发了一个公共和私人投资者相互竞争的模型，为不同程度暴露于持续私人现金流的公司提供融资。均衡融资是由首席执行官薪酬中的信息租金差异驱动的。我们使用公司上市和首席执行官薪酬数据验证并结构性地估计该模型。我们发现私人（无形）现金流比有形现金流表现出63%更高的持久性。此外，如果公司无形水平恢复到1980的水平，平均上市倾向将增加5个百分点，而平均CEO可变薪酬增长将下降61%。

records.title_en: Making Decisions Under Model Misspecification
records.title_cn: 在模型错误指定下做出决策
records.abstract_en: We use decision theory to confront uncertainty that is sufficiently broad to incorporate “models as approximations.” We presume the existence of a featured collection of what we call “structured models” that have explicit substantive motivations. The decision-maker confronts uncertainty through the lens of these models, but also views these models as simplifications, and hence, as misspecified. We extend the max–min analysis under model ambiguity to incorporate the uncertainty induced by acknowledging that the models used in decision making are simplified approximations. Formally, we provide an axiomatic rationale for a decision criterion that incorporates model misspecification concerns. We then extend our analysis beyond the max-min case allowing for a more general criterion that encompasses a Bayesian formulation.
records.abstract_cn: 我们使用决策理论来应对足够广泛的不确定性，以纳入“近似模型”。我们假设存在一个我们称之为“结构化模型”的特色集合，这些模型具有明确的实质性动机。决策者通过这些模型的视角面对不确定性，但也将这些模型视为简化，因此被错误指定。我们在模型模糊性下扩展了最大-最小分析，以纳入由于承认决策中使用的模型是简化的近似而引起的不确定性。形式上，我们为包含模型错误指定问题的决策标准提供了一个公理化的基本原理。然后，我们将分析扩展到最大-最小情况之外，从而允许包含贝叶斯公式的更通用的标准。

records.title_en: Revisiting the Non-Parametric Analysis of Time-Inconsistent Preferences
records.title_cn: 重新审视时间不一致偏好的非参数分析
records.abstract_en: We revisit the recent revealed preference analysis of sophisticated quasi-hyperbolic consumers by Blow et al. [(2021), “Non-parametric Analysis of Time-Inconsistent Preferences”, The Review of Economic Studies, 88, 2687–2734] (BBC). We show that BBC’s revealed preference test is too lax. There are non-rationalizable data that would pass their test. A basic problem with their test is that it requires finding a certain endogenous elasticity, without regard to the rationalizing utility. Their approach motivates a more stringent test, also based on first-order conditions, that would connect the endogenous elasticity and utility: We show that this test is also too lax. Aside from testing, we also discuss the possibility of recovering model parameters. We show that, even when discount factors are exactly identified, the approach followed in BBC allows for incorrect parameter values to lie in their identified set.
records.abstract_cn: 我们重新审视 Blow 等人最近揭示的对复杂的准双曲线消费者的偏好分析。 [(2021)，“时间不一致偏好的非参数分析”，经济研究评论，88，2687-2734] (BBC)。我们表明 BBC 的显示偏好测试过于宽松。有些不可合理化的数据可以通过他们的测试。他们的测试的一个基本问题是，它需要找到一定的内生弹性，而不考虑合理化效用。他们的方法激发了更严格的测试，同样基于第一阶条件，将内生弹性和效用联系起来：我们表明这个测试也太宽松了。除了测试之外，我们还讨论了恢复模型参数的可能性。我们表明，即使折扣因子被准确识别，BBC 中遵循的方法也会允许错误的参数值存在于其识别的集合中。

records.title_en: Pseudo Lindahl Equilibrium as a Collective Choice Rule
records.title_cn: 作为集体选择规则的伪林达尔均衡
records.abstract_en: A collective choice problem specifies a finite set of alternatives from which a group of expected utility maximizers must choose. We associate a collective pseudo market with every collective choice problem and establish the existence and efficiency of pseudo Lindahl equilibrium (PLE) allocations. We also associate a cooperative bargaining problem with every collective choice problem and define a set-valued solution concept, the ω-weighted Nash bargaining set where ω is a vector of welfare weights. We provide axioms that characterize the ω-weighted Nash bargaining set. Our main result shows that ω-weighted Nash bargaining set payoffs are also the PLE payoffs of the corresponding collective pseudo market with the same utility functions and incomes ω. We define a pseudo core for collective pseudo markets and show that pseudo Lindahl equilibria are in the pseudo core. We characterize the set of PLE outcomes of discrete allocation problems and show that they contain the set of pseudo Walrasian equilibrium outcomes.
records.abstract_cn: 集体选择问题指定一组有限的替代方案，一组预期效用最大化者必须从中进行选择。我们将集体伪市场与每个集体选择问题联系起来，并建立伪林达尔均衡（PLE）分配的存在性和效率。我们还将合作谈判问题与每个集体选择问题联系起来，并定义了一个集值解决方案概念，即 ω 加权纳什谈判集，其中 ω 是福利权重向量。我们提供了表征 ω 加权纳什讨价还价集的公理。我们的主要结果表明，ω 加权纳什讨价还价设定的收益也是具有相同效用函数和收入 ω 的相应集体伪市场的 PLE 收益。我们为集体伪市场定义了一个伪核心，并表明伪林达尔均衡位于伪核心中。我们描述了离散分配问题的 PLE 结果集，并表明它们包含伪瓦尔拉斯均衡结果集。

records.title_en: Overconfidence and Prejudice
records.title_cn: 过度自信和偏见
records.abstract_en: We develop a model of multi-dimensional misspecified learning in which an overconfident agent learns about groups in society from observations of his and others’ successes. We show that the average person sees his group relative to other groups too positively, and this in-group bias exhibits systematic comparative-statics patterns. First, a person is most likely to have negative opinions about other groups he competes with. Second, while information about another group’s achievements does not lower a person’s prejudice, information about economic or social forces affecting the group can, and personal contact with group members has a beneficial effect that is larger than in classical settings. Third, the agent’s beliefs are subject to “bias substitution”, whereby forces that decrease his bias regarding one group tend to increase his biases regarding unrelated other groups.
records.abstract_cn: 我们开发了一种多维错误指定学习模型，在该模型中，过度自信的主体通过观察自己和他人的成功来了解社会中的群体。我们发现，相对于其他群体，普通人对其群体的看法过于积极，而这种群体内偏见表现出系统性的比较静态模式。 第一，一个人最有可能对与他竞争的其他群体产生负面看法。 第二，虽然有关另一个群体成就的信息不会降低一个人的偏见，但有关影响该群体的经济或社会力量的信息可以降低一个人的偏见，并且与群体成员的个人接触所产生的有益影响比传统环境中更大。 第三，主体的信念受到“偏见替代”的影响，即减少他对一群体的偏见的力量往往会增加他对不相关的其他群体的偏见。

records.title_en: Surviving Childhood: Effects of Removing a Child From Home
records.title_cn: 幸存的童年：将孩子带离家的影响
records.abstract_en: This paper studies the effects of the court-ordered removal of children from home on health, crime, and education. To isolate causal effects, I exploit quasi-random variation in judge assignment together with across-judge variation in the tendency to favour removal in an instrumental variable design. Using a novel data set (N=26,579) based on Swedish court documents that I transcribe and link with detailed register data, I find that court-ordered out-of-home placement has large adverse effects on the mortality of the marginal child. These effects are primarily driven by suicides that occur while the removed child is still placed in out-of-home care. Removal also causes an increase in hospitalizations for mental illness and non-narcotic crimes. There is little evidence of adverse health effects for birth parents. I explore potential explanations for the detrimental effects on child health. Adverse care conditions and peer exposure appear to be important channels.
records.abstract_cn: 本文研究了法院下令将儿童逐出家门对健康、犯罪和教育的影响。为了隔离因果效应，我利用了法官分配中的准随机变化以及工具变量设计中倾向于去除的跨法官变化。使用基于我转录的瑞典法院文件并与详细登记数据链接的新颖数据集（N=26,579），我发现法院下令的户外安置对边缘儿童的死亡率有很大的不利影响。这些影响主要是由于被带走的儿童仍处于家庭外护理期间发生的自杀所致。驱逐还导致因精神疾病和非麻醉犯罪住院的人数增加。几乎没有证据表明对亲生父母的健康有不利影响。我探讨了对儿童健康有害影响的潜在解释。不利的护理条件和同伴接触似乎是重要的渠道。

records.title_en: Quantifying the Benefits of Labour Mobility in a Currency Union
records.title_cn: 量化货币联盟中劳动力流动的好处
records.abstract_en: Unemployment differentials are greater between countries in the euro area than between U.S. states. In both regions, net migration responds to unemployment differentials, though the response is smaller in the euro area compared to the U.S. We use a multi-country DSGE model with cross-border migration to quantify Mundell’s hypothesis that labour mobility could substitute for independent monetary policy in a currency union. While not as effective as independent monetary policy, increased labour mobility reduces business cycle fluctuations for most countries in the euro area. However, Mundell’s conjecture does not hold uniformly. For countries that primarily face demand shocks, labour mobility stabilizes inflation and unemployment and improves welfare. If supply shocks are dominant however, labour mobility increases the cost of being in a currency union by magnifying inflation volatility.
records.abstract_cn: 欧元区国家之间的失业率差异比美国各州之间的失业率差异更大。在这两个地区，净移民都会对失业率差异做出反应，尽管与美国相比，欧元区的反应较小。我们使用具有跨境移民的多国 DSGE 模型来量化蒙代尔的假设，即劳动力流动性可以替代货币联盟中的独立货币政策。虽然不如独立货币政策那么有效，但劳动力流动性的增加可以减少欧元区大多数国家的商业周期波动。然而，蒙代尔的猜想并不完全成立。对于主要面临需求冲击的国家来说，劳动力流动可以稳定通货膨胀和失业并改善福利。然而，如果供应冲击占主导地位，劳动力流动性就会放大通胀波动性，从而增加加入货币联盟的成本。

records.title_en: Endogenous Clustering and Analogy-Based Expectation Equilibrium
records.title_cn: 内生聚类和基于类比的期望均衡
records.abstract_en: Normal-form two-player games are categorized by players into K analogy classes so as to minimize the prediction error about the behaviour of the opponent. This results in Clustered Analogy-Based Expectation Equilibria in which strategies are analogy-based expectation equilibria given the analogy partitions and analogy partitions minimize the prediction errors given the strategies. We distinguish between environments with self-repelling analogy partitions in which some mixing over partitions is required and environments with self-attractive partitions in which several analogy partitions can arise, thereby suggesting new channels of belief heterogeneity and equilibrium multiplicity. Various economic applications are discussed.
records.abstract_cn: 正常形式的二玩家博弈被玩家分为K个类比类，以最小化对手行为的预测误差。这导致基于集群类比的期望均衡，其中给定类比分区的策略是基于类比的期望均衡，并且类比分区最小化给定策略的预测误差。我们区分具有自排斥类比分区的环境（其中需要对分区进行一些混合）和具有自吸引分区的环境（其中可以出现多个类比分区），从而提出信念异质性和均衡多重性的新渠道。讨论了各种经济应用。

records.title_en: Good Dispersion, Bad Dispersion
records.title_cn: 分散性好、分散性差
records.abstract_en: We document that most dispersion in marginal revenue products of inputs occurs across plants within firms rather than between firms. This is commonly thought to reflect misallocation: dispersion is “bad”. However, we show that eliminating frictions hampering internal capital markets in a multi-plant firm model may in fact increase productivity dispersion and raise output: dispersion can be “good”. This arises as firms optimally stagger investment activity across their plants over time to avoid raising costly external finance, instead relying on reallocating internal funds. The staggering in turn generates dispersion in marginal revenue products. We use U.S. Census data on multi-plant manufacturing firms to provide empirical evidence for the model mechanism and show a quantitatively important role for good dispersion. Since there is less scope for good dispersion in emerging economies, the difference in the degree of misallocation between emerging and developed economies looks more pronounced than previously thought.
records.abstract_cn: 我们记录了投入的边际收益产品的大部分分散发生在公司内部的工厂而不是公司之间。这通常被认为反映了配置不当：分散是“坏”的。然而，我们表明，消除多工厂企业模型中阻碍内部资本市场的摩擦实际上可能会增加生产力分散度并提高产出：分散度可能是“好的”。这种情况的出现是因为企业随着时间的推移最佳地错开其工厂的投资活动，以避免筹集昂贵的外部融资，而是依赖重新分配内部资金。这种惊人的结果反过来又导致了边际收益产品的分散。我们使用美国关于多工厂制造企业的人口普查数据为模型机制提供经验证据，并显示良好分散的定量重要作用。由于新兴经济体良好分散的空间较小，新兴经济体和发达经济体之间的错配程度差异看起来比之前想象的更为明显。

records.title_en: Extreme Categories and Overreaction to News
records.title_cn: 极端类别和对新闻的过度反应
records.abstract_en: What characteristics of news generate over-or-underreaction? We study the asset-pricing consequences of diagnostic expectations, a model of belief formation based on the representativeness heuristic, in a setting where news events are drawn from categories with extreme distributions of fundamentals. Our model predicts greater overreaction to news belonging to categories with more extreme outliers, or tail events. We test our theory on a comprehensive database of corporate news that includes news from twenty-four different categories, including earnings announcements, product launches, mergers and acquisition, business expansions, and client-related news. We find theory-consistent heterogeneity in investor reaction to news, with more overreaction in the form of greater post-announcement return reversals and trading volume for news categories with more extreme distributions of fundamentals.
records.abstract_cn: 新闻的哪些特征会导致反应过度或反应不足？我们研究诊断预期的资产定价后果，这是一种基于代表性启发式的信念形成模型，在新闻事件来自基本面极端分布类别的环境中。我们的模型预测，对于属于具有更极端异常值或尾部事件的类别的新闻，会有更大的过度反应。我们在一个综合的企业新闻数据库上测试我们的理论，该数据库包括二十-四不同类别的新闻，包括收益公告、产品发布、并购、业务扩张和客户相关新闻。我们发现，投资者对新闻的反应存在与理论一致的异质性，对于基本面分布更为极端的新闻类别，过度反应的形式包括更大的公告后回报逆转和交易量。

records.title_en: Auctions with Frictions: Recruitment, Entry, and Limited Commitment
records.title_cn: 存在摩擦的拍卖：招募、进入和有限承诺
records.abstract_en: Auction models are convenient abstractions of informal price-formation processes that arise in markets for assets or services. These processes involve frictions like bidder recruitment costs for sellers, participation costs for bidders, and limitations on sellers’ commitment abilities. This paper develops an auction model that captures such frictions. We derive novel insights, notably that outcomes are often inefficient, that markets sometimes unravel, and that the observability of competition may have a large effect.
records.abstract_cn: 拍卖模型是对资产或服务市场中出现的非正式价格形成过程的便捷抽象。这些过程涉及诸如卖方的投标人招募成本、投标人的参与成本以及卖方承诺能力的限制等摩擦。本文开发了一种捕捉此类摩擦的拍卖模型。我们得出新颖的见解，特别是结果往往效率低下，市场有时会崩溃，竞争的可观察性可能会产生很大的影响。

records.title_en: Hiring as Exploration
records.title_cn: 招聘作为探索
records.abstract_en: This article views hiring as a contextual bandit problem: to find the best workers over time, firms must balance “exploitation” (selecting from groups with proven track records) with “exploration” (selecting from under-represented groups to learn about quality). Yet modern hiring algorithms, based on supervised learning approaches, are designed solely for exploitation. Instead, we build a resume screening algorithm that values exploration by evaluating candidates according to their statistical upside potential. Using data from professional services recruiting within a Fortune 500 firm, we show that this approach improves the quality (as measured by eventual hiring rates) of candidates selected for an interview, while also increasing demographic diversity, relative to the firm’s existing practices. The same is not true for traditional supervised learning-based algorithms, which improve hiring rates but select far fewer Black and Hispanic applicants. Together, our results highlight the importance of incorporating exploration in developing decision-making algorithms that are potentially both more efficient and equitable.
records.abstract_cn: 本文将招聘视为一个上下文强盗问题：为了随着时间的推移找到最好的员工，公司必须平衡“剥削”（从有良好记录的群体中选择）和“探索”（从代表性不足的群体中选择以了解质量）。然而，基于监督学习方法的现代招聘算法只是为了剥削而设计的。相反，我们构建了一种简历筛选算法，通过根据统计上行潜力评估候选人来重视探索。使用《财富》500 公司内专业服务招聘的数据，我们表明，相对于公司现有的做法，这种方法提高了面试候选人的质量（通过最终招聘率衡量），同时也增加了人口多样性。对于传统的基于监督学习的算法来说情况并非如此，它提高了招聘率，但选择的黑人和西班牙裔申请人却少得多。总之，我们的结果凸显了将探索纳入开发可能更高效、更公平的决策算法的重要性。

records.title_en: Community Enforcement with Endogenous Records
records.title_cn: 使用内源记录进行社区执法
records.abstract_en: I study repeated games with anonymous random matching where players can add or remove signals from their records. The ability to manipulate records introduces monotonicity constraints on players’ continuation values, under which sufficiently long-lived players will almost never cooperate. When players’ expected lifespans are intermediate, their ability to sustain cooperation depends on (i) whether their actions are complements or substitutes and (ii) whether manipulation takes the form of adding or removing signals.
records.abstract_cn: 我研究了匿名随机匹配的重复游戏，玩家可以在记录中添加或删除信号。操纵记录的能力给玩家的持续价值带来了单调性约束，在这种情况下，足够长寿命的玩家几乎永远不会合作。当玩家的预期寿命处于中间时，他们维持合作的能力取决于（i）他们的行为是补充还是替代，以及（ii）操纵是否采取添加或删除信号的形式。

records.title_en: Racial Discrimination and the Social Contract: Evidence from U.S. Army Enlistment During WWII
records.title_cn: 种族歧视与社会契约：二战期间美国陆军入伍的证据
