records.abstract_en: This paper documents that the Pearl Harbor attack triggered a sharp increase in volunteer enlistment rates of American men, the magnitude of the increase was smaller for Black men than for White men and the Black–White gap was larger in counties with higher levels of racial discrimination. The results suggest that political exclusion and discrimination can undermine support for the government during critical times such as war.
records.abstract_cn: 该论文记录了珍珠港事件导致美国男性志愿者入伍率急剧上升，黑人男性的增长幅度小于白人，而且在种族歧视程度较高的县，黑人与白人的差距更大。结果表明，政治排斥和歧视可能会削弱在战争等关键时期对政府的支持。

records.title_en: Complexity and Satisficing: Theory with Evidence from Chess
records.title_cn: 复杂性和满意度：理论与国际象棋的证据
records.abstract_en: We develop a satisficing model of choice in which the available alternatives differ in their inherent complexity. We assume—and experimentally validate—that complexity leads to errors in the perception of alternatives’ values. The model yields sharp predictions about the effect of complexity on choice probabilities, some of which qualitatively contrast with those of maximization-based choice models. We confirm the predictions of the satisficing model—and thus reject maximization—in a novel data set with information on hundreds of millions of real-world chess moves by highly experienced players. Looking beyond chess, our work offers a blueprint for incorporating complexity at the level of individual objects into models of choice and for detecting satisficing outside of the laboratory.
records.abstract_cn: 我们开发了一个令人满意的选择模型，其中可用的替代方案因其固有的复杂性而有所不同。我们假设并通过实验验证复杂性会导致对替代方案价值的认知错误。该模型对复杂性对选择概率的影响做出了敏锐的预测，其中一些预测与基于最大化的选择模型的预测形成了定性对比。我们在一个新颖的数据集中确认了满意模型的预测，从而拒绝最大化，其中包含经验丰富的棋手数以亿计的现实世界国际象棋棋步的信息。除了国际象棋之外，我们的工作还提供了一个蓝图，将单个对象级别的复杂性纳入选择的模型中，并在实验室外检测满意度。

records.title_en: Behavioural Causal Inference
records.title_cn: 行为因果推断
records.abstract_en: When inferring causal effects from correlational data, a common practice by professional researchers but also lay people is to control for potential confounders. Inappropriate controls produce erroneous causal inferences. I model decision-makers (DMs) who use endogenous observational data to learn actions’ causal effect on payoff-relevant outcomes. Different DM types use different controls. Their resulting choices affect the very correlations they learn from, thus calling for an equilibrium analysis of the steady-state welfare cost of bad controls. I obtain tight upper bounds on this cost. Equilibrium forces drastically reduce it when types’ sets of controls contain one another.
records.abstract_cn: 当从相关数据推断因果效应时，专业研究人员和非专业人士的常见做法是控制潜在的混杂因素。不适当的控制会产生错误的因果推论。我对决策者 (DM) 进行建模，他们使用内生观察数据来了解行为对回报相关结果的因果影响。不同的 DM 类型使用不同的控件。他们的最终选择会影响他们从中学到的相关性，因此需要对不良控制的稳态福利成本进行均衡分析。我得到了这个成本的严格上限。当类型的控制组包含一另一个时，平衡力会大大减少它。

records.title_en: Cascades and Fluctuations in an Economy with an Endogenous Production Network
records.title_cn: 具有内生生产网络的经济中的级联和波动
records.abstract_en: This article studies the efficient allocation in an economy in which firms are connected through input–output linkages and must pay a fixed cost to produce. When economic conditions are poor, some firms might decide not to operate, thereby severing the links with their neighbours and changing the structure of the production network. Since producers benefit from having access to additional suppliers, nearby firms tend to operate, or not, together. As a result, the production network features clusters of operating firms, and the exit of a producer can create a cascade of firm shutdowns. While well-connected firms are better able to withstand shocks, they trigger larger cascades upon exit. The theory also predicts how the structure of the production network changes over the business cycle. As in the data, recessions are associated with more dispersed networks that feature fewer highly connected firms. In the calibrated economy, the endogenous reorganization of the network substantially dampens the impact of idiosyncratic shocks on aggregate fluctuations.
records.abstract_cn: 本文研究了企业通过投入产出联系相连并且必须支付固定生产成本的经济中的有效配置。当经济状况不佳时，一些企业可能决定不经营，从而切断与邻居的联系并改变生产网络的结构。由于生产商受益于获得更多供应商，附近的公司往往会合作或不合作。因此，生产网络以经营企业集群为特征，生产商的退出可能会导致一系列企业倒闭。虽然人脉广泛的公司能够更好地抵御冲击，但它们在退出时会引发更大的连锁反应。该理论还预测了生产网络的结构如何随着经济周期而变化。正如数据所示，经济衰退与更加分散的网络有关，而网络的高度关联性较少。在校准经济中，网络的内生重组大大削弱了特殊冲击对总波动的影响。

records.title_en: Land-use conversion from agricultural production areas to built-up areas in the Philippines for decades 2000–2020: Spatial analysis and policy implications
records.title_cn: 菲律宾数十年间（2000-2020年）从农业生产区向建成区的土地用途转换：空间分析与政策启示
records.abstract_en: Rapid urban expansion in the Philippines has intensified the pressure on agricultural lands, raising concerns about national food security and environmental sustainability. This study presents a national-scale spatial analysis of agricultural land conversion to built-up areas between 2003 and 2019, using high-resolution Earth Observation (EO) maps. The map validation based on expert-labeled reference data yielded 81% user accuracy, while correlation and bivariate mapping revealed a strong relationship (r= 0.89) between cropland loss (ha) and built-up expansion (ha), with hotspots identified in Central and Southern Mindanao, and Central Luzon. Conversions showed a moderate association with agricultural land area (r= 0.38), which may correspond to provinces with large areas for high-value crop production with intact economic value. Around 31% (3,228 out of 10,397 ha) of converted cropland to built-up fell within legally protected zones under the Network of Protected Areas for Agriculture and Agro-Industrial Development (NPAAAD), indicating possible governance and enforcement gaps. Almost 80% of the conversions within NPAAAD are mostly agro-industrial and alluvial lands characterized as high-value and road-accessible, thus being vulnerable also to urban and industrial projects. The findings underscore the urgency of enacting the National Land Use Act (NaLUA) to institutionalize spatial planning and safeguard agricultural lands from unregulated conversion. The findings of this study alongside mapping of specific land-uses following the conversions nationwide are deemed helpful inputs for mandated local land use planning.
records.abstract_cn: 菲律宾快速的城市扩张加剧了对农业用地的压力，引发了对国家粮食安全和环境可持续性的担忧。本研究利用高分辨率地球观测（EO）地图，对2003年至2019年间农业用地向建成区的转换进行了全国尺度的空间分析。基于专家标注参考数据的地图验证显示用户精度为81%，而相关性和双变量映射揭示了耕地损失（公顷）与建成区扩张（公顷）之间的强关系（r=0.89），热点区域位于中棉兰老岛、南棉兰老岛和中吕宋岛。转换与农业用地面积呈中等关联（r=0.38），这可能对应于拥有大面积高价值作物生产且经济价值完好的省份。约31%（10,397公顷中的3,228公顷）的耕地向建成区转换发生在农业和农工业发展保护区网络（NPAAAD）下的法定保护区内，表明可能存在治理和执法漏洞。NPAAAD内近80%的转换主要是农工业和冲积土地，这些土地具有高价值和交通便利的特点，因此也容易受到城市和工业项目的影响。研究结果强调了颁布《国家土地利用法》（NaLUA）以制度化空间规划并保护农业用地免受无管制转换的紧迫性。本研究的发现以及全国范围内转换后特定土地利用的映射，被认为是对授权的地方土地利用规划的有用输入。

records.title_en: Urban climate adaptation planning in Windhoek, Namibia: Gaps, challenges, and opportunities for Nature based Solutions
records.title_cn: 纳米比亚温得和克的城市气候适应规划：基于自然的解决方案的差距、挑战与机遇
records.abstract_en: Nature based Solutions (NbS) for urban climate adaptation remain underexplored in arid Sub-Saharan African (SSA) cities such as Windhoek, Namibia. This study investigates how national climate adaptation policies translate into local action, identifying gaps, challenges, and opportunities for embedding NbS in urban planning. A qualitative case study combined a review of policy documents with semi-structured stakeholder interviews. Findings reveal that while national policies and the Windhoek Integrated Climate Change Strategy and Action Plan (WICCSAP) set ambitious goals, they lack contextually derived measures and practical NbS targets, such as community-driven resilience or integrated locally tailored dryland strategies, or ecosystem-based water management, leaving the city reliant on grey infrastructure and short-term disaster risk responses. This omission exacerbates urban heat islands, flood risks, and constrains socio-ecological resilience. At the same time, both community-driven practices and municipal champions illustrate alternative pathways. Such initiatives signal early steps toward transformative adaptation where long-term systemic shifts in governance and practice are required. Locally grounded initiatives, including permaculture dryland gardens, rainfall monitoring, and the “Brown is Beautiful” campaign, demonstrate how culturally resonant NbS can integrate water conservation, ecological design, and social cohesion in Windhoek’s deprived, arid context. Within the municipality, individual planners and officials also advocate for NbS, seeking to move beyond grey solutions despite institutional barriers. Realising these opportunities requires capacity building, cross-sectoral coordination, and partnerships to institutionalise NbS in urban governance. The study makes two key contributions: first, it identifies the systemic neglect of NbS in Windhoek and Namibia’s climate policy frameworks; second, it highlights both bottom-up innovations and emerging top-down drivers that can bridge the policy implementation gap. Windhoek’s experience could offer transferable lessons for other rapidly urbanising, water-scarce cities across Sub-Saharan Africa.
records.abstract_cn: 基于自然的解决方案（NbS）在城市气候适应中的应用在干旱的撒哈拉以南非洲（SSA）城市（如纳米比亚的温得和克）仍未得到充分探索。本研究调查了国家气候适应政策如何转化为地方行动，识别了将NbS纳入城市规划的差距、挑战与机遇。一项定性案例研究结合了政策文件审查与半结构化利益相关者访谈。研究结果显示，尽管国家政策和温得和克综合气候变化战略与行动计划（WICCSAP）设定了雄心勃勃的目标，但它们缺乏基于背景的措施和实用的NbS目标，如社区驱动的韧性、针对当地情况的综合旱地战略或基于生态系统的水资源管理，使城市仍依赖灰色基础设施和短期灾害风险应对。这一遗漏加剧了城市热岛效应、洪水风险，并限制了社会-生态韧性。与此同时，社区驱动的实践和市政倡导者都展示了替代路径。这些举措标志着向变革性适应迈出的早期步骤，而长期系统性的治理和实践转变是必要的。本地扎根的举措，包括永续农业旱地花园、降雨监测和“棕色即美丽”运动，展示了文化共鸣的NbS如何在温得和克贫困干旱的环境中整合水资源保护、生态设计和社会凝聚力。在市内，个别规划者和官员也倡导NbS，尽管存在制度障碍，仍寻求超越灰色解决方案。实现这些机遇需要能力建设、跨部门协调和伙伴关系，以将NbS制度化于城市治理中。本研究做出两项关键贡献：第一，识别了温得和克和纳米比亚气候政策框架中对NbS的系统性忽视；第二，强调了可以弥合政策实施差距的自下而上的创新和新兴的自上而下的驱动因素。温得和克的经验可为撒哈拉以南非洲其他快速城市化、水资源稀缺的城市提供可借鉴的教训。

records.title_en: Restoring South Asian Forests: Key lessons, research gaps and the way forward
records.title_cn: 恢复南亚森林：关键经验、研究空白与未来路径
records.abstract_en: South Asia, home to over two billion people, is the world’s most populous and densely inhabited region. Its forests play vital roles in carbon storage, biodiversity conservation, water regulation, and rural livelihoods but face mounting pressures from population growth, agriculture, urbanization, and climate change. Heavy dependence on fuelwood further accelerates degradation. In response, countries across the region have initiated ambitious restoration programs aligned with global commitments and the UN Decade on Ecosystem Restoration. Here, we synthesized the articles published in the Special Issue (SI) titled – Restoring South Asian Forests, covering India, Nepal, Bangladesh and Pakistan. The regional and country-level case studies presented in this SI underscore critical lessons. Nepal’s 65-year restoration experience highlights the value of decentralization, community engagement, and recognition of forest multifunctionality. Post-2015 earthquake recovery demonstrates that natural regeneration often outperforms costly artificial interventions. In India, individual-led initiatives, like Padmashree Jadav Payeng’s Brahmaputra sandbar forest, illustrate how sustained, science-guided efforts can deliver outsized ecological and societal benefits. Research from Bangladesh and Pakistan further stresses the importance of secure land tenure, inclusive governance, and community participation for lasting restoration success. Despite progress, knowledge gaps persist regarding long-term ecological and socio-economic effects and the comparative effectiveness of restoration approaches. Advancing restoration in South Asia will require integrated, participatory, and landscape-level strategies that merge indigenous knowledge, science, and advanced monitoring to deliver enduring biodiversity, carbon, and livelihood co-benefits.
records.abstract_cn: 南亚，拥有超过二十亿人口，是世界上人口最多、密度最高的地区。其森林在碳储存、生物多样性保护、水资源调节和农村生计方面发挥着至关重要的作用，但面临着人口增长、农业、城市化和气候变化带来的日益增大的压力。对薪柴的严重依赖进一步加速了森林退化。为此，该地区各国已启动了与全球承诺及联合国生态系统恢复十年相一致的雄心勃勃的恢复计划。在此，我们综合了题为“恢复南亚森林”的特刊中发表的文章，涵盖印度、尼泊尔、孟加拉国和巴基斯坦。本特刊中的区域和国家案例研究强调了关键经验。尼泊尔65年的恢复经验凸显了权力下放、社区参与和承认森林多功能性的价值。2015年地震后的恢复表明，自然再生往往优于昂贵的人工干预。在印度，个人主导的倡议，如帕德玛什里·贾达夫·帕扬的布拉马普特拉河沙洲森林，展示了持续的、科学指导的努力如何能带来超额的生态和社会效益。来自孟加拉国和巴基斯坦的研究进一步强调了有保障的土地使用权、包容性治理和社区参与对持久恢复成功的重要性。尽管取得了进展，但在长期生态和社会经济影响以及恢复方法的比较有效性方面仍存在知识空白。推进南亚的恢复将需要综合的、参与式的和景观层面的策略，融合本土知识、科学和先进监测，以带来持久的生物多样性、碳和生计协同效益。

records.title_en: Implicit and explicit (in)justice on the route to Paris: An analysis of justice expressions in the Paris Agreement, EU-, and Swedish climate-forest policy mixes
records.title_cn: 通往巴黎之路上的隐性与显性（不）公正：对《巴黎协定》、欧盟及瑞典气候-森林政策组合中公正表达的分析
records.abstract_en: Forests are central to climate change mitigation, and there is consensus that climate transition efforts must be just. However, the “just transition” concept often functions as a boundary object, leading to ambiguity in its implementation. Statements of commitment to just transitions therefore require scrutiny as to what a just transition is meant to entail, what kind of justice transition policies seek to ensure, and how these ambitions are envisioned to be realised in practice. Yet, it is precisely this that is missing in the current academic literature, especially in the forest sector context. This study addresses this gap by analysing implicit and explicit justice expressions in the Paris Agreement, and EU- and Swedish climate-forest policy mixes, thereby providing empirical insights on the ‘what’ and ‘how’ of just transitions in the forest sector. Using a newly developed framework that combines the policy mix concept with distributional, recognitional, and procedural justice dimensions, the analysis reveals shared narrow foci in just transition understanding, discrepancies between expressed just transition motivations, and inconsistent mechanisms for implementation across governance levels, thus risking stakeholder disengagement. The results call for explicit discussions in policy debate on how justice can be ensured in transition efforts in the forest sector across levels, regardless of the specific understanding of justice that is adhered to, and open societal debate on what a just transition ultimately ought to mean in a forest context. Furthermore, policy makers must take the step from ambiguous promises to concrete instruments to support forest stakeholders through the transition.
records.abstract_cn: 森林是减缓气候变化的核心，且人们普遍认为气候转型努力必须是公正的。然而，“公正转型”概念往往充当边界对象，导致其实施中的模糊性。因此，对公正转型承诺的声明需要审视：公正转型意味着什么，转型政策寻求确保何种公正，以及这些雄心壮志在实践中如何设想实现。然而，这正是当前学术文献中所缺失的，尤其是在森林部门背景下。本研究通过分析《巴黎协定》、欧盟及瑞典气候-森林政策组合中的隐性和显性公正表达来填补这一空白，从而为森林部门公正转型的“内容”和“方式”提供实证见解。使用一个新开发的框架，将政策组合概念与分配公正、承认公正和程序公正维度相结合，分析揭示了公正转型理解中共同的狭隘焦点、表达的公正转型动机之间的差异，以及跨治理层面实施机制的不一致，从而可能导致利益相关者脱离参与。研究结果呼吁在政策辩论中明确讨论如何在森林部门各级转型努力中确保公正，无论遵循何种具体的公正理解，并开启关于公正转型在森林背景下最终应意味着什么的社会辩论。此外，政策制定者必须从模糊的承诺迈出一步，转向具体工具，以支持森林利益相关者度过转型。

records.title_en: Novel carbon dynamics assessment framework reveals climate positive land management approaches across North America
records.title_cn: 新型碳动态评估框架揭示北美气候正向土地管理方法
records.abstract_en: Natural climate solutions (NCS) can foster ecosystem resiliency and mitigate climate change. However, a gap exists between carbon cycle science and decision support systems. Bridging this gap can advance climate positive land management and promote the implementation of natural climate solutions. Here, we propose a novel framework to assess carbon dynamics to reveal management approaches for land cover at a 300 m resolution within which natural climate solutions can be more readily identified and applied. We use annual land cover change and model the associated carbon dynamics to categorize the sub-regional ecodistricts of Canada and the USA into the most effective NCS category based on its current change dynamics. Restoration NCS may be a useful strategy in the southern boreal forest, southeastern USA (Eastern Temperate Forest), and western Canadian Cordillera, while Protection NCS should be focused in the Great Plains and the far North. Specifically, we find that 9 % of ecodistricts, and 23 % of land area, would be best managed through protection-based nature climate solutions, while 27 % of ecodistricts, and 26 % of land area, should be managed using restoration climate solutions. This transferable framework can be used to target the sub-regional implementation of different NCS strategies based on local-level land cover changes and carbon dynamics.
records.abstract_cn: 自然气候解决方案（NCS）可以促进生态系统韧性并缓解气候变化。然而，碳循环科学与决策支持系统之间存在差距。弥合这一差距可以推进气候正向土地管理并促进自然气候解决方案的实施。在此，我们提出一个新颖的框架来评估碳动态，以揭示在300米分辨率下的土地覆盖管理方法，在此分辨率下可以更容易地识别和应用自然气候解决方案。我们利用年度土地覆盖变化并模拟相关的碳动态，将加拿大和美国的亚区域生态区根据其当前的动态变化分类为最有效的NCS类别。恢复型NCS可能是在南部北方森林、美国东南部（东部温带森林）和加拿大西部科迪勒拉山区的有用策略，而保护型NCS应集中在大平原和远北地区。具体而言，我们发现9%的生态区和23%的土地面积最适合通过基于保护的自然气候解决方案进行管理，而27%的生态区和26%的土地面积应使用恢复型气候解决方案进行管理。这一可转移的框架可用于根据地方层面的土地覆盖变化和碳动态，针对亚区域实施不同的NCS策略。

records.title_en: Land grabbing and armed conflict in Colombia (1874–2019): A historical analysis from a political ecology perspective
records.title_cn: 哥伦比亚的土地掠夺与武装冲突（1874-2019）：基于政治生态学视角的历史分析
records.abstract_en: This article employs a political ecology perspective to analyze the relationship between land grabbing and the internal armed conflict (IAC) in Colombia between 1874 and 2019, focusing on the power relations that have shaped the agrarian structure. The present study employs a historical-comparative method and qualitative documentary review to examine the dynamics of territorial accumulation and the mechanisms that enabled these processes. The findings indicate that land grabbing is not a recent phenomenon, nor is it solely a result of the 2008 crisis. Rather, it is a structural process rooted in longstanding privatization policies, colonization strategies, and territorial control. During the IAC, forced displacement emerged as the predominant mechanism for land accumulation, thereby reinforcing patterns of dispossession and rural property concentration. A salient finding is the pivotal role played by national actors - political and economic elites, state institutions, and illegal armed groups in driving these dynamics. This study makes a significant contribution to the ongoing discourse on the nexus between conflict, territory, and power. It underscores the role that structural inequalities play in perpetuating cycles of violence and exclusion. It is imperative to comprehend these historical dynamics to formulate policies that promote territorial justice and reconciliation in post-agreement Colombia.
records.abstract_cn: 本文采用政治生态学视角，分析1874年至2019年间哥伦比亚土地掠夺与内部武装冲突（IAC）之间的关系，重点关注塑造农业结构的权力关系。本研究采用历史比较方法和定性文献回顾，考察领土积累的动态及其促成这些过程的机制。研究结果表明，土地掠夺并非近期现象，也并非仅仅是2008年危机的产物。相反，它是一个植根于长期私有化政策、殖民战略和领土控制的结构性过程。在内部武装冲突期间，强迫流离失所成为土地积累的主要机制，从而强化了剥夺和农村财产集中的模式。一个显著发现是，国家行为体——政治和经济精英、国家机构以及非法武装团体——在推动这些动态中发挥了关键作用。本研究对当前关于冲突、领土与权力之间关系的讨论做出了重要贡献。它强调了结构性不平等在延续暴力和排斥循环中的作用。理解这些历史动态对于制定促进哥伦比亚协议后时期领土正义与和解的政策至关重要。

records.title_en: The new perspective of future multi-scenario analysis: Decoding impact pathways of land use dynamics on sustainable development goals
records.title_cn: 未来多情景分析的新视角：解码土地利用动态对可持续发展目标的影响路径
records.abstract_en: Achieving Sustainable Development Goals (SDGs) is often challenged by escalating land use conflicts and climate change. Existing research has overlooked the mediating effects of climatic factors and the nonlinear relationships between land use changes and SDGs, leading to gaps in understanding the synergistic mechanisms of these interactions. This study incorporates key climatic variables into a time-series forecasting framework for SDGs using a transformer-based model, with the goal to systematically revealing the relationships between land use dynamics and SDGs in the Yangtze River Economic Belt (YREB), as well as the impact mechanisms of different land use structures on SDGs. Predictions based on the Transformer model indicate that the spatial distribution of SDGs exhibits persistent heterogeneity in YREB in 2030. Land use dynamic changes exert nonlinear impacts on SDGs under different scenarios. The strongest nonlinear relationship is observed under the Sustainable Development scenario (Pnon–linear = 0.0003, Poverall < 0.001). The impact of built-up land on SDGs exhibits varying effects under different scenarios: 0.649 (p < 0.001) in the Economic Priority scenario; −0.702 (p < 0.001) and −0.549 (p < 0.001) in the Natural Development and Farmland Protection scenarios, respectively. This study demonstrates a framework for forecasting SDGs incorporating the influence of climatic variables, emphasizing the need to formulate scenario-specific policies to achieve synergies between land use change and SDGs against the backdrop of climate change.
records.abstract_cn: 实现可持续发展目标（SDGs）常常受到日益加剧的土地利用冲突和气候变化的挑战。现有研究忽视了气候因素的调节效应以及土地利用变化与SDGs之间的非线性关系，导致对这些相互作用协同机制的理解存在空白。本研究利用基于Transformer的模型，将关键气候变量纳入SDGs的时间序列预测框架中，旨在系统揭示长江经济带（YREB）土地利用动态与SDGs之间的关系，以及不同土地利用结构对SDGs的影响机制。基于Transformer模型的预测表明，在2030年，YREB中SDGs的空间分布表现出持续的异质性。在不同情景下，土地利用动态变化对SDGs产生非线性影响。在可持续发展情景下观察到最强的非线性关系（P非线性 = 0.0003，P总体 < 0.001）。建设用地对SDGs的影响在不同情景下表现出不同的效应：经济优先情景下为0.649（p < 0.001）；自然发展和农田保护情景下分别为−0.702（p < 0.001）和−0.549（p < 0.001）。本研究展示了一个纳入气候变量影响的SDGs预测框架，强调在气候变化背景下，需要制定针对特定情景的政策，以实现土地利用变化与SDGs之间的协同效应。

records.title_en: Urban land use prediction and construction effectiveness assessment supporting SDG 11.3.1 and regional planning goals
records.title_cn: 支持SDG 11.3.1和区域规划目标的城市土地利用预测与建设成效评估
records.abstract_en: Urban land use serves as the fundamental foundation for human survival and development, providing essential natural resources. Simulation is an important tool for assessing the impacts of urban planning and construction new urban. To support policy implementation for the development of the Xiongan New Area and promote sustainable urban management, we use the "Data-Information-Knowledge-Wisdom" (DIKW model) as a framework for predicting future land spatial changes considering sustainable development of urban planning. We developed a novel New Urban Multi-objective Land Use Prediction (NUMLUP) method, integrating a Genetic Algorithm (GA), Multi-Objective Planning (MOP), and the Conversion of Land Use and its Effects at Small Region Extent (CLUES) model. Using this approach, we obtained urban land spatial distribution data for three scenarios. Urban land spatial distribution data for the Historical Continuation Scenario (HCS), Policy Planning Scenario (PPS), and Planned Sustainable development scenario (PSDS) were obtained. To evaluate Sustainable Development Goal (SDG) 11.3.1 and Regional Planning Goals (RPGs), we assessed 19 consecutive years of construction effectiveness—covering both past (2017–2023) and future (2023–2035) periods under the three scenarios. The dataset achieved a multi-year overall accuracy (OA) exceeding 0.87 and a kappa index above 0.83, demonstrating strong integration of the NUMLUP model. The area of built up gradually increased, and the wetland was mainly dominated by Baiyangdian, which declined significantly from 2017 to 2023. In the three scenarios, from 2023 to 2035, the expansion of the built-up slows down, and the degree of change in the HCS area is minimal. Under the PPS, forest and wetland areas underwent the most drastic changes, with overall improvement rates ranked as PPS > PSDS > HCS. In contrast, the PSDS led to a significant increase in grassland. Under PSDS, grassland increased significantly. The construction of the three scenarios from 2017 to 2035 has achieved certain results. While PPS and PSDS closely aligned with planning targets, the HCS would fail to meet the 2035 requirements. The PSDS also prompted adjustments in the regional policy’s spatial layout. There were adjustments to the spatial layout of the policy as a result of PSDS. The LCRPGR is consistently greater than 1 from 2023 to 2035, reflecting a rational and comfortable urban plan that provides land use to meet population growth and demand.Furthermore, the PSDS introduced reasonable modifications to the regional plan’s spatial configuration. Our research provides robust support for monitoring sustainable urban development and implementing regional policies.
records.abstract_cn: 城市土地利用是人类生存和发展的基础，提供必要的自然资源。模拟是评估城市规划和新建城区影响的重要工具。为支持雄安新区发展的政策实施并促进可持续城市管理，我们以“数据-信息-知识-智慧”（DIKW模型）为框架，预测考虑城市规划可持续发展的未来土地空间变化。我们开发了一种新颖的新城区多目标土地利用预测（NUMLUP）方法，整合了遗传算法（GA）、多目标规划（MOP）和小区域土地利用转换及其效应（CLUES）模型。利用该方法，我们获得了三种情景下的城市土地空间分布数据。历史延续情景（HCS）、政策规划情景（PPS）和规划可持续发展情景（PSDS）下的城市土地空间分布数据均已获得。为评估可持续发展目标（SDG）11.3.1和区域规划目标（RPGs），我们评估了三种情景下连续19年的建设成效，涵盖过去（2017-2023年）和未来（2023-2035年）两个时期。数据集的多年度总体精度（OA）超过0.87，kappa指数高于0.83，表明NUMLUP模型具有较强的整合能力。建设用地面积逐渐增加，湿地主要以白洋淀为主，从2017年到2023年显著减少。在三种情景中，从2023年到2035年，建设用地扩张放缓，HCS面积变化程度最小。在PPS下，森林和湿地面积变化最为剧烈，总体改善率排序为PPS > PSDS > HCS。相比之下，PSDS导致草地显著增加。在PSDS下，草地显著增加。从2017年到2035年，三种情景的建设取得了一定成效。虽然PPS和PSDS与规划目标紧密一致，但HCS将无法满足2035年的要求。PSDS还促使区域政策空间布局的调整。由于PSDS，政策的空间布局有所调整。从2023年到2035年，LCRPGR始终大于1，反映了合理舒适的城市规划，提供了满足人口增长和需求的土地利用。此外，PSDS对区域规划的空间配置进行了合理修改。我们的研究为监测可持续城市发展和实施区域政策提供了有力支持。

records.title_en: Unraveling the impacts of free trade zones on urban innovation intensity: Evidence from China
records.title_cn: 自由贸易试验区对城市创新强度影响的解析：来自中国的证据
records.abstract_en: Land use efficiency of urban innovation is critical for sustainable development in transition economies with land constraints. In this context, Free Trade Zones (FTZs) have emerged as a key policy instrument for enhancing innovation performance. Drawing on a panel dataset from 284 Chinese cities between 2010 and 2020, this study investigates the impacts of FTZs on urban innovation intensity, measured by innovation output per unit of construction land, using a difference-in-differences (DID) framework. To mitigate endogeneity concerns, we apply propensity score matching to construct balanced treatment and control groups for the spatial DID models, enabling estimation of both direct and spillover effects of FTZs. The results show that FTZs significantly enhance innovation intensity in host cities, but generate negative spatial spillover effects on their neighboring cities. These findings are robust across a series of robustness tests. Heterogeneity analysis further reveals that the effects vary across regions, FTZ sizes, and administrative levels of cities. Mechanism analysis indicates that FTZs promote innovation through both government-led interventions and market-driven mechanisms. The findings highlight the need for policymakers to not only promote the diffusion of FTZ benefits within host cities but also mitigate the widening regional innovation disparities through coordinated planning and intercity policy alignment.
records.abstract_cn: 城市创新的土地利用效率对于面临土地约束的转型经济体的可持续发展至关重要。在此背景下，自由贸易试验区（FTZs）已成为提升创新绩效的关键政策工具。利用2010年至2020年间中国284个城市的面板数据集，本研究采用双重差分（DID）框架，考察了自由贸易试验区对城市创新强度（以单位建设用地创新产出衡量）的影响。为缓解内生性问题，我们应用倾向得分匹配构建平衡的处理组和对照组，用于空间DID模型，从而能够估计自由贸易试验区的直接效应和溢出效应。结果表明，自由贸易试验区显著提升了所在城市的创新强度，但对邻近城市产生了负向空间溢出效应。这些发现在一系列稳健性检验中保持稳健。异质性分析进一步揭示，效应因地区、自由贸易试验区规模和城市行政级别而异。机制分析表明，自由贸易试验区通过政府主导的干预和市场驱动机制促进创新。研究结果强调，政策制定者不仅需要促进自由贸易试验区利益在所在城市内部的扩散，还应通过协调规划和城际政策对齐来缓解不断扩大的区域创新差距。

records.title_en: Balancing grassland ecology and herders’ economic benefits: The impact of Grassland ecological compensation policy in Inner Mongolia
records.title_cn: 平衡草原生态与牧民经济效益：内蒙古草原生态补偿政策的影响
records.abstract_en: The Grassland Ecological Compensation Policy (GECP) in China is a herder-centered payment for ecosystem services program designed to restore grassland ecosystems while improving herders’ livelihoods. However, long-term empirical studies assessing the effects of GECP across different grassland types and its socioeconomic impacts on herders remain limited. Based on field surveys conducted among herders in Inner Mongolia in 2010, 2015, and 2018, this study evaluates the policy’s impact on grassland ecosystems and livestock production by Commonality Analysis and Partial Least Squares Path Modeling. The results showed that: (1) The livestock scale significantly decreased only in the meadow steppe, while notable changes in livestock structure were observed across all three grassland types; (2) Sheep or goat populations showed a great decline and large livestock (e.g., cattle) numbers exhibited minimal changes across three grassland types; (3) The policy induced notable shifts in herders’ income and cost structures, with livestock income decreasing by 25.7–45.5 % and non-farm income increasing by 19.7–30.5 %; (4) Although GECP significantly enhanced grassland productivity, its ecological benefits may be partially offset by other socio-economic factor like rising livestock prices, as herders adjust grazing and production strategies in response to market dynamics. These findings suggest that GECP not only improved grassland quality but also reshaped herders' production practices and livelihood strategies. To ensure sustainable grassland management, future policy adjustments should account for regional heterogeneity by considering key factors such as grassland carrying capacity, livestock market fluctuations, and climate variability. Adopting differentiated management strategies tailored to different grassland types will be crucial for balancing ecological conservation and herder welfare.
records.abstract_cn: 中国的草原生态补偿政策（GECP）是一项以牧民为中心的生态系统服务付费项目，旨在恢复草原生态系统，同时改善牧民生计。然而，评估GECP在不同草原类型上的长期效果及其对牧民社会经济影响的实证研究仍然有限。基于2010年、2015年和2018年在内蒙古牧民中进行的实地调查，本研究通过共性分析和偏最小二乘路径建模评估了该政策对草原生态系统和畜牧生产的影响。结果表明：（1）仅在草甸草原上，牲畜规模显著下降，而所有三种草原类型上的牲畜结构均发生了显著变化；（2）绵羊或山羊种群大幅减少，而大型牲畜（如牛）的数量在三种草原类型上变化极小；（3）该政策引起了牧民收入和成本结构的显著转变，畜牧收入下降了25.7-45.5%，非农收入增加了19.7-30.5%；（4）尽管GECP显著提高了草原生产力，但其生态效益可能部分被其他社会经济因素（如牲畜价格上涨）所抵消，因为牧民会根据市场动态调整放牧和生产策略。这些发现表明，GECP不仅改善了草原质量，还重塑了牧民的生产实践和生计策略。为确保草原的可持续管理，未来的政策调整应考虑区域异质性，纳入草原载畜量、牲畜市场波动和气候变异性等关键因素。针对不同草原类型采取差异化管理策略，对于平衡生态保护与牧民福利至关重要。

records.title_en: The significance of food-water-land-ecosystem nexus to management decisions of national nature reserves
records.title_cn: 食物-水-土地-生态系统纽带对国家自然保护区管理决策的意义
records.abstract_en: The coupling relationship within the food-water-land-ecosystem (FWLE) nexus is critical for the sustainable development of national nature reserves (NNRs). However, there is limited understanding of the trade-offs and synergies within this nexus. Consequently, the challenge of establishing a coordinated FWLE nexus has become increasingly urgent. This study takes the Momoge National Nature Reserve (MNNR) as a case study, utilizing past-present-future land use data, combined with the InVEST model and statistical data, to explore the dynamic evolution, driving factors and interrelationships within the FWLE nexus. The findings reveal significant transformations in land use patterns, including fluctuations observed in grassland and barren land areas, contrasted with a deceleration in the rate of forest and wetland reduction. Notably, the impervious land expanded by 10,463 ha, leading to a decline in habitat quality (HQ) and an increase in water yield (WY). Meanwhile, cropland areas exhibit annual fluctuations but consistently record increasing crop yields. Human activities are identified as the primary driver behind these changes. In scenarios emphasizing future ecological protection and restoration, both crop production (CP) increase, while the percentage of areas with great HQ reaches 39 % and 56 %, respectively, representing ideal FWLE nexus trends. Conversely, in scenarios prioritizing economic development, CP reaches its peak, but this progress coincides with a corresponding decline in HQ, reducing the proportion of areas with favorable HQ to 27 %. Based on these findings, we have constructed a robust FWLE implementation framework that emphasizes effective control of human activities within the protected area and improves ecological quality through measures such as hydrological connectivity and ecological restoration. The insights gleaned from this research hold significant implications for the formulation of management policies governing these invaluable conservation areas.
records.abstract_cn: 食物-水-土地-生态系统（FWLE）纽带中的耦合关系对国家自然保护区（NNRs）的可持续发展至关重要。然而，对这一纽带中的权衡与协同作用的理解仍然有限。因此，建立协调的FWLE纽带面临的挑战日益紧迫。本研究以莫莫格国家级自然保护区（MNNR）为案例，利用过去-现在-未来的土地利用数据，结合InVEST模型和统计数据，探讨FWLE纽带内的动态演变、驱动因素及其相互关系。研究发现，土地利用模式发生了显著变化，包括草地和裸地面积的波动，以及森林和湿地减少速度的放缓。值得注意的是，不透水面扩大了10,463公顷，导致栖息地质量（HQ）下降和水产量（WY）增加。同时，农田面积呈现年度波动，但作物产量持续增长。人类活动被确定为这些变化的主要驱动力。在强调未来生态保护和恢复的情景下，作物产量（CP）增加，而HQ优良面积比例分别达到39%和56%，代表了理想的FWLE纽带趋势。相反，在优先考虑经济发展的情景下，CP达到峰值，但这一进展伴随着HQ的相应下降，使HQ优良面积比例降至27%。基于这些发现，我们构建了一个稳健的FWLE实施框架，强调有效控制保护区内的人类活动，并通过水文连通性和生态恢复等措施改善生态质量。本研究获得的见解对这些宝贵保护区的管理政策制定具有重要意义。

records.title_en: Connect and grow: Spatial correlation network and risk regulation pattern of rural settlement health
records.title_cn: 连接与增长：乡村聚落健康的空间关联网络与风险调控模式
records.abstract_en: Given the intensifying regional interactions and rural decline, the synergistic enhancement of RSH has emerged as a pressing issue for improving resident well-being and promoting rural sustainable development. However, current cognitive ambiguities and insufficient assessments regarding RSH hamper its effective regional regulation. To bridge this gap, this study proposes a vitality-organization-resilience (VOR) framework for RSH. Fifty-eight township units in Zaozhuang City, a National Sustainable Development Agenda Innovation Demonstration Zone in China, are chosen as the case study area. The modified gravity model, social network analysis, and obstacle diagnosis model are employed to reveal the spatial correlation network and risk factors of RSH. The results show that the RSH of townships is primarily at a medium-to-low level, with the spatial correlation network exhibiting a multithreaded but low-density characteristic. The core nodes of the network are primarily townships with higher RSH levels located near central towns. The network can be categorized into two net beneficial blocks, one net spillover block, and one bidirectional spillover block, with most blocks exhibiting close internal relationships. The economic vitality, land use patch scale, and social resilience are primary risk dimensions to RSH. Combining RSH characteristics with current territorial spatial planning, a classified regulation pattern and corresponding governance strategies for RSH are proposed. Our findings enhance the understanding of RSH, and offer valuable insights for the evaluation and regulation of RSH in other regions.
records.abstract_cn: 鉴于区域互动加剧和乡村衰退，乡村聚落健康（RSH）的协同提升已成为改善居民福祉和促进乡村可持续发展的紧迫问题。然而，当前对RSH的认知模糊和评估不足阻碍了其有效的区域调控。为弥补这一缺口，本研究提出了RSH的活力-组织-韧性（VOR）框架。选取中国国家可持续发展议程创新示范区枣庄市的五十八个乡镇单元作为研究区。采用修正引力模型、社会网络分析和障碍诊断模型，揭示RSH的空间关联网络和风险因素。结果表明，乡镇RSH总体处于中低水平，空间关联网络呈现多线程但低密度的特征。网络的核心节点主要是位于中心城镇附近、RSH水平较高的乡镇。网络可分为两个净受益板块、一个净溢出板块和一个双向溢出板块，大多数板块内部关系密切。经济活力、土地利用斑块规模和社会韧性是RSH的主要风险维度。结合RSH特征与现行国土空间规划，提出了RSH的分类调控模式和相应治理策略。我们的发现增进了对RSH的理解，并为其他地区RSH的评估与调控提供了有价值的见解。

records.title_en: Has China’s farmland rotation and fallow system contributed to an increase in grain production?
records.title_cn: 中国耕地轮作休耕制度是否促进了粮食增产？
records.abstract_en: Coordinating the relationship between ecological security and food security and promoting sustainable agricultural development are of great significance for improving people’s well-being and ensuring social stability. To protect farmland, the Chinese government has implemented the farmland rotation and fallow system (FRFS) since 2016, and this study regards farming households’ participation in the FRFS as a quasi-natural experiment. Based on the China Rural Revitalization Survey (CRRS) data in 2020 and 2022, we empirically investigate the impacts and intermediate mechanisms of FRFS on grain production and assess the implementation effects of FRFS by using the Cross-sectional Linear Regression model, the Mediation model, the Propensity Score Matching method, and the Instrumental Variable (IV) method. The study finds that in the short term, the implementation of the FRFS has a weak and manageable negative impact on the grain production of participating farming households, with an average reduction of 4.8–5.7 % compared to non-participating farming households’ grain production. In the long term, not only does the FRFS promote a sustained increase in grain production, but it also improves soil fertility and reduces the use of agricultural chemical fertilizers, achieving a win-win situation for both ecological security and food security. Mechanism analysis shows that the increase in grain production per unit of sown area is the primary pathway through which the FRFS facilitates the growth in total grain production. Heterogeneity analysis reveals that the impact of the FRFS on grain production is influenced by factors such as the proportions of farmland rotation and fallow, village terrains, locational characteristics, the accessibility of agricultural production services, and the level of rural governance. Further analysis reveals that the FRFS not only does not diminish the income of participating farming households but also has a potential positive impact on enhancing their income. The findings of this study provide empirical evidence for relevant government departments to further optimize the FRFS.
records.abstract_cn: 协调生态安全与粮食安全的关系，促进农业可持续发展，对于改善民生福祉、保障社会稳定具有重要意义。为保护耕地，中国政府自2016年起实施了耕地轮作休耕制度（FRFS），本研究将农户参与轮作休耕视为一项准自然实验。基于2020年和2022年中国乡村振兴调查（CRRS）数据，我们实证考察了轮作休耕制度对粮食生产的影响及中间机制，并采用截面线性回归模型、中介效应模型、倾向得分匹配方法和工具变量法（IV）评估了轮作休耕制度的实施效果。研究发现，短期内，轮作休耕制度的实施对参与农户的粮食生产产生了微弱且可控的负面影响，与未参与农户的粮食生产相比，平均减少了4.8-5.7%。长期来看，轮作休耕制度不仅促进了粮食生产的持续增长，还改善了土壤肥力并减少了农业化肥的使用，实现了生态安全与粮食安全的双赢。机制分析表明，单位播种面积粮食产量的增加是轮作休耕制度促进粮食总产量增长的主要途径。异质性分析显示，轮作休耕制度对粮食生产的影响受到耕地轮作休耕比例、村庄地形、区位特征、农业生产服务可及性以及乡村治理水平等因素的影响。进一步分析发现，轮作休耕制度不仅没有降低参与农户的收入，反而对其收入提升具有潜在的正向影响。本研究结论为相关政府部门进一步优化轮作休耕制度提供了经验证据。

records.title_en: Conservation policies effectiveness in Arasbaran Biosphere Reserve: Insights from GLM-based forest cover change
records.title_cn: 阿尔斯巴兰生物圈保护区保护政策有效性：基于GLM的森林覆盖变化洞察
records.abstract_en: This study examines forest cover changes and the role of governance and policy in shaping land use dynamics in the ecologically sensitive Arasbaran forests of northwest Iran. We compare two land governance regimes: protected areas (PR) under the Department of Environment (DoE) since 1971, and previously unprotected areas (PUPR) managed by the Natural Resources Organization until their reclassification as protected in 2013. Using Landsat satellite imagery, we assess forest cover changes over two time periods (1984–2013 and 2013–2024) and apply Generalized Linear Models (GLM) to evaluate the socio-environmental drivers of deforestation and forest recovery. Findings reveal a net forest expansion in both areas, with PR showing gradual improvement across the two periods and PUPR recovering 2446.96 ha post-2013. While PUPR experienced significant deforestation before 2013 due to weaker enforcement, the transition to DoE management and associated policy reforms led to marked improvements in forest cover. Deforestation was closely associated with proximity to settlements and forest edges, indicating human pressure as a key factor. The improved model performance after the policy-driven governance shift highlights the critical role of institutional capacity and regulatory frameworks in shaping land use outcomes. These results underscore the importance of long-term, well-enforced conservation policies in reversing deforestation trends. The study offers actionable insights for evidence-based policymaking, forest governance, and land use planning in protected and transitioning areas. More broadly, it contributes to global discussions on how policy interventions and institutional change can enhance forest resilience and support sustainable development goals in biodiversity-rich landscapes.
records.abstract_cn: 本研究考察了伊朗西北部生态敏感的阿尔斯巴兰森林的森林覆盖变化以及治理和政策在塑造土地利用动态中的作用。我们比较了两种土地治理制度：自1971年起由环境部（DoE）管理的保护区（PR），以及此前未受保护的区域（PUPR），这些区域由自然资源组织管理，直到2013年重新分类为保护区。利用Landsat卫星影像，我们评估了1984-2013和2013-2024两个时期的森林覆盖变化，并应用广义线性模型（GLM）评估毁林和森林恢复的社会环境驱动因素。研究结果显示，两个区域均出现净森林扩张，其中PR在两个时期内呈现逐步改善，而PUPR在2013年后恢复了2446.96公顷。尽管PUPR在2013年前因执法较弱而经历了显著的毁林，但向环境部管理的过渡及相关政策改革带来了森林覆盖的显著改善。毁林与靠近定居点和森林边缘密切相关，表明人类压力是关键因素。政策驱动的治理转变后模型性能的提升，凸显了制度能力和监管框架在塑造土地利用结果中的关键作用。这些结果强调了长期、有效执行的保护政策在扭转毁林趋势中的重要性。该研究为基于证据的政策制定、森林治理以及保护区和过渡区域的土地利用规划提供了可操作的见解。更广泛地说，它有助于全球关于政策干预和制度变革如何增强森林韧性并支持生物多样性丰富景观中可持续发展目标的讨论。

records.title_en: Challenges of soil health restoration in Tunisian cereal production systems: an analysis through the social-ecological systems framework (SES)
records.title_cn: 突尼斯谷物生产系统中土壤健康恢复的挑战：基于社会-生态系统框架（SES）的分析
records.abstract_en: Soil health is essential for sustainable and resilient agricultural systems, supporting food production and maintaining vital ecosystem services. In the Mediterranean region, including Tunisia, it is seriously threatened by both natural and anthropogenic factors, such as erosion, loss of organic matter, intensive agricultural practices, and inadequate land management. In this context, adopting farming practices that can preserve and restore soil health is crucial, but such a transition is far from straightforward. To explore what this transition entails, we applied the Socio-Ecological Systems (SES) framework as the guiding structure for our methodological approach. Data was collected through a literature review, eleven semi-structured interviews, a multi-actor workshop involving twenty participants, and a multi-criteria analysis. Results reveal a combination of technical, political, institutional, economic, and socio-cultural barriers that hinder the adoption of practices that can secure soil health. The most critical include (1) the absence of agricultural policies supporting transition, (2) limited communication and cooperation among actors, and (3) high implementation costs. The study concludes by emphasizing the need for a coordinated national strategy that fosters cross-sectoral collaboration and provides effective support for farmers transitioning toward sustainable soil management in Tunisia’s cereal systems.
records.abstract_cn: 土壤健康对于可持续和有韧性的农业系统至关重要，它支持粮食生产并维持重要的生态系统服务。在地中海地区，包括突尼斯，土壤健康受到自然和人为因素的严重威胁，如侵蚀、有机质流失、集约化农业实践和不合理的土地管理。在此背景下，采用能够保护和恢复土壤健康的耕作实践至关重要，但这样的转型远非易事。为了探索这一转型所涉及的内容，我们应用社会-生态系统（SES）框架作为方法论指导结构。数据通过文献综述、十一次半结构化访谈、一次涉及二十名参与者的多方利益相关者研讨会以及多标准分析收集。结果显示，技术、政治、制度、经济和社会文化障碍的组合阻碍了能够保障土壤健康的实践的采用。其中最关键的包括（1）缺乏支持转型的农业政策，（2）参与者之间有限的沟通与合作，以及（3）高昂的实施成本。研究最后强调，需要一项协调的国家战略，促进跨部门合作，并为突尼斯谷物系统中向可持续土壤管理过渡的农民提供有效支持。

records.title_en: Spatial evolution characteristics and driving factors of urban forms in the Colombo Metropolitan Area (CMA), Sri Lanka: A geo-informatics approach
records.title_cn: 科伦坡大都市区（CMA）城市形态的空间演变特征及驱动因素：一种地理信息学方法
records.abstract_en: Understanding the development patterns of urban form is crucial for efficient planning in expanding metropolitan areas. This study examines the spatial evolution of urban form in the Colombo Metropolitan Area (CMA) from 1995 to 2024, utilizing Geographic Information System (GIS) and remote sensing technology. Key metrics include the expansion index, landscape index, compactness index, center-of-gravity shift, and standard deviation ellipse (SDE). Logistic regression was applied to identify influencing factors, while FRAGSTAT assessed landscape metrics. The Findings indicated that CMA’s urban form developed by 292.96 km2, with an annual growth rate (AGR) of 3.75 %, signifying rapid development. Spatial evolution extended beyond the core city, with edge expansion accounting for 95.03 % of new development (127.57 km²) between 2014 and 2024. While infill development increased, urban sprawl remained dominant. Landscape fragmentation fluctuated, reflecting dynamic spatial changes. SDE analysis revealed significant expansion in 2014, followed by a slight contraction by 2024, with continued northeastern expansion. The urban center shifted from the northwest to the northeast, marking a transition from the core city to other urban areas, such as Sri Jayewardenepura Kotte and Kaduwela. A logistic regression model identified six key drivers of urban form spatial evolution, highlighting the interplay among socioeconomic, physical, and environmental factors. Moreover, the Colombo Port City has emerged as a key catalyst for urban form transformation, significantly enhancing connectivity and extending its influence across the CMA. The findings support efficient infrastructure development, sustainable land use planning, and a well-rounded approach to urban form and spatial development in the CMA.
records.abstract_cn: 理解城市形态的发展模式对于不断扩张的大都市区的有效规划至关重要。本研究利用地理信息系统（GIS）和遥感技术，考察了科伦坡大都市区（CMA）从1995年到2024年城市形态的空间演变。关键指标包括扩张指数、景观指数、紧凑度指数、重心迁移和标准差椭圆（SDE）。应用逻辑回归识别影响因素，同时使用FRAGSTAT评估景观指标。结果表明，CMA的城市形态扩展了292.96平方公里，年均增长率（AGR）为3.75%，表明快速发展。空间演变超出了核心城市，边缘扩张占2014年至2024年间新增开发的95.03%（127.57平方公里）。虽然填充式开发有所增加，但城市蔓延仍占主导地位。景观破碎化波动，反映了动态的空间变化。SDE分析显示2014年显著扩张，随后到2024年略有收缩，并持续向东北方向扩展。城市中心从西北向东北转移，标志着从核心城市向其他城市区域（如斯里贾亚瓦德纳普拉科特和卡杜韦拉）的过渡。逻辑回归模型识别了城市形态空间演变的六个关键驱动因素，强调了社会经济、自然和环境因素之间的相互作用。此外，科伦坡港口城已成为城市形态转型的关键催化剂，显著增强了连通性并将其影响力扩展到整个CMA。这些发现支持CMA高效的基础设施开发、可持续的土地利用规划以及城市形态和空间发展的全面方法。

records.title_en: Impacts of Large-Scale Solar-Enabling Legislation on Farmland Values
records.title_cn: 大规模太阳能立法对农田价值的影响
records.abstract_en:
Abstract

Legislation promoting large-scale solar could potentially elevate farmland prices. Using approximately 12,000 farmland transactions (2007–2021), we study the impact of the 2015 Shared Renewable Program and relevant policies in New York state. We find that large solar-suitable parcels within two miles of substations sold for 15%–18% more than comparable parcels farther away after the program9s implementation. This effect is absent for parcels unsuitable for solar yet desirable for housing, suggesting it is unrelated to housing pressure. We also find a stronger effect on farmland in regions with higher electricity prices (ca. 20%), suggesting SRP’s impact varies by location and time.
records.abstract_cn: 促进大规模太阳能的立法可能提升农田价格。利用约12,000笔农田交易（2007-2021年），我们研究了2015年共享可再生能源计划及纽约州相关政策的影响。我们发现，在该计划实施后，位于变电站两英里内且适合大型太阳能开发的地块，其售价较距离更远的可比地块高出15%–18%。这一效应在那些不适合太阳能开发但适合住房的地块上并不存在，表明其与住房压力无关。我们还发现，在电价较高的地区，该效应对农田的影响更强（约20%），这表明共享可再生能源计划的影响因地点和时间而异。

records.title_en: Fires in the Built Environment and Residential Market Demand
records.title_cn: 建筑环境火灾与住宅市场需求
records.abstract_en:
Abstract

Using nationwide data on multifamily residential transactions in South Korea, we investigate how large-scale fires in the built environment affect housing markets. We make use of geo-spatial data and apply the difference-in-differences research design to show that fires within an apartment complex cause an approximately 9 percent decline in housing prices over a 1-2 month-long period. In contrast, fires that occur slightly farther away or in non-residential buildings have no significant effect. Text mining analysis further suggests that greater media coverage—often associated with fires in nonresidential structures—does not necessarily result in larger price declines.
records.abstract_cn: 利用韩国多户住宅交易的全国数据，我们研究了建筑环境中大规模火灾如何影响住房市场。我们使用地理空间数据并应用双重差分研究设计，表明公寓综合体内部的火灾会导致房价在1-2个月期间内下降约9%。相比之下，发生在稍远距离或非住宅建筑中的火灾则没有显著影响。文本挖掘分析进一步表明，更多的媒体报道——通常与非住宅结构火灾相关——并不必然导致更大的价格下跌。

records.title_en: Public Acceptance of Lawncare Policy Instruments to Reduce Nonpoint-Source Pollution
records.title_cn: 公众对减少非点源污染的草坪护理政策工具的接受度
records.abstract_en:
Abstract

Attainment of nutrient-reduction goals in many water bodies requires control over household behaviors such as lawn fertilizer use. These behaviors can be influenced through approaches including direct restrictions and price-based instruments. In practice, applications of policy instruments such as these are deterred by assumptions that they would be opposed by the public. This paper evaluates the public acceptability of price-, quantity-, and other instruments applicable to lawn fertilizer. Models are illustrated using data from a revealed/stated preference discrete choice experiment in the Baltimore region. Findings suggest that common wisdom regarding the acceptability of lawncare regulations may contribute to suboptimal policy.
records.abstract_cn: 在许多水体中实现营养物减排目标需要控制家庭行为，如草坪肥料的使用。这些行为可以通过直接限制和基于价格的工具等方法加以影响。在实践中，此类政策工具的应用常因假设公众会反对而受阻。本文评估了适用于草坪肥料的价格、数量及其他工具的可接受性。模型利用巴尔的摩地区的一项揭示/陈述偏好离散选择实验的数据进行说明。研究结果表明，关于草坪护理法规可接受性的普遍看法可能导致次优政策。

records.title_en: Heat, Climate Control, and Worker Absences
records.title_cn: 高温、气候控制与工人缺勤
records.abstract_en:
Abstract

Does heat increase the probability of missing work for formal sector workers? We address this question by analysing nearly three years of daily data on 274 employees across 86 locations of a large welding firm in India. A 1°C rise in daily mean temperature increases the probability of missing work for workers without workplace climate control by 3.4% of the mean rate of absence. The same temperature increase decreases the probability of missing work by 2.5% relative to mean absenteeism for workers with climate control.
records.abstract_cn: 高温是否会增加正规部门工人缺勤的概率？我们通过分析印度一家大型焊接公司在86个地点的274名员工近三年的每日数据来回答这个问题。日平均温度每升高1°C，无工作场所气候控制的工人缺勤概率相对于平均缺勤率增加3.4%。同样的温度升高使有气候控制的工人缺勤概率相对于平均缺勤率降低2.5%。

records.title_en: A Legacy Through Millennia
records.title_cn: 千年传承
records.abstract_en:
Abstract

Societal functioning needs both formal and informal institutions. However, the existing body of literature predominantly emphasizes the influence of formal institutions on climate change, often neglecting the role of informal mechanisms. This article draws on clan networks in China to investigate the influence of informal institutions on county-level carbon emissions. Using the historical number of Confucian temples as an instrumental variable, the findings suggest that informal institutions contribute to an unexpected increase in carbon emissions. This effect is attributed to corruption and deficiencies in environmental enforcement. Gender diversity among local leadership mitigates the adverse effects associated with informal institutions.
records.abstract_cn: 社会运转既需要正式制度，也需要非正式制度。然而，现有文献主要强调正式制度对气候变化的影响，往往忽视了非正式机制的作用。本文利用中国的宗族网络，研究非正式制度对县级碳排放的影响。以历史儒家祠堂数量作为工具变量，研究结果表明，非正式制度导致了碳排放的意外增加。这一效应归因于腐败和环境执法不足。地方领导层中的性别多样性缓解了与非正式制度相关的不利影响。

records.title_en: Assessing the Effects of Deterrence Mechanisms on Deforestation in the Brazilian Savanna
records.title_cn: 评估威慑机制对巴西稀树草原森林砍伐的影响
records.abstract_en:
Abstract

Deterrence mechanisms have garnered renewed interest as policy instruments to curb natural resources overexploitation. In this study deterrence is understood as inherently multidimensional, comprising the severity, celerity, and certainty of punishment. We employ an IV approach to econometrically assess the effectiveness of these dimensions in reducing deforestation in the Brazilian Savanna. The empirical results underscore the significance of severity, as well as the bureaucratic effectiveness, reflected in the certainty and celerity of enforcement, in curbing deforestation. These findings highlight the necessity of adopting a multidimensional legal and institutional framework to prevent deforestation in the region.
records.abstract_cn: 威慑机制作为遏制自然资源过度开采的政策工具，重新引起了人们的兴趣。在本研究中，威慑被理解为本质上多维的，包括惩罚的严厉性、迅速性和确定性。我们采用工具变量方法，对这些维度在减少巴西稀树草原森林砍伐方面的有效性进行计量经济学评估。实证结果强调了严厉性以及官僚效率（反映在执法的确定性和迅速性上）在遏制森林砍伐中的重要性。这些发现凸显了采取多维法律和制度框架以防止该地区森林砍伐的必要性。

records.title_en: High-Quality Farm and Poverty Alleviation
records.title_cn: 高标准农田建设与扶贫
records.abstract_en:
Abstract

To evaluate large-scale publicly-funded projects aiming at improving farmland quality, we study the income effects of China’s High-standard Farmland Construction Program. We exploit the implementation of the program and conduct a difference-in-differences analysis. We find that the program improved per capita income for rural populations, mainly through short-term projects. We find that crop production gains driven by complementary inputs including machinery and fertilizer, combined with efficient land allocation rather than labor allocation, are the primary mechanisms that account for the impacts of this policy.
records.abstract_cn: 为评估旨在改善农田质量的大规模公共资助项目，我们研究了中国高标准农田建设项目的收入效应。我们利用该项目的实施进行了双重差分分析。我们发现该项目提高了农村人口的人均收入，主要通过短期项目实现。我们发现，由机械和化肥等互补投入驱动的作物生产收益，加上有效的土地配置而非劳动力配置，是解释该政策影响的主要机制。

records.title_en: Economic Benefits of Nature-Based Solutions for Climate Risk
records.title_cn: 基于自然的气候风险解决方案的经济效益
records.abstract_en:
Abstract

This meta-analysis of stated preference studies involving over 49,500 total respondents aims to quantify the economic value of co-benefits from nature-based solutions (NBSs) that address climate risks. The results indicate that the willingness to pay (WTP) for co-benefits increases with GDP per capita and decreases with NBS size. Recreational and aesthetic benefits, as well as NBSs developed in urban grey areas, are more valued than conservation and maintenance of current nature sites. The novel value transfer function can assist future research and policymakers in assessing the economic co-benefits of NBSs for climate risk based on the policy site characteristics.
records.abstract_cn: 这项对涉及超过49,500名受访者的陈述偏好研究的元分析旨在量化应对气候风险的基于自然的解决方案（NBSs）的协同效益的经济价值。结果表明，对协同效益的支付意愿（WTP）随人均GDP增加而增加，随NBS规模减小而降低。娱乐和美学效益，以及在城市灰色区域开发的NBSs，比保护和维护现有自然场所更受重视。新颖的价值转移函数可根据政策场所特征，帮助未来研究和政策制定者评估NBSs应对气候风险的经济协同效益。

records.title_en: Identifying the general equilibrium effects of narcotics enforcement
records.title_cn: 确定禁毒执法的一般均衡效应
records.abstract_en: I analyze the demand side impacts of a supply-side intervention into the market for illegal drugs in what has been described as America’s largest open-air drug market. Beginning in 2018, the Pennsylvania Attorney General’s office and the Philadelphia Police Department engaged in an ambitious effort to shut down the drug market in Philadelphia’s Kensington neighborhood. The intervention involved increased police presence in the targeted area alongside a series of targeted “kingpin” sweeps which were intended to remove the most pervasive operators from the market. I employ highly granular SafeGraph cell phone location data to track changes in traffic flows between census block groups, observing that the Initiative led to sizeable and persistent reductions in traffic flows to the target area. Additionally, in contrast to substitution effects observed in other work, I observe that the Initiative led to reductions in traffic flows to other regional drug markets and large declines in overdose mortality in the Philadelphia metropolitan area as a whole, suggesting a genuine reduction in the quantity of illegal narcotics demanded. With a combination of theory and empirics, I argue that this reduction in the quantity demanded regionally is able to be achieved due to the Initiative disrupting a supply-chain that data indicates flows from the target area outwards to smaller satellite markets. Together this all suggests that, despite the inelastic demand for narcotics, regionally linked markets can be impacted broadly by location specific interventions.
records.abstract_cn: 我分析了供应方干预非法毒品市场对需求方的影响，这个市场被称为美国最大的露天毒品市场。从2018开始，宾夕法尼亚州总检察长办公室和费城警察局雄心勃勃地努力关闭费城肯辛顿社区的毒品市场。此次干预措施包括在目标地区增加警力，同时开展一系列有针对性的“主脑”扫荡，旨在将最普遍的经营者从市场上清除。我使用高度精细的 SafeGraph 手机位置数据来跟踪人口普查区块组之间的交通流量变化，观察到该计划导致目标区域的交通流量大幅持续减少。此外，与其他工作中观察到的替代效应相反，我观察到该倡议导致其他区域毒品市场的流量减少，整个费城大都市区的服药过量死亡率大幅下降，这表明非法麻醉品需求量真正减少。结合理论和经验，我认为区域需求量的减少是能够实现的，因为该倡议扰乱了供应链，数据显示从目标区域向外流向较小的卫星市场。所有这些都表明，尽管对麻醉品的需求缺乏弹性，但区域相关市场可能会受到特定地点干预措施的广泛影响。

records.title_en: JUE insight: Floods & urban density
records.title_cn: JUE洞察：洪水与城市密度
records.abstract_en: This paper examines the effects of floods on urban development dynamics using geolocalized data on the universe of buildings in Spain from 1996 to 2021. We provide empirical evidence that floods promote local urban development, resulting in taller, more compact urban layouts that attract populations, increase property values, and shift land use away from the agricultural and industrial sectors. We argue that adaptive responses to natural disasters may trigger positive local spillovers strong enough to overcompensate for the flood’s destructive nature.
records.abstract_cn: 本文利用1996年至2021年间西班牙所有建筑物的地理定位数据，考察了洪水对城市发展动态的影响。我们提供的经验证据表明，洪水促进了地方城市发展，导致城市布局更加高耸、紧凑，吸引了人口，提升了房产价值，并使土地利用从农业和工业部门转移。我们认为，对自然灾害的适应性反应可能引发足够强的正向地方溢出效应，足以弥补洪水的破坏性影响。

records.title_en: Working from home increases work–home distances
records.title_cn: 居家办公增加了工作与居住地之间的距离
records.abstract_en: This paper examines how the increased acceptance of working from home during and after the Covid-19 pandemic shapes how labor market and locality choices interact. We combine large administrative data on employment biographies in Germany and a new working from home potential indicator based on comprehensive data on working conditions across occupations. We find that, in the wake of the pandemic, the distance between workplace and residence has increased more strongly for workers in occupations that can be done from home: The association of working from home potential and work–home distance increased significantly since 2021 as compared to a stable pattern before. The effect is much larger for new jobs, suggesting that people match to jobs with high working from home potential that are further away than before the pandemic. Most of this effect stems from jobs in big cities, which indicates that working from home alleviates constraints by tight housing markets. We find no significant evidence that commuting patterns changed more strongly for women than for men.
records.abstract_cn: 本文考察了Covid-19疫情期间及之后居家办公接受度的提高如何影响劳动力市场与居住地选择的相互作用。我们结合了德国就业传记的大型行政数据以及基于各职业工作条件综合数据的新居家办公潜力指标。我们发现，疫情之后，在可居家办公的职业中，工作场所与居住地之间的距离增加更为显著：与之前稳定的模式相比，自2021年以来，居家办公潜力与工作-居住距离之间的关联显著增强。这一效应在新工作中更为明显，表明人们匹配到了比疫情前距离更远但居家办公潜力高的工作。这一效应大部分源于大城市的工作，这表明居家办公缓解了紧张住房市场的约束。我们没有发现显著证据表明女性的通勤模式变化比男性更大。

records.title_en: Does political partisanship affect housing supply? Evidence from US cities
records.title_cn: 政治党派性是否影响住房供应？来自美国城市的证据
records.abstract_en: We study the relationship between housing supply and political partisanship in US cities using an expanded database of mayoral elections combined with local housing permits since 1980. The endogeneity of which party holds the mayoral office is addressed via a regression discontinuity design that relies on closely contested races between Republicans and Democrats. Across a variety of election samples and econometric specifications, we find that partisanship does not have a statistically or economically significant effect on the supply of total, single- or multifamily housing unit permits despite recent increases in measured partisanship. This suggests that solutions to limitations on housing supply will not be dependent upon the political party in power at the local level.
records.abstract_cn: 我们利用一个扩展的市长选举数据库，结合自1980年以来的地方住房许可证，研究了美国城市住房供应与政治党派性之间的关系。市长办公室所属政党的内生性问题通过回归不连续设计来解决，该设计依赖于共和党与民主党之间的激烈竞争。在各种选举样本和计量经济学规范中，我们发现，尽管近年来测得的党派性有所增加，但党派性对总住房单位许可证、单户或多户住房单位许可证的供应没有统计上或经济上显著的影响。这表明，住房供应限制的解决方案将不依赖于地方层面的执政党。

records.title_en: Sticky places: The effect of college on where you live
records.title_cn: 粘性地点：大学对居住地的影响
records.abstract_en: Does the location of higher education institutions affect where graduates live? We use Norway’s centralized admissions system as a natural experiment to quantify the causal effect of study location on residence later in life. Leveraging students’ rankings of study programs and locations alongside GPA-based admission scores, we identify unpredictable cutoffs that create discontinuities in admission for near-identical applicants. Our analysis shows that being admitted to the preferred study location increases the likelihood of residing in the same region after graduation by 15–20 percentage points. This effect is consistent across both larger and smaller cities, highlighting the “stickiness” of educational locations.
records.abstract_cn: 高等教育机构的位置是否影响毕业生的居住地？我们利用挪威的集中招生系统作为自然实验，量化学习地点对日后居住地的因果效应。借助学生对学习项目和地点的排名以及基于GPA的录取分数，我们识别出不可预测的分数线，这些分数线在几乎相同的申请者中造成了录取的不连续性。我们的分析表明，被首选学习地点录取会使毕业后居住在同一地区的可能性增加15-20个百分点。这一效应在大城市和小城市中均一致，凸显了教育地点的“粘性”。

records.title_en: The redistribution of housing wealth caused by rent control
records.title_cn: 租金管制引起的住房财富再分配
records.abstract_en: This paper studies the effects of rent control on the housing wealth of renters, landlords, and homeowners. Following the passage of rent control in St. Paul, Minnesota in 2021, average property values fell by 4.0% to 5.5%. Leveraging parcel-level data, we show that in the aggregate, renters gained and landlords lost, though upper-income renters gained more than lower-income renters, while small landlords lost the same as large landlords. Owner-occupants’ wealth also fell significantly from direct capitalization effects and negative externalities. These results provide the first evidence on the heterogeneous wealth effects of a wave of new rent control laws.
records.abstract_cn: 本文研究了租金管制对租户、房东和房主住房财富的影响。在2021年明尼苏达州圣保罗市通过租金管制后，平均房产价值下降了4.0%至5.5%。利用地块级数据，我们表明总体而言，租户获益而房东受损，尽管高收入租户的获益多于低收入租户，而小房东与大房东的损失相同。自住业主的财富也因直接资本化效应和负外部性而显著下降。这些结果为新一轮租金管制法律带来的异质性财富效应提供了首个证据。

records.title_en: The topography of regulatory costs: The shadow cost-gradient of parking standards
records.title_cn: 监管成本的地形：停车标准的影子成本梯度
records.abstract_en: This paper examines the shadow cost of minimum parking requirements (MPRs) for commercial real estate in Los Angeles County. This cost is defined as the difference between a parking space's market value and its combined construction and land costs. To estimate this shadow cost on a property-by-property basis, we use Mixed Geographically Weighted hedonic estimates to determine the value of on-site parking and location-specific parking cost estimates. Our methodology could also be applied to analyze the cost gradients of other zoning regulations, such as height limits and inclusionary housing.
records.abstract_cn: 本文考察了洛杉矶县商业地产最低停车要求（MPRs）的影子成本。该成本定义为停车位的市场价值与其建设和土地成本总和之间的差额。为了在逐个物业的基础上估算这一影子成本，我们使用混合地理加权特征价格估计来确定现场停车和特定位置停车成本估计的价值。我们的方法也可应用于分析其他分区法规的成本梯度，如高度限制和包容性住房。

records.title_en: When the neighbors are watching: Immigrant integration policy and housing wealth
records.title_cn: 当邻居在观望：移民融合政策与住房财富
records.abstract_en: We hypothesize and establish empirically that the effects of migrant integration policies on housing wealth are influenced by public attention to immigration. Using a unique policy converting temporary refugee reception centers into integration facilities, we conduct an event study analysis. Our results show that timing matters: implementation during times of high public attention to immigration reduces housing wealth, while implementation during times of low attention has no impact. These findings suggest that the backlash effect of integration policies estimated in the literature may be driven by public perceptions of migration crises.
records.abstract_cn: 我们假设并实证确立，移民融合政策对住房财富的影响受到公众对移民关注度的影响。利用一项将临时难民接待中心转变为融合设施的独特政策，我们进行了事件研究分析。结果表明，时机至关重要：在公众对移民高度关注时期实施会减少住房财富，而在低关注时期实施则无影响。这些发现表明，文献中估计的融合政策反弹效应可能由公众对移民危机的认知所驱动。

records.title_en: Race and redistribution in the United States: An experimental analysis
records.title_cn: 美国的种族与再分配：一项实验分析
records.abstract_en: Scholars have suggested that White American support for welfare is influenced by their beliefs about the racial composition of welfare recipients. In this paper, we test this hypothesis using two experiments (n=9,775) that induce random variation in participants’ beliefs about the racial distribution of welfare recipients. In both experiments, we obtain evidence that exogenously increasing beliefs about the share of welfare recipients who are Black reduces support for welfare. We also use our experiments to study the effect of ‘priming’ participants to think about race, the accuracy of beliefs about the racial distribution of welfare recipients, and the mechanisms that underpin our results.
records.abstract_cn: 学者们提出，美国白人对福利的支持受到他们对福利领取者种族构成信念的影响。在本文中，我们通过两项实验（n=9,775）检验了这一假设，这些实验随机改变了参与者对福利领取者种族分布的信念。在两项实验中，我们获得的证据表明，外生地增加关于福利领取者中黑人所占比例的信念会降低对福利的支持。我们还利用我们的实验来研究‘启动’参与者思考种族的效果、关于福利领取者种族分布信念的准确性，以及支撑我们结果的机制。

records.title_en: The unequal job security scars of displacement
records.title_cn: 失业冲击带来的不平等就业保障伤痕
records.abstract_en: Segmented labor markets, where stable jobs coexist with insecure, high-turnover positions, make job security key to workers’ long-term outcomes. Using Dutch administrative data, we study the impact of displacement on job security and the role of cash-on-hand. One year after displacement, permanent employment falls by about one-fifth and remains lower five years later, amplifying wage losses: displaced workers who lose job security experience losses 21 % larger than those retaining a permanent contract. Exploiting a policy granting lump-sum transfers only to some displaced workers, we find that eligibility attenuates job security losses and, as a result, wage losses. Effects are larger among liquidity-constrained workers, consistent with binding liquidity constraints. Our findings highlight job security as a key channel through which cash-on-hand reduces the long-run costs of job loss, with implications for the design of unemployment insurance.
records.abstract_cn: 分割的劳动力市场中，稳定工作与不稳定、高流动性的职位并存，使得就业保障成为工人长期结果的关键。利用荷兰行政数据，我们研究了失业冲击对就业保障的影响以及手头现金的作用。失业一年后，永久性就业下降约五分之一，并在五年后仍保持较低水平，从而放大了工资损失：失去就业保障的失业工人所遭受的损失比保留永久合同的工人大21%。利用一项仅向部分失业工人提供一次性转移支付的政策，我们发现资格获取减轻了就业保障损失，并因此减轻了工资损失。在流动性受限的工人中，效应更大，这与流动性约束的约束性一致。我们的发现强调了就业保障是手头现金减少失业长期成本的关键渠道，这对失业保险的设计具有启示意义。

records.title_en: Weather and U.S. railways: risk, adaptation, and congestion
records.title_cn: 天气与美国铁路：风险、适应与拥堵
records.abstract_en: Railway operation is known to be affected by the weather, but the magnitude of these effects has not been estimated at scale. We investigate the effect of weather on U.S. railways using accident and performance data spanning 1997–2022. We find that exposure to temperatures over 86 ∘F (under 5 ∘F) leads to a 9.5% (46%) increase in accidents and a 57% (222%) increase in deaths. Railroads are also adapted to their local climate (with warmer places exhibiting lower sensitivity to heat), learn from prior accidents, and change train speed and throughput in response to weather. Due to the fixed, network nature of railways, we discover that local responses to weather result in a negative externality of propagating delays. Our findings suggest that public funding for rail upgrades may improve both safety and performance.
records.abstract_cn: 众所周知，铁路运营受天气影响，但这些影响的规模尚未在大范围内得到估算。我们利用覆盖1997-2022年的事故和运行数据，研究了天气对美国铁路的影响。我们发现，暴露于超过86华氏度（低于5华氏度）的温度会导致事故增加9.5%（46%），死亡人数增加57%（222%）。铁路也适应了当地气候（较温暖地区对高温的敏感性较低），从以往事故中学习，并根据天气调整列车速度和通过能力。由于铁路的固定网络特性，我们发现对天气的局部响应会导致延误传播的负外部性。我们的研究结果表明，公共资金用于铁路升级可能同时改善安全性和运行表现。

records.title_en: Emergency care centers, hospital performance and population health
records.title_cn: 急救中心、医院绩效与人口健康
records.abstract_en: A core challenge for healthcare systems is ensuring timely care for critical conditions while efficiently managing lower-complexity cases. Hospitals, often overburdened by both, struggle to balance these demands and allocate resources effectively. Many countries have responded by introducing alternative 24/7 facilities to relieve hospital strain and improve patient outcomes, yet evidence on their impact remains limited. We evaluate the introduction of freestanding Emergency Care Centers (UPAs) within Brazil’s publicly funded health system, leveraging rich administrative data. We find that UPAs reduced hospital outpatient procedures by 30% and hospital admissions for ambulatory-sensitive conditions by 24–37%, enabling hospitals to focus on more complex cases, such as surgeries and obstetric admissions, which increased by 25%. We observe a 13% reduction in inpatient mortality, particularly in intensive care and for conditions best suited to hospital treatment. While some deaths were displaced to UPAs, there was a decline in population-level mortality of 1.8%, although this is not statistically significant. Our findings show how an intermediate tier of emergency care reshapes patient sorting, alleviates hospital congestion, and improves hospital performance in an overstretched public health system.
records.abstract_cn: 医疗体系面临的一个核心挑战是确保危重病症得到及时救治，同时高效管理低复杂度病例。医院往往因两者负担过重，难以平衡这些需求并有效分配资源。许多国家通过引入替代性的24/7设施来缓解医院压力并改善患者预后，但关于其影响的证据仍然有限。我们利用丰富的行政数据，评估了巴西公立医疗体系内独立急救中心（UPAs）的引入效果。我们发现，UPAs使医院门诊程序减少了30%，因敏感病症可门诊处理而住院的入院率降低了24-37%，从而使医院能够专注于更复杂的病例，如手术和产科入院，这些增加了25%。我们观察到住院死亡率降低了13%，尤其是在重症监护和最适合医院治疗的病症方面。虽然一些死亡转移到了UPAs，但人口层面的死亡率下降了1.8%，尽管这在统计上不显著。我们的研究结果表明，一个中间层的急救护理如何重塑患者分流，缓解医院拥堵，并在一个超负荷的公共卫生体系中改善医院绩效。

records.title_en: Asylum seekers and the rise in homelessness
records.title_cn: 寻求庇护者与无家可归现象的上升
records.abstract_en: Data from the Department of Housing and Urban Development (HUD) show an unprecedented 43 percent increase in the number of people residing in homeless shelters in the United States between 2022 and 2024, reversing the gradual decline of the preceding sixteen years. Three-quarters of this rise occurred in four localities – New York City, Chicago, Massachusetts, and Denver – where large inflows of new immigrants, many lawfully paroled into the U.S. while seeking asylum, were housed in the homeless shelter system. Using direct estimates from local government sources and indirect methods based on demographic changes, we estimate that new migrant inflows were the primary driver of this dramatic rise, explaining about 59–62 percent of the two-year increase in sheltered homelessness. These estimates challenge narratives that attribute the increase primarily to local economic and housing market conditions and underscore the need to carefully consider population shifts, shelter capacity, and measurement practices when interpreting changes in official homeless counts over time.
records.abstract_cn: 住房和城市发展部（HUD）的数据显示，2022年至2024年间，美国居住在无家可归者收容所的人数出现了前所未有的43%增长，扭转了此前十六年逐步下降的趋势。这一增长的四分之三发生在四个地区——纽约市、芝加哥、马萨诸塞州和丹佛——这些地方大量新移民（其中许多人在寻求庇护时被合法假释进入美国）被安置在无家可归者收容系统中。利用地方政府来源的直接估计和基于人口变化的间接方法，我们估计新移民流入是这一急剧上升的主要驱动因素，解释了收容所无家可归现象两年间增长的约59-62%。这些估计挑战了将增长主要归因于当地经济和住房市场状况的说法，并强调在解读官方无家可归者统计随时间变化时，需要仔细考虑人口流动、收容能力和测量实践。

records.title_en: Human capital, unequal opportunities and productivity convergence: A global historical perspective, 1800–2100
records.title_cn: 人力资本、机会不平等与生产率趋同：一个全球历史视角，1800-2100
records.abstract_en: This paper constructs a new database on public expenditure and revenue and their components, particularly education and health expenditure, covering all world regions over the 1800–2025 period. Human capital expenditure has grown substantially, but with large and persistent inequalities. Public education expenditure per school-age individual in Sub-Saharan Africa is about 3% of the level observed in Europe and North America in 2025 at purchasing power parity, compared to 6% in 1980 and 4% in 1950. Human capital expenditure strongly correlates with productivity growth, especially for public education and in poor countries. Estimated returns from our macro-historical database are around 10%, in line with micro studies. Finally, we present simulations based on illustrative human capital expenditure trajectories over the 2025–2100 period. In particular, we analyze the conditions under which convergence in human capital expenditure could lead to global productivity convergence by 2100.
records.abstract_cn: 本文构建了一个关于公共支出与收入及其组成部分，特别是教育和健康支出的新数据库，覆盖了1800-2025年间所有世界地区。人力资本支出已大幅增长，但存在巨大且持续的不平等。撒哈拉以南非洲地区每个学龄个体的公共教育支出在2025年按购买力平价计算约为欧洲和北美水平的3%，而1980年为6%，1950年为4%。人力资本支出与生产率增长密切相关，尤其是在公共教育和贫困国家中。我们宏观历史数据库的估计回报率约为10%，与微观研究一致。最后，我们基于2025-2100年间说明性的人力资本支出轨迹进行了模拟。特别是，我们分析了在何种条件下，人力资本支出的趋同可能导致到2100年全球生产率的趋同。

records.title_en: Beyond lost earnings: Job displacement and the cost of commuting
records.title_cn: 超越收入损失：工作置换与通勤成本
records.abstract_en: We examine the impact of involuntary job displacement on workers’ commuting behavior and its implications for the overall welfare cost of job loss. Using geo-referenced employee-employer data from Germany (2000–2017), we track workers’ door-to-door commuting and relocation patterns between home and work. After displacement, workers commute 23.1% (3.38 kilometers) farther to new jobs, and the effect diminishes over time due to job changes rather than home relocation. The simultaneous wage and commuting effects suggest that wage differentials across jobs fail to compensate for commuting costs. An on-the-job search model with heterogeneous firm productivity and commuting distance rationalizes the findings, and structural estimates reveal that an average German worker’s commuting costs equal 20.2 euros per day. Hence, longer commutes exacerbate the total cost of job displacement by one-fifth of the wage losses.
records.abstract_cn: 我们研究了非自愿工作置换对工人通勤行为的影响及其对失业总体福利成本的启示。利用德国地理参考的员工-雇主数据（2000-2017年），我们追踪了工人从家到工作的门到门通勤和搬迁模式。置换后，工人通勤距离增加23.1%（3.38公里），且该效应随时间因工作变动而非家庭搬迁而减弱。同时发生的工资和通勤效应表明，不同工作间的工资差异未能补偿通勤成本。一个具有异质性企业生产率和通勤距离的在职搜索模型解释了这些发现，结构估计显示，德国普通工人的通勤成本每天为20.2欧元。因此，更长的通勤使工作置换的总成本增加了工资损失的五分之一。

records.title_en: Political accountability and bureaucratic selection
records.title_cn: 政治问责与官僚选拔
records.abstract_en: The selection of public sector employees is crucial to state effectiveness. Given politicians’ influence on bureaucracies, could political accountability improve bureaucratic selection? Using randomized audits and individual-level data on Brazil’s public sector employees, this paper finds that audits enhance the quality of the bureaucracy. The results are driven by politicians’ increased incentives to perform well in office, stronger recruitment efforts, and a reduction in patronage.
records.abstract_cn: 公共部门雇员的选择对国家效能至关重要。鉴于政治家对官僚机构的影响，政治问责能否改善官僚选拔？利用随机审计和巴西公共部门雇员的个体层面数据，本文发现审计提升了官僚机构的质量。这一结果由政治家在任期内表现良好的激励增强、招聘力度加大以及庇护主义减少所驱动。

records.title_en: Fiscal capacity and capital misallocation: the economic costs of tax evasion
records.title_cn: 财政能力与资本错配：逃税的经济成本
records.abstract_en: This paper examines developing countries’ low administrative capacity to enforce uniform tax rates across space as a driver of capital allocation and a cause of low productivity. We rely on the Golden Tax Project, an information technology reform in China that eliminates the need for local tax-enforcing agencies to verify firm sales and purchases through onsite inspections, as a natural experiment to study the effects of fiscal capacity on firms’ location and capital allocation decisions. Exploiting the heterogeneous shocks that the reform exerts on the fiscal capacity of Chinese counties with different geographic ruggedness, we find that the Golden Tax Project significantly leveled effective tax rates across Chinese counties, which caused capital to relocate out of counties that experienced a bigger fiscal capacity boost after the reform. Such cross-county capital reallocation significantly equalized the marginal product of capital across firms and caused a rightward shift in productivities among them.
records.abstract_cn: 本文考察了发展中国家在空间上执行统一税率的能力低下，作为资本配置的驱动因素和生产率低下的原因。我们利用金税工程——中国的一项信息技术改革，该改革消除了地方税务执行机构通过现场检查来核实企业销售和采购的需要——作为自然实验，研究财政能力对企业选址和资本配置决策的影响。利用改革对不同地理崎岖程度的中国县财政能力产生的异质性冲击，我们发现金税工程显著拉平了中国各县的有效税率，这导致资本从改革后财政能力提升较大的县流出。这种跨县的资本重新配置显著均衡了企业间的资本边际产品，并导致企业生产率分布右移。

records.title_en: Household production time and inequality in material living standards in the U.S., 1965–2018
records.title_cn: 美国家庭生产时间与物质生活水平不平等，1965-2018年
records.abstract_en: We study how unpaid household production shapes trends in inequality in material living standards in the U.S. in the last five decades. We construct extended income and consumption measures that add the imputed value of household production to standard market concepts. Extended income and consumption are consistently more equal than their market counterparts. The imputed value of time devoted to household production has fallen considerably, with proportionately larger impacts on money-poor households. Inequality in extended measures has therefore risen more than for market income and consumption. In other words, the degree to which household production buffers inequality in market resources has fallen over time. This analysis applies a lower-bound replacement cost value to hours of time reported in household production and is robust to the use of different valuation and equivalence scales.
records.abstract_cn: 我们研究了在过去五十年中，无酬家庭生产如何塑造美国物质生活水平不平等的趋势。我们构建了扩展的收入和消费衡量指标，将家庭生产的估算价值添加到标准市场概念中。扩展收入和消费始终比其市场对应指标更为平等。用于家庭生产的时间的估算价值已大幅下降，对货币贫困家庭的影响比例更大。因此，扩展指标的不平等上升幅度超过了市场收入和消费。换言之，家庭生产缓冲市场资源不平等的程度随时间下降。本分析对家庭生产中报告的小时数采用了下限替代成本价值，并且对使用不同的估值和等价尺度的稳健性进行了检验。

records.title_en: Ranking for engagement: How social media algorithms fuel misinformation and polarization
records.title_cn: 参与度排名：社交媒体算法如何助长错误信息与极化
records.abstract_en: Social media are at the center of countless debates on polarization, misinformation, and even the state of democracy in various parts of the world. An essential feature of social media is their recommendation algorithm that determines the ranking of content presented to the users. This paper investigates the dynamic feedback loop between recommendation algorithms and user behavior, and develops a theoretical framework to assess the impact of popularity-based parameters on platform engagement, misinformation, and polarization. The model uncovers a fundamental trade-off: assigning greater weight to online social interactions—such as likes and shares—increases user engagement but also increases misinformation (crowding-out the truth) and polarization. Building on this insight, the analysis considers how a simple “engagement tax” on social interactions can mitigate these negative externalities by altering platform incentives in the design of profit-maximizing algorithms. The framework is extended to include personalized rankings, demonstrating that personalization further amplifies polarization. Finally, empirical evidence from survey data in Italy and the United States indicates that Facebook’s 2018 “Meaningful Social Interactions” update—which increased the emphasis on certain engagement metrics—contributed to increased ideological extremism and affective polarization.
records.abstract_cn: 社交媒体处于关于极化、错误信息乃至世界各地民主状况的无数辩论的中心。社交媒体的一个基本特征是其推荐算法，该算法决定了呈现给用户的内容排名。本文研究了推荐算法与用户行为之间的动态反馈循环，并构建了一个理论框架来评估基于流行度的参数对平台参与度、错误信息和极化的影响。该模型揭示了一个基本权衡：赋予在线社交互动（如点赞和分享）更大的权重会增加用户参与度，但也会增加错误信息（排挤真相）和极化。基于这一见解，分析考虑了如何通过对社交互动征收简单的“参与税”来减轻这些负面外部性，通过改变平台在设计利润最大化算法时的激励。该框架扩展到包括个性化排名，表明个性化进一步加剧了极化。最后，来自意大利和美国的调查数据的实证证据表明，Facebook的2018“有意义的社交互动”更新——该更新增加了对某些参与度指标的重视——导致了意识形态极端主义和情感极化的加剧。

records.title_en: Climate coalitions with sophisticated policy makers
records.title_cn: 具有成熟政策制定者的气候联盟
records.abstract_en: We study the formation of international climate coalitions among sophisticated policymakers. They strategically predict the consequences of their membership decisions in climate negotiations and use an integrated assessment model of the economy and the climate in their decision-making. We analytically characterise the equilibrium number of coalitions and their number of signatories with certain types of heterogeneity. The special structure of our model drastically reduces the computational complexity of coalition formation with heterogeneous countries. We also numerically investigate possible coalition outcomes for a calibrated model with an exhaustible and an inexhaustible energy sector. In contrast to earlier approaches to coalition formation based on internal and external stability, much larger coalitions can be sustained in equilibrium alongside smaller ones. Sophisticated policymakers thus lead to greater mitigation of global warming.
records.abstract_cn: 我们研究了成熟政策制定者之间国际气候联盟的形成。他们战略性地预测其在气候谈判中成员资格决定的后果，并在决策中使用经济与气候的综合评估模型。我们在某些类型的异质性下，解析性地刻画了联盟的均衡数量及其签署国数量。我们模型的特殊结构大幅降低了异质性国家间联盟形成的计算复杂度。我们还对一个包含可耗竭和不可耗竭能源部门的校准模型进行了数值研究，探讨可能的联盟结果。与早期基于内部和外部稳定性的联盟形成方法相比，均衡中可以维持更大的联盟，同时也有较小的联盟存在。因此，成熟的政策制定者会导致更大程度的全球变暖减缓。

records.title_en: The Value of Ratings: Evidence from Their Introduction in Securities Markets
records.title_cn: 评级的价值：来自证券市场引入的证据
records.abstract_en: We study the first-ever ratings for corporate securities. In 1909, John Moody published a book that partitioned the majority of listed railroad bonds into letter-graded ratings. These ratings had no regulatory implications and were largely explainable using publicly available information.
