We find that lower-than-market-implied ratings caused a rise in secondary market bond yields and that bonds that were rated experienced a substantial decline in their bid-ask spreads, consistent with reduced information asymmetries and improved liquidity. Our findings suggest that ratings can improve information transmission and highlight their potential value for the functioning of financial markets.
records.abstract_cn: 我们研究有史以来的公司证券评级。在1909，约翰·穆迪出版了一本书，将大多数上市铁路债券划分为字母评级。这些评级没有监管影响，并且在很大程度上可以使用公开信息进行解释。我们发现，低于市场的隐含评级导致二级市场债券收益率上升，并且评级债券的买卖价差大幅下降，这与信息不对称的减少和流动性的改善相一致。我们的研究结果表明，评级可以改善信息传递并突显其对金融市场运作的潜在价值。

records.title_en: Mandated versus Voluntary Adaptation to Natural Disasters: The Case of US Wildfires
records.title_cn: 自然灾害的强制适应与自愿适应：以美国野火为例
records.abstract_en: Despite escalating losses in climate-related disasters, adoption of protective technologies and behaviors is limited by risk misperception, externalities, and insurance market frictions. One response to these market failures is to mandate these investments. We measure the effect of California’s wildfire building codes on own and neighboring structure survival using comprehensive data on US homes exposed to wildfires since 2000. Differences across jurisdictions and vintages reveal remarkable resilience effects of building codes. Codes also increase survival of neighboring homes by reducing structure-to-structure spread. We then develop and estimate a model of social benefits of mandatory building standards versus other adaptation policies.
records.abstract_cn: 尽管气候相关灾害造成的损失不断增加，但保护性技术和行为的采用仍受到风险误解、外部性和保险市场摩擦的限制。 一对这些市场失灵的反应是强制进行这些投资。我们使用自2000以来暴露于野火的美国房屋的综合数据来衡量加州野火建筑规范对自身和邻近结构生存的影响。不同司法管辖区和年份的差异揭示了建筑规范显着的弹性效应。规范还可以通过减少结构间的扩散来提高邻近房屋的生存率。然后，我们开发并评估强制性建筑标准与其他适应政策的社会效益模型。

records.title_en: Endogenous Treatment Models with Social Interactions: An Application to the Impact of Exercise on Self-Esteem
records.title_cn: 具有社会互动的内源性治疗模型：运动对自尊影响的应用
records.abstract_en: We address the estimation of endogenous treatment models with social interactions in both the treatment and outcome equations. We model the interactions between individuals via a game theoretic approach based on discrete Bayesian games. We employ a nested pseudo joint likelihood algorithm when obtaining the model’s parameters and provide relevant treatment effects and procedures for their estimation. Our empirical application examines the impact of an individual’s exercise frequency on their level of self-esteem. We find that an individual’s exercise frequency is influenced by their expectation of their friends’ exercise frequency. Moreover, an individual’s level of self-esteem is affected by their level of exercise and, at relatively lower levels of self-esteem, by the expectation of their friends’ self-esteem.
records.abstract_cn: 我们通过治疗和结果方程中的社会相互作用来估计内源性治疗模型。我们通过基于离散贝叶斯博弈的博弈论方法对个体之间的交互进行建模。我们在获取模型参数时采用嵌套伪联合似然算法，并提供相关的治疗效果和估计过程。我们的实证应用研究了个人的锻炼频率对其自尊水平的影响。我们发现一个人的锻炼频率受到他们对朋友锻炼频率的期望的影响。此外，一个人的自尊水平受到锻炼水平的影响，在自尊水平相对较低的情况下，还会受到朋友自尊期望的影响。

records.title_en: Making Information More Valuable
records.title_cn: 让信息更有价值
records.abstract_en: We study what changes to an agent’s decision problem increase her value for information. We prove that information becomes more valuable if and only if the agent’s reduced-form payoff in her belief becomes more convex. When the transformation corresponds to the addition of an action, the requisite increase in convexity occurs if and only if a simple geometric condition holds, which extends in a natural way to the addition of multiple actions. We apply these findings to two scenarios: a monopolistic screening problem in which the good is information and delegation with information acquisition.
records.abstract_cn: 我们研究代理人决策问题的哪些变化会增加她的信息价值。我们证明，当且仅当代理人的信念的简化形式回报变得更加凸时，信息才会变得更有价值。当变换对应于添加一个动作时，当且仅当一个简单的几何条件成立时，才会发生必要的凸性增加，该几何条件以自然的方式延伸到多个动作的添加。我们将这些发现应用于二场景：垄断筛选问题，其中商品是信息和信息获取的授权。

records.title_en: Automation and Polarization
records.title_cn: 自动化和两极分化
records.abstract_en: We develop an assignment model of automation. Each of a continuum of tasks of variable complexity is assigned to either capital or one of a continuum of labor skills. We characterize conditions for interior automation, whereby tasks of intermediate complexity are performed by capital. Interior automation arises when low-skill wages are low and effective cost of capital in low-complexity tasks is high. Minimum wages make interior automation less likely. Higher capital productivity causes employment and wage polarization, changes the skill premium nonmonotonically, and reduces the real wage of workers with comparative advantage profiles close to that of capital.
records.abstract_cn: 我们开发了自动化分配模型。每个复杂程度各异的连续任务都被分配给资本或一连续的劳动技能。我们描述了内部自动化的条件，其中中等复杂性的任务由资本执行。当低技能工资较低且低复杂性任务的有效资本成本较高时，内部自动化就会出现。最低工资降低了室内自动化的可能性。较高的资本生产率会导致就业和工资两极分化，非单调地改变技能溢价，并降低具有接近资本比较优势的工人的实际工资。

records.title_en: Estimation of common factors for microstructure noise and efficient price in a high-frequency dual factor model
records.title_cn: 高频双因子模型中微观结构噪声与有效价格的共同因子估计
records.abstract_en: We develop the Double Principal Component Analysis (DPCA) based on a dual factor structure for high-frequency intraday returns contaminated with microstructure noise. The dual factor structure allows a factor structure for microstructure noise in addition to the factor structure for efficient log-prices. We construct estimators of factors for both efficient log-prices and microstructure noise as well as their common components, and provide uniform consistency of these estimators when the number of assets and the sampling frequency go to infinity. In a Monte Carlo exercise, we compare our DPCA method to a PCA-VECM method. Finally, an empirical analysis of intraday returns of S&P 500 Index constituents provides evidence of co-movement of the microstructure noise that distinguishes from latent systematic risk factors.
records.abstract_cn: 我们基于高频日内收益的双因子结构，开发了双主成分分析（DPCA），该收益受到微观结构噪声的污染。双因子结构允许微观结构噪声具有因子结构，此外有效对数价格也具有因子结构。我们构建了有效对数价格和微观结构噪声的因子估计量及其共同成分，并在资产数量和采样频率趋于无穷时提供了这些估计量的一致一致性。在蒙特卡洛实验中，我们将DPCA方法与PCA-VECM方法进行了比较。最后，对标准普尔500指数成分股日内收益的实证分析提供了微观结构噪声共同运动的证据，这区别于潜在的系统性风险因子。

records.title_en: Robust estimation of integrated and spot volatility
records.title_cn: 积分波动率与瞬时波动率的稳健估计
records.abstract_en: We introduce a new method to estimate the integrated volatility (IV) and the spot volatility (SV) based on noisy high-frequency data. Our method employs the ReMeDI approach introduced by Li and Linton (2022) to estimate the moments of microstructure noise and thereby eliminate their influence, and the pre-averaging method to target the volatility parameter. The method is robust: it can be applied when the efficient price exhibits stochastic volatility and jumps, the observation times are random, and the noise process is nonstationary, autocorrelated, asymptotically vanishing and dependent on the efficient price. We derive the limit distributions for the proposed estimators under the infill asymptotics in a general setting. Our extensive simulation studies demonstrate the robustness, accuracy and computational efficiency of our estimators compared to several alternative estimators recently proposed in the literature. Empirically, we show that neglecting the complexities of noise and the random observation times generates substantial biases in volatility estimation and may yield a different intraday volatility pattern.
records.abstract_cn: 我们提出了一种基于含噪高频数据估计积分波动率（IV）和瞬时波动率（SV）的新方法。该方法采用Li和Linton（2022）提出的ReMeDI方法估计微观结构噪声的矩，从而消除其影响，并采用预平均方法针对波动率参数。该方法具有稳健性：当有效价格呈现随机波动率和跳跃、观测时间随机、噪声过程非平稳、自相关、渐近消失且依赖于有效价格时，均可适用。我们在一般设定下推导了所提估计量在填充渐近下的极限分布。我们广泛的模拟研究表明，与文献中近期提出的几种替代估计量相比，我们的估计量具有稳健性、准确性和计算效率。在实证中，我们表明忽略噪声的复杂性和随机观测时间会在波动率估计中产生显著偏差，并可能得出不同的日内波动率模式。

records.title_en: Intraday volatility patterns from short-dated options
records.title_cn: 短期期权中的日内波动率模式
records.abstract_en: We propose a nonparametric estimator for the deterministic periodic component of volatility from short-dated options within an in-fill asymptotic setting. The estimator uses options with zero and one day to expiration sampled at high-frequency during a trading day. At each point in time, we aggregate the options to form nonparametric estimates of conditional risk-neutral expectations of future integrated return variation for the two available option tenors. A suitable ratio of these estimates removes the stochastic components of the conditional expectations of future volatility, up to asymptotically higher-order terms, and allows to form estimates of the deterministic periodic component of volatility. We derive a Central Limit Theorem for the estimator, with its rate of convergence determined from the mesh of the strike grid and the length of the time to expiration of the options. The newly-developed estimation procedure is applied to S&P 500 index options data.
records.abstract_cn: 我们提出了一种在填充渐近框架下，利用短期期权估计波动率确定性周期成分的非参数估计器。该估计器使用交易日内高频采样的到期日为零天和一天的期权。在每个时间点，我们汇总期权，以形成对两种可用期权期限的未来积分收益变动的条件风险中性预期的非参数估计。这些估计的适当比率消除了未来波动率条件预期中的随机成分，直至渐近高阶项，并允许形成波动率确定性周期成分的估计。我们推导了该估计器的中心极限定理，其收敛速率由执行价格网格的间距和期权到期时间的长度决定。新开发的估计程序应用于S&P 500指数期权数据。

records.title_en: Robust realized integrated beta estimator with application to dynamic analysis of integrated beta
records.title_cn: 稳健的实现综合贝塔估计器及其在综合贝塔动态分析中的应用
records.abstract_en: In this paper, we develop a robust non-parametric realized integrated beta estimator using high-frequency financial data contaminated by microstructure noise, which is robust to the stylized features, such as the time-varying beta and the price-dependent and autocorrelated microstructure noise. With this robust realized integrated beta estimator, we investigate dynamic structures of integrated betas and find a persistent autoregressive structure. To model this dynamic structure, we utilize the autoregressive–moving-average (ARMA) model for daily integrated market betas. We call this the dynamic realized beta (DR Beta). Then, we propose a quasi-likelihood procedure for estimating the parameters of the ARMA model with the robust realized integrated beta estimator as the proxy. We establish asymptotic theorems for the proposed estimator and conduct a simulation study to check the performance of finite samples of the estimator. The proposed DR Beta model with the robust realized beta estimator is also illustrated by using data from the E-mini S&P 500 index futures and the top 50 large trading volume stocks from the S&P 500 and an application to constructing market-neutral portfolios.
records.abstract_cn: 在本文中，我们开发了一种稳健的非参数实现综合贝塔估计器，使用受微观结构噪声污染的高频金融数据，该估计器对诸如时变贝塔和价格依赖及自相关的微观结构噪声等典型特征具有稳健性。利用这一稳健的实现综合贝塔估计器，我们研究了综合贝塔的动态结构，并发现了一种持久的自回归结构。为了建模这一动态结构，我们利用自回归移动平均（ARMA）模型对日度综合市场贝塔进行建模，称之为动态实现贝塔（DR Beta）。然后，我们提出了一种拟似然程序，以稳健的实现综合贝塔估计器作为代理来估计ARMA模型的参数。我们为所提出的估计器建立了渐近定理，并进行了模拟研究以检验估计器在有限样本下的表现。所提出的DR Beta模型与稳健的实现贝塔估计器还通过使用E-mini S&P 500指数期货和S&P 500中交易量最大的前50只股票的数据以及构建市场中性投资组合的应用进行了说明。

records.title_en: High dimensional regression coefficient test with high frequency data
records.title_cn: 高频数据的高维回归系数检验
records.abstract_en: This paper presents the first study on high-dimensional regression coefficient tests with high-frequency financial data. These tests allow the number of regressors to be larger than the number of observations within each estimation block and can grow to infinity in asymptotics. In this paper, the sum-type test and max-type test have been proposed, where the former is suitable for the dense alternative (many small betas) and the latter is suitable for the sparse alternative (a very small number of large betas). By showing the asymptotic independence between the sum-type test and max-type test, the paper proposes a third test – Fisher’s combination test, which is robust to both dense and sparse alternatives. The paper derives the limiting null distributions of the three proposed tests and analyzes the asymptotic behavior of their powers. Monte Carlo simulations demonstrate the validity of the theoretical results developed in this paper. Empirical study shows the impact of high frequency (HF) factors when being added to a Fama–French-style factor model. We found that the HF effects are time varying. The proposed tests can help identify those time periods when the HF factors carry (significant) incremental information for the test asset. Our tests could shed light on market timing in a trading strategy.
records.abstract_cn: 本文首次提出了利用高频金融数据进行高维回归系数检验的研究。这些测试允许回归量的数量大于每个估计块内的观测值的数量，并且可以渐进地增长到无穷大。本文提出了sum-type test和max-type test，前者适用于密集替代（许多小贝塔），后者适用于稀疏替代（极少数大贝塔）。通过展示求和型检验和最大型检验之间的渐近独立性，本文提出了第三种检验——Fisher 组合检验，该检验对于密集和稀疏替代方案都具有鲁棒性。本文推导了所提出的三个检验的极限零分布，并分析了它们幂的渐近行为。蒙特卡洛模拟证明了本文理论结果的有效性。实证研究显示了高频 (HF) 因素添加到 Fama-French 式因素模型中时的影响。我们发现高频效应是随时间变化的。所提出的测试可以帮助识别 HF 因子携带测试资产（重要）增量信息的时间段。我们的测试可以揭示交易策略中的市场时机。

records.title_en: Realized drift
records.title_cn: 已实现漂移
records.abstract_en: Drift and volatility are two mainsprings of asset price dynamics. While volatilities have been studied extensively in the literature, drifts are commonly believed to be impossible to estimate and largely ignored in the literature. This paper shows how to detect drift using realized autocovariance implemented on high-frequency data. We use a theoretical treatment in which the classical model for the efficient price, an Itō semimartingale possibly contaminated by microstructure noise, is enriched with drift and volatility explosions. Our theory advocates a novel decomposition for realized variance into a drift and a volatility component, which leads to significant improvements in volatility forecasting.
records.abstract_cn: 漂移和波动性是资产价格动态的两个主要驱动力。尽管波动性在文献中已被广泛研究，但漂移通常被认为无法估计，并在文献中很大程度上被忽视。本文展示了如何利用高频数据上的已实现自协方差来检测漂移。我们采用理论处理方法，其中有效价格的经典模型——一个可能受微观结构噪声污染的伊藤半鞅——被赋予了漂移和波动性爆发。我们的理论倡导一种新的分解方法，将已实现方差分解为漂移和波动性成分，这导致了波动性预测的显著改进。

records.title_en: BUMVU estimators
records.title_cn: BUMVU估计量
records.abstract_en: We provide necessary and sufficient conditions for an (Unbiased) Block estimator to have Uniformly Minimum Variance. Our theory parallels the theory of UMVU estimation, the main novel insight being the focus on the covariance among blocks. We use this theory to derive lower variance bounds for block estimators of functionals of high-frequency volatility when the block size is fixed. We further show the relevance of the new theory for the classical problem of estimation of homoskedastic nonparametric regressions with varying mean. Finally, we introduce a new test for the presence of drift in financial data which exploits the precision of BUMVU estimators. The test shows abundant presence of drift in financial data.
records.abstract_cn: 我们提供了（无偏）块估计量具有一致最小方差性的充分必要条件。我们的理论与UMVU估计理论相平行，主要的新见解在于关注块间的协方差。我们利用这一理论推导了当块大小固定时，高频波动率泛函的块估计量的较低方差界。我们进一步展示了新理论对于具有变化均值的同方差非参数回归经典估计问题的相关性。最后，我们引入了一种新的检验方法，用于检测金融数据中漂移的存在，该方法利用了BUMVU估计量的精确性。该检验显示金融数据中漂移现象普遍存在。

records.title_en: Probability distributions for realized covariance measures
records.title_cn: 已实现协方差测度的概率分布
records.abstract_en: Realized covariance measures (RCs) are an essential input for assessing the risks of different investment allocations. Thus, it is useful to model and forecast them. To this end, a realistic distributional assumption is needed. In this paper, we compare all probability distributions that have so far in the literature been applied to time-series of RCs. We derive them in a unified framework based on their stochastic representations using random lower and upper triangular matrices. These matrices are composed of standard normal distributions in the off-diagonal elements and χ-distributions on the diagonals (Barlett matrices). Furthermore, we derive a novel family of probability distributions (the t-Riesz distribution family), which has a property we call tail-homogeneity. This property means that in crisis periods, i.e. large RCs, our distribution family realistically assumes high dependence between the individual entries of the RCs. We show theoretically how all the distributions differ from each other, and how they are related to each other. In the empirical part, we demonstrate how the theoretical differences translate into differences in fit and forecasting performance. We show that our novel distribution family achieves the best fit. Out-of-sample forecasting comparisons further corroborate the excellent performance of our novel distribution family.
records.abstract_cn: 已实现协方差测度（RCs）是评估不同投资配置风险的重要输入。因此，对它们进行建模和预测是有用的。为此，需要一个现实的分布假设。在本文中，我们比较了迄今为止文献中应用于RCs时间序列的所有概率分布。我们基于它们的随机表示，在一个统一框架中推导出这些分布，使用随机下三角和上三角矩阵。这些矩阵由非对角线元素的标准正态分布和对角线上的χ分布组成（巴特利特矩阵）。此外，我们推导了一个新的概率分布族（t-Riesz分布族），它具有我们称之为尾部同质性的性质。这个性质意味着在危机时期，即大的RCs，我们的分布族现实地假设RCs各个条目之间存在高依赖性。我们从理论上展示了所有分布之间的差异以及它们之间的相互关系。在实证部分，我们展示了理论差异如何转化为拟合和预测性能的差异。我们表明，我们的新分布族实现了最佳拟合。样本外预测比较进一步证实了我们新分布族的优异性能。

records.title_en: A multivariate realized GARCH model
records.title_cn: 多元已实现GARCH模型
records.abstract_en: We propose a novel class of multivariate GARCH models that incorporate realized measures of volatility and correlations. The key innovation is an unconstrained vector parametrization of the conditional correlation matrix, which enables the use of factor models for correlations. This approach elegantly addresses the main challenge faced by multivariate GARCH models in high-dimensional settings. As an illustration, we explore block correlation matrices that naturally simplify to linear factor models for the conditional correlations. The model is applied to the returns of nine assets, and its in-sample and out-of-sample performance compares favorably against several popular benchmarks.
records.abstract_cn: 我们提出了一类新颖的多元GARCH模型，该模型融入了波动率和相关性的已实现度量。关键创新在于对条件相关矩阵采用无约束向量参数化，这使得能够使用因子模型来刻画相关性。这种方法优雅地解决了多元GARCH模型在高维设置中所面临的主要挑战。作为示例，我们探讨了块相关矩阵，其自然简化为条件相关性的线性因子模型。该模型应用于九种资产的收益，其样本内和样本外表现优于几种流行的基准模型。

records.title_en: Bespoke realized volatility: Tailored measures of risk for volatility prediction
records.title_cn: 定制已实现波动率：针对波动率预测的定制风险度量
records.abstract_en: Standard realized volatility (RV) measures estimate the latent volatility of an asset price using high frequency data with no reference to how or where the estimate will subsequently be used. This paper presents methods for “tailoring” the estimate of volatility to the application in which it will be used. For example, if the volatility measure will be used in a specific parametric forecasting model, it may be possible to exploit that knowledge to construct a better measure of volatility. We use methods from machine learning to estimate optimal “bespoke” RVs for heterogeneous autoregressive (HAR) and GARCH-X forecasting applications. We apply the methods to 886 U.S. stock returns and find that bespoke RVs significantly improve out-of-sample forecast performance. We find that, across a variety of volatility models, the bespoke RV places more weight on data from the end of the trade day, and that the optimal bespoke weights can be well-approximated by a simple parametric function.
records.abstract_cn: 标准的已实现波动率（RV）度量使用高频数据估计资产价格的潜在波动率，而不考虑该估计随后将如何或在哪里使用。本文提出了针对其将被用于的应用场景“定制”波动率估计的方法。例如，如果波动率度量将用于特定的参数预测模型，那么利用这一知识来构建更好的波动率度量可能是可行的。我们使用机器学习方法为异质自回归（HAR）和GARCH-X预测应用估计最优的“定制”RV。我们将这些方法应用于886只美国股票收益，并发现定制RV显著提高了样本外预测性能。我们发现，在各种波动率模型中，定制RV对交易日结束时的数据赋予了更大的权重，并且最优定制权重可以很好地通过一个简单的参数函数来近似。

records.title_en: Efficient sampling for realized variance estimation in time-changed diffusion models
records.title_cn: 时间变换扩散模型中实现方差估计的高效抽样
records.abstract_en: This paper analyzes the benefits of sampling intraday returns in intrinsic time for the realized variance (RV) estimator. We theoretically show in finite samples that depending on the permitted sampling information, the RV estimator is most efficient under either hitting time sampling that samples whenever the price changes by a pre-determined threshold, or under the new concept of realized business time that samples according to a combination of observed trades and estimated tick variance. The analysis builds on the assumption that asset prices follow a diffusion that is time-changed with a jump process that separately models the transaction times. This provides a flexible model that allows for leverage specifications and Hawkes-type jump processes and separately captures the empirically varying trading intensity and tick variance processes, which are particularly relevant for disentangling the driving forces of the sampling schemes. Extensive simulations confirm our theoretical results and show that for low levels of noise, hitting time sampling remains superior while for increasing noise levels, realized business time becomes the empirically most efficient sampling scheme. An application to stock data provides empirical evidence for the benefits of using these intrinsic sampling schemes to construct more efficient RV estimators as well as for an improved forecast performance.
records.abstract_cn: 本文分析了在内在时间中对日内收益进行抽样对实现方差（RV）估计器的益处。我们在理论上证明，在有限样本中，根据允许的抽样信息，RV估计器在以下两种情况下最为有效：一是当价格变动达到预定阈值时进行抽样的击中时间抽样，二是根据观测交易和估计的跳动方差组合进行抽样的新概念——实现业务时间。该分析基于资产价格遵循一个由跳跃过程进行时间变换的扩散过程，该跳跃过程分别对交易时间进行建模。这提供了一个灵活的模型，允许杠杆设定和霍克斯型跳跃过程，并分别捕捉经验上变化的交易强度和跳动方差过程，这对于区分抽样方案的驱动因素尤为重要。大量模拟证实了我们的理论结果，并表明在低噪声水平下，击中时间抽样仍然优越，而在噪声水平增加时，实现业务时间成为经验上最有效的抽样方案。对股票数据的应用提供了经验证据，表明使用这些内在抽样方案构建更有效的RV估计器以及改善预测性能的益处。

records.title_en: FX futures invariance
records.title_cn: 外汇期货不变性
records.abstract_en: We develop and empirically examine a novel intraday invariance relation among trading activity variables across a set of currencies in the foreign exchange (FX) futures market exploiting tick level data. Our Trading Invariance (TI) hypothesis reflects an equilibrium involving trade-offs between the risk per trade versus market liquidity as captured by the bid-ask spread and market depth. We observe exogenous breaks in the trading costs for many of the currencies, as the exchange lowered the tick size for individual contracts at different points in time. Using these incidents as quasi-natural experiments, we confirm that the remaining components of the TI hypothesis adjust to maintain the equilibrium by shifts in the trading intensity and market depth. In contrast, alternative invariance relations fail dramatically when confronted with this type of exogenous shock. We further confirm that the values of key coefficients in the TI relation are similar across assets and in good correspondence with the theoretically predicted values. Our results point towards a fundamental equilibrium mechanism that should be accommodated within existing market microstructure paradigms. Moreover, they have direct implications for market design and surveillance.
records.abstract_cn: 我们利用逐笔数据，对外汇（FX）期货市场中一组货币的交易活动变量之间的一种新颖的日内不变性关系进行了发展和实证检验。我们的交易不变性（TI）假说反映了一种均衡，涉及每笔交易的风险与市场流动性（以买卖价差和市场深度衡量）之间的权衡。我们观察到许多货币的交易成本存在外生断裂，因为交易所不同时间点降低了单个合约的跳动点大小。利用这些事件作为准自然实验，我们确认TI假说的其余组成部分通过交易强度和市场深度的变化来调整以维持均衡。相比之下，替代性不变性关系在面对这种外生冲击时则彻底失效。我们进一步确认，TI关系中关键系数的值在不同资产间相似，并与理论预测值良好对应。我们的结果指向一种基本的均衡机制，该机制应被纳入现有的市场微观结构范式中。此外，它们对市场设计和监管具有直接意义。

records.title_en: Reprint of: Nonparametric estimation for high-frequency data incorporating trading information
records.title_cn: 重印：结合交易信息的高频数据非参数估计
records.abstract_en: We propose nonparametric estimators for the explicative part of the noise in a model where the market microstructure noise is an unknown function of the trading information while allowing for the presence of an additional residual noise component. Our method allows for dependence in the observable trading information and accommodates the presence of infinite variation jumps in the efficient price process. We establish the convergence and asymptotic normality of the proposed estimators. We also propose a two-step Laplace estimator of integrated volatility where we replace the observed price with the estimated price by removing the explicative part of the market microstructure noise. The finite sample properties of both the nonparametric estimators and the two-step Laplace estimator are examined through Monte Carlo simulations. We find that our method is robust to misspecification of the unknown functional form given finite sample size. Furthermore, an empirical application using high-frequency data demonstrates that our method outperforms commonly employed parametric methods.
records.abstract_cn: 我们提出了非参数估计量，用于模型中噪声的解释部分，其中市场微观结构噪声是交易信息的未知函数，同时允许存在额外的残余噪声成分。我们的方法允许可观测交易信息中的依赖性，并适应有效价格过程中无限变差跳跃的存在。我们建立了所提出估计量的收敛性和渐近正态性。我们还提出了一种两步拉普拉斯积分波动率估计量，其中我们用估计价格替换观测价格，通过去除市场微观结构噪声的解释部分。通过蒙特卡洛模拟检验了非参数估计量和两步拉普拉斯估计量的有限样本性质。我们发现，在有限样本量下，我们的方法对未知函数形式的错误设定具有稳健性。此外，使用高频数据的实证应用表明，我们的方法优于常用的参数方法。

records.title_en: Testing for jumps in a discretely observed price process with endogenous sampling times
records.title_cn: 离散观测价格过程中内生抽样时间下的跳跃检验
records.abstract_en: This paper introduces a novel nonparametric high-frequency jump test for discretely observed Itô semimartingales. Based on observations sampled recursively at first exit times from a symmetric double barrier, our method distinguishes between threshold exceedances caused by the Brownian component and jumps, which enables the construction of a feasible, noise-robust statistical test. Simulation results demonstrate superior finite-sample performance of our test compared to existing methods. An empirical analysis of NYSE-traded stocks provides clear statistical evidence for jumps, with the results highly robust to spurious detections.
records.abstract_cn: 本文针对离散观测的Itô半鞅引入了一种新颖的非参数高频跳跃检验。基于在对称双障碍的首次退出时间递归抽样的观测值，我们的方法区分由布朗成分引起的阈值超越和跳跃，从而能够构建一个可行且对噪声稳健的统计检验。模拟结果表明，与现有方法相比，我们的检验具有优越的有限样本性能。对纽交所上市股票的实证分析提供了跳跃的明确统计证据，且结果对虚假检测高度稳健。

records.title_en: Professional survey forecasts and expectations in DSGE models
records.title_cn: 专业调查预测与DSGE模型中的预期
records.abstract_en: This paper proposes a strategy to exploit timely information from survey data to disentangle the effects of persistent and transitory shocks driving the real business cycle in DSGE models. Enhanced identification of fundamental shocks leads to significant improvement in the model’s fit. We also examine how structural models with alternative expectation formation mechanisms can address the limitations in information processing often observed in surveys. Our analysis shows that Rational Expectations model with observed survey data generates predictable forecast errors, inheriting this property from survey expectations. We emphasize an important role of the time-varying propagation mechanism under learning, which reduces the constrains imposed by the complete rationality assumption and allows for more efficient integration of surveys in macro models.
records.abstract_cn: 本文提出了一种策略，利用调查数据中的及时信息来区分在DSGE模型中驱动实际商业周期的持久性和暂时性冲击的影响。基本冲击识别的增强导致模型拟合度的显著提高。我们还考察了具有替代预期形成机制的结构模型如何解决调查中常观察到的信息处理局限性。我们的分析表明，带有观测调查数据的理性预期模型会产生可预测的预测误差，这一特性源自调查预期。我们强调了学习机制下时变传播机制的重要作用，它减少了完全理性假设所施加的限制，并允许在宏观模型中更有效地整合调查数据。

records.title_en: The housing wealth effect: Quasi-experimental evidence
records.title_cn: 住房财富效应：准实验证据
records.abstract_en: Empirical studies have estimated a large range of consumption responses to changes in housing prices. Using a quasi-experiment, we estimate a shock of −19.4 percent to single-family house prices in the area surrounding an airport in Stockholm after its operations were unexpectedly continued as a result of political bargaining behind closed doors. Using a household data set with information on the locations of primary residences relative to the airport, we find a short-run elasticity with respect to new car purchases of 0.28, corresponding to a one-year marginal propensity for expenditure on cars (car MPX) of 0.09 cents per dollar lost in housing wealth. Households with high loan-to-value ratios and small bank deposits respond the most. A quantitative model aligns with our empirical findings but also suggests that the car MPX could be 0.31 cents when used cars are included; of this, 73 percent is explained by a collateral channel. When nondurables are accounted for, the total marginal propensity to spend is 2.1 cents. In the case of an absolute fall in housing prices, the total response is four times greater.
records.abstract_cn: 实证研究估计了消费对房价变化的反应范围很大。利用一项准实验，我们估计了斯德哥尔摩机场周边地区独栋住宅价格在机场运营因幕后政治谈判而意外继续后受到的−19.4%冲击。利用包含主要住宅相对于机场位置信息的家庭数据集，我们发现新车购买对房价的短期弹性为0.28，对应于一年内因住房财富损失而用于汽车支出的边际倾向（汽车MPX）为每美元损失0.09美分。贷款价值比高且银行存款少的家庭反应最大。一个定量模型与我们的实证结果一致，但也表明当包含二手车时，汽车MPX可能为0.31美分；其中，73%由抵押品渠道解释。当计入非耐用品时，总边际消费倾向为2.1美分。在房价绝对下跌的情况下，总反应是其四倍。

records.title_en: An endogenous gridpoint method for distributional dynamics
records.title_cn: 分布动态的内生网格点方法
records.abstract_en: Modeling continuous choices in heterogeneous agent models as “lotteries” over a discretized state space is standard practice (Young, 2010), but renders the distributional dynamics linear in optimal policies. We present a novel, simple method that captures nonlinearities and solves the distributional dynamics with interpolation instead of integration using the idea of an endogenous grid. Our approach solves for a stationary equilibrium as quickly as the lottery method for a given precision, outperforms it for linear dynamics, and accommodates nonlinear dynamics and aggregate risk. We demonstrate its efficacy by studying a model with aggregate investment risk with a third-order perturbation solution.
records.abstract_cn: 在异质性主体模型中，将连续选择建模为离散状态空间上的“彩票”是标准做法（Young, 2010），但这使得分布动态在最优策略下呈线性。我们提出了一种新颖、简单的方法，该方法捕捉非线性，并利用内生网格的思想，通过插值而非积分来求解分布动态。我们的方法在给定精度下，求解稳态均衡的速度与彩票方法相当，在线性动态中表现更优，并能适应非线性动态和总体风险。我们通过研究一个具有总体投资风险的模型，并采用三阶扰动解，证明了其有效性。

records.title_en: The timing of shocks matters in optimal monetary policy
records.title_cn: 冲击时机在最优货币政策中的重要性
records.abstract_en: This study explores optimal monetary policy in an economy with seasonal wage staggering. The findings reveal that the slope of the Phillips curve and the weights in the welfare loss function systematically differ by quarter. Consequently, optimal policy responses vary depending on the timing of shocks within a calendar year. However, implementing history-dependent policy rules can effectively mitigate much of the welfare deterioration that would otherwise occur when policymakers fail to adopt these quarter-specific optimal policy responses.
records.abstract_cn: 本研究探讨了在季节性工资交错的经济中的最优货币政策。研究结果显示，菲利普斯曲线的斜率以及福利损失函数中的权重按季度系统性不同。因此，最优政策反应取决于冲击在日历年内发生的时机。然而，实施历史依赖的政策规则可以有效缓解当政策制定者未能采用这些季度特定的最优政策反应时可能出现的福利恶化的大部分。

records.title_en: Motivating banks to lend? Credit spillover effects of the Main Street Lending Program
records.title_cn: 激励银行放贷？主街贷款计划的信贷溢出效应
records.abstract_en: We study the effects of the Main Street Lending Program (MSLP)—a Federal Reserve emergency program which sought to support bank lending to small- and medium-sized businesses by purchasing 95% of eligible loans from banks—on the provision of bank credit to non-financial firms. We show the MSLP increased banks’ willingness to lend outside the program by serving as an “implicit backstop.” Participating banks were more likely to grant new loans, increase loan volumes, and reduce loan spreads, with stronger effects for ex-ante riskier firms and for lower-capital banks. We estimate that every $1 of take-up increased lending by $1.95.
records.abstract_cn: 我们研究了主街贷款计划（MSLP）——一项美联储紧急计划，旨在通过从银行购买符合条件的贷款的95%来支持对中小企业的银行贷款——对非金融企业银行信贷供给的影响。我们表明，MSLP通过充当“隐性后盾”增加了银行在计划之外放贷的意愿。参与银行更有可能发放新贷款、增加贷款规模并降低贷款利差，对于事前风险较高的企业和资本较低的银行，这种效应更为显著。我们估计，每1美元的参与额度增加了1.95美元的贷款。

records.title_en: The Geography of job creation and job destruction
records.title_cn: 就业创造与就业消失的地理分布
records.abstract_en: Spatial differences in labor market performance are large and highly persistent. Using data from the United States, Germany, and the United Kingdom, we document striking similarities across these countries in the spatial differences in unemployment, vacancies, and vacancy filling, job finding, and separation rates. The novel facts on the geography of vacancies and vacancy filling are instrumental in guiding and disciplining the development of a theory of local labor market performance. We find that a spatial version of a Diamond–Mortensen–Pissarides model with endogenous separations and on-the-job search quantitatively accounts for all the documented empirical regularities. The model also quantitatively rationalizes why differences in job-separation rates have primary importance in inducing differences in unemployment across space while changes in the job-finding rate are the main driver in unemployment fluctuations over the business cycle.
records.abstract_cn: 劳动力市场表现的空间差异巨大且高度持久。利用美国、德国和英国的数据，我们记录了这些国家在失业率、职位空缺、职位填补率、工作寻找率和离职率方面的空间差异惊人地相似。关于职位空缺和职位填补地理分布的新事实，对于指导和约束地方劳动力市场表现理论的发展至关重要。我们发现，一个包含内生离职和在职搜索的空间版本的Diamond–Mortensen–Pissarides模型，能够定量解释所有已记录的实证规律。该模型还定量解释了为何离职率的差异在引发空间失业差异中具有首要重要性，而工作寻找率的变化则是商业周期中失业波动的主要驱动因素。

records.title_en: Heterogeneous innovations and growth under imperfect technology spillovers
records.title_cn: 不完全技术溢出下的异质性创新与增长
records.abstract_en: We study how frictions in learning others’ technology, termed “imperfect technology spillovers,” impact firm innovation strategies and the aggregate economy through changes in innovation composition. We develop an endogenous growth model that generates strategic innovation decisions, where multi-product firms improve their products via own-innovation and enter new product markets through creative destruction under learning frictions. In our model, firms with technological advantages intensify own-innovation as learning frictions enable them to protect their markets from competitors, thereby reducing creative destruction of rivals. This pattern gets more pronounced when learning frictions intensify or competitive pressure rises exogenously. Importantly, the shift in innovation composition reduces aggregate growth, as creative destruction contributes more to growth. Using U.S. administrative firm-level data, we provide regression results supporting the model predictions.
records.abstract_cn: 我们研究了学习他人技术中的摩擦，即“不完全技术溢出”，如何通过创新构成的变化影响企业创新策略和总体经济。我们构建了一个内生增长模型，该模型产生战略性创新决策，其中多产品企业通过自身创新改进其产品，并在学习摩擦下通过创造性破坏进入新产品市场。在我们的模型中，具有技术优势的企业会加强自身创新，因为学习摩擦使它们能够保护自己的市场免受竞争对手的侵害，从而减少竞争对手的创造性破坏。当学习摩擦加剧或竞争压力外生上升时，这种模式变得更加明显。重要的是，创新构成的转变降低了总体增长，因为创造性破坏对增长的贡献更大。利用美国行政企业层面数据，我们提供了支持模型预测的回归结果。

records.title_en: Financial shocks and leverage of financial institutions: When do they matter?
records.title_cn: 金融冲击与金融机构杠杆：它们何时重要？
records.abstract_en: We provide empirical evidence that the amplification of financial shocks through leverage of financial institutions is both time-varying and heterogeneous across types of financial institutions. Using institution-level micro data on market-based leverage, we find that the strength of this amplification varies over time and that deleveraging by global systemically important banks and broker–dealers has significantly more adverse effects on macroeconomic outcomes than deleveraging by depository institutions, particularly within a financial constraint regime. In our framework, this regime is not imposed but emerges endogenously from the state of financial and monetary conditions. To uncover these dynamics, we develop and apply an endogenous regime-switching structural vector autoregressive model with time-varying transition probabilities and introduce structural identification techniques to this class of models.
records.abstract_cn: 我们提供的经验证据表明，金融冲击通过金融机构杠杆的放大效应既随时间变化，又在不同类型的金融机构之间存在异质性。利用基于市场杠杆的机构层面微观数据，我们发现这种放大效应的强度随时间变化，且全球系统重要性银行和经纪交易商的去杠杆对宏观经济结果的不利影响显著大于存款机构，尤其是在金融约束体制内。在我们的框架中，这一体制并非强加，而是从金融和货币状况中内生地产生。为了揭示这些动态，我们开发并应用了一个具有时变转移概率的内生体制转换结构向量自回归模型，并将结构识别技术引入此类模型。

records.title_en: Firm dynamics and random search over the business cycle
records.title_cn: 企业动态与商业周期中的随机搜索
records.abstract_en: I build a tractable random search model with firm dynamics, on-the-job search, and aggregate shocks. Multi-worker firms make recruitment decisions, choose whether to enter or exit the market, and design wage contracts. Tractability is obtained by showing that, under a set of assumptions on the recruitment technology, the decisions of workers and firms are fully summarized by the firms’ current productivity. I confront the model to salient business cycle moments on the reallocation of workers across the firm productivity distribution derived from firm-level data that the model successfully replicates. I use this framework to quantify the drivers of worker reallocation over the post-war business cycle in Britain.
records.abstract_cn: 我构建了一个包含企业动态、在职搜索和总体冲击的可处理的随机搜索模型。多员工企业做出招聘决策，选择进入或退出市场，并设计工资合同。可处理性通过证明在招聘技术的一组假设下，工人和企业的决策完全由企业当前的生产率概括而获得。我将模型与从企业层面数据得出的工人跨企业生产率分布重新配置的显著商业周期时刻进行对比，该模型成功复制了这些时刻。我利用这一框架量化了英国战后商业周期中工人重新配置的驱动因素。

records.title_en: Wage growth and labor market tightness
records.title_cn: 工资增长与劳动力市场紧张程度
records.abstract_en: Good measures of labor market tightness are essential to predict wage inflation and to calibrate monetary policy. This paper highlights the importance of two measures of labor market tightness in determining wage growth: the quits rate and vacancies per effective searcher (V/ES)—where searchers include both employed and non-employed job seekers. Among a broad set of indicators of labor market tightness, we find that these two measures are independently the most strongly correlated with wage inflation both in aggregate time series data and in industry-level panel data, and also predict wage growth best out of sample. These results are consistent with the predictions of a New Keynesian DSGE model where firms have the power to set wages and workers search on the job. We develop a new composite indicator of labor market tightness that can be used by policymakers to predict wage pressures in real time.
records.abstract_cn: 良好的劳动力市场紧张程度衡量指标对于预测工资通胀和校准货币政策至关重要。本文强调了两个劳动力市场紧张程度指标在决定工资增长中的重要性：离职率和每个有效搜寻者的职位空缺数（V/ES）——其中搜寻者包括就业者和非就业求职者。在一系列广泛的劳动力市场紧张程度指标中，我们发现这两个指标在总体时间序列数据和行业层面面板数据中与工资通胀的相关性最强，并且在样本外预测工资增长方面也表现最佳。这些结果与一个新型凯恩斯主义DSGE模型的预测一致，在该模型中，企业有权设定工资，工人进行在职搜寻。我们开发了一个新的劳动力市场紧张程度综合指标，可供政策制定者实时预测工资压力。

records.title_en: Artificial intelligence and technological unemployment
records.title_cn: 人工智能与技术性失业
records.abstract_en: How large are the effects of artificial intelligence (AI) on labor productivity and unemployment? We develop a labor-search model of technological unemployment where AI learns from workers, raises productivity, and displaces them if renegotiation fails. The model admits three steady states: no AI; some AI with limited capability, more job creation but higher unemployment; unbounded AI with endogenous growth and employment gains. Calibrated to U.S. data, the model implies a threefold productivity gain in the long run for workers exposed to AI but a 23% employment loss, half within five years. Plausible parameters give rise to global and local indeterminacy with endogenous cycles in productivity and unemployment, underscoring the uncertainty of AI’s impacts in line with a wide range of empirical findings. Equilibria are inefficient despite the Hosios condition; subsidizing jobs at risk of AI displacement is constrained optimal.
records.abstract_cn: 人工智能（AI）对劳动生产率和失业的影响有多大？我们构建了一个技术性失业的劳动搜寻模型，其中AI从工人那里学习，提高生产率，如果重新谈判失败则会取代工人。该模型存在三个稳态：无AI；有限能力的AI，带来更多就业创造但失业率更高；无限AI，伴随内生增长和就业增加。以美国数据校准后，模型表明，长期来看，接触AI的工人生产率可提高三倍，但就业损失达23%，其中一半在五年内发生。合理的参数会导致全局和局部不确定性，并伴随生产率和失业的内生周期，这凸显了AI影响的不确定性，与广泛的实证发现一致。尽管满足Hosios条件，均衡仍是无效率的；对面临AI替代风险的岗位进行补贴是受约束的最优政策。

records.title_en: Central bank reputation with noise
records.title_cn: 噪音下的中央银行声誉
records.abstract_en: This paper presents a model of central bank reputation where inflation is a noisy function of central bank actions. In the model, a central bank can be “hawkish”, with a relatively high penalty for taking inflationary actions, or “dovish”, with a relatively low penalty. The central bank’s type varies according to a Markov process, and its reputation is the Bayesian posterior of households that it is a hawkish type. We show analytically that no Markov pooling equilibria exist: hawkish and dovish central banks must act differently. We then argue that without sufficient noise, it is difficult for Markov separating equilibria to exist either. But with sufficient noise, we show computationally that pure strategy separating equilibria exist and have appealing characteristics: both hawkish and dovish banks choose lower inflationary actions than they would in the absence of reputation considerations, and both types are most aggressive in attempting to gain a hawkish reputation when their current reputation is middling.
records.abstract_cn: 本文提出了一个中央银行声誉模型，其中通货膨胀是中央银行行动的带噪音函数。在该模型中，中央银行可以是“鹰派”，即对采取通胀性行动有相对较高的惩罚，或是“鸽派”，即惩罚相对较低。中央银行的类型根据马尔可夫过程变化，其声誉是家庭对其为鹰派类型的贝叶斯后验概率。我们分析性地证明不存在马尔可夫混同均衡：鹰派和鸽派中央银行必须采取不同的行动。然后我们论证，在没有足够噪音的情况下，马尔可夫分离均衡也难以存在。但在有足够噪音的情况下，我们通过计算表明纯策略分离均衡存在且具有吸引人的特征：鹰派和鸽派银行都选择比在没有声誉考虑时更低的通胀性行动，并且两种类型在试图获得鹰派声誉时，在当前声誉处于中等水平时最为积极。

records.title_en: Distorted prices and targeted taxes in the New Keynesian Network model
records.title_cn: 新凯恩斯网络模型中的扭曲价格与定向税收
records.abstract_en: When confronted with sectoral shocks, policymakers often resort to targeted, sector-specific taxes in an ad hoc fashion. Based on the New Keynesian Network model, we characterize the optimal tax response to sectoral shocks: it features twice as many tax instruments as there are sectors, is budget-neutral, and not confined to the sector where the shock originates. We show that the optimal policy can be approximated by a simple rule that responds to inflation in the shocked sector and adjusts tax instruments in other sectors according to input–output linkages. We study its quantitative performance in a calibrated version of the model.
records.abstract_cn: 当面临部门冲击时，政策制定者往往以临时方式采用针对特定部门的税收。基于新凯恩斯网络模型，我们刻画了应对部门冲击的最优税收反应：其特点是税收工具数量是部门数量的两倍，预算中性，并且不局限于冲击起源的部门。我们证明，最优政策可以通过一个简单规则来近似，该规则对受冲击部门的通胀作出反应，并根据投入产出关联调整其他部门的税收工具。我们在模型的校准版本中研究其量化表现。

records.title_en: Nickell bias in panel local projection: Financial crises are worse than you think
records.title_cn: 面板局部投影中的Nickell偏差：金融危机比你想象的更严重
records.abstract_en: Panel local projection (LP) with fixed-effects (FE) is widely adopted for evaluating the economic consequences of financial crises across countries. This paper highlights a fundamental methodological issue: the presence of the Nickell bias in the panel FE estimator due to inherent dynamic structures of predictive specifications, even if the regressors have no lagged dependent variables. The Nickell bias invalidates the standard inferential procedure based on the t-statistic. We propose a split-panel jackknife (SPJ) estimator as a simple, easy-to-implement, and yet effective solution to eliminate the bias and restore valid statistical inference. We revisit four influential empirical studies on the impact of financial crises, and find that the FE method underestimates the economic losses of financial crises relative to the SPJ estimates. Replication files are available at https://metricshilab.github.io/panel-lp-replication/, with links to R and Stata packages.
records.abstract_cn: 带有固定效应（FE）的面板局部投影（LP）被广泛用于评估各国金融危机的经济后果。本文强调了一个基本的方法论问题：即使回归因子没有滞后因变量，由于预测规范的固有动态结构，面板FE估计量中存在Nickell偏差。Nickell偏差使得基于t统计量的标准推断程序失效。我们提出了一种分割面板刀切法（SPJ）估计量，作为一种简单、易于实施且有效的解决方案，以消除偏差并恢复有效的统计推断。我们重新审视了四项关于金融危机影响的实证研究，发现相对于SPJ估计，FE方法低估了金融危机的经济损失。复制文件可在https://metricshilab.github.io/panel-lp-replication/获取，并附有R和Stata软件包的链接。

records.title_en: Services trade and the choice of online versus in-person delivery
records.title_cn: 服务贸易与线上与线下交付方式的选择
records.abstract_en: Trade in services is unique from goods trade in that the trade cost associated with services exports depends on whether the service is delivered in-person (via travel of producer or consumer) or remotely (via the internet). Building on the trade-in-task framework of Grossman and Rossi-Hansberg (2008), this paper develops a task-based model of services trade that explains choice of delivering intermediate services tasks to customers in foreign markets either in-person or over the internet. To test the predictions of the empirical model, I isolate average trade costs for 23 U.S. services sectors, and consider the contribution of internet technology, travel costs, and the share of employees in each sector in occupations that can only be performed in-person to total trade costs. I find that U.S. services exporters with a higher concentration of in-person only employees face significantly higher trade costs than those with employees more concentrated in occupations that can be performed online, particularly during the COVID-19 pandemic and for professional services sectors.
records.abstract_cn: 服务贸易与商品贸易的不同之处在于，与服务出口相关的贸易成本取决于服务是面对面交付（通过生产者或消费者的旅行）还是远程交付（通过互联网）。基于Grossman和Rossi-Hansberg（2008）的贸易任务框架，本文开发了一个基于任务的服务贸易模型，解释了在外国市场向客户交付中间服务任务时选择面对面还是通过互联网的方式。为了检验实证模型的预测，我分离了23个美国服务部门的平均贸易成本，并考虑了互联网技术、旅行成本以及每个部门中只能面对面执行的职业员工占比对总贸易成本的贡献。我发现，美国服务出口商中，面对面执行员工集中度较高的，其面临的贸易成本显著高于那些员工更集中于可在线执行职业的出口商，尤其是在COVID-19疫情期间以及专业服务部门中。

records.title_en: Globalization and structural transformation: The role of tradable services
records.title_cn: 全球化与结构转型：可贸易服务业的作用
records.abstract_en: This paper studies how globalization impacts structural transformation from goods to services. I construct a multi-country, multi-sector model in which the transformation occurs through changes in income, prices, comparative advantage, or input-output linkages. I parameterize it with data from 1995 to 2018 for 66 countries covering diverse stages of economic development. Decomposition exercises show that globalization outweighs productivity growth in shaping structural transformation and that globalization’s impact primarily operates through comparative advantage. Counterfactual exercises reveal globalization’s heterogeneous impact on countries’ structural transformation. I characterize the underlying factor behind this result: Globalization affected countries’ transformation to the extent that it altered their comparative advantage. In countries with sector-neutral globalization—where export trade costs relative to import trade costs changed at similar rates for goods and services—comparative advantage and structural transformation were minimally impacted. In countries with sector-biased globalization, the transformation accelerated when the globalization shifted comparative advantage toward services, but decelerated otherwise.
records.abstract_cn: 本文研究全球化如何影响从商品到服务的结构转型。我构建了一个多国、多部门模型，其中转型通过收入、价格、比较优势或投入产出联系的变化而发生。我利用1995年至2018年66个覆盖不同经济发展阶段国家的数据对其进行了参数化。分解练习表明，全球化在塑造结构转型方面超过了生产率增长，且全球化的影响主要通过比较优势发挥作用。反事实练习揭示了全球化对各国结构转型的异质性影响。我刻画了这一结果背后的根本因素：全球化影响各国转型的程度，取决于它如何改变其比较优势。在部门中性的全球化国家——即商品和服务的出口贸易成本相对于进口贸易成本以相似速率变化的国家——比较优势和结构转型受到的影响最小。在部门偏向的全球化国家，当全球化将比较优势转向服务业时，转型加速，否则减速。

records.title_en: Historical military conflict, current trade tensions, and global supply chains
records.title_cn: 历史军事冲突、当前贸易紧张与全球供应链
records.abstract_en: We study how two significant conflicts between China and the U.S.—the Korean War and the current trade war—affect global supply chains. Using hand-collected data, we find that the death toll from the Korean War in a chairperson's city of origin strongly influences Chinese firms' selection of U.S. suppliers today. Moreover, the current trade tensions reactivate memories of wartime trauma, significantly amplifying their negative effects. We identify two key mechanisms driving this change: Chinese retaliatory tariffs and increased media coverage of the Korean War within China. A variety of empirical tests suggest that our findings are causal and are not a result of U.S. suppliers' choice.
records.abstract_cn: 我们研究了中国与美国之间的两次重大冲突——朝鲜战争和当前的贸易战——如何影响全球供应链。利用手工收集的数据，我们发现，朝鲜战争在一位董事长出生城市的死亡人数强烈影响今天中国企业对美国供应商的选择。此外，当前的贸易紧张局势重新激活了战争创伤的记忆，显著放大了其负面影响。我们识别了驱动这一变化的两个关键机制：中国的报复性关税和中国国内对朝鲜战争媒体报道的增加。多种实证检验表明，我们的发现具有因果性，并非美国供应商选择的结果。

records.title_en: Protection for sale without aggregation bias
records.title_cn: 无聚合偏差的销售保护
records.abstract_en: Estimates of Grossman and Helpman (1994) Protection For Sale (PFS) model yield unrealistically high estimates of the weight governments put on social welfare relative to lobbying contributions. Estimates of the former are often close to 1. We argue this is due to the level of aggregation at which the model is estimated. While protection is determined at the tariff line level, production data are only available at the industry level. Using a new production dataset at the tariff level, our estimates show that the average weight on social welfare in a sample of 142 countries declines by 77 percent.
records.abstract_cn: Grossman和Helpman（1994）的“销售保护”（PFS）模型的估计结果产生了不切实际的高估计值，即政府相对于游说捐款对社会福利的重视程度。前者的估计值通常接近1。我们认为这是由于模型估计时的聚合水平所致。虽然保护是在关税细目层面决定的，但生产数据仅在行业层面可得。利用一个新的关税层面的生产数据集，我们的估计显示，在142个国家的样本中，社会福利的平均权重下降了77%。

records.title_en: Demand for safe assets and spillovers from the global dollar cycle
records.title_cn: 安全资产需求与全球美元周期的溢出效应
records.abstract_en: US dollar appreciations can inflict sizable negative cross-border spillovers. We investigate such spillovers from flight-to-safety shocks and the accompanying “global dollar cycle”. Our results show that negative real sector spillovers from US dollar appreciations fall disproportionately on emerging markets. In contrast, effects on advanced economies are small and short-lived. Emerging market commodity exporters historically experienced larger negative spillovers than commodity importers, reflecting a strong negative link between the US dollar and commodity prices. In terms of policies, more anchored inflation expectations can mitigate the initial negative spillovers, while more flexible exchange rates can speed up the subsequent economic recovery.
records.abstract_cn: 美元升值可能造成显著的跨境负面溢出效应。我们研究了来自避险冲击及其伴随的“全球美元周期”的此类溢出效应。我们的结果显示，美元升值对实体部门的负面溢出效应不成比例地落在新兴市场上。相比之下，对发达经济体的影响则较小且短暂。历史上，新兴市场的商品出口国经历了比商品进口国更大的负面溢出效应，这反映了美元与商品价格之间的强烈负相关关系。在政策方面，更锚定的通胀预期可以缓解初始的负面溢出效应，而更灵活的汇率制度可以加速随后的经济复苏。

records.title_en: Labor market polarization and the great urban divergence
records.title_cn: 劳动力市场极化与大城市分化
records.abstract_en: Labor market polarization is among the most important features in recent decades of advanced country labor markets. Yet key spatial aspects of this phenomenon remain under-explored. We develop four key facts that document the universality of polarization across cities, a city-size difference in the shock magnitudes, a skew in the types of middle-paid jobs lost, and the role of polarization in the great urban divergence of skills. Existing theories cannot account for these facts. Hence we develop a parsimonious theoretical account that does so by integrating elements from the literatures on labor market polarization and systems of cities with heterogeneous labor in spatial equilibrium.
records.abstract_cn: 劳动力市场极化是近几十年来发达国家劳动力市场最重要的特征之一。然而，这一现象的关键空间方面仍未得到充分探索。我们提出了四个关键事实，记录了极化在各城市间的普遍性、冲击幅度上的城市规模差异、中等收入工作岗位流失类型的偏斜，以及极化在技能大城市分化中的作用。现有理论无法解释这些事实。因此，我们发展了一个简约的理论解释，通过整合劳动力市场极化文献和具有异质性劳动力的空间均衡城市体系文献中的要素来实现这一点。

records.title_en: Intersectoral demand linkages: Good shocks, bad outcomes?
records.title_cn: 部门间需求联系：好的冲击，坏的结果？
records.abstract_en: When and how are sector-specific price shocks magnified or dampened in general equilibrium with multiple industries and distortions? We develop a general framework with homothetic sectoral preferences and derive a welfare multiplier, which is a sufficient statistic for the share of the direct effect of the shock that materializes in the aggregate. We show that the combination of Cobb–Douglas or CES preferences with monopolistic competition always yields welfare gains from a positive shock. However, a positive sectoral shock may lead to aggregate losses under departures from either CES preferences or monopolistic competition. While our approach is similar to Baqaee and Fahri (2019, 2024), shocks propagate via consumer preferences in our case and production networks in their case, and market structure plays an explicit role in the transmission of shocks in our model.
records.abstract_cn: 在具有多个行业和扭曲的一般均衡中，部门特定的价格冲击何时以及如何被放大或减弱？我们开发了一个具有同质部门偏好的通用框架，并推导出一个福利乘数，该乘数是冲击直接效应在总体中实现份额的充分统计量。我们表明，Cobb-Douglas或CES偏好与垄断竞争的结合总是从正向冲击中产生福利收益。然而，在偏离CES偏好或垄断竞争的情况下，正向部门冲击可能导致总体损失。虽然我们的方法与Baqaee和Fahri（2019，2024）类似，但在我们的案例中，冲击通过消费者偏好传播，而在他们的案例中通过生产网络传播，并且市场结构在我们的模型中在冲击传导中扮演着明确的角色。

records.title_en: Firm and labor adjustments to FDI liberalization
records.title_cn: 对外直接投资自由化下的企业与劳动力调整
records.abstract_en: This paper studies how liberalizing outward foreign direct investments affects manufacturers’ engagement in global production and their domestic workers’ labor market outcomes. Focusing on a liberalization policy in 2001 by the government of Taiwan that allowed 122 electronic products to be produced in China, we estimate its effect on Taiwanese electronic manufacturers and their domestic workers. Employing a matched difference-in-differences strategy, we find that the manufacturers targeted by the policy were on average 10% more likely to invest in China relative to the non-targeted ones. Correspondingly, the domestic incumbent workers of the targeted manufacturers were on average more likely to change their jobs, remain employed for fewer years, and have lower wages in subsequent years relative to those employed by the non-targeted ones. The worker-level effects of the policy exhibited substantial heterogeneity across the initial wage distribution, with top-decile workers being less affected and the remaining workers experiencing average losses.
records.abstract_cn: 本文研究对外直接投资自由化如何影响制造商参与全球生产及其国内工人的劳动力市场结果。聚焦于台湾政府于2001年实施的一项自由化政策，该政策允许122种电子产品在中国生产，我们估计了该政策对台湾电子制造商及其国内工人的影响。采用匹配的双重差分策略，我们发现，相对于未受政策针对的制造商，受政策针对的制造商平均有10%更高的可能性在中国投资。相应地，与未受政策针对的制造商雇佣的工人相比，受政策针对的制造商的国内在职工人平均更可能更换工作、在职年限更短，且在后续年份工资更低。该政策在工人层面的影响在初始工资分布上表现出显著的异质性，其中最高十分位工人受影响较小，而其余工人则经历平均损失。

records.title_en: The distributional effects of carbon pricing across countries
records.title_cn: 碳定价的跨国分配效应
records.abstract_en: We use a quantitative international trade model with climate policies to explore the distributional effects of carbon pricing across countries. Our analysis addresses two key questions facing global climate action: which countries bear the greatest burden of climate policies, and how these policies can be designed to ensure fairness. We present three main findings. First, efficient climate policies that disregard distributional concerns significantly exacerbate between-country inequality. Second, equity can be achieved alongside efficiency when climate policies are complemented by economically feasible international transfers, either equalizing carbon tax costs or accounting for historical emissions, with minimal economic impact on high-income countries. Third, carbon tax schemes with heterogeneous pricing – featuring lower rates for low- and middle-income countries – do not necessarily result in fairer outcomes.
records.abstract_cn: 我们使用一个包含气候政策的定量国际贸易模型来探讨碳定价在各国间的分配效应。我们的分析针对全球气候行动面临的两个关键问题：哪些国家承受气候政策的最大负担，以及如何设计这些政策以确保公平。我们提出三个主要发现。首先，忽视分配关切的高效气候政策显著加剧了国家间的不平等。其次，当气候政策辅以经济上可行的国际转移支付时，可以实现公平与效率的兼顾，无论是均等化碳税成本还是考虑历史排放，对高收入国家的经济影响微乎其微。第三，具有差异化定价的碳税方案——对低收入和中等收入国家设定较低税率——并不必然导致更公平的结果。

records.title_en: Knowledge diffusion through FDI: Worldwide firm-level evidence
records.title_cn: 通过外国直接投资的知识扩散：全球企业层面的证据
records.abstract_en: This paper examines how foreign direct investment (FDI) affects cross-border knowledge diffusion by linking firm-level FDI events to patent citations. We assemble a global panel that merges utility patents with project-level greenfield and M&A investments in 60 countries over two decades. Using a new local-projection difference-in-differences methodology, we find that FDI raises bidirectional citation flows between investor and hosts, with stronger effects for greenfield than for M&A. Spillovers are heterogeneous—larger where host absorptive capacity is higher and where investor–host technologies are closer. At the country–industry level, diffusion extends beyond the targeted sector, propagating to technologically related industries and along production input–output linkages. Mode of entry matters: greenfield projects generate robust intra- and inter-industry diffusion, whereas M&A exhibits limited horizontal effects but notable forward (downstream) spillovers consistent with learning-by-using.
records.abstract_cn: 本文通过将企业层面的外国直接投资（FDI）事件与专利引用联系起来，考察FDI如何影响跨境知识扩散。我们构建了一个全球面板数据，将实用专利与60个国家二十年间项目层面的绿地投资和并购投资合并。使用一种新的局部投影双重差分方法，我们发现FDI提高了投资者与东道国之间的双向引用流，其中绿地投资的效果强于并购。溢出效应具有异质性——在东道国吸收能力较高以及投资者与东道国技术更接近的情况下，溢出效应更大。在国家-行业层面，扩散超出了目标行业，传播到技术相关行业，并沿着生产投入产出联系进行。进入模式很重要：绿地项目产生稳健的行业内和行业间扩散，而并购则表现出有限的横向效应，但显著的向前（下游）溢出，这与使用中学习相一致。

records.title_en: Trade wars and rumors of trade wars: The dynamic effects of the U.S.–China tariff hikes
records.title_cn: 贸易战与贸易战传闻：美中关税上调的动态效应
records.abstract_en: We use a general equilibrium dynamic trade model to study the effects of the U.S.–China tariff hikes on the global economy. Our model captures key trade patterns since the tariff hikes, such as the pace of the decline in U.S.–China bilateral trade and the reallocation of global imports from the U.S. toward China. The welfare losses from the tariff hikes are much larger in our dynamic model than implied by static trade models. Expectations about the persistence of the tariff hikes shape aggregate dynamics in the short to medium run.
records.abstract_cn: 我们使用一般均衡动态贸易模型研究美中关税上调对全球经济的影响。我们的模型捕捉了关税上调以来的关键贸易模式，如美中双边贸易下降的速度以及全球进口从美国向中国转移的情况。在我们的动态模型中，关税上调造成的福利损失远大于静态贸易模型所暗示的。关于关税上调持续性的预期塑造了短期至中期的总体动态。

records.title_en: Insufficient or excessive investment under sovereign default risk
records.title_cn: 主权违约风险下的投资不足或过度
records.abstract_en: Private agents do not internalize the impact of their investment decisions on the sovereign’s bond prices and default risk. Therefore, a standard externality argument implies that investment is insufficient and that a subsidy can improve welfare, if financed by non-distortionary means. We contrast this logic with a countervailing force. When the sovereign is impatient relative to households, plausibly due to political economy factors, it finds laissez-faire capital accumulation excessive and might prefer instead to tax it. We embed both mechanisms in a sovereign default model with decentralized capital investment, long-term public debt, and stochastic trend growth, calibrated to salient features of the Spanish economy. We find that the impatience channel dominates quantitatively, to such an extent that laissez-faire is preferable to the government’s ideal fiscal policy, based on households’ welfare.
records.abstract_cn: 私人主体不会内化其投资决策对主权债券价格和违约风险的影响。因此，标准的外部性论点意味着投资不足，如果通过非扭曲性手段融资，补贴可以改善福利。我们将这一逻辑与一种相反的力量进行对比。当主权者相对于家庭而言缺乏耐心（可能由于政治经济因素），它会认为自由放任的资本积累过度，并可能更倾向于对其征税。我们将这两种机制嵌入一个主权违约模型中，该模型包含分散化的资本投资、长期公共债务和随机趋势增长，并校准至西班牙经济的显著特征。我们发现，耐心渠道在数量上占主导地位，以至于基于家庭福利，自由放任优于政府理想的财政政策。

records.title_en: The effects of wealth shocks on public and private long-term care insurance
records.title_cn: 财富冲击对公共和私人长期护理保险的影响
records.abstract_en: The financing of long-term care services and supports (LTSS) relies heavily on self-insurance in the form of housing or financial wealth. Exploiting both local market variation in housing prices and individual-level variation in stock market wealth from 1996 to 2016, we show that exogenous wealth shocks significantly reduce the probability of LTCI coverage, without altering Medicaid eligibility among people with housing and financial assets. The effect of shocks to liquid wealth strongly dominates the effect of housing wealth changes. A $100 K increase in housing (financial) wealth reduces the likelihood of LTCI coverage by 1.24 (3.22) percentage points.
records.abstract_cn: 长期护理服务与支持（LTSS）的融资在很大程度上依赖于以住房或金融财富形式进行的自我保险。利用1996年至2016年间当地市场价格变动和个体层面股市财富变动，我们表明外生财富冲击显著降低了长期护理保险（LTCI）的覆盖率，同时并未改变拥有住房和金融资产人群的医疗补助资格。流动性财富冲击的影响明显强于住房财富变化的影响。住房（金融）财富增加100万美元，会使长期护理保险覆盖率降低1.24（3.22）个百分点。

records.title_en: What happens to population health when the doctors leave? Evidence from the exit of Cuban doctors in Brazil
records.title_cn: 当医生离开时，人口健康会发生什么变化？来自巴西古巴医生撤离的证据
records.abstract_en: This paper studies the effects of a large-scale exit of doctors on population health outcomes, health production inputs, outputs, and health system adaptation in Brazil. Identification exploits the exogenous timing of the Cuban exit from municipalities that relied more versus less on Cuban doctors within the More Doctors Program. We find persistent reductions in the care of chronic diseases, while service utilization for conditions requiring immediate care, such as maternal-related services and infections, quickly recovered. Reductions in utilization did not translate into changes in health outcomes. Supply-side response and demand diversion helped mitigate major adverse repercussions for population health at the market level.
records.abstract_cn: 本文研究了大规模医生撤离对人口健康结果、健康生产投入、产出及卫生系统适应性的影响，以巴西为背景。识别策略利用了古巴医生从“更多医生计划”中依赖程度较高与较低的市镇撤离的外生时机。我们发现慢性病护理持续减少，而需要即时护理的服务利用，如孕产妇相关服务和感染，则迅速恢复。利用率的下降并未转化为健康结果的变化。供给侧响应和需求分流有助于在市场层面减轻对人口健康的重大不利影响。

records.title_en: Housing affordability and domestic violence: The case of San Francisco’s rent control policies
records.title_cn: 住房可负担性与家庭暴力：旧金山租金管制政策的案例
records.abstract_en: Over a third of women in the United States experience intimate partner violence (IPV); existing research demonstrates that household finances are one important driver of such violence. We study the effects of rent control on IPV to develop understanding of the financial causes of IPV. Rent control may lessen financial stressors within a relationship and decrease strain that leads to violence. Conversely, it may make leaving the relationship more costly, shifting the bargaining power in the relationship and leading to more violence. We leverage the 1994 expansion of rent control in San Francisco as a natural experiment to study this question. This expansion created variation across ZIP codes in the number of rental units that were newly rent controlled. We exploit this variation in a continuous difference-in-difference design. We estimate an elasticity of -0.08 between the number of newly rent controlled units and assaults on women resulting in hospitalization. This effect translates to a nearly 10% decrease in assaults on women for the average ZIP code. This relationship is not explained by changes in neighborhood composition or overall crime, consistent with the effects being driven by individual level changes in IPV.
records.abstract_cn: 在美国，超过三分之一的女性经历过亲密伴侣暴力（IPV）；现有研究表明，家庭财务是此类暴力的一个重要驱动因素。我们研究租金管制对IPV的影响，以加深对IPV财务原因的理解。租金管制可能减轻关系中的财务压力，减少导致暴力的紧张情绪。相反，它可能使离开关系变得更加昂贵，改变关系中的议价能力，从而导致更多暴力。我们利用1994年旧金山租金管制的扩展作为自然实验来研究这一问题。这一扩展在邮政编码层面造成了新受租金管制的租赁单位数量的差异。我们在连续双重差分设计中利用这一差异。我们估计，新受租金管制的单位数量与导致女性住院的袭击之间的弹性为-0.08。这一效应转化为平均邮政编码中女性遭受袭击的次数减少了近10%。这种关系不能由社区构成或整体犯罪率的变化来解释，这与效应由个体层面的IPV变化驱动的结论一致。

records.title_en: Community health teams and health utilization in El Salvador
records.title_cn: 社区卫生团队与萨尔瓦多的医疗服务利用
records.abstract_en: The overutilization of costly hospital and emergency care and the underutilization of primary care is considered a key driver of wasteful health spending. We study how a shift toward community-based primary care reshapes care patterns across levels of the health system in El Salvador. Using data on outpatient consultations and hospitalizations across 254 municipalities, we exploit the staggered introduction of community health teams (CHTs) between 2010 and 2013 using an event-study design. We find that CHTs increased preventive care, reduced curative consultations for conditions amenable to effective primary care, and lowered preventable hospitalizations. We also document improved primary-care coverage for previously unattended chronic conditions. Together, these results suggest that strengthening primary care through CHTs can meaningfully improve the organization of care and bolster health system performance.
records.abstract_cn: 对昂贵的医院和急诊服务的过度利用以及初级保健的利用不足，被认为是造成浪费性医疗支出的关键因素。我们研究了向以社区为基础的初级保健转变如何重塑萨尔瓦多卫生系统各级别的护理模式。利用覆盖254个市镇的门诊咨询和住院数据，我们采用事件研究设计，利用2010年至2013年间社区卫生团队（CHTs）的分阶段引入。我们发现，CHTs增加了预防性护理，减少了针对可通过有效初级保健治疗的病症的 curative 咨询，并降低了可预防的住院率。我们还记录了先前未得到关注的慢性病初级保健覆盖率的改善。综合来看，这些结果表明，通过CHTs加强初级保健可以显著改善护理组织并提升卫生系统绩效。

records.title_en: Reform-induced competition: Evaluating the impact on Swiss pharmacies and total drug costs
records.title_cn: 改革引发的竞争：评估对瑞士药房及药品总成本的影响
records.abstract_en: This paper explores the effect of increased competition on pharmacies induced by a regime change in two Swiss cities allowing physicians to self-dispense drugs. By merging detailed sales and survey data at the pharmacy level, a difference-in-differences estimation shows a significant and permanent loss of market share in prescribed drug revenue and profits. The decline is driven by drugs used for acute illnesses and is less pronounced for larger pharmacies. While generic drug sales decrease significantly, the more expensive brand-name drugs remain largely unaffected. I find evidence that pharmacies respond to increased competition by diversifying toward health services. Adding administrative physician data shows that the reform caused approximately CHF 19.5M in additional drug costs per year. My results demonstrate that more competition can result in higher drug costs for society.
records.abstract_cn: 本文探讨了瑞士两个城市允许医生自行配药的制度变革所引发的竞争加剧对药房的影响。通过合并药房层面的详细销售和调查数据，双重差分估计显示，处方药收入和利润的市场份额出现了显著且持久的下降。这种下降主要由用于急性疾病的药物驱动，并且对大型药房的影响较小。虽然仿制药销售显著减少，但更昂贵的品牌药基本未受影响。我发现有证据表明，药房通过向健康服务多元化来应对竞争加剧。加入行政医生数据显示，改革每年导致约CHF 19.5M的额外药物成本。我的结果表明，更多的竞争可能导致社会药物成本上升。

records.title_en: Learner driving experience and motor vehicle accidents
records.title_cn: 学员驾驶经验与机动车事故
records.abstract_en: Minimum supervised driving hours (MSDH) are a key component of Graduated Driver Licensing (GDL) policy. GDL has been shown to reduce motor vehicle accidents, but its optimal design is far from clear. Exploiting two discrete MSDH changes in New South Wales (the largest state in Australia), we estimate causal effects of various MSDH options, providing evidence on driver safety under different regimes. Increasing MSDH from zero to 50 h lowered the risk of a motor vehicle accident in the first year of unsupervised driving by around 23%. Further increasing the mandate to 120 h had no additional benefit.
records.abstract_cn: 最低监督驾驶小时数（MSDH）是渐进式驾驶执照（GDL）政策的关键组成部分。GDL已被证明能减少机动车事故，但其最优设计远未明确。利用新南威尔士州（澳大利亚最大的州）两次离散的MSDH变化，我们估计了各种MSDH选项的因果效应，提供了不同制度下驾驶员安全性的证据。将MSDH从零增加到50小时，在无监督驾驶的第一年将机动车事故风险降低了约23%。进一步将规定增加到120小时没有额外益处。

records.title_en: Obesity, sedentary behavior and lifestyle: A lifecycle model of eating and physical activity
records.title_cn: 肥胖、久坐行为与生活方式：饮食与体力活动的生命周期模型
records.abstract_en: We propose a theoretical model to study individual lifestyle choices related to calorie intake and physical activity, depending on personal fitness and body weight. The model builds on the rational eating literature and can generate a variety of behaviors that are consistent with the empirical evidence. In particular, we show that engaging in periods of a sedentary lifestyle can be a rational, utility-maximizing decision—a finding that is not present in the existing literature but is empirically widespread. Additionally, we show the possible existence of multiple equilibria and multiple indifferent lifestyles. The former justifies policy interventions to help individuals exit a self-reinforcing, but unhealthy equilibrium; the latter provides a theoretical basis for remediation plans that compensate for earlier unhealthy behaviors.
records.abstract_cn: 我们提出了一个理论模型，研究个人在卡路里摄入和体力活动方面的生活方式选择，这些选择取决于个人健康状况和体重。该模型建立在理性饮食文献的基础上，并能产生与实证证据一致的各种行为。特别是，我们表明，久坐生活方式的时期可以是一个理性的、效用最大化的决策——这一发现在现有文献中不存在，但在经验上广泛存在。此外，我们展示了多重均衡和多重无差异生活方式可能存在的可能性。前者证明了政策干预的必要性，以帮助个人摆脱自我强化但不健康的均衡；后者为补偿早期不健康行为的补救计划提供了理论基础。

records.title_en: The impact of immunotherapy on reductions in cancer mortality: Evidence from Medicare
records.title_cn: 免疫疗法对癌症死亡率降低的影响：来自医疗保险的证据
records.abstract_en: Immunotherapy is a breakthrough innovation in cancer care, but it is also among the most expensive treatments, with costs exceeding $150,000 per patient. We study the introduction of immune checkpoint inhibitors (ICIs), the most widely used class of immunotherapy drugs. In 2022, ICIs accounted for 44% of the $17.5 billion Medicare Part B cancer drug spending. We focus on metastatic melanoma, the first approved indication for ICIs. While overall cancer mortality rates declined since the 1990s, melanoma mortality rates increased through the early 2010s. Following the first ICI approvals in 2011 and 2014, melanoma mortality declined sharply. Using traditional Medicare claims, we estimate the impact of the introduction of ICIs on healthcare utilization, costs, and 1-year survival for patients with metastatic melanoma, relative to metastatic colorectal cancer (CRC), where ICIs were not approved until 2017. Variation in approval timing allows us to isolate the effect of ICIs from broader cancer care trends. We find that ICIs reduced 1-year mortality by 6.2%. Since about 1 in 5 metastatic melanoma patients received ICIs, this implies a 28.0% reduction among treated patients. The introduction of ICIs also reduced chemotherapy and radiation use, but increased Medicare spending by 59.3% or about 260% among ICI-treated patients. Accounting for life expectancy gains beyond one year, the benefits of ICIs for melanoma patients appear comparable, or potentially even greater, than the substantial added Medicare costs. Nonetheless, ICI use remains relatively low given large survival benefits and few alternative treatments, suggesting that costs and other barriers limit patient access.
records.abstract_cn: 免疫疗法是癌症治疗中的一项突破性创新，但它也是最昂贵的治疗方法之一，每位患者的费用超过150,000美元。我们研究了免疫检查点抑制剂（ICIs）的引入，这是最广泛使用的一类免疫治疗药物。在2022年，ICIs占医疗保险B部分癌症药物支出的44%，总额达17.5亿美元。我们聚焦于转移性黑色素瘤，这是ICIs首个获批的适应症。尽管自1990年以来总体癌症死亡率有所下降，但黑色素瘤死亡率在2010年代初之前持续上升。在2011年和2014年首次获批ICIs后，黑色素瘤死亡率急剧下降。利用传统医疗保险索赔数据，我们估计了ICIs的引入对转移性黑色素瘤患者医疗利用、成本和1年生存率的影响，并与转移性结直肠癌（CRC）患者相比，后者直到2017年才获批ICIs。批准时间的差异使我们能够将ICIs的效果与更广泛的癌症治疗趋势区分开来。我们发现ICIs使1年死亡率降低了6.2%。由于大约1/5的转移性黑色素瘤患者接受了ICIs治疗，这意味着在接受治疗的患者中死亡率降低了28.0%。ICIs的引入还减少了化疗和放疗的使用，但使医疗保险支出增加了59.3%，或在接受ICIs治疗的患者中增加了约260%。考虑到一年以上的预期寿命增益，ICIs对黑色素瘤患者的益处似乎与大幅增加的医疗保险成本相当，甚至可能更大。尽管如此，鉴于巨大的生存获益和很少的替代治疗选择，ICIs的使用仍然相对较低，这表明成本和其他障碍限制了患者的获取。

records.title_en: The impact of mining-induced earthquakes on mental health: Evidence from the Dutch Lifelines Cohort Study and Biobank
records.title_cn: 采矿诱发地震对心理健康的影响：来自荷兰生命线队列研究和生物样本库的证据
records.abstract_en: A large body of literature demonstrates that exposure to major adverse events such as natural disasters affects physical and mental health. Less is known about health consequences of long-term exposure to smaller, recurring shocks such as mining-induced earthquakes. Leveraging data from the Dutch Lifelines Cohort Study and Biobank and the Royal Netherlands Meteorological Institute, we examine mental health effects of frequent earthquakes generated by the extraction of natural gas, which was a major source of economic revenue for the Netherlands. Long-term exposure is captured by the accumulated peak ground acceleration. We employ individual-level fixed effects models to deal with selective exposure. We find that exposure increases depression and anxiety symptoms. Our results are robust to selective migration and to varying the exposure indicator. The results support a reassessment of the societal costs of the mining of natural gas.
records.abstract_cn: 大量文献表明，暴露于自然灾害等重大不良事件会影响身心健康。关于长期暴露于较小、反复发生的冲击（如采矿诱发地震）的健康后果，我们知之甚少。利用荷兰生命线队列研究和生物样本库以及荷兰皇家气象研究所的数据，我们考察了由天然气开采（荷兰主要经济收入来源之一）引发的频繁地震对心理健康的影响。长期暴露通过累积峰值地面加速度来衡量。我们采用个体固定效应模型来处理选择性暴露。我们发现，暴露会增加抑郁和焦虑症状。我们的结果对选择性迁移和暴露指标的变化具有稳健性。这些结果支持重新评估天然气开采的社会成本。

records.title_en: The effects of delayed remuneration on doctor labour supply: Evidence from the English NHS
records.title_cn: 延迟薪酬对医生劳动力供给的影响：来自英国国家医疗服务体系的证据
records.abstract_en: We examine the labour supply response of doctors in England to a reform to public sector pensions that increased the link between current labour supply and pension value. Exploiting the staggered rollout of the reform across narrowly defined birth cohorts, we find that mid-career doctors increased their labour supply to the public healthcare system by just under 4% four years after exposure. This was driven by increases on the extensive margin of working in the public healthcare system. Our results imply an extensive margin labour supply elasticity with respect to the link between current labour supply and pension value of 0.04. Taking into account current pay we estimate an extensive margin labour supply elasticity with respect to total remuneration of 0.29. This is similar to estimates of doctor labour elasticities with respect to pay in other contexts, and suggests that delayed remuneration can be an effective tool for hospital systems to affect mid-career doctor labour supply.
records.abstract_cn: 我们研究了英格兰医生对公共部门养老金改革的劳动力供给反应，该改革增强了当前劳动力供给与养老金价值之间的联系。利用改革在狭窄定义的出生队列中分阶段推出的特点，我们发现，中年医生在接触改革四年后，向公共医疗系统提供的劳动力供给增加了近4%。这一增长主要由在公共医疗系统工作的广泛边际增加所驱动。我们的结果表明，相对于当前劳动力供给与养老金价值之间的联系，广泛边际劳动力供给弹性为0.04。考虑到当前薪酬，我们估计相对于总薪酬的广泛边际劳动力供给弹性为0.29。这与其他情境下医生劳动力供给对薪酬的弹性估计相似，并表明延迟薪酬可以成为医院系统影响中年医生劳动力供给的有效工具。

records.title_en: Unhooking the past: Early-life exposure to hookworm eradication and later-life longevity
records.title_cn: 摆脱过去：生命早期钩虫根除暴露与晚年寿命
records.abstract_en: This study examines the long-term effects of the Rockefeller Sanitary Commission’s (RSC) hookworm eradication campaign, initiated in the American South in the 1910s, on old-age longevity. Utilizing Social Security Administration death records linked to the 1940 full-count census, we employ a two-way fixed effect approach to examine the effects of early-life exposure to the eradication campaign on later-life outcomes. We find that individuals exposed to the RSC campaign during in-utero and early life experience an increase of approximately 1.3 months in longevity for a one–standard-deviation increase in county-level treatment intensity. The effects are substantially larger among nonwhites, children of illiterate mothers, and those born in urban areas. Moreover, we provide evidence of dynamic complementarity in the effects of hookworm eradication on longevity, with larger effects observed in counties exposed to the Rosenwald school construction movement and in states with more stringent child labor laws. Using the 1940 census and World War II enlistment data, we provide suggestive evidence of improvements in educational attainment, income, and cognitive ability as possible pathways. Our findings contribute to the literature on the lasting effects of early-life public health interventions and underscore the importance of such programs in addressing present-day global health challenges.
records.abstract_cn: 本研究考察了洛克菲勒卫生委员会（RSC）于1910年在美国南部发起的钩虫根除运动对老年寿命的长期影响。利用与社会保障管理局死亡记录相关联的1940年全量人口普查数据，我们采用双向固定效应方法，检验生命早期暴露于根除运动对晚年结果的影响。我们发现，在子宫内和生命早期暴露于RSC运动的个体，县级治疗强度每增加一个标准差，寿命约增加1.3个月。在非白人、母亲为文盲的子女以及城市出生者中，效应显著更大。此外，我们提供了钩虫根除对寿命影响中动态互补性的证据，在罗森瓦尔德学校建设运动覆盖的县以及童工法更为严格的州，观察到的效应更大。利用1940年人口普查和二战入伍数据，我们提供了教育程度、收入和认知能力改善作为可能途径的提示性证据。我们的发现为关于生命早期公共卫生干预持久影响的文献做出了贡献，并强调了此类项目在应对当今全球健康挑战中的重要性。

records.title_en: Nurse practitioner training and local medical provider supply
records.title_cn: 执业护士培训与当地医疗服务提供者供给
records.abstract_en: The Nurse Practitioner (NP) workforce expanded rapidly from 2010-2023, especially in rural counties, where patients today are nearly as likely to receive care from an NP as from a physician. At the same time, rural health outcomes and access to health care continue to worsen relative to urban areas. Empirical research on how NPs interact with or substitute for physicians remains limited. This paper exploits county-level openings of graduate nursing programs to test how they impact the local supply of NPs and primary care physicians. Using data from the Integrated Postsecondary Education Data System and Area Health Resource Files, we estimate staggered difference-in-differences frameworks. We show that new graduate programs lead to large increases in the local NP supply and find positive spillover effects for nearby rural counties and counties with low provider to population ratios. We find that over the decade after a program first graduates students, up to 30% of students become licensed NPs in the same county, and for rural programs, the majority of graduates add to the regional supply of NPs. We find no adverse impact of local NP increases on the number of primary care physicians, suggesting that broader access to NP education boosts the local supply of providers overall. This paper illustrates the importance of rural medical education in increasing local access to primary care providers and in addressing existing inequities in access to care.
records.abstract_cn: 执业护士（NP）队伍在2010-2023年间迅速扩张，尤其是在农村县，如今患者从执业护士处获得护理的可能性几乎与从医生处获得护理相当。与此同时，农村地区的健康结果和医疗保健可及性相对于城市地区持续恶化。关于执业护士如何与医生互动或替代医生的实证研究仍然有限。本文利用县级研究生护理项目的开设情况，检验这些项目如何影响当地执业护士和初级保健医生的供给。使用来自综合中学后教育数据系统和地区卫生资源文件的数据，我们估计了交错双重差分框架。我们发现，新的研究生项目导致当地执业护士供给大幅增加，并对邻近农村县和提供者与人口比率较低的县产生正向溢出效应。我们发现，在一个项目首批学生毕业后的十年内，多达30%的学生在同一县成为持照执业护士，而对于农村项目，大多数毕业生增加了该地区执业护士的供给。我们发现当地执业护士增加对初级保健医生数量没有不利影响，这表明更广泛的执业护士教育机会总体上提升了当地医疗服务提供者的供给。本文说明了农村医学教育在增加当地初级保健提供者可及性和解决现有护理可及性不平等方面的重要性。

records.title_en: Shared Stakes in English General Practice: The Impact of Practice Managers as Partners on Outcomes
records.title_cn: 英国全科医疗中的共享股权：执业经理作为合伙人对结果的影响
records.abstract_en: Ownership of English general practices by physicians has been declining for many years and concentrated among fewer physicians. Non-clinical ownership may provide a sustainable alternative structure for general practice. In this study, we provide the first formal evaluation of non-clinical ownership in an English general practice setting. We compile a comprehensive dataset of general practices across eight years between 2015/16 and 2022/23 from a range of sources to investigate the impact of non-clinical ownership stakes on key primary care outcomes, including staffing levels and turnover, patient satisfaction, access, quality of care, reimbursement for non-core services and total patient list size. Employing a dynamic event study design combined with propensity-score weighting, we find practice manager partners increase direct patient care (excluding physicians and nurses), administrative staff numbers, reimbursement for non-core services and total patient list size. However, we find no statistically significant effect on any other outcome. Offering equity stakes to non-physician staff may support practice sustainability by allowing alternative ownership structures.
records.abstract_cn: 英国全科医疗由医生拥有的比例多年来持续下降，且集中在少数医生手中。非临床所有权可能为全科医疗提供一种可持续的替代结构。在本研究中，我们首次对英国全科医疗环境中的非临床所有权进行了正式评估。我们汇编了从2015/16到2022/23八个年度的全科医疗综合数据集，数据来源多样，以调查非临床所有权股份对关键初级保健结果的影响，包括人员配置水平和流动率、患者满意度、可及性、护理质量、非核心服务报销以及总患者名单规模。采用动态事件研究设计结合倾向性评分加权，我们发现执业经理合伙人增加了直接患者护理（不包括医生和护士）、行政人员数量、非核心服务报销和总患者名单规模。然而，我们未发现对其他任何结果有统计学显著影响。向非医师员工提供股权可能通过允许替代所有权结构来支持实践的可持续性。

records.title_en: Accelerating birth timing to access cash transfers? Evidence from households in extreme poverty
records.title_cn: 加速生育时机以获取现金转移？来自极端贫困家庭的证据
records.abstract_en: There has been a sustained rise in cash transfer programs to the poor, and burgeoning interest in interventions promoting early childhood development. We draw together these trends to study whether open enrolment interventions targeting cash transfers to pregnant mothers unintentionally induce those not pregnant to accelerate birth timing in order to start receiving the cash. Our study context is rural Northern Nigeria, where households have high demand for liquidity because they are reliant on volatile earnings from agriculture, are subject to frequent natural and man-made aggregate shocks, and reside in communities with imperfect credit markets. Our evidence comes from an evaluation of an intervention providing high-valued unconditional cash transfers to pregnant mothers, with four years of open enrolment. We examine how this impacts pregnancy timing among 1700 women not pregnant at baseline. We document relatively weak distortionary impacts on pregnancy timing over the four year period of open enrolment. The reasons are women retain full control over the use of cash transfers, they have productive investment opportunities in their own businesses, and they choose to invest in those rather than transfer cash to husbands.
