records.abstract_en: We systematically review studies of how unemployment benefits affect unemployment duration. Statistically significant findings are eight times more likely to be published. Correcting for publication bias cuts the average elasticity by a third. Meta-analysis is a data-driven way to aggregate estimates across policy contexts and generalize sufficient statistics methods to compute the global optimal policy. Although existing consumption drop-based approaches typically imply an optimal replacement rate near zero, our corrected estimates imply an optimal replacement rate of 28 percent in the United States. We are unable to reject the hypothesis that the “micro” elasticity is equal to the “macro” elasticity. (JEL E24, J64, J65)
records.abstract_cn: 我们系统性地回顾了关于失业救济金如何影响失业持续时间的研究。统计显著的研究结果被发表的可能性高出八倍。校正发表偏倚后，平均弹性降低了三分之一。元分析是一种数据驱动的方法，用于跨政策背景汇总估计，并将充分统计量方法推广以计算全球最优政策。尽管现有的基于消费下降的方法通常暗示最优替代率接近于零，但我们的校正估计表明，在美国，最优替代率为28%。我们无法拒绝“微观”弹性等于“宏观”弹性的假设。(JEL E24, J64, J65)

records.title_en: Rational Inattention during a Randomized Controlled Trial
records.title_cn: 随机对照试验中的理性疏忽
records.abstract_en: We introduce an information provision experiment into a standard dynamic rational inattention model. We derive analytical results about how the treatment effect varies with characteristics of the environment and the individual. We use these results to discuss findings in the empirical literature on information provision experiments that can be explained by rational inattention of survey respondents and what this interpretation implies about behavior outside the survey. (JEL C90, D83, D91)
records.abstract_cn: 我们将信息提供实验引入标准动态理性疏忽模型中。我们推导出关于处理效应如何随环境和个体特征变化的解析结果。我们利用这些结果讨论信息提供实验实证文献中的发现，这些发现可由调查受访者的理性疏忽解释，并探讨这一解释对调查之外行为的意义。（JEL C90, D83, D91）

records.title_en: Nonbinary and Transgender Identities and Earnings: Evidence from a National Census
records.title_cn: 非二元与跨性别身份及收入：来自全国人口普查的证据
records.abstract_en: We provide the first evidence from a large population census on earnings disparities experienced by nonbinary people—individuals who do not exclusively identify as men or women—and transgender people—individuals whose gender differs from their sex assigned at birth—relative to cisgender people. Using restricted-access 2021 Canadian census data linked to tax records, we find that nonbinary individuals assigned male at birth, transgender men, transgender women, and cisgender women all earn significantly less than comparable cisgender men. Nonbinary individuals assigned female at birth experience an additional earnings penalty. Differences in job sorting explain some of these disparities. (JEL J16, J31, J71)
records.abstract_cn: 我们提供了来自大型人口普查的首个证据，关于非二元人群——即不 exclusively 认同为男性或女性的个体——以及跨性别者——即性别与出生时指定性别不同的个体——相对于顺性别者所经历的收入差距。利用与税务记录关联的受限访问的2021年加拿大人口普查数据，我们发现出生时被指定为男性的非二元个体、跨性别男性、跨性别女性和顺性别女性均显著低于可比的顺性别男性。出生时被指定为女性的非二元个体则面临额外的收入惩罚。工作分类的差异解释了部分这些差距。(JEL J16, J31, J71)

records.title_en: Breadwinner’s Burden: The Effect of Financial Concerns on Sleeplessness
records.title_cn: 养家者的负担：财务担忧对失眠的影响
records.abstract_en: Using a regression discontinuity design, we find that eligible household heads surveyed just after an unconditional cash transfer in Indonesia report a 0.4 standard deviation improvement in sleep quality compared to those surveyed just before, and they perform better on cognitive tasks sensitive to sleep deprivation. The cash transfer appears to alleviate financial concerns for household heads—typically the breadwinners—improving their sleep. Postdisbursement, eligible households increase savings and reduce debts, and household heads feel less worried, frustrated, and tired. These effects are not observed in ineligible household heads or other members of eligible households. (JEL D12, D91, G51, I38, O12, O16)
records.abstract_cn: 利用断点回归设计，我们发现，在印度尼西亚无条件现金转移支付后不久接受调查的符合条件的户主，与在支付前接受调查的相比，睡眠质量改善了0.4个标准差，并且在对睡眠剥夺敏感的认知任务上表现更好。现金转移似乎缓解了户主（通常是养家者）的财务担忧，改善了他们的睡眠。支付后，符合条件的家庭增加了储蓄并减少了债务，户主感到更少的担忧、沮丧和疲惫。这些效应在不符合条件的户主或符合条件的家庭的其他成员中并未观察到。(JEL D12, D91, G51, I38, O12, O16)

records.title_en: Exploiting or Augmenting Labor?
records.title_cn: 剥削还是增强劳动力？
records.abstract_en: We show that existing “production approaches” to markdown estimation do not separately identify factor price markdowns from factor-augmenting productivity levels. We propose a method to overcome this challenge and apply it to study the effects of ownership liberalization in Chinese nonferrous metal industries. We find that private firms have much higher labor-augmenting productivity levels than state-owned enterprises (SOEs). However, we also find that private firms exert higher monopsony power over their workers than SOEs, although this only holds for domestically owned firms. This suggests that privatization policies imply a trade-off between increased productivity and monopsony power. (JEL D24, F23, J42, L33, L61, L72, P31)
records.abstract_cn: 我们表明，现有的“生产方法”在估算加价时无法将要素价格加价与要素增强型生产率水平区分开来。我们提出了一种克服这一挑战的方法，并将其应用于研究中国有色金属行业所有权自由化的影响。我们发现，私营企业的劳动增强型生产率水平远高于国有企业。然而，我们也发现，私营企业对工人施加的买方垄断力高于国有企业，尽管这仅适用于国内所有的企业。这表明私有化政策意味着生产率提升与买方垄断力之间的权衡。（JEL D24, F23, J42, L33, L61, L72, P31）

records.title_en: Minority Salience and Criminal Justice Decisions
records.title_cn: 少数族裔显著性对刑事司法决策的影响
records.abstract_en: Decision-makers can exhibit biases when they overemphasize particularly salient features under limited attention. We exploit a sudden salience shock involving individuals of Moroccan descent to examine biases within the Dutch criminal justice system. The salience shock concerned the assassination of a defense attorney by organized crime and thus specifically targeted the justice system. Leveraging high-quality data covering arrest through appeal, we find no impact on police or prosecutor decisions but uncover a 71 percent increase in sentence lengths imposed by judges on salient individuals. Heterogeneity analyses suggest that judge experience with minority suspects can mitigate bias in more discretionary decisions. (JEL D91, J15, K42)
records.abstract_cn: 决策者在有限注意力下过度强调某些显著特征时，可能会表现出偏见。我们利用涉及摩洛哥裔个体的突然显著性冲击来考察荷兰刑事司法系统中的偏见。该显著性冲击涉及一名辩护律师被有组织犯罪暗杀，因此特别针对司法系统。利用涵盖从逮捕到上诉的高质量数据，我们发现对警察或检察官决策没有影响，但发现法官对显著个体判处的刑期长度增加了71%。异质性分析表明，法官与少数族裔嫌疑人的经验可以在更具裁量权的决策中减轻偏见。(JEL D91, J15, K42)

records.title_en: Substitution Bias and Fixed-Weight Price Indices in Time-Dependent Pricing Models
records.title_cn: 时间依赖定价模型中的替代偏差与固定权重价格指数
records.abstract_en: This paper compares measured inflation in true and fixed-weight price indices. We construct model-based inflation measures in time-dependent pricing models that are analogous to measures of inflation in the data—for example, the consumer price index. In the standard new Keynesian model, when inflation rises rapidly, the differences between inflation in those indices and true price indices are increasing in the degree of price stickiness and the elasticity of substitution across goods. For commonly used parameter values, those differences are large and persistent for increases in inflation of the size seen after 2020 in the United States. (JEL E12, E31)
records.abstract_cn: 本文比较了真实价格指数与固定权重价格指数中测得的通货膨胀。我们在时间依赖定价模型中构建了基于模型的通胀度量，这些度量与数据中的通胀度量（例如消费者价格指数）类似。在标准新凯恩斯模型中，当通胀迅速上升时，这些指数与真实价格指数之间的差异随价格粘性程度和商品间替代弹性的增加而增大。对于常用的参数值，在美国2020年后出现的通胀上升幅度下，这些差异既大又持久。（JEL E12, E31）

records.title_en: On the Programmability and Uniformity of Digital Currencies
records.title_cn: 论数字货币的可编程性与统一性
records.abstract_en: Central bankers argue that programmable digital currencies may compromise the uniformity or singleness of money. We explore this view in a stylized model where programmable money arises endogenously, and differently programmed monies have varying liquidity. Programmability provides private value by easing commitment frictions but imposes social costs under informational frictions. Preserving uniformity is not necessarily socially beneficial. Banning programmable money lowers welfare when informational frictions are mild but improves it when commitment frictions are low. These insights suggest that programmable money could be more beneficial on permissionless blockchains, where it is difficult to commit but trades are publicly observable. (JEL D83, E42, E52, E58)
records.abstract_cn: 央行官员认为，可编程数字货币可能会损害货币的统一性或单一性。我们在一个程式化模型中探讨了这一观点，其中可编程货币内生地出现，且不同编程的货币具有不同的流动性。可编程性通过缓解承诺摩擦提供私人价值，但在信息摩擦下施加社会成本。保持统一性并不一定对社会有益。当信息摩擦较轻时，禁止可编程货币会降低福利，但当承诺摩擦较低时则会提高福利。这些见解表明，可编程货币在无需许可的区块链上可能更有益，因为在那里难以承诺但交易公开可观察。(JEL D83, E42, E52, E58)

records.title_en: The Price of War
records.title_cn: 战争的代价
records.abstract_en: We assemble a new dataset spanning 150 years and 60 countries to study the economic toll of war. A war of average intensity is associated with an output drop of close to 10 percent in the war-site economy, while consumer prices rise by approximately 20 percent. The capital stock, total factor productivity, and equity returns all decline sharply. The economic ramifications of war are not confined to the war site. The evidence points to adverse economic outcomes in other belligerent and third-party countries if they are exposed to the war site through trade linkages or share a common border.
records.abstract_cn: 我们收集了一个跨越 150 年和 60 个国家的新数据集来研究战争的经济损失。平均强度的战争会导致战地经济产出下降接近 10%，而消费者价格则上涨约 20%。资本存量、全要素生产率和股本回报率均大幅下降。战争的经济影响并不局限于战地。证据表明，如果其他交战国和第三方国家通过贸易联系暴露在战争现场或共享共同边界，则会产生不利的经济后果。

records.title_en: Immigration, Innovation, and Growth
records.title_cn: 移民、创新和增长
records.abstract_en: We propose a novel identification strategy to isolate exogenous immigration shocks across US counties, by interacting quasi-random variations in the composition of ancestry across counties with the contemporaneous inflow of migrants from different countries. We show a positive causal impact of immigration on local innovation and wages at the five-year horizon. The positive dynamic impact of immigration on innovation and wages dominates the short-run negative impact of increased labor supply. A structural estimation of a model of endogenous growth and migrations suggests the increased immigration to the United States since 1965 may have increased innovation and wages by 5 percent.
records.abstract_cn: 我们提出了一种新颖的识别策略，通过将各县血统构成的准随机变化与来自不同国家的移民的同期流入相互作用，来隔离美国各县的外源移民冲击。我们展示了移民对五年当地创新和工资的积极因果影响。移民对创新和工资的积极动态影响超过了劳动力供应增加的短期负面影响。对内生增长和移民模型的结构性估计表明，自1965以来美国移民的增加可能使创新和工资增加了5%。

records.title_en: Temporary Layoffs, Loss-of-Recall, and Cyclical Unemployment Dynamics
records.title_cn: 临时裁员、记忆丧失和周期性失业动态
records.abstract_en: We revisit the role of temporary layoffs in the business cycle. While some have emphasized a stabilizing effect due to recall hiring, we quantify from the data an important countercyclical destabilizing effect due to "loss-of-recall," whereby workers in temporary-layoff unemployment lose their job permanently. We develop a quantitative model allowing for endogenous flows of workers across employment and both temporary-layoff and jobless unemployment. The model captures both pre- and post-pandemic unemployment dynamics, including the contractionary role of loss-of-recall. We use our structural model to show that the Paycheck Protection Program generated sizable employment gains, in part by significantly reducing loss-of-recall.
records.abstract_cn: 我们重新审视临时裁员在商业周期中的作用。虽然有些人强调召回招聘带来的稳定效应，但我们从数据中量化了“召回丧失”带来的重要的反周期不稳定效应，即暂时失业的工人永久失去工作。我们开发了一个定量模型，允许工人在就业、临时失业和失业中进行内生流动。该模型捕捉了大流行前和大流行后的失业动态，包括记忆丧失的收缩作用。我们使用我们的结构模型来表明，薪资保护计划产生了可观的就业增长，部分原因是显着减少了记忆丧失。

records.title_en: Sequential Cursed Equilibrium
records.title_cn: 顺序诅咒平衡
records.abstract_en: We propose an extensive-form solution concept, with players who neglect information from hypothetical events but make inferences from observed events. Our concept modifies cursed equilibrium (Eyster and Rabin 2005) and allows that players can be cursed about endogenous information.
records.abstract_cn: 我们提出了一个广泛形式的解决方案概念，让参与者忽略来自假设事件的信息，但从观察到的事件中做出推断。我们的概念修改了诅咒平衡（Eyster 和 Rabin 2005），并允许玩家因内生信息而受到诅咒。

records.title_en: Equal Pay for Similar Work
records.title_cn: 类似工作同工同酬
records.abstract_en: Equal pay laws increasingly require that workers with different group identities doing "similar" work are paid equal wages within firm. We study such "equal pay for similar work" (EPSW) policies theoretically and test our models' predictions empirically using evidence from a 2009 gender-based Chilean EPSW. Under EPSW, firms segregate their workforce by gender. When there are more men than women in a labor market, EPSW increases the gender wage gap.
records.abstract_cn: 同工同酬法越来越多地要求具有不同群体身份、从事“类似”工作的工人在公司内获得同等工资。我们从理论上研究了这种“同工同酬”（EPSW）政策，并使用来自2009基于性别的智利 EPSW 的证据来实证检验我们模型的预测。根据 EPSW，公司按性别隔离员工。当劳动力市场中男性多于女性时，EPSW 会增加性别工资差距。

records.title_en: Dynamics of the Long-Term Housing Yield: Evidence from Natural Experiments
records.title_cn: 长期住房收益率的动态：来自自然实验的证据
records.abstract_en: Each month, a fraction of UK property leases are extended by 90 years or more. We construct a new dataset using thousands of these natural experiments since 2000 and estimate the expected long-term housing yield, y*. After remaining steady at around 5 percent, y* starts to decline when the Great Recession hits and reaches a low of 2.7 percent in 2024. The decline is steeper in inelastic markets, while y* remains higher in regions more exposed to long-run climate risk. Our estimate of y* is updated in real time using public data.
records.abstract_cn: 每个月，一小部分英国房产租约都会延长 90 年或更长。自2000以来，我们使用数千个这样的自然实验构建了一个新的数据集，并估计了预期的长期住房收益率 y*。在稳定在 5% 左右之后，当大衰退来袭时 y* 开始下降，并在 2.7% 达到 2024 的低点。在缺乏弹性的市场中，下降幅度更大，而在更容易受到长期气候风险影响的地区，y* 仍然较高。我们对 y* 的估计是使用公共数据实时更新的。

records.title_en: Zero-Sum Thinking and the Roots of US Political Differences
records.title_cn: 零-求和思维与美国政治分歧的根源
records.abstract_en: We investigate the origins and implications of zero-sum thinking: the belief that gains for one individual or group tend to come at the cost of others. Using a new survey of 20,400 US residents, we measure zero-sum thinking, political preferences, policy views, and a rich array of ancestral information spanning four generations. We find that a more zero-sum mindset is strongly associated with more support for government redistribution, race- and gender-based affirmative action, and more restrictive immigration policies. Zero-sum thinking can be traced back to the experiences of both the individual and their ancestors, encompassing factors such as the degree of intergenerational upward mobility they experienced, whether they immigrated to the United States or lived in a location with more immigrants, and whether they were enslaved or lived in a location with more enslavement.
records.abstract_cn: 我们研究了零求和思维的起源和含义：认为一个人或群体的收益往往是以他人为代价的。通过对 20,400 美国居民的一项新调查，我们测量了 零 和思维、政治偏好、政策观点以及跨越 四 代人的丰富祖先信息。我们发现，更多的零和心态与更多地支持政府再分配、基于种族和性别的平权行动以及更严格的移民政策密切相关。 零和思维可以追溯到个人及其祖先的经历，包括他们所经历的代际向上流动的程度、他们是否移民到美国或生活在移民较多的地方、他们是否被奴役或生活在被奴役较多的地方等因素。

records.title_en: What You Don't Know May Be Good for You
records.title_cn: 你不知道的事情可能对你有好处
records.abstract_en: We consider an economy in which long-lived experts are matched with short-lived clients. Experts choose the type of client with whom they match, unobserved by the market. The interaction outcome depends on both the expert's and the client's type. We study the effects of supplying information about otherwise unobservable outcomes, such as "medical report cards," to help clients identify better experts. Such information can lead to inefficient matches, as experts reject risky clients to build their reputation. Hence, information can reduce welfare. Withholding information can mitigate these perverse incentives at the cost of misallocating experts known to be inept.
records.abstract_cn: 我们考虑的经济是长期专家与短期客户相匹配。专家会选择与他们匹配的客户类型，而不是被市场观察到。交互结果取决于专家和客户的类型。我们研究提供有关其他不可观察结果的信息（例如“医疗报告卡”）的效果，以帮助客户找到更好的专家。此类信息可能会导致匹配效率低下，因为专家会拒绝有风险的客户以建立声誉。因此，信息可以减少福利。隐瞒信息可以减轻这些不正当的激励措施，但代价是错配已知无能的专家。

records.title_en: The Value of Clean Water: Experimental Evidence from Rural India
records.title_cn: 清洁水的价值：来自印度农村的实验证据
records.abstract_en: Over 2 billion people lack clean drinking water. Existing solutions face high costs (piped water) or low demand (point-of-use chlorine). Using a 60,000 household cluster-randomized experiment, we test an alternative approach: decentralized treatment and home delivery of clean water to the rural poor. At low prices, take-up exceeds 90 percent, sustained throughout the experiment. High prices reduce take-up but are privately profitable. We experimentally recover revealed-preference measures of valuation. Willingness-to-pay is several times higher than prior indirect estimates; willingness-to-accept is larger and exceeds marginal cost. Self-reported health measures improve accordingly. On a cost-per-DALY basis, free water delivery regimes appear highly cost effective.
records.abstract_cn: 超过2十亿人缺乏清洁饮用水。现有解决方案面临成本高（自来水）或需求低（使用点氯）的问题。通过60,000家庭整群随机实验，我们测试了另一种方法：分散处理并向农村贫困人口提供清洁水到家。在低价格下，使用率超过 90%，并在整个实验过程中持续。高价格减少了使用量，但私人盈利。我们通过实验恢复了估值的显示偏好度量。支付意愿比之前的间接估计高出数倍；接受意愿较大并超过边际成本。自我报告的健康指标相应改善。从每个伤残调整生命年的成本来看，免费供水制度似乎具有很高的成本效益。

records.title_en: Chinese vs. World Bank development projects: Insights from earth observation and computer vision on wealth gains in Africa, 2002–2013
records.title_cn: 中国与世界银行发展项目：基于地球观测和计算机视觉对非洲财富增长的洞察，2002-2013
records.abstract_en: Debates about whether development projects improve living conditions persist, partly because observational estimates can be biased by incomplete adjustment and because reliable outcome data are scarce at the neighborhood level. We address both issues in a continent-scale, sector-specific evaluation of Chinese and World Bank projects across 9899 neighborhoods in 36 African countries (2002-2013), representative of ∼88% of the population. First, we use a recent dataset that measures living conditions with a machine-learned wealth index derived from contemporaneous satellite imagery, yielding a consistent panel of 6.7 km square mosaics. Second, to strengthen identification, we proxy officials’ map-based placement criteria using pre-treatment daytime satellite images and fuse these with tabular covariates to estimate funder- and sector-specific ATEs via inverse-probability weighting. Incorporating imagery often shrinks effects relative to tabular-only models. On average, both donors raise wealth, with larger and more consistent gains for China; sector extremes in our sample include Trade and Tourism (330) for the World Bank (+12.29 IWI points), and Emergency Response (700) for China (+15.15). Assignment-mechanism analyses also show World Bank placement is often more predictable from imagery alone (as well as from tabular covariates). This suggests that Chinese project placements are more driven by non-visible, political, or event-driven factors than World Bank placements. To probe residual concerns about selection on observables, we also estimate within-neighborhood (unit) fixed-effects models at a spatial resolution about 67 times finer than prior fixed-effects analyses, leveraging the computer-vision-imputed IWI panels; these deliver smaller but, for Chinese projects, directionally consistent effects. Methodologically, we extend recent EO–ML causal inference frameworks by fusing pre-treatment satellite imagery with tabular covariates to estimate treatment propensities, and by systematically benchmarking image-augmented estimators against tabular-only and unit fixed-effects designs using new assignment-mechanism diagnostics. Empirically, we provide a continent-wide, sector-specific comparison of the neighborhood-level wealth effects of Chinese and World Bank projects across 9899 African neighborhoods.
records.abstract_cn: 关于发展项目是否改善生活条件的争论持续存在，部分原因是观测性估计可能因调整不完整而产生偏差，且邻里层面的可靠结果数据稀缺。我们在一个覆盖非洲36个国家9899个邻里、代表约88%%人口的大陆尺度、部门特定评估中解决了这两个问题，评估对象为中国和世界银行的项目（2002-2013）。首先，我们使用一个近期数据集，该数据集通过从同期卫星图像中机器学习得出的财富指数来衡量生活条件，生成了一致的6.7平方公里方格马赛克面板。其次，为加强识别，我们使用处理前的白天卫星图像来代理官员基于地图的选址标准，并将这些图像与表格协变量融合，通过逆概率加权估计资助方和部门特定的平均处理效应（ATE）。纳入图像通常相对于仅使用表格模型会缩小效应。平均而言，两个捐助方都提高了财富，其中中国的增益更大且更一致；我们样本中的部门极端值包括世界银行的贸易和旅游（330，+12.29 IWI点）以及中国的应急响应（700，+15.15）。分配机制分析还显示，世界银行的项目选址通常更可预测，仅从图像（以及表格协变量）即可预测。这表明中国项目的选址更多受非可见、政治或事件驱动因素影响，而非世界银行项目。为探究关于可观测变量选择的残余担忧，我们还估计了邻里内（单元）固定效应模型，其空间分辨率比先前固定效应分析精细约67倍，利用计算机视觉插补的IWI面板；这些模型得出的效应较小，但对于中国项目而言方向一致。在方法上，我们通过将处理前卫星图像与表格协变量融合以估计处理倾向，并使用新的分配机制诊断系统地将图像增强估计器与仅表格和单元固定效应设计进行基准比较，扩展了近期EO-ML因果推断框架。在实证上，我们提供了中国和世界银行项目在9899个非洲邻里层面的财富效应的大陆范围、部门特定比较。

records.title_en: Agri-labour mobility in a changing climate: A systems approach to vulnerability and precarity among migrant farmworkers
records.title_cn: 气候变化中的农业劳动力流动：移民农场工人脆弱性与不稳定性的系统方法
records.abstract_en: This research explores the climate vulnerability of migrant farmworkers within the climate-sensitive commercial agriculture of the Mediterranean Basin, through a case study of Turkey. In Turkey a vast majority of the farmworkers belong to Kurdish and Arab ethnic groups, including internally displaced people (IDPs) and Syrians. Utilising a critical political economy approach to vulnerability and synthesising a decade of qualitative data, we examine farmworkers’ experience of climate change. The findings demonstrate that climate vulnerability operates across three interconnected levels: (1) direct exposure to climate extremes, (2) indirect socio-economic impacts on livelihoods, social and political vulnerabilities, and (3) systemic effects arising from the interaction of multiple climate events across multiple locations of labour. To this end, we introduce the concept of agri-labour mobility systems. These operate through an ad hoc system of routes shaped by labour demands at specific points in production cycles and the minimum income thresholds required to offset the costs of migration. This framework allows us to analyse vulnerability beyond hazard-based frameworks by incorporating the political economy of farm labour and emphasising intersecting social, economic, political, and climate-related vulnerabilities. Finally, we assert that experiences with climate change for mobile livelihoods can only be understood by looking at the migration routes, multiple commodities and locations and the continuity of the experiences with the climate irregularities.
records.abstract_cn: 本研究通过土耳其的案例研究，探讨了地中海盆地气候敏感型商业化农业中移民农场工人的气候脆弱性。在土耳其，绝大多数农场工人属于库尔德和阿拉伯族群，包括境内流离失所者（IDPs）和叙利亚人。采用批判性政治经济学方法分析脆弱性，并综合十年的定性数据，我们考察了农场工人对气候变化的经历。研究结果表明，气候脆弱性在三个相互关联的层面上运作：（1）直接暴露于气候极端事件，（2）对生计的间接社会经济影响、社会和政治脆弱性，以及（3）由多个气候事件在多个劳动地点相互作用产生的系统性效应。为此，我们引入了农业劳动力流动系统的概念。这些系统通过由生产周期特定点的劳动力需求和抵消迁移成本所需的最低收入门槛所塑造的临时路线系统运作。该框架使我们能够超越基于灾害的框架分析脆弱性，通过纳入农场劳动力的政治经济学，并强调社会、经济、政治和气候相关脆弱性的交叉性。最后，我们断言，对于流动生计而言，气候变化的经历只能通过考察迁移路线、多种商品和地点以及气候异常经历的连续性来理解。

records.title_en: Complexity in institutional reform
records.title_cn: 制度改革的复杂性
records.abstract_en: Why is there so much institutional reform in the world? If institutions are the deep rules of the game that determine how societies are governed, collective decisions taken, and resources mobilized for public purposes, then changing them is bound to have effects that are long-run and multidimensional across politics, the economy and society. Such effects will be unpredictable. Politicians with short time horizons should flee such initiatives, but instead embrace them the world over. Why? Because politicians design reform processes around often unstated private goals that may be orthogonal, or even directly opposed, to a reform’s stated, public goals. We characterize instrumental mismatch as the gap between stated goals and the specific reform instruments politicians deploy. Such reforms lead to incongruous institutions ill-suited to their core purpose, and hence to outcomes that are bad for society. Through 13 case studies from Latin America, India, Rwanda and the UK, we test and refine the theory. High instrumental mismatch leads to incongruous institutions in all our cases. Stated goals are never achieved, but private goals are. This is by design. Incongruous institutions sometimes produce good outcomes for reformers, but not for society. Low mismatch leads to institutions that are mostly congruous. Stated goals are always achieved. This makes sense: politicians’ private goals do not conflict with reform’s stated goals, increasing reform coherence. Ex-post, such reforms are good for society but bad for reformers. Medium mismatch also produces incongruous institutions. Stated goals and private goals are sometimes achieved. Outcomes for society are generally poor – not surprising given incomplete reform design and implementation. A twelfth article mines this evidence to propose three game-theoretic models of institutional change from a complex systems perspective. Taken together, we call this the complexity approach to institutional reform.
records.abstract_cn: 为什么世界上有如此多的制度改革？如果制度是决定社会如何治理、集体决策如何做出以及资源如何为公共目的而动员的深层游戏规则，那么改变它们必然会产生跨政治、经济和社会的长期且多维的影响。这些影响将是不可预测的。任期较短的政治家应回避此类举措，但他们在世界各地却纷纷拥抱它们。为什么？因为政治家围绕通常未言明的私人目标设计改革过程，这些目标可能与改革所宣称的公共目标正交，甚至直接对立。我们将工具性错位定义为所宣称的目标与政治家所部署的具体改革工具之间的差距。此类改革导致与其核心目的不相适应的不协调制度，从而产生对社会不利的结果。通过来自拉丁美洲、印度、卢旺达和英国的13个案例研究，我们检验并完善了这一理论。在所有案例中，高工具性错位导致不协调的制度。所宣称的目标从未实现，但私人目标得以实现。这是设计使然。不协调的制度有时为改革者带来良好结果，但对社会不利。低错位导致大体协调的制度。所宣称的目标总能实现。这很合理：政治家的私人目标与改革的宣称目标不冲突，增强了改革的一致性。事后看来，此类改革对社会有利但对改革者不利。中等错位也产生不协调的制度。所宣称的目标和私人目标有时得以实现。社会结果通常较差——鉴于改革设计和实施不完整，这并不令人意外。第十二篇文章挖掘这些证据，从复杂系统视角提出了三个制度变迁的博弈论模型。综合来看，我们称之为制度改革的复杂性方法。

records.title_en: Conflict and democratic preferences
records.title_cn: 冲突和民主偏好
records.abstract_en: We investigate how exposure to conflict events shapes individuals’ democratic preferences, focusing on support for democracy in general and perceptions of governance within one’s own country. We examine how ethnic affiliation—whether an individual belongs to an ethnic group with access to state power—influences democratic attitudes, reflecting differences in social standing and expectations about democratization. Using a rich data set covering more than 30 African countries over two decades, we exploit variation in the timing of conflict events relative to survey interviews to identify causal effects. Our findings show that conflict exposure, on average, increases support for democracy, but the effects vary by ethnicity and regime type. In autocracies, conflict triggers rally-around-the-flag effects: support for democracy rises, but so do perceptions of the state. Violence also increases trust in ruling institutions in autocratic regimes, an effect that is absent in more democratic settings.
records.abstract_cn: 我们研究冲突事件如何影响个人的民主偏好，重点关注对总体民主的支持以及对自己国家治理的看法。我们研究种族归属（个人是否属于有权获得国家权力的种族群体）如何影响民主态度，反映社会地位和对民主化期望的差异。我们使用覆盖超过30个非洲国家二十年的丰富数据集，利用冲突事件相对于调查访谈的时间变化来确定因果影响。我们的研究结果表明，平均而言，接触冲突会增加对民主的支持，但效果因种族和政体类型而异。在独裁国家，冲突会引发团结效应：对民主的支持上升，但对国家的看法也随之上升。暴力还增加了对独裁政权统治机构的信任，而这种效果在更民主的环境中是不存在的。

records.title_en: Developing a multidimensional resilience index for farm households: A food system approach
records.title_cn: 构建农户多维韧性指数：一种食物系统方法
records.abstract_en: Existing measures of resilience focus on specific food system components, neglecting the complexity of the whole system. We propose a measure of farm-level resilience that encompasses three dimensions of a food system: economic profitability, environmental sustainability, and adequate nutrition. To empirically estimate the proposed model, we combine longitudinal household-level data from Malawi, Tanzania, and Nigeria with GIS data and macro-level indicators. We define resilience as a normative condition using a probabilistic moment-based approach following Cissé & Barrett (2018). To aggregate the probabilities across different dimensions into a single index of resilience, we employ and compare two different methods: Principal Component Analysis (PCA) and the Multiple Indicators Multiple Causes (MIMIC) model. Our findings indicate an overall increase in the resilience of farm households over time, with improvements in Nigeria and Tanzania. Clear trade-offs are evident across the various domains of the food system. Both proposed resilience indexes perform well when analyzed across different shocks and alternative specifications. Resilience tends to support improvements in certain dimensions without undermining others. The comparison between the two methods indicates a preference for the simpler PCA-based approach to measuring farm households’ resilience using a food system approach. Our findings underline the need to broaden our focus beyond individual aspects of resilience to achieve sustainable food systems.
records.abstract_cn: 现有的韧性度量侧重于食物系统的特定组成部分，忽视了整个系统的复杂性。我们提出了一种农场层面韧性的度量方法，涵盖了食物系统的三个维度：经济盈利能力、环境可持续性和充足营养。为了实证估计所提出的模型，我们将来自马拉维、坦桑尼亚和尼日利亚的纵向家庭层面数据与GIS数据和宏观层面指标相结合。我们将韧性定义为一种规范性条件，采用基于概率矩的方法，遵循Cissé & Barrett (2018)。为了将不同维度的概率聚合为单一的韧性指数，我们采用并比较了两种不同的方法：主成分分析（PCA）和多指标多原因（MIMIC）模型。我们的研究结果表明，农户的韧性随时间总体增加，其中尼日利亚和坦桑尼亚有所改善。食物系统的各个领域之间存在明显的权衡。所提出的两种韧性指数在不同冲击和替代规格下均表现良好。韧性倾向于支持某些维度的改善，而不损害其他维度。两种方法的比较表明，在采用食物系统方法测量农户韧性时，更倾向于基于PCA的简单方法。我们的研究结果强调，需要将关注点扩展到韧性的个体方面之外，以实现可持续的食物系统。

records.title_en: Urbanisation and the political demography of African cities
records.title_cn: 城市化与非洲城市的政治人口学
records.abstract_en: Africa is undergoing a rapid process of urban demographic change. Increasingly youthful population structures are defining the continent’s towns and cities. Scholarship suggests this will be associated with greater protest incidence and lower levels of voting and electoral participation. However, these findings often rely on national-level data, despite there being considerable subnational variation in population structures between African cities. Building on existing theory, we argue that local demographic contexts matter for political behaviour. Specifically, we hypothesise that youthful urban demographic structures will be associated with lower levels of formal political participation (voting) and greater levels of informal contentious mobilisation (protest) for all individuals, and that the magnitude of this effect will be greater for younger people. We test these expectations using novel geospatial data on the spatial extent of unique urban settlements, urban-level age and sex structures, and geolocated individual-level survey data from 399 cities in 36 countries across Africa. Using multilevel regression, we find that individuals are more likely to vote in more youthful urban contexts, with young people no more or less likely to vote than their older counterparts. Conversely, we find no significant relationship between individual protest participation and city youth shares overall. However, young people in more youthful cities are significantly more likely to protest than older people. In light of these findings, we discuss how the demographic composition of individual cities in Africa nuances our understanding of political behaviour and contentious mobilisation.
records.abstract_cn: 非洲正在经历快速的城市人口变化过程。日益年轻化的人口结构正在定义该大陆的城镇。学术研究表明，这将与更高的抗议发生率和较低的投票及选举参与度相关。然而，这些发现往往依赖于国家级数据，尽管非洲各城市之间的人口结构存在相当大的次国家级差异。基于现有理论，我们认为地方人口背景对政治行为至关重要。具体而言，我们假设年轻化的城市人口结构将与所有个体较低水平的正式政治参与（投票）和较高水平的非正式抗争动员（抗议）相关，且这一效应的幅度对年轻人更大。我们使用关于独特城市聚落空间范围的新颖地理空间数据、城市层面的年龄和性别结构，以及来自非洲36个国家399个城市的地理定位个体层面调查数据来检验这些预期。通过多层次回归，我们发现个体在更年轻化的城市环境中更有可能投票，而年轻人与年长者相比，投票可能性并无显著差异。相反，我们总体上未发现个体抗议参与与城市青年比例之间存在显著关系。然而，在更年轻化的城市中，年轻人比年长者更有可能参与抗议。鉴于这些发现，我们讨论了非洲各城市的人口构成如何细化我们对政治行为和抗争动员的理解。

records.title_en: Improving police management boosts economic development: Evidence from Brazil
records.title_cn: 改善警务管理促进经济发展：来自巴西的证据
records.abstract_en: This paper provides causal evidence that improving public security can stimulate local economic development. Leveraging a staggered adoption of results-based police reforms across Brazilian states and applying a double robust difference-in-differences design, I find that reductions in violence significantly boosted formal job creation and entrepreneurship. Specifically, treated municipalities experienced increases of 7–10% relative to control means in employment and business formation. Heterogeneity analyses reveal that, while the largest crime reductions occurred in high-violence areas, economic benefits were larger in cities with lower baseline violence, highlighting the importance of initial security conditions for development gains. These findings demonstrate that strengthening public institutions can produce substantial economic externalities, suggesting that crime reduction policies can be key levers for inclusive growth in middle-income countries.
records.abstract_cn: 本文提供了因果证据，表明改善公共安全可以刺激地方经济发展。利用巴西各州逐步采用基于结果的警务改革，并应用双重稳健双重差分设计，我发现暴力事件的减少显著促进了正规就业创造和创业活动。具体而言，处理组城市在就业和企业成立方面相对于对照组均值增加了7-10%。异质性分析显示，虽然最大的犯罪减少发生在高暴力地区，但经济收益在基线暴力较低的城市更大，这凸显了初始安全条件对发展收益的重要性。这些发现表明，加强公共机构可以产生显著的经济外部性，暗示减少犯罪的政策可以成为中等收入国家包容性增长的关键杠杆。

records.title_en: Individual entrepreneurial orientation from an economic lens: The U-shaped relationship with economic development and income inequality
records.title_cn: 从经济学视角看个体创业导向：与经济发展和收入不平等的U型关系
records.abstract_en: While the economic development-entrepreneurship nexus has been widely studied, the individual entrepreneurial orientation (Ind.EO) phenomenon has not considered development stages across countries, where important differences ranging from poverty to wealth exist. This study investigates the relationship between the level of economic development and individual entrepreneurial orientation, analyzing the moderating role of income inequality. We conducted robust multilevel regression analysis on a sample of 30,292 nascent entrepreneurs from 29 economies drawn from the 2020–2021 Global University Entrepreneurship Spirit Students’ Survey (GUESSS). The findings demonstrate a U-shaped relationship between economic development and Ind.EO, where dispositional-behavioral characteristics are more pronounced in economies situated at both extremes of the development spectrum. Income inequality negatively moderates this curvilinear relationship, producing a flattening effect that reduces entrepreneurial intensity in both low- and high-development contexts. This study offers some of the first empirical evidence on Ind.EO from a cross-national economic perspective and provides valuable guidance for policymakers seeking to promote entrepreneurship through strategies tailored to development stages and mechanisms that mitigate the adverse effects of inequality.
records.abstract_cn: 尽管经济发展与创业之间的关系已被广泛研究，但个体创业导向（Ind.EO）现象尚未考虑各国的发展阶段，这些阶段存在从贫困到财富的重大差异。本研究探讨了经济发展水平与个体创业导向之间的关系，并分析了收入不平等的调节作用。我们对来自29个经济体的30,292名新生创业者样本进行了稳健的多层次回归分析，数据来源于2020-2021年全球大学创业精神学生调查（GUESSS）。研究结果表明，经济发展与Ind.EO之间存在U型关系，其中倾向性-行为特征在发展谱系两端的经济体中更为显著。收入不平等对这种曲线关系产生负向调节作用，产生一种扁平化效应，在低发展和高发展情境下均降低了创业强度。本研究提供了从跨国经济视角对Ind.EO的首批实证证据之一，并为政策制定者提供了宝贵指导，以通过针对发展阶段量身定制的策略和减轻不平等不利影响的机制来促进创业。

records.title_en: The development revolution will not be nudged: The c2-frame approach as a proposal
records.title_cn: 发展革命不会被轻推：作为提议的c2框架方法
records.abstract_en: The intertwined dynamics of promoting development and preserving the environment has increasingly been affected by global structures and processes. It is not sufficient that communities engage in local collective action processes when global dynamics in economic and ecological systems are threatening them, even if they solve their local cooperation problems. The recent debate generated by the i-frame/s-frame controversy by Chater & Loewenstein (2023) is used here as a start to propose a framework for solving such divide and offer an approach where elements of the individual behavior (i-frame mechanisms) are brought together in the c2-frame community level, and trigger dynamics that bring change in the s-frame. A c2-frame dynamic involves the scaling up of local collective action processes achieving an s-frame transformation. Behavioral sciences can offer cues on how these processes reach transformational change.
records.abstract_cn: 促进发展与保护环境之间的交织动态日益受到全球结构和进程的影响。当全球经济与生态系统动态威胁到社区时，即使它们解决了本地合作问题，仅靠社区参与地方集体行动过程也是不够的。本文以Chater & Loewenstein（2023）引发的i-frame/s-frame争议为起点，提出一个解决这一分歧的框架，并提供一种方法，将个体行为元素（i-frame机制）汇集到c2框架的社区层面，并触发带来s-frame变革的动态。c2框架动态涉及地方集体行动过程的升级，实现s-frame转型。行为科学可以为这些过程如何实现转型性变革提供线索。

records.title_en: Hidden work-family challenges in the low- and middle-income countries: a systematic review of causes, consequences, and policy responses
records.title_cn: 低收入和中等收入国家中隐藏的工作-家庭挑战：原因、后果和政策应对的系统综述
records.abstract_en: Work–family challenges are a major barrier to gender equality and contribute to the intergenerational reproduction of inequalities by undermining child development from the earliest stages of life. In low- and middle-income countries (LMICs), however, these tensions remain poorly captured by prevailing metrics, data, and frameworks. Drawing on a systematic review of qualitative and quantitative studies published between 2000 and 2024, this article shows that motherhood penalties in LMICs are expressed through poverty-driven sectoral shifts into lower-quality jobs, heightened time poverty and what we term a work-family trade-off, where maternal employment in precarious conditions is associated with worse child health and developmental outcomes. We synthesize evidence on how micro-, meso- and macro-level factors jointly shape these patterns and highlight a “flexibility trap”: informal and agricultural jobs that appear compatible with caregiving in theory often deepen work-family tensions in practice. We then review empirical evidence on three family policy domains (i.e., paid leave, cash transfers, and early childhood education and care (ECEC)) showing that ECEC most consistently improves both women’s employment quality and child outcomes, while cash transfers primarily ease poverty-driven labor responses and paid leave yield mixed effects in high-informality settings. Building on these findings, we develop a conceptual framework that locates “poverty-driven work-family challenges” at the center of LMIC experiences. The review concludes with design principles for family policies and a research agenda that better captures hidden work-family tensions in LMICs.
records.abstract_cn: 工作-家庭挑战是性别平等的主要障碍，并通过从生命早期阶段损害儿童发展，促成不平等的代际再生产。然而，在低收入和中等收入国家（LMICs）中，这些紧张关系在主流指标、数据和框架中仍未得到充分捕捉。基于对2000年至2024年间发表的定性和定量研究的系统综述，本文表明，LMICs中的母职惩罚表现为贫困驱动的部门转移至低质量工作、时间贫困加剧以及我们称之为工作-家庭权衡的现象，即在不稳定条件下的母亲就业与较差的儿童健康和发育结果相关。我们综合了微观、中观和宏观层面因素如何共同塑造这些模式的证据，并强调了一种“灵活性陷阱”：理论上看似与照护兼容的非正规和农业工作，在实践中往往加深工作-家庭紧张关系。随后，我们回顾了三个家庭政策领域（即带薪休假、现金转移和早期儿童教育和照护（ECEC））的经验证据，表明ECEC最一致地改善了女性就业质量和儿童结果，而现金转移主要缓解贫困驱动的劳动响应，带薪休假在高非正规性环境中产生混合效应。基于这些发现，我们构建了一个概念框架，将“贫困驱动的工作-家庭挑战”置于LMIC经历的中心。综述最后提出了家庭政策的设计原则和研究议程，以更好地捕捉LMICs中隐藏的工作-家庭紧张关系。

records.title_en: Sustainability governance diversifies: unpacking private-sector governance strategies in coffee and cocoa value chains
records.title_cn: 可持续性治理的多元化：解析咖啡和可可价值链中的私营部门治理策略
records.abstract_en: Certification schemes remain a main strategy for sustainability of agri-food value chains, but sustainability governance is diversifying. Various alternative or complementary strategies to certification have emerged, but sustainability governance research faces challenges to precisely compare them, identify agency for sustainability governance at multiple sites, and grasp the complex and evolving overlaps between strategies. Therefore, this study aims to understand the similarities, differences and overlaps of six key contemporary strategies of sustainability governance—corporate sustainability programmes, certification, direct trade, mission-driven businesses, solidarity economy and producer-led upgrading. To do so, it pioneers an analytical framework that can be used to unpack sustainability governance strategies by examining their constitutional, value chain, and operational attributes, which we apply to survey data on 112 organizations in the cocoa and coffee value chains of Switzerland and Peru. Results show that the strategies differ clearly in terms of 118 constitutional, value chain, and operational attributes and they demonstrate frequent and insightful linkages across levels. The study also identifies significant overlaps, particularly between certification and other strategies, as value chain actors typically combine attributes from different strategies. Results indicate that sustainability governance research would benefit from contextualizing strategies within an actor’s value chain position and its constitutional attributes, to account for multi-sited agency along the entire value chain and diversity in terms of actors’ mission and ownership.
records.abstract_cn: 认证计划仍然是农产品价值链可持续性的主要策略，但可持续性治理正在多元化。各种替代或补充认证的策略已经出现，但可持续性治理研究在精确比较这些策略、识别多个地点的可持续性治理机构以及把握策略之间复杂且不断演变的重叠方面面临挑战。因此，本研究旨在理解六种当代关键的可持续性治理策略——企业可持续性计划、认证、直接贸易、使命驱动型企业、团结经济和生产商主导的升级——之间的相似性、差异性和重叠性。为此，本研究开创了一个分析框架，通过考察其宪法属性、价值链属性和运营属性来解析可持续性治理策略，并将该框架应用于对瑞士和秘鲁的可可和咖啡价值链中112个组织的调查数据。结果表明，这些策略在118宪法属性、价值链属性和运营属性方面存在明显差异，并显示出跨层级的频繁且富有洞察力的联系。研究还识别出显著的重叠，特别是认证与其他策略之间的重叠，因为价值链参与者通常结合不同策略的属性。结果表明，可持续性治理研究将受益于将策略置于参与者的价值链位置及其宪法属性背景下，以考虑整个价值链上的多点机构以及参与者使命和所有权方面的多样性。

records.title_en: Reservoir construction and deforestation
records.title_cn: 水库建设与森林砍伐
records.abstract_en: This study investigates the impact of reservoir construction on surrounding deforestation. We construct a unique panel dataset at the reservoir level across China for 2005, 2010, and 2015. By adopting instruments that combine information of geographical features and projected reservoir numbers, our two-stage least squares (2SLS) estimates of the difference-in-differences (DID) model reveal that the construction of an average reservoir accelerates the decline in the Normalized Difference Vegetation Index (NDVI) by 0.095 (12.94% of the sample mean) within its 5 km buffer zone in the first five years post-construction, indicating an exacerbation in deforestation. We further find that the construction of smaller reservoirs leads to more severe deforestation, where a reduction of one square kilometer in reservoir area results in an additional decrease in NDVI by 0.001. Our findings highlight the urgency for policymakers to thoroughly evaluate the effects of reservoir construction on forests and devise appropriate conservation strategies when making investment decisions.
records.abstract_cn: 本研究探讨了水库建设对周边森林砍伐的影响。我们构建了一个覆盖中国2005、2010和2015年的水库层面独特面板数据集。通过采用结合地理特征和预测水库数量的工具变量，我们的两阶段最小二乘法（2SLS）对双重差分（DID）模型的估计结果显示，在建设后的前五年内，平均规模水库的建设使其5公里缓冲区内归一化植被指数（NDVI）的下降速度加快了0.095（占样本均值的12.94%），表明森林砍伐加剧。我们进一步发现，较小水库的建设会导致更严重的森林砍伐，水库面积每减少一平方公里，NDVI额外下降0.001。我们的发现凸显了政策制定者在做出投资决策时，迫切需要全面评估水库建设对森林的影响，并制定适当的保护策略。

records.title_en: Who runs the NGOs? Women’s access to leadership in Nepal
records.title_cn: 谁在运营非政府组织？尼泊尔女性进入领导层的途径
records.abstract_en: Studies on women’s barriers to win political office have been burgeoning in recent years, but few studies look beyond politics. We extend this scholarship to the voluntary sector by focusing on women’s access to leadership, and potential causes of gender discrimination, in NGOs in Nepal. Based on existing studies on gender and leadership, as well as our fieldwork in Nepal, we expected that leaders from NGOs prefer a male leader. The results from a conjoint experiment, conducted with 385 leaders representing unique local NGOs, reveal—contrary to our hypothesis—that female candidates are significantly more likely to be selected than male candidates. Drawing on survey data and interview material, we argue that the discrepancy between stated preferences and actual practices can be explained by three factors—the illusion of an ideal candidate, organizational culture, and practical hurdles—which ultimately lead to unequal treatment of women. Our study offers an initial inside look at gender inequalities in leadership roles within local NGOs in the Global South, an area where systematic data has been scarce. Additionally, our mixed-methods approach presents a nuanced understanding of the causes and potential support measures to promote greater equality in this crucial social sector.
records.abstract_cn: 近年来，关于女性在赢得政治职位方面所面临障碍的研究日益增多，但很少有研究超越政治领域。我们将这一学术研究扩展到志愿部门，聚焦于尼泊尔非政府组织中女性进入领导层的机会以及性别歧视的潜在原因。基于现有的关于性别与领导力的研究以及我们在尼泊尔的实地调查，我们预期非政府组织的领导者更倾向于男性领导者。一项针对385名代表独特地方非政府组织的领导者进行的联合实验结果显示——与我们的假设相反——女性候选人被选中的可能性显著高于男性候选人。利用调查数据和访谈材料，我们认为，陈述偏好与实际做法之间的差异可以由三个因素解释——理想候选人的幻觉、组织文化和实际障碍——这些最终导致了对女性的不平等对待。我们的研究为全球南方地方非政府组织内领导角色中的性别不平等提供了初步的内部视角，这一领域的系统性数据一直稀缺。此外，我们的混合方法方法提供了对原因和潜在支持措施的细致理解，以促进这一关键社会部门中更大的平等。

records.title_en: Benchmarking property institutions: conceptual background and evidence from 85 jurisdictions
records.title_cn: 产权制度基准评估：概念背景与来自85个司法管辖区的证据
records.abstract_en: Property registries are a pillar of state capacity that is essential for private investment and job creation. While registry establishment and maintenance were traditionally costly and difficult, digital technology can, if appropriate regulations and institutional arrangements are in place, reduce delivery cost and increase quality and usefulness of land records. We develop indicators for effective registry operation in terms of digital coverage, interoperability, public land management, and land value capture. By highlighting vast differences across regions but also significant advances, data from 85 countries show that such indicators can help provide strategic direction, share experience, and measure progress towards realizing property registries’ potential in terms of (i) empowering private right holders to invest and create the basis for land, mortgage and insurance markets; (ii) providing the information needed to transparently regulate markets and use of land; and (iii) foster effective decentralization in management of public land and land value capture for public good provision.
records.abstract_cn: 产权登记是国家能力的一个支柱，对于私人投资和就业创造至关重要。虽然登记处的建立和维护传统上成本高昂且困难重重，但数字技术，在适当的法规和制度安排到位的情况下，可以降低交付成本并提高土地记录的质量和实用性。我们开发了衡量有效登记处运营的指标，涵盖数字覆盖、互操作性、公共土地管理和土地价值捕获等方面。通过突出各地区之间的巨大差异以及显著进展，来自85个国家的数据表明，此类指标有助于提供战略方向、分享经验，并衡量在实现产权登记潜力方面的进展，具体包括：(i) 赋予私人权利持有人投资能力，并为土地、抵押和保险市场奠定基础；(ii) 提供透明监管市场和土地利用所需的信息；(iii) 促进公共土地管理和土地价值捕获的有效分权，以提供公共产品。

records.title_en: Do ‘Women hold up half the sky’ in fuel choices? Revisiting the role of adolescent empowerment in a developing country context
records.title_cn: 女性是否“顶起半边天”在燃料选择中？重新审视发展中国家背景下青少年赋权的作用
records.abstract_en: In this paper, we study the impact of a multidimensional women’s empowerment programme in India, known as SABLA, on the choice of cooking fuel within the household. The programme, launched in 2010 as a pilot project in 205 districts of the country, provided support to women across a multitude of dimensions. We exploit plausibly exogenous geographic and cohort variation generated in the implementation of the SABLA programme using a difference-in-difference identification design. The results of our study, based on this quasi-experimental methodology and using data on 21 states of India from the DLHS-4 survey, suggest that women potentially exposed to the SABLA empowerment programme were more likely to use cleaner and efficient modern cooking fuels post-marriage. This high usage of modern cooking fuels is matched by a fall in the likelihood of using inefficient transitional and traditional cooking fuels. We also show that women potentially exposed to the programme now exhibit improved health behaviors in the context of their children’s as well as their own health. These improved health behaviors, when combined with the empowering effects of the programme in other domains, as evidenced by the literature, serve as potential mechanisms for our effects. The results of our study remain robust to a variety of sensitivity checks and analyses.
records.abstract_cn: 在本文中，我们研究了印度一项名为SABLA的多维度女性赋权项目对家庭烹饪燃料选择的影响。该项目于2010年作为试点项目在该国205个地区启动，为女性提供了多方面的支持。我们利用SABLA项目实施中产生的看似外生的地理和队列变异，采用双重差分识别设计。基于这一准实验方法，并使用来自DLHS-4调查的印度21个州的数据，我们的研究结果表明，可能接触过SABLA赋权项目的女性在婚后更有可能使用清洁高效的现代烹饪燃料。现代烹饪燃料的高使用率伴随着使用低效过渡性和传统烹饪燃料可能性的下降。我们还表明，可能接触过该项目的女性在子女及自身健康方面表现出改善的健康行为。这些改善的健康行为，结合文献中证明的项目在其他领域的赋权效应，构成了我们效应的潜在机制。我们的研究结果在各种敏感性检验和分析中保持稳健。

records.title_en: Lithium for the global energy transition: how global forces and national legacies are driving resource-based development in South America
records.title_cn: 锂与全球能源转型：全球力量与国家遗产如何推动南美洲的资源型发展
records.abstract_en: Minerals are central to the global energy transition, and resource-rich countries increasingly view this context as a window of opportunity for development. Yet, despite broadly shared objectives, they have adopted markedly different strategies in terms of their goals, scope, policy instruments, and the balance of authority between state and market actors. Focusing on the case of lithium in Bolivia, Chile, and Argentina, this article firstly develops a typology of lithium-based development strategies: Neoliberal, State-led, and Hybrid. Secondly, it traces the evolution of these strategies and explains their divergence through the interplay between external forces –such as international development paradigms and technological or market dynamics– and domestic historical legacies. While external factors may favour certain strategic orientations, we argue that domestic institutional legacies have been decisive in defining the scope and direction of state action. The study provides new insights into how resource-rich countries manage the challenges and opportunities of the energy transition by navigating the complex interaction between international pressures and domestic constraints to reposition themselves within global supply chains.
records.abstract_cn: 矿产对全球能源转型至关重要，资源丰富的国家日益将这一背景视为发展的机遇窗口。然而，尽管目标大致相同，它们在目标、范围、政策工具以及国家与市场行为体之间的权力平衡方面采取了显著不同的策略。本文以玻利维亚、智利和阿根廷的锂矿案例为焦点，首先构建了基于锂的发展策略类型学：新自由主义、国家主导和混合型。其次，它追溯了这些策略的演变，并通过外部力量——如国际发展范式和技术或市场动态——与国内历史遗产之间的相互作用来解释其差异。虽然外部因素可能偏向某些战略取向，但我们认为，国内制度遗产在界定国家行动的范围和方向上具有决定性作用。本研究为资源丰富国家如何通过应对国际压力与国内约束之间的复杂互动，在全球供应链中重新定位自身，从而管理能源转型的挑战与机遇提供了新的见解。

records.title_en: Can cash improve diet quality in old age? evidence from a large-scale unconditional transfer
records.title_cn: 现金能否改善老年时期的饮食质量？来自大规模无条件转移支付的证据
records.abstract_en: We examine the impact of an unconditional cash transfer program on diet quality and food consumption among older adults using cross-sectional data and a regression discontinuity design that exploits age and poverty eligibility thresholds. We find that participation in the program significantly improves diet quality (10%) and food expenditure, particularly among females. Effects are larger among younger elderly, historically disadvantaged, and those receiving higher transfers. However, program benefits diminish with age and are muted in places with a longer distance to food retailers. Findings highlight the need for complementary behavioral and structural interventions to strengthen the nutritional impact of cash transfers among older adults in low-and-middle-income countries.
records.abstract_cn: 我们利用横截面数据和回归不连续设计，利用年龄和贫困资格门槛，考察了无条件现金转移支付项目对老年人饮食质量和食品消费的影响。我们发现，参与该项目显著改善了饮食质量（10%）和食品支出，尤其是在女性中。影响在较年轻的老年人、历史上处于弱势地位的人群以及获得较高转移支付的人群中更大。然而，项目收益随年龄增长而减少，并且在距离食品零售商较远的地方效果减弱。研究结果强调了需要补充行为和政策干预措施，以加强中低收入国家老年人现金转移支付的营养影响。

records.title_en: Circular resettlement and ongoing risk: earthquakes, landslides, and the challenges of “integrated” reconstruction in Nepal
records.title_cn: 循环安置与持续风险：尼泊尔的地震、滑坡与“综合”重建的挑战
records.abstract_en: State-led resettlement projects that urge communities to move location due to anticipated future risk from hazards may result in patterns of “circular resettlement”, as displaced people circulate between integrated resettlement communities and still-accessible settlements of origin to create sustainable lives and livelihoods. Further, residents’ own perception of risk shifts in relation to experiences of resettlement. These findings result from in-depth ethnographic research with two communities in rural Nepal, both resettled after a post-earthquake Geohazard Assessment designated them at high risk from ongoing landslides. This empirical material frames four intertwined arguments: (1) when the impetus for state-led resettlement is the potential for future risk, rather than actually experienced destruction, households can develop patterns of “circular resettlement” to cobble together livelihoods that combine the affordances of both old and new locations of residence; (2) local, national, and regional political histories and aspirations for modernity significantly shape contemporary resettlement policies in tandem with donor-driven priorities; (3) understanding resettlement outcomes requires attention to the intersection of temporal and spatial dynamics in post-disaster residential decision-making; (4) moving between multiple differently hazardous locations produces new lived experiences of risk for resettled people, generating transformations in subjectivity that can contribute positively to collaborative risk governance. We conclude with a recommendation that in cases where original settlements remain accessible despite some level of recognized risk, policy-makers should consider the prospects for integration across original and resettlement locations, rather than exclusively within spatially bounded integrated resettlement sites that separate people from their agrarian livelihoods and affective connections to place.
records.abstract_cn: 国家主导的安置项目因预期未来灾害风险而敦促社区迁移，可能导致“循环安置”模式的出现，因为流离失所者在综合安置社区与仍可进入的原居地之间循环流动，以创造可持续的生活和生计。此外，居民自身对风险的认知会随着安置经历而发生变化。这些发现源于对尼泊尔农村两个社区的深入民族志研究，这两个社区在震后地质灾害评估将其列为持续滑坡高风险区后被重新安置。这一实证材料构成了四个相互交织的论点：（1）当国家主导安置的动因是未来风险的潜在可能，而非实际经历的破坏时，家庭可能形成“循环安置”模式，以拼凑生计，结合新旧居住地的优势；（2）地方、国家和区域的政治历史及对现代化的向往，与捐助者驱动的优先事项共同显著塑造了当代安置政策；（3）理解安置结果需要关注灾后居住决策中时间与空间动态的交汇；（4）在多个不同危险地点之间移动，为被安置者带来了新的风险生活体验，产生主体性的转变，这可以积极促进协作式风险治理。我们最后建议，在原始定居点尽管存在一定程度公认风险但仍可进入的情况下，政策制定者应考虑在原居地与安置地点之间进行整合的前景，而非仅限于空间上受限的综合安置点，后者将人们与其农业生计和对地方的情感联系隔离开来。

records.title_en: Beyond overall income inequality: Racial income gaps and health disparities
records.title_cn: 超越总体收入不平等：种族收入差距与健康差异
records.abstract_en: In this paper, we combine Census data with death records to examine the relationship between income inequality and race-specific mortality across 5,565 municipalities in Brazil. We find that overall income inequality is strongly associated with Non-White mortality but not with White mortality. To understand this disparity, we decompose the Gini coefficient and find that the racial income gap accounts for 14% of overall income inequality. Using an Oaxaca–Blinder decomposition, we show that 79% of the racial income gap is explained by differences in education between Whites and Non-Whites. Finally, we document that the residual (structural) component of the racial income gap is strongly associated with Non-White male mortality, particularly homicides at young ages. Our results imply that closing schooling gaps alone will not eliminate racial health disparities in Brazil.
records.abstract_cn: 在本文中，我们将人口普查数据与死亡记录相结合，考察巴西5,565个城市中收入不平等与种族特定死亡率之间的关系。我们发现，总体收入不平等与非白人死亡率密切相关，但与白人死亡率无关。为理解这一差异，我们对基尼系数进行分解，发现种族收入差距占总体收入不平等的14%。利用Oaxaca–Blinder分解，我们显示种族收入差距的79%可由白人与非白人之间的教育差异解释。最后，我们记录到种族收入差距的残余（结构性）部分与非白人男性死亡率密切相关，尤其是年轻年龄段的凶杀死亡率。我们的结果表明，仅缩小教育差距并不能消除巴西的种族健康差异。

records.title_en: De-modernizing energy justice: Ivan Illich and the struggles for pluriversal territorialities in the Global South
records.title_cn: 去现代化的能源正义：伊万·伊里奇与全球南方多元宇宙领土性的斗争
records.abstract_en: The surge in energy justice scholarship over the past decade has been remarkable. Despite extensive analysis of the socioecological, political, historical, and material implications of energy systems, much of this research remains conceptually and theoretically vague, uncritical of the colonial, patriarchal and capitalist underpinnings of modernity. Additionally, it has systematically disavowed historical struggles and radical calls to challenge energy infrastructure and critical perspectives, including the work of Ivan Illich, who provided a comprehensive critique of modern institutions and the rise of mechanical energy. Although Illich’s ideas maintained some recognition in some academic circles, some of his contributions have been largely neglected in anglophone academia, especially within energy justice and transition discussions. Examining examples from Mexico –Yucatán, Acapatzingo and Puebla–, this article argues that energy justice, as a conceptual discipline in academia needs to be reconceptualized as a tool for struggle and not complacency in order to lead towards emancipatory transformations ought to reject the principles of the ’modern constitution’ as a given, adopting instead a decolonial perspective drawing on Illich’s insights. These examples illustrate diverse approaches moving towards ’pluriversal territorialities’ grounded in place-based solidarity, communitarian energy, and alternative knowledge systems, transcending the confines of capitalism and state institutions.
records.abstract_cn: 过去十年间，能源正义学术研究的激增令人瞩目。尽管对能源系统的社会生态、政治、历史和物质影响进行了广泛分析，但许多研究在概念和理论上仍然模糊不清，对现代性的殖民、父权和资本主义基础缺乏批判。此外，它系统性地否认了历史斗争和挑战能源基础设施及批判视角的激进呼吁，包括伊万·伊里奇的工作，他对现代机构和机械能源的兴起提供了全面批判。尽管伊里奇的思想在某些学术圈中保持了一定的认可，但他的部分贡献在英语学术界，特别是在能源正义和转型讨论中，很大程度上被忽视了。通过考察墨西哥的实例——尤卡坦、阿卡帕钦戈和普埃布拉——本文认为，作为学术领域的能源正义需要被重新概念化为一种斗争工具而非自满，以引领走向解放性转型，应当拒绝将“现代宪法”的原则视为既定，转而采纳借鉴伊里奇见解的非殖民视角。这些实例展示了朝向基于地方团结、社群能源和替代知识体系的“多元宇宙领土性”的多样路径，超越了资本主义和国家制度的限制。

records.title_en: Measuring national entrepreneurial ecosystems in Africa
records.title_cn: 衡量非洲国家创业生态系统
records.abstract_en: Productive entrepreneurship is highly needed for economic growth and development in Africa. For this to happen, the conditions for productive entrepreneurship need to be improved. However, data on the conditions for productive entrepreneurship in the African continent are scarce, which makes it very difficult to improve these conditions and interventions in a context-specific way. We tackle this challenge and source data from various public, private, global, and African sources. We use an entrepreneurial ecosystem framework to select, make sense of, and integrate this data. We use an extensive set of 21 empirical indicators to measure seven dimensions of national entrepreneurial ecosystems in Africa and to compose the Africa Entrepreneurial Ecosystem Index. This index and the underlying data aim to facilitate large-scale research on entrepreneurial ecosystems and collective learning for improving entrepreneurial ecosystems in Africa.
records.abstract_cn: 生产性创业对于非洲的经济增长和发展至关重要。要实现这一点，需要改善生产性创业的条件。然而，关于非洲大陆生产性创业条件的数据稀缺，这使得在特定背景下改善这些条件和干预措施变得非常困难。我们应对这一挑战，从各种公共、私人、全球和非洲来源获取数据。我们使用创业生态系统框架来筛选、理解和整合这些数据。我们使用一套包含21个实证指标的广泛体系来衡量非洲国家创业生态系统的七个维度，并编制非洲创业生态系统指数。该指数及其基础数据旨在促进对创业生态系统的大规模研究以及改善非洲创业生态系统的集体学习。

records.title_en: New Frontiers in Household Finance
records.title_cn: 家庭金融的新前沿
records.abstract_en: We present and discuss the papers in this special issue. We use the themes that these papers study to illustrate interesting new directions that are being pursued in the household finance literature and highlight open questions on which more work is needed.
records.abstract_cn: 我们介绍并讨论本期特刊中的论文。我们利用这些论文研究的主题来阐述家庭金融文献中正在探索的有趣新方向，并强调需要更多研究来解决的开放性问题。

records.title_en: Estimating Discount Functions with Consumption Choices over the Lifecycle
records.title_cn: 基于生命周期消费选择估计贴现函数
records.abstract_en: We estimate β-δ time preferences and relative risk aversion (RRA) using a lifecycle model including stochastic income, liquid and illiquid assets, credit cards, dependents, Social Security, mortality, and bequests. Preference parameters are identified by cross-tabulating four lifecycle age intervals and four balance sheet moments: the share of households carrying (ie, revolving) credit card debt, average carried credit card debt, average net wealth among households carrying credit card debt, and average net wealth among households not carrying credit card debt. The 16 moments are approximately matched by (MSM) parameter estimates β=0.53, δ=0.99, and RRA = 1.9.
records.abstract_cn: 我们使用包含随机收入、流动与非流动资产、信用卡、受抚养人、社会保障、死亡率和遗产的生命周期模型，估计β-δ时间偏好和相对风险厌恶系数（RRA）。偏好参数通过交叉列联四个生命周期年龄区间和四个资产负债表矩来识别：持有（即循环）信用卡债务的家庭比例、平均持有的信用卡债务、持有信用卡债务家庭的平均净财富，以及未持有信用卡债务家庭的平均净财富。这16个矩通过（MSM）参数估计近似匹配，估计值为β=0.53，δ=0.99，RRA=1.9。

records.title_en: The Gender Gap in Household Bargaining Power: A Revealed-Preference Approach
records.title_cn: 家庭议价能力中的性别差距：一种显示性偏好方法
records.abstract_en: When members of the same household have different risk preferences, whose preference matters more for investment decisions and why? We propose an intrahousehold model that aggregates individual preferences at the household level as a result of bargaining. We structurally estimate the model, analyze the determinants of bargaining power, and find a significant gender gap. Gender differences in individual characteristics, as well as gender effects, partially explain the gap. These patterns hold broadly across Australia, Germany, and the United States. We further link the distribution of bargaining power to households’ perceived gender norms in a cross-sectional analysis. (JEL G11, G41, G50)
records.abstract_cn: 当同一家庭成员具有不同的风险偏好时，谁的偏好对投资决策更重要，以及为什么？我们提出了一个家庭内部模型，该模型将个人偏好通过议价过程在家庭层面进行聚合。我们对模型进行了结构估计，分析了议价能力的决定因素，并发现了显著的性别差距。个人特征中的性别差异以及性别效应部分解释了这一差距。这些模式在澳大利亚、德国和美国广泛存在。我们进一步通过横截面分析将议价能力的分布与家庭感知的性别规范联系起来。(JEL G11, G41, G50)

records.title_en: Beliefs about the Stock Market and Investment Choices: Evidence from a Survey and a Field Experiment
records.title_cn: 关于股票市场的信念与投资选择：来自一项调查和一项实地实验的证据
records.abstract_en: We survey retail investors at an online bank to study how beliefs about the autocorrelation of aggregate stock returns shape investment decisions measured in administrative account data. Individuals’ beliefs exhibit substantial heterogeneity and predict trading responses to market movements. We inform half of our respondents that, historically, the autocorrelation was close to zero, which causes them to update their perceived current autocorrelation and return expectations. The treatment shifts respondents’ equity purchases during the COVID-19 crash months later in the direction implied by the intervention. Our results provide causal evidence about the drivers of disagreement and trade in asset markets.
records.abstract_cn: 我们在一家在线银行对散户投资者进行调查，以研究关于总体股票收益自相关的信念如何影响以行政账户数据衡量的投资决策。个体的信念表现出显著的异质性，并预测对市场波动的交易反应。我们告知一半的受访者，历史上自相关接近于零，这导致他们更新其感知的当前自相关和收益预期。该干预在数月后的COVID-19崩盘期间，使受访者的股票购买行为朝着干预所暗示的方向转变。我们的结果提供了关于资产市场中分歧和交易驱动因素的因果证据。

records.title_en: When Discounted Rates End: The Costs of Taking Action in the Mortgage Market
records.title_cn: 当折扣利率终止时：抵押贷款市场采取行动的成本
records.abstract_en: We combine administrative data with a life cycle structural model that exploits the unique features of the U.K. mortgage market to analyze the sources of inaction and to estimate borrowers’ nonpecuniary remortgaging costs. The utility costs needed to generate a given level of inaction depend on monetary gains from remortgaging and on the importance of those monetary gains for agents, which in turn depend on the (endogenously determined) marginal utility of consumption. The model results reveal significant nonpecuniary costs of action that, when measured as a proportion of borrower income, are larger for the young and for lower-income households.
records.abstract_cn: 我们将行政数据与利用英国抵押贷款市场独特特征的生命周期结构模型相结合，分析不作为的根源并估计借款人的非货币性再抵押成本。产生给定水平的不作为所需的效用成本取决于再抵押的货币收益以及这些货币收益对代理人的重要性，而后者又取决于（内生决定的）消费边际效用。模型结果揭示了显著的非货币性行动成本，当以借款人收入的比例衡量时，这些成本对年轻人和低收入家庭而言更大。

records.title_en: Cross-Selling in Bank-Household Relationships: Mechanisms and Implications for Pricing
records.title_cn: 银行-家庭关系中的交叉销售：机制与定价影响
records.abstract_en: We show that banks cross-sell future deposits and loans to existing household depositors. A bank is 20-percentage-points more likely to sell a loan to an existing depositor than to an otherwise comparable household. Existing depositors pay a premium when borrowing, and we find no indication that banks obtain an informational advantage on such borrowers, suggesting that the cross-selling is driven more by demand than by supply complementarities. These demand complementarities are in turn driven more by stickiness rather than by unobserved persistent preferences. Finally, banks internalize future cross-selling potential when setting deposit rates.
records.abstract_cn: 我们表明银行向现有家庭储户交叉销售未来存款和贷款。银行向现有储户销售贷款的可能性比向其他类似家庭高出20个百分点。现有储户在借款时支付溢价，我们没有发现银行在此类借款人身上获得信息优势的迹象，这表明交叉销售更多由需求而非供给互补性驱动。这些需求互补性又更多由粘性而非未观察到的持久偏好驱动。最后，银行在设定存款利率时会内化未来的交叉销售潜力。

records.title_en: Can Human Capital Explain Income-Based Disparities in Financial Services?
records.title_cn: 人力资本能否解释金融服务中的收入差异？
records.abstract_en: Research shows that access to high-quality financial services varies with local income and wealth. We study how financial firms’ internal allocation of human capital contributes to these disparities. Using a near-comprehensive panel of over 350,000 U.S. mortgage loan officers, we document large and persistent differences in productivity and performance. We find that firms’ hiring and promotion practices allocate workers with less experience or poor track records to branches serving low-income customers. Further, the consequences of poor performance differ by location: low sales, bad loans, and misconduct are more tolerated in low-income branches, exacerbating income-based disparities in financial services.
records.abstract_cn: 研究表明，获得高质量金融服务的渠道随当地收入和财富而变化。我们研究了金融公司内部人力资本配置如何导致这些差异。利用一个近乎全面的美国抵押贷款官员面板数据，包含超过350,000名贷款官员，我们记录了生产力和绩效方面巨大且持续的差异。我们发现，公司的招聘和晋升实践将经验较少或业绩记录不佳的员工分配到服务低收入客户的网点。此外，绩效不佳的后果因地点而异：低销售额、不良贷款和不当行为在低收入网点更为容忍，从而加剧了金融服务中的收入差异。

records.title_en: Designing Pension Plans According to Consumption-Savings Theory
records.title_cn: 根据消费-储蓄理论设计养老金计划
records.abstract_en: We derive optimal characteristics of contribution rates into defined contribution pension plans based on consumption-savings theory. Contribution rates should increase with age and decrease with the balance-to-income ratio. Using Swedish registry data, we show that on average, individuals save according to those principles. However, almost half of the population behaves hand-to-mouth and does not undo the mandated constant contribution rates. In a quantitative model, designing contribution rates to follow the principles implies a 1.8% welfare gain and less dispersed replacement rates, while maintaining the same average replacement rate. Results are robust to various sources of model misspecification, including temptation preferences.
records.abstract_cn: 我们基于消费-储蓄理论推导出固定缴费型养老金计划中缴费率的最优特征。缴费率应随年龄增长而增加，并随余额-收入比率的下降而降低。利用瑞典注册数据，我们表明平均而言，个体按照这些原则进行储蓄。然而，几乎一半的人口表现为手到口（hand-to-mouth）行为，并未调整强制性的恒定缴费率。在一个定量模型中，按照这些原则设计缴费率意味着1.8%的福利收益和更分散的替代率，同时保持相同的平均替代率。结果对多种模型误设来源具有稳健性，包括诱惑偏好。

records.title_en: The Coholding Puzzle: New Evidence from Transaction-Level Data
records.title_cn: 共同持有之谜：来自交易层面数据的新证据
records.abstract_en: Why do individuals pay debt interest when they could use their savings to pay down the debt? We explore why individuals “cohold” debt and savings using detailed and highly disaggregated daily-level data on household finances. We find that coholding mostly occurs in short spells within the month and the level of coholding is typically modest. Periods of coholding are not associated with shocks at the individual level. We show that mental accounting has a role to play in explaining coholding, in particular how individuals allocate different categories of expenditure to accounts in credit and debit.
records.abstract_cn: 为什么个人在可以用储蓄偿还债务时却支付债务利息？我们利用详细且高度细分的家庭财务日度数据，探讨个人为何“共同持有”债务和储蓄。我们发现，共同持有主要发生在月内的短期时段，且共同持有的水平通常较为温和。共同持有期间与个人层面的冲击无关。我们表明，心理账户在解释共同持有中发挥作用，特别是个人如何将不同类别的支出分配到信用账户和借记账户中。

records.title_en: Modern approaches to building interpretable models of the property market using machine learning on the base of mass cadastral valuation
records.title_cn: 基于大规模批量评估的房地产市场可解释模型构建的现代方法
records.abstract_en: In this paper, we review modern approaches to building interpretable models of property markets using machine learning on the base of mass valuation of property in the Primorye region, Russia. There are numerous potential difficulties one could encounter in the effort to build a good model. Their main source is the huge difference between noisy real market data and ideal data usually used in tutorials on machine learning. This paper covers all stages of modeling: collection of initial data, identification of outliers, search and analysis of patterns in the data, formation and final choice of price factors, building of the model, and evaluation of its efficiency. For each stage, we highlight potential issues and describe sound methods for overcoming emerging difficulties on actual examples. We show that the combination of classical linear regression with kriging (interpolation method of geostatistics) allows to build an effective model for land parcels. For flats, when many objects are attributed to one spatial point, the application of geostatistical methods becomes problematic. Instead, we suggest linear regression with automatic generation and selection of additional rules on the base of decision trees, so called the RuleFit method. We compare the performance of our inherently interpretable models with well-proven “black-box” Random Forest method and demonstrate similar results. Thus we show, that despite such a strong restriction as the requirement of interpretability which is important in practical aspects, for example, legal matters, it is still possible to build effective models of real property markets.
records.abstract_cn: 本文回顾了基于俄罗斯滨海边疆区房地产批量评估的机器学习构建房地产市场可解释模型的现代方法。在构建良好模型的过程中，可能会遇到许多潜在困难，其主要来源是嘈杂的真实市场数据与机器学习教程中通常使用的理想数据之间的巨大差异。本文涵盖了建模的所有阶段：初始数据收集、异常值识别、数据中模式的搜索与分析、价格因素的形成与最终选择、模型构建及其效率评估。对于每个阶段，我们指出了潜在问题，并描述了在实际案例中克服新出现困难的可靠方法。我们表明，经典线性回归与克里金法（地质统计学插值方法）的结合能够为土地地块构建有效模型。对于公寓，当许多对象归属于一个空间点时，地质统计方法的应用变得困难。相反，我们建议使用线性回归，并基于决策树自动生成和选择附加规则，即所谓的RuleFit方法。我们将我们固有可解释模型的性能与经过验证的“黑箱”随机森林方法进行比较，并展示了相似的结果。因此，我们表明，尽管存在可解释性要求这一在实践方面（例如法律事务）重要的强限制，仍然可以构建有效的房地产市场模型。

records.title_en: Diverse interplay of grey and green space in distinct Asian arid and semi-arid cities
records.title_cn: 亚洲不同干旱和半干旱城市中灰色空间与绿色空间的多样互动
records.abstract_en: The rapid expansion of grey space (GS) profoundly impacts the distribution and sustainability of urban green space (UGS), especially in water-scarce arid and semi-arid regions. However, the relationship between GS and UGS and its variation across cities with different socio-political and environmental contexts remains poorly understood. This study examines eight Asian arid and semi-arid cities categorized by distinct characteristics: Group1 (Lanzhou, Xi’an; geographically-constrained), Group2 (Baghdad, Tehran; conflict-affected), Group3 (Tashkent, Dushanbe; stable expanding), and Group4 (Beirut, Damascus; small-scale). We analyzed the spatiotemporal dynamics of GS and UGS from 1985 to 2022 using urban expansion intensity, net changes from UGS to GS, etc. We then employed the Geodetector and landscape indices to evaluate the influence of GS spatial pattern on UGS. The results show that: (1) GS expansion intensity depends on land availability, which is constrained by topography, climate and social stability; (2) Socio-political stability fundamentally shapes urban expansion patterns, leading to divergent trajectories from security-driven dispersal to policy-induced optimization; (3) The impact mechanisms of GS on UGS exhibit significant scale dependency and regional heterogeneity: terrain dominates at regional scale, while GS configuration, socio-economic factors, and their interactions play varied roles across cities; (4) Context-specific planning strategies are proposed: rigid regulation and internal optimization for geographically-constrained cities, multi-centric decentralization for conflict cities, refined morphological management for stable expanding cities, and three-dimensional greening for land-scarce cities. Our findings deepen the understanding of GS-UGS dynamics and offer valuable insights for optimizing spatial planning and promoting sustainable land use in arid and semi-arid urban environments.
records.abstract_cn: 灰色空间（GS）的快速扩展深刻影响着城市绿色空间（UGS）的分布和可持续性，尤其是在缺水干旱和半干旱地区。然而，GS与UGS之间的关系及其在不同社会政治和环境背景城市之间的变化仍知之甚少。本研究考察了八个亚洲干旱和半干旱城市，根据其不同特征分类：Group1（兰州、西安；地理受限），Group2（巴格达、德黑兰；受冲突影响），Group3（塔什干、杜尚别；稳定扩张），以及Group4（贝鲁特、大马士革；小规模）。我们利用城市扩展强度、UGS向GS的净变化等，分析了1985至2022年间GS和UGS的时空动态。随后，我们采用地理探测器和景观指数来评估GS空间格局对UGS的影响。结果显示：(1)GS扩展强度取决于土地可用性，而后者受地形、气候和社会稳定性的制约；(2)社会政治稳定性从根本上塑造了城市扩展格局，导致从安全驱动的分散到政策驱动的优化等不同轨迹；(3)GS对UGS的影响机制表现出显著的尺度依赖性和区域异质性：在区域尺度上地形起主导作用，而GS配置、社会经济因素及其相互作用在不同城市中发挥不同作用；(4)提出了针对具体情境的规划策略：对地理受限城市实行刚性管制和内部优化，对冲突城市实行多中心分散化，对稳定扩张城市实行精细化形态管理，对土地稀缺城市实行三维绿化。我们的研究结果加深了对GS-UGS动态的理解，并为优化空间规划和促进干旱及半干旱城市环境中的可持续土地利用提供了有价值的见解。

records.title_en: Exploring drivers and motivations behind garden management for climate change adaptation
records.title_cn: 探索花园管理对气候变化适应的驱动因素与动机
records.abstract_en: Serving as an integral part of urban green infrastructure, the collective network of domestic gardens could make a substantial contribution to climate change adaptation. Nevertheless, these private outdoor spaces are autonomously managed by many individual gardeners, often prioritizing aesthetics and maintenance convenience, rather than environmental considerations. Understanding how people manage their gardens, and why they make certain gardening decisions is crucial for unlocking the climate adaptation potential of gardens, shedding light on the current situation and identifying opportunities for change. Unfortunately, limited research has been conducted on the personal drivers behind gardeners’ decisions. Therefore, our research aims at unveiling current gardening practices and their drivers through an online citizen science survey of Flemish domestic garden owners (n = 827). Using a Structural Equation Modeling (SEM) approach, we studied how motivations, knowledge, spatial- and socio-economic factors are associated with garden management decisions related to sealed soil, lawns, and tree cover. Our findings show that factors such as spatial context, socio-economic status, and personal motivations are more critical in shaping garden composition and management. The results stress the complexity of garden management, where traditional practices and cultural perceptions coexist with a growing ecological awareness and highlights the intricate relationship between local contexts and the diverse personal drivers influencing individual gardeners' decisions. By recognizing this interconnectedness, we emphasize the need for gardening policies tailored to spatial and socio-economic variations and offer insights that can inform urban planners and policymakers on how to harness the untapped climate adaptation potential within these private outdoor spaces.
records.abstract_cn: 作为城市绿色基础设施的重要组成部分，家庭花园的集体网络可以为气候变化适应做出实质性贡献。然而，这些私人户外空间由许多个体园丁自主管理，往往优先考虑美观和维护便利，而非环境因素。理解人们如何管理他们的花园，以及他们为何做出某些园艺决策，对于释放花园的气候适应潜力至关重要，这能揭示当前状况并识别变革机会。遗憾的是，关于园丁决策背后的个人驱动因素的研究有限。因此，我们的研究旨在通过一项针对佛兰德斯家庭花园所有者的在线公民科学调查（n = 827）来揭示当前的园艺实践及其驱动因素。采用结构方程模型（SEM）方法，我们研究了动机、知识、空间和社会经济因素如何与涉及密封土壤、草坪和树木覆盖的花园管理决策相关联。我们的研究结果表明，空间背景、社会经济地位和个人动机等因素在塑造花园组成和管理方面更为关键。结果强调了花园管理的复杂性，其中传统实践和文化观念与日益增长的生态意识并存，并突出了地方背景与影响个体园丁决策的多样化个人驱动因素之间的复杂关系。通过认识到这种相互关联性，我们强调需要针对空间和社会经济差异量身定制的园艺政策，并提供见解，帮助城市规划者和政策制定者了解如何利用这些私人户外空间中未开发的气候适应潜力。

records.title_en: Reforming land valuation and taxation in Ukraine: A path towards greater sustainability, fairness, and transparency
records.title_cn: 乌克兰土地估价与税收改革：迈向更高可持续性、公平性与透明度的路径
records.abstract_en: The shift from administrative to market-based property valuation is critical for effective decentralization and local revenue collection in Ukraine. To demonstrate the viability of such a shift, this paper uses prices for more than 175,000 agricultural land sale transactions in 2021–24 together with parcel attributes from public data to estimate a hedonic model and predict prices for all of Ukraine’s 7.5 million commercial agricultural land parcels. Despite the war, mean predicted prices are significantly above current ‘normative monetary’ valuations (NMVs). Inter-regional differences are pronounced. Steps to extend mass appraisal to residential urban properties and legislative changes needed to replace NMVs with a market-based approach are discussed, noting that a shift to market-based valuation will have far-reaching implications for the volume of public and private investment that can be attracted to support reconstruction; the likely effectiveness of such investment; and local governments’ ability to benefit from any land value appreciation that may result from it.
records.abstract_cn: 从行政估价向市场基础财产估价的转变对于乌克兰的有效分权化和地方税收征管至关重要。为证明此类转变的可行性，本文利用超过175,000笔2021-24年农业用地销售交易的价格数据，结合公共数据中的地块属性，估计了一个特征价格模型，并对乌克兰所有7.5万块商业农业用地地块的价格进行了预测。尽管处于战争状态，平均预测价格仍显著高于当前的“规范性货币”估价（NMVs）。区域间差异显著。本文讨论了将大规模评估扩展到城市住宅物业的步骤，以及用市场基础方法替代NMVs所需的立法变革，并指出转向市场基础估价将对可吸引用于支持重建的公共和私人投资规模、此类投资可能产生的有效性，以及地方政府从可能由此产生的土地增值中获益的能力产生深远影响。

records.title_en: Perceptions, sustainability and forest cover associated to public programs for coffee production in the Sierra de Zongolica, Mexico
records.title_cn: 墨西哥宗戈利卡山脉咖啡生产公共项目的感知、可持续性与森林覆盖
records.abstract_en: Rural policies in Mexico have often been criticized for failing to adequately address peasants’ longstanding challenges. During the first leftist federal government, public programs such as Sembrando Vida (Sowing Life) and Producción para el Bienestar (Production for Wellbeing) were introduced to improve peasants’ living conditions and environmental sustainability. Both programs require substantial budgetary allocations, and have been the focus of polarized national and international debates. However, few studies have assessed their performance empirically. Here, we analyze both programs in contrast to traditional management in an indigenous coffee-growing area of Veracruz (Sierra de Zongolica). Specifically, we 1) use the Q-method to explore socio-environmental perceptions about the programs’ scope and limitations, 2) analyze the sustainability of plot managements through an evaluation framework, and 3) quantify forest-cover changes through the use of GIS. Four distinct groups of social perceptions were identified: program defenders, proactive critics, pragmatists, and absolute critics. The key finding from the sustainability assessment is that there is no existing ideal agroforestry coffee model, instead, public programs and traditional managements exhibit considerable potential for complementarity through exchange of knowledge and practices. Forest loss occurred mainly at the initial phase of Sembrando Vida, after which the rate of loss decreased. We attribute that decrease to the farmers’ tradition of adaptive agroforestry management. Drawing on the case study, the conclusions assess the key successes and remaining opportunities within both land-use policies, especially in agrarian terms, the integration of local agriculture knowledge and practices, and the potential for cross-territorial exchange between the programs.
records.abstract_cn: 墨西哥的农村政策常因未能充分解决农民长期面临的挑战而受到批评。在首届左翼联邦政府期间，引入了诸如“播种生命”（Sembrando Vida）和“为福祉而生产”（Producción para el Bienestar）等公共项目，以改善农民的生活条件和环境可持续性。这两个项目都需要大量的预算拨款，并已成为国内外两极分化辩论的焦点。然而，很少有研究对其绩效进行实证评估。在此，我们对比分析了这两个项目与韦拉克鲁斯州（宗戈利卡山脉）一个土著咖啡种植区的传统管理方式。具体而言，我们[[1]）使用Q方法探讨关于项目范围和局限性的社会环境感知，[[2]）通过评估框架分析地块管理的可持续性，以及[[3]）利用GIS量化森林覆盖变化。识别出四组不同的社会感知群体：项目捍卫者、积极批评者、实用主义者和绝对批评者。可持续性评估的关键发现是，不存在理想的农林复合咖啡模式，相反，公共项目和传统管理在知识和实践交流方面展现出显著的互补潜力。森林损失主要发生在“播种生命”项目的初始阶段，之后损失率有所下降。我们将这一下降归因于农民适应性农林复合管理的传统。基于案例研究，结论评估了这两项土地利用政策的主要成功之处和剩余机遇，特别是在农业方面、当地农业知识和实践的整合，以及项目间跨区域交流的潜力。

records.title_en: Urban sprawl in Latin America: A systematic review of the existing literature and emerging insights
records.title_cn: 拉丁美洲城市蔓延：现有文献的系统综述与新见解
records.abstract_en: Urban sprawl has become one of the most pressing challenges in Latin American cities, driven by a complex interplay of economic, political, and spatial factors. Despite being one of the most urbanized regions in the world, Latin America lacks a consistent analytical framework to fully understand the indicators, patterns, approaches and consequences of urban sprawl. This study conducts a systematic review of 56 peer-reviewed articles published between 2004 and 2025, applying a six-dimensional analytical framework: (i) general publication features, (ii) scale of analysis, (iii) methodological approaches, (iv) indicators employed, (v) drivers of change, and (vi) effects of urban sprawl.
