records.abstract_cn: 我们利用巴基斯坦警方的行政微观数据，研究委托-代理关系中的数据操纵行为。我们发现，在政治问责压力较高的地区，即执政党持有特定选区时，警方登记公民犯罪报告的意愿较低。我们进行了一系列测试，以排除这一结果是由犯罪预防增强所解释的可能性。结果与官员在压力下决定不登记某些报告、以保持犯罪统计数据较低的情况一致。随着新的犯罪报告追踪数据库的推出，可观测性提高，登记犯罪的数量也随之增加。

records.title_en: Access to credit reduces the value of insurance
records.title_cn: 信贷获取降低了保险的价值
records.abstract_en: We study how access to credit markets affects the value of insurance. Loans allow consumers to smooth financial shocks over time, reducing the incremental benefits provided by insurance. We derive tractable formulas for the value of insurance that can be taken to data and show how that value varies with loan features. We then apply our framework to health insurance. Access to a five-year loan decreases the values of community- and experience-rated health insurance for the average two-person household by $232–$366 (58–61%). Even for the sickest decile, loan access reduces the value of community-rated insurance by $1099 (17%). Our results suggest that greater credit availability can serve as a substitute for health insurance.
records.abstract_cn: 我们研究了信贷市场的获取如何影响保险的价值。贷款允许消费者随时间平滑金融冲击，减少了保险提供的增量收益。我们推导出可用于数据的保险价值简便公式，并展示了该价值如何随贷款特征变化。然后我们将我们的框架应用于健康保险。获得五年期贷款使平均两人家庭的社区评级和经验评级健康保险的价值降低了$232–$366（58-61%）。即使对于最病重的十分位人群，贷款获取也使社区评级保险的价值降低了$1099（17%）。我们的结果表明，更大的信贷可用性可以作为健康保险的替代品。

records.title_en: Taxation and business entry: Evidence from the Polish self-employment “Flat” tax
records.title_cn: 税收与创业进入：来自波兰个体经营“统一”税的证据
records.abstract_en: How does the tax treatment of entrepreneurial activity affect the decision to start a business? We study this question in the context of a major tax reform in Poland that introduced a flat tax for business owners, leaving the taxation of employees unchanged. Using a difference-in-differences approach and data on the universe of Polish taxpayers, we find that a 1 percentage point increase in the tax differential at the top of the income distribution leads to a 0.9% increase in the share of self-employed five years after the reform. The increase is primarily driven by transitions from employment to self-employment, in particular, solo self-employment (self-employment without dependent workers). Moreover, the transitions occur in industries with a high human-capital component. Altogether, we find that high-income taxpayers respond strongly to the increased attractiveness of self-employment by starting a business, that such behavior shows considerable persistence, that it accumulates over time, and much of it is likely to reflect income reclassification rather than genuine entrepreneurial activity.
records.abstract_cn: 创业活动的税收待遇如何影响创业决策？我们在波兰一项重大税制改革的背景下研究这一问题，该改革为商业所有者引入了统一税，而雇员的税收保持不变。使用双重差分方法以及波兰纳税人全量数据，我们发现，在收入分配顶端，税收差异每增加1个百分点，改革五年后个体经营者比例增加0.9%。这一增长主要由从就业转向个体经营，特别是独自个体经营（无受抚养员工的个体经营）所驱动。此外，这种转变发生在人力资本密集的行业。总体而言，我们发现高收入纳税人对个体经营吸引力的增加反应强烈，通过创业来应对，这种行为表现出相当的持续性，随时间累积，且其中很大一部分可能反映的是收入重新分类而非真正的创业活动。

records.title_en: Better late than never? Quantifying funding and liquidity effects of the PPP on pandemic-era employment recovery
records.title_cn: 迟做总比不做好？量化PPP在疫情时期就业复苏中的资金与流动性效应
records.abstract_en: This paper examines how the Paycheck Protection Program (PPP) supported employment during the COVID-19 period by distinguishing between its short-term liquidity and broader funding effects. Using county-level data, we show that delays in loan disbursement had prolonged negative impacts only on the smallest urban businesses. To identify the causal impact of funding itself, we develop an instrument based on the pre-pandemic payroll share in small establishments. Instrumental-variable and firm-level analyses reveal that PPP funding improved business survival and employment recovery substantially and broadly, with an estimated cost of roughly $89,000 per job-year, consistent with other large-scale fiscal interventions.
records.abstract_cn: 本文通过区分短期流动性和更广泛的资金效应，考察了薪资保护计划（PPP）在COVID-19期间对就业的支持作用。利用县级数据，我们表明贷款发放的延迟仅对最小的城市企业产生了长期的负面影响。为了识别资金本身的因果影响，我们基于小企业疫情前工资份额构建了一个工具变量。工具变量和企业层面的分析显示，PPP资金显著且广泛地改善了企业生存和就业复苏，估计每工作年成本约为89,000美元，与其他大规模财政干预措施一致。

records.title_en: Intertemporal substitution in response to non-linear health insurance contracts
records.title_cn: 对非线性健康保险合同的跨期替代反应
records.abstract_en: I explore how non-linear health insurance contracts allow consumers to substitute healthcare in one period for healthcare in another period by increasing consumption in the year the annual deductible was met and decreasing future consumption. I exploit variation in the timing of an injury that generates significant healthcare expenses to identify the causal effect of meeting the deductible on healthcare consumption in the following year. Estimates indicate that there is intertemporal substitution across years in healthcare consumption and that consumers are able to strategically respond to non-linear pricing schemes to undermine the potential savings from deductible plans.
records.abstract_cn: 我探讨了非线性健康保险合同如何允许消费者通过增加达到年度免赔额当年的消费并减少未来消费，从而在一个时期用医疗保健替代另一个时期的医疗保健。我利用一次产生重大医疗费用的伤害发生时间的变异，来识别达到免赔额对次年医疗保健消费的因果效应。估计结果表明，医疗保健消费存在跨年度的跨期替代，且消费者能够策略性地应对非线性定价方案，从而削弱免赔额计划可能带来的节省。

records.title_en: Identifying tax-setting responses from local fiscal policy programs
records.title_cn: 从地方财政政策项目中识别税收设定反应
records.abstract_en: This paper provides event-study evidence on the dynamics of strategic tax-policy interactions. Using the participation of German municipalities in state debt reduction programs as a quasi-exogenous shock, we demonstrate how these programs affect tax rates of participating municipalities. We then illustrate how competing municipalities – not directly affected by the program – adjust their tax rates in response. Combining both steps using a two-sample Wald estimator, the strategic response of competitors to a one-unit tax change by program participants ranges from 0.66 to 0.70 for the local business tax and 0.34 to 0.49 for the property tax. Characteristics of municipalities, especially proximity, influence the size and scope of tax interdependence.
records.abstract_cn: 本文提供了关于战略性税收政策互动动态的事件研究证据。利用德国市政当局参与州债务减免计划作为准外生冲击，我们展示了这些计划如何影响参与市政当局的税率。然后，我们说明了未直接受计划影响的竞争市政当局如何调整其税率以作出反应。通过使用两样本Wald估计量结合这两个步骤，竞争对手对计划参与者一单位税收变化的战略反应，对于地方营业税而言，范围在0.66至0.70之间，对于财产税而言，范围在0.34至0.49之间。市政当局的特征，尤其是邻近性，影响税收相互依赖的程度和范围。

records.title_en: Can early public childcare reduce child penalties? Evidence from Germany
records.title_cn: 早期公共托育能否减少育儿惩罚？来自德国的证据
records.abstract_en: This paper studies the effects of public childcare expansion for children under age three in Germany on mothers’ child penalties. Exploiting county-level variation in the expansion, we find that a 20-percentage-point increase in childcare coverage rate reduces earnings penalties by 4.5 percentage points. This accounts for about 56% of the total 8-percentage-point decline in earnings penalties over the reform period. Early childcare increases employment and days worked, especially in full-time and non-marginal positions. It also raises daily wages and increases the likelihood that mothers work in higher-paying firms and occupations. These effects persist beyond the early childcare eligibility period. We further identify two key contextual factors explaining the positive effects of early childcare: the initial level of child penalties and reliance on informal care. In settings with high child penalties and limited alternatives, early public childcare can yield substantial lasting benefits for mothers’ careers.
records.abstract_cn: 本文研究了德国三岁以下儿童公共托育扩展对母亲育儿惩罚的影响。利用县级扩展差异，我们发现托育覆盖率每增加20个百分点，收入惩罚减少4.5个百分点。这约占改革期间收入惩罚总下降8个百分点中的56%。早期托育增加了就业和工作天数，尤其是在全职和非边缘职位上。它还提高了日工资，并增加了母亲在高薪企业和职业中工作的可能性。这些影响在早期托育资格期之后仍然持续。我们进一步识别了两个解释早期托育积极影响的关键背景因素：育儿惩罚的初始水平和依赖非正式照料的程度。在育儿惩罚高且替代选择有限的环境中，早期公共托育能为母亲的职业生涯带来显著的持久益处。

records.title_en: The compliance effects of the automatic exchange of information: Evidence from the Swiss tax amnesty
records.title_cn: 自动信息交换的合规效应：来自瑞士税收大赦的证据
records.abstract_en: This paper studies the effects of the 2017 multilateral automatic exchange of information (AEoI) on tax compliance in Switzerland. Using detailed administrative tax data and difference-in-differences designs, I document large and persistent compliance gains. The AEoI triggered around 107,000 taxpayers (about 2% of all) to enter Switzerland’s tax amnesty, disclosing CHF 37.6 billion of previously hidden wealth (over 5.5% of GDP). At the micro level, once they enter the amnesty, participants increase reported wealth by roughly 50% on average, with effects sustained in the medium run. Finally, the evidence indicates that tax evasion in Switzerland is widespread and comparatively more evenly distributed across the wealth distribution than in other countries.
records.abstract_cn: 本文研究了2017年多边自动信息交换（AEoI）对瑞士税收合规的影响。利用详细的行政税收数据和双重差分设计，我记录了显著且持续的合规收益。AEoI促使约107,000名纳税人（约占所有纳税人的2%）进入瑞士的税收大赦，披露了此前隐藏的37.6亿瑞士法郎财富（超过GDP的5.5%）。在微观层面，一旦进入大赦，参与者的报告财富平均增加约50%，且这一效应在中期内得以持续。最后，证据表明，瑞士的逃税现象普遍存在，且与其他国家相比，逃税在财富分布中的分布相对更为均匀。

records.title_en: Almost fare free: Impact of a cheap public transport ticket on mobility patterns and train delays
records.title_cn: 几乎免费：廉价公共交通票对出行模式和火车延误的影响
records.abstract_en: During June–August 2022, Germany temporarily reduced the fare of unlimited local and regional public transport nationwide to €9 per month. We study changes in mobility behavior and rail congestion effects induced by this 9-Euro Ticket. We employ difference-in-differences and event-study designs to analyze data from mobile-network devices, administrative traffic counts from road monitoring stations, and train arrival data. We find a strong increase in rail travel with modest substitution away from cars. Train trips rise by around 35%, while car traffic falls by 1–5%, with the smallest traffic reductions during commuting times and the largest increases in rail travel for leisure purposes on weekends and to touristic destinations. Moreover, the train demand surge materially worsens service quality via elevated train delays, which even spill over to long-distance trains. A welfare analysis suggests that the policy mostly acted as a cost-of-living transfer with limited emissions benefits, implying high implicit CO2 government abatement costs. Overall, our findings indicate that deeply discounted, nationwide “go-anywhere” tickets can substantially increase railway travel, yet generate limited car-to-rail substitution and strain service reliability when implemented without accompanying capacity extensions.During June–August 2022, Germany temporarily reduced the fare of unlimited local and regional public transport nationwide to €9 per month. We study changes in mobility behavior and rail congestion effects induced by this 9-Euro Ticket. We employ difference-in-differences and event-study designs to travel data from mobile-network devices, administrative traffic counts from road monitoring stations, and train arrival data. We find a strong increase in rail travel with modest substitution away from cars. Train trips rise by around 35%, while car traffic falls by 1–5%, with the smallest traffic reductions during commuting times and the largest increases in rail travel for leisure purposes on weekends and to touristic destinations. Moreover, the train demand surge materially worsens service quality via elevated train delays, which even spill over to long-distance trains. A welfare analysis suggests that the policy mostly acted as a cost-of-living transfer with limited emissions benefits, implying high implicit CO2 government abatement costs. Overall, our findings indicate that deeply discounted, nationwide “go-anywhere” tickets can substantially increase railway travel, yet generate limited car-to-rail substitution and strain service reliability when implemented without accompanying capacity extensions.
records.abstract_cn: 六月至八月2022期间，德国暂时将全国无限次地方和地区公共交通票价降至每月9欧元。我们研究了这种 9-Euro Ticket 引起的出行行为的变化和铁路拥堵效应。我们采用双重差分法和事件研究设计来分析来自移动网络设备的数据、来自道路监控站的行政交通计数以及火车到站数据。我们发现铁路出行强劲增长，汽车出行有适度替代。火车出行量增加了约 35%，而汽车交通量则下降了 1-5%，通勤期间的交通量减少幅度最小，而周末休闲和前往旅游目的地的铁路出行量增幅最大。此外，火车需求激增导致火车晚点增多，严重恶化了服务质量，甚至波及长途火车。福利分析表明，该政策主要作为生活成本转移，排放效益有限，这意味着政府的隐性CO2减排成本很高。总体而言，我们的研究结果表明，大幅折扣的全国范围内“去往任何地方”的车票可以大幅增加铁路旅行，但在不扩大运力的情况下，产生的汽车到铁路替代有限，并会导致服务可靠性紧张。 六月至八月2022期间，德国暂时将全国范围内无限制的本地和区域公共交通票价降低至每月欧元9。我们研究了这种 9-Euro Ticket 引起的出行行为的变化和铁路拥堵效应。我们采用双重差分法和事件研究设计来获取来自移动网络设备的出行数据、来自道路监控站的行政交通计数以及火车到站数据。我们发现铁路出行强劲增长，汽车出行有适度替代。火车出行量增加了约 35%，而汽车交通量则下降了 1-5%，通勤期间的交通量减少幅度最小，而周末休闲和前往旅游目的地的铁路出行量增幅最大。此外，火车需求的激增导致火车晚点增多，从而严重恶化了服务质量，甚至波及长途火车。福利分析表明，该政策主要作为生活成本转移，排放效益有限，这意味着政府的隐性CO2减排成本很高。总体而言，我们的研究结果表明，大幅折扣的全国性“去往任何地方”的车票可以大幅增加铁路旅行，但在不扩大运力的情况下实施时，会产生有限的汽车到铁路的替代，并导致服务可靠性紧张。

records.title_en: On the Nature of Entrepreneurship
records.title_cn: 论创业的本质
records.abstract_en: This paper examines the nature of entrepreneurship using a novel panel dataset based on US Internal Revenue Service data. We analyze income growth trajectories and the determinants of entrepreneurial choice for business owners. Compared with prior household survey–based studies, we find that self-employed individuals have significantly higher average incomes and steeper income growth than their wage-earning matched peers. Contrary to survey evidence, we find a limited role for nonpecuniary motives, uninsurable risk, and liquidity constraints driving entrepreneurial choice. Prior work experience predicts entrepreneurial entry. Entry and exit rates into self-employment remain stable over time, including during the Great Recession.
records.abstract_cn: 本文使用基于美国国税局数据的新颖面板数据集研究了创业的本质。我们分析企业主的收入增长轨迹和创业选择的决定因素。与之前基于家庭调查的研究相比，我们发现自营职业者的平均收入明显高于其工资收入匹配的同龄人，收入增长也更快。与调查证据相反，我们发现非金钱动机、不可保风险和流动性限制在推动创业选择方面的作用有限。先前的工作经验预示着创业机会。自营职业的进入和退出率随着时间的推移保持稳定，包括在大衰退期间。

records.title_en: Revolutionary Transition: Inheritance Change and Fertility Decline
records.title_cn: 革命性转变：继承变化和生育率下降
records.abstract_en: We test Le Play’s 1875 hypothesis that the French Revolution contributed to France’s early fertility decline by imposing equal partition of inheritance among all children, including women. We combine new data on local inheritance rules before the Revolution and individual-level demographic data from historical sources and crowdsourced genealogies. Difference-in-differences and regression discontinuity estimates show that the inheritance reforms enacted during the Revolution reduced completed fertility by 0.5 children. A key mechanism was the desire to avoid land fragmentation across generations. These reforms closed the fertility gap between regions with different historical inheritance rules and crucially contributed to France’s demographic transition.
records.abstract_cn: 我们检验了 Le Play 的 1875 假设，即法国大革命通过在包括妇女在内的所有儿童中平等分配继承权，导致了法国早期生育率下降。我们结合了革命前当地继承规则的新数据以及来自历史来源和众包家谱的个人人口统计数据。双重差分和回归不连续性估计表明，革命期间实施的继承改革减少了0.5个孩子的完全生育率。一个关键机制是希望避免代代相传的土地碎片化。这些改革缩小了具有不同历史继承规则的地区之间的生育率差距，并对法国的人口转型做出了至关重要的贡献。

records.title_en: Health Shocks, Health Insurance, Human Capital, and the Dynamics of Earnings and Health
records.title_cn: 健康冲击、健康保险、人力资本以及收入和健康的动态
records.abstract_en: We develop a life-cycle model of labor supply and human capital formation that incorporates health shocks, health insurance, and medical treatment decisions. We use the model to study effects of health shocks on health, labor supply, earnings, and earnings inequality. We also simulate provision of public insurance to agents who lack employer-sponsored insurance. While this increases medical spending substantially, it creates positive labor supply incentives for low-skill workers while reducing costs of social insurance, Medicaid, and free care. The net program cost is modest, and all model agents are ex ante better off in a balanced budget simulation.
records.abstract_cn: 我们开发了劳动力供应和人力资本形成的生命周期模型，其中包含健康冲击、健康保险和医疗决策。我们使用该模型来研究健康冲击对健康、劳动力供应、收入和收入不平等的影响。我们还模拟向缺乏雇主赞助保险的代理人提供公共保险。虽然这大幅增加了医疗支出，但它为低技能工人创造了积极的劳动力供应激励，同时降低了社会保险、医疗补助和免费护理的成本。净计划成本适中，并且所有模型代理在平衡预算模拟中事前状况都更好。

records.title_en: Glass Walls: Experimental Evidence on Constraints Faced by Women in Accessing Valuable Skilling Opportunities
records.title_cn: 玻璃墙：关于女性在获得宝贵技能机会方面面临的限制的实验证据
records.abstract_en: Experimental evidence from Pakistan shows that distance poses a large and discontinuous access constraint: women with village-based training centers are four times more likely to access valued training opportunities. More than half of the travel penalty is incurred when crossing the village boundary. Exogenous stipend variation reveals that this boundary effect is costly to offset and is not explained by travel costs. Security considerations are an important factor: providing secure group transport raises take-up, while women with greater safety concerns and those traversing underpopulated areas, a proxy for insecurity, have lower take-up. The training has similar positive benefits for women attending inside- and outside-village centers.
records.abstract_cn: 来自巴基斯坦的实验证据表明，距离造成了巨大且不连续的准入限制：拥有乡村培训中心的妇女获得宝贵培训机会的可能性要高出四倍。超过一半的交通罚款是在穿越村庄边界时产生的。外源性津贴变化表明，抵消这种边界效应的成本很高，并且不能用差旅成本来解释。安全考虑是一个重要因素：提供安全的团体交通会提高使用率，而安全问题较大的女性和穿越人口稀少地区（代表不安全）的女性使用率较低。对于参加村内和村外中心的妇女来说，培训也有类似的积极好处。

records.title_en: Ever since Allais
records.title_cn: 自从阿莱
records.abstract_en: The Allais critique of expected utility theory (EUT) has led to the development of theories of choice under risk that relax the independence axiom but adhere to the fundamental/conventional axioms of ordering (completeness and transitivity) and monotonicity (with respect to first-order stochastic dominance). Unlike experimental work designed to test independence, our experiment is comprehensive, testing the entire set of axioms on which EUT is based. Our econometric analysis is also nonparametric and performed at the level of each individual subject. For the vast majority of subjects, departures from independence are small relative to departures from ordering and/or monotonicity.
records.abstract_cn: 阿莱对预期效用理论（EUT）的批评导致了风险选择理论的发展，这些理论放宽了独立性公理，但坚持有序性（完整性和传递性）和单调性（关于第一阶随机优势）的基本/传统公理。与旨在测试独立性的实验工作不同，我们的实验是全面的，测试 EUT 所基于的整套公理。我们的计量经济学分析也是非参数的，并且在每个单独主题的层面上进行。对于绝大多数主题而言，相对于顺序和/或单调性的偏离，偏离独立性的程度较小。

records.title_en: Linking Social and Personal Preferences: Theory and Experiment
records.title_cn: 连接社会和个人偏好：理论与实验
records.abstract_en: We provide necessary and sufficient conditions for linking preferences for personal and social consumption and attitudes toward risk. We also offer an experimental test of the theory in which subjects were confronted with risky personal choices, riskless social choices, and risky social choices. Revealed preference tests show that subject choices are generally consistent within each choice domain but frequently involve at least some errors. We test for consistency across choice domains using a revealed preference test that accounts for these errors. The choices of a large majority of subjects are consistent with the predictions of our theory.
records.abstract_cn: 我们为将个人和社会消费偏好与风险态度联系起来提供充分必要条件。我们还对该理论进行了实验测试，其中受试者面临有风险的个人选择、无风险的社会选择和有风险的社会选择。显示偏好测试表明，每个选择领域内的主题选择通常是一致的，但经常至少包含一些错误。我们使用解释这些错误的显示偏好测试来测试选择域之间的一致性。绝大多数受试者的选择与我们理论的预测一致。

records.title_en: Customer accumulation, returns to scale, and secular trends
records.title_cn: 客户积累、规模报酬和长期趋势
records.abstract_en: This paper studies how rising returns to scale contributed to declining business dynamism and increasing markups and expenditures devoted to customer acquisition in the U.S. economy. It introduces a firm dynamics model with heterogeneous markups and customer accumulation based on directed search, in which larger firms gain a competitive edge from higher returns to scale. This makes markets less contestable for new firms and leads to the rise of superstar firms. The model quantitatively accounts for a substantial share of these trends, and the underlying micro-level mechanisms align with empirical evidence.
records.abstract_cn: 本文研究了规模报酬上升如何导致美国经济中商业活力下降以及客户获取支出和加价增加。它引入了一个基于定向搜索的异质加价和客户积累的企业动态模型，其中较大的企业因更高的规模报酬而获得竞争优势。这使得市场对新企业的竞争性降低，并导致超级企业的崛起。该模型定量地解释了这些趋势的相当大一部分，基础的微观机制与实证证据相一致。

records.title_en: Monetary policy trade-offs amid global supply chain disruptions
records.title_cn: 全球供应链中断下的货币政策权衡
records.abstract_en: The COVID-19 pandemic led to unprecedented disruptions in global supply chains (GSC), coupled with large fiscal stimulus. This paper employs a proxy structural VAR model to examine GSC shocks, the Federal Reserve’s response, and their propagation under two counterfactual policy rules. Large fiscal stimulus amplifies inflation while cushioning the downturn from GSC shocks. Historically, the Fed has looked through price surges and adopted a loose stance. The first counterfactual, which stabilises inflation, entails less accommodation and yields a more favourable inflation-output trade-off, reflecting greater price flexibility and limited output losses. The second, which minimises a dual-mandate loss function under inflation targeting (IT) or average inflation targeting (AIT), calls for greater initial easing. Relative to IT, AIT implies a looser policy that generates more persistent inflation and ultimately requires a contractionary response, worsening the trade-off.
records.abstract_cn: COVID-19大流行导致全球供应链（GSC）出现前所未有的中断，并伴随大规模财政刺激。本文采用代理结构VAR模型来研究GSC冲击、联邦储备委员会的反应及其在二反事实政策规则下的传播。大规模财政刺激在缓解GSC冲击带来的经济下滑的同时，放大了通货膨胀。历史上，联邦储备委员会对价格飙升采取了忽视态度，并采取了宽松立场。第一反事实政策稳定通货膨胀，意味着更少的宽松，并产生更有利的通货膨胀-产出权衡，反映出更大的价格灵活性和有限的产出损失。第二在通货膨胀目标（IT）或平均通货膨胀目标（AIT）下最小化双重任务损失函数，要求更大的初始宽松。与IT相比，AIT意味着更宽松的政策，产生更持久的通货膨胀，最终需要收缩性反应，从而恶化了权衡。

records.title_en: Racial disparities in crime and wealth
records.title_cn: 种族在犯罪和财富方面的差异
records.abstract_en: This paper documents how racial differences in labor income may simultaneously explain both crime and wealth disparities between Black and White individuals. Using an overlapping generations model that endogenously determines crime rates alongside consumption and savings decisions, we find that equalizing labor incomes results in a significant decline in both the Black crime rate and the proportion of Black individuals in the lowest wealth quintile. Higher crime and incarceration rates of Black individuals, on the other hand, do not significantly contribute to their low wealth. This is primarily because most crimes are committed by already poor and young individuals who are not saving in any case.
records.abstract_cn: 本文记录了劳动收入的种族差异如何同时解释黑人和白人个体之间的犯罪和财富差距。使用一个重叠世代模型，该模型内生地确定犯罪率以及消费和储蓄决策，我们发现平等化劳动收入导致黑人犯罪率和处于最低财富五分位的黑人个体比例显著下降。另一方面，黑人个体的高犯罪和监禁率并未显著导致他们的低财富。这主要是因为大多数犯罪是由已经贫穷和年轻的个体所犯，他们在任何情况下都没有储蓄。

records.title_en: Bank concentration, product market competition and productivity growth
records.title_cn: 银行集中度、产品市场竞争与生产率增长
records.abstract_en: U.S. product markets have become more concentrated since the late 1990s, with higher markups, weaker entry, and slower productivity growth. This paper studies whether consolidation in the U.S. banking sector has contributed to these trends. Empirically, I show that higher bank concentration is associated with rising product market markups, lower entry, and a reallocation of market power toward large incumbents. I interpret these patterns in a quantitative endogenous growth model with imperfect bank competition and heterogeneous firms. The key mechanism is a widening loan-deposit spread: even as interest rate levels decline, greater bank market power increases the wedge between the borrowing costs faced by small bank-dependent firms and the opportunity cost of funds faced by large internally financed firms, shifting competition toward large incumbents and weakening innovation incentives. In calibrated counterfactuals, the rise in bank concentration explains about 14% of the increase in product market concentration and 5% of the slowdown in productivity growth over the post-2000 period.
records.abstract_cn: 自 1990 以来，美国产品市场变得更加集中，标价更高，进入壁垒更弱，生产率增长放缓。本文研究了美国银行业的整合是否对这些趋势产生了影响。从实证上看，我表明更高的银行集中度与产品市场标价上升、进入减少以及市场权力向大型 incumbents 的重新分配相关。我在一个具有不完全银行竞争和异质性企业的定量内生增长模型中解释这些模式。关键机制是贷款-存款利差的扩大：即使利率水平下降，银行市场权力的增强也增加了小型依赖银行的企业面临的借款成本与大型内部融资企业面临的资金机会成本之间的差距，导致竞争向大型 incumbents 转移，并削弱了创新激励。在校准的反事实中，银行集中度的上升解释了约 14% 的产品市场集中度增加和 5% 的生产率增长放缓，时间段为后 2000 期。

records.title_en: Staffing agencies and in-house bargaining
records.title_cn: 人力资源中介与内部谈判
records.abstract_en: Nowadays, many producing firms do not hire workers, but rent them from “staffing agencies”, whose main activity is to find, employ, and rent out workers to producing firms. That way, producing firms do not bear the direct costs of search and instead rent workers in a competitive market. We employ standard search-and-matching theory to analyze this phenomenon, with producing firms that have decreasing returns to scale. We find that the mere presence of staffing agencies has an important impact on the bargaining between the firms and their hired, “in-house” workers: firms can strategically use rented workers to weaken the bargaining position of in-house workers, tilting bargaining in their own favor. This has first-order effects on wages and employment. If rented and in-house workers are identical in production and in search markets, the unique equilibrium is one where producing firms only use rented workers. If renting workers involve additional costs, the equilibrium features an interior solution where each firm procures workers from two sources.
records.abstract_cn: 如今，许多生产企业不直接雇佣工人，而是从“人力资源中介”租用工人，这些中介的主要活动是寻找、雇佣并将工人租给生产企业。通过这种方式，生产企业不承担直接的搜索成本，而是在竞争市场中租用工人。我们运用标准的搜索与匹配理论来分析这一现象，考虑到生产企业具有递减的规模收益。我们发现，人力资源中介的存在对企业与其雇佣的“内部”工人之间的谈判产生了重要影响：企业可以战略性地利用租用工人来削弱内部工人的谈判地位，从而使谈判倾向于自身有利。这对工资和就业产生了第一阶的影响。如果租用工人和内部工人在生产和搜索市场上是相同的，则唯一的均衡是一，其中生产企业仅使用租用工人。如果租用工人涉及额外成本，则均衡特征为内部解决方案，每个企业从二来源采购工人。

records.title_en: Unstable prosperity: How globalization made the world economy more volatile
records.title_cn: 不稳定的繁荣：全球化如何使世界经济更加波动
records.abstract_en: The protracted fall in the real interest rate of the 1991–2020 period indicates that global demand for financial assets grew much faster than supply. We propose a two-region model of private capital flows to show that two drivers of global prosperity played a key role in this phenomenon: faster growth in emerging economies (EMEs) and financial development in advanced (AEs) and emerging economies. The model also predicts that asset portfolios became riskier and made countries more vulnerable to financial crises, increasing output volatility worldwide. The faster growth of EMEs accounts for 18% and 13% of the rise in volatility in EMEs and AEs, respectively, and it also produced large welfare gains for EMEs. Changes in the financial structure of both regions also contributed to increase output volatility, producing gains for entrepreneurs and losses for households.
records.abstract_cn: 1991-2020时期实际利率的长期下降表明，全球对金融资产的需求增长速度远快于供应。我们提出了一个二区域的私人资本流动模型，以表明二全球繁荣的驱动因素在这一现象中发挥了关键作用：新兴经济体（EMEs）的更快增长以及发达经济体（AEs）和新兴经济体的金融发展。该模型还预测，资产组合变得更加风险，导致各国对金融危机的脆弱性增加，从而提高了全球的产出波动性。EMEs的更快增长分别占EMEs和AEs波动性上升的18%和13%，并且为EMEs带来了巨大的福利收益。两个地区金融结构的变化也导致了产出波动性的增加，为企业家带来了收益，而家庭则遭受了损失。

records.title_en: Comment on: Is it AI or data that drives market power?
records.title_cn: 评论：是人工智能还是数据驱动市场力量？
records.abstract_en: •Distinguishes raw data, AI capability, and processed data in firm production.•Connects AI data processing to the information entropy literature.•Discusses secondary markets for processed data among firms.•Clarifies implications of data and AI capability for industry concentration.•Benchmarks AI–market power models against the broader data economics literature.
records.abstract_cn: •区分企业生产中的原始数据、人工智能能力和处理数据。•将人工智能数据处理与信息熵文献联系起来。•讨论企业之间处理数据的二级市场。•阐明数据和人工智能能力对行业集中度的影响。•将人工智能-市场力量模型与更广泛的数据经济学文献进行基准比较。

records.title_en: Discussion of: “Automated credit limit increases and consumer welfare”
records.title_cn: 讨论：“自动化信用额度提升与消费者福利”

records.title_en: Comment on “The impact of AI on global knowledge work” by Enrique Ide and Eduard Talamàs
records.title_cn: 对Enrique Ide和Eduard Talamàs《人工智能对全球知识工作的影响》的评论

records.title_en: Operational shorting and ETF liquidity provision
records.title_cn: 运营性卖空与ETF流动性提供
records.abstract_en: ETF market makers can satisfy excess demand in secondary markets by selling shares that are not yet created. While this ability to “operationally short” is not unique to ETFs, it plays a central role in ETF liquidity provision. We propose and validate a novel “operational shorting” measure. In addition to constituting a majority of ETF short interest, it is associated with higher retail trading activity and short-term return reversals, consistent with liquidity-supplying motives. Accounting for operational shorting is important in examining ETF returns, mispricing, and the asset-pricing implications of ETF trading on underlying securities.
records.abstract_cn: ETF做市商可以通过出售尚未创建的股份来满足二级市场的超额需求。虽然这种“运营性卖空”能力并非ETF独有，但它在ETF流动性提供中扮演核心角色。我们提出并验证了一种新颖的“运营性卖空”度量。除了构成ETF空头持仓的大部分外，它与更高的散户交易活动和短期收益反转相关，这与流动性供给动机一致。在考察ETF收益、错误定价以及ETF交易对标的证券的资产定价影响时，考虑运营性卖空至关重要。

records.title_en: Market feedback: Evidence from the horse’s mouth
records.title_cn: 市场反馈：来自企业内部的证据
records.abstract_en: We surveyed all Chinese public firms in 2019 and 2022 to examine the real effects of financial markets. Over 90% of firms say they actively monitor the stock market, and the most common reasons they provide are that they learn new information from the price and that they depend on the price for financing. Focusing on the learning channel, we examine how the responses relate to firm characteristics and actions. Firms that indicate learning have characteristics that suggest greater benefit from market information. They also exhibit higher investment-to-price sensitivity. We provide results on what dimensions of information firms learn about.
records.abstract_cn: 我们在2019年和2022年调查了所有中国上市公司，以考察金融市场的实际影响。超过90%的公司表示他们积极关注股票市场，他们提供的最常见原因是从价格中获取新信息以及依赖价格进行融资。聚焦于学习渠道，我们考察了这些回应如何与公司特征和行为相关联。表明学习的公司具有表明从市场信息中获益更大的特征。它们还表现出更高的投资-价格敏感性。我们提供了关于公司学习信息维度的结果。

records.title_en: Dual peer effects and cross-stock predictability
records.title_cn: 双重同伴效应与跨股票可预测性
records.abstract_en: This paper introduces a Peer Index (PI) constructed from economically motivated peer networks that summarizes (i) the strength of a firm’s peers and (ii) the firm’s position within its peer group. PI predicts stock returns and earnings surprises over short and long horizons. Machine-learning models based solely on firm-level characteristics do not subsume PI’s predictive power, supporting the interpretation that it captures genuine cross-stock information. Lag-augmented local projections show that positive PI innovations are followed by higher next-month returns that gradually decay without reversal, consistent with slow diffusion of peer information into prices.
records.abstract_cn: 本文引入了一个基于经济动机驱动的同伴网络构建的同伴指数（PI），该指数概括了（i）公司同伴的强度以及（ii）公司在其同伴群体中的地位。PI在短期和长期内预测股票回报和盈利惊喜。仅基于公司层面特征的机器学习模型并未包含PI的预测能力，支持了其捕捉真实跨股票信息的解释。滞后增强的局部投影显示，正的PI创新随后带来更高的下月回报，这些回报逐渐衰减而无反转，与同伴信息缓慢扩散至价格中的情况一致。

records.title_en: Did pandemic relief fraud inflate house prices?
records.title_cn: 疫情救济欺诈是否推高了房价？
records.abstract_en: Pandemic fraud is geographically concentrated and stimulated local purchases, with effects on prices. Recipients of fraudulent Paycheck Protection Program (PPP) funds significantly increased their home purchasing rate compared to recipients of non-fraudulent PPP funds, and house prices in high-fraud ZIP codes increased 5.8 percentage points more than in low-fraud ZIP codes within the same county. In a horse race, pandemic fraud is one of the largest and most robust factors explaining house price appreciation during COVID. ZIP codes with fraud also experienced heightened vehicle purchases and other consumer spending in 2020-21, with a return to normal in 2022.
records.abstract_cn: 疫情欺诈在地理上集中，并刺激了当地购买，对价格产生了影响。与获得非欺诈性薪资保护计划（PPP）资金的受助者相比，欺诈性PPP资金的受助者购房率显著提高，且在同一县内，高欺诈邮政编码区的房价涨幅比低欺诈邮政编码区高出5.8个百分点。在一项赛马回归中，疫情欺诈是解释COVID期间房价上涨的最大且最稳健的因素之一。欺诈邮政编码区在2020-21年期间还经历了车辆购买和其他消费支出的增加，到2022年恢复正常。

records.title_en: Foundational processes and growth
records.title_cn: 基础性流程与增长
records.abstract_en: This paper studies the interaction between process and product innovations and their distinct role in firm growth dynamics. We differentiate empirically and theoretically two types of process innovations: foundational processes that advance production technology and cost-reducing processes that enhance existing production efficiency. We develop an innovation model of product varieties with quality heterogeneity to illustrate how these innovations impact firm growth differently and highlight how process innovation induces product innovation. By analyzing millions of patent texts from 1900 to 2020, we classify innovations into product, cost-reducing process, and foundational process innovations. We find that foundational processes lead to sustained firm growth, especially through their effect on subsequent product creation. R&D-intensive firms focused on “deep-tech” innovations have an advantage in creating foundational processes, resulting in superior product quality. Using patents linked to FDA-approved drugs, we show that firms with a comparative advantage in creating foundational processes, due to greater knowledge and technological stock, tend to produce higher-value products.
records.abstract_cn: 本文研究了流程创新与产品创新之间的相互作用及其在企业增长动态中的不同作用。我们在实证和理论上区分了两种类型的流程创新：推进生产技术的基础性流程和提升现有生产效率的成本降低流程。我们开发了一个具有质量异质性的产品种类创新模型，以说明这些创新如何对企业增长产生不同影响，并强调流程创新如何诱发产品创新。通过分析从1900年到2020年的数百万专利文本，我们将创新分类为产品创新、成本降低流程创新和基础性流程创新。我们发现，基础性流程带来持续的企业增长，尤其是通过其对后续产品创造的影响。专注于“深科技”创新的研发密集型企业，在创造基础性流程方面具有优势，从而产生卓越的产品质量。利用与FDA批准药物相关联的专利，我们表明，由于拥有更多的知识和技术存量，在创造基础性流程方面具有比较优势的企业，往往生产出更高价值的产品。

records.title_en: Cashless payment and financial inclusion
records.title_cn: 无现金支付与金融包容性
records.abstract_en: This paper investigates how cashless payment affects credit access for underserved populations using data from Alipay, a leading Chinese BigTech platform with over 1 billion users that offers a wide range of financial services. By exploiting the staggered rollout of Alipay-bundled shared bikes across cities as a natural experiment and analyzing a representative Alipay user sample, I find that cashless payment adoption increases credit access by 56.3% and that a 1% rise in payment flow increases credit lines by 0.41%. These effects are stronger for less educated and older individuals, who have traditionally faced greater barriers to accessing financial services.
records.abstract_cn: 本文利用中国领先的BigTech平台支付宝（拥有超过1亿用户，提供广泛的金融服务）的数据，研究无现金支付如何影响服务不足人群的信贷获取。通过将支付宝捆绑的共享单车在各城市的逐步推出作为自然实验，并分析具有代表性的支付宝用户样本，我发现无现金支付的采用使信贷获取增加了56.3%，且支付流量每增加1%，信贷额度增加0.41%。这些效应在受教育程度较低和年龄较大的个体中更为显著，他们传统上面临更大的金融服务获取障碍。

records.title_en: Past is prologue: Inference from the cross section of returns around an event
records.title_cn: 过去即前奏：从事件周围横截面收益的推断
records.abstract_en: Confounding events can cause false positives when testing the relationship between short-term returns around a quasi-experimental event and firm characteristics. We show that this risk is severe in practice — return-characteristic relationships are often statistically significant at the 1% level on over 30% of all trading days. Benchmarking a relationship against the distribution of the same relationship on pre-event days is effective at addressing the problem. We introduce a novel GLS variation of this approach that achieves large gains in statistical power relative to OLS and provide Stata and Python modules that implement both procedures.
records.abstract_cn: 混淆事件可能导致在检验准实验事件周围短期收益与企业特征之间的关系时出现假阳性。我们表明，这种风险在实践中很严重——在超过30%的所有交易日中，收益-特征关系在1%的水平上统计显著。将某一关系与事件前日同一关系的分布进行基准比较，能有效解决这一问题。我们引入了该方法的一种新颖的GLS变体，相对于OLS在统计功效上实现了大幅提升，并提供了实现这两种程序的Stata和Python模块。

records.title_en: Face-to-face social interactions and local informational advantage
records.title_cn: 面对面社交互动与本地信息优势
records.abstract_en: This paper examines the causal role of face-to-face (F2F) interactions in generating local informational advantages for mutual fund managers. Using COVID-19 lockdowns as an exogenous shock, I show that fund managers’ performance on local stocks declined relative to distant stocks when in-person meetings were curtailed, driven by impaired investment timing rather than changes in firm fundamentals. I investigate two distinct benefits of F2F interactions arising from interpersonal cues: trust-building, which enhances the transmission of soft information, and impression management, which facilitates the transmission of favorable information. The results cannot be fully explained by changes in internal information flows or the use of public information, and are more pronounced for stocks in less transparent information environments and in regions with stronger social traits.
records.abstract_cn: 本文考察了面对面（F2F）互动在共同基金经理获取本地信息优势中的因果作用。利用COVID-19封锁作为外生冲击，我发现当面对面会议受到限制时，基金经理在本地股票上的表现相对于远处股票有所下降，这主要是由于投资时机受损而非公司基本面变化所致。我研究了面对面互动中源于人际线索的两个不同益处：建立信任，这增强了软信息的传递；以及印象管理，这促进了有利信息的传递。结果不能完全由内部信息流的变化或公共信息的使用来解释，并且在信息环境透明度较低和社交特质较强的地区，这种效应更为显著。

records.title_en: Patents that match your standards: Firm-level evidence on competition, innovation and growth
records.title_cn: 符合你标准的专利：关于竞争、创新与增长的企业层面证据
records.abstract_en: When a technology becomes the new standard, the firms that are leaders in producing this technology gain a competitive advantage. Matching the semantic content of patents to standard documents, we show that firms closer to the new technology standard increase their market share and sales. In addition, if they operate in a competitive market, these firms also increase their R&D expenditure. Yet, these effects are temporary since standardization creates a common technological basis for everyone, which allows followers to catch up and the economy to grow.
records.abstract_cn: 当一项技术成为新标准时，生产该技术的领先企业获得竞争优势。通过将专利的语义内容与标准文件匹配，我们发现更接近新技术标准的企业市场份额和销售额增加。此外，如果这些企业在竞争性市场中运营，它们还会增加研发支出。然而，这些效应是暂时的，因为标准化为所有人创造了共同的技术基础，使追随者能够追赶上来，经济得以增长。

records.title_en: Pricing of Climate Risk Insurance: Regulation and Cross‐Subsidies
records.title_cn: 气候风险保险定价：监管与交叉补贴
records.abstract_en: Homeowners insurance is central to managing the rising losses from climate‐related disasters. We show that insurance premiums are subject to starkly different regulations across states, creating persistent cross‐subsidies and price distortions. We employ states' regulatory rules in an instrumental variable estimation and a border discontinuity design to show insurers do not adjust rates in highly regulated states and compensate by raising rates in less regulated states. Rates and risks diverge in the long run, distorting cross‐state risk‐sharing and increasing insurer exits from highly regulated states. We argue these patterns stem from the interactions between rate regulation and insurers' financing constraints.
records.abstract_cn: 住房保险是应对气候相关灾害日益增加损失的核心手段。我们展示了各州保险费率受到截然不同的监管，导致持续的交叉补贴和价格扭曲。我们利用各州的监管规则，采用工具变量估计和边界不连续设计，表明保险公司在高度监管的州不调整费率，而通过提高监管较少州的费率进行补偿。长期来看，费率与风险出现背离，扭曲了跨州风险分担，并增加了保险公司退出高度监管州的现象。我们认为这些模式源于费率监管与保险公司融资约束之间的相互作用。

records.title_en: Competition Enforcement and Accounting for Intangible Capital
records.title_cn: 竞争执法与无形资本的核算
records.abstract_en: Antitrust laws mandate review of mergers and acquisitions (M&As) that exceed an asset size threshold based on accounting standards that exclude most intangible capital. We show that this exclusion leads to thousands of intangible‐intensive M&As being nonreportable. Acquirers in nonreportable deals achieve higher equity values and price markups, especially when consolidating product markets. Furthermore, nonreportable pharmaceutical deals are three times more likely to involve overlapping drug projects, which are subsequently 40% more likely to be terminated. Our results suggest that the growth of intangible assets may exacerbate market power through nonreportable consolidation of the sectors most concerning for consumers.
records.abstract_cn: 反垄断法要求对超过基于会计准则的资产规模门槛的并购交易进行审查，而该会计准则排除了大部分无形资本。我们表明，这种排除导致数千起无形资本密集型的并购交易未被报告。非报告交易中的收购方实现了更高的股权价值和价格溢价，尤其是在整合产品市场时。此外，非报告的制药交易中涉及重叠药物项目的可能性是三倍，这些项目随后被终止的可能性是40%倍。我们的结果表明，无形资产的增长可能通过未报告的整合加剧市场势力，尤其是在消费者最关切的行业中。

records.title_en: The (Missing) Relation between Acquisition Announcement Returns and Value Creation
records.title_cn: 收购公告收益与价值创造之间的（缺失）关系
records.abstract_en: Cumulative abnormal returns (CARs) computed around acquisition announcements are widely considered to be market‐based assessments of expected value creation. We show, however, that announcement returns do not correlate with commonly used and new measures of ex post outcomes. A simple characteristics‐based model using standard information known at the announcement date can predict these outcomes reasonably well, yet CAR even fails to capture the predictions from this model. Evidence suggests that information about the stand‐alone acquirer dominates CAR, making it virtually impossible to extract deal‐related information. We conclude that CAR is an unreliable measure of expected value creation.
records.abstract_cn: 围绕收购公告计算的累计异常收益（CARs）被广泛认为是基于市场的预期价值创造评估。然而，我们发现公告收益与常用及新提出的事后结果衡量指标之间不存在相关性。一个基于公告日期已知标准信息的简单特征模型能够较好地预测这些结果，但CAR甚至未能反映该模型的预测。证据表明，关于独立收购方的信息主导了CAR，使得几乎不可能提取与交易相关的信息。我们得出结论，CAR是一个不可靠的预期价值创造衡量指标。

records.title_en: The Voting Premium
records.title_cn: 投票溢价
records.abstract_en: We develop a unified theory of blockholder governance and the voting premium in a setting without takeovers or controlling shareholders. A voting premium emerges when a minority blockholder can influence shareholder composition by accumulating votes and buying shares from dissenting shareholders. Our theory reconciles conflicting empirical findings by showing that standard measures of the voting premium often misrepresent the true value of voting rights, increased conflicts between the blockholder and small shareholders do not necessarily raise the voting premium, and the voting premium can even turn negative when small shareholders free‐ride on the blockholder's trades.
records.abstract_cn: 我们在无收购或控股股东的情形下，构建了一个关于大股东治理与投票溢价的统一理论。当少数大股东通过积累投票权并从持不同意见的股东手中购买股份，从而影响股东构成时，投票溢价便会出现。我们的理论调和了相互矛盾的实证结果，表明投票溢价的标准衡量方法常常误导投票权的真实价值，大股东与小股东之间的冲突加剧并不必然提升投票溢价，且当小股东搭便车于大股东的交易时，投票溢价甚至可能转为负值。

records.title_en: Leader‐Follower Dynamics in Shareholder Activism
records.title_cn: 股东激进主义中的领导者-跟随者动态
records.abstract_en: We propose a theory of coordination and influence among blockholders. Privately informed activists time their trades in sequence to lower acquisition costs, prompting a strategic use of order flows: leader activists create trading gains for their followers, ultimately influencing their willingness to bear greater value‐enhancing intervention costs. Through this channel, informed trades can exhibit predictability, in sharp contrast with Kyle (1985, Econometrica 53, 1315–1335). We explain how this novel predictability shapes free‐rider problems affecting governance, and how it produces price abnormalities analogous to those documented empirically. We also uncover how private information interdependence can be a key catalyst for the mechanism studied.
records.abstract_cn: 我们提出了一个关于大股东之间协调与影响的理论。私下掌握信息的激进投资者按顺序安排交易时机，以降低收购成本，从而促使订单流的战略性使用：领导者激进投资者为其跟随者创造交易收益，最终影响他们承担更大价值提升干预成本的意愿。通过这一渠道，信息交易可以表现出可预测性，这与Kyle（1985，Econometrica 53，1315-1335）形成鲜明对比。我们解释了这种新颖的可预测性如何影响治理中的搭便车问题，以及它如何产生与实证文献中记录的价格异常类似的现象。我们还发现，私人信息的相互依赖性可能是所研究机制的关键催化剂。

records.title_en: Corporate M&As and Labor Market Concentration: Efficiency Gains or Power Grabs?
records.title_cn: 企业并购与劳动力市场集中度：效率提升还是权力攫取？
records.abstract_en: Mergers of firms that share labor markets increase labor market concentration which can lead to labor efficiency gains and/or create labor market power for the merged firms. Using a novel measure based on establishment‐level employment data, we find that merger‐induced increases in labor market concentration explain value creation in a sample of completed U.S. public firm mergers from 1991 to 2016. Analysis of the stock market reactions of rival, supplier, and customer firms, as well as firm‐ and establishment‐level real effects in the merging firms, supports a labor efficiency explanation of these merger gains.
records.abstract_cn: 共享劳动力市场的企业合并会增加劳动力市场集中度，这可能带来劳动力效率提升和/或为合并企业创造劳动力市场权力。利用基于企业层面就业数据的新颖度量方法，我们发现劳动力市场集中度因合并而增加，能够解释一组从1991到2016完成的美国上市公司并购样本中的价值创造。对竞争对手、供应商和客户公司的股市反应分析，以及合并企业的公司层面和企业层面的实际效应，支持了这些并购收益的劳动力效率解释。

records.title_en: Consumer Choice and Corporate Bankruptcy
records.title_cn: 消费者选择与企业破产
records.abstract_en: We estimate the indirect costs of corporate bankruptcy associated with lost customers. In incentivized experiments, randomly informing consumers about a firm's Chapter 11 reorganization lowers their willingness to pay for the firm's products by 17% to 28%. Consumers worry that bankruptcy could reduce product quality or prevent future interactions with the bankrupt firm. On average, 38% of consumers are aware of major bankruptcies. Using our experiments to estimate a structural model, we show that these indirect costs of bankruptcy amount to 12% to 15% of a firm's value. We show that these costs are unlikely to arise before bankruptcy.
records.abstract_cn: 我们估计了与客户流失相关的企业破产间接成本。在激励实验中，随机告知消费者某公司根据第11章进行重组，会使其对该公司产品的支付意愿降低17%至28%。消费者担心破产可能降低产品质量或阻碍未来与破产公司的互动。平均而言，38%的消费者知晓重大破产事件。利用我们的实验估计结构模型，我们表明这些破产的间接成本占公司价值的12%至15%。我们还表明，这些成本不太可能在破产前出现。

records.title_en: Specialization in Banking
records.title_cn: 银行业的专业化
records.abstract_en: Using supervisory data on the loan portfolios of large U.S. banks, we document that these banks specialize by concentrating their lending disproportionately in a few industries. This specialization is consistent with banks having industry‐specific knowledge, reflected in reduced risk of loan defaults, lower aggregate charge‐offs, and higher propensity to lend to opaque firms in the preferred industry. Banks attract high‐quality borrowers by offering generous loan terms in their specialized industry, especially to borrowers with alternative options. Banks focus on their preferred industry in times of instability and relatively lower Tier 1 capital as well as after surges in deposits.
records.abstract_cn: 利用美国大型银行贷款组合的监管数据，我们记录到这些银行通过在少数几个行业中不成比例地集中贷款实现专业化。这种专业化与银行拥有行业特定知识相一致，表现为贷款违约风险降低、整体核销减少以及更倾向于向首选行业中信息不透明的企业放贷。银行通过在其专业化行业中为借款人提供优厚的贷款条件，尤其是对那些有其他选择的借款人，吸引高质量借款人。银行在不稳定时期、相对较低的一级资本充足率（Tier 1）以及存款激增后，更加专注于其首选行业。

records.title_en: Deposit Franchise Runs
records.title_cn: 存款特许经营权挤兑
records.abstract_en: The deposit franchise is valuable because banks pay below‐market deposit rates. However, if depositors leave, its value vanishes. This can trigger runs by uninsured depositors, even if banks hold fully liquid assets. Because the franchise value increases with interest rates, runs are more harmful, and hence likelier, when rates are high. Banks can deter runs by shortening asset duration, but this risks insolvency if rates fall. Avoiding both runs and insolvency requires capital covering the potential loss of the uninsured deposit franchise. We estimate deposit franchise values and use them to identify vulnerable banks during the 2023 regional bank crisis.
records.abstract_cn: 存款特许经营权具有价值，因为银行支付的存款利率低于市场利率。然而，如果存款人撤资，其价值将消失。这可能引发无保险存款人的挤兑，即使银行持有完全流动的资产。由于特许经营权价值随利率上升而增加，挤兑在利率高时更具破坏性，因此也更可能发生。银行可以通过缩短资产期限来阻止挤兑，但如果利率下降，这会带来破产风险。避免挤兑和破产都需要资本覆盖无保险存款特许经营权的潜在损失。我们估计了存款特许经营权的价值，并利用这些估计识别了2023地区银行危机中脆弱的银行。

records.title_en: Funding Black High‐Growth Startups
records.title_cn: 资助黑人高增长初创企业
records.abstract_en: We classify the race of over 160,000 U.S. founders and investors and study the venture capital (VC) funding gap for Black entrepreneurs. Only 3.1% of VC‐funded startups are Black‐owned, and they raise half as much VC funding as others. We attribute much of this gap to Black founders having fewer traditional success markers, like patents or entrepreneurial experience. This disparity also affects matching: Black VC partners invest more in Black founders, and these investments have higher successful exit rates. We attribute this outperformance to lower information asymmetries due to network overlap and “screening discrimination,” whereby Black VCs better differentiate among Black founders.
records.abstract_cn: 我们对超过160,000名美国创始人和投资者的种族进行了分类，并研究了黑人创业者的风险投资（VC）资金差距。只有3.1%的风险投资资助的初创企业是黑人拥有的，他们获得的风险投资资金仅为其他企业的一半。我们将这一差距主要归因于黑人创始人拥有的传统成功标志较少，如专利或创业经验。这种差异也影响了匹配：黑人风险投资合伙人更多地投资于黑人创始人，而这些投资的成功退出率更高。我们将这种超额表现归因于由于网络重叠导致的信息不对称较低以及“筛选歧视”，即黑人风险投资者能够更好地区分黑人创始人。

records.title_en: Size, Returns, and Value: Do Private Equity Firms Allocate Capital According to Manager Skill?
records.title_cn: 规模、收益与价值：私募股权公司是否根据管理者技能配置资本？
records.abstract_en: Using a novel data set linking private equity (PE) deals to individual managers, we document evidence of manager skill in terms of generating net present value (NPV), a performance measure that captures both scale and returns. PE firms have strong economic incentives to raise larger funds and execute larger deals. While relative returns decline with scale, NPV persists and even increases. Skilled managers are entrusted with more capital and achieve better career outcomes, and approximately 40% of NPV is attributable to internal capital allocation decisions. These findings highlight the role of PE firms in creating value through performance‐based capital deployment.
records.abstract_cn: 利用一套将私募股权（PE）交易与个别管理者关联的新颖数据集，我们记录了管理者技能在创造净现值（NPV）方面的证据，NPV是一种同时反映规模和收益的绩效指标。私募股权公司有强烈的经济动机筹集更大规模的基金并执行更大规模的交易。尽管相对收益随规模增长而下降，NPV却得以持续甚至增加。具备技能的管理者被赋予更多资本并取得更好的职业成果，约有40%的NPV归因于内部资本配置决策。这些发现凸显了私募股权公司通过基于绩效的资本部署创造价值的作用。

records.title_en: The Effect of Advisors' Incentives on Clients' Investments
records.title_cn: 顾问激励对客户投资的影响
records.abstract_en: We use granular data from an investment firm and a credible identification strategy to estimate the effect of financial advisors' incentives on client investments. Exploiting a natural experiment triggered by the 2018 implementation of Markets in Financial Instruments Directive II (MiFID II), we find that clients' investments respond strongly to changes in advisor incentives. Advisors react through multiple mechanisms: (i) inducing existing clients to bring in new money, (ii) channeling it to high‐incentive funds, and (iii) attracting more new clients. We also find that the MiFID II reform generated more balanced incentives, which translated into higher portfolio efficiency through lower average fees and stronger portfolio diversification.
records.abstract_cn: 我们利用一家投资公司的详细数据和可信的识别策略，估计金融顾问激励对客户投资的影响。通过利用金融工具市场指令II（MiFID II）中2018实施引发的自然实验，我们发现客户投资对顾问激励的变化反应强烈。顾问通过多种机制作出反应：（i）促使现有客户带入新资金，（ii）将资金引导至高激励基金，以及（iii）吸引更多新客户。我们还发现，MiFID II改革产生了更为平衡的激励，这转化为更高的投资组合效率，表现为更低的平均费用和更强的投资组合多样化。

records.title_en: Model Ambiguity versus Model Misspecification in Dynamic Portfolio Choice
records.title_cn: 动态投资组合选择中的模型模糊性与模型误设
records.abstract_en: We study aversion to model ambiguity and misspecification in dynamic portfolio choice. Risk‐averse investors (relative risk aversion ) fear return persistence, while risk‐tolerant investors () fear mean reversion, when confronting model misspecification concerns of identically and independently distributed (IID) returns. The intuition is that risk‐averse investors, who want to hedge intertemporally, endogenously fear return persistence, which precludes hedging. A log investor is myopic and unaffected by model misspecification, therefore only worrying about model ambiguity. Our model can generate belief scarring, nonparticipation in equity markets, and extrapolative return expectations. Extending beyond IID returns, we study model misspecification for a mean‐reverting Sharpe ratio.
records.abstract_cn: 我们研究了动态投资组合选择中对模型模糊性和模型误设的厌恶。风险厌恶型投资者（相对风险厌恶系数）在面对同分布且独立（IID）收益的模型误设担忧时，担心收益的持续性；而风险容忍型投资者（）则担心均值回归。其直觉是，风险厌恶型投资者希望进行跨期对冲，因此内生地担心收益的持续性，因为持续性会阻碍对冲。对数效用投资者是近视的，不受模型误设影响，因此仅担心模型模糊性。我们的模型能够生成信念创伤、股市非参与以及外推性收益预期。超越IID收益，我们还研究了均值回归夏普比率的模型误设。

records.title_en: Asymmetric optimal auction design with loss-averse bidders
records.title_cn: 具有损失厌恶竞标者的非对称最优拍卖设计
records.abstract_en: We study optimal auctions with expectation-based loss-averse bidders. For ex-ante identical bidders, we establish sufficient conditions under which optimal mechanisms must be asymmetric. While symmetric designs are optimal for bidders with expected-utility preferences, we show that if the degree of loss aversion is sufficiently large relative to valuation variation, a one-bidder optimal design (an extreme form of asymmetry) yields higher expected revenue than any symmetric design with multiple bidders. To address the challenges posed by non-standard preferences, we develop a novel method for deriving the optimal auction. First, we employ the reduced-form auction framework to reformulate the revenue maximization problem as a tractable optimal control problem. We then use the ironing technique of Toikka (2011) to address the monotonicity constraint on the allocation rule, as Myerson’s ironing method is not applicable in our setting. Applying our method to a two-bidder setting with uniformly distributed valuations, we derive the optimal auction in closed form. The resulting mechanism modifies (Myerson, 1981) to reduce auction outcome uncertainty.
records.abstract_cn: 我们研究了具有基于期望的损失厌恶竞标者的最优拍卖。对于事前同质的竞标者，我们建立了最优机制必须非对称的充分条件。虽然对于具有期望效用偏好的竞标者，对称设计是最优的，但我们表明，如果损失厌恶程度相对于估值变异足够大，一竞标者的最优设计（一种极端形式的非对称）比任何多竞标者的对称设计都能带来更高的期望收入。为应对非标准偏好带来的挑战，我们开发了一种推导最优拍卖的新方法。第一，我们采用简化形式拍卖框架，将收益最大化问题重新表述为一个可解的最优控制问题。然后，我们使用Toikka（2011）的熨平技术来处理分配规则上的单调性约束，因为Myerson的熨平方法在我们的设定中不适用。将我们的方法应用于具有均匀分布估值的二竞标者设定，我们得出了闭式形式的最优拍卖。所得机制修改了（Myerson，1981），以减少拍卖结果的不确定性。

records.title_en: Localized perfection
records.title_cn: 局部完美均衡
records.abstract_en: Perfect equilibrium and its refinements are widely studied and typically rely on full-support perturbations. We introduce a δ-localized notion of perfection for games with a continuum of players. It confines perturbations within a δ-neighborhood of the underlying action distribution and eliminates undesirable equilibria from a local perspective. We establish the existence of a pure strategy δ-localized perfect equilibrium and show that it is equivalent to δ-admissible Nash equilibrium. We also study limit versions of δ-localized perfection. Illustrative applications to large routing games and crowd saturation games are presented.
records.abstract_cn: 完美均衡及其精炼概念被广泛研究，通常依赖于全支持扰动。我们引入了适用于具有连续玩家的博弈的δ-局部完美概念。该概念将扰动限制在基础行动分布的δ邻域内，并从局部视角消除不良均衡。我们证明了纯策略δ-局部完美均衡的存在性，并表明其等价于δ-可接受纳什均衡。我们还研究了δ-局部完美的极限版本。文中展示了该概念在大规模路径选择博弈和人群饱和博弈中的应用示例。

records.title_en: Nonbossy mechanisms: Mechanism design robust to secondary goals
records.title_cn: 非支配机制：对次要目标具有鲁棒性的机制设计
records.abstract_en: We study mechanism design when agents may have hidden secondary goals which will play a role when the primary utility of the outcomes is the same. We show that in such cases, a mechanism is immune to strategic manipulation if and only if it is incentive compatible with regard to primary utility — a property we term “primary incentive compatibility” — and nonbossy — a well-studied property in the context of matching and allocation mechanisms. We give complete characterizations of primarily incentive-compatible and nonbossy mechanisms in various settings, including auctions with single-parameter agents and public decision settings where all agents share a common outcome. In particular, we show that in the single-item setting, a mechanism is primarily incentive compatible, individually rational, and nonbossy if and only if it is a sequential posted-price mechanism.
records.abstract_cn: 我们研究当代理人可能具有隐藏的次要目标且在结果的主要效用相同时次要目标发挥作用的机制设计。我们证明，在此类情况下，机制对策略性操纵免疫当且仅当该机制在主要效用方面具有激励相容性——我们称之为“主要激励相容性”——且非支配——这是匹配和分配机制中广泛研究的性质。我们在多种情境下给出了主要激励相容且非支配机制的完整刻画，包括具有单参数代理人的拍卖以及所有代理人共享共同结果的公共决策情境。特别地，我们证明在单物品情境中，机制主要激励相容、个体理性且非支配当且仅当该机制为顺序定价机制。

records.title_en: Positive and negative selection in bargaining
records.title_cn: 讨价还价中的正向选择与负向选择
records.abstract_en: In the standard dynamic screening problem between an uninformed seller and a privately informed buyer, theory suggests that the presence (absence) of the buyer’s outside option leads to a substantial surplus for the seller (buyer). This outcome arises from contrasting unraveling processes that theory predicts: negative selection occurs in the absence of an outside option, while positive selection occurs in the presence of it. We examine the validity of these contrasting unraveling processes and report laboratory data that qualitatively deviate from theoretical predictions. We found that the seller’s profit ranking was reversed between the two environments. In particular, in the presence of an outside option, the buyer frequently rejected current-round offers, leading to pervasive delays; and the seller’s reported beliefs about the buyer’s type were qualitatively more consistent with the negative selection than with the theoretically predicted positive selection.
records.abstract_cn: 在无信息卖方与私有信息买方之间的标准动态筛选问题中，理论表明买方外部选择权的存在（缺失）会导致卖方（买方）获得显著的剩余。该结果源于理论预测的两种截然不同的剥离过程：在无外部选择权时发生负向选择，而在有外部选择权时发生正向选择。我们检验了这两种截然不同剥离过程的有效性，并报告了实验室数据，这些数据在定性上偏离理论预测。我们发现卖方利润排序在不同环境（二）间发生了逆转。特别是在存在外部选择权的情况下，买方频繁拒绝当前轮次的报价，导致普遍的延迟；且卖方关于买方类型的报告信念在定性上更符合负向选择，而非理论上预测的正向选择。

records.title_en: Credit rationing in unsecured debt markets
records.title_cn: 无担保债务市场中的信用配给
records.abstract_en: We show that a temporary tightening of unsecured credit limits can raise welfare in competitive economies with limited commitment. When default excludes agents from borrowing but not saving, the value of default becomes price-dependent. Because agents do not internalize the effects of borrowing limits on equilibrium prices and participation constraints, laissez-faire limits need not be welfare-maximizing. A pre-announced, transitory tightening raises bond prices (lowers interest rates), reduces the value of default, and relaxes self-enforcing borrowing limits in earlier periods. If the resulting expansion of risk sharing outweighs the temporary distortion when the cap binds, the policy delivers an ex ante Pareto improvement. The mechanism has a natural macroprudential interpretation, implying, under certain conditions, that reneging cannot be supported by unanimity once the policy is announced, and can also deliver welfare gains even in the absence of output penalties, low interest rates, and bubbly debt limits.
records.abstract_cn: 我们表明，在有限承诺的竞争经济中，暂时收紧无担保信用额度可以提高福利。当违约导致代理人被排除在借款之外但不影响储蓄时，违约的价值变得依赖于价格。由于代理人未能内化借款限额对均衡价格和参与约束的影响，自由放任的限额不一定是福利最大化的。预先宣布的暂时性收紧提高了债券价格（降低了利率），减少了违约价值，并放宽了早期的自我执行借款限额。如果由此带来的风险分担扩张超过了限额约束时的暂时扭曲，该政策将带来事前的帕累托改进。该机制具有自然的宏观审慎解释，意味着在某些条件下，一旦政策宣布，违约行为无法通过一致同意支持，并且即使在没有产出惩罚、低利率和泡沫债务限额的情况下，也能带来福利提升。

records.title_en: The VCG mechanism, the core, and assignment stages in auctions
records.title_cn: VCG机制、核心与拍卖中的分配阶段
records.abstract_en: The Vickrey-Clarke-Groves (VCG) mechanism is one of the most compelling constructs in mechanism design, but the presence of complementary goods creates the possibility of non-core and even zero-revenue outcomes. In this article, we show that joint feasibility constraints on allocations offer a second pathway to ill-behaved outcomes in the VCG mechanism, even when all bidders have substitutes preferences for the goods. We then develop a theory of complementarities specifically tailored to assignment stages of spectrum auctions. Assignment stages typically guarantee contiguous spectrum to each winner—this proves to be an especially severe joint feasibility constraint. We propose a definition of bidder complementarities and further dichotomize them as direct or indirect. When opponents bid on distinct parts of a bidder’s preferred assignment, they set up a direct bidder complementarity. However, if an assignment is denied through the contiguity restriction, that is called an indirect complementarity. As a result, non-core outcomes, together with all of the accompanying anomalies, can be expected in VCG assignment stages. We then examine a conspicuous recent spectrum auction, the FCC’s Broadcast Incentive Auction, and we provide the first documentation of zero-revenue outcomes in the field. Of 207 assignment stage auctions with at least three bidders, 17.9% produced non-core outcomes relative to the bids and, of these, 3 generated zero revenues. After rescaling bidder values, we find that the majority of assignment stage auctions had the potential for exploitable bidder complementarities and that the vast majority of bidder complementarities—both potential and realized—were indirect.
records.abstract_cn: Vickrey-Clarke-Groves (VCG) 机制是机制设计中最具吸引力的构造之一，但互补品的存在会导致非核心甚至零收入的结果。在本文中，我们表明，即使所有竞标者对商品都有替代偏好，分配的联合可行性约束也为VCG机制中的不良结果提供了第二条途径。然后，我们针对频谱拍卖的分配阶段，发展了一套专门的互补性理论。分配阶段通常保证每个赢家获得连续的频谱——这被证明是一种特别严格的联合可行性约束。我们提出了竞标者互补性的定义，并进一步将其划分为直接或间接互补性。当对手对竞标者偏好的分配的不同部分出价时，他们建立了直接竞标者互补性。然而，如果通过连续性限制拒绝了分配，则称为间接互补性。因此，在VCG分配阶段，可以预期非核心结果，以及所有伴随的异常现象。然后，我们研究了一个显著的近期频谱拍卖，即FCC的广播激励拍卖，并首次记录了现场的零收入结果。在207个至少有三个竞标者的分配阶段拍卖中，17.9%相对于出价产生了非核心结果，其中3个产生了零收入。在重新调整竞标者价值后，我们发现大多数分配阶段拍卖都有可利用的竞标者互补性，并且绝大多数竞标者互补性——无论是潜在的还是已实现的——都是间接的。

records.title_en: Information design with endogenous state verification
records.title_cn: 具有内生状态验证的信息设计
records.abstract_en: We study a persuasion problem in which the receiver has the ability to probabilistically verify the state at a cost. The sender wants to convince the receiver to accept a project, but the receiver is only willing to accept the project when its quality is above a threshold. The optimal disclosure policy strikes a balance between influencing the receiver’s decisions to accept and to verify the quality. It is deterministic and involves at most three messages, each consisting of an acceptance recommendation and a verification recommendation. Under the optimal disclosure policy, the acceptance recommendation exhibits a cutoff structure, while the verification recommendation exhibits a negative assortative structure. Specifically, the optimal disclosure policy recommends acceptance when the quality exceeds a certain threshold. When the quality falls below this threshold, rejection without verification is recommended. For qualities above the threshold, verification is not recommended if the quality lies within the middle range of the interval. Using the characterization of the optimal disclosure policy, we conduct comparative statics and show that verification is recommended when the probability of successful verification is moderate.
records.abstract_cn: 我们研究了一个说服问题，其中接收者能够以一定成本对状态进行概率性验证。发送者希望说服接收者接受一个项目，但接收者仅在项目质量高于某一阈值时才愿意接受该项目。最优披露策略在影响接收者接受决策与验证质量决策之间取得平衡。该策略是确定性的，最多包含三条信息，每条信息包括一个接受建议和一个验证建议。在最优披露策略下，接受建议呈现截断结构，而验证建议呈现负配对结构。具体而言，当质量超过某一阈值时，最优披露策略建议接受；当质量低于该阈值时，建议拒绝且不进行验证。对于高于阈值的质量，如果质量位于区间的中间范围内，则不建议进行验证。利用最优披露策略的特征，我们进行了比较静态分析，结果表明当成功验证的概率处于中等水平时，建议进行验证。

records.title_en: Credit, money and (pseudo-)anonymity
records.title_cn: 信用、货币与（伪）匿名性
records.abstract_en: We study pseudonymity—an information regime where agents’ histories are perfectly observable, but linked only to pseudonyms rather than to true identities. A key feature is that agents may open and use multiple pseudonyms simultaneously. In a tractable environment with limited commitment, we characterize the set of stationary credit equilibria under pseudonymity, showing that it forms a strict non-empty subset of equilibria attainable under a no anonymity regime, where histories are publicly linked to true identities. Moreover, money is always essential under pseudonymity, yet cannot co-exist with credit. Finally, imposing optimal fees on pseudonym creation generally raises welfare, whereas making pseudonyms tradable never does.
records.abstract_cn: 我们研究伪匿名性——一种信息制度，其中代理人的历史记录是完全可观察的，但仅与伪名相关联，而非真实身份。一个关键特征是代理人可以同时开设并使用多个伪名。在一个具有有限承诺能力的可处理环境中，我们刻画了伪匿名性下的平稳信用均衡集合，表明该集合是无匿名制度下可达均衡的一个严格非空子集，在无匿名制度中，历史记录公开关联真实身份。此外，货币在伪匿名性下始终是必需的，但不能与信用共存。最后，对伪名创建施加最优费用通常会提高福利，而使伪名可交易则从未提高福利。

records.title_en: Learning through imitation: An experiment
records.title_cn: 通过模仿学习：一项实验
records.abstract_en: We compare how well agents aggregate information in two repeated social learning environments. In the first setting agents have access to a public data set. In the second they have access to the same data, and also to the past actions of others. Despite the fact that actions contain no additional payoff-relevant information, and despite potential herd behavior, free riding and information overload issues, observing and imitating the actions of others leads agents to take the optimal action more often in the second setting. We also investigate the effect of group size, as well as a setting in which agents observe private data and others’ actions.
records.abstract_cn: 我们比较了代理人在二重复社会学习环境中聚合信息的效果。在第一环境中，代理人可以访问一个公共数据集。在第二环境中，他们不仅可以访问相同的数据，还可以观察他人的过去行为。尽管这些行为不包含额外的与收益相关的信息，且存在潜在的羊群效应、搭便车和信息过载问题，观察并模仿他人的行为仍使代理人在第二环境中更频繁地采取最优行动。我们还研究了群体规模的影响，以及代理人观察私人数据和他人行为的情形。

records.title_en: The Hard Problem and the Tyranny of the Losers
records.title_cn: 难题与输家暴政
records.abstract_en: A Hard Problem is a collective choice problem in which the only feasible alternatives to the status quo consist of a welfare gain to some people (the Winners) and a welfare loss to others (the Losers). These problems are typical in a number of settings, such as climate action, anti-trust regulation, and tax design. We study how to make collective choices when faced with Hard Problems. We find that a relatively weak fairness requirement, which we call Expansion Solidarity, necessarily leads to a dictatorship of the Losers, no matter how small their number. Even one single Loser must be given the power to veto any departure from the status quo, regardless of the number of Winners, how large the gains, how small the loss, or how extreme the welfare inequalities.
records.abstract_cn: 难题是一种集体选择问题，其中对现状的唯一可行替代方案是部分人（赢家）福利增加而其他人（输家）福利减少。这类问题在多个情境中典型存在，如气候行动、反垄断监管和税收设计。我们研究在面临难题时如何做出集体选择。我们发现，一种相对较弱的公平性要求，即我们称之为扩展团结，必然导致输家的独裁，无论其人数多么少。即使只有单个输家，也必须赋予其否决任何偏离现状的权力，无论赢家人数多少、收益多大、损失多小或福利不平等多么极端。

records.title_en: The hold-up problem with flexible unobservable investments
records.title_cn: 具有灵活不可观测投资的挟持问题
records.abstract_en: The paper studies the canonical hold-up problem with one-sided investment by the buyer and full bargaining power by the seller. The buyer can covertly choose any distribution of valuations at a cost and privately observes her valuation. I show that, unlike in the well-understood case with linear costs, if investment costs are strictly convex, the buyer’s equilibrium utility is strictly positive and total welfare is strictly higher than when valuations are public information, thus alleviating the severity of the hold-up problem. In fact, when costs are mean-based or display decreasing risk, the equilibrium outcome might be efficient.
records.abstract_cn: 本文研究了买方具有一单边投资且卖方拥有完全议价权的典型挟持问题。买方可以秘密选择任意估值分布，需支付成本，并私下观察其估值。我证明，与线性成本的已知情况不同，如果投资成本是严格凸的，买方的均衡效用严格为正，总福利严格高于估值为公开信息时的情况，从而缓解了挟持问题的严重性。事实上，当成本基于均值或表现出风险递减时，均衡结果可能是有效的。

records.title_en: Covert learning and disclosure
records.title_cn: 隐秘学习与信息披露
records.abstract_en: I study a model of information acquisition and transmission in which the sender’s ability to misreport her findings is limited. The sender learns covertly, so a key observation is that in equilibrium she must be deterred from undetectably worsening the meaningof the messages she sends. This force substantially disciplines equilibrium beliefs and behavior: the receiver is maximally skeptical of what the sender claims and learns all discovered information. I exploit these equilibrium properties to characterize the sense in which the sender benefits from her claims being more verifiable, showing that this is akin to increasing her commitment power. Finally, I identify sender- and receiver-optimal falsification environments.
records.abstract_cn: 我研究了一个信息获取与传递的模型，其中发送者误报其发现的能力受到限制。发送者以隐秘方式学习，因此一个关键观察是，在均衡中必须阻止发送者无检测地恶化其所发送信息的含义。这一机制显著约束了均衡信念和行为：接收者对发送者的主张持最大程度的怀疑态度，并且学习所有被发现的信息。我利用这些均衡性质来刻画发送者从其主张更具可验证性中获益的意义，表明这类似于增强其承诺能力。最后，我识别了发送者和接收者最优的伪造环境。

records.title_en: Reference-dependent choice bracketing
records.title_cn: 参照依赖的选择分组
records.abstract_en: I derive a model of choice bracketing from two behavioral axioms in an expected utility framework. The first behavioral axiom establishes a link between narrow bracketing and correlation neglect. The second behavioral axiom identifies the reference point as the connector between broad and narrow preferences. The narrow bracketer is characterized by an inability to process changes from the reference point in different dimensions simultaneously. As a result, her tradeoffs between dimensions are distorted. She evaluates dimensions in isolation, implying a disregard for how they affect one another. When evaluating a dimension, she remains anchored to the reference point in the respective other dimension. This implies that she mistakenly perceives preference interactions in relation to the reference point. I present applications to portfolio choice, consumption bundle choice, and an exchange economy.
records.abstract_cn: 我在期望效用框架下，从二行为公理推导出选择分组模型。第一行为公理建立了狭义分组与相关性忽视之间的联系。第二行为公理将参照点确定为广义偏好与狭义偏好之间的连接点。狭义分组者的特征是无法同时处理来自参照点在不同维度上的变化。因此，她在维度之间的权衡被扭曲。她孤立地评估各维度，意味着忽视了它们如何相互影响一。在评估某一维度时，她仍锚定于相应其他维度的参照点。这意味着她错误地将偏好交互视为与参照点相关。我展示了该模型在投资组合选择、消费组合选择及交换经济中的应用。

records.title_en: Expectation and confusion: Evidence and theory
records.title_cn: 预期与混淆：证据与理论
records.abstract_en: In this paper, we characterize a forecasting model where forecasters cannot perfectly distinguish between the two persistent components (trends and cycles) in a dynamic setting. In this model, forecasters jointly update their beliefs about the two components: noisy information about one component is used to update beliefs about the other component. We present diagnostic empirical facts on forecasting behaviors and show that these facts are consistent with our model’s predictions while contradicting those of existing models in the expectation formation literature. To validate our model, we exploit the Federal Reserve’s 2012 adoption of explicit inflation targeting as a policy shock. Structural estimation reveals that this policy change altered the underlying data-generation process, and the corresponding changes in forecasting behavior indeed align with our model’s predictions. Finally, we revisit the standard Forecast Error-Forecast Revision regression approach in this literature. We examine its robustness within our enriched framework and reveal that trend-cycle confusion can interact with behavioral bias and generate horizon-dependent overreaction patterns documented in empirical studies.
records.abstract_cn: 本文刻画了一个预测模型，其中预测者在动态环境中无法完全区分两个持久性成分（趋势和周期）。在这个模型中，预测者共同更新他们对这两个成分的信念：关于一个成分的噪声信息被用来更新对另一个成分的信念。我们提出了关于预测行为的诊断性实证事实，并表明这些事实与我们模型的预测一致，而与预期形成文献中现有模型的预测相矛盾。为了验证我们的模型，我们利用美联储2012年采用明确的通胀目标作为政策冲击。结构估计显示，这一政策变化改变了潜在的数据生成过程，而相应的预测行为变化确实与我们模型的预测一致。最后，我们重新审视了这一文献中的标准预测误差-预测修正回归方法。我们在我们的扩展框架内检验了它的稳健性，并揭示了趋势-周期混淆可以与行为偏差相互作用，并产生实证研究中记录的与预测期限相关的过度反应模式。

records.title_en: Which experiments test a model?
records.title_cn: 哪些实验检验一个模型？
records.abstract_en: Given a model of preferences, what choice data or experiment is sufficient to definitively test whether a subject is consistent with the model or to classify them into some “type” within the model? We characterize all experiments that test or classify a given model using a novel graph-theoretic construction: the labeled permutohedron. We show how these results can be used to identify the smallest experiments that achieve a particular goal.
records.abstract_cn: 给定一个偏好模型，哪些选择数据或实验足以明确检验一个主体是否与该模型一致，或将其归类为模型中的某种“类型”？我们利用一种新颖的图论构造——带标签的置换多面体，刻画了所有能够检验或分类给定模型的实验。我们展示了如何利用这些结果识别实现特定目标的最小实验。

records.title_en: Shining Light on a Statistical Dark Age: Postal Activity in Antebellum America
records.title_cn: 照亮统计黑暗时代：战前美国的邮政活动
records.abstract_en: American economic historians generally believe that U.S. modern economic growth began before 1840, was broadly based, and the acceleration was gradual. These claims are treated as conjectures rather than solid conclusions because the census did not publish good economic data before 1840. But the earlier period was not a “statistical dark age,” as sometimes asserted. After 1817, systematic statistics on postal activity were available at the local level at high frequencies. These data shed light on the timing and sources of the onset of modern economic growth, the patterns of regional development, and the spread of a culture of communication.
records.abstract_cn: 美国经济历史学家普遍认为，美国现代经济增长始于1840之前，基础广泛，且加速过程是渐进的。这些观点被视为推测而非确凿结论，因为人口普查在1840之前未公布良好的经济数据。但早期时期并非如有时所言的“统计黑暗时代”。在1817之后，地方层面上高频率的系统性邮政活动统计数据得以获得。这些数据揭示了现代经济增长起始的时间和来源、区域发展模式以及通信文化的传播。

records.title_en: Gender and Racial Differences in Migration Behavior: Evidence from the Farm Exodus within and out of the U.S. South, 1900–1940
records.title_cn: 迁移行为中的性别与种族差异：基于美国南部农场迁出现象的证据，1900-1940
records.abstract_en: Using linked Census Tree records and archival sources, I explore the roles of race and gender in migrant selection and sorting during the exodus of single young women and men from U.S. Southern farms from 1900–1940. Female migration rates, influenced by changes in farm men’s marriageability, rose during the farm crisis of 1920–1940 and exceeded men’s by 1940. On- and off-farm discrimination by race and gender drove differences in migrant characteristics: out-of-South Black female migrants, but not within-South, were positively selected on education and family resources, while White women were positively selected across both destinations.
records.abstract_cn: 利用关联的人口普查树记录和档案资料，我探讨了种族和性别在美国南部农场单身年轻男女迁移选择与排序中的作用，时间范围为1900-1940。女性迁移率受农场男性婚配能力变化的影响，在1920-1940的农场危机期间上升，并于1940超过男性。种族和性别在农场内外的歧视导致迁移者特征的差异：南部以外的黑人女性迁移者在教育和家庭资源方面呈现正向选择，但南部内部则不然，而白人女性在两个目的地均表现出正向选择。

records.title_en: Exposure to World War II and Its Labor Market Consequences over the Life Cycle
records.title_cn: 二战暴露及其对生命周期劳动市场的影响
records.abstract_en: With 70 million dead, World War II remains the most devastating conflict in history. Among the survivors, millions were displaced, returned maimed from the battlefield, or endured years of captivity. We examine the effects of such war exposures on labor market careers, showing that they often become apparent only at certain life stages. While war injuries reduced employment in old age, former prisoners of war prolonged their time in the workforce before retiring. Many displaced workers, especially women, never returned to employment. These responses align with standard life-cycle theory and thus likely hold relevance for other conflicts.
records.abstract_cn: 随着70 百万的逝世，二战仍是历史上最具破坏性的冲突。在幸存者中，数百万人被迫流离失所，战场上负伤归来，或经历多年囚禁。我们考察了这种战争暴露对劳动市场职业生涯的影响，显示其效应常常仅在特定生命阶段显现。战争伤害减少了老年时期的就业，而前战俘则延长了退休前的劳动时间。许多流离失所的工人，尤其是女性，未能重返就业。这些反应符合标准生命周期理论，因此可能对其他冲突同样适用。

records.title_en: Strikes and Machines: Investments in the Norwegian Inter-War-Period
records.title_cn: 罢工与机器：挪威战间期的投资行为
records.abstract_en: To what extent do strike threats prompt firms to adopt capital-intensive methods to deter strikes or labor-intensive strategies to maintain flexibility during work stoppages? We introduce a theoretical model that demonstrates how threats of industrial action influence capital investments through relative factor prices and the power dynamics between workers and employers. Using newly digitized data from 3,141 industrial conflicts and collective agreements in Norway during the interwar period, our findings indicate that strikes generally drive firms toward less capital-intensive technologies. This trend is particularly pronounced in conflicts resolved at the branch or national level, where strike threats may appear more exogenous to firms.
records.abstract_cn: 罢工威胁在多大程度上促使企业采用资本密集型方法以威慑罢工，或采用劳动密集型策略以在停工期间保持灵活性？我们引入一个理论模型，展示了工业行动威胁如何通过相对要素价格以及工人与雇主之间的权力动态影响资本投资。利用挪威战间期3,141工业冲突和集体协议的新数字化数据，我们的研究结果表明，罢工通常促使企业倾向于采用较少资本密集的技术。这一趋势在分行业或国家层面解决的冲突中尤为显著，在这些情况下，罢工威胁对企业而言可能显得更为外生。

records.title_en: Winners and Losers from the Protestant Reformation: An Analysis of the Network of European Universities
records.title_cn: 新教改革的赢家与输家：欧洲大学网络分析
records.abstract_en: Using a new database of European academics, we build a network of universities that is based on professors’ mobility. We describe how the network was altered following the Protestant Reformation. We focus on fragmentation and on universities’ centrality. Dyadic regressions confirm that geography and vernacular languages were important for mobility, but did not substitute for religion. We compare simulated networks with and without religious identity. Most universities lose centrality in the simulated religious network compared to the non-religious one. As publications per university are correlated with centrality, the loss of connectedness of many universities after the Reformation contributed to their scientific decline.
records.abstract_cn: 利用一份新的欧洲学者数据库，我们构建了一个基于教授流动性的大学网络。我们描述了新教改革后该网络的变化，重点关注网络的分裂和大学的中心性。双边回归分析确认地理位置和本地语言对流动性具有重要影响，但不能替代宗教因素。我们比较了有无宗教身份的模拟网络。与非宗教的一网络相比，大多数大学在宗教模拟网络中的中心性下降。由于每所大学的出版物数量与中心性相关，新教改革后许多大学连接性的丧失促成了其科学地位的衰落。

records.title_en: Crises and Educational Attainment
records.title_cn: 危机与教育成就
records.abstract_en: Between 1910 and 1940, U.S. high school graduation rates rose five-fold, driving twentieth-century economic growth. I explore how the Great Depression’s surge in youth unemployment influenced this trend, emphasizing gender and socioeconomic disparities. Using linked census data and newly digitized city-level unemployment rates, I find that youth unemployment significantly increased high school and post-secondary completion among higher-income boys, while effects on girls and lower-income youths were negligible. These results underscore the role of household resources in leveraging educational opportunities, as financial constraints limited disadvantaged groups from benefiting from reduced opportunity costs.
records.abstract_cn: 在1910至1940期间，美国高中毕业率上升了五倍，推动了二十世纪的经济增长。我探讨了大萧条期间青年失业率激增如何影响这一趋势，重点关注性别和社会经济差异。利用链接的人口普查数据和新数字化的城市级失业率，我发现青年失业显著提高了高收入男孩的高中及高等教育完成率，而对女孩和低收入青年的影响则微乎其微。这些结果强调了家庭资源在利用教育机会中的作用，因为财务限制使弱势群体难以从机会成本降低中受益。

records.title_en: Eligibility to the Central Bank in Times of Crises: Evidence from France, 1863–1890
records.title_cn: 危机时期中央银行的合格资产范围：来自法国的证据，1863-1890
records.abstract_en: We provide empirical evidence that central banks can mitigate economic crises more efficiently when they extend eligibility for their discount facility to any safe asset or solvent agent. Nineteenth-century France serves as a case study to circumvent endogeneity. Following 1863, an agricultural pandemic increased defaults outside agriculture. We exploit specificities of the discount window to create exogenous variation in central bank access. Regressions show that while the demand shock brought about by the pandemic led to an increase in defaults outside agriculture by 20 percent, this effect was significantly reduced whenever a branch office of the central bank was present.
records.abstract_cn: 我们提供实证证据表明，当中央银行将其贴现便利的合格资产范围扩大至任何安全资产或偿付能力良好的主体时，能够更有效地缓解经济危机。十九世纪的法国作为案例研究，以规避内生性问题。根据1863，一场农业疫情导致农业以外领域的违约增加。我们利用贴现窗口的特殊性创造中央银行准入的外生变异。回归结果显示，尽管疫情引发的需求冲击使农业以外领域的违约增加了20%，但只要中央银行设有分支机构，这一影响就显著减弱。

records.journal_name: Journal of Environmental Economics and Management
records.title_en: Water stress and industrial firm productivity
records.title_cn: 水资源压力和工业企业生产力
records.abstract_en: We estimate the causal effect of water stress on firm-level productivity in China. In contrast with most extant studies that have employed precipitation to proxy water availability, we use local water runoff, which we argue is a more appropriate measure of water available for industrial firms. By matching a panel for over half a million formal industrial firms with a novel, county-level, dataset on water runoff, we find that shocks to local water runoff exert asymmetric effects on firm productivity. A negative runoff shock reduces firm productivity by 1.93 – 5.40 per cent, depending on its magnitude, whereas the corresponding positive shock has a small and not statistically significant effect. Water runoff consistently outperforms other proxies of water availability across different horserace specifications. The main channels through which negative runoff shocks affect firms operate through reduced water inputs, disruptions to power generation, and tighter cash flows. Our study sheds new light on how climate change can impede economic development.
