records.abstract_cn: 本文研究了模糊性对指数保险下技术采纳的影响。作者在加纳可可农户中进行了一项人为场景实验。实验对象有选择投资一揽子含指数保险的化肥的选项。收益既取决于受试者的投资选择，也取决于随机天气实现。研究的关键在于是否知道恶劣天气的确切概率。该概率在实验处理组中具有模糊性，且模糊程度在不同处理组中存在差异。在模糊性较小或较大的处理组中，化肥投资受到显著的负面影响。研究还发现，模糊性较大的影响更为显著，暗示农户相对更有经验的技术在指数保险方案下更可能被采纳。作者提供了新的证据表明，模糊性可能是限制指数保险在促进农业创新方面有效性的重要因素。总体发现与相关的近期随机对照试验互为补充，因为后者在精确校准和变化模糊水平方面实际上几乎不可能实现。

records.title_en: Cost and affordability of recommended diets in Rwanda using [near] real-time market data
records.title_cn: 卢旺达基于[近]实时市场数据的推荐膳食成本与可负担性
records.abstract_en: Countries are increasingly benchmarking food assistance and labour laws on the cost of nationally recommended diets. Benchmarking is made against national annual estimates, which fail to account for sub-national and intra-annual variation in cost, blunting the impact of policies. Using monthly market price data collected by the Government of Rwanda (April 2019-March 2024), we estimate the cost of the country’s proposed food-based dietary guidelines, using a standardised diet costing methodology. We found rural areas experienced greater inflation in diet cost over the study period than urban areas (41% vs 28%), yet the recommended diet was 12.7% higher in urban locations. Diet costs were approximately 6% lower in districts with international border crossings to Tanzania, but 7% more in those with borders with the Democratic Republic of Congo. Fruits and vegetables (110% and 71%) and starchy staples (86% and 83%) contributed most to cost increases in rural and urban locations respectively. Seasonal diet cost fluctuations were also evident with a seasonal amplitude of 5.6% and 6.9% in rural and urban locations, synchronised to Rwanda’s agricultural calendar. 70% of employed Rwandans would find the recommended diet unaffordable, if spending 52% of wages on food. Diet costs varied 4.2-fold across all districts throughout the study period, meaning that uniform national policies to address costs and affordability would be systematically inadequate in high-cost settings and wasteful in low-cost ones. That such spatial–temporal variation exists in a small, relatively market integrated country like Rwanda suggests variation would be at least equally consequential in other low and lower-middle-income countries. High-frequency and sub-national monitoring of prices, diet costs, and affordability provides essential intelligence for policymakers to enable spatially and seasonally targeted interventions, improving both the adequacy and efficiency of food policy.
records.abstract_cn: 各国日益将国家推荐膳食的成本作为食品援助和劳动法律的基准。基准通常以国家年度估算为依据，未能考虑子国家和年度内的成本变异，削弱了政策的影响。利用卢旺达政府收集的每月市场价格数据（四月 2019-三月 2024），我们采用标准化的膳食成本核算方法，估算了该国拟议的以食物为基础的膳食指南的成本。研究发现，农村地区在研究期间的膳食成本通胀高于城市地区（41% 对比 28%），但在城市地区推荐膳食的成本更高（12.7%）。在与坦桑尼亚有国际边境的地区，膳食成本大约比其他地区低（6%），而与刚果民主共和国接壤的地区则更高（7%）。水果和蔬菜（110% 和 71%）以及淀粉类主食（86% 和 83%）对农村和城市地区成本的增加贡献最大。季节性膳食成本波动也很明显，农村和城市地区的季节性振幅分别为 5.6% 和 6.9%，与卢旺达的农业季节同步。若卢旺达的在职人员将其工资的 70% 用于食品，则 52% 的人将发现推荐膳食难以负担。研究期间，膳食成本在所有地区的变动范围达 4.2 倍，表明统一的国家政策在高成本地区可能系统性不足，而在低成本地区则可能造成资源浪费。如此空间-时间变异在像卢旺达这样的小型、市场相对一体化的国家中存在，意味着在其他低收入和中低收入国家中，这种变异至少同样具有重要意义。高频率和子国家层面的价格、膳食成本及可负担性监测，为政策制定者提供了关键情报，以实现空间和季节性针对性干预，从而改善食品政策的充足性和效率。

records.title_en: Seasonality of employment and food security in rural sub-Saharan Africa
records.title_cn: 撒哈拉以南非洲农村地区就业季节性与粮食安全
records.abstract_en: Many rural households in sub-Saharan Africa rely on rainfed agriculture, meaning that harvests and incomes from farming are highly seasonal. This leads to recurring periods of food insecurity, commonly referred to as lean seasons. Off-farm employment may help mitigate seasonal food insecurity, but evidence on whether it actually does remains scarce. Using panel data from high-frequency phone surveys in Burkina Faso, Malawi, and Uganda, covering the period from 2020–2024, we examine seasonal labor reallocation and implications for food security throughout the year. We find that seasonal labor shifts from farming to off-farm sectors are associated with reduced seasonal food insecurity in most contexts, especially for off-farm wage employment. We also find that in regions where multiple cropping seasons are possible, work in farming is more strongly associated with food security than off-farm wage or self-employment. However, seasonal shifts from farming to other income-generating activities are not very large at the aggregate level, possibly due to lack of rural labor opportunities. These findings highlight that — depending on the context — improvements of opportunities for farming and off-farm employment are important to ensure year-round food security in rural sub-Saharan Africa.
records.abstract_cn: 撒哈拉以南非洲的许多农村家庭依赖雨养农业，这意味着农作物收获和农业收入具有高度的季节性。这导致粮食安全问题周期性出现，通常被称为粮食短缺季节。非农就业可能有助于缓解季节性粮食不安全问题，但关于其是否确实有效的证据仍然不足。利用布基纳法索、马拉维和乌干达2020-2024年期间的高频电话调查面板数据，我们研究了全年劳动力季节性再分配及其对粮食安全的影响。我们发现，从农业向非农部门的季节性劳动力转移在大多数情况下与季节性粮食不安全的减少相关，尤其是非农工资就业。我们还发现，在可能实现多季种植的地区，农业工作与粮食安全的关联性比非农工资或自雇就业更强。然而，从农业向其他收入生成活动的季节性转移在总体上并不显著，可能是由于农村劳动力机会的缺乏。这些发现表明，根据具体情况，改善农业和非农就业机会对于确保撒哈拉以南非洲农村地区全年的粮食安全至关重要。

records.title_en: A critical review of EU agri-food policy impacts
records.title_cn: 对欧盟农业食品政策影响的批判性回顾
records.abstract_en: The European Union’s agri-food policies aim to balance productivity with environmental, social, and economic sustainability. However, their overall effectiveness remains debated due to fragmented evidence and inconsistent implementation. This study critically reviews the literature on the cumulative impacts of EU policies governing primary agricultural production, focusing on six sectors: the Common Agricultural Policy, genetically modified organisms, pesticide, fertilizers, fisheries, and animal health and welfare.
records.abstract_cn: 欧洲联盟的农业食品政策旨在平衡生产力与环境、社会和经济的可持续性。然而，由于证据碎片化和执行不一致，其整体有效性仍存在争议。本研究对关于欧盟管理初级农业生产的政策累积影响的文献进行了批判性回顾，重点关注农业、转基因生物、农药、化肥、渔业以及动物健康与福利等六个领域。

records.title_en: Agenda-setting in local food environment policy: A comparative Multiple Streams Analysis of the City Deal network in the Netherlands
records.title_cn: 地方食品环境政策中的议程设置：荷兰城市合作网络的多重流分析比较
records.abstract_en: Little is known about the processes through which local food environment policies gain a place on municipal policy agendas. This study examines why some municipalities within the Dutch City Deal: Healthy and Sustainable Food Environment succeed in placing food strategies and food environmental zoning policies on the agenda.
records.abstract_cn: 关于地方食品环境政策如何进入市政政策议程的过程知之甚少。本研究探讨为何荷兰城市合作：健康与可持续食品环境中的某些市政当局能够成功将食品策略和食品环境分区政策列入议程。

records.title_en: Extreme heat and markets: Theoretical and empirical evidence from Nigeria
records.title_cn: 极端高温与市场：尼日利亚的理论与实证证据
records.abstract_en: We investigate how exposure to extreme temperature affects smallholder commercialization. We examine a range of outcomes that indicate the degree of commercialization, including market participation, sales quantity, commercialization index, and sales revenue, which serves as an indicator of monetary benefit. Recognizing the non-separability between production and commercialization, we also examine how extreme temperature directly affects agricultural production. To address these questions, we develop a simple and straightforward theoretical framework that links temperature events to production and market dynamics. From this framework, we derive a set of hypotheses which we proceed to test empirically. Our empirical strategy leverages a comprehensive three-wave panel dataset, which we integrate with earth observation data on temperature extremes. We find that extreme temperatures lead to production losses. We also observe significant declines in market participation among smallholder farmers which could be explained by production shortfalls. This reduction is evident at both the extensive margin (likelihood of participating in markets) and the intensive margin (sales quantity). Furthermore, we observe that when farmers face extreme temperatures, the proportion of harvested crops they sell and the resulting revenue from these also decrease. Causal mediation analysis further confirms that production losses due to extreme temperatures explains the reduction in market outcomes. Overall, these findings highlight the broader economic burden that extreme weather events continue to impose on smallholder households.
records.abstract_cn: 我们研究极端温度暴露如何影响小农户的商品化程度。我们考察一系列反映商品化程度的结果指标，包括市场参与、销售数量、商品化指数和销售收入，后者作为货币收益的指标。鉴于生产与商品化之间的非可分离性，我们还分析极端温度如何直接影响农业生产。为此，我们建立了一个简洁直观的理论框架，将温度事件与生产和市场动态联系起来。基于此框架，我们提出一系列假设，并进行实证检验。我们的实证策略利用一份全面的三-波段面板数据集，并结合关于温度极端事件的遥感数据。研究发现，极端温度导致生产损失。我们还观察到小农户的市场参与显著下降，这可能由生产短缺引起。这一减少在市场参与的广度（参与市场的可能性）和深度（销售数量）两个方面均有体现。此外，当农户面临极端温度时，他们出售的收获作物比例及由此产生的收入也会减少。因果中介分析进一步确认，极端温度引起的生产损失解释了市场结果的下降。总体而言，这些发现凸显了极端天气事件对小农户家庭持续带来的更广泛的经济负担。

records.title_en: Consumer preferences for sustainability labels: A comparative analysis of the green-score and other established labels
records.title_cn: 消费者对可持续性标签的偏好：绿色评分与其他既有标签的比较分析
records.abstract_en: The Green-Score label aims to complement established certifications by providing a standardized and easily interpretable assessment of products’ environmental performance. This study examines (i) the relative influence of Green-Score, organic, and Protected Designation of Origin (PDO) certifications on consumers’ willingness to pay (WTP); (ii) how label effectiveness varies across food categories; and (iii) the impact of a salience nudge on consumer choices. A Discrete Choice Experiment was conducted with a nationally representative sample of 1,102 Italian consumers, using a between-subjects design to evaluate the nudge. Results show that PDO labels, leveraging strong institutional credibility and symbolic value, consistently generate the highest marginal WTP (€7.61), especially for culturally and traditionally significant products. Green-Score A+ labels, valued for their diagnosticity and cross-product comparability, achieve an average marginal WTP of €6.25, slightly above organic certification (€4.59), with variation across product categories and treatment conditions. The salience nudge enhances the perceived value of Green-Score, particularly in contexts where environmental performance is salient, and can reduce the marginal contribution of overlapping labels such as organic certification. These findings demonstrate that the effectiveness of sustainability labels depends on both the balance between credibility and diagnosticity and the product-specific context, offering actionable insights for policymakers and stakeholders seeking to design targeted and effective environmental labelling strategies in food markets.
records.abstract_cn: 绿色评分标签旨在通过提供产品环境绩效的标准化和易于理解的评估来补充既有认证。本研究考察了（i）绿色评分、有机和原产地保护（PDO）认证对消费者支付意愿（WTP）的相对影响；（ii）标签效果如何因食品类别而异；（iii）显著性提示对消费者选择的影响。研究采用离散选择实验，以1,102名具有全国代表性的意大利消费者为样本，使用被试间设计评估提示效果。结果表明，PDO标签凭借其强大的机构信誉和象征价值，始终产生最高的边际支付意愿（7.61欧元），尤其是对文化和传统意义重大的产品。绿色评分A+标签因其诊断性和跨产品可比性，实现了6.25欧元的平均边际支付意愿，略高于有机认证（4.59欧元），且因产品类别和处理条件而异。显著性提示增强了绿色评分的感知价值，特别是在环境绩效显著的情境中，并可降低有机认证等重叠标签的边际贡献。这些发现表明，可持续性标签的有效性取决于信誉与诊断性之间的平衡以及产品特定情境，为政策制定者和利益相关者提供了可操作的洞察，以设计针对性和有效的食品市场环境标签策略。

records.title_en: UK Food standards agency proposals for re-structuring how it regulates food-borne risks: an analysis and critique
records.title_cn: 英国食品标准局关于重组其食品安全风险监管方式的提案：分析与批评
records.abstract_en: Official food policy-makers are expected both to ensure that they have a well-functioning system of food supply, processing, distribution and consumption while also ensuring that their citizens are protected from unsafe and unhealthy foods. It is evident that the implications of those two responsibilities can and sometimes do conflict; which historically has prompted the question: should those two policy responsibilities be institutionally co-located, or institutionally separated? The UK’s Food Standards Agency (FSA) was created in response to the policy failures revealed by the Mad Cow Disease saga. Previously one UK ministry had been responsible for both agendas, but the tension between them had been so severe that they contributed to turning the saga into a deep crisis. Responsibility for ensuring UK food safety was subsequently separated from the food industries’ sponsoring ministry, and transferred to the FSA. A recent set of proposals from the FSA recommends that the agency should expand its responsibilities by also endeavouring to promote the commercial interests of the food industries. Implementing the proposals risks undermining public confidence in the FSA and the safety of the UK’s food supply. The significance of the proposals goes beyond the UK as it illustrates a pivotal and ubiquitous axis of contestation in food policy-making, it illustrates ways in which food policy governance can be malleable rather than rigid, and explains how a combination of forgetfulness and economic re-prioritisation risks undermining food safety and public trust in policy-making.
records.abstract_cn: 官方食品政策制定者既要确保食品供应、加工、分销和消费体系的正常运作，又要保障公民免受不安全和不健康食品的危害。显而易见，这些责任的影响可能会发生冲突；这在历史上引发了一个问题：这些政策责任应当在制度上合并还是分离？英国食品标准局（FSA）成立的背景是应对疯牛病事件暴露的政策失误。此前，英国的相关部门同时负责这两个方面，但二者之间的紧张关系极为严重，导致事件演变成一场深刻的危机。确保英国食品安全的责任随后从食品行业的主管部门中剥离出来，转交给FSA。FSA近期提出的一系列建议建议该机构应扩大职责，兼顾促进食品行业的商业利益。实施这些建议可能会削弱公众对FSA及英国食品安全的信心。这些提案的意义超越英国，展示了食品政策制定中的一个关键且普遍存在的争论轴心，揭示了食品政策治理可以具有弹性而非刚性，以及说明了遗忘与经济再优先排序的结合如何可能削弱食品安全和公众对政策的信任。

records.title_en: The impact of post-harvest training interventions on adoption and production behavior: evidence from black pepper farmers in Sri Lanka
records.title_cn: 收获后培训干预对采纳和生产行为的影响：来自斯里兰卡黑胡椒农户的证据
records.abstract_en: As agricultural development increasingly targets high-value crops and markets, food quality and safety have become critical. However, smallholder farmers often face barriers to adopting quality-enhancing practices in the post-production stage because of their limited access to reliable information. Most research on information provision emphasises the need to reduce quantity losses in staple crops, leaving a research gap with respect to quality improvements in high-value crops such as black pepper. This study addresses this gap by evaluating the impact of government training and farmer-to-farmer experience sharing on the adoption of post-harvest quality improvement practices and production behaviour. We conducted a randomized controlled trial with 660 black pepper farmers in the Matale District of Sri Lanka. We found that government training significantly improves the adoption of key post-harvest practices such as threshing, fresh berry grading, dry berry grading, and blanching and leads to a shift in production from low quality to high quality. Our findings highlight the importance of structured expertise-led training to improve the quality of high-value crops.
records.abstract_cn: 随着农业发展日益聚焦于高价值作物和市场，食品质量与安全变得至关重要。然而，小农户在采后阶段采用提升质量的实践中常面临信息获取有限的障碍。大部分关于信息提供的研究强调减少主粮作物的产量损失，忽视了高价值作物如黑胡椒的质量改善研究空白。本研究通过评估政府培训和农户间经验分享对采后质量改善实践采纳和生产行为的影响，填补了这一空白。我们在斯里兰卡马塔勒区对660黑胡椒农户进行了随机对照试验。研究发现，政府培训显著促进了打谷、鲜果等级划分、干果等级划分以及漂白等关键采后实践的采纳，并促使生产从低质量向高质量转变。我们的研究结果强调了结构化、由专业人员主导的培训在提升高价值作物质量方面的重要作用。

records.title_en: Regulatory heterogeneity, trade mediation and nutrient intake: The case of Trans fat
records.title_cn: 监管异质性、贸易中介作用与营养摄入：反式脂肪的案例
records.abstract_en: National nutrition regulations can shape diets in two distinct ways: directly, through domestic policy mechanisms, and indirectly, by mediating trade flows. This study assesses how trans fat (TF) intake is affected by both pathways. When countries act alone – by banning or limiting TF – their rules often differ in timing, stringency, and enforcement. The resulting regulatory heterogeneity can create loopholes that allow unhealthy products to move across borders. This study estimates the causal effects of TF regulations on its intake nationally by constructing a food-item-level panel dataset for 161 countries (2010–2022, validated with established benchmarks), and applying a staggered difference-in-differences approach combined with mediation analysis. The findings show that strict, enforceable regulations, such as those in the United States and European Union, significantly reduce TF intake and imports, acting as effective filters against TF-rich foods. In contrast, countries with weaker regulations experience rising TF imports and, eventually, increased intake, effectively placing them at risk of becoming “dietary risk havens.” Even modest rules work better when backed by strong monitoring. These results are robust to alternative specifications such as controlling for importer-specific foreign regulatory exposure. The causal evidence demonstrates that unilateral action delivers meaningful health gains, but fragmented regulatory approaches create opportunities for “regulatory dumping.” This study underscores the need for global cooperation – through harmonized standards or trade-linked enforcement – to prevent cross-border displacement of dietary risks. Beyond TF, the findings offer timely insights for emerging national and global mandates on other nutrients, such as salt, sugar, and saturated fats.
records.abstract_cn: 国家营养法规可以通过两种不同方式影响饮食：直接通过国内政策机制，以及间接通过调节贸易流动。本研究评估反式脂肪（TF）摄入受到这两条路径的影响。当各国单独采取行动——通过禁止或限制TF——其法规在时间、严格程度和执行力度上常常存在差异。这种监管异质性可能导致漏洞，使不健康产品得以跨境流动。本研究通过构建161国家（2010-2022，采用已建立的基准验证）食品项目层面的面板数据集，并结合分段差异中的差异法与中介分析，估算TF法规对其国内摄入的因果效应。结果显示，像美国和欧盟那样的严格、可执行的法规显著降低了TF的摄入和进口，起到了有效过滤富含TF食品的作用。相反，法规较弱的国家进口和摄入量逐步上升，最终增加摄入，实际上使其面临成为“饮食风险避风港”的风险。即使是温和的法规，在强有力的监测支持下也能取得更好的效果。这些结果对控制进口国特定的外国监管暴露等替代规格的稳健性检验均保持一致。因果证据表明，单边行动能带来显著的健康改善，但碎片化的监管方式也为“监管倾销”提供了机会。本文强调需要通过协调标准或与贸易挂钩的执法实现全球合作，以防止跨境饮食风险的转移。除了反式脂肪外，这些发现为新兴国家和全球范围内关于盐、糖和饱和脂肪等其他营养素的法规制定提供了及时的见解。

records.title_en: Fostering legume purchases with behavioural interventions: evidence from field experiments in online and offline supermarkets
records.title_cn: 通过行为干预促进豆类购买：来自线上与线下超市的实地实验证据
records.abstract_en: The protein transition is a crucial element of the transition to sustainable food systems, and both EU and national policies aim to foster the consumption of plant-based proteins. Supermarkets as the primary source of food products in many countries represent a promising environment for translating these policy objectives into practice. With three studies from Denmark, including a representative online survey (n = 838 participants) followed by randomised controlled trials in a real online supermarket in two rounds over 6 weeks (n = 9,093 transactions Round 1; n = 8,706 transactions Round 2) and field experiments in physical brick-and-mortar stores (9 test stores, 13 control stores, 21 days of observation), this research investigates the potential of leveraging behavioural interventions to foster legume purchases in online and offline retail settings. The randomised controlled trials in the online supermarket showed that placement interventions in the vegetable section were effective in increasing sales of legumes by 57%, while placement interventions in the meat section were not effective, suggesting that the strategies known to work for highly processed plant-based meat substitutes cannot be translated to legumes. The field experiments in brick-and-mortar supermarkets confirmed that the vegetable section is a promising intervention point. The multi-layered intervention tested (bundling placement combined with a recipe inspiration poster) significantly increased legume purchases to a similar degree as in the other study.
records.abstract_cn: 蛋白质转型是实现可持续食品体系转型的关键要素，欧盟及各国政策均致力于促进植物蛋白的消费。超市作为许多国家食品产品的主要来源，是将这些政策目标转化为实践的有前景的环境。本文基于丹麦的三项研究，包括一项具有代表性的线上问卷调查（n = 838名参与者），随后在真实线上超市中分两轮、为期6周的随机对照试验（第1轮n = 9,093笔交易；第2轮n = 8,706笔交易），以及在线下实体门店的实地实验（9家实验门店，13家对照门店，21天观察），探讨了在线上与线下零售环境中利用行为干预促进豆类购买的潜力。线上超市的随机对照试验显示，在蔬菜区进行陈列干预能有效提升豆类销量57%，而在肉类区的陈列干预则无效，表明已知对高度加工的植物基肉类替代品有效的策略并不能直接应用于豆类。线下实体超市的实地实验进一步证实，蔬菜区是有前景的干预点。多层次干预（陈列捆绑结合菜谱启发海报）显著提升了豆类购买，提升幅度与其他研究相当。

records.title_en: Viewpoint: evaluating transparency and market consequences of the national bioengineered food disclosure standard in the United States
records.title_cn: 观点：评估美国国家生物工程食品披露标准的透明度及市场后果
records.abstract_en: The 2018 National Bioengineered Food Disclosure Standard (NBFDS) mandated disclosure of bioengineered (BE) ingredients in regulated foods in the United States, with full compliance required by January 2022. The policy is intended to reduce information asymmetry by enabling consumers to infer BE status through mandatory labeling, alongside existing voluntary claims such as organic and non-GMO labels. This viewpoint paper concludes that the current design and implementation of the NBFDS do not fully support this transparency objective in practice. We show that several regulatory features weaken the inference mechanism linking disclosure to consumer understanding on which the policy relies, including evolving definition and terminology associated with BE foods, electronic and digital disclosure options, detectability-based exclusions for highly refined products, exemptions from mandatory disclosure, and limited ingredient specificity. As a result, under the current design, mandatory BE labeling increases consumer search costs and cognitive burden while creating implementation challenges for industry. These findings underscore the importance of careful policy design in achieving effective transparency. Continued evaluation and evidence-based refinement are needed to improve the effectiveness of the law.
records.abstract_cn: 2018年的国家生物工程食品披露标准（NBFDS）要求在美国对受管制食品中披露生物工程（BE）成分，全面合规截止日期为2022年一月。该政策旨在通过强制性标签披露，使消费者能够推断BE状态，从而减少信息不对称，同时还有现有的自愿声明，如有机和非转基因标签。本观点论文得出结论，NBFDS的当前设计和实施在实践中并未完全支持这一透明度目标。我们表明，几项监管特征削弱了披露与消费者理解之间的推断机制，这是政策依赖的，包括与BE食品相关的不断演变的定义和术语、电子和数字披露选项、对高度精制产品的检测性排除、强制披露豁免以及有限的成分特定性。因此，在当前设计下，强制性BE标签增加了消费者的搜索成本和认知负担，同时为行业带来了实施挑战。这些发现强调了在实现有效透明度时仔细政策设计的重要性。需要持续评估和基于证据的改进，以提高法律的有效性。

records.title_en: Digital literacy training to promote diffusion of digital agricultural tools to smallholder farmers: evidence from a randomized intervention in Egypt
records.title_cn: 数字素养培训促进数字农业工具在小农户中的推广：埃及随机干预的证据
records.abstract_en: Despite growing enthusiasm about the potential of digital innovations to transform agrifood systems, adoption among smallholder farmers in Africa remains low and heterogeneous. While the proliferation of digital tools targeting smallholder farmers is encouraging, the vast majority remain at pilot stages, facing barriers such as limited awareness among farmer, digital illiteracy, usability challenges, and low trust among farmers. This paper evaluates alternative digital literacy interventions designed to address these demand-side barriers and enhance smallholder farmers’ knowledge, utilization, trust, and uptake of two Egyptian mobile apps offering marketing, advisory, and input delivery services. Following a Training of Trainers (TOT) model, we designed and implemented a randomized controlled trial to test three variants of digital literacy training: standard classroom-based digital literacy training (T1), digital training complemented (preceded) by a video-based play (T2), digital training complemented (preceded) by a live community play (T3), and a control group (C). We find that the different variants of digital training led to statistically significant increases in uptake and utilization of digital tools. Specifically, the standard digital training alone increased uptake by 20 percentage points and utilization by 18 percentage points. The interventions also improved farmers’ trust in digital tools by 8–13 percentage points. Surprisingly, for some outcomes, the digital literacy training alone outperformed the combined approaches that incorporated edutainment nudges. We explore possible explanations, including group size effects and social influence dynamics during the plays. We also document heterogeneity in the impact of these interventions across farmers’ gender and age. Our findings offer insights into designing cost-effective, scalable interventions that build digital capabilities and trust among smallholder farmers, while cautioning against assuming edutainment always strengthens adoption outcomes.
records.abstract_cn: 尽管对数字创新有望变革农产品系统的潜力日益热衷，但非洲小农户的采用率仍然较低且存在异质性。虽然针对小农户的数字工具的普及令人鼓舞，但绝大多数仍处于试点阶段，面临诸如农户认知有限、数字素养不足、可用性挑战以及农户信任度低等障碍。本文评估旨在解决这些需求侧障碍、提升小农户对提供市场营销、咨询和投入配送服务的埃及二移动应用的认知、利用、信任和采纳的数字素养干预措施。采用培训师培训（TOT）模式，我们设计并实施了一项随机对照试验，测试三数字素养培训的不同变体：标准的课堂数字素养培训（T1）、在数字培训前辅以视频播放（T2）、在数字培训前辅以现场社区剧（T3），以及对照组（C）。研究发现，不同的数字培训变体在提升数字工具的采纳和利用方面具有统计学显著性。具体而言，单独的标准数字培训使采纳率提高了20个百分点，利用率提高了18个百分点。这些干预措施还使农户对数字工具的信任度提高了8-13个百分点。令人惊讶的是，在某些结果中，单一的数字素养培训优于结合娱乐教育元素的多种干预方式。我们探讨了可能的解释，包括小组规模效应和剧中社会影响动力学。我们还记录了这些干预措施在不同性别和年龄农户中的异质性影响。我们的研究结果为设计具有成本效益、可扩展的干预措施提供了见解，旨在提升小农户的数字能力和信任，同时提醒不要假设娱乐教育元素总能增强采纳效果。

records.title_en: Does school lunch equalize? An examination of dietary quality and socioeconomic disparities in Germany
records.title_cn: 学校午餐能否实现平衡？德国饮食质量与社会经济差异的检验
records.abstract_en: An adequate diet is essential for children’s cognitive, physical, and educational development, yet children from lower socioeconomic backgrounds are more likely to have poorer dietary quality, reinforcing social inequalities. This study examines whether the offer of school lunch can mitigate the effect of socioeconomic status on children’s total daily dietary quality. Using food frequency data from the second wave of the German KiGGS study (2014–2017), we construct an updated Healthy Nutrition Score for Kids and Youth (HuSKY) to capture overall dietary quality in a single measure. We focus on children between 6 and 13 years and proxy school lunch using attendance at after-school care facilities that typically offer school lunch. To address potential selection bias between children with and without such a lunch offer, we apply propensity score matching. We then estimate a mixed-effects model on the matched sample (n = 2,212) to analyze the effects of socioeconomic status, school lunch offer, and their interaction on total daily dietary quality. Our results corroborate that dietary quality is higher among children with higher socioeconomic status and is also positively associated with receiving a school lunch offer. Beyond supporting prior findings, we find that the positive association between socioeconomic status and dietary quality is substantially weaker among children receiving a school lunch offer. Accordingly, we conclude that school lunch may help reduce socioeconomic disparities in dietary quality. Future research should examine whether these improvements help reduce broader inequalities in health, education, and income. Policymakers should consider these potential benefits in the ongoing debate surrounding (free) school lunch provision.
records.abstract_cn: 充足的饮食对儿童的认知、身体和教育发展至关重要，然而来自较低社会经济背景的儿童更可能拥有较差的饮食质量，从而加剧社会不平等。本研究考察学校午餐的提供是否能够减轻社会经济地位对儿童每日总饮食质量的影响。利用德国KiGGS研究（第二）中2014-2017波段的食物频率数据，我们构建了更新的儿童与青少年健康营养评分（HuSKY），以单一指标反映整体饮食质量。研究对象为6至13年龄段的儿童，利用通常提供学校午餐的课后照料机构的出席情况作为学校午餐的代理变量。为应对有无学校午餐提供的儿童之间可能存在的选择偏差，我们采用倾向得分匹配方法。在匹配样本（样本量为2,212）上，应用混合效应模型估算社会经济地位、学校午餐提供及其交互作用对每日总饮食质量的影响。结果显示，社会经济地位较高的儿童饮食质量较好，且接受学校午餐的儿童饮食质量也呈正相关。除支持先前的研究发现外，我们还发现，社会经济地位与饮食质量之间的正向关系在接受学校午餐的儿童中显著减弱。因此，我们得出结论，学校午餐可能有助于减少饮食质量方面的社会经济差异。未来的研究应探讨这些改善是否有助于缩小健康、教育和收入等更广泛的不平等。政策制定者应在关于（免费）学校午餐提供的持续辩论中考虑这些潜在的益处。

records.title_en: Defaults harmonize our food choices – a systematic data review of default effects across socio-demographic groups
records.title_cn: 默认设置协调我们的食品选择——一项关于不同社会人口群体默认效应的系统数据综述
records.abstract_en: Food policy often struggles to reach diverse population groups, and well-intentioned interventions can sometimes exacerbate inequalities along socio-demographic groups. This systematic data review examines whether default nudges in food choices have consistent effects across different socio-demographic groups, or whether their impact varies depending on factors such as education level, age, and gender. After selecting eligible studies, authors from 12 studies shared their primary data and were subsequently included in the Default Nudge Research & Data Sharing Consortium (Table A2). These primary data enabled us to analyze 40 interaction effects examining whether age, gender, and education moderate the effectiveness of defaults relative to active choice conditions. Results show no consistent and rarely any interaction effects, suggesting defaults influence food decisions similarly across socio-demographic groups. A possible exception is that harmful defaults may be more effective among less educated individuals. These findings highlight default nudges as a broadly equitable behavioral tool in food policy design.
records.abstract_cn: 食品政策常常难以覆盖多样化的人口群体，善意的干预措施有时可能加剧沿社会人口群体的差异。本系统数据综述考察了食品选择中的默认引导是否在不同社会人口群体中具有一致的效果，或其影响是否因教育水平、年龄和性别等因素而异。在筛选符合条件的研究后，来自12研究的作者共享了他们的原始数据，并随后被纳入默认引导研究与数据共享联盟（表A2）。这些原始数据使我们能够分析40交互作用，检验年龄、性别和教育是否调节默认设置相对于主动选择条件的有效性。结果显示没有一致且几乎没有交互作用，表明默认设置在不同社会人口群体中对食品决策的影响类似。一个可能的例外是，有害的默认设置在教育程度较低的个体中可能更为有效。这些发现强调了默认引导作为一种广泛公平的行为工具在食品政策设计中的作用。

records.title_en: Impact of gardening and nutrition support provided to women in refugee camps in Cox’s Bazar, Bangladesh
records.title_cn: 为孟加拉国科克斯巴扎尔难民营妇女提供园艺和营养支持的影响
records.abstract_en: Nearly one million Rohingya refugees, displaced by the Myanmar civil war, live in densely populated camps in Cox’s Bazar, Bangladesh. While food aid addresses some of their immediate needs, additional solutions are necessary to foster self-reliance, as many have been living in camps for years with little hope of returning home. Gardening is one approach that could enhance diets, food security, and incomes, but evidence for the impact of home garden programs in refugee camps remains limited. The objective of this study is to evaluate the impact of a home garden and nutrition program on the diets and food security of pregnant and lactating women in refugee camps in Cox’s Bazar. A cluster-randomized controlled trial was conducted, with pre- and post-intervention data collected from 1050 women, evenly split into control and treatment groups. A difference-in-differences estimator was used to measure the intent-to-treat effects. Lack of space was the primary obstacle to gardening, but sack gardens and rooftop gardens offered solutions. Women reported many benefits from gardening beyond food consumption, such as personal joy and making the house look nice. The intervention led to a 17-percentage point increase in garden adoption (p = 0.018) and a 57-percentage point rise in households sourcing fruits and vegetables from their gardens (p < 0.001). It also improved nutrition knowledge by 23 percentage points (p < 0.001) and household food security by 66% (p < 0.05). The intervention led to a significant increase of 1 additional serving of fruit per week, but there was no significant increase in vegetable intake. These findings clearly show the benefits of providing gardening and nutrition training to nutritionally vulnerable women in densely populated refugee camps.
records.abstract_cn: 近一百万因缅甸内战流离失所的罗兴亚难民居住在孟加拉国科克斯巴扎尔人口密集的难民营中。虽然粮食援助解决了部分他们的即时需求，但由于许多人已在营地生活多年且几乎没有回家的希望，仍需额外方案以促进自力更生。园艺是一种能够改善饮食、粮食安全和收入的方法，但关于家庭园艺项目在难民营影响的证据仍有限。本研究旨在评估家庭园艺和营养项目对科克斯巴扎尔难民营孕妇和哺乳期妇女饮食和粮食安全的影响。采用集群随机对照试验，干预前后共收集了1050名妇女的数据，控制组和干预组人数均等。使用双重差分估计量测量意向性处理效应。空间不足是园艺的主要障碍，但袋式花园和屋顶花园提供了解决方案。妇女们报告园艺带来的诸多益处，除了食物消费外，还包括个人愉悦和美化家园。干预使园艺采纳率提高了17个百分点（p = 0.018），家庭从自家园艺获取水果和蔬菜的比例上升了57个百分点（p < 0.001）。此外，营养知识提升了23个百分点（p < 0.001），家庭粮食安全提高了66%（p < 0.05）。干预显著增加了每周水果摄入量1份，但蔬菜摄入量无显著增加。这些结果清楚显示，在人口密集的难民营为营养脆弱妇女提供园艺和营养培训具有明显益处。

records.title_en: Introducing and Terminating Monetary Incentives in Non-Regenerating Forests: Insights from a Framed Field Experiment
records.title_cn: 非再生森林中货币激励的引入与终止：来自框架田野实验的见解
records.abstract_en: In regions with low soil fertility, smallholder farmers often clear forest to sustain agricultural yields. This pattern becomes more problematic where forest regrowth is slow, contributing to local forest loss and global environmental challenges such as climate change and biodiversity decline. This paper presents findings from a framed field experiment that examines how different types of monetary incentives affect forest-clearing decisions in northern Namibia, a semi-arid region with negligible forest regrowth. We implemented a common-pool resource game with 518 smallholder farmers across 25 villages, in which a forest stock declines dynamically based on participants’ clearing decisions, without immediate regrowth. The game spans three periods: a baseline without incentives, an intervention period where participants receive either individual rewards, collective rewards, an individual fee, or no incentives (control group), and a post-incentive phase. This setup allows us to assess both the immediate effects of incentives and their persistence after incentive removal. All incentive types reduce clearing compared to the baseline, but not significantly more than in the control condition, where clearing also declined – an unexpected trend likely linked to features of the dynamic game design. Incentive effects largely dissipate after removal, with no strong evidence of lasting motivational crowding-in or crowding-out. Overall, our results suggest that moderate payments may be insufficient to sustain cooperation in persistent resource dilemmas. More broadly, they highlight the importance of multifaceted analysis including control conditions and careful experimental framing in field-laboratory studies, coupled with caution in generalizing findings to other settings or policy applications.
records.abstract_cn: 在土壤肥力低的地区，小农常常通过砍伐森林来维持农业产量。在森林再生缓慢的地区，这种模式变得更加问题重重，导致当地森林损失和全球环境挑战，如气候变化和生物多样性下降。本文介绍了一项框架田野实验的结果，该实验考察了不同类型的货币激励如何影响纳米比亚北部（一个森林再生几乎为零的半干旱地区）的森林砍伐决策。我们实施了一个公共池资源博弈，涉及25个村庄的518名小农，其中森林存量根据参与者的砍伐决策动态下降，且没有即时再生。博弈分为三个阶段：无激励的基线期、干预期（参与者接受个人奖励、集体奖励、个人费用或无激励（对照组）），以及激励后阶段。这种设置使我们能够评估激励的即时效应及其在激励移除后的持续性。所有激励类型相比基线减少了砍伐，但并未显著多于对照组，对照组中砍伐也有所下降——这一意外趋势可能与动态博弈设计的特征有关。激励效应在移除后基本消散，没有强有力的证据表明存在持久的动机挤入或挤出。总体而言，我们的结果表明，适度的支付可能不足以在持续的资源困境中维持合作。更广泛地说，它们强调了在田野实验室研究中包括控制条件和仔细的实验框架的多方面分析的重要性，以及对将发现推广到其他环境或政策应用持谨慎态度。

records.title_en: Adjacency Externality and the Timing of Timber Harvesting – The Case of Windthrow Risk
records.title_cn: 邻接外部性与木材采伐时机——以风倒风险为例
records.abstract_en: We examine the timing of timber harvesting, when neighboring forest stands interact through windthrow risk. Positive adjacency externality stems from the sheltering effect of tall trees whereas negative externality stems from a windthrow-prone border created by clear felling or wind damage. We model wind damages as catastrophic, which call for immediate salvage harvest and regeneration. We augment previous optimal rotation results by extending the analysis to a dynamic harvest policy, where harvest age depends on the age of the neighboring stand. We examine both an efficient equilibrium and an inefficient noncooperative Markov perfect equilibrium. In the efficient equilibrium, where the externality is internalized, harvest is delayed when the neighboring stand is mature. This delay provides shelter by postponing harvest-created border risks. In the noncooperative equilibrium, the shelter is not provided, yet the harvest age adapts to increased risk-levels due to the border effect. We numerically test the magnitude of the border effect under various model assumptions and find that pricing the carbon externality makes the harvest policy more responsive to the adjacency externality.
records.abstract_cn: 我们研究了当邻近林分通过风倒风险相互作用时，木材采伐的时机问题。正邻接外部性源于高大树木的庇护效应，而负外部性则源于皆伐或风害造成的易风倒边界。我们将风害建模为灾难性事件，需要立即进行抢救性采伐和更新。我们通过将分析扩展到动态采伐政策，其中采伐年龄取决于邻近林分的年龄，从而增强了先前的最优轮伐结果。我们同时考察了有效均衡和低效的非合作马尔可夫完美均衡。在有效均衡中，外部性被内部化，当邻近林分成熟时，采伐被延迟。这种延迟通过推迟采伐造成的边界风险来提供庇护。在非合作均衡中，庇护不被提供，但采伐年龄会适应因边界效应而增加的风险水平。我们在各种模型假设下数值测试了边界效应的幅度，并发现对碳外部性定价会使采伐政策对邻接外部性更加敏感。

records.title_en: Harnessing Social Information to Improve Public Support for Pigouvian Taxes
records.title_cn: 利用社会信息提升公众对庇古税的支持
records.abstract_en: Pigouvian taxes are often unpopular among the general public. We test the effectiveness of pro-tax social information in increasing support for such taxes. In a lab experiment that involves a market game with externalities, we provide subjects with information about other participants’ views about the “right thing to do” (voting, or not, for the tax policy). We also elicit personal, normative, and positive beliefs. Our findings demonstrate a causal effect of social information provision on subjects’ support for the tax, and that subjects’ changes in beliefs is a causal mechanism through which this increased support for the tax is made possible. We therefore highlight the important role of beliefs in voting behaviors and the acceptability of Pigouvian taxes.
records.abstract_cn: 庇古税在公众中往往不受欢迎。我们测试了支持税收的社会信息在增加对此类税收支持方面的有效性。在一个涉及外部性的市场博弈实验室实验中，我们向受试者提供关于其他参与者对“正确做法”（投票支持或不支持税收政策）的看法的信息。我们还引出了个人、规范性和实证信念。我们的研究结果表明，社会信息的提供对受试者支持税收具有因果效应，并且受试者信念的变化是这种增加税收支持得以实现的因果机制。因此，我们强调了信念在投票行为及庇古税可接受性中的重要作用。

records.title_en: Population Ageing and the Environment: A Comparative Study of Nature-Concerning and Action-Requiring Outcomes
records.title_cn: 人口老龄化与环境：关注自然与要求行动结果的比较研究
records.abstract_en: This study examines an under-explored implication of population ageing: its relationship with environmental outcomes at the country level and environmental attitudes at the individual level. The analysis introduces a novel classification of environmental outcomes, distinguishing between action-requiring and nature-concerning dimensions based on the degree of civic engagement necessary for their realisation. Using panel data from a broad set of countries over the period 1995–2018, population ageing is shown to be associated with improvements in environmental outcomes that require limited civic engagement, while no systematic relationship is observed for outcomes that rely on active public participation. Complementary evidence from individual-level survey data for 2005–2016 indicates that ageing societies exhibit lower levels of environmental engagement, without a corresponding decline in underlying environmental concern. The findings contribute to the literature on demographic change and environmental performance by highlighting the role of civic engagement as a mediating mechanism and suggest that ageing societies may face specific challenges in sustaining participatory forms of environmental action.
records.abstract_cn: 本研究探讨了人口老龄化一个未被充分研究的含义：其与国家层面环境结果及个体层面环境态度的关系。分析引入了一种新颖的环境结果分类，根据实现这些结果所需的公民参与程度，区分了要求行动和关注自然两个维度。利用1995-2018年间广泛国家面板数据，研究表明人口老龄化与需要有限公民参与的环境结果改善相关，而对于依赖公众积极参与的结果则未观察到系统性关系。来自2005-2016年个体层面调查数据的补充证据表明，老龄化社会表现出较低的环境参与水平，而潜在的环境关注并未相应下降。这些发现通过强调公民参与作为中介机制的作用，为人口变化与环境绩效的文献做出贡献，并表明老龄化社会在维持参与式环境行动方面可能面临特定挑战。

records.title_en: Realtor Forecasting Accuracy on Homebuyer Preferences for Energy Efficiency
records.title_cn: 房地产经纪人对购房者能源效率偏好的预测准确性
records.abstract_en: Residential energy use is a major contributor to total energy consumption and CO 2 emissions, and energy costs can take up high shares of household spending. In this context, we make three contributions to the literature. First, using a discrete choice experiment with 1,389 prospective homebuyers in Sweden, we investigate how homebuyers account for energy efficiency of buildings compared to other attributes when looking for a new home. Second, we elicit forecasts from a sample of 252 realtors whom we ask to predict homebuyers’ preferences, allowing us to shed light on the role these important mediators play regarding energy efficiency in the housing market. Third, we estimate how providing prior information on homebuyers’ choices affects realtors’ forecasting accuracy. For homebuyers, we find that energy efficiency ranks low overall. Realtors’ forecasting accuracy is lower for the energy efficiency attribute. Providing realtors with more prior information has sizeable positive effects on forecasting accuracy, and information also affects self-reported difficulty of and confidence in the forecasts.
records.abstract_cn: 住宅能源使用是总能源消耗和二氧化碳2排放的主要贡献者，能源成本在家庭支出中占据很大比例。在这种背景下，我们对文献做出了三项贡献。首先，我们对瑞典的1,389位潜在购房者进行了离散选择实验，研究了购房者在寻找新房时如何考虑建筑物的能源效率与其他属性的比较。其次，我们从252房地产经纪人样本中得出预测，我们要求他们预测购房者的偏好，从而使我们能够阐明这些重要的中介因素在住房市场能源效率方面所发挥的作用。第三，我们估计提供有关购房者选择的先验信息如何影响房地产经纪人的预测准确性。对于购房者来说，我们发现能源效率总体排名较低。房地产经纪人对能源效率属性的预测准确性较低。为房地产经纪人提供更多先验信息对预测准确性具有相当大的积极影响，并且信息还会影响自我报告的预测难度和信心。

records.title_en: Tax Progressivity of Carbon and Gasoline Taxes: The Role of Income Inequality
records.title_cn: 碳税与汽油税的累进性：收入不平等的作用
records.abstract_en: We present a simple model showing how income inequality and the income elasticity of demand jointly shape the tax progressivity of indirect taxes, with rising inequality increasing the regressivity of taxes on necessities. We test the model’s predictions by analyzing the Swedish carbon tax on transport fuel. We find that the tax becomes increasingly regressive over time, closely tracking rising income inequality. We also show that the relative incidence shifts from regressive to progressive when using annual expenditure rather than annual income as the welfare measure, as expenditure is more evenly distributed. A cross-country analysis of gasoline taxes in high-income nations further supports our findings, establishing a strong correlation between higher inequality and greater regressivity. Our model helps policymakers identify when complementary redistributive measures such as lump-sum transfers may become necessary.
records.abstract_cn: 我们提出了一个简单模型，展示收入不平等和需求的收入弹性如何共同塑造间接税的累进性，其中不平等加剧会增加对必需品税收的累退性。我们通过分析瑞典对运输燃料征收的碳税来检验模型的预测。我们发现，该税种随时间推移变得越来越累退，与收入不平等的上升紧密相关。我们还表明，当使用年度支出而非年度收入作为福利衡量标准时，相对负担从累退转为累进，因为支出的分布更为均匀。对高收入国家汽油税的跨国分析进一步支持了我们的发现，确立了更高不平等与更大累退性之间的强相关性。我们的模型有助于政策制定者识别何时可能需要补充性再分配措施，如一次性转移支付。

records.title_en: The Green Peace Dividend: The Effects of Militarisation on Emissions and the Green Transition
records.title_cn: 绿色和平红利：军事化对排放和绿色转型的影响
records.abstract_en: This paper argues that military buildups lead to a significant rise in greenhouse gas emissions and can disrupt the green transition. Identifying military spending shocks, I use local projections to show that a percentage point rise in the military spending share leads to a 0.9–2% rise in total emissions, as well as a 1% rise in emission intensity, depending on the economy’s overall emission intensity. Using a dynamic production network model calibrated for the US, I find that a permanent shock of the same size would increase total emissions by between 0.25% and 1.38%, and emission intensity by between 0.12% and 1.06%. The empirical analysis tentatively suggests that green patenting may be reduced by 10–25% following such a shock, and the model suggests that investment in renewables could be crowded out by defence spending under certain circumstances, hindering the energy transition. I show in a directed technical change model that crowding out green innovation could result in the growth rate - not just the level - of emissions becoming higher. These effects can significantly raise climate damages. Depending on the social cost of carbon and the composition of a military spending shock, I estimate that permanently doubling the military spending share in the US in 2017 (equal to 3.3% of GDP) would have led to climate damages equivalent to between 0.05–1.81% of US GDP per year.
records.abstract_cn: 本文认为，军事集结会导致温室气体排放大幅增加，并可能破坏绿色转型。在确定军费开支冲击时，我使用当地预测来表明，军费开支份额每增加一个百分点，就会导致总排放量增加 0.9-2%，以及排放强度 1% 增加，具体取决于经济体的总体排放强度。使用针对美国校准的动态生产网络模型，我发现相同规模的永久性冲击将使总排放量增加 0.25% 和 1.38% 之间，排放强度增加 0.12% 和 1.06% 之间。实证分析初步表明，在这种冲击之后，绿色专利申请可能会减少10-25%，并且该模型表明，在某些情况下，对可再生能源的投资可能会被国防开支挤出，从而阻碍能源转型。我在定向技术变革模型中表明，排挤绿色创新可能会导致排放量的增长率（而不仅仅是水平）变得更高。这些影响会显着加剧气候损害。根据碳的社会成本和军费开支冲击的构成，我估计，如果 2017 美国军费开支份额永久翻倍（相当于 GDP 的 3.3%），将导致每年相当于美国 GDP 0.05-1.81% 的气候损害。

records.title_en: Disentangling the distributional inequity of solar tax credits
records.title_cn: 解析太阳能税收抵免的分配不平等
records.abstract_en: This study examines the distributional equity of residential solar tax credits, distinguishing effects on both the extensive and intensive margins. Using a comprehensive dataset of system-level installations in New Mexico, combined with housing characteristics and census tract demographics, the analysis shows that credit take-up and benefits are unevenly distributed across socioeconomic groups. On the extensive margin, adopters with smaller systems, lower housing values, and in tracts with lower education levels and higher Hispanic population shares are less likely to claim credits. On the intensive margin, more affluent households receive larger credits because they install larger systems at lower unit costs. Taken together, the results indicate that disparities in credit claims constitute an additional channel that widens the consumer surplus gap across socioeconomic groups.
records.abstract_cn: 本研究考察了住宅太阳能税收抵免的分配公平性，区分了其对广泛边际和集约边际的影响。利用新墨西哥州系统级安装的综合数据集，结合住房特征和人口普查区人口统计数据，分析显示税收抵免的领取和收益在不同社会经济群体间分布不均。在广泛边际上，系统规模较小、住房价值较低、所在区域教育水平较低且西班牙裔人口比例较高的采纳者更不可能申请抵免。在集约边际上，更富裕的家庭因安装更大系统且单位成本更低而获得更大的抵免。总体而言，结果表明抵免申请中的差异构成了一个额外渠道，扩大了不同社会经济群体间的消费者剩余差距。

records.title_en: A novel grey multivariable model for forecasting electricity consumption considering the accumulative time lag effects from energy transition and technological innovation
records.title_cn: 考虑能源转型与技术创新累积时滞效应的新型灰色多变量电力消费预测模型
records.abstract_en: The accurate identification of driven factors and precise prediction of the electricity consumption (EC) are crucial for green economic development and dual‑carbon goals. However, existing studies ignore the accumulative time lag effects from energy transition and technological innovation on EC. In order to achieve an accurate prediction, this study proposes a forecasting framework combining feature identification strategy and a novel grey multivariate model. Firstly, 15 potential driven factors are screened from six dimensions, and random forest regression is used to identify the key influencing factors. In addition, time delay factors and its time lag periods are recognized by cross-correlation analysis. The analysis results indicate that the key driven factors of EC are electricity generation, energy consumption and regional gross domestic product, with importance coefficients of 0.38, 0.33, 0.23, respectively, and the time delay factors are fixed asset investment, renewable energy generation proportion and R&D expenditure intensity. Secondly, a novel grey multivariate model with accumulative time lag effects is constructed. And the ordinary least squares estimation and nonlinear programmer are utilized to solve the unknown parameters. In case study, four typical prefectures in China are taken as examples to verify the superiority, validity and robustness of the proposed model. Finally, EC for China's 30 provinces and municipalities are conducted for 2023–2030 under different scenarios. The regional heterogeneity is emphasized based on prediction results under three scenarios.
records.abstract_cn: 准确识别驱动因素并精确预测电力消费（EC）对于绿色经济发展和双碳目标至关重要。然而，现有研究忽视了能源转型和技术创新对电力消费的累积时滞效应。为实现精确预测，本研究提出了一种结合特征识别策略和新型灰色多变量模型的预测框架。首先，从六个维度筛选出15个潜在驱动因素，并使用随机森林回归识别关键影响因素。此外，通过交叉相关分析识别时滞因素及其时滞周期。分析结果表明，电力消费的关键驱动因素为发电量、能源消费和地区生产总值，其重要性系数分别为0.38、0.33、0.23，时滞因素为固定资产投资、可再生能源发电占比和研发支出强度。其次，构建了具有累积时滞效应的新型灰色多变量模型，并利用普通最小二乘估计和非线性规划求解未知参数。在案例研究中，以中国四个典型地级市为例，验证了所提模型的优越性、有效性和稳健性。最后，在不同情景下对中国30个省和直辖市进行了2023-2030年的电力消费预测，并基于三种情景下的预测结果强调了区域异质性。

records.title_en: Is Spain's energy voucher lighting the way for the poor? A microeconomic evaluation of the Bono Social Eléctrico
records.title_cn: 西班牙能源券是否为穷人照亮了道路？对Bono Social Eléctrico的微观经济评估
records.abstract_en: Energy poverty refers to the inability of households to afford adequate energy services, with negative impacts on health, well-being, and economic opportunities. In Spain, energy poverty has become an increasing concern, with many low-income households struggling to meet their energy needs despite social protection mechanisms. This paper analyses the effectiveness of the Bono Social Eléctrico (BSE), a Spanish social energy voucher aimed at alleviating energy poverty. Departing from a microeconomic theoretical framework and applying a Stochastic Frontier Analysis (SFA) approach, the study evaluates the gap between actual and potential energy poverty levels using Spanish household panel data from 2021 to 2023. The findings indicate that the BSE contributes to reducing energy poverty, but its effectiveness is constrained by insufficient coverage and limited impact on the poorest households. Education and computer access also play a significant role in addressing energy poverty. Our study suggests policy recommendations to enhance the voucher's targeting mechanisms and improve effectiveness.
records.abstract_cn: 能源贫困指的是家庭无法负担足够的能源服务，对健康、福祉和经济机会产生负面影响。在西班牙，能源贫困已成为日益关注的问题，尽管有社会保护机制，许多低收入家庭仍难以满足其能源需求。本文分析了西班牙社会能源券Bono Social Eléctrico（BSE）在缓解能源贫困方面的有效性。基于微观经济理论框架，并应用随机前沿分析（SFA）方法，本研究利用2021年至2023年的西班牙家庭面板数据，评估了实际与潜在能源贫困水平之间的差距。研究结果表明，BSE有助于减少能源贫困，但其有效性受到覆盖不足和对最贫困家庭影响有限的制约。教育和计算机使用在解决能源贫困方面也发挥着重要作用。我们的研究提出了政策建议，以增强该券的瞄准机制并提高其有效性。

records.title_en: Temperature sensitivity of residential energy demand on the global scale: A Bayesian Partial Pooling Model
records.title_cn: 全球范围内住宅能源需求的温度敏感性：一种贝叶斯部分池化模型
records.abstract_en: This paper contributes to the limited literature on the temperature sensitivity of residential energy demand on a global scale. Using a Bayesian Partial Pooling model, we estimate country-specific intercepts and slopes, focusing on non-linear temperature response functions. The results, based on data for up to 126 countries spanning from 1978 to 2023, indicate a higher demand for residential electricity and natural gas at temperatures below -5°C and a higher demand for electricity at temperatures above 30°C. For temperatures above 23°C, the relationship between power demand and temperature steepens. Demand in developed countries is more sensitive to high temperatures than in less developed countries, possibly due to an inability to meet cooling demands in the latter.
records.abstract_cn: 本文对全球范围内住宅能源需求温度敏感性的有限文献做出了贡献。使用贝叶斯部分池化模型，我们估计了国家特定的截距和斜率，重点关注非线性温度响应函数。基于多达126个国家、时间跨度从1978年到2023年的数据，结果显示，在低于-5°C的温度下，住宅电力和天然气的需求更高，而在高于30°C的温度下，电力需求更高。对于高于23°C的温度，电力需求与温度之间的关系变得更加陡峭。发达国家的需求对高温的敏感性高于欠发达国家，这可能是由于后者无法满足制冷需求所致。

records.title_en: Temperature response functions for climate impact assessments: The case of ENSO and electricity consumption
records.title_cn: 气候影响评估中的温度响应函数：以ENSO和电力消费为例
records.abstract_en: We propose a simple regression-based approach to creating counterfactual temperature responses based on high-frequency temperature observations and low-frequency economic responses generated by way of a nonlinear temperature response function (TRF) or cross-TRF interacted with covariates. Our approach allows identification of components of temperature or other climate variables and hence the economic damages attributable to specific climate forcings or sources of natural variability. We apply this methodological approach to estimating the impact of the El Niño Southern Oscillation (ENSO) on electricity consumption in Washington state. By comparing the responses to actual temperatures with those to the counterfactual temperatures, we find that La Niña raises and El Niño reduces electricity consumption, and hence the effect of ENSO alternates between cost and saving, which may be as high as 8.5% per month in a given month. Averaging costs and savings since 1990, ENSO presents a very small net saving (<0.001% per month) in electricity consumption in the state.
records.abstract_cn: 我们提出了一种基于回归的简单方法，利用高频温度观测和通过非线性温度响应函数（TRF）或与协变量交互的交叉TRF生成的低频经济响应，来构建反事实温度响应。我们的方法能够识别温度或其他气候变量的组成部分，从而识别可归因于特定气候强迫或自然变率来源的经济损害。我们将此方法应用于估计厄尔尼诺-南方涛动（ENSO）对华盛顿州电力消费的影响。通过比较对实际温度的响应与对反事实温度的响应，我们发现拉尼娜事件增加电力消费，而厄尔尼诺事件减少电力消费，因此ENSO的影响在成本与节约之间交替，在给定月份中可能高达每月8.5%。自1990年以来，平均成本与节约，ENSO在该州的电力消费中呈现非常小的净节约（每月<0.001%）。

records.title_en: Spillover effects and cost-sharing of carbon emissions in supply chain: Evidence from green factory certification policy in China
records.title_cn: 供应链中碳排放的溢出效应与成本分担：来自中国绿色工厂认证政策的证据
records.abstract_en: The synergistic governance within supply chain serves as a crucial driver for advancing sustainable economic development. Using China's Green Factory Certification (GFC) as a quasi-natural experiment, this study examines the spillover effects on carbon intensity across the supply chain. Based on a dataset of A-share listed companies from 2010 to 2023, our multi-period DID analysis reveals a distinct asymmetric feature: focal firms' GFC significantly reduces the carbon intensity of their suppliers, yet demonstrates no significant impact on clients. it remains robust across various tests. Mechanism analysis elucidates that GFC facilitates carbon reduction by stimulating green innovation of suppliers and improving supply-demand matching condition. Moreover, heterogeneity analysis demonstrates that these spillover effects are more pronounced for small-scale suppliers, and are further intensified by stringent environmental regulations and close geographical distance. Finally, further analysis proves suppliers can share the cost of focal firms while clients cannot.
records.abstract_cn: 供应链内的协同治理是推动可持续经济发展的重要驱动力。以中国绿色工厂认证（GFC）作为准自然实验，本研究考察了供应链中碳强度的溢出效应。基于2010年至2023年A股上市公司的数据集，我们的多期双重差分分析揭示了一个显著的非对称特征：焦点企业的GFC显著降低了其供应商的碳强度，但对客户没有显著影响。这一结果在多种检验中保持稳健。机制分析表明，GFC通过刺激供应商的绿色创新和改善供需匹配条件来促进碳减排。此外，异质性分析显示，这些溢出效应在小规模供应商中更为显著，并且受到严格的环境规制和紧密的地理距离的进一步强化。最后，进一步分析证明供应商能够分担焦点企业的成本，而客户则不能。

records.title_en: The price of going green: Multi-objective optimization in the energy equity space
records.title_cn: 绿色转型的代价：能源股权空间中的多目标优化
records.abstract_en: This paper develops a three-objective portfolio optimization framework for the energy sector that simultaneously maximizes expected return, minimizes volatility, and improves environmental performance, measured by the Environmental Pillar Score. Using NSGA-III and rolling 60-month windows from 2010 to 2024, we analyze the U.S. and European equity markets and extract four representative strategies: Max-Return, Min-Volatility, Max-Environmental, and Balanced. Our findings show that trade-offs between financial performance and environmental impact are systematic and regionally specific. U.S. portfolios generally achieve higher returns with greater risk and lower environmental scores, while European portfolios offer stronger sustainability outcomes and lower volatility. The Balanced strategy proves to be a robust compromise among environmental scores, reduced risk, and moderate returns, offering a viable path for investors seeking alignment between financial and sustainability objectives. These results emphasize the value of multi-objective optimization in designing portfolios that align with both financial and sustainability goals.
records.abstract_cn: 本文针对能源部门开发了一个三目标投资组合优化框架，该框架同时最大化预期收益、最小化波动性，并通过环境支柱评分提升环境绩效。利用NSGA-III算法和从2010年到2024年的滚动60个月窗口，我们分析了美国和欧洲的股票市场，并提取了四种代表性策略：最大收益、最小波动、最大环境和平衡策略。我们的研究结果表明，财务绩效与环境影响之间的权衡是系统性的且具有区域特异性。美国投资组合通常实现更高的收益，但伴随更大的风险和较低的环境评分，而欧洲投资组合则提供更强的可持续性成果和较低的波动性。平衡策略被证明是环境评分、降低风险和适度收益之间的稳健折中方案，为寻求财务与可持续目标对齐的投资者提供了一条可行路径。这些结果强调了多目标优化在设计符合财务和可持续目标投资组合中的价值。

records.title_en: Probabilistic load forecasting in Europe: Capturing meteorological, socio-economic and political risks
records.title_cn: 欧洲概率负荷预测：捕捉气象、社会经济与政治风险
records.abstract_en: Electricity in Europe is delivered through an interconnected grid that requires continuous balancing of supply and demand while large-scale storage remains limited. Trading, contracting and generation decisions therefore rely on high-resolution mid-term load forecasts capturing cross-country dependencies and uncertainty in meteorological, socio-economic and political conditions. Yet fine-resolution models at this horizon remain scarce—and probabilistic multivariate frameworks across countries rarer still. We propose a novel probabilistic mid-term forecasting model for hourly electricity demand that is multivariate across 24 European countries. Demand is decomposed within an interpretable Generalized Additive Model (GAM) into calendar and temperature effects, including a climate trend, an endogenously retrieved unit-root socio-economic and political component, and short-term autoregressive deviations. Uncertainty in these components is modelled jointly across countries and propagated through forecasted trajectories. In a forecasting study based on more than nine years of hourly data (2015–2024), the model outperforms standard benchmarks in terms of Continuous Ranked Probability Scores. The latent socio-economic component is shown to align with external macroeconomic, energy-market and uncertainty indicators. Beyond probabilistic forecasting, the trajectory-based design enables gigawatt-level attribution of individual drivers under risk scenarios. We demonstrate this by showing how extreme weather events translate into country-specific demand deviations, revealing elevated cold-weather vulnerability in countries with high shares of electric heating.
records.abstract_cn: 欧洲的电力通过互联电网输送，这要求在大型储能仍然有限的情况下持续平衡供需。因此，交易、签约和发电决策依赖于高分辨率的中期负荷预测，这些预测需捕捉跨国依赖关系以及气象、社会经济和政治条件的不确定性。然而，在这一时间尺度上，精细分辨率模型仍然稀缺——而跨国家的概率多变量框架则更为罕见。我们提出了一种新颖的概率中期预测模型，用于每小时电力需求，该模型在24个欧洲国家之间具有多变量特性。需求在一个可解释的广义加性模型（GAM）中被分解为日历效应和温度效应，包括气候趋势、一个内生提取的单位根社会经济与政治成分，以及短期自回归偏差。这些成分的不确定性在各国之间联合建模，并通过预测轨迹进行传播。在一项基于超过九年每小时数据（2015-2024）的预测研究中，该模型在连续排序概率得分方面优于标准基准。潜在的社会经济成分被证明与外部宏观经济、能源市场和不确定性指标相一致。除了概率预测，基于轨迹的设计还能够在风险情景下对个体驱动因素进行吉瓦级归因。我们通过展示极端天气事件如何转化为特定国家的需求偏差来证明这一点，揭示了在电加热占比高的国家中，寒冷天气脆弱性较高。

records.title_en: Gone with the wind: Renewable energy projects and population change
records.title_cn: 随风而逝：可再生能源项目与人口变化
records.abstract_en: This paper uses a difference-in-differences model with staggered treatment timing to estimate the causal effect of utility-scale renewable energy projects (wind turbines and solar facilities) on out-migration at the county level for the United States. We find that counties that receive wind turbines experience decrease in population of 2%–3% while solar facilities do not cause out-migration. We also find evidence of similarly-sized spillover effects in adjacent counties. Given the literature on the rural resentment towards renewable energy project in their communities, we split our sample into rural and urban counties using Rural–Urban Continuum Codes and re-run our analysis. We find that rural and urban counties exhibit nearly identical out-migration responses to wind projects, indicating that, in practice, their attitudes towards renewable energy projects are more similar. Combined with the previous literature on the externalities of utility-scale renewable energy projects, our results suggest that solar energy is the better option for generating renewable energy when the concerns of — and impacts on — communities are considered by policy makers.
records.abstract_cn: 本文采用交错处理时点的双重差分模型，估计美国县级公用事业规模可再生能源项目（风力涡轮机和太阳能设施）对外迁的因果效应。我们发现，接收风力涡轮机的县人口减少2%–3%，而太阳能设施并未导致外迁。我们还发现相邻县存在规模相似的溢出效应。鉴于关于农村社区对可再生能源项目不满情绪的文献，我们使用农村-城市连续代码将样本分为农村县和城市县，并重新进行分析。我们发现，农村和城市县对风电项目的外迁反应几乎相同，表明在实践中，它们对可再生能源项目的态度更为相似。结合先前关于公用事业规模可再生能源项目外部性的文献，我们的结果表明，当政策制定者考虑社区的关切及影响时，太阳能是产生可再生能源的更好选择。

records.title_en: The impact of green financial and monetary policy on the low-carbon energy transition: Global empirical evidence
records.title_cn: 绿色金融与货币政策对低碳能源转型的影响：全球经验证据
records.abstract_en: Aligning economic pathways with a 2°C climate target implies rapid decarbonisation and a substantial increase in renewable energy (RE) investment and deployment. The financial system plays a key role in mobilising these investments. To support transition efforts and address related climate risks, financial regulators and central banks increasingly adopt green financial and monetary policies (GFMP). However, empirical evidence on the effects of GFMP on the low-carbon energy transition remains scarce. This paper sheds light on the impact of GFMP on RE capacity, a measure of RE investment and key transition indicator. I construct a country-level GFMP index capturing the flow and stock of policy intensity and mix across 26 countries for the years 2000 to 2023. Leveraging this index, I deploy two-way fixed effects and quantile panel regressions to quantify aggregate, policy type-specific, and heterogeneous conditional effects. Results show a positive relationship between GFMP intensity and RE capacity. On average, each adopted GFMP is associated with an addition of 0.016 gigawatt RE capacity per million capita, corresponding to 4.8 Mt CO2 emissions avoided when displacing fossil energy sources. Distinguishing by policy type, I find incentive-based instruments are about twice as effective as informational instruments. Both the adoption of GFMP and the size of effect shows heterogeneity. This study provides an early empirical quantification of the impact of GFMP on the energy transition, with findings holding important policy implications for the green transition.
records.abstract_cn: 将经济路径与2°C气候目标对齐意味着快速脱碳以及可再生能源（RE）投资和部署的大幅增加。金融体系在动员这些投资中扮演关键角色。为支持转型努力并应对相关气候风险，金融监管机构和中央银行越来越多地采用绿色金融与货币政策（GFMP）。然而，关于GFMP对低碳能源转型影响的实证证据仍然稀缺。本文揭示了GFMP对可再生能源装机容量（衡量可再生能源投资和关键转型指标）的影响。我构建了一个国家层面的GFMP指数，捕捉了26个国家在2000年至2023年间政策强度和组合的流量与存量。利用这一指数，我采用双向固定效应和分位数面板回归来量化总体、政策类型特定以及异质性的条件效应。结果显示GFMP强度与可再生能源装机容量之间存在正相关关系。平均而言，每采用一项GFMP与人均百万人口增加0.016吉瓦可再生能源装机容量相关，相当于在替代化石能源时避免4.8百万吨二氧化碳排放。按政策类型区分，我发现激励型工具的效果大约是信息型工具的两倍。GFMP的采用及其效应大小均显示出异质性。本研究提供了GFMP对能源转型影响的早期实证量化，其发现对绿色转型具有重要的政策含义。

records.title_en: Climate change, electricity consumption, and households in impoverished areas in China
records.title_cn: 气候变化、电力消费与中国贫困地区家庭
records.abstract_en: Using electricity for cooling and heating is critical for households to adapt to climate change, yet such consumption can simultaneously exacerbate it. While a large literature has documented household temperature-electricity response functions, most studies focus on developed regions. Far less is known about developing areas, particularly low-income households, who are more vulnerable to climate change and have significant potential in electricity demand. Using high-frequency household-level meter data from Xin County, an impoverished area in China, this paper investigates how household electricity consumption responds to temperature variation. We find that the response curve follows a U-shaped pattern similar to that observed in developed areas but is notably flatter, indicating a weaker sensitivity to climate change among households in developing regions. Considering that key differences likely stem from income constraints and urbanization levels, we conduct a mechanism analysis and compare our results with data from Zhejiang Province, one of China's most developed regions. Our analysis reveals that in Xin County, income mainly affects temperature responsiveness by limiting the use of air conditioners and heating appliances. Although better urban infrastructure accounts for part of the urban-rural gap in temperature response, demand-side constraints appear to play a more dominant role. These findings underscore the importance of incorporating regional and socioeconomic heterogeneity into the design of climate and energy policies.
records.abstract_cn: 使用电力进行制冷和供暖对于家庭适应气候变化至关重要，然而这种消费同时可能加剧气候变化。尽管大量文献记录了家庭温度-电力响应函数，但大多数研究集中在发达地区。对发展中地区，特别是低收入家庭的研究则少得多，这些家庭更容易受到气候变化的影响，并且在电力需求方面具有显著潜力。本文利用来自中国贫困地区新县的高频家庭级电表数据，研究家庭电力消费如何响应温度变化。我们发现响应曲线呈U形，与发达地区观察到的模式相似，但明显更为平缓，表明发展中地区家庭对气候变化的敏感性较弱。考虑到关键差异可能源于收入约束和城市化水平，我们进行了机制分析，并将我们的结果与浙江省（中国最发达地区之一）的数据进行比较。我们的分析揭示，在新县，收入主要通过限制空调和供暖设备的使用来影响温度响应性。尽管更好的城市基础设施部分解释了城乡温度响应差距，但需求侧约束似乎起着更主导的作用。这些发现强调了将区域和社会经济异质性纳入气候与能源政策设计的重要性。

records.title_en: Population aging and China's energy transition: Industrial reallocation and upgrading
records.title_cn: 人口老龄化与中国能源转型：产业再配置与升级
records.abstract_en: Population aging is associated with slower improvement in the energy consumption transition (TRE, measured as the clean-energy share of final consumption), operating mainly through weaker industrial reallocation efficiency (IRE) and more limited, regionally heterogeneous industrial upgrading (ISU). To investigate these dynamics, we apply a spatial econometric panel approach to provincial-level data in China from 2005 to 2021. Our analysis demonstrates that demographic shifts hinder the energy transition by amplifying aggregate reallocation frictions and widening the mismatch between sectoral output and employment shares. Furthermore, population aging in neighboring regions creates significant spatial spillovers that impede the local clean-energy transition. Policymakers should therefore integrate demographic trends into long-term energy planning. Overcoming these constraints requires targeted support for labor mobility and technological upgrading, alongside robust cross-regional policy coordination.
records.abstract_cn: 人口老龄化与能源消费转型（TRE，以最终消费中清洁能源占比衡量）改善速度放缓相关，主要通过削弱产业再配置效率（IRE）以及更有限且区域异质的产业升级（ISU）发挥作用。为探究这些动态，我们采用空间计量面板方法，基于中国2005年至2021年的省级数据进行分析。我们的分析表明，人口结构变化通过加剧总体再配置摩擦并扩大部门产出与就业份额之间的错配，阻碍了能源转型。此外，邻近地区的人口老龄化产生了显著的空间溢出效应，抑制了本地清洁能源转型。因此，政策制定者应将人口趋势纳入长期能源规划。克服这些制约因素需要针对劳动力流动和技术升级提供定向支持，并辅以强有力的跨区域政策协调。

records.title_en: How economic and policy uncertainty shapes the stringency of climate change policies
records.title_cn: 经济与政策不确定性如何影响气候变化政策的严格程度
records.abstract_en: This paper examines the impact of uncertainty on the stringency of climate change policies using data for 37 advanced and emerging economies over the period 1990–2020. We find that higher uncertainty is significantly associated with greater stringency in market-based climate change policies, such as carbon taxes and emissions trading schemes, while non-market-based and technology-support policies show no statistically significant effects. These results suggest that uncertainty particularly influences policy areas that are politically costly and involve stronger distributive implications. The relationship remains robust across multiple sensitivity tests, including an instrumental variable approach, and is stronger in fully democratic countries and where governments are politically weak, but diminishes during economic downturns. We theoretically and empirically link our results to the literature analyzing the impact of uncertainty on the implementation of structural reforms, according to which periods of high uncertainty reduce the capacity of voters to attribute short-run economic costs to policy decisions.
records.abstract_cn: 本文利用1990-2020年间37个发达经济体和新兴经济体的数据，考察了不确定性对气候变化政策严格程度的影响。我们发现，较高的不确定性与市场型气候变化政策（如碳税和排放交易计划）的更大严格程度显著相关，而非市场型和技术支持政策则没有显示出统计上显著的影响。这些结果表明，不确定性尤其影响那些政治成本高昂且涉及更强分配效应的政策领域。这一关系在多项敏感性测试中保持稳健，包括工具变量方法，并且在完全民主国家和政府政治弱势的国家中更为显著，但在经济衰退期间减弱。我们从理论和实证上将我们的结果与关于不确定性对结构性改革实施影响的研究文献联系起来，根据该文献，高不确定性时期降低了选民将短期经济成本归因于政策决策的能力。

records.title_en: The propagation of ESG practices through multinational corporations
records.title_cn: 跨国公司ESG实践的传播
records.abstract_en: Multinational firms are increasingly required to comply with evolving environmental, social, and governance (ESG) regulations in their host countries, raising the question of whether such regulations shape corporate behavior in firms' home countries. Using data on Chinese multinational firms from 2015 to 2020 and hand-collected information on cross-country changes in mandatory ESG regulations, this study examines cross-border spillovers of ESG regulation propagated through multinational networks. The results indicate that firms with subsidiaries in countries that adopt more stringent ESG regulations subsequently increase domestic R&D expenditure, generate more green innovation, and receive higher ESG ratings. These effects are more pronounced when exposure is concentrated in financially developed host countries and among firms subject to greater institutional investor monitoring, consistent with financial-market discipline as the underlying mechanism. Further evidence indicates local spillovers in ESG-related outcomes: cities with greater exposure to multinationals affected by foreign ESG regulation experience larger declines in air pollution. Overall, the findings suggest that ESG regulations can propagate across borders via multinational networks, with important implications for emerging markets seeking to strengthen ESG practices.
records.abstract_cn: 跨国公司日益需要遵守东道国不断演变的环境、社会和治理（ESG）法规，这引发了一个问题：此类法规是否会影响企业母国的企业行为。利用2015年至2020年中国跨国公司的数据以及手工收集的跨国强制性ESG法规变化信息，本研究考察了通过跨国网络传播的ESG法规的跨境溢出效应。结果表明，在采用更严格ESG法规的国家设有子公司的企业，随后增加了国内研发支出，产生了更多绿色创新，并获得了更高的ESG评级。当风险敞口集中在金融发达的东道国以及受到更多机构投资者监督的企业中时，这些效应更为显著，这与金融市场纪律作为潜在机制相一致。进一步的证据表明，ESG相关结果存在本地溢出效应：受外国ESG法规影响的跨国公司敞口较大的城市，空气污染下降幅度更大。总体而言，研究结果表明，ESG法规可以通过跨国网络跨境传播，这对寻求加强ESG实践的新兴市场具有重要意义。

records.title_en: Empowering women to brighten health: Unlocking the energy-gender-health nexus through machine learning in Sub-Saharan Africa
records.title_cn: 赋权女性以照亮健康：通过机器学习解锁撒哈拉以南非洲的能源-性别-健康纽带
records.abstract_en: Sustainably access to energy, combined with social development, involves indivisible interactions. This necessitates a contemporary yet rarely attained understanding of the interplay among three United Nation's Sustainable Development Goals (SDGs): clean energy (SDG7), gender equality (SDG5), and good health (SDG3), particularly in the least developed regions—Sub-Saharan Africa. Leveraging large-scale household survey dataset from over 44,000 households across 16 countries, we apply various econometric models and machine learning algorithms to systematically and robustly explore the complex interactions among energy poverty, gender equality, and women's health. By establishing the Multidimensional Energy Poverty Index (MEPI) and the Women's Empowerment Index (WEI), we reveal a leading role of gender equality in improving health outcomes impaired by energy poverty, with the light gradient boosting machine (lightGBM) model demonstrating the highest accuracy rate. Notably, our findings indicate that coordinated efforts towards SDG7 and SDG5 significantly advance SDG3. Furthermore, we provide three-dimensional visualizations fitted through the random forest (RF) model to transparency the nexus. Finally, we assess synergies among the three SDGs using the coupling coordination degree model, with results remaining robust, revealing a relatively high synergistic grade among them. These findings call for coherent, gender-responsive policies that prioritize efficient resource allocation to women, unlocking simultaneous energy-gender-health gains, thereby accelerating Africa's broader SDGs through a just energy transition.
records.abstract_cn: 可持续的能源获取与社会发展相结合，涉及不可分割的相互作用。这需要当代但鲜有达成的对联合国三个可持续发展目标（SDGs）之间相互作用的理解：清洁能源（SDG7）、性别平等（SDG5）和良好健康（SDG3），特别是在最不发达地区——撒哈拉以南非洲。利用来自16个国家超过44,000户家庭的大规模住户调查数据集，我们应用各种计量经济学模型和机器学习算法，系统且稳健地探索能源贫困、性别平等和女性健康之间的复杂相互作用。通过建立多维能源贫困指数（MEPI）和女性赋权指数（WEI），我们揭示了性别平等在改善因能源贫困而受损的健康结果中的主导作用，其中轻梯度提升机（lightGBM）模型显示出最高的准确率。值得注意的是，我们的研究结果表明，针对SDG7和SDG5的协调努力显著推进了SDG3。此外，我们提供了通过随机森林（RF）模型拟合的三维可视化，以透明化这一纽带。最后，我们使用耦合协调度模型评估三个SDG之间的协同作用，结果保持稳健，显示它们之间存在相对较高的协同等级。这些发现呼吁采取连贯的、性别响应的政策，优先向女性高效分配资源，解锁能源-性别-健康的同步增益，从而通过公正的能源转型加速非洲更广泛的SDGs。

records.title_en: Do sustainability-linked bonds reward greater sustainability by design?
records.title_cn: 可持续发展挂钩债券是否在设计上奖励更强的可持续性？
records.abstract_en: Sustainability-linked bonds (SLBs) are a new financial instrument designed to create incentives for sustainable behavior on the part of the issuing companies or institutions. SLBs feature increased coupon payments if key performance indicators do not reach sustainability performance targets. In a standard pricing framework, we find that fair issue yields of SLBs, and hence their financing costs, are non-monotonic in the planned sustainability performance and the ambition of the sustainability targets. As a result, issuers that commit themselves to greater sustainability are not always rewarded through a lower issue yield, and increasing the ambition of the sustainability target has ambiguous effects. The rewards that the SLB offers over its lifetime through a reduction of penalty payments are also non-monotonic. They tend to go to zero if the target is made very ambitious.
records.abstract_cn: 可持续发展挂钩债券（SLBs）是一种新型金融工具，旨在激励发行公司或机构采取可持续行为。SLBs的特点是，如果关键绩效指标未达到可持续发展绩效目标，则票息支付会增加。在标准定价框架下，我们发现SLBs的公平发行收益率，及其融资成本，在计划中的可持续绩效和可持续发展目标的雄心程度上是非单调的。因此，承诺更高可持续性的发行者并不总是通过较低的发行收益率获得奖励，而提高可持续发展目标的雄心程度则具有模糊效应。SLBs在其存续期内通过减少罚金支付所提供的奖励也是非单调的。如果目标设定得非常雄心勃勃，这些奖励往往趋于零。

records.title_en: Street green space and electricity demand: Evidence from metered consumption data
records.title_cn: 街道绿地与电力需求：来自计量消费数据的证据
records.abstract_en: Growing climate change impacts call for increased efforts to adapt and to reduce its adverse consequences on society. Adaptation responses can themselves be a source of climate risk, generating negative environmental externalities while entailing budgetary costs for both governments and private citizens. A key example is the private use of air-conditioning for indoor air temperature regulation in the face of rising urban heat. In this paper, we empirically evaluate the impact of street green spaces (SGS) on residential electricity demand through their urban temperature regulation effect. We exploit a monthly panel of household metered electricity demand data from 129,524 households located in 2181 municipalities distributed across Italy, in the period between 2020 and 2022. We find evidence of a significant non-linear mediating role of SGS on the impact of temperature on household electricity demand. The most salient effect is a reduction in electricity consumption when hot temperatures occur — lowering monthly average electricity consumption by up to 11%–25% (for monthly maximum temperatures of 30 and 35°C, respectively). The observed moderating effects of SGS are heterogeneous across municipalities, as they depend on contextual factors such as the degree of urbanization, baseline heat and SGS levels, and average income level. To dissipate across-municipality sorting concerns, we conduct propensity score weighting on a range of potentially confounding observables, and find our results remain consistent. We estimate that a policy increasing the average Green View Index (GVI) level across all municipalities to a value comparable to the median of the current distribution would reduce the growth in residential electricity consumption driven by climate change by more than two thirds (under Representative Concentration Pathway 8.5 climate conditions around 2050). This corresponds to a gross national-level private saving in energy bills of €150 million yearly in 2050. This is a noticeable benefit that represents about 7.3% of our estimated costs to implement such policy, and informs on a potentially substantial social and economic benefit of urban green spaces. Our results provide new quantitative evidence of the role of street green spaces for both energy demand reduction, and therefore climate change mitigation, and in terms of outdoor temperature reduction, supporting climate change adaptation.
records.abstract_cn: 日益加剧的气候变化影响要求加大努力以适应并减少其对社会的不利后果。适应措施本身可能成为气候风险的来源，产生负面的环境外部性，同时给政府和私人公民带来预算成本。一个关键例子是，面对城市热岛加剧，私人使用空调调节室内空气温度。在本文中，我们通过街道绿地（SGS）的城市温度调节效应，实证评估其对居民电力需求的影响。我们利用了129524年至2181年间，分布在意大利2020个市镇的2022户家庭月度计量电力需求数据的面板数据。我们发现，SGS对温度影响家庭电力需求具有显著的非线性中介作用。最显著的效果是在高温发生时减少电力消耗——将月平均电力消耗降低高达11%至25%（分别对应月最高温度为30°C和35°C时）。观察到的SGS调节效应在不同市镇间存在异质性，因为它们取决于城市化程度、基线热量和SGS水平以及平均收入水平等背景因素。为消除跨市镇排序的担忧，我们对一系列可能混淆的可观测变量进行了倾向得分加权，发现结果保持一致。我们估计，将所有市镇的平均绿色视野指数（GVI）水平提高到当前分布中位数相当值的政策，将使气候变化驱动的居民电力消耗增长减少超过三分之二（在代表性浓度路径8.5的气候条件下，约在2050年）。这对应于150年国家层面每年能源账单私人节省总额为2050亿欧元。这是一个显著的效益，约占我们估计实施此类政策成本的7.3%，并揭示了城市绿地的潜在巨大社会经济效益。我们的结果为街道绿地在减少能源需求（从而减缓气候变化）以及降低室外温度（支持气候变化适应）方面的作用提供了新的定量证据。

records.title_en: Dynamics production strategies of duopoly heterogeneous automakers in the context of energy transition: A bounded rationality perspective
records.title_cn: 能源转型背景下双寡头异质汽车制造商的动态生产策略：有限理性视角
records.abstract_en: China's dual-credit policy is reshaping competition between new energy vehicle (NEV) and fuel vehicle (FV) manufacturers, raising a practical question: how can firms adjust production and fuel-saving choices without destabilizing the market? We develop a long-term repeated game model with boundedly rational firms to study joint adjustments in NEV output, FV output, and FV fuel-saving effort under dual-credit compliance. Calibrated with Chinese market parameters, the model shows that the speed of firms' adjustments is pivotal: gradual updates keep quantities and profits stable, whereas aggressive updates generate dynamically unstable cycles that amplify credit price shocks. The results indicate that faster fuel-saving adjustments tend to reduce an FV maker's own profits while benefiting its NEV rival; reducing the FV fuel-saving cost coefficient increases FV output and profits while lowering total emissions. Policy implications are twofold. First, regulators can enhance market stability, thereby facilitating NEV adoption, by progressively tightening target stringency, imposing caps on credit-price volatility, and promoting disclosure to reduce informational noise. Second, firms should implement stepwise adjustment rules rather than one-shot changes when responding to credit targets. Together, these practices support a more orderly transition toward low-carbon mobility.
records.abstract_cn: 中国的双积分政策正在重塑新能源汽车（NEV）和燃油车（FV）制造商之间的竞争，引发了一个现实问题：企业如何在不让市场失稳的情况下调整生产和节油选择？我们构建了一个包含有限理性企业的长期重复博弈模型，研究在双积分合规约束下，新能源汽车产量、燃油车产量和燃油车节油努力的联合调整。利用中国市场参数进行校准后，模型显示企业调整速度至关重要：渐进式更新保持产量和利润稳定，而激进式更新则产生动态不稳定的周期，放大积分价格冲击。结果表明，更快的节油调整往往降低燃油车制造商自身的利润，同时惠及其新能源汽车竞争对手；降低燃油车节油成本系数会增加燃油车产量和利润，同时降低总排放。政策启示有两点。第一，监管机构可以通过逐步收紧目标严格度、对积分价格波动设置上限以及促进信息披露以减少信息噪声，来增强市场稳定性，从而促进新能源汽车的普及。第二，企业在响应积分目标时应采用逐步调整规则，而非一次性变更。这些做法共同支持向低碳出行更有序的转型。

records.title_en: Carbon risk and corporate creditworthiness: Evidence from a major emerging economy
records.title_cn: 碳风险与企业信用状况：来自主要新兴经济体的证据
records.abstract_en: We examine the relationship between climate-related transition risk and the creditworthiness of non-financial Indian firms. We find that higher emissions are associated with significantly higher market-implied probabilities of default (PD), and that this association becomes stronger after the Paris Agreement. Firms misaligned with Paris-consistent decarbonization pathways and those with greater exposure to prospective carbon pricing exhibit elevated credit risk. The magnitude of the association varies with firm characteristics: stronger financial positions, robust ESG practices, and higher investment capacity attenuate the positive association between emissions and PD. Reputational exposure and the cost of equity emerge as significant channels linking emissions to default risk, whereas no meaningful effect is detected through the cost of debt. These results highlight the growing importance of transition risk in emerging markets and highlight mechanisms through which investors incorporate firm-level environmental exposure into credit risk assessments.
records.abstract_cn: 我们研究了气候相关转型风险与印度非金融企业信用状况之间的关系。我们发现，较高的排放量与显著更高的市场隐含违约概率（PD）相关，且这种关联在《巴黎协定》之后变得更强。与巴黎协定一致的脱碳路径不一致的企业以及面临未来碳定价风险更大的企业表现出更高的信用风险。这种关联的强度随企业特征而变化：更强的财务状况、稳健的ESG实践和更高的投资能力减弱了排放量与PD之间的正相关关系。声誉风险和股权成本成为连接排放与违约风险的重要渠道，而通过债务成本未检测到显著效应。这些结果突显了转型风险在新兴市场中日益增长的重要性，并揭示了投资者将企业层面环境暴露纳入信用风险评估的机制。

records.title_en: Nonrenewable resources, endogenous reserves and environmental policy
records.title_cn: 不可再生资源、内生储量与环境政策
records.abstract_en: This study develops a model for nonrenewable resource exploration and extraction containing all the relevant stages of operation from exploration to site reclamation, and uses the model for two purposes: to analyse the optimal exploration, development, and extraction decisions of a mining firm, and to design optimal environmental and biodiversity policies. The main novelty is the endogenization of reserves through the discovery process. The private solution is characterized, including conditions under which exploration and mine development are not performed. Then, the planner’s problem is analysed and compared with the private solution, and the optimal policy is derived. It is shown among other things that the discoveries must be richer in the social optimum than in the private optimum for it to be optimal to build a mine. In addition, corrective taxes have an informational advantage compared to the much used standards in that the regulator need not be informed of the reserve level.
