We obtain closed-form solutions using Laplace approximations and apply our techniques to a controlled numerical experiment and cross-country growth regressions. Our results show that, under fine tuning of the hyperparameters, the proposed approach has similar performance to the conjugate alternatives on synthetic datasets, whereas in real data it favors, on average, more parsimonious models than the conjugate alternatives and also exhibits superior predictive performance.
records.abstract_cn: 本文考虑了贝叶斯模型平均（BMA）中非共轭先验分布的情况。尽管自然共轭设置是BMA的默认选择，主要是出于分析可处理性的考虑，但由于其对先验信息的不切实际假设等原因，受到了相当大的批评。在本研究中，我们通过考虑多元Student-t分布的二特例来扩展文献。我们使用拉普拉斯近似法获得闭式解，并将我们的技术应用于受控数值实验和跨国增长回归。我们的结果表明，在超参数的精细调整下，所提出的方法在合成数据集上的表现与共轭替代方案相似，而在真实数据中，它平均更倾向于比共轭替代方案更简约的模型，并且还表现出更优越的预测性能。

records.title_en: Bayesian methods in economics and finance: A unified survey and taxonomy
records.title_cn: 经济与金融中的贝叶斯方法：统一综述与分类
records.abstract_en: This special issue brings together 21 papers that reflect the expanding scope and methodological evolution of Bayesian econometrics. We introduce a new organizing taxonomy that distinguishes between Traditional Bayesian Approaches - rooted in conjugate priors, standard likelihood-based estimation, and established Markov Chain Monte Carlo (MCMC) techniques - and Contemporary Bayesian Frontiers, characterized by nonparametric methods, variational inference, high-dimensional shrinkage, and integration with machine learning. We further classify contributions across two broad domains covering applications in Economics (focusing on macroeconomics, microeconomics, and climate econometrics) and Finance (focusing on asset pricing, volatility, and bank business models). Across these fields, four cross-cutting themes emerge: (1) high-dimensionality, volatility, and time-varying dynamics; (2) structural identification and model uncertainty; (3) semiparametric and nonparametric flexibility; and (4) data quality, granularity, and novel data structures. This survey synthesizes the methodological and empirical contributions of the special issue, proposes a unifying framework for organizing recent advances in Bayesian econometrics, and identifies unresolved challenges and promising directions for future research.
records.abstract_cn: 本期特刊汇集了21篇论文，反映了贝叶斯计量经济学不断扩大的范围和方法论的演变。我们提出了一个新的组织分类法，将传统贝叶斯方法（基于共轭先验、标准似然估计和已建立的马尔可夫链蒙特卡洛（MCMC）技术）与当代贝叶斯前沿（以非参数方法、变分推断、高维收缩和与机器学习的整合为特征）区分开来。我们进一步将贡献分为两大领域，涵盖经济学（侧重宏观经济学、微观经济学和气候计量经济学）和金融学（侧重资产定价、波动性和银行业务模型）的应用。在这些领域中，出现了四个跨领域的主题：（1）高维度、波动性和时变动态；（2）结构识别和模型不确定性；（3）半参数和非参数灵活性；（4）数据质量、粒度和新型数据结构。本综述综合了特刊的方法论和实证贡献，提出了一个统一的框架来组织贝叶斯计量经济学的最新进展，并确定了未解决的挑战和未来研究的有希望的方向。

records.title_en: Stochastic volatility in mean: Efficient analysis by a generalized mixture sampler
records.title_cn: 均值中的随机波动性：通过广义混合采样器的高效分析
records.abstract_en: In this paper we consider the simulation-based Bayesian analysis of stochastic volatility in mean (SVM) models. Extending the highly efficient Markov chain Monte Carlo mixture sampler for the SV model proposed in Kim et al. (1998) and Omori et al. (2007), we develop an accurate approximation of the logarithm of the non-central chi-squared distribution as a mixture of thirty normal distributions. Under this mixture representation, we sample the parameters and latent volatilities in one block. We also detail a correction of the small approximation error by using additional Metropolis–Hastings steps. The proposed method is extended to the SVM model with leverage. The methodology and models are applied to excess holding yields and S&P500 returns in empirical studies, and the SVM models are shown to outperform other volatility models based on marginal likelihoods.
records.abstract_cn: 本文考虑了基于模拟的随机波动性在均值（SVM）模型的贝叶斯分析。扩展了Kim等人（1998）和Omori等人（2007）提出的SV模型的高效马尔可夫链蒙特卡洛混合采样器，我们开发了非中心卡方分布对数的准确近似，作为三十个正态分布的混合。在这种混合表示下，我们在一块中对参数和潜在波动性进行采样。我们还详细说明了通过使用额外的Metropolis-Hastings步骤来修正小的近似误差。所提出的方法扩展到具有杠杆效应的SVM模型。该方法和模型应用于超额持有收益和S&P500回报的实证研究，结果表明SVM模型在边际似然性方面优于其他波动性模型。

records.title_en: A dynamic state-space HAR model
records.title_cn: 动态状态空间HAR模型
records.abstract_en: The Heterogeneous AutoRegressive model for the logs of Realised Volatility (HARL) has established itself as the benchmark specification for modelling and forecasting return volatility, owing to its parsimony and ability to capture the strong persistence typically observed in RV. To address potential concerns such as measurement errors, nonlinearities, and non-spherical residuals, numerous variants of the baseline HARL model have been developed in the literature. This paper contributes to this body of work by proposing a new class of dynamic state-space models with time-varying parameters. The parameter dynamics are assumed to follow an autoregressive process, with or without stochastic volatility, giving rise to two specifications: SHARP and SHARP-SV. Both models are designed to capture the evolving nature of return volatility and are estimated via Bayesian inference using Particle Gibbs sampling. Empirical applications to high-frequency data on SPY, sector ETFs, representative NYSE stocks, and the VIX index demonstrate that our proposed models on average outperform alternative HARL-based specifications in forecasting volatility, particularly at medium- and long-term horizons. An extensive Monte Carlo analysis further illustrates the advantages of our approach in terms of both estimation accuracy and predictive performance.
records.abstract_cn: 异质自回归模型（HARL）已成为建模和预测收益波动的基准规范，因其简洁性和捕捉到的收益波动中通常观察到的强持久性。为了解决潜在的测量误差、非线性和非球形残差等问题，文献中开发了许多基线HARL模型的变体。本文通过提出一类具有时间变参数的动态状态空间模型，为这一研究领域做出了贡献。参数动态假设遵循自回归过程，可能带有或不带有随机波动，从而产生二规范：SHARP和SHARP-SV。这两种模型旨在捕捉收益波动的演变特性，并通过使用粒子吉布斯采样的贝叶斯推断进行估计。对SPY、高频数据、行业ETF、代表性NYSE股票和VIX指数的实证应用表明，我们提出的模型在预测波动性方面平均优于替代的基于HARL的规范，特别是在中长期视野下。广泛的蒙特卡洛分析进一步说明了我们的方法在估计准确性和预测性能方面的优势。

records.title_en: Testing for differences in high-frequency network connectedness from variance decompositions
records.title_cn: 基于方差分解的高频网络连接性差异检验
records.abstract_en: We develop a Bayesian Wald-type test for detecting temporal differences in connectedness from variance decompositions, and establish the asymptotic normality of impulse response functions and variance decomposition matrices at fixed local time points. The resulting test statistic is asymptotically χ2 distributed under the null hypothesis and performs well in Monte Carlo simulations. Applying our methodology to high-frequency options data on sectoral exchange-traded funds (ETFs) from January 2013 to June 2023, we identify and quantify monetary policy surprises following Federal Open Market Committee (FOMC) announcements. Our empirical results indicate that total connectedness among sectoral ETF implied volatilities increases significantly following FOMC announcements, with these elevated connectedness levels persisting for approximately one hour on days with monetary policy surprises. Our findings indicate more than one-fifth of FOMC announcements surprise financial markets.
records.abstract_cn: 我们开发了一种贝叶斯 Wald 类型检验，用于检测方差分解中的时间差异连接性，并建立了在固定的局部时间点上冲击响应函数和方差分解矩阵的渐近正态性。结果的检验统计量在零假设下渐近服从 χ2 分布，并在蒙特卡罗模拟中表现良好。将我们的方法应用于从 2013 年 一月到 2023 年 六月的高频期权数据，涉及部门交易所交易基金（ETF），我们识别并量化联邦公开市场委员会（FOMC）公告后的货币政策惊喜。我们的实证结果表明，FOMC 公告后部门 ETF 暗示波动率之间的总连接性显著增加，这些提高的连接性水平在货币政策惊喜的日子里持续约一小时。我们的发现表明，超过五分之一的 FOMC 公告对金融市场来说是惊喜。

records.title_en: Unconventional monetary policy spillovers and the (in)convenience of Treasuries
records.title_cn: 非常规货币政策溢出效应与国债的（不）便利性
records.abstract_en: Foreign monetary policy shocks increasingly influence U.S. yields, particularly since the Global Financial Crisis. We show that this heightened sensitivity reflects both the adoption of unconventional monetary policy tools and a decline in the convenience of Treasuries. Using high frequency identification, we find that when Treasuries command a low convenience premium — behaving more like other assets — they respond more to ECB monetary policy, consistent with increased sensitivity to portfolio rebalancing. A two-country preferred-habitat model with time-varying covariance of yields rationalizes these results: when Treasuries are less convenient, they become closer substitutes for foreign equivalents, amplifying cross-border transmission of policy shocks.
records.abstract_cn: 外国货币政策冲击对美国收益率的影响日益增强，尤其是在全球金融危机之后。我们表明，这种敏感性的增强既反映了非常规货币政策工具的采用，也反映了国债便利性的下降。利用高频识别方法，我们发现当国债的便利溢价较低——表现得更像其他资产时——它们对欧洲央行货币政策的反应更大，这与对投资组合再平衡的敏感性增强相一致。一个具有时变收益率协方差的两国偏好栖息地模型解释了这些结果：当国债的便利性降低时，它们与外国同类资产的替代性增强，从而放大了政策冲击的跨境传导。

records.title_en: Payment data, information disclosure, and privacy
records.title_cn: 支付数据、信息披露和隐私
records.abstract_en: This paper develops a general equilibrium framework to examine the welfare implications of aggregate-demand information derived from payment data. The disclosure of such information tends to improve aggregate welfare when interest rates are low but may reduce welfare when rates are high. If a central bank controls information disclosure, it can craft noisy messages that encourage investment and benefit welfare through a form of Bayesian persuasion. If the information is instead produced by private banks and traded in a competitive market, excessive information production may happen. Finally, privacy concerns may dissuade some consumers from using digital payments, thereby decreasing the precision of aggregate-demand information, but it need not reduce welfare.
records.abstract_cn: 本文开发了一个一般均衡框架来研究从支付数据中得出的总需求信息对福利的影响。当利率较低时，此类信息的披露往往会改善总体福利，但当利率较高时，可能会减少福利。如果央行控制信息披露，它就可以通过贝叶斯说服的形式制造噪音信息，鼓励投资并有利于福利。如果信息由私人银行生产并在竞争性市场上交易，则可能会出现信息过度生产的情况。最后，隐私问题可能会阻止一些消费者使用数字支付，从而降低总需求信息的准确性，但这不一定会减少福利。

records.title_en: Disincentive effects of unemployment insurance benefits
records.title_cn: 失业保险金的抑制效应
records.abstract_en: Unemployment insurance (UI) acts both as a disincentive for labor supply and as a demand stimulus, which may explain why empirical studies often find limited effects of UI on employment. This paper provides independent estimates of the disincentive effects arising from the largest expansion of UI in U.S. history, the pandemic unemployment benefits. Using high-frequency data for a representative sample of restaurants and retailers, we control for demand effects by comparing neighboring businesses that largely share the positive impact of UI stimulus. We find that employment in low-wage businesses recovered more slowly than employment in neighboring high-wage businesses in labor markets with larger differences in the relative generosity of pandemic UI benefits. According to a labor search model that replicates the estimated employment differences between low- and high-wage businesses, the disincentive effects from the pandemic UI programs held back the aggregate employment recovery by 3.4 percentage points, which represents around 20 percent of the overall employment loss in the Leisure and Hospitality sector between April and December 2020.
records.abstract_cn: 失业保险（UI）既作为劳动力供给的抑制因素，也作为需求刺激因素，这可能解释了为何实证研究常常发现UI对就业的影响有限。本文针对美国历史上最大规模的UI扩张——疫情失业补助，提供了抑制效应的独立估计。利用餐馆和零售商的代表性样本的高频数据，我们通过比较邻近企业来控制需求效应，这些企业大体上共享UI刺激的正面影响。我们发现，在疫情UI补助相对慷慨程度差异较大的劳动力市场中，低工资企业的就业恢复速度慢于邻近的高工资企业。根据一个复制低工资与高工资企业间估计就业差异的劳动搜索模型，疫情UI项目的抑制效应使总体就业恢复滞后了3.4个百分点，这大约占四月至十二月2020年间休闲与酒店业整体就业损失的20%。

records.title_en: Central bank communication by ??? The economics of monetary policy leaks
records.title_cn: 中央银行沟通之谜？货币政策泄露的经济学
records.abstract_en: Using a novel database of media-reported anonymous leaks about monetary policy in the euro area, we conduct the first systematic empirical analysis of these confidential information disclosures originating from central banks. Our database reveals that Eurosystem leaks are frequent — in particular relative to leaks from other major central banks. We provide evidence that many Eurosystem leaks are likely not accidents, but placed strategically by insiders. Exploiting high-frequency financial market reactions to leaks, we find that they have large effects on markets relative to standard monetary surprises, often exceeding the impact of attributed statements by policy-makers. Yet, mainly reflecting minority opinions, leaks do not usually lock in decision-making. Post-meeting leaks regularly reveal information about dissent on the committee, changing market perceptions about the strength of the policy signal. Post-meeting leaks thereby reverse some of the initial market effect of official policy announcements.
records.abstract_cn: 利用一个关于欧元区货币政策媒体匿名泄露的新数据库，我们首次对这些源自中央银行的机密信息披露进行了系统的实证分析。我们的数据库显示，欧元体系的泄露事件频繁——尤其是相对于其他主要中央银行的泄露而言。我们提供的证据表明，许多欧元体系的泄露可能并非偶然，而是内部人士策略性安排的。利用高频金融市场对泄露的反应，我们发现相对于标准的货币政策意外，泄露对市场产生了显著影响，往往超过政策制定者署名声明的冲击。然而，主要反映少数意见的泄露通常不会锁定决策。会后泄露经常揭示委员会内部的异议信息，改变市场对政策信号强度的看法。因此，会后泄露部分逆转了官方政策公告的初始市场效应。

records.title_en: Evaluating macroeconomic outcomes under asymmetries: Expectations matter
records.title_cn: 评估不对称情况下的宏观经济结果：预期很重要
records.abstract_en: Asymmetries play an important role in many macroeconomic models. We show that assumptions on household and firm expectations play a key role in determining the effects of these asymmetries on macroeconomic outcomes. If households and firms have perfect foresight and hence do not account for the possibility of future shocks, then the implied longer-run averages and distributions can differ significantly from their rational expectations counterparts. We first derive this result analytically in a standard New Keynesian environment under either an asymmetric monetary policy rule or a nonlinear Phillips curve before numerically examining some of the key nonlinearities featured in the recent literature.
records.abstract_cn: 不对称性在许多宏观经济模型中发挥着重要作用。我们表明，对家庭和企业预期的假设在确定这些不对称性对宏观经济结果的影响方面发挥着关键作用。如果家庭和企业具有完美的远见，因此没有考虑未来冲击的可能性，那么隐含的长期平均值和分布可能与其理性预期有很大不同。我们第一在标准新凯恩斯主义环境下，在不对称货币政策规则或非线性菲利普斯曲线下分析得出这一结果，然后对最近文献中的一些关键非线性进行数值研究。

records.title_en: Geography versus income: The heterogeneous effects of carbon taxation
records.title_cn: 地理与收入：碳税的异质效应
records.abstract_en: The distributive effects of carbon taxation are critical for its political acceptability and depend on both income and geographic factors. Using French administrative data, household surveys, and matched employer–employee records, we document that rural households spend 2.8 times more on fossil fuels than urban households and work in firms that emit 2.7 times more greenhouse gases. We incorporate these facts into a spatial heterogeneous-agent model with migration, housing and wealth accumulation, bridging spatial and macroeconomic approaches. Carbon taxes generate 56% larger welfare losses for rural households than for urban households, as the former may be trapped due to mobility frictions and homeownership. While uniform or income-based rebates reduce inequality along the income dimension, they leave large spatial disparities that must be offset through location-based transfers. These results suggest that carbon policies should account for spatial differences to improve political feasibility.
records.abstract_cn: 碳税的分配效应对其政治可接受性至关重要，并且取决于收入和地理因素。使用法国行政数据、家庭调查和匹配的雇主-雇员记录，我们记录了农村家庭在化石燃料上的支出是城市家庭的 2.8 倍，并且在排放温室气体的公司中工作的2.7 倍。我们将这些事实纳入一个具有移民、住房和财富积累的空间异质主体模型，连接空间和宏观经济方法。碳税给农村家庭带来的福利损失56%比城市家庭更大，因为前者可能因流动性摩擦和住房所有权而陷入困境。虽然统一或基于收入的回扣减少了收入方面的不平等，但它们留下了巨大的空间差距，必须通过基于地点的转移来抵消。这些结果表明，碳政策应考虑空间差异，以提高政治可行性。

records.title_en: Wasserstein worst-case scenarios and asset pricing
records.title_cn: 瓦瑟斯坦最坏情况和资产定价
records.abstract_en: We develop a framework for decision-making under model uncertainty, grounded in Wasserstein distributionally robust optimization. In contrast to standard Kullback–Leibler approaches constrained by absolute continuity, Wasserstein ambiguity sets constructed via optimal transport permit the adversary to physically relocate probability mass to new states, capturing economically relevant support-shifting distortions—structural breaks, regime shifts, and catastrophic tail events—that the reference model excludes entirely. We integrate these state-shift distortions into both static and recursive dynamic decision problems, where agents optimize against the worst-case distribution within a transport budget. A data-driven bootstrap calibration procedure disciplines the degree of robustness by linking the ambiguity radius to statistical confidence sets. Applying the framework to asset pricing, we show that endogenous belief distortions amplify perceived variance, inducing precautionary savings that lower the risk-free rate and widen the equity premium. The geometric uncertainty propagates through persistent state dynamics, generating endogenous stochastic volatility akin to long-run risk. The resulting pricing kernel aligns with empirical Hansen–Jagannathan bounds without requiring implausibly high risk aversion or non-standard preferences.
records.abstract_cn: 我们开发了一个基于 Wasserstein 分布稳健优化的模型不确定性下的决策框架。与受绝对连续性限制的标准 Kullback-Leibler 方法相比，通过最优传输构建的 Wasserstein 模糊集允许对手将概率质量物理重新定位到新状态，捕获经济相关的支持转移扭曲（结构断裂、政权转变和灾难性尾部事件），而参考模型完全排除了这些扭曲。我们将这些状态转移扭曲整合到静态和递归动态决策问题中，其中代理针对运输预算内的最坏情况分配进行优化。数据驱动的引导校准程序通过将模糊半径与统计置信集联系起来来控制鲁棒性程度。将该框架应用于资产定价，我们发现内生信念扭曲会放大感知方差，引发预防性储蓄，从而降低无风险利率并扩大股权溢价。几何不确定性通过持续的状态动态传播，产生类似于长期风险的内生随机波动。由此产生的定价内核与经验汉森-贾甘纳森边界一致，不需要令人难以置信的高风险厌恶或非标准偏好。

records.title_en: Profits of Prejudiced Algorithms
records.title_cn: 偏见算法的利润
records.abstract_en: Firms are starting to replace humans with algorithms in important screening decisions, but there are potential spillovers of human biases contained in datasets to subsequent algorithmic predictions. When these biases are motivated by human prejudices, there are risks of algorithms perpetuating discrimination. I prove that when datasets are generated by a sufficiently discriminatory human, firms are more profitable when training discriminatory algorithms. If instead enough affirmative action is instituted in favor of a disadvantaged group, firms are more profitable when training algorithms that inflate scores for this group, but this effect diminishes with excess affirmative action.
records.abstract_cn: 公司开始在重要的筛选决策中用算法替代人类，但数据集中包含的人类偏见可能对后续的算法预测产生潜在的溢出效应。当这些偏见源于人类的偏见时，算法可能会延续歧视。我证明，当数据集是由一个足够歧视的人生成时，公司在训练歧视性算法时更有利可图。如果相反，针对弱势群体实施了足够的平权行动，公司在训练为该群体提高分数的算法时更有利可图，但这种效果在过度平权行动下会减弱。

records.title_en: When Is Discrimination Unfair?
records.title_cn: 何时歧视是不公平的？
records.abstract_en: We use a vignette-based survey experiment to elicit respondents’ assessments of the fairness of race-based hiring decisions and compare these assessments with the predictions of four preregistered ethical frameworks. While conservative respondents are much more accepting of discriminatory actions than others, respondents of all political leanings rate the relative fairness of different actions in a very similar way. A two-group framework in which one group (mostly self-described conservatives) values employers’ decision rights, the other has utilitarian concerns, and both groups use the same race-blind rules to assign relative fairness levels to actions explains our data well.
records.abstract_cn: 我们使用基于情境的调查实验来引导受访者评估基于种族的招聘决策的公平性，并将这些评估与四预注册伦理框架的预测进行比较。虽然保守派受访者对歧视性行为的接受程度远高于其他人，但所有政治倾向的受访者对不同行为的相对公平性评估非常相似。一个二群体框架，其中一群体（主要是自我描述为保守派的人）重视雇主的决策权，另一个则关注功利主义，两组都使用相同的无种族规则来为行为分配相对公平性水平，能够很好地解释我们的数据。

records.title_en: Gene-Environment Complementarity in Educational Attainment
records.title_cn: 教育成就中的基因-环境互补性
records.abstract_en: Firstborns, on average, complete more education than laterborns. We study whether individuals’ endowments measured by genetic information amplify this effect. Our family fixed effects approach exploits exogenous variation in birth order and genetic endowments among 14,850 siblings in the UK Biobank. We find that those with higher genetic endowments benefit disproportionately more from being firstborn compared with those with lower endowments—a clean example of how nature and nurture interact in producing human capital. Since parental investments are a dominant channel driving birth order effects, our results are consistent with complementarity between endowments and investments in human capital formation.
records.abstract_cn: 长子平均完成的教育比晚出生的孩子更多。我们研究个体的遗传信息所测量的禀赋是否会放大这一效应。我们的家庭固定效应方法利用了英国生物库中14,850兄弟姐妹的出生顺序和遗传禀赋的外生变异。我们发现，遗传禀赋较高的人相比于遗传禀赋较低的人，从长子身份中受益的程度更大——这是自然与养育在生产人力资本中相互作用的一个清晰例子。由于父母投资是驱动出生顺序效应的主要渠道，我们的结果与禀赋与人力资本形成投资之间的互补性是一致的。

records.title_en: Does Monitoring Change Teacher Pedagogy and Student Outcomes?
records.title_cn: 监控是否改变教师教学法和学生成果？
records.abstract_en: In theory, monitoring can improve employee motivation and effort, particularly in settings lacking measurable outputs, but research assessing monitoring as a motivator is limited to laboratory settings. To address this gap, I leverage exogenous variation in the presence and intensity of teacher monitoring, in the form of unannounced in-class observations as part of DC public schools’ IMPACT program. As monitoring intensifies, teachers use more individualized teaching and emphasize higher-level learning. When teachers are unmonitored, their students have lower test scores and increased suspensions. This evidence validates monitoring as a potential tool for enhancing teacher pedagogy and employee performance more broadly.
records.abstract_cn: 理论上，监控可以提高员工的积极性和努力程度，特别是在缺乏可测量输出的环境中，但评估监控作为激励因素的研究仅限于实验室环境。为了解决这一空白，我利用教师监控的存在和强度的外生变化，以华盛顿特区公立学校IMPACT项目中的未通知课堂观察为形式。随着监控的加强，教师采用更多个性化的教学，并强调更高层次的学习。当教师未被监控时，他们的学生测试成绩较低，停学率增加。这一证据验证了监控作为提升教师教学法和更广泛的员工绩效的潜在工具。

records.title_en: Instrumental Variables with Unordered Treatments: Theory and Evidence from Returns to Fields of Study
records.title_cn: 无序处理的工具变量：来自学习领域回报的理论与证据
records.abstract_en: We revisit the 2016 identification argument of Kirkeboen and colleagues, who showed how one may combine instruments for multiple unordered treatments with information about individuals’ ranking of these treatments to achieve identification while allowing for heterogeneity in treatment effects. We show that the key identifying assumptions have testable implications and provide a new characterization of the bias that may arise if these assumptions are violated. We estimate and compare the earnings payoffs to postsecondary fields of study in Norway and Denmark. We empirically examine whether and why the payoffs to fields of study differ across the two countries.
records.abstract_cn: 我们重新审视Kirkeboen及其同事的2016识别论证，他们展示了一如何结合多个无序处理的工具与个体对这些处理的排名信息，以实现识别，同时允许处理效应的异质性。我们表明，关键的识别假设具有可检验的含义，并提供了对这些假设被违反时可能出现的偏差的新表征。我们估计并比较挪威和丹麦的高等教育学习领域的收入回报。我们实证检验了学习领域的回报在二国家之间是否以及为何存在差异。

records.title_en: Customer Discrimination in the Workplace: Evidence from Online Sales
records.title_cn: 职场中的客户歧视：来自在线销售的证据
records.abstract_en: Many workers are evaluated on their ability to engage with customers. We measure the impact of gender-based customer discrimination on the productivity of online sales agents in sub-Saharan Africa. Using a novel framework that randomly varies the gender of names presented to customers without changing worker behavior, we find that the assignment of a female-sounding name leads to 50% fewer purchases. Customers also lag in responding, are less expressive, and avoid discussing purchases. We show similar results for customers around the world and across workers. Removing customer bias, we find that women would be more productive than their male coworkers.
records.abstract_cn: 许多员工的评估基于他们与客户的互动能力。我们测量了基于性别的客户歧视对撒哈拉以南非洲在线销售人员生产力的影响。使用一种新颖的框架，随机改变呈现给客户的名字的性别而不改变员工行为，我们发现分配一个女性化名字会导致 50% 较少的购买。客户的响应也滞后，表达不够丰富，并且避免讨论购买。我们在全球范围内和不同员工中显示了类似的结果。消除客户偏见后，我们发现女性的生产力会高于她们的男性同事。

records.title_en: Working Hours, Top Management Appointments, and Gender: Evidence from Linked Employer-Employee Data
records.title_cn: 工作时间、高层管理任命与性别：来自链接雇主-员工数据的证据
records.abstract_en: Using Danish registry data linked to the Labor Force Survey, we provide the first rigorous evidence with external validity on the hours-career nexus (positive association between hours and career success). Guided by three theories (human capital, rat race, tournament), we unpack the hours-career nexus through examining the differential effect of hours in the present firm and elsewhere, hours relative to peers’ hours, standard versus evening/night/weekend hours, and the importance of sustaining long hours. Supplemented by the time use survey, we show that the gender gap in hours and career success is mostly due to gendered division of labor in household production.
records.abstract_cn: 利用与劳动市场调查链接的丹麦注册数据，我们提供了关于工作时间与职业成功之间关系（工作时间与职业成功之间的正相关）的严谨证据，具有外部有效性。根据人力资本、竞争和锦标赛理论，我们通过考察当前公司与其他公司的工作时间差异、相对于同龄人工作时间的比较、标准工作时间与晚间/夜间/周末工作时间的差异，以及维持长时间工作的重要性，来解构工作时间与职业成功之间的关系。通过时间使用调查的补充，我们表明，工作时间和职业成功之间的性别差距主要是由于家庭生产中的性别分工造成的。

records.title_en: Beyond IQ: The Rising Value of Extraversion
records.title_cn: 超越智商：外向性价值的上升
records.abstract_en: We analyze trends in labor market returns to psychological traits using data from half a million Finnish men from 2001 to 2015. Cognitive skills’ value declined, while noncognitive skills’ value increased. Our novel findings show that extraversion drives this rise, while conscientiousness remains stable. Extraversion’s rising returns are most pronounced for lower earners and those on the employment margin. These traits predict different labor market paths: extraversion predicts lower education and more work experience, while cognitive ability and conscientiousness lead to higher education and high-paying jobs.
records.abstract_cn: 我们分析了使用来自2001到2015的半个百万芬兰男性的数据，心理特征在劳动市场的回报趋势。认知技能的价值下降，而非认知技能的价值上升。我们的新发现表明，外向性推动了这一上升，而尽责性保持稳定。外向性回报的上升在低收入者和处于就业边缘的人群中最为明显。这些特征预测了不同的劳动市场路径：外向性预测较低的教育水平和更多的工作经验，而认知能力和尽责性则导致更高的教育水平和高薪工作。

records.title_en: Consumption and Income Inequality across Generations
records.title_cn: 代际消费与收入不平等
records.abstract_en: This paper characterizes the joint evolution of income and consumption inequality across generations. We estimate a model featuring intergenerational persistence and family-independent idiosyncratic heterogeneity. We find that inequality in income and consumption is predominantly driven by idiosyncratic factors rather than intergenerational linkages. We show evidence of consumption insurance against idiosyncratic lifetime income risk, particularly for the bottom and top quartiles of income. Parental income is a significant source of this insurance only for the richest quartile.
records.abstract_cn: 本文描述了代际间收入与消费不平等的共同演变。我们估计了一个包含代际持续性和家庭独立的特异性异质性的模型。我们发现，收入和消费的不平等主要是由特异性因素驱动，而非代际联系。我们展示了针对特异性终身收入风险的消费保险的证据，特别是在收入的底部和顶部四分位数。父母收入仅对最富裕的四分位数是这一保险的重要来源。

records.title_en: The Economics of Gender-Specific Minimum Wage Legislation
records.title_cn: 性别特定最低工资立法的经济学分析
records.abstract_en: Using full count US census data, we study the impact of early twentieth-century state-industry-specific minimum wage laws that primarily targeted female employees. Our triple-difference estimates suggest a null impact of the minimum wage laws, potentially reflecting disemployment effects and the positive selection bias of the workers remaining in the labor force. When comparing county-industry trends between counties straddling state borders, female employment is lower by around 3.1% in affected county-industry cells. We further investigate the implications for own-wage elasticity of labor demand as a function of cross-industry concentration, the channels of substitution between men and women, and heterogeneity by marital status.
records.abstract_cn: 利用美国人口普查全样本数据，我们研究了二十世纪早期主要针对女性雇员的州-行业特定最低工资法律的影响。我们的三重差分估计结果显示最低工资法律的影响为零，可能反映了就业减少效应以及留在劳动力市场的工人存在正向选择偏差。在比较跨州边界县的县-行业趋势时，受影响的县-行业单元中女性就业率低约3.1%。我们进一步考察了劳动需求自身工资弹性作为跨行业集中度函数的含义、男女之间的替代渠道，以及按婚姻状况的异质性。

records.title_en: The labor and health economics of breast cancer
records.title_cn: 乳腺癌的劳动与健康经济学
records.abstract_en: We estimate the long-run labor market and health effects of breast cancer among Austrian women. Compared to a random sample of same-aged non-affected women, those diagnosed with breast cancer face a 22.8 percent increase in health expenses, 9 percent lower unconditional earnings, 5.8 lower employment probability, and an earnings penalty conditional on employment of 6.4 percent five years after diagnosis. We discuss changes in job quality, hours, incapacitation, and employer discrimination as potential mechanisms behind these labor market adjustments.
records.abstract_cn: 我们估算了奥地利女性乳腺癌的长期劳动力市场与健康影响。与随机抽取的同龄未患病女性相比，被诊断患有乳腺癌的女性在诊断后五年面临健康支出增加22.8%，无条件收入降低9%，就业概率降低5.8个百分点，以及在就业条件下的收入惩罚为6.4%。我们讨论了工作质量、工作时间、丧失工作能力及雇主歧视的变化作为这些劳动力市场调整背后的潜在机制。

records.title_en: The effect of offering standardized “Simple Choice” plans on premiums in the Federally Facilitated ACA marketplaces
records.title_cn: 提供标准化“简单选择”计划对联邦便利交易所ACA市场中保费的影响
records.abstract_en: Plan standardization policies aim to help consumers assess plan value by limiting variation in cost-sharing and directing attention towards premiums, networks, and formularies. They may also intensify issuer competition and lower premiums. We study one such policy–the introduction of standardized “Simple Choice” plans alongside non-standardized options in the 2017 ACA marketplaces–and estimate its effect on premiums. Across multiple identification strategies and robustness checks, we find that Simple Choice plans reduced premiums for bronze, silver, and gold tiers, including a 7.3% reduction in the benchmark premium.
records.abstract_cn: 计划标准化政策旨在通过限制成本分摊的变动并将注意力引导至保费、网络和处方集，帮助消费者评估计划价值。这些政策也可能加剧发行商竞争并降低保费。我们研究了这样一项政策——在2017年ACA市场中引入标准化“简单选择”计划与非标准化选项并存——并估计其对保费的影响。通过多种识别策略和稳健性检验，我们发现简单选择计划降低了青铜、白银和黄金层级的保费，包括基准保费降低了7.3%。

records.title_en: Tele-triage, care substitution, and health: Evidence from quasi-randomly assigned nurses
records.title_cn: 电话分诊、护理替代与健康：来自准随机分配护士的证据
records.abstract_en: Patients experiencing acute health symptoms often face uncertainty about how and where to receive care. We study patients who call a nurse advice line and receive one of four recommendations: emergency department (ED), urgent care (UC), primary care (PC), or self-care (Home). Leveraging an extension of examiner designs that recovers margin-specific effects for each pair of adjacent recommendations (ED-UC, UC-PC, PC-Home), we estimate the impact of nurse recommendations on both patient decisions and their subsequent health outcomes. We find that recommendations have large impacts on patient decisions at each margin. We then show that UC recommendations reduce 28-day healthcare costs by $404 relative to ED recommendations and by $247 relative to PC recommendations, suggesting substantial potential for cost savings through improved triage.
records.abstract_cn: 经历急性健康症状的患者常常对如何及在何处接受护理感到不确定。我们研究了拨打护士咨询热线并收到四种建议之一的患者：急诊科（ED）、紧急护理（UC）、初级护理（PC）或自我护理（Home）。利用考官设计的扩展，该设计恢复了每对相邻建议（ED-UC、UC-PC、PC-Home）的边际特定效应，我们估计了护士建议对患者决策及其后续健康结果的影响。我们发现，建议在每个边际上对患者决策都有显著影响。然后我们表明，与ED建议相比，UC建议将28天医疗成本降低了$404，与PC建议相比降低了$247，这表明通过改进分诊存在大幅节省成本的潜力。

records.title_en: The impact of health shocks on housing instability: Evidence from urban Medicaid enrollees
records.title_cn: 健康冲击对住房不稳定的影响：来自城市医疗补助参保者的证据
records.abstract_en: Poor health and unstable housing are closely linked. Most research has focused on how housing shapes health, with little empirical study of whether and how health events can lead to future residential mobility or housing instability. This paper uses high-frequency administrative data on residential location and health among Medicaid enrollees in New York City to test whether adverse health events trigger housing mobility or insecurity, independent of the financial toll of medical bills. Using an event study design, I find that health shocks – or, sudden hospitalizations after two hospital-free years – immediately increase residential mobility (21–35 % relative increase) and the probability of living in shelters or on the street (6–10 % relative increase). These increased rates of mobility and instability persist above expected levels for at least two years. For unplanned or urgent hospital admissions, the impact of health events is even greater. These estimates imply that, in their immediate aftermath, adverse health events could be a tipping point for approximately 80,000 additional moves and 20,000 additional cases of homelessness among the U.S. Medicaid-insured population annually. The effects of health events on residential mobility are smaller for those with subsidized housing, a usual source of outpatient care, higher-quality inpatient care, and social support, suggesting potential areas for policy interventions to break the relationship between health problems and housing outcomes, from both inside and outside of health systems. This work also contributes to our understanding of the long tail of social consequences of adverse health events.
records.abstract_cn: 健康状况不佳与住房不稳定密切相关。大多数研究关注住房如何影响健康，而关于健康事件是否以及如何导致未来居住流动性或住房不稳定的实证研究很少。本文利用纽约市医疗补助参保者居住位置和健康的高频行政数据，检验不良健康事件是否在独立于医疗账单的经济负担之外，触发住房流动性或不安全感。采用事件研究设计，我发现健康冲击——即两年无住院后的突发住院——立即增加了居住流动性（相对增加21-35%）以及居住于收容所或无家可归的概率（相对增加6-10%）。这些增加的流动性和不稳定率在至少两年内持续高于预期水平。对于计划外或紧急住院，健康事件的影响更大。这些估计意味着，在事件发生后立即，不良健康事件可能成为美国医疗补助参保人群每年约80,000次额外搬迁和20,000例额外无家可归的临界点。对于拥有补贴住房、常规门诊护理来源、更高质量住院护理和社会支持的人群，健康事件对居住流动性的影响较小，这表明从卫生系统内外进行政策干预以打破健康问题与住房结果之间关系的潜在领域。这项工作也有助于我们理解不良健康事件社会后果的长期尾部效应。

records.title_en: When fewer children mean shorter lives: Fertility policy and elderly well-being in China
records.title_cn: 当孩子减少意味着寿命缩短：中国的生育政策与老年人福祉
records.abstract_en: We study the long-run consequences of fertility policy for aging and survival, exploiting the staggered provincial rollout of China’s 1970s Later, Longer, Fewer campaign. Linking variation in exposure to the Chinese Longitudinal Healthy Longevity Survey (1998–2021), we find that cohorts subject to fertility restrictions experienced significantly higher late-life mortality, over 10% on average, and worse cognitive and psychological outcomes. These effects arise because smaller sibships, delayed childbearing, and wider spacing reduced both the supply and timing of intergenerational care. While the subsequent introduction of LTCI mitigated some adverse impacts, the effects were driven by in-kind benefits, whereas cash-based LTCI provided little offset, underscoring the limits of formal substitution for kin-based support. Our findings reveal a fundamental intergenerational trade-off in fertility control and highlight the enduring demographic costs of policies that reshape family structure.
records.abstract_cn: 我们利用中国1970年“晚、稀、少”运动在各省逐步推行的自然实验，研究了生育政策对老龄化和生存的长期后果。通过将暴露差异与中国老年健康影响因素跟踪调查（1998-2021）相关联，我们发现受到生育限制的队列在晚年死亡率显著更高，平均超过10%，并且认知和心理结果更差。这些效应的产生是因为兄弟姐妹数量减少、生育延迟和生育间隔扩大降低并改变了代际照料的供给和时间安排。尽管随后引入的长期护理保险（LTCI）缓解了部分不利影响，但这些效应主要由实物福利驱动，而现金型LTCI提供的抵消作用甚微，凸显了正式替代对亲属支持的限制。我们的发现揭示了生育控制中基本的代际权衡，并强调了重塑家庭结构的政策所带来的持久人口成本。

records.title_en: Income and immunity: The consequences of social security administration reform for childhood infection risk
records.title_cn: 收入与免疫力：社会保障管理改革对儿童感染风险的影响
records.abstract_en: We analyse the impact of a change in the administration of social security payments, occurring in utero and early infancy, on health in early childhood. We identify this impact through the gradual rollout of the so-called ‘income management’ policy in Aboriginal communities in Australia’s Northern Territory in 2007. This policy changed the delivery method of social security payments but not their value – however, implementation challenges meant that many families did not receive their payments on time. Using linked administrative data, we find that children who were exposed to the policy rollout in utero or in their first three months of life (the ‘fourth trimester’) were at higher risk of severe infection requiring hospitalisation. These children spent, on average, 4.7 more days in hospital between birth and their 8th birthday. Most of this impact is concentrated in hospitalisations for infection, which increased by 23 percent. These admissions are driven by a range of infection types: bacterial, viral and respiratory. We link our findings to the ‘immune programming hypothesis’, i.e. maternal stress and poor nutrition during key stages in immune system development can permanently weaken the child’s immune system. Our findings highlight the importance of attention to key phases in child development when designing policies that affect households’ financial resources, even temporarily.
records.abstract_cn: 我们分析了社会保障支付管理方式的变化，该变化发生在胎儿期和婴儿早期，对儿童早期健康的影响。我们通过澳大利亚北领地原住民社区所谓的‘收入管理’政策在2007年的逐步推广来识别这一影响。该政策改变了社会保障支付的发放方式，但未改变其金额——然而，实施中的挑战意味着许多家庭未能按时收到付款。利用关联的行政数据，我们发现，在胎儿期或出生后前三个月（即‘第四孕期’）暴露于政策推广的儿童，其因严重感染而住院的风险更高。这些儿童从出生到8岁生日之间，平均住院天数多出4.7天。这一影响主要集中在感染相关的住院，增加了23%。这些入院由多种感染类型驱动：细菌性、病毒性和呼吸道感染。我们将研究结果与‘免疫编程假说’联系起来，即母亲在免疫系统发育关键阶段承受的压力和营养不良可能永久削弱儿童的免疫系统。我们的发现强调了在设计影响家庭财务资源的政策时，关注儿童发展关键阶段的重要性，即使这种影响是暂时的。

records.title_en: Consent-based laws and aggregate fertility
records.title_cn: 基于同意的法律与总体生育率
records.abstract_en: This paper examines how expanding the legal definition of sexual assault affects fertility and sexual behavior, using a panel of European countries. I find that switching to tacit consent-based legislation reduces fertility by about 4% relative to the mean. This effect is driven by a decrease in couple formation and an increase in abortion rates. Supporting evidence is consistent with a behavioral channel in which more risk-averse individuals withdraw from dating and partner markets following the reform, altering the composition of those who remain active toward a pool that is less precautionary. Consistent with this compositional shift, contraceptive use rises among younger women but declines among older age groups, while condom use falls among young men. Finally, an analysis of appeals court verdicts in Sweden following the adoption of consent-based legislation shows a decline in unanimous guilty verdicts, indicating challenges in assessing tacit consent. These results are consistent with a simple framework in which heterogeneity in risk perceptions and precautionary behavior in dating and partner markets, including reduced participation by some individuals, helps explain the observed decline in fertility following the reform.
records.abstract_cn: 本文利用欧洲国家面板数据，考察扩大性侵犯法律定义对生育率和性行为的影响。我发现，转向默示同意立法会使生育率相对于平均值降低约4%。这一效应由伴侣形成减少和堕胎率上升所驱动。支持性证据与一种行为渠道一致，即改革后，更规避风险的个体退出约会和伴侣市场，从而将仍活跃人群的构成转向预防措施较少的群体。与这种构成性转变一致，年轻女性的避孕药具使用增加，但较大年龄组的使用下降，而年轻男性的安全套使用减少。最后，对瑞典采用基于同意的立法后上诉法院判决的分析显示，一致有罪判决减少，表明评估默示同意存在挑战。这些结果与一个简单框架一致，在该框架中，约会和伴侣市场中风险感知和预防行为的异质性，包括某些个体参与减少，有助于解释改革后观察到的生育率下降。

records.title_en: Intertemporal coordination in volunteer markets
records.title_cn: 志愿者市场中的跨期协调
records.abstract_en: Many volunteer markets, and most prominently markets for substances of human origin, feature dynamic coordination problems where volunteering today can temporarily restrict volunteering later. We show that, unsurprisingly, these restrictions reduce market surplus compared to no restrictions. We examine whether providing volunteers with demand or supply information improves market surplus without and with intertemporal restrictions. We show theoretically that, without restrictions, providing demand or supply information increases market surplus, while with restrictions, providing supply rather than demand information causes higher market surplus. Experimental results support most predictions and further show that supply information especially improves market surplus when intertemporal restrictions exist. Overall, comparative static inferences in an environment without intertemporal restrictions do not carry over to an environment with restrictions. Thus, policies based on analyses of static conditions will not necessarily be effective in situations featuring dynamic spillovers.
records.abstract_cn: 许多志愿者市场，尤其是人体来源物质市场，具有动态协调问题，即今天的志愿服务可能暂时限制以后的志愿服务。我们表明，不出所料，这些限制相比无限制情况会减少市场盈余。我们考察了向志愿者提供需求或供给信息是否能在无跨期限制和有跨期限制的情况下改善市场盈余。理论上我们证明，在没有限制的情况下，提供需求或供给信息会增加市场盈余，而在有限制的情况下，提供供给信息而非需求信息会导致更高的市场盈余。实验结果支持大多数预测，并进一步表明，当存在跨期限制时，供给信息尤其能改善市场盈余。总体而言，在无跨期限制环境中的比较静态推断并不能推广到有限制的环境。因此，基于静态条件分析的政策在存在动态溢出效应的情况下不一定有效。

records.title_en: Integrating equity and productivity in health evaluation
records.title_cn: 健康评估中整合公平与生产力
records.abstract_en: This paper develops a unified framework for evaluating health outcomes that jointly incorporates equity and productivity. Extending beyond traditional QALYs, PALYs, and the more recent PQALYs, we introduce a broader class of evaluation functions that integrate equity- and productivity-sensitive conditions. By imposing several normative criteria, including independence from measurement scales and Pigou–Dalton transfer principles, we obtain tractable power-form representations. In balancing equity and efficiency, the framework provides a coherent foundation for assessing interventions in contexts where both health and productive capacity are at stake.
records.abstract_cn: 本文开发了一个统一框架，用于评估健康结果，该框架同时纳入公平与生产力。超越传统的QALYs、PALYs以及较新的PQALYs，我们引入了一类更广泛的评估函数，这些函数整合了公平敏感和生产力敏感的条件。通过施加若干规范性标准，包括测量尺度独立性和Pigou–Dalton转移原则，我们获得了易于处理的幂函数形式表示。在平衡公平与效率时，该框架为评估那些健康和生产能力均受影响的干预措施提供了连贯的基础。

records.title_en: Online food delivery and body weight: Quasi-experimental evidence from China
records.title_cn: 在线外卖配送与体重：来自中国的准实验证据
records.abstract_en: This paper estimates the causal effect of online food delivery platforms on body weight in China. Exploiting the staggered rollout of Eleme across Chinese cities between 2010 and 2020, we find that platform entry shifts the BMI distribution rightward among urban young adults: it increases body mass index, lowers underweight prevalence, and raises the likelihood of being overweight. Effects are negligible among urban older adults, consistent with lower platform adoption in this group. Mechanism analysis points to shifts in dietary preferences toward energy-dense foods, reduced meal preparation time, and increased restaurant entry. Our findings highlight the health trade-offs associated with digital food platforms in rapidly urbanizing developing countries, where improved caloric access may coexist with greater exposure to lower-quality, energy-dense foods.
records.abstract_cn: 本文估计了中国在线外卖配送平台对体重的因果效应。利用2010年至2020年间饿了么在中国各城市的分阶段推出，我们发现平台进入使城市年轻成年人的BMI分布右移：它增加了身体质量指数，降低了体重不足的普遍性，并提高了超重的可能性。对城市老年人的影响可忽略不计，这与该群体中平台采用率较低一致。机制分析指向饮食偏好向高能量密度食物的转变、餐食准备时间的减少以及餐馆进入的增加。我们的发现强调了在快速城市化的发展中国家，数字食品平台带来的健康权衡，其中改善的热量获取可能与更多接触低质量、高能量密度食物共存。

records.title_en: School closures and parental mental health
records.title_cn: 学校关闭与父母心理健康
records.abstract_en: Schools support families not only through education but also by facilitating daily routines, childcare, and social supports. Disruptions to schooling may therefore have broader effects on family well-being, including parental mental health. We study how school closures affected parental initiation of antidepressant use, as a proxy for mental healthcare needs, using national commercial claims data and a difference-in-differences design that exploits geographic variation in physical school access during the COVID-19 pandemic. Even though antidepressant use declined during the pandemic overall, we find that in zip codes with a high level of school closures, the decline in antidepressant use was approximately 3.8% smaller for both mothers and fathers relative to zip codes that remained largely open during the early months of the pandemic. These effects persisted through 2021, even after in-person instruction resumed. Mothers across most racial groups are affected by specific school-level closures (elementary, middle, and high), while for fathers, there are only small detectable increases with respect to elementary schools. These findings highlight the role of schools in buffering household stress and supporting mental health, and contribute to a broader economics literature that leverages the pandemic as a natural experiment to better understand how institutional disruptions impact health outcomes.
records.abstract_cn: 学校不仅通过教育支持家庭，还通过促进日常作息、儿童保育和社会支持来发挥作用。因此，学校教育的中断可能对家庭福祉产生更广泛的影响，包括父母的心理健康。我们利用全国商业索赔数据和双重差分设计，利用COVID-19疫情期间物理学校可及性的地理差异，研究了学校关闭如何影响父母开始使用抗抑郁药的情况，以此作为心理健康护理需求的代理指标。尽管疫情期间抗抑郁药使用总体下降，但我们发现，在学校关闭程度较高的邮政编码区域，母亲和父亲的抗抑郁药使用下降幅度比疫情初期基本保持开放的邮政编码区域大约小3.8%。这些影响持续到2021年，即使在面对面教学恢复后也是如此。大多数种族群体的母亲受到特定学校层面关闭（小学、初中和高中）的影响，而对于父亲，仅在与小学相关的方面有微小的可检测增加。这些发现凸显了学校在缓冲家庭压力和促进心理健康方面的作用，并为更广泛的经济学文献做出贡献，该文献利用疫情作为自然实验，以更好地理解制度性中断如何影响健康结果。

records.title_en: Mental health, substance use, and child maltreatment
records.title_cn: 心理健康、物质使用与儿童虐待
records.abstract_en: Child maltreatment is a pressing concern in the United States, with more than four million children referred to child protective services in 2022. Parental mental health and substance use disorders are strongly associated with child maltreatment. We use administrative data from 2004–2022 to study the relationship between the number of mental health and substance use treatment centers and child maltreatment reports in U.S. counties. Findings show that a 9.6% increase in the supply of treatment centers per county reduces child maltreatment reports by 0.7% and child injury deaths by 0.4%. These findings suggest that improved access to mental health and substance use treatment may help reduce child maltreatment.
records.abstract_cn: 儿童虐待在美国是一个紧迫的问题，2022年有超过四百万儿童被转介至儿童保护服务机构。父母的心理健康和物质使用障碍与儿童虐待密切相关。我们使用2004-2022年的行政数据，研究美国各县心理健康和物质使用治疗中心的数量与儿童虐待报告之间的关系。研究发现，每县治疗中心供应量增加9.6%，儿童虐待报告减少0.7%，儿童伤害死亡减少0.4%。这些发现表明，改善心理健康和物质使用治疗的可及性可能有助于减少儿童虐待。

records.title_en: Retirement and cognitive abilities: Evidence from the German early retirement age reform for women
records.title_cn: 退休与认知能力：来自德国女性提前退休年龄改革的证据
records.abstract_en: We study the effects of retirement on cognitive functioning among women aged 63 to 67 by exploiting a German retirement reform that raised the early retirement age for women born after 1951 by three years, from 60 to 63. Our indicators of cognitive functioning are objective cognitive test scores (word recall, semantic fluency, and the Stroop test) from a large biomedical dataset, as well as the diagnosis of cognitive disorders from administrative health insurance claims. We find reductions of around 13% of a standard deviation per year in retirement for measures of fluid intelligence, whereas crystallized intelligence remains unaffected. These estimates reflect the reform-induced shift in retirement duration for compliers around the eligibility cutoff. In contrast, additional years in retirement do not affect diagnosis of cognitive disorder and decrease diagnoses of dementia-related risk factors such as hypertension, depression, and sleep problems. The improvement in health outcomes suggests that cognitive decline is not driven by health deterioration but might possibly be due to reduced cognitive engagement after leaving work.
records.abstract_cn: 我们利用德国一项将1951年后出生女性的提前退休年龄从60岁提高至63岁（延长三年）的退休改革，研究退休对63至67岁女性认知功能的影响。我们的认知功能指标来自大型生物医学数据集的客观认知测试得分（单词回忆、语义流畅性和Stroop测试），以及行政健康保险索赔中认知障碍的诊断。我们发现，在退休期间，流体智力测量每年下降约13%的标准差，而晶体智力则不受影响。这些估计反映了改革导致的合规者在资格截止点附近退休时长的变化。相比之下，额外的退休年限不影响认知障碍的诊断，并减少了高血压、抑郁和睡眠问题等痴呆相关风险因素的诊断。健康结果的改善表明，认知衰退并非由健康恶化驱动，而可能是由于离开工作后认知参与度降低所致。

records.title_en: The benefits of timely access to treatment: Substance use disorders, healthcare utilization and employment
records.title_cn: 及时获得治疗的好处：物质使用障碍、医疗保健利用与就业
records.abstract_en: This research studies the impact of improving access to treatment for substance use disorders by reducing wait times. Linked individual-level administrative data are used to estimate the impacts of wait times on patients’ treatment service utilization and employment. Potential confounding is addressed using an instrumental variables strategy that exploits exogenous variation in wait times generated by local congestion in the healthcare system. We find that longer wait times lead to increased use of treatment services in the focal treatment episode, raised re-entry into subsequent treatment episodes, and lowered employment, consistent with patients’ health deteriorating while waiting for treatment. Our calculations suggest that each dollar spent on reducing wait times yields a return of between six and seven dollars. These findings demonstrate that shortening wait times for treatment can significantly reduce the economic and social burdens of addiction.
records.abstract_cn: 本研究探讨了通过减少等待时间来改善物质使用障碍治疗可及性的影响。利用关联的个体层面行政数据，估计等待时间对患者治疗服务利用和就业的影响。采用工具变量策略解决潜在混杂因素，该策略利用医疗系统局部拥堵产生的等待时间外生变异。我们发现，较长的等待时间导致焦点治疗阶段中治疗服务使用增加，后续治疗阶段的再入院率上升，以及就业率下降，这与患者在等待治疗期间健康状况恶化相一致。我们的计算表明，每花费一美元用于减少等待时间，可带来六至七美元的回报。这些发现表明，缩短治疗等待时间可以显著减轻成瘾带来的经济和社会负担。

records.title_en: Improving disability benefit take-up: Experimental evidence from a public information campaign in Vietnam
records.title_cn: 提高残疾福利领取率：来自越南公共信息运动的实验证据
records.abstract_en: Despite substantial disability-related costs, participation in public disability benefit programs remains incomplete in many countries. This is particularly the case in low- and middle-income countries where disability programs are relatively new and awareness of eligibility rules may be limited. This paper evaluates whether reducing information frictions can increase enrolment in Vietnam’s national disability benefits program. In a randomised controlled trial across 70 rural communes, standardised information about disability benefits was embedded within routine government loudspeaker broadcasts over a five-week period. Using commune-level administrative data observed approximately two years after the intervention, the results show that program enrolment was 9 percent higher in treated communes. The effects are larger among individuals classified with severe disabilities, for whom enrolment increased by 12 percent. Smaller effects are observed among persons with the most severe disabilities, who were likely already well covered by the program. Larger effects are also observed among children who are eligible for higher monthly disability pension amounts. These findings demonstrate that a low-cost and scalable information campaign delivered through existing government communication infrastructure can substantially increase participation in disability benefit programs.
records.abstract_cn: 尽管存在大量与残疾相关的成本，许多国家参与公共残疾福利项目的比例仍不完整。在低收入和中等收入国家尤其如此，这些国家的残疾项目相对较新，对资格规则的认知可能有限。本文评估了减少信息摩擦是否能增加越南国家残疾福利项目的注册率。在一项覆盖70个农村公社的随机对照试验中，关于残疾福利的标准化信息在五周内嵌入到常规政府广播中。使用干预后约两年观察到的公社级行政数据，结果显示，处理公社的项目注册率高出9%%。对于被归类为严重残疾的个体，效果更大，其注册率增加了12%%。在最严重残疾的人群中观察到较小的效果，这些人可能已被项目充分覆盖。在符合更高月度残疾养老金金额的儿童中也观察到更大的效果。这些发现表明，通过现有政府通信基础设施提供的低成本、可扩展的信息运动可以显著增加残疾福利项目的参与率。

records.title_en: Competition matters: Uniform vs. indication-based pricing of pharmaceuticals
records.title_cn: 竞争至关重要：药品的统一定价与基于适应症的定价
records.abstract_en: Pharmaceutical expenditures are rising rapidly, driven in part by the innovation of highly effective but very expensive drug therapies that treat multiple diseases, implying that payers face a critical trade-off between cost containment and access to new medicines. A key policy question is whether producers should be restricted to uniform pricing or allowed to use indication-based pricing, where prices vary across patient groups. We use a two-market model to analyse how this choice affects drug producers’ incentives to invest in new indications, their pricing strategies, and the resulting surplus for health plans. In a monopoly setting, indication-based pricing yields higher profits and thus strengthens incentives to invest in new indications, while the payer prefers uniform pricing unless the fixed investment costs cannot be recouped. However, monopoly-based insights may not hold if the multi-indication producer faces therapeutic competition in one of the markets. Specifically, we identify a softening-of-competition effect, where a uniform pricing restriction serves as a credible commitment to raise prices in the competitive market. In this case, the health plan might favour indication-based pricing to reduce costs. Overall, our findings suggest that neither pricing scheme is universally optimal, underscoring the need for case-by-case assessments across drug classes.
records.abstract_cn: 药品支出迅速上升，部分原因是创新药物疗法虽然高效但价格昂贵，且可治疗多种疾病，这意味着支付方面临成本控制与获取新药之间的关键权衡。一个关键的政策问题是，生产者应被限制采用统一定价，还是允许采用基于适应症的定价，即不同患者群体价格不同。我们使用一个双市场模型来分析这一选择如何影响药品生产者投资新适应症的激励、其定价策略以及由此产生的健康计划盈余。在垄断情境下，基于适应症的定价带来更高利润，从而增强投资新适应症的激励，而支付方则偏好统一定价，除非固定投资成本无法收回。然而，如果多适应症生产者在其中一个市场面临治疗竞争，基于垄断的见解可能不成立。具体而言，我们识别出一种竞争缓和效应，即统一定价限制可作为在竞争市场中提高价格的可信承诺。在这种情况下，健康计划可能倾向于基于适应症的定价以降低成本。总体而言，我们的研究结果表明，两种定价方案均非普遍最优，这强调了需要针对不同药物类别进行个案评估。

records.title_en: Sustainable investing and market governance
records.title_cn: 可持续投资与市场治理
records.abstract_en: This paper examines how sustainable investing affects the governance role of financial markets. We show that stronger concerns about externalities among informed investors can reduce price informativeness about managerial effort to improve financial performance, increasing the cost of incentive provision. This mechanism creates an inherent link between firms’ environmental and social (ES) and governance quality. We show that the agency costs of sustainable investing can have real effects on ES outcomes when firms can change their externalities.
records.abstract_cn: 本文考察了可持续投资如何影响金融市场的治理作用。我们表明，知情投资者对外部性更强的关注会降低关于管理层提升财务绩效努力的价格信息含量，从而增加激励提供的成本。这一机制在企业环境与社会（ES）表现和治理质量之间建立了内在联系。我们进一步表明，当企业能够改变其外部性时，可持续投资的代理成本可能对ES结果产生实际影响。

records.title_en: Government litigation risk and the decline in low-income mortgage lending
records.title_cn: 政府诉讼风险与低收入群体抵押贷款发放的下降
records.abstract_en: This study examines the effect of Department of Justice lawsuits in the 2010s against large lenders for alleged fraud in the Federal Housing Administration (FHA) mortgage insurance program. The suits led to over $5 billion in settlements and caused targeted banks and their peers to precipitously exit the FHA market. Difference-in-differences and triple-differences tests exploiting geographic variation in exposure to exiting banks show an 18% reduction in FHA lending in heavily exposed areas. This reduction was not associated with improved underwriting standards or lower default rates. Large banks’ FHA exit has significantly reduced low-income households’ overall access to mortgage credit.
records.abstract_cn: 本研究考察了2010年美国司法部针对大型贷款机构在联邦住房管理局（FHA）抵押贷款保险项目中涉嫌欺诈提起的诉讼的影响。这些诉讼导致了超过5亿美元的和解金，并促使目标银行及其同行迅速退出FHA市场。利用暴露于银行退出的地理差异进行的双重差分和三重差分检验显示，在高度暴露地区，FHA贷款发放减少了18%。这种减少并未伴随着承保标准的改善或违约率的降低。大型银行退出FHA市场显著减少了低收入家庭整体获得抵押贷款信贷的机会。

records.title_en: Bonding with risk: Corporate investment and savings in risky financial assets
records.title_cn: 与风险共舞：企业投资与储蓄于风险金融资产
records.abstract_en: We study the rationale behind firms’ investment in risky financial assets by formulating and estimating a dynamic model in which firms allocate their precautionary savings to both safe and risky securities. In equilibrium, risky financial asset holdings are positively related to the sensitivity of a firm’s financing deficit to the risky asset returns—the “financing deficit beta”. Using a comprehensive sample of US corporate financial asset holdings, we find evidence of a positive correlation between risky financial asset holdings and financing deficit betas that capture firms’ incentives to hedge interest-rate risk. Precautionary motives are stronger in small, high-volatility, and R&D-intensive firms.
records.abstract_cn: 我们通过构建并估计一个动态模型来研究企业投资于风险金融资产背后的逻辑，在该模型中，企业将预防性储蓄配置于安全证券和风险证券。在均衡状态下，风险金融资产持有量与企业的融资缺口对风险资产收益的敏感性——即“融资缺口贝塔”——正相关。利用美国企业金融资产持有的全面样本，我们发现风险金融资产持有量与融资缺口贝塔之间存在正相关关系，这反映了企业对冲利率风险的激励。预防性动机在小规模、高波动性和研发密集型企业中更为强烈。

records.title_en: Risk-averse dealers in a risk-free market—The role of trading desk risk limits
records.title_cn: 风险规避的交易商在无风险市场——交易台风险限额的作用
records.abstract_en: We show that self-imposed risk limits significantly constrain dealers’ risk-taking and Treasury market intermediation, especially during market stress. Dealers near value-at-risk (VaR) limits reduce positions and demand higher compensation for risk. During March 2020, constrained dealers sold more Treasuries to the Fed at lower prices and provided less liquidity to clients. An aggregate measure of dealer VaR constraints closely tracks Treasury market illiquidity. Our findings offer a micro-foundation for the volatility–liquidity link and show that, in crises, policy actions that remove risk from intermediary balance sheets may be more effective at supporting Treasury market functioning than regulatory relief.
records.abstract_cn: 我们表明，自我施加的风险限额显著约束了交易商的风险承担和国债市场的中介活动，尤其是在市场压力时期。接近在险价值（VaR）限额的交易商会减少头寸并要求更高的风险补偿。在2020年三月，受约束的交易商以更低价格向美联储出售更多国债，并向客户提供更少的流动性。交易商VaR约束的总体衡量指标与国债市场非流动性紧密相关。我们的发现为波动性-流动性关联提供了微观基础，并表明在危机时期，从中介机构资产负债表中移除风险的政策行动可能比监管宽松更有效地支持国债市场运作。

records.title_en: Extrapolators and contrarians: Forecast bias and individual investor stock trading
records.title_cn: 外推者与逆向者：预测偏差与个人投资者股票交易
records.abstract_en: We test whether forecast bias affects individual investors’ stock trading by combining bias measures from laboratory experiments with administrative trade data. Forecast bias is positively associated with past excess returns of purchased stocks: Compared to contrarians, extrapolators purchase stocks with higher past returns. Forecast bias is negatively associated with capital gains of sold stocks. Forecast bias also explains investor heterogeneity in the relation between market returns and net flows. Taken together, forecast bias provides a unifying mechanism through which different salient performance measures — past stock returns, capital gains, and past market returns — shape corresponding purchase, sale, and net flow decisions.
records.abstract_cn: 我们通过将实验室实验中的偏差度量与行政交易数据相结合，检验预测偏差是否影响个人投资者的股票交易。预测偏差与所购股票的历史超额收益正相关：与逆向者相比，外推者购买历史收益更高的股票。预测偏差与所售股票的资本利得负相关。预测偏差还解释了投资者在市场收益与净流量关系中的异质性。综合来看，预测偏差提供了一个统一的机制，通过该机制，不同的显著绩效指标——历史股票收益、资本利得和历史市场收益——分别塑造相应的购买、出售和净流量决策。

records.title_en: Financial literacy and financial crime: A regression discontinuity approach
records.title_cn: 金融素养与金融犯罪：一种回归断点方法
records.abstract_en: This study investigates how financial literacy shapes the propensity of individuals to commit financial crime. Using state-level administrative data on criminal charges linked to comprehensive public records , we exploit a policy-based discontinuity in grade level assignment based on individual birth dates that exogenously requires certain high school cohorts to attend a financial literacy course. Our estimates suggest that exposure to the course reduces the propensity to commit financial crime by 37%. The reduction is driven by declines in embezzlement and is stronger for low-income individuals. Additional evidence suggests that the reductions are primarily explained by improvements in household balance sheets.
records.abstract_cn: 本研究探讨金融素养如何影响个人实施金融犯罪的倾向。利用与全面公共记录相关联的州级行政犯罪指控数据，我们基于个人出生日期对年级分配的政策性断点，该断点外生地要求某些高中队列参加金融素养课程。我们的估计表明，接触该课程将实施金融犯罪的倾向降低了37%。这一减少主要由贪污行为的下降驱动，并且对低收入个体更为显著。额外证据表明，这些减少主要归因于家庭资产负债表的改善。

records.title_en: Glass box machine learning and corporate bond returns
records.title_cn: 玻璃箱机器学习与公司债券回报
records.abstract_en: Machine learning methods in asset pricing are often criticized for their black box nature. We study this issue by predicting corporate bond returns using interpretable machine learning on a high-dimensional bond characteristics data set. We achieve state-of-the-art performance while maintaining an interpretable model structure, overcoming the accuracy–interpretability trade-off. The estimation uncovers nonlinear relationships and economically meaningful interactions in bond pricing, notably related to term structure and macroeconomic uncertainty. Subsample analysis reveals stronger sensitivities to these effects for small firms and long-maturity bonds. Finally, we demonstrate how interpretable models enhance transparency in portfolio construction by providing ex ante insights into portfolio composition.
records.abstract_cn: 资产定价中的机器学习方法常因其黑箱性质而受到批评。我们通过使用可解释的机器学习方法，基于高维债券特征数据集预测公司债券回报来研究这一问题。我们在保持可解释模型结构的同时实现了最先进的性能，克服了准确性与可解释性之间的权衡。估计揭示了债券定价中的非线性关系和经济上有意义的交互作用，特别是与期限结构和宏观经济不确定性相关的部分。子样本分析显示，小公司和长期限债券对这些效应的敏感性更强。最后，我们展示了可解释模型如何通过提供投资组合构成的先验洞察来增强投资组合构建的透明度。

records.title_en: Flying below the radar: Insider trading by executives below the top
records.title_cn: 在雷达之下飞行：高层以下高管的内部交易
records.abstract_en: To enforce insider trading laws, financial regulators require top executives to make their own-company trades public. One implication of this regulatory focus is that executives below the top fly under the radar. We use administrative register data from Norway to examine whether executives below the top in listed companies earn abnormal returns on purchases in own-company stock. We find evidence of abnormal returns on such trades, about 50 to 100 basis points at the 1-month horizon. The abnormal returns on purchases in other stocks are negative, making high investor ability an unlikely explanation.
records.abstract_cn: 为执行内幕交易法律，金融监管机构要求高层管理人员公开其对本公司股票的交易。这一监管重点的一个含义是，高层以下的高管在雷达之下飞行。我们使用来自挪威的行政登记数据，考察上市公司中高层以下的高管是否在购买本公司股票时获得异常回报。我们发现了此类交易存在异常回报的证据，在1个月的时间范围内约为50至100个基点。购买其他股票的异常回报为负，这使得高投资者能力成为一个不太可能的解释。

records.journal_name: Journal of Economic Dynamics and Control
records.title_en: A data-driven econo-financial stress-testing framework to estimate the effect of supply chain networks on financial systemic risk
records.title_cn: 基于数据驱动的经济金融压力测试框架：评估供应链网络对金融系统性风险的影响
records.abstract_en: Supply chain disruptions constitute a widely neglected risk for financial stability. As in financial networks, systemic risk in supply chain networks (SCNs) arises when the local failure of a single or a small group of firms impacts the production of others and might trigger cascading drops in production that affect significant parts of the economy. Here, we study how systemic risk in SCNs translates into financial systemic risk through a mechanism where supply chain contagion leads to correlated bank-firm loan defaults. We propose a financial stress-testing framework for macro-prudential applications that features a national firm level SCN in combination with bank-firm loans and the interbank network. The model is calibrated with a unique data set including about 1 million firm-level supply links, practically all bank-firm loans, and all interbank loans in Hungary. As a showcase we implement a real COVID-19 shock scenario based on firm-level labour data. This model allows us to study how the disruption dynamics in the real economy can lead to and amplify interbank solvency contagion dynamics. We estimate to what extent SCN contagion amplifies financial systemic risk, discuss the relative importance of these contagion channels, and find an increase of interbank contagion of 70% when SCN contagion is present. A key finding is that the interaction of SCN contagion and financial network contagion amplifies financial systemic risks and leads to heavier tails of banks’ loss distributions. We then examine the financial systemic risk of individual firm failures and find that interbank contagion can amplify bank equity losses from supply-chain-contagion-induced defaults by up to 28%. This framework is the first financial systemic risk model that takes real economy shocks mediated by supply chain contagion into account at the agent-level. This opens a path for a direct and event-driven understanding of the dynamical interaction between the real economy and financial systems.
records.abstract_cn: 供应链中断构成了金融稳定中一个被广泛忽视的风险。与金融网络类似，供应链网络中的系统性风险产生于单个或一小部分企业的局部失败影响其他企业的生产，并可能引发影响经济重要部分的生产级联下降。在此，我们研究供应链网络中的系统性风险如何通过一种机制转化为金融系统性风险，其中供应链传染导致银行-企业贷款违约的相关性。我们提出了一个用于宏观审慎应用的金融压力测试框架，该框架以国家层面的企业级供应链网络为特征，并结合银行-企业贷款和银行间网络。该模型使用一个独特的数据集进行校准，该数据集包括约1百万条企业级供应链接、几乎所有银行-企业贷款以及匈牙利的所有银行间贷款。作为展示，我们基于企业级劳动力数据实施了一个真实的COVID-19冲击情景。该模型使我们能够研究实体经济中的中断动态如何导致并放大银行间偿付能力传染动态。我们估计了供应链网络传染在多大程度上放大金融系统性风险，讨论了这些传染渠道的相对重要性，并发现当存在供应链网络传染时，银行间传染增加了70%。一个关键发现是，供应链网络传染与金融网络传染的相互作用放大了金融系统性风险，并导致银行损失分布的尾部更重。然后，我们考察了单个企业失败的金融系统性风险，发现银行间传染可以将供应链传染引发的违约导致的银行股权损失放大至多28%。该框架是第一个在代理层面考虑由供应链传染介导的实体经济冲击的金融系统性风险模型。这为直接和事件驱动地理解实体经济与金融系统之间的动态相互作用开辟了道路。

records.journal_name: Journal of Economic Dynamics and Control
records.title_en: Dynamic order dispersion and volatility persistence in a simple limit order book model
records.title_cn: 简单限价订单簿模型中的动态订单分散与波动率持续性
records.abstract_en: We extend the dynamics of a basic stylized limit order book model introduced in Chiarella and Iori, (2002). The original model is capable of generating some key market microstructure features, but it cannot recreate longer range persistence in volatility. We explore a very simple and intuitive addition to the stylized, near zero intelligence behavior of traders that is capable of delivering persistent volatility and fat tailed return distributions. Specifically, we introduce a feedback mechanism where agents adjust their order placement in response to recent volatility: when short-term volatility rises relative to long-term volatility, traders place their limit orders farther from the current market price. This volatility-responsive order shading creates a self-reinforcing cycle where higher volatility leads to sparser order books, which in turn amplifies subsequent price movements and volatility. We also extend our results to some well known properties of realized volatility measures. Our model reveals that all these properties are generated by order book patterns which are consistent with empirical liquidity patterns in market microstructure studies. We feel our parsimonious agent-based model may be used as a test bed for developing agents with more complex behavior.
records.abstract_cn: 我们扩展了Chiarella和Iori（2002）引入的基本风格化限价订单簿模型的动态。原始模型能够生成一些关键的市场微观结构特征，但无法重现波动率的长期持续性。我们探索了一种非常简单且直观的添加方式，针对交易者的风格化、接近零智能行为，能够产生持续的波动率和厚尾收益分布。具体来说，我们引入了一个反馈机制，其中代理根据近期波动率调整其订单放置：当短期波动率相对于长期波动率上升时，交易者将其限价订单放置在离当前市场价格更远的位置。这种对波动率响应的订单遮蔽创造了一个自我强化的循环，其中更高的波动率导致订单簿更稀疏，进而放大后续的价格变动和波动率。我们还将我们的结果扩展到已实现波动率度量的一些众所周知的性质。我们的模型揭示了所有这些性质都是由与市场微观结构研究中的经验流动性模式一致的订单簿模式生成的。我们认为我们简约的基于代理的模型可以用作开发具有更复杂行为的代理的测试平台。

records.journal_name: Journal of Economic Dynamics and Control
records.title_en: A dynamic model of capital investment with uncertain demand and Bayesian learning
records.title_cn: 不确定需求与贝叶斯学习下的资本投资动态模型
records.abstract_en: This paper employs a sequential learning framework to extend the static industrial organisation literature regarding optimal capacity choice and timing for incumbents and potential entrants to a dynamic environment with heterogeneous products in which uncertainty over future demand changes over time. The incumbent is uncertain about the quality of the entrant’s product and receives imperfect information signals at random points in time. Based on these signals, the incumbent updates his belief about the entrant’s product in a Bayesian fashion. Once adequately convinced about its true quality, he stops learning and makes a capacity choice according to his conviction. Existing models on capacity choice and timing in an incumbent-entrant context have not accounted for incomplete information and sequential learning in their analyses. As such, there are several novel implications that arise from the modeling framework, as well as new rationales for incumbent inertia and what this suggests in terms of over- and under-investment in capacity relative to the welfare-maximising socially optimal level.
records.abstract_cn: 本文采用序贯学习框架，将关于在位者和潜在进入者最优产能选择与时机选择的静态产业组织文献扩展到具有异质性产品且未来需求不确定性随时间变化的动态环境中。在位者对于进入者产品的质量存在不确定性，并在随机时间点接收到不完美的信息信号。基于这些信号，在位者以贝叶斯方式更新其对进入者产品的信念。一旦充分确信其真实质量，他便停止学习并根据自己的信念做出产能选择。现有的关于在位者-进入者情境下产能选择与时机的模型未在其分析中考虑不完全信息和序贯学习。因此，该建模框架产生了若干新的启示，以及关于在位者惰性的新解释，以及这对相对于福利最大化的社会最优水平的产能过度投资和投资不足意味着什么。

records.journal_name: Journal of Economic Dynamics and Control
records.title_en: Restoring existence and uniqueness at the effective lower bound with simple fiscal policy
records.title_cn: 通过简单财政政策恢复有效下限处的存在性与唯一性
records.abstract_en: The presence of an occasionally binding constraint from the effective lower bound (ELB) in New Keynesian models often leads to multiple or no equilibria. The problem stems from a strong feedback loop between expectations (of inflation and output) and current outcomes at the ELB. With non-existence, the economy cannot settle into a consistent, stable outcome; whilst with multiplicity, non-fundamental shifts in beliefs might trigger belief-driven recessions. To prevent such outcomes, a policymaker needs to ensure their actions will produce a unique minimum state variable solution. We show that simple fiscal policy rules can introduce additional stabilising forces that dampen the feedback loop, thereby ensuring the existence and uniqueness of an equilibrium.
records.abstract_cn: 新凯恩斯模型中有效下限（ELB）偶尔起作用的约束常常导致多重均衡或不存在均衡。问题源于在ELB处，预期（对通胀和产出的）与当前结果之间的强反馈循环。当不存在均衡时，经济无法稳定于一致、稳定的结果；而当存在多重均衡时，信念的非基本面变动可能引发由信念驱动的衰退。为防止此类结果，政策制定者需要确保其行动能产生唯一的最小状态变量解。我们表明，简单的财政政策规则可以引入额外的稳定力量，削弱反馈循环，从而确保均衡的存在性和唯一性。

records.journal_name: Journal of Economic Dynamics and Control
records.title_en: How do stock market experiences shape wealth inequality?
records.title_cn: 股市经历如何塑造财富不平等？
records.abstract_en: This paper develops a continuous-time OLG model, incorporating rare disasters and agents who learn more from their own experiences. Disasters such as the Great Depression make investors distrustful of the market. Generations that experience disasters save in the form of safer portfolios, even if similar disasters are not likely to occur again during their lifetimes. “Fearing to attempt” therefore inhibits wealth accumulation by these “depression babies” relative to other generations. This effect is amplified in the general equilibrium since the expected excess return is relatively high following a disaster. When calibrated to US data, the model can explain around half of the old-to-young wealth ratio decrease between the Great Depression and the 1980s, and around 7% of the subsequent increase. The model can also explain about a quarter of the increase of top 1% wealth shares and is consistent with observations of life cycle portfolio choices, and changes in asset returns following disasters.
records.abstract_cn: 本文构建了一个连续时间的OLG模型，其中包含罕见灾难以及更多从自身经历中学习的代理人。诸如大萧条之类的灾难使投资者对市场产生不信任。经历过灾难的世代即使在其有生之年类似灾难不太可能再次发生，也会以更安全的投资组合形式进行储蓄。因此，“畏惧尝试”抑制了这些“大萧条婴儿”相对于其他世代的财富积累。由于灾难后预期超额回报相对较高，这一效应在一般均衡中被放大。当用美国数据进行校准后，该模型可以解释大萧条至1980年间老年与青年财富比率下降的大约一半，以及随后上升的大约7%。该模型还能解释顶层1%财富份额增加的大约四分之一，并与生命周期投资组合选择以及灾难后资产回报变化的观察结果一致。

records.journal_name: Journal of Economic Dynamics and Control
records.title_en: Bank liability structure under capital requirements in a regime-switching framework
records.title_cn: 制度转换框架下资本要求与银行负债结构
records.abstract_en: We develop a regime-switching banking model that incorporates deposit insurance and dual bankruptcy thresholds—one endogenously determined by shareholders and the other exogenously imposed by regulators. Quantitative results indicate that rigid capital regulation tends to amplify risk during economic downturns, while countercyclical adjustments contribute to greater financial stability. Capital regulation should be state-dependent; otherwise, excessively stringent regulation may induce higher leverage, whereas insufficient oversight may undermine regulatory effectiveness. The findings also highlight a trade-off between capital requirements and financial stability. These insights offer guidance for designing countercyclical capital frameworks that help stabilize bank behavior throughout the business cycle.
records.abstract_cn: 我们构建了一个包含存款保险和双重破产阈值的制度转换银行模型——其中一个阈值由股东内生决定，另一个由监管机构外生设定。定量结果表明，刚性的资本监管在经济下行期间往往会放大风险，而逆周期调整则有助于增强金融稳定性。资本监管应视状态而定；否则，过度严格的监管可能诱发更高的杠杆率，而监管不足则可能削弱监管有效性。研究结果还凸显了资本要求与金融稳定性之间的权衡关系。这些见解为设计有助于在整个商业周期内稳定银行行为的逆周期资本框架提供了指导。

records.journal_name: Journal of Economic Dynamics and Control
records.title_en: Production and endogenous preferences
records.title_cn: 生产与内生偏好
records.abstract_en: This paper proposes a two-sector production model augmented with the endogenous preference evolution mechanism. The preference evolution reflects the popularity of two sectors among investors and captures the idea that preferences for the two goods move endogenously over time. The interaction of preference evolution and market-clearing mechanism generates endogenous movements in Tobin’s Q, risk premia and wealth shares different to the standard production economy of Eberly and Wang (2011). The model also implies that wealth fluctuates across sectors due to the shifts in preferences and subsequently because of expected returns and Sharpe ratios. In the empirical tests, I calibrate the baseline model to the US data sample over 1975–2019 and verify that model predictions are supported in the data.
records.abstract_cn: 本文提出了一个包含内生偏好演化机制的两部门生产模型。偏好演化反映了投资者对两个部门的偏好程度，并体现了对两种商品偏好随时间内生变动的观点。偏好演化与市场出清机制的相互作用产生了托宾Q、风险溢价和财富份额的内生变动，这与Eberly和Wang（2011）的标准生产经济不同。该模型还暗示，由于偏好的变化以及随后的预期回报和夏普比率的变化，财富在各部门间波动。在实证检验中，我将基准模型校准到美国1975-2019年的数据样本，并验证了模型预测在数据中得到支持。

records.journal_name: Journal of Economic Dynamics and Control
records.title_en: Market-based short-rate uncertainty and time-varying expected returns
records.title_cn: 基于市场的短期利率不确定性与时变预期收益
records.abstract_en: We show that the cyclical component of market-based short-term interest rate uncertainty (SRU) is a robust predictor of aggregate stock market returns, whereas the slow-moving trend component obscures this predictability. In real-time out-of-sample forecasting, the cyclical component of SRU achieves an R2 of up to 14.22%, significantly outperforming the historical average and a broad set of standard financial and macroeconomic predictors. This predictive performance translates into substantial economic value for mean-variance investors. Mechanistically, the cyclical component captures transient uncertainty shocks that are strongly linked to interest rates, real economic activity, and investor sentiment. A present-value decomposition reveals that the predictive power of cyclical component operates primarily through the cash-flow channel rather than the discount-rate channel.
records.abstract_cn: 我们表明，基于市场的短期利率不确定性（SRU）的周期成分是股票市场总回报的稳健预测因子，而其缓慢移动的趋势成分则掩盖了这种可预测性。在实时样本外预测中，SRU的周期成分实现了高达14.22%的R²，显著优于历史平均值以及一系列标准的金融和宏观经济预测因子。这种预测表现转化为均值-方差投资者的实质性经济价值。从机制上看，周期成分捕捉了与利率、实际经济活动和投资者情绪密切相关的暂时性不确定性冲击。现值分解显示，周期成分的预测能力主要通过现金流渠道而非贴现率渠道发挥作用。

records.journal_name: Journal of Economic Dynamics and Control
records.title_en: Identifying episodes of fiscal austerity: An LLM-based approach
records.title_cn: 识别财政紧缩时期：一种基于大语言模型的方法
records.abstract_en: This paper introduces a hierarchical Large Language Model (LLM) framework for the automated identification of narrative fiscal shocks. We develop a multi-stage architecture to extract austerity episodes from IMF Article IV reports (2004–2020) for 17 OECD countries. Relative to manual coding, our approach improves replicability and auditability by generating a documented sequence of classification steps. Benchmarking against Adler et al. (2024), we find that the LLM-based classification aligns closely with the narrative benchmark, while differing on a small subset of episodes. Local projection estimates indicate that LLM-identified shocks are associated with smaller estimated multipliers than the narrative benchmark, with the difference linked in large part to differences in shock persistence and endogeneity.
records.abstract_cn: 本文介绍了一种分层大语言模型（LLM）框架，用于自动识别叙事性财政冲击。我们开发了一个多阶段架构，从国际货币基金组织（IMF）第四条磋商报告（2004-2020）中提取17个OECD国家的紧缩时期。相对于人工编码，我们的方法通过生成一系列有记录的分类步骤，提高了可复制性和可审计性。与Adler等人（2024）的基准比较，我们发现基于LLM的分类与叙事基准高度一致，但在少数时期上存在差异。局部投影估计表明，LLM识别的冲击所关联的估计乘数小于叙事基准，这一差异在很大程度上与冲击持续性和内生性的差异有关。

records.journal_name: Journal of Economic Dynamics and Control
records.title_en: Bayesian estimation of a large-scale macroeconomic policy agent-based model
records.title_cn: 大规模宏观经济政策主体基模型（ABM）的贝叶斯估计
records.abstract_en: Empirical parameter estimation of large scale agent-based models has long been recognised as computationally challenging. Their bottom-up nature imposes the use of non-parametric or indirect inference methods, which in turn typically requires a significant amount simulated data. However, their high computational requirements makes the application of these estimation methodologies unfeasible in practice. This hurdle can limit the applicability of agent based models for quantitative policy advice, for example in scenario analysis, in cases where the parameter calibration cannot be checked against empirical data. We show how this problem can be overcome by estimating the Dosi et al. (2015) agent-based model. This extends the original ‘Keynes meets Schumpeter’ model of Dosi et al. (2010) allowing for the interaction of fiscal and monetary policy. 18 free parameters of the model are estimated on 10 standard macroeconomic US variables, using annual and quarterly data, and the estimates obtained are shown to improve the fit of the baseline model on the data. A model-selection exercise is carried out, investigating impact of changing the expectation-formation mechanism. Finally, the original policy experiments are replicated using the new empirical estimates, showing that pushing the model into a low-growth regime leads to several key differences relative to the original conclusions. Overall, the exercise establishes the feasibility and relevance of macro-economic empirical parameter estimation and mechanism selection to ABM designers for improving the fit of scenario analyses.
records.abstract_cn: 大规模主体基模型的经验参数估计长期以来被认为在计算上具有挑战性。其自下而上的特性要求使用非参数或间接推断方法，这通常需要大量的模拟数据。然而，其高计算需求使得这些估计方法在实际中难以应用。这一障碍可能限制主体基模型在定量政策建议中的适用性，例如在情景分析中，当参数校准无法与经验数据对照时。我们展示了如何通过估计Dosi等人（2015）的主体基模型来克服这一问题。这扩展了Dosi等人（2010）的原始“凯恩斯遇见熊彼特”模型，允许财政政策和货币政策的相互作用。模型的18个自由参数基于10个标准宏观经济美国变量进行估计，使用年度和季度数据，所得估计显示改善了基线模型对数据的拟合。进行了模型选择练习，考察了改变预期形成机制的影响。最后，使用新的经验估计复制了原始政策实验，表明将模型推入低增长体制会导致与原始结论相比的几个关键差异。总体而言，该练习确立了宏观经济经验参数估计和机制选择对ABM设计者在改进情景分析拟合方面的可行性和相关性。

records.title_en: Fair inequality? Lab evidence from Kenya
records.title_cn: 公平的不平等？来自肯尼亚的实验室证据
records.abstract_en: Attitudes to inequality differ across countries and contexts, and understanding these differences is important for the design of redistributive policies. We here present evidence on fairness preferences in Kenya, based on a series of lab experiments with participants from Nairobi’s largest informal settlement and its main university. This innovative sample allows us to compare the attitudes and beliefs of two important groups in society: the poor and the educated. We find that while the participants from the informal settlements are more egalitarian than the university students, they are less egalitarian than what is generally perceived. A second important finding is the sharp distinction made between distribution and redistribution, where participants are far more willing to equalize funds with no clear entitlement compared to funds where there is an ex-ante allocation. Finally, many participants view luck as a more deserving source of inequality than performance, an observation that is contrary to what is commonly found in the literature. Our results highlight the complexity of people’s fairness views and show the importance of not relying on stereotypes when designing redistributive policies that harmonize with local norms.
records.abstract_cn: 各国和不同情境下对不平等的态度存在差异，理解这些差异对于设计再分配政策至关重要。本文基于一系列实验室实验，研究了肯尼亚的公平偏好，参与者来自内罗毕最大的非正规定居点及其主要大学。该创新样本使我们能够比较社会中两个重要群体——贫困者与受教育者的态度和信念。研究发现，非正规定居点的参与者比大学生更倾向于平等主义，但其平等主义程度低于普遍认知。一个重要发现是参与者在分配与再分配之间存在明显区分：他们更愿意平等分配无明确权利的资金，而非事先已分配的资金。最后，许多参与者认为运气比表现更能正当化不平等，这一观察结果与文献中常见结论相反。我们的结果凸显了人们公平观念的复杂性，强调在设计符合当地规范的再分配政策时不应依赖刻板印象的重要性。

records.title_en: Maternity leave and labour market outcomes
records.title_cn: 产假与劳动力市场结果
records.abstract_en: Using a triple difference estimation strategy, we compare the labour market outcomes of men and women before and just after the implementation of extended maternity leave policy across age profiles of individuals, in India. We find a negative impact of the maternity leave extension policy on the employment of women in high-fertility age cohorts. To explain this intuitively, we adapt a stylized micro-founded model of life-cycle search and matching friction in a gendered environment where the additional cost burden of maternity leave is borne by the firms, as is the case in India. We argue that if the firm’s cost from longer maternity leave duration outweighs the gain from retaining a worker, then the probability of being employed for fertile-age female workers decreases; via increased reservation productivity and decreased market tightness.
