records.abstract_cn: 本文研究了重复横截面数据及跨时期潜在构成变化下的双重差分（DiD）设定。我们首先通过推导有效影响函数和平均处理效应（ATT）的半参数效率界来开始分析。我们引入了非参数估计量，在干扰函数估计量的温和速率条件下达到半参数效率界，展现出一种速率双重稳健（DR）性质。此外，我们记录了与构成变化相关的权衡：我们推导了错误排除构成变化的DR DiD估计量的渐近偏差，以及未能正确排除构成变化时的效率损失。基于这些权衡，我们提出了一种非参数的Hausman型构成变化检验。通过蒙特卡洛实验和实证应用评估了所提出的DiD工具的有限样本性能。我们考虑了框架的扩展，以适应带有交叉拟合的双机器学习程序，以及某些单位在预处理和后处理期间均被观测到的设定。作为分析的副产品，我们提出了局部多项式多项逻辑估计量的新的一致随机展开，这可能具有独立的研究价值。

records.title_en: Functional semiparametric modeling for nonstationary and periodic time series data
records.title_cn: 非平稳和周期时间序列数据的函数半参数建模
records.abstract_en: Inspired by a real data example illustrating the periodicity in hog price data, this study aims to analyze time series that exhibit an unknown period alongside complex covariate effects. To address these complexities and effectively handle the data structures, we incorporate the partial functional varying-coefficient single-index model into the classical time series decomposition model. We propose a two-stage estimation procedure designed to accurately estimate the unknown periodic component and the associated covariate functions. In the first stage, the unknown period is estimated using a penalized least squares approach, where the covariate functions are approximated via B-splines rather than being ignored. In the second stage, given the estimated period, we employ B-splines to estimate key components, including the amplitude of the periodic component, the varying-coefficient functions, the single-index link function, and the functional slope function. Asymptotic results for the proposed estimators are derived, encompassing the consistency of the period estimator as well as the asymptotic properties of the estimated periodic sequence and covariate functions. Furthermore, we conduct simulations to validate the superior performance of the proposed method and demonstrate its practical applicability through the aforementioned empirical example.
records.abstract_cn: 受一个展示生猪价格数据周期性的实际数据示例启发，本研究旨在分析具有未知周期及复杂协变量效应的时间序列。为应对这些复杂性并有效处理数据结构，我们将部分函数变系数单指标模型纳入经典时间序列分解模型。我们提出了一种两阶段估计程序，旨在准确估计未知周期成分及相关协变量函数。在第一阶段，使用惩罚最小二乘法估计未知周期，其中协变量函数通过B样条近似而非忽略。在第二阶段，给定估计的周期，我们采用B样条估计关键成分，包括周期成分的振幅、变系数函数、单指标连接函数和函数斜率函数。推导了所提估计量的渐近结果，涵盖周期估计量的一致性以及估计的周期序列和协变量函数的渐近性质。此外，我们进行模拟以验证所提方法的优越性能，并通过上述实证示例展示其实际适用性。

records.title_en: Robustness to missing data: breakdown point analysis
records.title_cn: 对缺失数据的稳健性：崩溃点分析
records.abstract_en: Missing data is pervasive in econometric applications, and rarely is it plausible that the data are missing (completely) at random. This paper proposes a methodology for studying the robustness of results drawn from incomplete datasets. Selection is measured as the divergence from the distribution of complete observations to the distribution of incomplete observations. The breakdown point is defined as the minimal amount of selection needed to overturn a given result. Reporting point estimates and lower confidence intervals of the breakdown point is a simple, concise way to communicate the robustness of a result. An estimator of the breakdown point is proposed and shown n-consistent and asymptotically normal. This estimator can be applied directly to conclusions drawn from any model identified with the generalized method of moments (GMM) that satisfies mild assumptions. Simulations demonstrate the finite sample performance of the breakdown point estimator on averages, linear regression, and logistic regression. The methodology is illustrated by estimating the breakdown point of conclusions drawn from several randomized controlled trails suffering from missing data due to attrition.
records.abstract_cn: 缺失数据在计量经济学应用中普遍存在，且数据完全随机缺失的假设很少成立。本文提出了一种研究从不完整数据集中所得结果稳健性的方法。选择效应被度量为其与完整观测分布到不完整观测分布的偏离程度。崩溃点定义为推翻给定结果所需的最小选择量。报告崩溃点的点估计和置信区间下界是一种简单、简洁地传达结果稳健性的方式。本文提出了崩溃点的一个估计量，并证明其具有n一致性和渐近正态性。该估计量可直接应用于任何满足温和假设的广义矩方法（GMM）识别模型所得出的结论。模拟实验展示了崩溃点估计量在均值、线性回归和逻辑回归中的有限样本表现。本文通过估计若干因流失而存在缺失数据的随机对照试验所得结论的崩溃点，对该方法进行了说明。

records.title_en: Bootstraps for dynamic panel threshold models
records.title_cn: 动态面板阈值模型的Bootstrap方法
records.abstract_en: This paper develops valid bootstrap inference methods for the dynamic short panel threshold regression. We show that the standard nonparametric bootstrap is inconsistent for the first-differenced generalized method of moments (GMM) estimator. The inconsistency arises from an n1/4-consistent non-normal asymptotic distribution of the threshold estimator when the true parameter lies in the continuity region of the parameter space, which stems from the rank deficiency of the approximate Jacobian of the sample moment conditions on the continuity region. To address this, we propose a grid bootstrap to construct confidence intervals for the threshold and a residual bootstrap to construct confidence intervals for the coefficients. They are shown to be valid regardless of the model’s continuity. Moreover, we establish a uniform validity for the grid bootstrap. A set of Monte Carlo experiments compares the proposed bootstraps with the standard nonparametric bootstrap. An empirical application to a firm investment model illustrates our methods.
records.abstract_cn: 本文为动态短面板阈值回归开发了有效的Bootstrap推断方法。我们证明，标准非参数Bootstrap对一阶差分广义矩（GMM）估计量是不一致的。这种不一致性源于当真实参数位于参数空间的连续区域时，阈值估计量具有n1/4-一致的非正态渐近分布，而这又源于样本矩条件在连续区域上的近似雅可比矩阵秩不足。为解决此问题，我们提出了一种网格Bootstrap来构建阈值的置信区间，以及一种残差Bootstrap来构建系数的置信区间。无论模型是否连续，这些方法都被证明是有效的。此外，我们建立了网格Bootstrap的一致有效性。一系列蒙特卡洛实验将所提出的Bootstrap方法与标准非参数Bootstrap进行了比较。一个关于企业投资模型的实证应用说明了我们的方法。

records.title_en: Inference for time-varying factor models under local stationarity
records.title_cn: 局部平稳条件下时变因子模型的推断
records.abstract_en: This paper considers estimation of and testing for a class of locally stationary time series factor models with evolutionary dynamics, where the entries and dimension of the factor loading matrix are allowed to vary with time while the factors and idiosyncratic components are locally stationary. We propose an adaptive sieve estimator for the span of the time-varying loading matrix of a locally stationary factor process. A uniformly consistent estimator of the effective number of factors is developed via eigenanalysis of a non-negative definite time-varying matrix. We also propose a possibly high-dimensional bootstrap test for the hypothesis of constant factor loadings by comparing the kernels of the covariance matrices of the whole time series with their local counterparts. This test avoids the assumption that factors and idiosyncratic errors are stationary or the covariance matrix of factors is time-invariant. Our results cover both cases of white noise idiosyncratic errors and serially correlated idiosyncratic errors. We examine the finite sample performance of our proposed estimator and test via simulation studies and real data analysis.
records.abstract_cn: 本文考虑一类具有演化动态的局部平稳时间序列因子模型的估计与检验，其中因子载荷矩阵的元素和维度允许随时间变化，而因子和特质成分是局部平稳的。我们提出了一种自适应筛估计量，用于估计局部平稳因子过程的时变载荷矩阵的跨度。通过非负定时间变化矩阵的特征分析，我们开发了一个有效因子数的一致估计量。我们还提出了一个可能高维的bootstrap检验，用于检验常数因子载荷的假设，通过比较整个时间序列的协方差矩阵的核与其局部对应部分。该检验避免了因子和特质误差是平稳的或因子协方差矩阵是时间不变的假设。我们的结果涵盖了白噪声特质误差和序列相关特质误差两种情况。我们通过模拟研究和实际数据分析检验了我们提出的估计量和检验的有限样本性能。

records.title_en: Unobserved component models, approximate filters and dynamic adaptive mixture models
records.title_cn: 不可观测成分模型、近似滤波与动态自适应混合模型
records.abstract_en: State estimation in unobserved component models with parameter uncertainty is traditionally performed through approximate filters, where Gaussian distributions with given moments are employed to replace otherwise intractable conditional densities. This paper re-examines signal-plus-noise models where parameter uncertainty is induced by a latent variable that may assume a fixed number of states. First, it is shown that, for these models, the approximate filters commonly adopted in the literature can be obtained as linear combinations of minimum variance linear unbiased estimators. Second, it is observed that they coincide with filters implied by a novel class of dynamic adaptive mixture models, where the parameters of a mixture of distributions evolve over time following a recursion that is based on the score of the one-step-ahead predictive distribution. Focusing on a robust specification, where the mixture components are Student’s t distributions, we prove existence, stationarity, and ergodicity of the data generating process as well as invertibility of the filter, and consistency and asymptotic normality of the maximum likelihood estimator of the static parameters. An application to energy spot prices is discussed, where the novel specification is compared with, and shown to outperform, robust score-driven filters and the related class of mixture autoregressive models.
records.abstract_cn: 在具有参数不确定性的不可观测成分模型中，状态估计传统上通过近似滤波进行，其中使用具有给定矩的高斯分布来替代原本难以处理的条件密度。本文重新审视了信号加噪声模型，其中参数不确定性由可能取固定数量状态的潜在变量引起。首先，研究表明，对于这些模型，文献中常用的近似滤波可以表示为最小方差线性无偏估计量的线性组合。其次，观察到它们与一类新颖的动态自适应混合模型所隐含的滤波一致，在该模型中，混合分布的参数随时间演变，遵循基于一步预测分布得分的递归。聚焦于稳健设定，其中混合成分为学生t分布，我们证明了数据生成过程的存在性、平稳性和遍历性，以及滤波的可逆性，和静态参数最大似然估计量的一致性和渐近正态性。讨论了在能源现货价格中的应用，其中新颖设定与稳健得分驱动滤波及相关混合自回归模型类别进行比较，并显示出优于后者。

records.title_en: Decomposition and interpretation of treatment effects in settings with delayed outcomes
records.title_cn: 延迟结果环境中治疗效果的分解和解释
records.abstract_en: This paper studies settings where the analyst is interested in identifying and estimating the average direct causal effect of a binary treatment on an outcome. We consider a setup in which the outcome realization does not get immediately realized after the treatment assignment, a feature that is ubiquitous in empirical settings. The period between the treatment and the realization of the outcome allows other observed actions to occur and affect the outcome. In this context, we study several regression-based estimands routinely used in empirical work to capture the average treatment effect and shed light on interpreting them in terms of ceteris paribus effects, indirect causal effects, and selection terms. We obtain three main and related takeaways under a common set of assumptions. First, the three most popular estimands do not generally satisfy what we call strong sign preservation, in the sense that these estimands may be negative even when the treatment positively affects the outcome conditional on any possible combination of other actions. Second, the most popular regression that includes the other actions as controls satisfies strong sign preservation if and only if these actions are mutually exclusive binary variables. Finally, we show that a linear regression that fully stratifies the other actions leads to estimands that satisfy strong sign preservation.
records.abstract_cn: 本文研究了分析师有兴趣识别和估计二元治疗对结果的平均直接因果效应的环境。我们考虑一种设置，其中结果实现在治疗分配后不会立即实现，这是经验设置中普遍存在的特征。治疗和实现结果之间的这段时间允许其他观察到的行为发生并影响结果。在这种背景下，我们研究了实证工作中常用的几种基于回归的估计量，以捕获平均治疗效果，并阐明在其他条件不变的情况下效应、间接因果效应和选择项方面解释它们。我们在一组共同的假设下获得了三个主要且相关的结论。首先，三个最受欢迎的估计量通常不满足我们所说的强符号保留，即即使治疗对结果产生积极影响（以任何可能的其他行动组合为条件），这些估计量也可能是负面的。其次，当且仅当这些动作是互斥的二元变量时，包含其他动作作为控制的最流行的回归满足强符号保留。最后，我们表明，将其他动作完全分层的线性回归会产生满足强符号保留的估计值。

records.title_en: Quantile approach to intertemporal consumption with multiple assets
records.title_cn: 多资产跨期消费的分位数方法
records.abstract_en: This paper develops a novel economic model and econometric methods to jointly identify and estimate parameters related to intertemporal preference and risk attitude. We begin by formulating an intertemporal consumption model with multiple assets based on dynamic quantile preferences that account for elasticity of intertemporal substitution, risk attitude, and discount factor. We establish the properties of the model and obtain interesting explicit expressions for the value function, and the optimal consumption. In addition, we derive the quantile Euler equation. From this equilibrium condition, we show that, when at least two returns are available, one is able to separately identify the risk attitude, which is measured by the quantile τ, and the elasticity of intertemporal substitution and discount factor. We propose new econometric theory for estimating these parameters of interest and establish the statistical properties of the semiparametric two-step estimator. In particular, we show that the estimator is consistent, with a cubic-root rate of convergence, derive its limiting distribution, and suggest a subsampling procedure for inference. Finally, we empirically estimate the structural model, and results show evidence that discount factor is slightly smaller than one, the elasticity of intertemporal substitution is larger than one, and risk attitude is close to the median.
records.abstract_cn: 本文开发了一个新颖的经济模型和计量经济学方法，以联合识别和估计与跨期偏好和风险态度相关的参数。我们首先基于动态分位数偏好构建了一个包含多种资产的跨期消费模型，该模型考虑了跨期替代弹性、风险态度和贴现因子。我们确立了模型的性质，并获得了价值函数和最优消费的有趣显式表达式。此外，我们推导了分位数欧拉方程。从这一均衡条件中，我们表明，当至少有两种回报可用时，能够分别识别由分位数τ衡量的风险态度，以及跨期替代弹性和贴现因子。我们提出了用于估计这些感兴趣参数的新计量经济学理论，并建立了半参数两步估计量的统计性质。特别地，我们证明了该估计量是一致的，具有立方根收敛速率，推导了其极限分布，并建议使用子抽样程序进行推断。最后，我们实证估计了结构模型，结果显示贴现因子略小于一，跨期替代弹性大于一，风险态度接近中位数。

records.title_en: Non-Parametric identification of stationary dynamic discrete choice models
records.title_cn: 平稳动态离散选择模型的非参数识别
records.abstract_en: We provide new non-parametric identification results for stationary dynamic discrete choice models, where both the flow utilities and the distribution of unobserved shocks are fully non-parametric. Our main identification result establishes that a multinomial choice model is non-parametrically identified when there is a special regressor that (i) has a known derivative in the utility function (e.g., enters utility quasi-linearly); (ii) only affects the evolution of the other variables indirectly through the policy function; and (iii) exhibits a type of bounded persistence. To our knowledge, this is the first non-parametric identification result for stationary models that does not require any state variable to exhibit a form of serial independence. Our identification arguments map conditional choice probabilities and the state transition process into structural primitives, and they can be applied to models with persistent unobserved heterogeneity. Our identification results have broad applicability in practice, since candidate variables for the special regressor are already common in the empirical literature.
records.abstract_cn: 我们为平稳动态离散选择模型提供了新的非参数识别结果，其中流动效用和未观测冲击的分布都是完全非参数的。我们的主要识别结果表明，当存在一个特殊回归变量时，多项式选择模型可以被非参数识别，该变量满足：(i) 在效用函数中具有已知导数（例如，以拟线性方式进入效用）；(ii) 仅通过政策函数间接影响其他变量的演化；(iii) 表现出一种有界持续性。据我们所知，这是首个不需要任何状态变量表现出某种序列独立性的平稳模型的非参数识别结果。我们的识别论证将条件选择概率和状态转移过程映射为结构原始要素，并且可以应用于具有持久未观测异质性的模型。我们的识别结果在实践中具有广泛的适用性，因为特殊回归变量的候选变量在实证文献中已经很常见。

records.title_en: Exogenous consideration and extended random utility
records.title_cn: 外生考虑集与扩展随机效用
records.abstract_en: In a consideration set model, an individual maximizes utility among the considered alternatives. I relate an exogenous consideration set additive random utility model to classic discrete choice and the extended additive random utility model, in which utility can be −∞ for infeasible alternatives. When observable utility shifters are bounded, all three models are observationally equivalent. Moreover, they have the same counterfactual bounds and welfare formulas given variation in price-like utility indices. For attention interventions, welfare cannot change in the full consideration model but is completely unbounded in the limited consideration model. The identified set for consideration set probabilities has a minimal width for any bounded support of shifters, but with unbounded support it is a point: identification “towards” infinity does not resemble identification “at” infinity.
records.abstract_cn: 在考虑集模型中，个体在被考虑的备选方案中最大化效用。我将外生考虑集加性随机效用模型与经典离散选择及扩展加性随机效用模型联系起来，后者中不可行备选方案的效用可以为−∞。当可观测效用移位因子有界时，这三个模型在观测上等价。此外，在价格类效用指数变化的情况下，它们具有相同的反事实边界和福利公式。对于注意力干预，在完全考虑模型中福利无法改变，但在有限考虑模型中福利完全无界。考虑集概率的识别集在任何有界移位因子支撑下具有最小宽度，但在无界支撑下它是一个点：向无穷的识别并不类似于在无穷处的识别。

records.title_en: Estimation and inference for CP tensor factor models
records.title_cn: CP张量因子模型的估计与推断
records.abstract_en: High-dimensional tensor-valued data have recently gained attention from researchers in economics and finance. We consider the estimation and inference of high-dimensional tensor factor models, where each dimension of the tensor diverges. Our focus is on a factor model that admits CP-type tensor decomposition, which allows for non-orthogonal loading vectors. Based on the contemporary covariance matrix, we propose an iterative simultaneous projection estimation method. Our estimator is robust to weak dependence among factors and weak correlation across different dimensions in the idiosyncratic shocks. We establish an inferential theory, demonstrating both consistency and asymptotic normality under relaxed assumptions. Within a unified framework, we consider two eigenvalue ratio-based estimators for the number of factors in a tensor factor model and justify their consistency. Simulation studies confirm the theoretical results and an empirical application to sorted portfolios reveals three important factors: a market factor, a long-short factor, and a volatility factor.
records.abstract_cn: 高维张量值数据近来引起了经济学和金融学研究者的关注。我们考虑高维张量因子模型的估计与推断问题，其中张量的每个维度都发散。我们关注的是允许CP型张量分解的因子模型，该模型允许非正交载荷向量。基于当代协方差矩阵，我们提出了一种迭代同时投影估计方法。我们的估计器对因子间的弱依赖以及异质冲击中不同维度间的弱相关性具有稳健性。我们建立了推断理论，在宽松假设下证明了一致性和渐近正态性。在统一框架内，我们考虑了两种基于特征值比率的张量因子数估计器，并证明了它们的一致性。模拟研究证实了理论结果，对排序投资组合的实证应用揭示了三个重要因子：市场因子、多空因子和波动率因子。

records.title_en: Multivariate kernel regression in vector and product metric spaces
records.title_cn: 向量与乘积度量空间中的多元核回归
records.abstract_en: This paper derives limit properties of nonparametric kernel regression estimators without requiring existence of density for regressors in Rq. In functional regression limit properties are established for multivariate functional regression. The rate and asymptotic normality for the Nadaraya–Watson (NW) estimator is established for distributions of regressors in Rq that allow for mass points, factor structure, multicollinearity and nonlinear dependence, as well as fractal distribution; when bounded density exists we provide statistical guarantees for the standard rate and the asymptotic normality without requiring smoothness. We demonstrate faster convergence associated with dimension reducing types of singularity, such as a fractal distribution or a factor structure in the regressors. The paper extends asymptotic normality of kernel functional regression to multivariate regression over a product of any number of metric spaces. Finite sample evidence confirms rate improvement due to singularity in regression over Rq. For functional regression the simulations underline the importance of accounting for multiple functional regressors. We demonstrate the applicability and advantages of the NW estimator in our empirical study, which reexamines the job training program evaluation based on the LaLonde data.
records.abstract_cn: 本文推导了非参数核回归估计量的极限性质，无需要求Rq中回归变量存在密度。在函数回归中，建立了多元函数回归的极限性质。对于Rq中允许质量点、因子结构、多重共线性和非线性依赖以及分形分布的回归变量分布，建立了Nadaraya–Watson（NW）估计量的速率和渐近正态性；当存在有界密度时，我们为标准速率和渐近正态性提供了统计保证，无需光滑性要求。我们展示了与降维型奇异性（如回归变量中的分形分布或因子结构）相关的更快收敛。本文将核函数回归的渐近正态性扩展到任意数量度量空间乘积上的多元回归。有限样本证据证实了Rq上回归中奇异性带来的速率改进。对于函数回归，模拟强调了考虑多个函数回归变量的重要性。我们在实证研究中展示了NW估计量的适用性和优势，该研究基于LaLonde数据重新审视了职业培训项目评估。

records.title_en: Empirical welfare maximization with constraints
records.title_cn: 带约束的经验福利最大化
records.abstract_en: Empirical Welfare Maximization (EWM) is a framework that can be used to select welfare program eligibility policies based on data. This paper extends EWM by allowing for uncertainty in estimating the budget needed to implement the selected policy, in addition to its welfare. Due to the additional estimation error, I show there exist no rules that achieve the highest welfare possible while satisfying a budget constraint uniformly over a wide range of DGPs. This differs from the setting without a budget constraint where uniformity is achievable. I propose an alternative trade-off rule and illustrate it with Medicaid expansion, a setting with imperfect take-up and varying program costs.
records.abstract_cn: 经验福利最大化（EWM）是一个基于数据选择福利项目资格政策的框架。本文通过允许在估计实施所选政策所需预算时存在不确定性，以及其福利的不确定性，扩展了EWM。由于额外的估计误差，我证明不存在任何规则能在满足预算约束的同时，在广泛的数据生成过程（DGPs）上统一实现最高可能的福利。这与无预算约束且可实现统一性的情况不同。我提出了一种替代的权衡规则，并以医疗补助扩展为例进行说明，该情境涉及不完全的接受率和变化的项目成本。

records.title_en: Data-driven policy learning for continuous treatments
records.title_cn: 连续处理变量的数据驱动政策学习
records.abstract_en: This paper studies policy learning for continuous treatments from observational data. Continuous treatments present more significant challenges than discrete ones because population welfare may need nonparametric estimation, and policy space may be infinite-dimensional and may satisfy shape restrictions. We propose to approximate the policy space with a sequence of finite-dimensional spaces and, for any given policy, obtain the empirical welfare by applying the kernel method. We consider two cases: known and unknown propensity scores. In the latter case, we allow for machine learning of the propensity score and modify the empirical welfare to account for the effect of machine learning. The learned policy maximizes the empirical welfare or the modified empirical welfare over the approximating space. In both cases, we modify the penalty algorithm proposed in Mbakop and Tabord-Meehan (2021) to data-automate the tuning parameters (i.e., bandwidth and dimension of the approximating space) and establish an oracle inequality for the welfare regret.
records.abstract_cn: 本文研究了从观测数据中对连续处理变量进行政策学习的问题。连续处理变量比离散处理变量带来更显著的挑战，因为总体福利可能需要非参数估计，且政策空间可能是无限维的并可能满足形状限制。我们提出用一系列有限维空间来逼近政策空间，并且对于任何给定的政策，通过应用核方法获得经验福利。我们考虑两种情况：倾向得分已知和未知。在后一种情况下，我们允许对倾向得分进行机器学习，并修改经验福利以考虑机器学习的影响。学习到的政策在逼近空间上最大化经验福利或修改后的经验福利。在两种情况下，我们修改了Mbakop和Tabord-Meehan (2021)提出的惩罚算法，以数据自动化的方式调整调参参数（即带宽和逼近空间的维度），并为福利遗憾建立了一个神谕不等式。

records.title_en: Multi-horizon test for market frictions
records.title_cn: 市场摩擦的多时间跨度检验
records.abstract_en: We test for the presence of market frictions that induce transitory deviations of observed asset prices from the underlying efficient prices. Our test is based on the joint inference of return covariances across multiple horizons. We demonstrate that a small set of horizons suffices to identify a broad spectrum of frictions, both theoretically and practically. Our method works for high- and low-frequency data under different asymptotic regimes. Extensive simulations show our method outperforms widely used state-of-the-art tests. Our empirical studies indicate that intraday transaction prices from recent years can be considered effectively friction-free at significantly higher frequencies.
records.abstract_cn: 我们检验是否存在导致观测资产价格与潜在有效价格产生暂时性偏离的市场摩擦。我们的检验基于跨多个时间跨度的收益协方差的联合推断。我们证明，无论在理论上还是实践中，一小部分时间跨度就足以识别广泛的市场摩擦类型。我们的方法适用于不同渐近框架下的高频和低频数据。大量模拟显示，我们的方法优于广泛使用的最新检验方法。我们的实证研究表明，近年来的日内交易价格在显著更高的频率下可以被视为实际上无摩擦的。

records.title_en: Nonparametric treatment effect identification in school choice
records.title_cn: 学校选择中的非参数处理效应识别
records.abstract_en: This paper studies nonparametric identification and estimation of causal effects in centralized school assignment. In many centralized assignment algorithms, students face both lottery-driven variation and regression discontinuity- (RD) driven variation. We characterize the full set of identified atomic treatment effects (aTEs), defined as the conditional average treatment effect between a pair of schools given student characteristics. Atomic treatment effects are the building blocks of more aggregated treatment contrasts, and common approaches to estimating aTE aggregations can mask important heterogeneity. In particular, many aggregations of aTEs put zero weight on aTEs driven by RD variation, and estimators of such aggregations put asymptotically vanishing weight on the RD-driven aTEs. We provide a diagnostic and recommend new aggregation schemes. Lastly, we provide estimators and asymptotic results for inference on these aggregations.
records.abstract_cn: 本文研究了集中式学校分配中因果效应的非参数识别与估计。在许多集中式分配算法中，学生同时面临由抽签驱动的变异和由回归不连续性（RD）驱动的变异。我们刻画了所有可识别的原子处理效应（aTEs）的完整集合，其定义为在给定学生特征条件下，一对学校之间的条件平均处理效应。原子处理效应是更聚合处理对比的构建块，而估计aTE聚合的常见方法可能掩盖重要的异质性。特别是，许多aTE的聚合对由RD驱动的aTE赋予零权重，而这些聚合的估计器对RD驱动的aTE赋予渐近消失的权重。我们提供了一种诊断方法，并推荐了新的聚合方案。最后，我们提供了用于这些聚合推断的估计量和渐近结果。

records.title_en: Strategic network formation with many agents
records.title_cn: 多主体战略网络形成
records.abstract_en: We derive asymptotic approximations for models of strategic network formation, where limits are taken as the number of nodes (agents) increases to infinity. Our framework assumes a random utility model where agents have heterogeneous tastes over links, and payoffs allow for anonymous and non-anonymous interaction effects, and the observed network is assumed to be pairwise stable. Our main results concern convergence of the link intensity from finite pairwise stable networks to the (many-player) limiting distribution. The set of possible limiting distributions is shown to have a fairly simple form and is characterized through aggregate equilibrium conditions, which may permit multiple solutions. We illustrate how these formal results can be used to analyze identification of link preferences and estimate or bound preference parameters. We also derive an analytical expression for agents’ welfare (expected surplus) from the structure of the network.
records.abstract_cn: 我们推导了战略网络形成模型的渐近近似，其中极限是随着节点（主体）数量趋于无穷大而取的。我们的框架假设一个随机效用模型，其中主体对链接具有异质性偏好，收益允许匿名和非匿名的交互效应，并且观察到的网络被假定为成对稳定。我们的主要结果涉及链接强度从有限成对稳定网络到（多主体）极限分布的收敛性。可能的极限分布集合被证明具有相当简单的形式，并通过总体均衡条件来刻画，这可能允许多个解。我们说明了这些形式化结果如何用于分析链接偏好的识别以及估计或界定偏好参数。我们还从网络结构中推导出主体福利（预期剩余）的解析表达式。

records.title_en: Uncovering mild drift in asset prices with intraday high-frequency data
records.title_cn: 利用日内高频数据揭示资产价格中的微弱漂移
records.abstract_en: Asset prices are commonly represented as a drift-diffusion process, wherein the drift component denotes the anticipated return of the asset within some time frame, while the diffusion component accommodates random shocks. The drift component has substantial practical significance but accurate estimation is typically challenging and has met with limited success in the existing literature except over large time spans. This paper explores a comprehensive range of drift-diffusion models that include constant, linear, trending, and bursting drift. Conditions are identified under which realized squared drift RSD is a reliable tool for gauging integrated squared drift when the time span Tn is large enough. The recently introduced drift-robust quarticity estimator RiceQ is found to retain consistency under twin asymptotics with Tn → ∞ and infill Δn → 0, subject to some constraints on the divergence rate of Tn across different drift specifications. An inferential method of detecting nonzero drift using RSD and RiceQ is proposed and the drift tests are shown to be consistent under different data generating processes with various conditions on Tn. Simulation studies reveal excellent performance of the realized squared drift measure and the drift test in finite samples. The drift test is demonstrated empirically in real-time surveillance of market abnormalities in the Nasdaq Composite Index over two notable sample periods: the dotcom bubble (1996–2003) and the artificial intelligence boom (2016–2024), using intraday data.
records.abstract_cn: 资产价格通常被表示为漂移-扩散过程，其中漂移成分表示资产在某个时间范围内的预期收益，而扩散成分则容纳随机冲击。漂移成分具有重要的实际意义，但准确估计通常具有挑战性，并且在现有文献中除长时间跨度外成功有限。本文探讨了一系列全面的漂移-扩散模型，包括常数、线性、趋势和爆发性漂移。确定了在时间跨度Tn足够大时，实现平方漂移RSD作为衡量积分平方漂移的可靠工具的条件。新引入的漂移稳健四次方估计量RiceQ在双渐近条件下，即Tn → ∞和填充Δn → 0，且受限于不同漂移规范下Tn的发散速率约束时，保持一致性。提出了一种使用RSD和RiceQ检测非零漂移的推断方法，并证明漂移检验在不同数据生成过程及Tn的各种条件下具有一致性。模拟研究显示，实现平方漂移度量和漂移检验在有限样本中表现优异。漂移检验在纳斯达克综合指数的两个显著样本期内，即互联网泡沫（1996-2003）和人工智能繁荣（2016-2024），使用日内数据进行了实时市场异常监测的实证演示。

records.title_en: Estimation and inference for causal functions with multi-way clustered data
records.title_cn: 多向聚类数据下因果函数的估计与推断
records.abstract_en: We propose methods for estimation and uniform inference for a broad class of causal functions, such as conditional average treatment effects and continuous treatment effects, under multi-way clustering. The causal function is identified as the conditional expectation of a Neyman-orthogonal signal that depends on high-dimensional nuisance parameters. We introduce a two-step procedure: the first step uses machine learning to estimate the nuisance parameters, and the second step projects the estimated Neyman-orthogonal signal onto a dictionary of basis functions whose dimension grows with the sample size. We consider both full-sample and multi-way cross-fitting approaches to this procedure and derive a functional limit theory for the resulting estimators. For uniform inference, we develop a novel resampling method, the multi-way cluster-robust sieve score bootstrap, which extends the sieve score bootstrap of Chen and Christensen (2018) to settings with multi-way clustering. Extensive simulations demonstrate that the proposed methods exhibit favorable finite-sample performance. We apply our approach to study the causal relationship between mistrust levels in Africa and historical exposure to the slave trade. Accounting for the two-way clustering by ethnicity and region, our inference method rejects the null hypothesis of uniformly zero effects and uncover heterogeneous treatment effects, with particularly strong impacts in regions with high historical trade intensity.
records.abstract_cn: 我们提出了在多向聚类下，针对一类广泛的因果函数（如条件平均处理效应和连续处理效应）的估计和一致推断方法。该因果函数被识别为依赖于高维 nuisance 参数的 Neyman 正交信号的条件期望。我们引入了一个两步程序：第一步使用机器学习估计 nuisance 参数，第二步将估计的 Neyman 正交信号投影到一组基函数字典上，其维度随样本量增长。我们考虑了全样本和多向交叉拟合两种方法，并推导了所得估计量的函数极限理论。对于一致推断，我们开发了一种新的重抽样方法，即多向聚类稳健筛分数 bootstrap，它将 Chen 和 Christensen (2018) 的筛分数 bootstrap 扩展到多向聚类设置。大量模拟表明，所提出的方法具有良好的有限样本性能。我们将我们的方法应用于研究非洲不信任水平与历史上奴隶贸易暴露之间的因果关系。考虑到按种族和地区的双向聚类，我们的推断方法拒绝了均匀零效应的原假设，并揭示了异质性处理效应，在历史贸易强度高的地区影响尤为显著。

records.title_en: Estimation and inference for large-dimensional generalized matrix factor models
records.title_cn: 大规模广义矩阵因子模型的估计与推断
records.abstract_en: This article introduces a nonlinear generalized matrix factor model, moving beyond the linear-Gaussian framework to accommodate a broader class of response models typically handled via logit, probit, Poisson, or Tobit structures. We introduce a novel Lagrange multiplier method carefully tailored to ensure that the penalized likelihood function is locally concave around the true factor and loading parameters. This leads to central limit theorems of the estimated factors and loadings which is nontrivial for nonlinear matrix factor modeling. We establish the convergence rates of the estimated factor and loading matrices for the generalized matrix factor model under general conditions that allow for correlations across samples, rows, and columns. We provide a model selection criterion to determine the numbers of row and column factors. Extensive simulation studies demonstrate the superiority in handling discrete and mixed-type variables of the generalized matrix factor model. An empirical data analysis of the company’s operating performance shows that the generalized matrix factor model does clustering and reconstruction well in the presence of discontinuous entries in the data matrix.
records.abstract_cn: 本文介绍了一种非线性广义矩阵因子模型，超越了线性高斯框架，以适应通常通过logit、probit、Poisson或Tobit结构处理的更广泛的响应模型类别。我们引入了一种新颖的拉格朗日乘子方法，精心定制以确保惩罚似然函数在真实因子和载荷参数附近局部凹性。这导致了估计因子和载荷的中心极限定理，这对于非线性矩阵因子建模而言是非平凡的。我们在允许样本、行和列之间相关的通用条件下，建立了广义矩阵因子模型估计因子和载荷矩阵的收敛速率。我们提供了一种模型选择准则来确定行因子和列因子的数量。广泛的模拟研究表明，广义矩阵因子模型在处理离散和混合类型变量方面具有优越性。对公司经营绩效的实证数据分析表明，广义矩阵因子模型在数据矩阵存在不连续条目时，能够很好地完成聚类和重构。

records.title_en: Doubly-robust inference for conditional average treatment effects with high-dimensional controls
records.title_cn: 高维控制变量下条件平均处理效应的双重稳健推断
records.abstract_en: Plausible identification of conditional average treatment effects (CATEs) can rely on controlling for a large number of variables to account for confounding factors. In these high-dimensional settings, estimation of the CATE requires estimating first-stage models whose consistency relies on correctly specifying their parametric forms. While doubly-robust estimators of the CATE exist, inference procedures based on the second-stage CATE estimator are not doubly-robust. Using the popular augmented inverse propensity weighting signal, we propose an estimator for the CATE whose resulting Wald-type confidence intervals are doubly-robust. We assume a logistic model for the propensity score and a linear model for the outcome regression, and estimate the parameters of these models using an ℓ1 (Lasso) penalty to address the high-dimensional covariates. Inference based on this estimator remains valid even if one of the logistic propensity score or linear outcome regression models are misspecified.
records.abstract_cn: 条件平均处理效应（CATE）的合理识别可以依赖于控制大量变量以解释混杂因素。在这些高维设置中，估计CATE需要估计第一阶段模型，其一致性依赖于对其参数形式的正确设定。尽管存在CATE的双重稳健估计量，但基于第二阶段CATE估计量的推断程序并非双重稳健。利用流行的增强逆倾向加权信号，我们提出了一种CATE估计量，其生成的Wald型置信区间是双重稳健的。我们假设倾向得分采用逻辑模型，结果回归采用线性模型，并使用ℓ1（Lasso）惩罚来估计这些模型的参数以处理高维协变量。基于该估计量的推断即使逻辑倾向得分或线性结果回归模型之一被错误设定，仍然有效。

records.title_en: GLS estimation of local projections: Trading robustness for efficiency
records.title_cn: 局部投影的GLS估计：以稳健性换取效率
records.abstract_en: Local projections (LPs) are widely used for estimating impulse responses (IRs) as they are considered more robust to model misspecification than forward-iterated IRs from dynamic models such as VARs. However, this robustness comes at the cost of higher variance, particularly at longer horizons. To mitigate this trade-off, several GLS transformations of LPs have been proposed. This paper analyzes two broad strands of GLS-type LP estimators: those that condition on residuals from an auxiliary VAR, and those that condition on residuals from previous-horizon LPs. We show that the former impose a VAR structure, which leads them to align with VAR IRs, while the latter preserve the unrestricted nature of LPs but end up replicating LP OLS estimates. Consequently, the intended efficiency gains are either not achieved or come at the expense of the very robustness that motivates the use of LPs.
records.abstract_cn: 局部投影（LPs）被广泛用于估计脉冲响应（IRs），因为它们被认为比从动态模型（如VAR）前向迭代得到的IRs对模型误设更具稳健性。然而，这种稳健性以更高的方差为代价，尤其是在较长的时间跨度上。为缓解这一权衡，已有多种LPs的GLS变换被提出。本文分析了两大类GLS型LP估计量：一类以辅助VAR的残差为条件，另一类以先前时间跨度LPs的残差为条件。我们表明，前者施加了VAR结构，使其与VAR IRs一致，而后者保留了LPs的无限制性质，但最终复制了LP OLS估计。因此，预期的效率提升要么未能实现，要么以牺牲促使使用LPs的稳健性为代价。

records.title_en: On generalized CCE estimation
records.title_cn: 广义CCE估计
records.abstract_en: The widely-used common correlated effects (CCE) estimator, pioneered by Pesaran (2006), is computed using least squares applied to auxiliary regressions where the observed regressors are augmented with cross-sectional averages of the dependent variable and regressors. However, the CCE estimator requires a crucial rank condition and becomes inconsistent when this condition is violated and the factor loadings of the x- and y -equations are correlated, causing an endogeneity issue. This paper proposes a generalized CCE (GCCE) estimator by augmenting the regression with both cross-sectional and time-series averages of the regressors. We argue that the time-series average can serve as “control variables” to address the endogeneity issue. We show that the GCCE and CCE estimators are asymptotically equivalent when the rank condition holds, and the GCCE estimator remains consistent even when the rank condition is violated under our “control variable” condition. Therefore, our GCCE estimator is doubly robust, achieving consistency under either the rank condition or the “control variable” condition. Furthermore, we propose a leave-one-out jackknife method to conduct valid inferences regardless of whether the rank condition holds. Monte Carlo simulations demonstrate excellent performance of our estimators and inference methods in finite samples. We apply our new methods to two datasets to estimate the production function and gravity equation.
records.abstract_cn: 由Pesaran（2006）首创的广泛使用的公共相关效应（CCE）估计器，是通过对辅助回归应用最小二乘法计算的，其中观测到的回归变量增加了因变量和回归变量的横截面平均值。然而，CCE估计器需要一个关键的秩条件，当该条件被违反且x方程和y方程的因子载荷相关时，会导致内生性问题，从而使估计不一致。本文通过增加回归变量和回归变量的横截面平均值及时间序列平均值，提出了一种广义CCE（GCCE）估计器。我们认为时间序列平均值可以作为“控制变量”来解决内生性问题。我们证明，当秩条件成立时，GCCE和CCE估计器是渐近等价的，而在我们的“控制变量”条件下，即使秩条件被违反，GCCE估计器仍然保持一致。因此，我们的GCCE估计器具有双重稳健性，在秩条件或“控制变量”条件下都能实现一致性。此外，我们提出了一种留一法刀切法，无论秩条件是否成立，都能进行有效的推断。蒙特卡洛模拟证明了我们的估计器和推断方法在有限样本中的优异表现。我们将新方法应用于两个数据集，以估计生产函数和引力方程。

records.title_en: Efficient estimation of structural models via sieves
records.title_cn: 通过筛子对结构模型的有效估计
records.abstract_en: We propose a class of sieve-based efficient estimators for structural models (SEES), which approximate the solution using a linear combination of basis functions and impose equilibrium conditions as a penalty to determine the best-fitting coefficients. Our estimators circumvent repeated solution of the structural model, apply to a broad class of models, and are consistent, asymptotically normal, and asymptotically efficient. Moreover, they solve unconstrained optimization problems with fewer unknowns and offer convenient standard error calculations. As an illustration, we apply our method to an entry game between Walmart and Kmart.
records.abstract_cn: 我们提出了一类基于筛子的结构模型有效估计器（SEES），该方法使用基函数的线性组合来近似解，并通过施加均衡条件作为惩罚来确定最佳拟合系数。我们的估计器避免了重复求解结构模型，适用于广泛类别的模型，并且具有一致性、渐近正态性和渐近有效性。此外，它们解决了具有较少未知数的无约束优化问题，并提供了便捷的标准误计算。作为示例，我们将该方法应用于沃尔玛和凯马特之间的进入博弈。

records.title_en: Identification in nonlinear dynamic panel models under partial stationarity
records.title_cn: 部分平稳性下非线性动态面板模型的识别
records.abstract_en: This paper provides a general identification approach for a wide range of nonlinear panel data models, including binary choice, ordered response, and other types of limited dependent variable models. Our approach accommodates dynamic models with any number of lagged dependent variables as well as other types of endogenous covariates. Our identification strategy relies on a partial stationarity condition, which allows for not only an unknown distribution of errors, but also temporal dependencies in errors. We derive partial identification results under flexible model specifications and establish sharpness of our identified set in the binary choice setting. We demonstrate the robust finite-sample performance of our approach using Monte Carlo simulations, and apply the approach to the empirical analysis of income categories using various ordered choice models.
records.abstract_cn: 本文为广泛的非线性面板数据模型提供了一种通用的识别方法，包括二元选择、有序响应以及其他类型的受限因变量模型。我们的方法适用于具有任意数量滞后因变量的动态模型以及其他类型的内生协变量。我们的识别策略依赖于部分平稳性条件，该条件不仅允许误差分布未知，还允许误差存在时间依赖性。我们在灵活模型设定下推导出部分识别结果，并在二元选择设定中确立了识别集的锐利性。我们通过蒙特卡洛模拟展示了该方法稳健的有限样本性能，并将该方法应用于使用各种有序选择模型对收入类别的实证分析。

records.title_en: Dynamic panel data quantile regression with network-linked fixed effects
records.title_cn: 带有网络关联固定效应的动态面板数据分位数回归
records.abstract_en: This paper introduces a dynamic panel data quantile regression model with network-linked fixed effects, named DQR-NFE, in which unobserved individual heterogeneity is structured through an underlying network. The corresponding estimator is derived by incorporating a quantile network cohesion (QNC) penalty into the dynamic panel quantile regression framework. This penalty encourages connected units within the network to exhibit similar conditional quantiles, with a particularly increased capacity to capture tail network dependence. Relative to conventional fixed-effects specifications, the proposed framework improves the estimation of unobserved heterogeneity and enables more accurate prediction in cold-start settings where training data are unavailable. We establish the consistency and asymptotic normality of the DQR-NFE estimators within a general nonlinear structural framework. These theoretical guarantees hold under both correctly specified and misspecified network structures, with an explicit characterization of their dependence on the network topology. Simulation studies and empirical applications reveal that the proposed estimator outperforms competing approaches in terms of both estimation accuracy and out-of-sample forecasting.
records.abstract_cn: 本文介绍了一种带有网络关联固定效应的动态面板数据分位数回归模型，命名为DQR-NFE，其中未观测到的个体异质性通过潜在网络进行结构化。相应的估计量通过将分位数网络凝聚（QNC）惩罚纳入动态面板分位数回归框架中推导得出。该惩罚鼓励网络内相连单元表现出相似的条件分位数，特别增强了捕捉尾部网络依赖性的能力。相对于传统的固定效应设定，所提出的框架改进了未观测异质性的估计，并在训练数据不可用的冷启动环境中实现了更准确的预测。我们在一般非线性结构框架内建立了DQR-NFE估计量的一致性和渐近正态性。这些理论保证在正确设定和错误设定的网络结构下均成立，并明确刻画了它们对网络拓扑的依赖性。模拟研究和实证应用表明，所提出的估计量在估计精度和样本外预测方面均优于竞争方法。

records.title_en: Inference for two-stage experiments under covariate-adaptive randomization
records.title_cn: 协变量自适应随机化下两阶段实验的推断
records.abstract_en: This paper studies inference in two-stage randomized experiments under covariate-adaptive randomization. In the initial stage of this experimental design, clusters (e.g., households, schools, or graph partitions) are stratified and randomly assigned to control or treatment groups based on cluster-level covariates. Subsequently, an independent second-stage design is carried out, wherein units within each treated cluster are further stratified and randomly assigned to either control or treatment groups, based on individual-level covariates. Under the homogeneous partial interference assumption, I establish conditions under which the proposed difference-in-“average of averages” estimators are consistent and asymptotically normal for the corresponding average primary and spillover effects and develop consistent estimators of their asymptotic variances. Combining these results establishes the asymptotic validity of tests based on these estimators. My findings suggest that ignoring covariate information in the design stage can result in efficiency loss, and commonly used inference methods that ignore or improperly use covariate information can lead to either conservative or invalid inference. Then, I apply these results to studying optimal use of covariate information under covariate-adaptive randomization in large samples, and demonstrate that a specific generalized matched-pair design achieves minimum asymptotic variance for each proposed estimator. Finally, I discuss covariate adjustment, which incorporates additional baseline covariates not used for treatment assignment. The practical relevance of the theoretical results is illustrated through a simulation study and an empirical application.
records.abstract_cn: 本文研究了在协变量自适应随机化下两阶段随机实验的推断问题。在该实验设计的初始阶段，聚类（例如，家庭、学校或图划分）根据聚类层面的协变量进行分层，并随机分配到对照组或处理组。随后，进行独立的第二阶段设计，其中每个处理聚类内的单元根据个体层面的协变量进一步分层，并随机分配到对照组或处理组。在同质部分干扰假设下，我建立了所提出的“平均值之差”估计量对于相应的平均主要效应和溢出效应具有一致性和渐近正态性的条件，并开发了其渐近方差的一致估计量。结合这些结果，确立了基于这些估计量的检验的渐近有效性。我的发现表明，在设计阶段忽略协变量信息可能导致效率损失，而常见的不考虑或不当使用协变量信息的推断方法可能导致保守或无效的推断。然后，我将这些结果应用于研究在大样本下协变量自适应随机化中协变量信息的最优使用，并证明一种特定的广义匹配对设计对于每个提出的估计量都能达到最小渐近方差。最后，我讨论了协变量调整，该调整纳入了未用于处理分配的额外基线协变量。理论结果的实际相关性通过模拟研究和实证应用加以说明。

records.title_en: A simple, robust identification approach for first-price auctions
records.title_cn: 一种简单、稳健的一级价格拍卖识别方法
records.abstract_en: This paper proposes a new approach to the identification of first-price auctions that is robust to overbidding, but at the same time remains contiguous with the canonical point-identification approach of Guerre et al. (2000) (GPV) and its simple estimators. We show that a weak identifying restriction allows us to reinterpret the GPV estimates as a bound. We demonstrate that the identifying restriction holds in a set of commonly used auction models that can generate overbidding and is satisfied in the bid data from a laboratory experiment. We illustrate the approach in applications to laboratory data and field data. We recommend that practitioners continue to follow the GPV approach, but interpret the estimates as a bound in applications where they are concerned about overbidding.
records.abstract_cn: 本文提出了一种新的识别一级价格拍卖的方法，该方法对过度出价具有稳健性，但同时与Guerre等人（2000）（GPV）的经典点识别方法及其简单估计量保持连续性。我们证明，一个较弱的识别约束允许我们将GPV估计重新解释为一个界限。我们证明了该识别约束在一组能够产生过度出价的常用拍卖模型中成立，并且在实验室实验的出价数据中得到满足。我们在实验室数据和实地数据的应用中展示了该方法。我们建议实践者继续遵循GPV方法，但在担心过度出价的应用中，应将估计解释为一个界限。

records.title_en: The natural rate of interest through a hall of mirrors
records.title_cn: 透过镜像迷宫看自然利率
records.abstract_en: We propose a novel explanation for persistent movements in the natural rate of interest, or r-star, based on a model of two-sided learning between the central bank and the private sector. Each side has some information about r-star fundamentals and also learns from observing output, inflation and interest rates. When both sides fail to recognise that their actions influence the other’s beliefs, a “hall-of-mirrors” effect arises that causes persistent shifts in r-star in response to cyclical shocks. The model can explain the post-2008 decline in r-star without changes in long-run fundamentals, as well as the excess sensitivity of long-term yields to monetary policy surprises and the underreaction of interest rate forecasts. Aggressive policy easing designed to counter a recession can inadvertently lower r-star and endogenously narrow policy space.
records.abstract_cn: 我们基于中央银行与私人部门之间双向学习的模型，提出了对自然利率（即r-star）持续性变动的新解释。每一方都掌握一些关于r-star基本面的信息，并通过观察产出、通胀和利率来学习。当双方都未能认识到自身行为会影响对方的信念时，就会出现“镜像迷宫”效应，导致r-star对周期性冲击产生持续性变动。该模型可以解释2008年后r-star的下降，而无需改变长期基本面，同时也能解释长期收益率对货币政策意外的过度敏感以及利率预测的反应不足。为应对衰退而采取的激进政策宽松可能无意中降低r-star，并内生性地收窄政策空间。

records.title_en: Generating inflation expectations with large language models
records.title_cn: 利用大型语言模型生成通胀预期
records.abstract_en: This paper studies the generation of inflation expectations using generative AI in survey experiments, examining diverse agents created with both proprietary and open-source large language models (LLMs). It shows that model architecture significantly impacts expectations, with proprietary models generally exhibiting less disagreement in their responses than open-source alternatives. Some LLMs predict higher inflation than actual rates, aligning with patterns observed in the Survey of Consumer Expectations. Information treatments, particularly forward guidance on inflation, influence LLMs’ inflation expectations, though with varying magnitudes across model types. Customizing prompts with demographic personas induces heterogeneous responses that mirror human survey behaviors, with some biases similar to those documented in household surveys. The paper also demonstrates how central banks could leverage these models as communication policy tools to test messaging strategies before implementation.
records.abstract_cn: 本文研究在调查实验中使用生成式人工智能生成通胀预期，考察了由专有和开源大型语言模型（LLMs）创建的不同智能体。研究表明，模型架构对预期有显著影响，专有模型在响应中的分歧通常小于开源替代模型。一些LLMs预测的通胀率高于实际水平，这与消费者预期调查中观察到的模式一致。信息处理，特别是关于通胀的前瞻性指引，会影响LLMs的通胀预期，尽管不同模型类型的影响幅度有所不同。使用人口统计特征定制提示词会引发异质性响应，这些响应反映了人类调查行为，其中一些偏差与家庭调查中记录的偏差相似。本文还展示了中央银行如何利用这些模型作为沟通政策工具，在实施前测试信息传递策略。

records.title_en: Biased surveys
records.title_cn: 有偏的调查
records.abstract_en: We find empirical evidence that surveys of professional forecasters are biased by strategic incentives. First, we find that individual forecasts overreact to idiosyncratic information but underreact to common information. We show this is consistent with a model of strategic diversification incentives in forecast reporting where forecasters want to optimally “stand out” from the crowd, and thus report forecasts that exaggerate the agents’ true beliefs. Second, we show that no such biases are present in forecasts data that is not subject to strategic incentives. We also test further comparative statics that also confirm the strategic incentive model. Overall, we conclude that strategic reporting biases the inference an econometrician can draw on the true underlying expectations formation process, and the precision and heterogeneity in agents’ information sets, and lastly we show how to correct for this.
records.abstract_cn: 我们发现了专业预测者调查因策略性激励而产生偏差的经验证据。首先，我们发现个体预测对特殊信息过度反应，但对公共信息反应不足。我们表明这与预测报告中策略性多样化激励的模型一致，其中预测者希望最优地“脱颖而出”，从而报告夸大代理人真实信念的预测。其次，我们表明在不受策略性激励影响的预测数据中不存在此类偏差。我们还测试了进一步比较静态分析，这些分析也证实了策略性激励模型。总体而言，我们得出结论，策略性报告会使计量经济学家对真实预期形成过程的推断，以及代理人信息集中的精确性和异质性产生偏差，最后我们展示了如何对此进行修正。

records.title_en: A theory of fear of floating
records.title_cn: 浮动恐惧理论
records.abstract_en: Central banks with flexible exchange rate regimes are often reluctant to let their currency float, a phenomenon known as “fear of floating.” We develop a framework in which a floating exchange rate may exacerbate vulnerability to self-fulfilling financial crises rather than provide the intended insulation against external shocks. A commitment to a crawling peg—where the currency can fluctuate within a predetermined band—can help mitigate the risk of self-fulfilling crises. In contrast to the Mundell–Fleming paradigm, the optimal exchange rate policy entails allowing the exchange rate to float in response to real shocks while maintaining it fixed in response to non-fundamental shocks.
records.abstract_cn: 实行浮动汇率制度的中央银行往往不愿让其货币浮动，这一现象被称为“浮动恐惧”。我们构建了一个框架，在该框架中，浮动汇率可能加剧对自我实现金融危机的脆弱性，而非提供预期的对外部冲击的隔离。承诺实行爬行盯住汇率制度——即货币可以在预定区间内波动——有助于缓解自我实现危机的风险。与蒙代尔-弗莱明范式相反，最优汇率政策要求允许汇率对实际冲击作出浮动反应，同时在对非基本面冲击时保持固定。

records.title_en: Dissecting the great retirement boom
records.title_cn: 解析大退休潮
records.abstract_en: Between 2020 and 2023, the fraction of retirees in the working-age population in the U.S. increased above its pre-pandemic trend. Several explanations have been proposed to rationalize this gap, including increases in net worth, the deterioration of the labor market with higher job separations, the expansion of fiscal transfer programs, and higher mortality risk. We develop an incomplete markets, overlapping generations model with a frictional labor market to quantitatively study the interaction of these factors and decompose their contributions to the rise in retirements. We find that new retirements were concentrated at the bottom of the income distribution, and the most important factors driving the rise in retirements were higher job separations and the expansion of fiscal transfers. We show that our model’s predictions on aggregate labor market moments and cross-sectional moments on retirement patterns across income and wealth distributions are in line with the data.
records.abstract_cn: 在2020年至2023年间，美国劳动年龄人口中退休人员的比例上升至高于疫情前趋势的水平。已有多种解释被提出以合理化这一差距，包括净资产增加、劳动力市场恶化导致更高的职位分离率、财政转移支付项目的扩张以及更高的死亡风险。我们构建了一个具有摩擦性劳动力市场的不完全市场世代交叠模型，以定量研究这些因素的相互作用，并分解它们对退休人数上升的贡献。我们发现，新增退休人员集中在收入分配的底部，而推动退休人数上升的最重要因素是更高的职位分离率和财政转移支付的扩张。我们表明，我们的模型在总体劳动力市场矩以及按收入和财富分布划分的退休模式的横截面矩方面的预测与数据相符。

records.title_en: Soft landing and inflation scares
records.title_cn: 软着陆与通胀恐慌
records.abstract_en: We discuss the timing and strength of the Fed’s reaction to the recent inflation surge within an estimated macroeconomic model where long-run inflation expectations are heterogeneous and can lose their anchoring to the target. The resulting inflation scare worsens the real cost of disinflation. We derive a closed-form solution that retains the entire time-varying cross-sectional distribution of subjective inflation beliefs. We estimate the model using Bayesian techniques on both US macroeconomic time series and forecast data from the Survey of Professional Forecasters. Counterfactual simulations show that the timing – rather than the strength – of the policy reaction to the inflation surge is critical to contain the development of an inflation scare and prevent the entrenchment of above-target inflation. We show that the Fed fell behind the curve in 2021 since an earlier tightening could have reduced the inflation peak without triggering a recession. However, further delays would have unanchored inflation expectations, aggravated the inflation scare and strengthened the inflation surge, resulting in larger output losses.
records.abstract_cn: 我们在一个估计的宏观经济模型中讨论了美联储对近期通胀飙升反应的时机和力度，该模型中长期通胀预期是异质的，并且可能失去对目标的锚定。由此产生的通胀恐慌加剧了反通胀的实际成本。我们推导出一个闭式解，该解保留了主观通胀信念的整个时变横截面分布。我们使用贝叶斯技术对美国宏观经济时间序列和来自专业预测者调查的预测数据进行模型估计。反事实模拟表明，政策对通胀飙升反应的时机——而非力度——对于遏制通胀恐慌的发展并防止高于目标的通胀根深蒂固至关重要。我们表明，美联储在2021年落后于曲线，因为更早的紧缩本可以降低通胀峰值而不引发衰退。然而，进一步的延迟会使通胀预期脱锚，加剧通胀恐慌并强化通胀飙升，从而导致更大的产出损失。

records.title_en: Inequality and asset prices during Sudden Stops
records.title_cn: 突然停止期间的不平等与资产价格
records.abstract_en: This paper studies the cross-sectional dimension of Fisher’s debt-deflation mechanism that triggers endogenous Sudden Stop crises — i.e., episodes with large reversals in the current account. Analyzing microdata from Mexico, we show that this dimension has macroeconomic implications that operate via opposing effects. First, an amplifying effect by which households with high leverage fire-sale their assets during crises, increasing downward pressure on asset prices. Second, a dampening effect by which wealthy households with low leverage buy depressed assets, relieving downward pressure on asset prices. As a result, the role of inequality during crises is ambiguous. We conduct a quantitative analysis using a calibrated small open economy, asset-pricing model with heterogeneous agents and aggregate risk to measure the effects of inequality during crises. The model suggests that economies with lower inequality, whether due to reduced idiosyncratic risk or wealth redistribution across agents, experience less severe crises, as observed in the data.
records.abstract_cn: 本文研究了费雪债务通缩机制的横截面维度，该机制触发内生性突然停止危机——即经常账户大幅逆转的时期。通过分析墨西哥的微观数据，我们表明这一维度通过相反的作用产生宏观经济影响。首先，放大效应，即高杠杆家庭在危机期间抛售资产，增加资产价格的下行压力。其次，抑制效应，即低杠杆的富裕家庭购买贬值资产，缓解资产价格的下行压力。因此，不平等在危机期间的作用是模糊的。我们使用校准的小型开放经济、资产定价模型，包含异质主体和总体风险，进行定量分析，以衡量危机期间不平等的影响。模型表明，不平等程度较低的经济体，无论是由于个体风险降低还是财富在主体间的再分配，经历的危机严重程度较低，正如数据所观察到的。

records.title_en: Bridging micro and macro production functions: The fiscal multiplier of infrastructure investment
records.title_cn: 连接微观与宏观生产函数：基础设施投资的财政乘数
records.abstract_en: This paper investigates the fiscal multiplier of infrastructure investment using an estimated heterogeneous-firm general equilibrium model. We theoretically and quantitatively show that the firm-level non-rivalry in infrastructure usage drives a significant discrepancy in the estimated input elasticities between the firm and state levels. Moreover, it microfounds the increasing returns to scale assumption in a representative-agent framework (Baxter and King, 1993). The quantitative findings indicate a fiscal multiplier of approximately 1.15 over a 2-year horizon, suggesting a significantly greater net economic benefit than the representative-agent model prediction. This is due to the low sensitivity of the firm-level investment to the general equilibrium effect, followed by a significantly dampened crowding out.
records.abstract_cn: 本文利用一个估计的异质性企业一般均衡模型研究基础设施投资的财政乘数。我们在理论和数量上表明，企业层面在基础设施使用上的非竞争性导致了企业和国家层面估计的投入弹性之间存在显著差异。此外，它为代表性主体框架中的规模报酬递增假设提供了微观基础（Baxter和King，1993）。定量研究结果表明，在2年时间范围内，财政乘数约为1.15，这表明其净经济效益显著大于代表性主体模型的预测。这是由于企业层面的投资对一般均衡效应的敏感性较低，随后挤出效应显著减弱。

records.title_en: The rise of AI pricing: Trends, driving forces, and implications for firm performance
records.title_cn: AI定价的兴起：趋势、驱动力及其对企业绩效的影响
records.abstract_en: We document key stylized facts about the time-series trends and cross-sectional distributions of artificial intelligence (AI)-powered pricing and study its implications for firm performance, both on average and in response to monetary policy shocks. We use the online job postings data from Lightcast to measure the adoption of AI pricing. We infer that a firm is adopting AI pricing if it posts a job that requires AI-related skills and contains the keyword “pricing.” At the aggregate level, the share of AI pricing jobs in all pricing jobs has increased more than tenfold since 2010. The rise of AI pricing jobs has been broad-based, spreading across more industries than other types of AI jobs. At the firm level, larger and more productive firms are more likely to adopt AI pricing. Firms that adopted AI pricing experienced faster growth in sales, employment, assets, and markups, and their stock returns are also more responsive to high-frequency monetary policy surprises than non-adopters. We show that these empirical observations can be rationalized by a simple model where a monopolist firm with incomplete information about its demand function invests in AI pricing to acquire information.
records.abstract_cn: 我们记录了人工智能（AI）驱动定价的时间序列趋势和横截面分布的关键典型事实，并研究了其对企业绩效的影响，既包括平均影响，也包括对货币政策冲击的响应。我们使用来自Lightcast的在线职位发布数据来衡量AI定价的采用情况。我们推断，如果一家公司发布的职位要求具备AI相关技能并包含关键词“定价”，则该公司在采用AI定价。在总体层面，自2010年以来，AI定价职位在所有定价职位中的占比增长了十倍以上。AI定价职位的增长具有广泛性，其覆盖的行业范围比其他类型的AI职位更广。在企业层面，规模更大、生产率更高的企业更可能采用AI定价。采用AI定价的企业在销售额、就业、资产和加成率方面经历了更快的增长，其股票回报对高频货币政策意外事件的响应也强于未采用者。我们表明，这些实证观察可以通过一个简单模型来解释，在该模型中，对其需求函数信息不完全的垄断企业投资于AI定价以获取信息。

records.title_en: The impact of AI on global knowledge work
records.title_cn: 人工智能对全球知识工作的影响
records.abstract_en: We analyze how Artificial Intelligence (AI) reshapes global knowledge work in a two-region world where firms organize production hierarchically to use knowledge efficiently: the most knowledgeable individuals specialize in problem-solving, while others perform routine work. Before AI, the Advanced Economy specializes in problem-solving services, whereas the Emerging Economy focuses on routine work. AI converts compute — which is located in the Advanced Economy — into autonomous “AI agents” that perfectly substitute for humans with a given level of knowledge. Basic AI reduces the Advanced Economy’s net exports of problem-solving services, potentially reversing pre-AI trade patterns. In contrast, sophisticated AI expands these exports, reinforcing existing trade patterns. Finally, we show that a global ban on AI autonomy redistributes AI’s gains toward lower-skilled workers, while a regional ban — such as prohibiting autonomy only in the Emerging Economy — offers little benefit to lower-skilled workers and harms the most knowledgeable individuals in that region.
records.abstract_cn: 我们分析了人工智能（AI）如何在一个两区域世界中重塑全球知识工作，其中企业按层级组织生产以高效利用知识：知识最丰富的个体专门从事问题解决，而其他人则执行常规工作。在AI出现之前，发达经济体专门从事问题解决服务，而新兴经济体则专注于常规工作。AI将计算能力（位于发达经济体）转化为自主的“AI代理”，这些代理完美替代具有给定知识水平的人类。基础AI减少了发达经济体问题解决服务的净出口，可能逆转AI之前的贸易模式。相反，复杂的AI扩大了这些出口，强化了现有的贸易模式。最后，我们表明，全球禁止AI自主性将AI的收益重新分配给低技能工人，而区域禁令——例如仅在新兴经济体禁止自主性——对低技能工人的益处甚微，并损害该地区知识最丰富的个体。

records.title_en: AI and task efficiency
records.title_cn: 人工智能与任务效率
records.abstract_en: We model several ways in which AI may improve decisions, raise the productivity of firms, and raise human capital growth. Each focuses on activities that involve problem solving, with solutions being guided by signals. If AI raises the accuracy of the signals, humans will then make better decisions — individually and in groups.
records.abstract_cn: 我们构建了人工智能可能改善决策、提高企业生产率以及促进人力资本增长的几种模型。每种模型都聚焦于涉及问题解决的活动，其解决方案由信号引导。如果人工智能提高了信号的准确性，那么人类——无论是个人还是群体——将做出更好的决策。

records.title_en: Is it AI or data that drives firm market power?
records.title_cn: 是人工智能还是数据驱动了企业市场势力？
records.abstract_en: The technology revolution is transforming firm and industry dynamics, yet the roots of firm dominance in the modern economy remain unclear. Is industry dynamism driven by compute capabilities (AI), access to data, or the interaction between them? We develop a dynamic model in which firms gain knowledge from raw data using AI, but face “informational entropy”: without sufficient AI, more raw data leads to information overload and has negative returns. The model has two key predictions: (1) improvements in AI (compute) disproportionately benefit data-rich firms; and (2) access to processed data substitutes for compute, increasing industry dynamism and reducing market concentration. We confirm these predictions using novel data from 2000–2023 and two exogenous shocks: the 2006 launch of Amazon Web Services (AWS) and the 2017 introduction of transformer-based architectures. Our findings suggest that regulating data usability, not just AI models, is essential to preserving competition in the modern economy.
records.abstract_cn: 技术革命正在改变企业和行业动态，然而现代经济中企业主导地位的根源仍不明确。行业动态是由计算能力（人工智能）、数据获取还是它们之间的相互作用驱动的？我们开发了一个动态模型，其中企业利用人工智能从原始数据中获取知识，但面临“信息熵”：在没有足够人工智能的情况下，更多原始数据会导致信息过载并产生负回报。该模型有两个关键预测：（1）人工智能（计算）的改进不成比例地惠及数据丰富的企业；（2）获取处理后的数据替代计算，增加行业动态并降低市场集中度。我们使用来自2000-2023的新数据和两个外生冲击验证了这些预测：2006年亚马逊网络服务（AWS）的推出和2017年基于变换器架构的引入。我们的研究结果表明，监管数据可用性，而不仅仅是人工智能模型，对于维护现代经济中的竞争至关重要。

records.title_en: Multinational production and global shock propagation during the great recession
records.title_cn: 跨国生产与全球衰退期间的冲击传导
records.abstract_en: Using a new database on global multinational production (MP), I document that world multinational enterprise (MNE) sales declined as sharply as trade during the Great Recession (2008–2009). This collapse was driven by MNEs from a few key headquarters countries and associated with steeper GDP declines in MP-intensive countries. MNEs amplified the trade collapse because their overall sales fell while they maintained higher trade intensity than domestic firms. In a calibrated quantitative model with flexible vertical and horizontal MNE structures, international trade, and input–output linkages, I show that productivity shocks, which disproportionately affected trade-intensive MNEs, contributed more to the trade collapse than demand shocks. MNEs’ productivity shocks accounted for over half of the global GDP decline during the Great Recession. MP linkages significantly amplified the transmission of headquarters-country productivity shocks to global GDP, MP, and trade.
records.abstract_cn: 利用一个新的全球跨国生产（MP）数据库，我记录了在大衰退（2008-2009年）期间，世界跨国企业（MNE）的销售额下降幅度与贸易下降幅度一样剧烈。这一崩溃是由来自少数几个关键总部国家的跨国企业驱动的，并与跨国生产密集型国家的GDP下降更为陡峭相关。跨国企业放大了贸易崩溃，因为它们的总销售额下降，同时它们保持了比国内企业更高的贸易强度。在一个具有灵活垂直和水平跨国企业结构、国际贸易和投入产出关联的校准定量模型中，我表明，不成比例地影响贸易密集型跨国企业的生产率冲击，比需求冲击对贸易崩溃的贡献更大。跨国企业的生产率冲击占大衰退期间全球GDP下降的一半以上。跨国生产联系显著放大了总部国家生产率冲击对全球GDP、跨国生产和贸易的传导。

records.title_en: The price of intelligence: How should socially-minded firms price and deploy AI?
records.title_cn: 智能的价格：具有社会意识的公司应如何定价和部署人工智能？
records.abstract_en: Leading AI firms claim to prioritize social welfare. How should firms with a social mandate price and deploy AI? We derive pricing formulas that depart from profit maximization by incorporating incentives to improve welfare and reduce labor disruptions. Using US data, we evaluate several scenarios. A welfarist firm that values both profit and welfare should price closer to marginal cost, as efficiency gains outweigh distributional concerns. A conservative firm focused on labor-market stability should price above the profit-maximizing level in the short run, especially when its AI may displace low-income workers. Overall, socially minded firms face a trade-off between expanding access to AI and the resulting loss in profits and labor market risks.
records.abstract_cn: 领先的人工智能公司声称优先考虑社会福利。具有社会使命的公司应如何定价和部署人工智能？我们推导出的定价公式偏离了利润最大化，纳入了改善福利和减少劳动力中断的激励。利用美国数据，我们评估了几种情景。一个重视利润和福利的福利主义公司应将价格定得更接近边际成本，因为效率收益超过分配关切。一个专注于劳动力市场稳定的保守公司短期内应将价格定在利润最大化水平之上，尤其是当其人工智能可能取代低收入工人时。总体而言，具有社会意识的公司在扩大人工智能获取与由此产生的利润损失和劳动力市场风险之间面临权衡。

records.title_en: Expectation-driven term structure of equity and bond yields
records.title_cn: 预期驱动的股票与债券收益率期限结构
records.abstract_en: This paper develops a noisy-information equilibrium model to study how subjective expectations shape the joint dynamics of equity and bond yields. In our framework, movements in asset yields are driven by subjective expectations of dividend and GDP growth, rather than time-varying risk premia. A dual-component dividend structure, together with belief distortions, generates key asset-pricing facts: short-term equity yields are more volatile than long-term yields because short-run dividend growth expectations mean-revert to their stable long-run counterpart; the equity yield slope is procyclical due to countercyclical term structure of expected dividend growth; and the bond-stock correlation changes from positive to negative after the late 1990s, reflecting a shift in the correlation between expected GDP and dividend growth. The model also implies predictable dividend strip returns, with predictability declining with maturity due to dividend forecast revisions, and it successfully replicates the observed dynamics of equity yields and some aggregate moments.
records.abstract_cn: 本文开发了一个噪声信息均衡模型，研究主观预期如何塑造股票和债券收益率的联合动态。在我们的框架中，资产收益率的变动由股息和GDP增长的主观预期驱动，而非时变的风险溢价。双成分股息结构，连同信念扭曲，产生了关键的资产定价事实：短期股票收益率比长期收益率更具波动性，因为短期股息增长预期均值回归至其稳定的长期对应值；股票收益率斜率是顺周期的，因为预期股息增长的期限结构是逆周期的；债券-股票相关性在1990年代末之后由正转负，反映了预期GDP增长与股息增长之间相关性的转变。该模型还暗示了可预测的股息条回报，其可预测性随期限增加而下降，这是由于股息预测修正所致，并且它成功复制了观察到的股票收益率动态和一些总体矩。

records.title_en: A choice-based approach to the measurement of inflation expectations
records.title_cn: 基于选择的通胀预期测量方法
records.abstract_en: Economists widely rely on measures of inflation expectations and uncertainty elicited via density forecasts. This approach, which asks respondents to assign probabilities to pre-specified ranges, has proven highly informative, but also faced criticism in recent periods of elevated and volatile inflation. We propose a new method to elicit the full distribution of inflation expectations, which is rooted in decision theory and can be implemented in standard surveys. In two large surveys and a laboratory experiment, we demonstrate that the proposed method leads to well-defined expectations that fulfil both subjective and objective quality criteria. The method is neither perceived as more difficult nor does it take more time to complete compared to the current standard. In contrast to density forecasts, the method is robust to differences in the state of the economy and thus allows comparisons across time and across countries. The method is portable and can be applied to elicit different macroeconomic expectations.
records.abstract_cn: 经济学家广泛依赖通过密度预测引出的通胀预期和不确定性度量。这种方法要求受访者为预先设定的区间分配概率，已被证明信息量丰富，但在近期通胀高企且波动加剧的时期也面临批评。我们提出了一种新方法，用于引出通胀预期的完整分布，该方法植根于决策理论，并可在标准调查中实施。在两项大型调查和一项实验室实验中，我们证明了所提出的方法能够产生定义明确的预期，满足主观和客观质量标准。与当前标准相比，该方法既不被认为更困难，也不耗时更多。与密度预测相比，该方法对经济状态的差异具有稳健性，因此允许跨时间和跨国家的比较。该方法具有可移植性，可应用于引出不同的宏观经济预期。

records.title_en: Consumer durables and monetary policy according to HANK
records.title_cn: 消费者耐用品与货币政策：基于HANK模型的分析
records.abstract_en: Durables’ interest-rate sensitivity and their persistent comovement with nondurable spending are hallmarks of monetary policy transmission. We develop a two-sector HANK model that replicates this pattern—both across spending categories and among households sorted by liquid asset holdings, consistent with empirical evidence. Direct effects of real interest rate changes are quantitatively important in reproducing sectoral expenditure comovement, while infrequent information updating is crucial to match the hump-shaped dynamics of sectoral and aggregate expenditures. Income effects are essential to preventing counterfactual declines in nondurable spending resulting from fiscal interventions specifically aimed at stimulating durable purchases.
records.abstract_cn: 耐用品的利率敏感度及其与非耐用品支出的持续联动是货币政策传导的标志性特征。我们构建了一个两部门HANK模型，该模型复制了这一模式——无论是在支出类别之间，还是在按流动资产持有量排序的家庭之间，均与实证证据一致。实际利率变动的直接效应在再现部门支出联动方面具有定量重要性，而信息更新频率低对于匹配部门及总支出驼峰形动态至关重要。收入效应对于防止专门旨在刺激耐用品购买的财政干预导致非耐用品支出反事实下降至关重要。

records.title_en: Artificial intelligence and cognitive inequality
records.title_cn: 人工智能与认知不平等
records.abstract_en: We combine insights from the medical and artificial intelligence (AI) literatures to propose a novel model, which suggests that the expansion of AI may exacerbate cognitive inequality. Information providers maximize profit by tailoring the complexity of content, offering less cognition-enhancing content to less able customers. While individuals with high cognitive abilities may benefit from this increased within-cognitive-group homogeneity, those with lower cognitive abilities – and even children – may suffer adverse effects. Anecdotal data from political discourse and cognitive skills scores are consistent with the model predictions. The findings introduce a new consideration to the debate on financial literacy and AI regulation.
records.abstract_cn: 我们结合医学和人工智能（AI）文献的见解，提出一个新模型，该模型表明AI的扩展可能加剧认知不平等。信息提供者通过调整内容的复杂性来最大化利润，向能力较弱的客户提供较少促进认知的内容。虽然高认知能力的个体可能从这种认知群体内同质性的增加中受益，但认知能力较低的个体——甚至儿童——可能遭受不利影响。来自政治话语和认知技能得分的轶事数据与模型预测一致。这些发现为金融素养和AI监管的辩论引入了新的考量。

records.title_en: Lender concentration of external debts and sudden stops
records.title_cn: 外部债务的贷款人集中度与骤停
records.abstract_en: This paper studies how the lender structure of external debt affects open economies’ credit conditions via a model with lenders of varying sizes. While atomistic lenders take the collateral price as given, large lenders internalize the pecuniary externality whereby selling foreclosed collateral injects supply and reduces its price. Thus, concentrating external debt in a few large lenders supports a high collateral price during financial downturns, leading borrowers to demand less precautionary savings and overborrow. I document that emerging countries borrow from significantly fewer banks than advanced countries, implying that emerging countries tend to overborrow. This new mechanism complements the existing view of overborrowing due to the pecuniary externality of the borrowers. Under plausible parameterization, the size of the pecuniary externality internalized by lenders is two-thirds of that internalized by borrowers. Finally, allowing lender countries to optimally choose lender structure increases lender concentration, raises debt, and improves borrowers’ welfare.
records.abstract_cn: 本文通过一个包含不同规模贷款人的模型，研究外部债务的贷款人结构如何影响开放经济体的信贷条件。原子式贷款人将抵押品价格视为给定，而大型贷款人则将变卖止赎抵押品会增加供给并降低其价格这一金钱外部性内部化。因此，将外部债务集中在少数大型贷款人手中，能在金融下行期间支撑较高的抵押品价格，导致借款人减少预防性储蓄需求并过度借贷。本文记录到，新兴国家从显著少于发达国家的银行借款，这意味着新兴国家倾向于过度借贷。这一新机制补充了现有关于借款人金钱外部性导致过度借贷的观点。在合理的参数化下，贷款人内部化的金钱外部性规模为借款人所内部化规模的三分之二。最后，允许贷款国最优地选择贷款人结构会增加贷款人集中度，提高债务水平，并改善借款人的福利。

records.title_en: Work Boots to Combat Boots: Mass Layoffs and Military Enlistment
records.title_cn: 从工作靴到军靴：大规模裁员与参军入伍
records.abstract_en: Weak local labor market conditions may change the trajectories of young adults who expected to find work. Well-documented responses include increasing educational investments, moving to more prosperous labor markets, or reducing labor force attachment. Military enlistment is a channel of potential adjustment that has received less study. Using data on Army recruits, we demonstrate a significant local response in enlistment to mass layoffs, characterized by increased labor supply to the military rather than increased local military recruiting. Our work documents the significance of military employment as an important arm of adjustment to local labor market shocks.
records.abstract_cn: 疲软的本地劳动力市场状况可能会改变那些原本期望找到工作的年轻人的发展轨迹。已有充分记录的应对措施包括增加教育投资、迁往更繁荣的劳动力市场，或减少劳动力参与。参军入伍是一个潜在调整渠道，但相关研究较少。利用陆军新兵数据，我们证明了大规模裁员对入伍人数存在显著的本地响应，其特征是向军队的劳动力供给增加，而非本地征兵活动的增加。我们的研究记录了军事就业作为应对本地劳动力市场冲击的重要调整途径的意义。

records.title_en: Party On: The Labor Market Returns to Social Networks in Adolescence
records.title_cn: 派对时间：青春期社交网络的劳动力市场回报
records.abstract_en: We investigate the returns to adolescent friendships on earnings in adulthood using data from the National Longitudinal Study of Adolescent to Adult Health. Because both education and friendships are jointly determined in adolescence, ordinary least squares estimates of their returns are likely biased. We implement a novel procedure to obtain bounds on the causal returns to friendships: we assume that the returns to schooling range from 5% to 15% (on the basis of prior literature) and instrument for friendships using similarity in age among peers. Having one more friend in adolescence increases earnings between 7% and 14%, substantially more than ordinary least squares estimates would suggest.
records.abstract_cn: 我们利用“全国青少年至成人健康纵向研究”的数据，考察青春期友谊对成年期收入的影响。由于教育和友谊在青春期是共同决定的，普通最小二乘法对其回报的估计可能存在偏误。我们采用一种新颖的方法来界定友谊因果回报的边界：我们假设教育回报率在5%至15%之间（基于既有文献），并利用同龄人之间的年龄相似性作为友谊的工具变量。青春期每多一个朋友，收入会增加7%至14%，这一幅度远高于普通最小二乘法估计所显示的水平。

records.title_en: The Long-Run Effects of Consequential School Accountability
records.title_cn: 后果性学校问责制的长期效应
records.abstract_en: The rise of accountability programs was perhaps the most noticeable change in American education during the 1990s and early 2000s. We measure how these programs affected students’ long-run outcomes. We find increases in income, occupational skill level, and attainment, though the labor market effects are insignificant in most specifications. A typical accountability regime with high-stakes testing in seven grades increased attainment by 0.1 years. Last, the pattern of occupational skill usage does not support concerns about teaching to the test. Our results suggest that accountability was more likely beneficial than harmful for students’ human capital.
records.abstract_cn: 问责制项目的兴起也许是1990年代和2000年代初美国教育最显著的变化。我们衡量了这些项目如何影响学生的长期结果。我们发现收入、职业技能水平和受教育程度有所提高，尽管劳动力市场效应在大多数设定中不显著。一个典型的问责制度在七个年级进行高风险测试，使受教育程度增加了0.1年。最后，职业技能使用的模式并不支持对应试教学的担忧。我们的结果表明，问责制更有可能是对学生人力资本有益而非有害。

records.title_en: Trade Competition and the Decline in Union Organizing: Evidence from Certification Elections
records.title_cn: 贸易竞争与工会组织活动的衰退：来自认证选举的证据
records.abstract_en: The long-term decline in US workers’ attempts to organize labor unions accelerated after 2000. We find that the swift rise of imports from China arising from a change in trade policy accounts for nearly all of this post-2000 acceleration: union certification elections decreased substantially among workers in manufacturing industries directly exposed to imports, but also among workers indirectly exposed through their local labor market. Consistent with a simple model of workers’ decision to seek union representation, direct exposure lowered the expected wage gain from unionization, whereas indirect exposure increased the cost of job loss—both of which discourage organizing.
records.abstract_cn: 美国工人组织工会尝试的长期下降在2000年后加速。我们发现，由于贸易政策变化导致的中国进口迅速增长，几乎解释了2000年后这一加速的全部原因：直接受到进口影响的制造业工人中的工会认证选举显著减少，但通过当地劳动力市场间接受到影响的工人也是如此。与工人寻求工会代表的简单模型一致，直接暴露降低了工会化的预期工资收益，而间接暴露增加了失业成本——这两者都抑制了组织活动。

records.title_en: The Impact of a Prototypical Home Visiting Program on Child Skills
records.title_cn: 原型家访项目对儿童技能的影响
records.abstract_en: This paper estimates the causal impacts on child skills and the mechanisms producing these impacts using data from a randomized control experiment. We study a widely emulated early-childhood home visiting program and show the feasibility of replicating it at scale. We go beyond reporting treatment effects as unweighted item scores and assess item difficulties. To interpret treatment effects, we estimate individual-level latent skills and compare treatments and controls. The program substantially improves multiple skills. We decompose the source of treatment effects and find that enhancements in latent skills explain most of the conventional treatment effects for language and cognition.
records.abstract_cn: 本文利用随机对照实验的数据，估计了儿童技能因果影响及产生这些影响的机制。我们研究了一个被广泛模仿的幼儿家访项目，并展示了其大规模复制的可行性。我们超越了将处理效应报告为未加权项目得分的做法，评估了项目难度。为了解释处理效应，我们估计了个人层面的潜在技能，并比较了处理组和对照组。该项目显著提高了多种技能。我们分解了处理效应的来源，发现潜在技能的提升解释了语言和认知方面大部分常规处理效应。

records.title_en: Differences in On-the-Job Learning across Firms
records.title_cn: 企业间在职学习的差异
records.abstract_en: We present evidence that is consistent with large disparities across firms in their on-the-job learning opportunities using administrative datasets from Brazil and Italy. We categorize firms into discrete “classes”—which our conceptual framework interprets as skill-learning classes—using a clustering methodology that groups together firms with similar distributions of unexplained wage growth. Mincerian returns to experience vary widely across experiences acquired in different firm classes. Four tests leveraging firm movers, occupation/industry switchers, hiring wages, and displaced workers point toward a portable and general human capital interpretation. Heterogeneous employment experiences explain an important share of wage variance by age 35.
records.abstract_cn: 我们利用巴西和意大利的行政数据集，提供了与企业间在职学习机会存在巨大差异相一致的证据。我们使用一种聚类方法，将具有相似未解释工资增长分布的企业归为离散的“类别”——我们的概念框架将其解释为技能学习类别。在不同企业类别中获得的经验，其明瑟回报率差异很大。四项测试利用企业流动者、职业/行业转换者、招聘工资和失业工人，指向可携带且通用的人力资本解释。异质性的就业经历解释了按年龄划分的工资差异的重要部分35。

records.title_en: The Multigenerational Impact of Children and Childcare Policies
records.title_cn: 儿童与儿童保育政策的多代影响
records.abstract_en: This paper examines the multigenerational impact of children and whether the public provision of formal childcare lessens the earnings and employment impacts of children. We find that the arrival of a firstborn reduces employment and earnings of mothers and employment of grandmothers. Studying a universal childcare program in Quebec, we find that formal childcare increases the employment rates of mothers as well as that of grandmothers to a lesser extent. Examining heterogeneity of the program’s impact across census divisions, we find a negative correlation between the positive effects on mothers’ employment and the prepolicy supply of informal childcare by grandmothers.
records.abstract_cn: 本文考察了儿童的多代影响，以及公共提供的正规儿童保育是否减轻了儿童对收入和就业的影响。我们发现，第一个孩子的出生降低了母亲的就业和收入，以及祖母的就业。通过研究魁北克的一项普及儿童保育项目，我们发现正规儿童保育提高了母亲的就业率，并在较小程度上提高了祖母的就业率。考察该项目在人口普查分区间的异质性影响，我们发现对母亲就业的积极影响与政策前祖母提供非正规儿童保育之间存在负相关。

records.title_en: University Loans and Grants: Effects on Educational and Labor Market Outcomes
records.title_cn: 大学贷款与助学金：对教育和劳动力市场结果的影响
records.abstract_en: This study examines the long-term effects of student loans and grants in Chile through a regression discontinuity design. It finds that university loans significantly boost degree completion, especially among women and low-income students, with marginal positive effects on employment and earnings for women. Vocational loans benefit only those ineligible for university loans. Conversely, grants, alongside loans, do not affect education or labor market outcomes. The limited impact of the tuition reductions induced by grants, combined with the substantial gains for low-income students, highlights the presence of credit constraints.
records.abstract_cn: 本研究通过断点回归设计考察了智利学生贷款和助学金的长期影响。研究发现，大学贷款显著提高了学位完成率，尤其是在女性和低收入学生中，对女性的就业和收入有边际正向影响。职业贷款仅惠及那些不符合大学贷款资格的学生。相反，助学金与贷款一同提供时，并不影响教育或劳动力市场结果。由助学金引起的学费减免影响有限，加上低收入学生的实质性收益，凸显了信贷约束的存在。

records.title_en: Spatial Diffusion of Local Economic Shocks in Social Networks: Evidence from the US Fracking Boom
records.title_cn: 地方经济冲击在社会网络中的空间扩散：来自美国水力压裂繁荣的证据
records.abstract_en: I study the role of social networks in the propagation of economic shocks across space. Combining comprehensive data on US online friendships with extraction activity during the fracking boom, I show that exogenous changes in economic conditions in one area affect outcomes in socially proximate places, regardless of how far apart they are geographically. Social exposure to fracking generates a wage spillover amounting to one-third of every dollar of energy produced in a county’s social network. This spillover decays slowly in space and is associated with a large mobility response. Diffusion mainly stems from the commuting of transient fracking workers.
records.abstract_cn: 我研究了社会网络在经济冲击跨空间传播中的作用。结合美国在线友谊的全面数据与水力压裂繁荣期间的开采活动，我表明一个地区经济状况的外生变化会影响社会邻近地区的结果，无论它们在地理上相距多远。社会暴露于水力压裂产生的工资溢出效应相当于一个县社会网络中每生产一美元能源的三分之一。这种溢出在空间上衰减缓慢，并与较大的流动性响应相关。扩散主要源于临时压裂工人的通勤。

records.title_en: From Unemployment to Self-Employment: An Evaluation of Self-Employment Assistance Programs
records.title_cn: 从失业到自雇：自雇援助项目的评估
records.abstract_en: This paper evaluates self-employment assistance (SEA) programs, which are government initiatives extending the unemployment insurance system to support unemployment to self-employment transitions. Using a general equilibrium model of the US labor market, we show that these programs have important labor market mobility effects and increase the self-employment rate. They also significantly impact the composition and performance outcomes of self-employment: while lump-sum subsidies select low-skilled individuals, SEA programs contingent on previously employed earnings select skilled and wealthier individuals. At the aggregate level, the latter programs mainly reallocate individuals from employment to self-employment, leaving the unemployment rate largely unaffected.
records.abstract_cn: 本文评估了自雇援助（SEA）项目，这些项目是政府举措，扩展失业保险体系以支持从失业到自雇的转变。利用美国劳动力市场的一般均衡模型，我们表明这些项目具有重要的劳动力市场流动性效应，并提高了自雇率。它们还显著影响自雇的构成和绩效结果：一次性补贴选择低技能个体，而依赖于先前就业收入的SEA项目则选择技能较高且较富裕的个体。在总体层面，后者主要将个体从就业重新分配至自雇，使失业率基本不受影响。

records.title_en: Unilateral environmental policy and offshoring
records.title_cn: 单边环境政策与离岸外包
records.abstract_en: This paper examines how offshoring shapes emissions leakage and global emissions in response to unilateral environmental policy.
