records.abstract_cn: 宗教传教是否影响了企业层面的生产率？本研究考察了二十世纪初丹麦，一个以新教为主且同质化、正经历快速工业化的社会中，内部传教（IM）运动对生产率的影响。利用964家乳品厂的数据并采用工具变量方法，我们提供的证据表明，内部传教强度降低了黄油生产的生产率，以牛奶-黄油比率衡量。主要机制是周日关闭，这破坏了规模经济，以及因农民之间的教义分歧导致的乳品厂碎片化。这些干扰阻止了乳品厂高效运营并降低了其盈利能力。我们的结果显示了宗教性如何在没有通常的殖民或传教混杂因素的情况下塑造了现代化和工业发展的模式。这一历史案例涉及发展经济学中关于非正式制度和道德规范如何约束企业行为和生产率的辩论。

records.title_en: Public good or public bad? Nation-building and Indigenous institutions
records.title_cn: 公共物品还是公共祸害？国家建设与原住民制度
records.abstract_en: While existing evidence shows that nation-building policies unify societies, little is known about how and what makes some societal groups to resist them. We examine this in the context of the post-Mexican Revolution (1920s–1950s), when the new state implemented a nation-building policy to eliminate Indigenous cultures and identities by increasing connectivity via transport infrastructure. In a difference-in-differences design, we leverage heterogeneity in the exposure to pre-colonial political centralisation as a proxy for the ability of Indigenous populations in mobilising to resist national integration. We find that the expansion of transport infrastructure was lower in municipalities with a stronger efficacy of Indigenous mobilisation. We demonstrate that this underprovision of public goods can be partly explained by Indigenous identity preservation and high abilities for collective actions.
records.abstract_cn: 尽管现有证据表明国家建设政策统一了社会，但关于哪些社会群体以及何种因素使其抵制这些政策，我们知之甚少。我们在后墨西哥革命时期（1920–1950）的背景下考察了这一点，当时新国家实施了一项国家建设政策，通过增加交通基础设施的连通性来消除原住民文化和身份。在双重差分设计中，我们利用前殖民时期政治集权程度的异质性作为原住民群体动员以抵抗国家整合能力的代理变量。我们发现，在原住民动员效能更强的市镇，交通基础设施的扩张程度较低。我们证明，这种公共物品供给不足可以部分归因于原住民身份保护和高度的集体行动能力。

records.title_en: Rural pension, factor reallocation and agricultural productivity: Evidence from China
records.title_cn: 农村养老金、要素重新配置与农业生产力：来自中国的证据
records.abstract_en: This study examines how pension schemes influence land reallocation and agricultural productivity. While previous research typically groups households based on the presence of elderly members, we distinguish between households where the elderly are operators and those where they are not. Our findings show that land is reallocated from elderly-operated to younger-operated households, leading to a 9.8 % increase in agricultural productivity. The rural pension scheme in China drives migration and land leasing out in elderly-operated households, while facilitating rent-in and scale expansion in younger households. These findings offer new insights into how pension schemes can enhance agricultural factor reallocation and productivity.
records.abstract_cn: 本研究探讨了养老金计划如何影响土地重新配置和农业生产力。以往的研究通常根据是否有老年成员对家庭进行分组，而我们则区分了老年人作为经营者的家庭和老年人不作为经营者的家庭。我们的研究结果显示，土地从老年人经营的农户重新配置到年轻人经营的农户，导致农业生产力提高了9.8。中国的农村养老金计划推动了老年人经营农户的迁移和土地出租，同时促进了年轻人经营农户的土地租入和规模扩张。这些发现为养老金计划如何促进农业要素重新配置和生产力提升提供了新的见解。

records.title_en: Urbanization and educational attainment: Evidence from Africa
records.title_cn: 城市化与教育成就：来自非洲的证据
records.abstract_en: Despite the rapid urbanization of the developing world, little remains known about how urban migration and residency affect childhood outcomes. Using census data for 14 African countries combined with an age-at-move design, I show that childhood exposure to cities significantly increases primary school completion and literacy rates, even among children from poor urban households. Better availability of schools and lower opportunity costs of education in cities appear to be important channels to explain the positive effects. The paper thus provides evidence of a novel channel through which urban migration can promote economic development.
records.abstract_cn: 尽管发展中世界城市化迅速，但关于城市迁移和居住如何影响儿童期结果，我们仍知之甚少。利用14个非洲国家的人口普查数据，结合年龄迁移设计，我表明儿童期接触城市能显著提高小学完成率和识字率，即使对于来自贫困城市家庭的儿童也是如此。城市中更好的学校可获得性和较低的教育机会成本似乎是解释这些积极效应的重要渠道。因此，本文提供了城市迁移能促进经济发展的一个新渠道的证据。

records.title_en: Causal Inference with Predicted Outcomes: Correcting prediction error bias in satellite-based impact evaluation
records.title_cn: 利用预测结果进行因果推断：纠正基于卫星的影响评估中的预测误差偏差
records.abstract_en: Recent advances in Earth observation and machine learning open new frontiers in impact evaluation that appear well-suited for agricultural settings. We probe the nuances and limitations of these promising methods using satellite-predicted maize yields to measure the impact of Ethiopia’s Direct Seed Marketing (DSM) program, which was rolled out after 2011 to enhance farmer access to improved seed varieties. Machine learning-generated outcomes inevitably introduce prediction error, which attenuates coefficients and understates standard errors in downstream causal analysis. We find positive effects of DSM on crop cut maize yields, but weaker effects when using (naive) predicted yields. We demonstrate how ground-truth data can be leveraged to diagnose and correct this bias using tools from the prediction-powered inference literature — albeit with additional assumptions about unobservable prediction errors. Our corrected estimates suggest substantial DSM impacts on satellite-predicted maize yields in all producing areas and years.
records.abstract_cn: 地球观测和机器学习的最新进展为影响评估开辟了新的前沿，这些进展似乎非常适合农业环境。我们利用卫星预测的玉米产量来衡量埃塞俄比亚直接种子营销（DSM）项目的影响，该项目在2011年后推出，旨在增强农民获得改良种子品种的机会，从而探讨这些有前景方法的细微差别和局限性。机器学习生成的结果不可避免地引入预测误差，这会削弱下游因果分析中的系数并低估标准误。我们发现DSM对作物收割玉米产量有正向影响，但使用（朴素）预测产量时影响较弱。我们展示了如何利用地面实况数据，借助预测驱动推断文献中的工具来诊断和纠正这一偏差——尽管需要对不可观测的预测误差做出额外假设。我们的修正估计表明，DSM对所有生产地区和年份的卫星预测玉米产量均有显著影响。

records.title_en: Social protection and social distancing during the pandemic: Mobile money transfers in Ghana
records.title_cn: 疫情期间的社会保护与社会距离：加纳的移动货币转移支付
records.abstract_en: We randomized mobile money transfers to a sample of low-income Ghanaians during the COVID-19 pandemic. Treated households received eight transfers that sum to roughly one month’s income, while control households only received one transfer. The mere announcement of upcoming transfers has no effect. Once disbursed, transfers increase contemporaneous food expenditure by 8% and income by 20%, but do not affect psychological well-being. Over 40% of the transfers are spent on food. We find suggestive evidence that transfers increased social distancing. The positive effect on income does not persist to two years after the last transfer, and surprisingly, two-year effects on consumption and psychological well-being are negative. Together, we learn that pandemic-era cash transfers can support households economically without diminishing adherence to public health protocols, though with null or negative long-term effects.
records.abstract_cn: 我们在COVID-19大流行期间对一组低收入加纳人进行了移动货币转移支付的随机化实验。受处理的家庭收到了八次转移支付，总额约为一个月收入，而对照组家庭仅收到一次转移支付。仅仅宣布即将到来的转移支付没有效果。一旦发放，转移支付使同期食品支出增加了8%，收入增加了20%，但对心理健康没有影响。超过40%的转移支付用于食品。我们发现了转移支付增加了社会距离的提示性证据。对收入的正面影响在最后一次转移支付两年后并未持续，且令人惊讶的是，两年后对消费和心理健康的影响为负面。总体而言，我们了解到，疫情期间的现金转移支付可以在不削弱公共卫生协议遵守的情况下为家庭提供经济支持，尽管长期影响为零或负面。

records.title_en: The decision-makers we become: Early education and the decision-making of boys and girls
records.title_cn: 我们成为的决策者：早期教育对男孩和女孩决策的影响
records.abstract_en: One way to advance our understanding of individual differences in decision-making is to study the development of children's decision-making. This paper studies the causal effects of daycare attendance on children's economic preferences and decision-making abilities, exploiting a lottery system that randomized admissions into oversubscribed daycare centers in Rio de Janeiro. Impacts are estimated separately for boys and girls. Daycare attendance increased the decision-making quality of boys by 0.16 standard deviations (SD) and the aversion of girls to disadvantageous inequality (i.e., having less than one's peer) by 0.23 SD. It also decreased the self-control of boys by 0.19 SD.
records.abstract_cn: 推进我们对决策中个体差异理解的一个途径是研究儿童决策的发展。本文利用里约热内卢抽签系统随机分配进入供不应求的日托中心的机会，研究了日托出勤对儿童经济偏好和决策能力的因果效应。影响分别针对男孩和女孩进行估计。日托出勤使男孩的决策质量提高了0.16个标准差（SD），使女孩对不利不平等（即拥有比同伴少）的厌恶程度提高了0.23个标准差。同时，日托出勤还使男孩的自我控制能力降低了0.19个标准差。

records.title_en: Using free remotely sensed data to assess war-induced damage to agricultural cultivation: Evidence from Ukraine
records.title_cn: 利用免费遥感数据评估战争对农业耕作的损害：来自乌克兰的证据
records.abstract_en: We use remotely sensed data to measure conflict-induced field damage in Ukraine 2022-24 for about 10,000 village councils (VCs). Compared to media-based indicators (ACLED), these suggest higher conflict incidence in less densely populated VCs, consistent with official data. Use of annual crop maps for 2019-24 to estimate a difference in differences (DID) model at VC level suggests conflict significantly and persistently reduced cropped area in directly affected and neighboring VCs. Predicted conflict effects are three times larger and differently distributed for image as compared to media-based indicators, suggesting remotely sensed conflict measures may usefully complement media-based ones, especially in rural areas.
records.abstract_cn: 我们利用遥感数据来衡量乌克兰2022-24年冲突引起的田间损害，涉及约10,000个村委员会（VCs）。与基于媒体的指标（ACLED）相比，这些数据表明在人口密度较低的村委员会中冲突发生率更高，这与官方数据一致。使用2019-24年的年度作物图来估计村委员会层面的双重差分（DID）模型，结果表明冲突显著且持续地减少了直接受影响及邻近村委员会的耕地面积。与基于媒体的指标相比，图像预测的冲突效应大三倍且分布不同，这表明遥感冲突测量可能有效地补充基于媒体的指标，尤其是在农村地区。

records.title_en: Unlocking young women’s potential? The impact of a low-cost career guidance program
records.title_cn: 释放年轻女性的潜力？低成本职业指导项目的影响
records.abstract_en: Societal expectations and gender norms constrain young people’s career planning, particularly for girls, limiting the role of personal interests in skill-building decisions. This study evaluates a low-cost, 10-hour career exploration intervention through a pre-registered, school-level, clustered randomized controlled trial with over 6,000 primarily female students in urban India. The program improved future planning and increased the importance students placed on personal interests in career choices. However, there is no evidence of medium-term impacts on educational or skill-building investments. These findings suggest that while scalable interventions can shift aspirations and planning, structural barriers constrain longer-term behavioral change.
records.abstract_cn: 社会期望和性别规范限制了年轻人的职业规划，尤其是对女孩而言，限制了个人兴趣在技能培养决策中的作用。本研究通过一项预先注册、学校层面、整群随机对照试验，评估了一个低成本的10小时职业探索干预项目，样本包括印度城市中超过6,000名以女性为主的学生。该项目改善了未来规划，并提高了学生在职业选择中对个人兴趣的重视程度。然而，没有证据表明该项目对教育或技能培养投资有中期影响。这些发现表明，虽然可扩展的干预措施能够改变愿望和规划，但结构性障碍限制了长期行为改变。

records.title_en: The consumption side of trade shocks: Inequality dynamics and luxury imports
records.title_cn: 贸易冲击的消费侧：不平等动态与奢侈品进口
records.abstract_en: We study how a large, exogenous trade shock — triggered by China’s accession to the WTO in 2001 — reshaped income, inequality, and import behavior across Brazilian regions. Using a shift-share instrument based on pre-shock export structures, we show that regions more exposed to China’s demand boom experienced faster growth in per capita income and larger increases in within-region inequality relative to less exposed areas. These changes, in turn, led to rising import values and shifts in composition, especially toward consumption and medium- to high-tech manufactured goods. To analyze these shifts, we classify goods by necessity and luxury status using Brazilian household data and introduce a complementary classification based on the spending patterns of high-income households in the United States. Luxury imports rose most in regions that were initially more unequal or experienced sharper post-shock inequality growth, consistent with non-homothetic preferences and broader theories of stratified consumption. Our findings highlight inequality as a key channel through which trade shocks shape regional import demand in developing economies.
records.abstract_cn: 我们研究了一个由2001年中国加入WTO引发的大型外生贸易冲击如何重塑巴西各地区的收入、不平等和进口行为。利用基于冲击前出口结构的份额转移工具，我们发现，相对于暴露程度较低的地区，对中国需求繁荣暴露程度更高的地区人均收入增长更快，区域内不平等加剧幅度更大。这些变化进而导致进口值上升和构成转变，尤其是向消费品和中高技术制成品转变。为分析这些转变，我们使用巴西家庭数据将商品按必需品和奢侈品状态分类，并引入一种基于美国高收入家庭支出模式的补充分类。奢侈品进口在最初更不平等或冲击后不平等增长更剧烈的地区增长最多，这与非齐次偏好和更广泛的分层消费理论一致。我们的研究结果强调，不平等是贸易冲击塑造发展中经济体区域进口需求的关键渠道。

records.title_en: Stimulating local economies through central transfers: A natural experiment from Ecuador
records.title_cn: 通过中央转移支付刺激地方经济：来自厄瓜多尔的一项自然实验
records.abstract_en: This paper provides causal evidence on the economic impact of central-to-local government transfers in a developing country context. We exploit plausibly exogenous variation in municipal transfers generated by a 2018 reform to Ecuador’s intergovernmental allocation formula. Using a design-based instrumental variables strategy, we estimate that a 1% increase in government transfers led to a 0.94% increase in total business sales in 2018 and 1.05% in 2019. The strongest effects are found in non-VAT sales. Mechanism analysis shows that transfers boost local economic activity mainly through increased recurrent and capital spending, particularly wages and procurement, suggesting that well-designed transfers can act as effective local demand stimuli.
records.abstract_cn: 本文提供了在发展中国家背景下中央向地方政府转移支付对经济影响的因果证据。我们利用了厄瓜多尔政府间分配公式改革（2018年）所产生的市政转移支付中看似外生的变化。采用基于设计的工具变量策略，我们估计政府转移支付每增加1%，在2018年导致总商业销售额增加0.94%，在2019年增加1.05%。最强的效应出现在非增值税销售中。机制分析表明，转移支付主要通过增加经常性和资本性支出，特别是工资和采购，来促进地方经济活动，这表明设计良好的转移支付可以作为有效的本地需求刺激手段。

records.title_en: Digital revitalization or useless effort? Public e-commerce support and local specialty sales
records.title_cn: 数字振兴还是徒劳无功？公共电商支持与地方特产销售
records.abstract_en: We examine how a government-initiated e-commerce platform (GEP) affects sales of a local specialty in China’s Pu’er tea market. Using a unique dataset from field experiments and surveys of 983 farmers, we examine changes in online and offline sales over time. We employ two-way fixed effects (TWFE) models to identify the causal impact of GEP access. The results reveal significant substitution effects: access to the GEP increases online sales by 16.649% and decreases offline sales by 15.549%, indicating an overall shift from offline to online sales. On the extensive margin, households that previously sold only offline become more likely to sell online. On the intensive margin, adopters expand their online channels and offer a wider range of tea qualities. The mediation analysis suggests that the increase in online sales channels and product variety accounts for the impact of GEP access on the shift to online transactions.
records.abstract_cn: 我们研究了政府发起的电子商务平台（GEP）如何影响中国普洱茶市场中一种地方特产的销售。利用来自对983户农户的实地实验和调查的独特数据集，我们考察了线上和线下销售随时间的变化。我们采用双向固定效应（TWFE）模型来识别GEP接入的因果影响。结果揭示了显著的替代效应：接入GEP使线上销售增加了16.649%，线下销售减少了15.549%，表明整体从线下向线上销售转移。在广延边际上，以前仅在线下销售的农户更有可能转向线上销售。在集约边际上，采纳者扩展了其线上渠道，并提供更广泛的茶叶品质。中介分析表明，线上销售渠道和产品种类的增加解释了GEP接入对线上交易转移的影响。

records.title_en: Protecting the vulnerable: How migrant regularization reduces crime and empowers women
records.title_cn: 保护弱势群体：移民正规化如何减少犯罪并赋权女性
records.abstract_en: This paper examines the impacts of a regularization program that granted temporary economic rights to over 281,000 undocumented Venezuelan forced migrants in Colombia. The program resulted in a general reduction in crimes committed by forced migrants, while also increasing the number of domestic abuse and sex crimes female migrants reported. These findings suggest that empowerment and greater trust in local authorities are key mechanisms driving the behavioral changes for females, while proper enforcement facilitated by adequate documentation and the positive income effects of the program reduced the general propensity for migrants to commit crimes.
records.abstract_cn: 本文考察了一项正规化项目的影响，该项目向哥伦比亚超过281,000名无证委内瑞拉被迫移民授予了临时经济权利。该项目导致被迫移民所犯罪行普遍减少，同时女性移民报告的家庭暴力和性犯罪数量增加。这些发现表明，赋权和对地方当局更大的信任是推动女性行为变化的关键机制，而通过适当文件记录和项目的积极收入效应实现的适当执法，降低了移民犯罪的一般倾向。

records.title_en: Two birds, one stone: Responses of agriculture to water pollution regulation
records.title_cn: 一石二鸟：农业对水污染规制的响应
records.abstract_en: This paper exploits China’s Water Quality Control Assessment Plan as a natural experiment to examine the impact of environmental regulation on fertilizer use and food security. Leveraging variation in enforcement incentives across counties determined by their locations relative to water quality monitoring stations, we document a 5.9 % fertilizer application reduction in upstream counties, driven by reduction in public financial support for agriculture. Salience of information highlighting agriculture as a major pollution source reinforces enforcement incentives in curbing fertilizer use. Agricultural output remained stable, reflecting both prior overuse of fertilizer and slight productivity gains likely associated with improved water quality.
records.abstract_cn: 本文利用中国的水质控制考核计划作为自然实验，考察环境规制对化肥使用和粮食安全的影响。利用各县相对于水质监测站的位置所决定的执法激励差异，我们记录了上游县化肥施用减少5.9，这一减少由农业公共财政支持缩减所驱动。信息凸显农业为主要污染源，增强了执法激励以抑制化肥使用。农业产出保持稳定，既反映了先前化肥的过度使用，也反映了可能与水质改善相关的轻微生产率提升。

records.title_en: Does social identity constrain rural entrepreneurship? Evidence on the role of financial inclusion
records.title_cn: 社会身份是否制约农村创业？金融包容性作用的证据
records.abstract_en: This paper examines whether improved financial access can mitigate the constraints imposed by social identity on entrepreneurship among under-privileged caste groups in India. Using a novel dataset on Indian villages and their proximity to bank branches, we find that closer access to a bank branch significantly enhances entrepreneurial activity among Scheduled Castes (SCs) in non-agricultural sectors, especially in those sectors that are traditionally dominated by upper-caste groups. These findings are more pronounced in villages where the improvement in proximity was plausibly exogenous, resulting from the RBI's Bank Branch Expansion Policy of 2005. For Scheduled Tribes (STs), however, financial access is associated with a gain in the size of hired employment within enterprises. Exploring several mechanisms, we find that these effects are primarily driven by credit uptake. Overall, our findings highlight the potential of financial inclusion in breaking rigid social norms around the entrenched caste-based occupational segregation and promoting more equitable economic participation in India.
records.abstract_cn: 本文考察了改善金融获取渠道能否减轻印度弱势种姓群体创业所面临的社会身份约束。利用关于印度村庄及其与银行分支机构邻近性的新颖数据集，我们发现，更接近银行分支机构显著增强了表列种姓（SCs）在非农业部门的创业活动，尤其是在那些传统上由高种姓群体主导的部门。这些发现在邻近性改善可能外生的村庄中更为显著，这种改善源于印度储备银行（RBI）2005年的银行分支机构扩张政策。然而，对于表列部落（STs），金融获取与企业内雇佣劳动力规模的增加相关。通过探索多种机制，我们发现这些效应主要由信贷获取驱动。总体而言，我们的发现强调了金融包容性在打破围绕根深蒂固的种姓职业隔离的刚性社会规范，以及促进印度更公平经济参与方面的潜力。

records.title_en: Bittersweet: Grandparenting and elderly mental health in the two-child policy era
records.title_cn: 苦乐参半：二孩政策时代的祖辈照料与老年人心理健康
records.abstract_en: We exploit China's universal two-child policy and variations in adult children's birth cohort to examine the causal impact of the family-planning policy on grandparenting and elderly mental well-being. Using a difference-in-differences design, we find that the policy significantly increased the number of grandchildren and intensified grandparental involvement—raising informal caregiving, weekly hours spent, co-residence, and contact with adult children. These changes were accompanied by a 6.8 % increase in CESD-10 depression scores and 8.9 %–14.3 % increase in underlying symptoms such as restless sleep, irritability, difficulty concentrating, and hopelessness. We find no significant changes in income, consumption, or healthcare use, suggesting that the mental health effects are most plausibly driven by increased caregiving demands. The impacts are most pronounced among urban and paternal grandparents, especially paternal grandmothers. Despite these declines, we find no evidence of elevated risk of severe clinical depression.
records.abstract_cn: 我们利用中国的全面二孩政策以及成年子女出生队列的差异，来考察计划生育政策对祖辈照料和老年人心理健康的因果影响。采用双重差分设计，我们发现该政策显著增加了孙辈数量，并强化了祖辈的参与——提高了非正式照料、每周投入时间、同住以及与成年子女的联系。这些变化伴随着CESD-6.8抑郁评分增加10，以及不安睡眠、易怒、注意力难以集中和无望感等潜在症状增加8.9至14.3。我们未发现收入、消费或医疗保健使用方面的显著变化，这表明心理健康影响最可能是由照料需求增加所驱动。这些影响在城市祖辈和父系祖辈中最为显著，尤其是父系祖母。尽管存在这些下降，我们未发现严重临床抑郁风险升高的证据。

records.title_en: Downstream impacts of mines on agriculture in Africa
records.title_cn: 非洲矿业对农业的下游影响
records.abstract_en: Mining operations in Africa are expanding rapidly, creating negative externalities that remain poorly understood. In this paper, we provide causal evidence for the impact of water pollution from mines on downstream vegetation and agriculture across the continent. We exploit a natural experiment, where mines cause a discontinuity in water pollution along river networks, to compare vegetation health in upstream and downstream locations. We find that mines significantly reduce peak vegetation downstream by 1.3–1.5%, impairing the productivity of over 74,000 km2 of croplands. These reductions correspond to annual losses of 91,000–205,000 tons of cereal crops in the immediate vicinity alone, with particularly severe effects in fertile regions and areas where gold mining predominates. Our findings highlight substantial externalities of mining and demonstrate an urgent need for oversight and regulation.
records.abstract_cn: 非洲的采矿作业正在迅速扩张，产生了仍未被充分理解的负外部性。在本文中，我们提供了关于矿山水污染对非洲大陆下游植被和农业影响的因果证据。我们利用一个自然实验，即矿山沿河流网络造成水污染的不连续性，来比较上游和下游地点的植被健康状况。我们发现，矿山显著减少了下游峰值植被，降幅为1.3-1.5%，损害了超过74,000平方公里农田的生产力。这些减少仅邻近地区就相当于每年损失91,000-205,000吨谷物作物，在肥沃地区和以金矿开采为主的地区影响尤为严重。我们的研究结果凸显了采矿的巨大外部性，并表明迫切需要监督和监管。

records.title_en: Narrowing or widening the gender gap in market and domestic work? The impact of workweek reduction reform in China
records.title_cn: 缩小还是扩大市场与家务劳动中的性别差距？中国缩短工作周改革的影响
records.abstract_en: We investigate whether shorter working hours can narrow the gender gap in market and domestic work by examining the impact of China's workweek reduction policy. We find that the policy deepened the gender division of labor within dual-employee households, resulting in women further leaning toward familial roles. Specifically, women allocated more time to childcare and other household chores, while men withdrew from these domestic duties, worked longer hours beyond the designated schedule, and pursued higher education. This shift contributed to improved income and career advancement for men, whereas women did not experience similar improvements. The impact of this polarized gender division of labor was particularly pronounced in households with higher demands for domestic product consumption or with higher male-female wage ratios prior to the reform. Our analysis demonstrates that under the shortened working hours system, families' optimization behavior manifests as a deepened household specialization aimed at maximizing household consumption, suggesting that the reduction in working hours may exacerbate labor market gender inequality.
records.abstract_cn: 我们通过考察中国缩短工作周政策的影响，研究较短的工作时间能否缩小市场与家务劳动中的性别差距。我们发现该政策加深了双职工家庭内部的性别分工，导致女性进一步倾向于家庭角色。具体而言，女性将更多时间分配给育儿和其他家务，而男性则退出这些家务职责，超出规定时间工作更长时间，并追求更高教育。这种转变有助于男性收入和职业发展的提升，而女性则未经历类似改善。这种极化性别分工的影响在改革前对家庭产品消费需求较高或男女工资比率较高的家庭中尤为显著。我们的分析表明，在缩短工作周制度下，家庭的最优化行为表现为加深家庭专业化以最大化家庭消费，这表明工作时间的减少可能加剧劳动力市场中的性别不平等。

records.title_en: Endogenous migration restrictions and population aging in China
records.title_cn: 内生性迁移限制与中国人口老龄化
records.abstract_en: This paper investigates how local governments in China respond to demographic shifts by reducing migration restrictions through Hukou reform. We construct a novel measure of reform intensity by combining a data-driven approach with textual analysis of official policy documents. By quantifying the share of pre-reform migrants who would qualify for local urban Hukou under the most recent settlement criteria, our measure captures the endogenous constraints embedded in local settlement policies. Using this measure, we estimate the impact of local population aging on Hukou policy changes. We find that cities with higher aging levels are more likely to lower thresholds for migrant settlement, with stronger effects in prefectures facing lower fertility rates. Mechanism analysis further highlights the role of population aging as a driver of labor market deregulation and urban development.
records.abstract_cn: 本文研究了中国地方政府如何通过户籍改革减少迁移限制来应对人口结构变化。我们通过结合数据驱动方法与官方政策文件的文本分析，构建了一个新颖的改革强度度量指标。通过量化在最新落户标准下，改革前迁移者中有资格获得当地城镇户口的比例，我们的度量捕捉了地方落户政策中嵌入的内生性约束。利用这一度量，我们估计了地方人口老龄化对户籍政策变化的影响。我们发现，老龄化程度较高的城市更有可能降低迁移者落户门槛，且在生育率较低的地级市中效应更强。机制分析进一步强调了人口老龄化作为劳动力市场放松管制和城市发展驱动因素的作用。

records.title_en: 2024 Klein Lecture ‐ Monies, Transactions, and Inflation: Part 1
records.title_cn: 2024年克莱因讲座——货币、交易与通货膨胀：第一部分
records.abstract_en: Modern macroeconomics ignores the recent proliferation of new monies. We show in our model that new monies like credit cards or stable coins or crypto currencies or helicopter money can cause a huge increase in prices, like the 1970s inflation when credit cards emerged in full use. These monies are not perfect substitutes, so shrinking conventional money supply to compensate for the growth of new monies comes at a welfare cost. Price levels are determined by money chasing goods, measured by the separate quantities of each kind of money and the scale of individual transactions. In Part I we introduce a one period version of our model in which we concentrate on the transactions role of monies. We show how fiat wealth (net of taxes) can be positive if there are enough gains to trade. Monies that raise fiat wealth (such as helicopter money) cause more inflation—eventually even hyperinflation—by increasing the interest rate, which reduces transactions. In contrast, credit cards (and central bank purchases of bonds) also cause inflation, but they enhance transactions and welfare. In Part II we present a multiperiod version in which the store‐of‐value role of money, and expectations about future policy, also affect inflation.
records.abstract_cn: 现代宏观经济学忽视了近期新货币的激增。我们在模型中表明，像信用卡、稳定币、加密货币或直升机撒钱这样的新货币可能导致价格大幅上涨，类似于1970年代信用卡全面使用时出现的通货膨胀。这些货币并非完全替代品，因此收缩传统货币供应以补偿新货币的增长会带来福利成本。价格水平由货币追逐商品决定，以每种货币的单独数量和个体交易的规模来衡量。在第一部分，我们引入了模型的一个单期版本，重点关注货币的交易角色。我们展示了如果交易收益足够大，法定财富（扣除税收后）如何可能为正。提高法定财富的货币（如直升机撒钱）通过提高利率减少交易，从而引发更多通货膨胀——最终甚至恶性通货膨胀。相比之下，信用卡（以及中央银行购买债券）也会引发通货膨胀，但它们增强了交易和福利。在第二部分，我们提出了一个多期版本，其中货币的价值储存角色以及对未来政策的预期也会影响通货膨胀。

records.title_en: Dynamics of Deterrence: A Macroeconomic Perspective on Punitive Justice Policy
records.title_cn: 威慑的动态：惩罚性司法政策的宏观经济学视角
records.abstract_en: We argue that transitional dynamics play a critical role in evaluating the effects of punitive incarceration reform on crime, inequality, and labor markets. Individuals' past choices regarding crime and employment under previous policies have persistent consequences that limit their responsiveness to policy changes. A quantitative model of this theory, calibrated using administrative data, predicts nuanced dynamics of crime and incarceration that are distinct across property and violent crime and similar to the US experience after 1980. Increased inequality and declining employment accompany these changes, with unequal impacts across generations.
records.abstract_cn: 我们认为，过渡动态在评估惩罚性监禁改革对犯罪、不平等和劳动力市场的影响中起着关键作用。个体在先前政策下关于犯罪和就业的过去选择具有持续性后果，限制了他们对政策变化的响应能力。基于行政数据校准的该理论定量模型，预测了犯罪和监禁的细致动态，这些动态在财产犯罪和暴力犯罪之间有所不同，且与美国1980年后的经历相似。不平等加剧和就业下降伴随这些变化，且对各代人的影响不均。

records.title_en: Policy Contagion: What Do We Learn From Financial Reforms?
records.title_cn: 政策传染：我们从金融改革中学到了什么？
records.abstract_en: We use financial reforms as a case study to understand the temporal clustering of policy changes across countries, shedding light on the broader phenomenon of global policy contagion. We construct a comprehensive database of domestic financial reforms spanning 90 countries from 1973 to 2014. Using this dataset, we estimate a semistructural model that incorporates key factors identified in the literature. We find that (1) geopolitical influence and cross‐country learning drove the global surge in reforms during the 1990s, and (2) reversals of financial reforms in developing countries after the global financial crisis reflected shifting beliefs about their growth effects.
records.abstract_cn: 我们以金融改革为案例研究，以理解各国政策变化在时间上的聚集现象，从而揭示全球政策传染的更广泛现象。我们构建了一个涵盖90个国家、时间跨度从1973年到2014年的国内金融改革综合数据库。利用这一数据集，我们估计了一个半结构模型，该模型纳入了文献中识别的关键因素。我们发现，（1）地缘政治影响和跨国学习推动了1990年代全球改革浪潮，（2）全球金融危机后发展中国家金融改革的逆转反映了对其增长效应看法的转变。

records.title_en: Strategic Flip‐Flopping in Political Competition
records.title_cn: 政治竞争中的策略性摇摆
records.abstract_en: We study candidates' position adjustments in response to information about voters' preferences. Repositioning allows candidates to move closer to the median voter, but it incurs financial and electoral costs. In a subgame‐perfect equilibrium, candidates diverge from the center ex ante if the costs of adjustment are sufficiently large. This allows them to increase the chances of a costless victory when the information is strongly in their favor. Our theory highlights a dynamic of moderation during the campaign stage in competitive elections, as well as a prominent role for minor adjustments made preemptively by the favored candidate.
records.abstract_cn: 我们研究候选人对选民偏好信息的立场调整。重新定位使候选人能够更接近中位选民，但会带来财务和选举成本。在子博弈完美均衡中，如果调整成本足够大，候选人事前会偏离中心。这使他们能够在信息强烈有利于自己时增加无成本获胜的机会。我们的理论强调了竞争性选举中竞选阶段的温和化动态，以及受青睐候选人预防性进行小幅调整的突出作用。

records.title_en: Debt Ceilings With Fiscal Intransparency and Imperfect Electoral Accountability
records.title_cn: 财政不透明与不完全选举问责下的债务上限
records.abstract_en: We study optimal debt ceilings in a political‐agency model with uncertainty about both policymaker type (benevolent or selfish) and economic state (good or bad). Elections generate disciplining and selection effects that differ across pooling, hybrid, and separating equilibria induced by different ceilings. The optimal ceiling trades off distorted intertemporal allocation under benevolent policymakers against excessive debt under selfish ones. Increased fiscal transparency appears ineffective under constant ceilings. State‐contingent ceilings do improve welfare by adapting to economic conditions. Our results support differentiating budgetary restrictions in the reformed EU Stability and Growth Pact and underscore the role of independent fiscal institutions.
records.abstract_cn: 我们在一个政治代理模型中研究最优债务上限，该模型同时包含关于政策制定者类型（仁慈或自私）和经济状态（好坏）的不确定性。选举产生的纪律效应和选择效应在不同上限诱导的混合、混合与分离均衡中有所不同。最优上限在仁慈政策制定者下的扭曲跨期配置与自私政策制定者下的过度债务之间进行权衡。在固定上限下，提高财政透明度似乎无效。状态依赖的上限确实通过适应经济状况改善了福利。我们的结果支持在改革后的欧盟稳定与增长公约中区分预算限制，并强调了独立财政机构的作用。

records.title_en: Skill Acquisition and the Gains From Trade: A Cross‐Country Quantitative Analysis
records.title_cn: 技能获取与贸易收益：一项跨国定量分析
records.abstract_en: This paper studies the impact of trade openness on welfare through alterations in workers' skill acquisition. Guided by empirical evidence, we integrate endogenous choices of learning investments into a multisector Eaton–Kortum model. Our model reveals that trade openness influences skill acquisition by two channels: (1) reallocating labor between sectors with varying skill intensities and on‐the‐job learning opportunities and (2) allowing producers in each country to source varieties from more cost‐effective suppliers in other countries, thus reducing costs of material inputs for learning. Our quantification indicates that the gains in skill acquisition account for 5% of the total gains from trade.
records.abstract_cn: 本文通过工人技能获取的变化来研究贸易开放对福利的影响。在经验证据的指导下，我们将学习投资的内生选择整合到一个多部门Eaton-Kortum模型中。我们的模型揭示，贸易开放通过两个渠道影响技能获取：（1）在具有不同技能密集度和在职学习机会的部门之间重新分配劳动力；（2）允许每个国家的生产者从其他国家更具成本效益的供应商处采购品种，从而降低学习所需材料投入的成本。我们的量化分析表明，技能获取的收益占贸易总收益的5%。

records.title_en: The Dark Side of Batteries: Cobalt Mining and Children's Education in Sub‐Saharan Africa
records.title_cn: 电池的阴暗面：钴矿开采与撒哈拉以南非洲儿童教育
records.abstract_en: Although extractive industries have been associated with women's empowerment and lower infant mortality in Africa, this article provides evidence that the rapid increase in the demand for lithium‐ion batteries reduced the education rates of children living in cobalt mining villages in sub‐Saharan Africa. Children exposed to cobalt mining also exhibit slower cognitive and physical development than those living in noncobalt mining communities. The estimates are robust to spatial spillover effects and selective migration. This study highlights the need for policies that enforce child labor regulations in the cobalt mining sector, particularly because cobalt is crucial to technological development. Such policies can help mitigate the negative economic consequences for cobalt‐rich communities in the long run.
records.abstract_cn: 尽管采掘业在非洲与女性赋权和婴儿死亡率降低相关联，但本文提供的证据表明，锂离子电池需求的快速增长降低了撒哈拉以南非洲钴矿开采村庄儿童的教育率。接触钴矿开采的儿童在认知和身体发育方面也表现出比非钴矿开采社区的儿童更慢的发展。这些估计在空间溢出效应和选择性迁移方面是稳健的。本研究强调了在钴矿开采部门执行童工法规的必要性，特别是因为钴对技术发展至关重要。此类政策有助于长期缓解钴资源丰富社区的经济负面后果。

records.title_en: The Capital Matthew Effect: Directed Technical Change and International Capital Flows
records.title_cn: 资本马太效应：定向技术变革与国际资本流动
records.abstract_en: This study shows that technological specialization is one plausible driver of long‐term international capital flows. Capital scarcity raises marginal returns but also steers countries toward capital‐saving technologies. As a result, capital‐rich countries adopt capital‐complementary technologies and keep importing capital from poorer countries that favor capital‐substitute innovations. This divergence force on capital allocation, which we name the capital Matthew effect , offsets convergence from diminishing returns. The mechanism offers a unified explanation for puzzles like the Lucas paradox and global imbalances. Finally, we provide both country‐level and firm‐level evidence supporting this new model mechanism.
records.abstract_cn: 本研究显示，技术专业化是长期国际资本流动的一个合理驱动因素。资本稀缺提高了边际回报，但也引导国家采用节约资本的技术。因此，资本充裕的国家采用与资本互补的技术，并持续从偏好资本替代创新的较贫穷国家进口资本。这种资本配置上的分化力量，我们称之为资本马太效应，抵消了边际收益递减带来的趋同效应。该机制为卢卡斯悖论和全球失衡等谜题提供了统一的解释。最后，我们提供了国家和企业层面的证据，支持这一新模型机制。

records.title_en: Material Aspirations, Cultural Change, and the Transition Toward Sustained Growth
records.title_cn: 物质渴望、文化变迁与向持续增长的转型
records.abstract_en: We highlight the role of economic materialism as a cultural phenomenon of significance in relation to economic transformation and development. By inducing material aspirations, an endogenous cultural change toward more widespread adherence to materialistic values is both a cause and an effect of productivity growth. This cultural–economic complementarity is a powerful mechanism of endogenous productivity growth; it also determines the prevalence of different cultural values vis‐à‐vis the prominence of material objectives. From a historical perspective, the model draws attention to a novel mechanism through which cultural change may have contributed to the take‐off toward sustained economic growth.
records.abstract_cn: 我们强调经济物质主义作为一种文化现象在经济发展和转型中的重要性。通过激发物质渴望，向更广泛接受物质主义价值观的内生文化变迁既是生产力增长的原因也是其结果。这种文化-经济互补性是内生生产力增长的有力机制；它也决定了不同文化价值观相对于物质目标突出地位的普遍性。从历史角度看，该模型揭示了一种新机制，通过这种机制，文化变迁可能促进了向持续经济增长的起飞。

records.title_en: HANK Beyond FIRE: Amplification, Forward Guidance, and Belief Shocks
records.title_cn: 超越FIRE的HANK：放大效应、前瞻指引与信念冲击
records.abstract_en: Monetary policy transmission in the benchmark New Keynesian (NK) model hinges on the Full Information Rational Expectations (FIRE) assumption, especially via indirect general equilibrium (GE) effects. This paper relaxes FIRE by introducing noisy information into a Heterogeneous‐Agent NK model with financial frictions. Noisy information dampens amplification by muting GE effects, aligning model dynamics with empirical evidence, and resolving the forward guidance puzzle. It also broadens the determinacy region for policy rules. Finally, I explore belief shocks, showing that transitory “animal spirits” can have persistent effects, offering new insights into the macroeconomic consequences of information frictions.
records.abstract_cn: 基准新凯恩斯（NK）模型中的货币政策传导依赖于完全信息理性预期（FIRE）假设，尤其是通过间接一般均衡（GE）效应。本文通过将噪声信息引入具有金融摩擦的异质性主体NK模型，放宽了FIRE假设。噪声信息通过抑制GE效应减弱了放大效应，使模型动态与经验证据一致，并解决了前瞻指引之谜。它还拓宽了政策规则的确定性区域。最后，我探讨了信念冲击，表明暂时性的“动物精神”可能产生持久影响，为信息摩擦的宏观经济后果提供了新的见解。

records.title_en: An Economic Analysis of Difficulty Adjustment Algorithms in Proof‐of‐Work Blockchain Systems
records.title_cn: 工作量证明区块链系统中难度调整算法的经济分析
records.abstract_en: We study the stability of cryptocurrency systems through difficulty adjustment. Bitcoin's difficulty adjustment algorithm (DAA) exhibits instability when the reward elasticity of the hash rate is high, implying that a sharp price reduction could disrupt the current Bitcoin system. By contrast, newer DAAs developed and installed for other cryptocurrencies remain stably under substantially weaker conditions; thus, Bitcoin can inherently address this concern by upgrading its DAA. However, miners with high marginal costs profit from the existing DAA's instability and may oppose reforms that are beneficial for users. This finding highlights a critical challenge for the sustainability of cryptocurrencies.
records.abstract_cn: 我们通过难度调整来研究加密货币系统的稳定性。当哈希率的奖励弹性较高时，比特币的难度调整算法（DAA）表现出不稳定性，这意味着价格急剧下跌可能会扰乱当前的比特币系统。相比之下，为其他加密货币开发并安装的新DAA在显著较弱的条件下仍保持稳定；因此，比特币可以通过升级其DAA来固有地解决这一担忧。然而，具有高边际成本的矿工从现有DAA的不稳定性中获利，可能反对对用户有益的改革。这一发现凸显了加密货币可持续性的一个关键挑战。

records.title_en: Do Engine‐Specific Tax Programs Work? A Structural Analysis of Market Spillovers and Welfare Implications
records.title_cn: 发动机特定税收计划是否有效？市场溢出效应与福利影响的结构性分析
records.abstract_en: This paper examines engine‐specific tax programs that are widely used in developing countries to limit car emissions. Using China's tax abatement program for small vehicles in 2015, we find significant price and sales responses for both small and large vehicles, indicating strong competition spillovers. The quantification model shows that an increase in car ownership generates more car emissions than the reduction resulting from the relocation from large to small vehicles. Welfare analysis further shows that the reduced government tax revenue and increased car emissions significantly outweigh the increased household welfare and firm profits, rendering the engine‐specific tax program socially unbeneficial.
records.abstract_cn: 本文考察了发展中国家广泛用于限制汽车排放的发动机特定税收计划。利用中国2015年针对小排量汽车的税收减免计划，我们发现小排量和大排量汽车的价格和销量均有显著反应，表明存在强烈的竞争溢出效应。量化模型显示，汽车保有量的增加所产生的汽车排放量超过了因从大排量汽车转向小排量汽车而减少的排放量。福利分析进一步表明，政府税收收入的减少和汽车排放的增加显著超过了家庭福利和企业利润的增加，使得发动机特定税收计划在社会福利上无益。

records.title_en: An Efficient and Incentive‐Compatible Dynamic Multi‐Item Auction Under Budget Constraints
records.title_cn: 预算约束下高效且激励相容的动态多物品拍卖
records.abstract_en: This paper proposes an efficient and incentive‐compatible dynamic auction for selling multiple heterogeneous indivisible goods when bidders have unit demand, quasi‐linear preferences, and hard budgets. Valuations and budgets are private information. The auction generates an efficient outcome that is not only in the core but also strongly Pareto efficient. When no bidder is budget‐constrained, the auction returns a Walrasian equilibrium with the minimal equilibrium prices.
records.abstract_cn: 本文提出了一种高效且激励相容的动态拍卖机制，用于在竞标者具有单位需求、拟线性偏好和硬预算约束的情况下销售多种异质不可分割商品。估值和预算是私人信息。该拍卖产生的结果不仅处于核心中，而且是强帕累托有效的。当没有竞标者受到预算约束时，拍卖返回具有最小均衡价格的瓦尔拉斯均衡。

records.title_en: Games Between Players With Dual‐Selves
records.title_cn: 双自我玩家之间的博弈
records.abstract_en: Human decision making often seems to be determined by the resolution of intrapersonal conflict. This paper conceptualizes the analysis of decisions governed by such dual‐self processes in individual decision contexts and strategic interactions. For this purpose, we define the solution concept Dual‐Selves Equilibrium and derive sufficient conditions for the existence of such equilibria. We show that our framework also helps to study the strategic interaction between boundedly rational players that have only one‐self. In particular, our results extend several equilibrium existence results in Behavioral Game Theory and provide a simple sufficient condition for equilibrium existence.
records.abstract_cn: 人类决策往往似乎由内心冲突的解决所决定。本文在个体决策情境和战略互动中，概念化了对受此类双自我过程支配的决策的分析。为此，我们定义了解决方案概念“双自我均衡”，并推导了此类均衡存在的充分条件。我们表明，我们的框架也有助于研究仅具有单一自我的有限理性玩家之间的战略互动。特别是，我们的结果扩展了行为博弈论中的若干均衡存在性结果，并为均衡存在提供了一个简单的充分条件。

records.title_en: Limit Orders and Knightian Uncertainty
records.title_cn: 限价订单与奈特不确定性
records.abstract_en: A wide variety of financial instruments allows risk‐averse traders to reduce their exposure to risk. This raises the question of what financial instruments allow ambiguity‐averse traders to reduce their exposure to ambiguity. We show in this paper that price‐contingent orders, such as limit orders, are sufficient: In a two‐period trading model, an ambiguity‐averse trader who trades with limit orders is observationally indistinguishable from an ambiguity‐neutral trader with the same risk preferences.
records.abstract_cn: 种类繁多的金融工具使风险厌恶的交易者能够减少其风险敞口。这引出了一个问题：哪些金融工具能使模糊厌恶的交易者减少其模糊性敞口。本文表明，价格条件订单（如限价订单）是足够的：在一个两期交易模型中，使用限价订单进行交易的模糊厌恶交易者，在观察上与具有相同风险偏好的模糊中性交易者无法区分。

records.title_en: Evaluating Allocations of Opportunities
records.title_cn: 评估机会分配
records.abstract_en: This paper provides a robust criterion for comparing lists of probability distributions—interpreted as allocations of opportunities—faced by different social groups. We axiomatically argue in favor of comparing those lists of probability distributions on the basis of a uniform—among groups—valuation of their expected utility. We identify an empirically implementable criterion for comparing allocations of opportunities that coincides with the unanimity of all such uniform valuations of expected utility that exhibit aversion to inequality of opportunity. We illustrate our criterion by evaluating allocations of educational opportunities among castes and genders in 14 Indian states.
records.abstract_cn: 本文提供了一个稳健的标准，用于比较不同社会群体所面临的概率分布列表——这些列表被解释为机会分配。我们从公理角度论证，应基于群体间统一的期望效用评估来比较这些概率分布列表。我们确定了一个经验上可实施的机会分配比较标准，该标准与所有表现出机会不平等厌恶的统一期望效用评估的一致意见相吻合。我们通过评估14个印度邦中不同种姓和性别间教育机会的分配来说明我们的标准。

records.title_en: Choice and welfare under social constraints
records.title_cn: 社会约束下的选择与福利
records.abstract_en: Economists often rely on people’ s choices to infer their preferences. However, inferring preferences from choices becomes problematic when people face unobserved constraints. In this paper, I study how to (cautiously) infer preferences from choices when the choices of the members of a social group are subject to a constraint that we only imperfectly know. When this happens, heterogeneity in the group’ s choices, along with more information about the constraint, helps recover the preferences of group members, whereas homogeneity in choices hinders it. I further argue that standard approaches to choice-based welfare analysis can lead to misleading inferences about welfare when there are unobserved social constraints.
records.abstract_cn: 经济学家常常依赖人们的选择来推断其偏好。然而，当人们面临未观察到的约束时，从选择中推断偏好就会变得有问题。在本文中，我研究了当社会群体成员的选择受到我们仅不完全了解的约束时，如何（谨慎地）从选择中推断偏好。当这种情况发生时，群体选择中的异质性，连同关于约束的更多信息，有助于恢复群体成员的偏好，而选择中的同质性则阻碍了这一过程。我进一步论证，当存在未观察到的社会约束时，基于选择的标准福利分析方法可能导致关于福利的误导性推断。

records.title_en: Provoking the opposition
records.title_cn: 激怒反对党
records.abstract_en: Parties in primary elections often choose between candidates who appeal to their base and those who appeal to the broader electorate. I present a model of primaries where incumbents can exploit this trade-off the opposition faces between ideological congruence and electability. In the model, incumbents reduce their appeal to the median voter by moving away from the center. In doing so, they provoke the opposition into nominating extremists, improving their reelection prospects. This mechanism generates elite polarization as politicians leapfrog voters — not despite electoral concerns, but because of them. The analysis fits the observation that incumbents sometimes move away from the center near the end of their term. Provoking the opposition relies on two conditions: divergence of primary and general electorates and a limited set of potential nominees. I argue that partisan sorting and changes in nomination procedures over the last decades made this strategy viable.
records.abstract_cn: 在初选中，政党常常在吸引本党基本盘的候选人和吸引更广泛选民的候选人之间做出选择。我提出了一个初选模型，其中现任者可以利用反对党在意识形态一致性和可选举性之间面临的权衡。在该模型中，现任者通过远离中间立场来降低对中间选民的吸引力。这样做，他们激怒反对党提名极端分子，从而改善自己的连任前景。这一机制产生了精英极化，即政治家跨越选民——并非不顾选举考量，而是恰恰因为选举考量。该分析符合观察到的现象：现任者有时在任期接近尾声时远离中间立场。激怒反对党依赖于两个条件：初选选民与普选选民的差异，以及潜在提名人的有限集合。我认为，过去几十年中党派分化与提名程序的变化使这一策略变得可行。

records.title_en: Risk-taking in financial networks
records.title_cn: 金融网络中的风险承担
records.abstract_en: We analyze risk-taking behaviors of financial institutions linked through cross-shareholding relationships. We endogenize risk exposure accounting for default risk by modeling Value-at-Risk-based risk-management – that is targeted default probabilities – in the presence of extreme risk on asset return. We relate risk-taking behaviors to a centrality measure that captures the propagation of losses within the network, and show that network integration increases risk-taking levels and expected return. However, we show that network integration also results in larger expected shortfall, indicating greater exposure to losses for creditors. We explore the impact of the cross-shareholding network on the implementation of regulation, particularly through capital requirements, and identify key institutions, those with the highest influence on aggregate investments in risky assets.
records.abstract_cn: 我们分析了通过交叉持股关系相连的金融机构的风险承担行为。我们通过建模基于风险价值的风险管理——即目标违约概率——在资产回报存在极端风险的情况下，内生化了风险敞口。我们将风险承担行为与衡量网络内损失传播的中心性指标联系起来，并表明网络一体化提高了风险承担水平和预期回报。然而，我们表明网络一体化也导致更大的预期短缺，表明债权人面临更大的损失敞口。我们探讨了交叉持股网络对监管实施的影响，特别是通过资本要求，并识别出关键机构，即那些对风险资产总投资影响最大的机构。

records.title_en: A note on the non-coincidence of the core and the bargaining set in many-to-one assignment markets
records.title_cn: 关于多对一指派市场中核与谈判集不一致的一个注记
records.abstract_en: This paper analyzes the extent to which well-known results on the relationship between the bargaining set, the core, and the kernel in one-to-one assignment games generalize to many-to-one assignment markets, and by extension, many-to-many markets. Using a minimal counterexample, we show that the bargaining set does not necessarily coincide with the core and that the kernel may not be contained within the core. We would like to highlight that the failure of the coincidence between the core and the bargaining set, as observed in the many-to-one assignment game, is quite notable. This is especially true when compared to various other highly structured games, many of which emerge from combinatorial optimization problems, such as the one underlying many-to-one assignment games.
records.abstract_cn: 本文分析了在一对一指派博弈中关于谈判集、核与核仁之间关系的著名结果在多大程度上推广到多对一指派市场，并进而推广到多对多市场。通过一个最小反例，我们证明了谈判集不一定与核重合，且核仁可能不包含于核内。我们想强调，在多对一指派博弈中观察到的核与谈判集不一致的失败是相当显著的。这一点在与其他各种高度结构化的博弈相比时尤为突出，其中许多博弈源于组合优化问题，例如支撑多对一指派市场的问题。

records.title_en: Improving the deferred acceptance with minimal compromise
records.title_cn: 以最小妥协改进延迟接受机制
records.abstract_en: In school choice problems, the pursuit of student welfare (efficiency) is constrained by the requirement to respect schools’ priorities (fairness). Among fair matchings, even the welfare maximizing one, the Student-Optimal Stable Matching (SOSM), is inefficient. Moreover, any mechanism that yields welfare gains over the SOSM is manipulable by students. This paper investigates the fairness and incentive properties of efficient mechanisms. We compare matchings using the notion that one matching is less unfair than another if it generates a smaller set of students whose priorities are violated, and we define minimal unfairness accordingly. We show that the Efficiency-Adjusted Deferred Acceptance (EADA) mechanism is minimally unfair within the class of Pareto efficient mechanisms satisfying a simple incentive requirement, top-manipulation-proofness. Moreover, the EADA satisfies a stronger property, upper-manipulation-proofness. Upper-manipulation-proofness is a broad incentive property one can maintain while improving upon the SOSM. Together, these results highlight a sharp frontier in school choice: when the objective is efficiency and improving student welfare over the SOSM, the EADA emerges as a compelling mechanism in both fairness and incentive terms.
records.abstract_cn: 在学校选择问题中，对学生福利（效率）的追求受到尊重学校优先权（公平性）要求的约束。在公平匹配中，即使是福利最大化的匹配，即学生最优稳定匹配（SOSM），也是低效的。此外，任何能在SOSM基础上带来福利改进的机制都可能被学生操纵。本文研究了高效机制的公平性和激励特性。我们通过一个匹配比另一个匹配产生更少的优先权被侵犯的学生集合来比较匹配，并据此定义最小不公平性。我们证明，在满足简单激励要求（即防顶部操纵性）的帕累托高效机制类别中，效率调整延迟接受（EADA）机制是最小不公平的。此外，EADA还满足更强的性质，即防上部操纵性。防上部操纵性是在改进SOSM的同时可以维持的一种广泛的激励性质。这些结果共同凸显了学校选择中的一个鲜明边界：当目标是效率和在SOSM基础上提高学生福利时，EADA在公平性和激励性方面都成为一个引人注目的机制。

records.title_en: Marginal contribution and singleton cores in one-sided matching and assignment
records.title_cn: 单边匹配与指派中的边际贡献与单点核
records.abstract_en: We examine the attainability of marginal contributions in two models of one-sided matching and assignment. For the one-sided matching problem, where agents in a single group are matched with each other, the core may be empty, and even when nonempty, some agents may fail to attain their marginal contributions in the core. By allowing fractional matchings, however, we guarantee the non-emptiness of the core and show that every agent’s marginal contribution is attainable in the core. This implies that all the agents can receive their marginal contributions at the same time if and only if the core is a singleton. For the one-sided assignment problem, where agents are matched to objects they own, we obtain analogous results even without introducing fractional assignments. Finally, extending to linear production games, which encompass both models, we show that the attainability property may fail but is guaranteed under sufficiently many replications.
records.abstract_cn: 我们考察了单边匹配和指派两种模型中边际贡献的可实现性。对于单边匹配问题，其中单一群体中的代理人相互匹配，核可能为空，即使非空，某些代理人可能无法在核中实现其边际贡献。然而，通过允许分数匹配，我们保证了核的非空性，并表明每个代理人的边际贡献在核中是可实现的。这意味着所有代理人能够同时获得其边际贡献当且仅当核是单点集。对于单边指派问题，其中代理人匹配到他们拥有的物品，即使不引入分数指派，我们也获得了类似的结果。最后，扩展到涵盖这两种模型的线性生产博弈，我们表明可实现性可能失败，但在足够多的复制下得到保证。

records.title_en: Payoff continuity in games of incomplete information across models of knowledge
records.title_cn: 不完全信息博弈中跨知识模型的收益连续性
records.abstract_en: Equilibrium predictions in games of incomplete information are sensitive to the assumed information structure. Monderer and Samet (1996) and Kajii and Morris (1998) define topological notions of proximity for common prior information structures such that two information structures are close if and only if (approximate) equilibrium payoffs are close. However, Monderer and Samet (1996) fix a common prior and define their topology on profiles of partitions over a state space, whereas Kajii and Morris (1998) define their topology on common priors over the product of a state space and a type space. We prove the open conjecture that two partition profiles are close in the Monderer and Samet (1996) topology if and only if there exists a labeling of types such that the associated common priors are close in the Kajii and Morris (1998) topology.
records.abstract_cn: 不完全信息博弈中的均衡预测对假定的信息结构敏感。Monderer和Samet（1996）以及Kajii和Morris（1998）为共同先验信息结构定义了拓扑邻近概念，使得两个信息结构接近当且仅当（近似）均衡收益接近。然而，Monderer和Samet（1996）固定了一个共同先验，并在状态空间上的划分轮廓上定义其拓扑，而Kajii和Morris（1998）则在状态空间与类型空间的乘积上的共同先验上定义其拓扑。我们证明了公开猜想：在Monderer和Samet（1996）拓扑中两个划分轮廓接近，当且仅当存在一个类型标记，使得相关的共同先验在Kajii和Morris（1998）拓扑中接近。

records.title_en: Extensive form games with incentive stage-bidding: An emergence of non-cooperative cooperation
records.title_cn: 具有激励阶段招标的广泛形式博弈：非合作合作的出现
records.abstract_en: This paper proposes and studies a mechanism modelling the emergence of cooperation in non-cooperative multi-player extensive form games. We consider such games enriched with additional “stage bidding actions”, where at each decision node of the game tree, before the player controlling that node makes a decision every other player may make a committed offer (‘bid’) to pay an explicitly proposed amount of utility to the controlling player if she makes the choice explicitly indicated in the bid. In this work we assume that the bids are made simultaneously by all players. The controlling player then considers all these bids and then decides on its move. The effect of each bid associated with that choice is that it modifies the payoffs in the respective subgame according to the bid by transferring the proposed amounts of utility from the bidder to the controlling player who made the choice; all other bids made at that stage become irrelevant. Thus, these stage bids serve as an incentives-based mechanism that enables reaching a mutually beneficial cooperation in extensive form games.
records.abstract_cn: 本文提出并研究了一种模拟非合作多人扩展形式博弈中合作出现的机制。我们认为此类游戏富含额外的“阶段投标动作”，其中在游戏树的每个决策节点，在控制该节点的玩家做出决定之前，所有其他玩家都可以做出承诺的报价（“投标”），如果控制玩家做出投标中明确指示的选择，则向控制玩家支付明确提议的效用金额。在这项工作中，我们假设所有参与者同时出价。然后，控制玩家考虑所有这些出价，然后决定其行动。与该选择相关的每个出价的效果是，它通过将提议的效用量从出价者转移到做出选择的控制玩家，根据出价修改相应子游戏中的收益；在此阶段提出的所有其他出价都变得无关紧要。因此，这些阶段性投标作为一种基于激励的机制，能够在广泛的博弈中达成互利合作。

records.title_en: When do prediction markets return average beliefs? Experimental evidence
records.title_cn: 预测市场何时返回平均信念？实验证据
records.abstract_en: In prediction markets, prices can be interpreted as the average belief of the traders under restrictive theoretical assumptions, i.e. specific risk preferences and the Prior Information Equilibrium. The validity of these assumptions depends on the specific market institution and on the composition of the market in terms of risk preferences. In this paper we test in a laboratory experiment the main elements that should affect the distance between prices and average beliefs, manipulating the market institution and the market composition. We do not find that risk preferences significantly affect prices. We find instead that in the double auction– where at least partial information aggregation is expected – prices are closer to the average belief than in the call auction – where, instead, belief aggregation is expected. We show that traders update beliefs in the direction of observed prices, rather than of the true state.
records.abstract_cn: 在预测市场中，价格可以解释为交易者在限制性理论假设（即特定风险偏好和先验信息均衡）下的平均信念。这些假设的有效性取决于具体的市场制度以及市场风险偏好的构成。在本文中，我们在实验室实验中测试了影响价格与平均信念之间距离、操纵市场制度和市场构成的主要因素。我们没有发现风险偏好对价格有显着影响。相反，我们发现，在双重拍卖中（预计至少部分信息聚合），价格比集合拍卖中更接近平均信念（相反，预计信念聚合）。我们表明，交易者会根据观察到的价格方向而不是真实状态来更新信念。

records.title_en: Naivete and sophistication in initial and repeated play in games
records.title_cn: 博弈中初始与重复博弈中的天真与老练
records.abstract_en: Compared with more sophisticated equilibrium theory, naive, non-equilibrium behavioral rules often better describe individuals’ initial play in games. In addition, in repeated play in games, when individuals have the opportunity to learn about their opponents’ past behavior, learning models of different sophistication levels are successful in explaining how individuals modify their behavior in response to the provided information. How do subjects who follow different behavioral rules in initial play modify their behavior after they learn about past behavior? This study links initial and repeated play in two different types of games (11–20 and 3 × 3 normal-form games) using a within-subject laboratory design. We classify individuals as following different behavioral rules in initial and repeated play and test whether and/or how strategic naivete and sophistication in initial play correlate with naivete and sophistication in repeated play. We find no evidence of a positive correlation between naivete and sophistication in initial and repeated play.
records.abstract_cn: 与更老练的均衡理论相比，天真的、非均衡的行为规则往往能更好地描述个体在博弈中的初始行为。此外，在博弈的重复进行中，当个体有机会了解对手过去的行为时，不同老练程度的学习模型在解释个体如何根据所提供的信息调整其行为方面是成功的。在初始博弈中遵循不同行为规则的受试者在了解过去行为后如何调整其行为？本研究通过受试者内实验室设计，将两种不同类型博弈（11-20和3×3标准型博弈）中的初始与重复博弈联系起来。我们将个体在初始和重复博弈中遵循的不同行为规则进行分类，并检验初始博弈中的战略天真和老练是否以及/或如何与重复博弈中的天真和老练相关。我们发现没有证据表明初始和重复博弈中的天真与老练之间存在正相关。

records.title_en: Understanding Non-Compliance with Rights-Based Fisheries Management In Vietnam
records.title_cn: 理解越南权利型渔业管理中的不遵从行为
records.abstract_en: Understanding the determinants of non-compliance is crucial for the effective management and conservation of small-scale fisheries. This study empirically examines the drivers of non-compliance with Territorial Use Rights for Fisheries (TURFs) regulations in Vietnam’s Tam Giang Lagoon. To mitigate response bias associated with sensitive topics, we employed a mixed-methods approach combining the randomized response technique (RRT) and direct questioning (DQ) to estimate the prevalence of illegal fishing activities. Results indicate that the predominant form of non-compliance involves the use of nets with illegal mesh size, whereas violations related to destructive gear and fishing in protected areas are infrequent. Statistical analysis revealed no significant difference between RRT and DQ estimates for illegal mesh-size use, implying minimal social desirability bias in reporting this behavior. Determinants of non-compliance were identified using a binary logistic regression model. Compliance was positively and significantly associated with fishers’ awareness of the negative consequences of illegal fishing, perceived legitimacy of the regulatory framework, and social trust in peers’ adherence to regulations. Conversely, combined instrumental-normative incentives did not significantly influence compliance. The study highlights that the widespread use of illegal nets seems to have established a social norm that replaces traditional incentives, primarily due to insufficient enforcement. These findings contribute to understanding regulatory compliance in multispecies fisheries and offer critical insights for policy design aimed at enhancing adherence to TURF regulations. Policy recommendations include leveraging educational initiatives, promoting participatory governance, and supporting livelihood diversification to reconcile conservation objectives with the socioeconomic needs of fishing communities.
records.abstract_cn: 理解不遵从行为的决定因素对于小规模渔业的有效管理和保护至关重要。本研究实证考察了越南三江潟湖中渔业领地使用权（TURFs）法规不遵从行为的驱动因素。为减轻与敏感话题相关的回答偏差，我们采用了混合方法，结合随机应答技术（RRT）和直接提问（DQ）来估计非法捕捞活动的普遍程度。结果表明，不遵从的主要形式涉及使用非法网目尺寸的渔网，而与破坏性渔具和在保护区捕捞相关的违规行为则较少见。统计分析显示，对于非法网目尺寸的使用，RRT和DQ估计之间没有显著差异，这意味着在报告这一行为时社会期望偏差很小。使用二元逻辑回归模型识别了不遵从行为的决定因素。合规性与渔民对非法捕捞负面后果的认识、对监管框架合法性的感知以及对同伴遵守法规的社会信任呈显著正相关。相反，工具性和规范性激励的组合并未显著影响合规性。研究强调，非法渔网的广泛使用似乎已形成一种社会规范，取代了传统激励，主要原因是执法不足。这些发现有助于理解多物种渔业中的监管合规性，并为旨在提高TURF法规遵守度的政策设计提供了关键见解。政策建议包括利用教育举措、促进参与式治理和支持生计多样化，以协调保护目标与渔业社区的社会经济需求。

records.title_en: Result-Based vs. Action-Based Payments in Spatially Heterogeneous Landscapes: A Systematic Model-Based Comparison
records.title_cn: 空间异质景观中的结果导向支付与行动导向支付：基于模型的系统比较
records.abstract_en: Result-based payments (RBP) are discussed as a more targeted and cost-effective alternative to action-based payments (ABP). Previous research indicates that if the economic costs and ecological benefits of conservation measures are spatially heterogeneous the efficiency gains of RBP relative to ABP are largest if there is a positive spatial correlation between the conservation costs and benefits. The present paper presents a stylised spatially structured model of an agricultural landscape with spatially heterogeneous conservation costs and benefits, to systematically explore gains in cost-effectiveness and budget efficiency of RBP relative to ABP as functions of the spatial distribution of the conservation costs and benefits. In addition, since RBP lead to a different allocation of ecological risks between the regulator and the farmers, the present paper explores how the cost-effectiveness and budget efficiency gains depend on the risk attitudes of regulator and farmers when the ecological benefits accruing from the farmers’ conservation efforts are uncertain. Among other things, the results highlight the previously underrated influence of the magnitudes of the spatial variations of the conservation costs and benefits. In the analysis the modelled RBP measurably outperformed the ABP only if the variation in the ecological benefits sufficiently exceeded that in the economic costs. The recently proposed “RBP for modelled results” (as an alternative to the common “RBP for observed results”) did not show any additional performance gain, and in particular were not able to mitigate the risk trade-off between farmers and regulators as it appears in the choice between RBP for observed results and ABP.
records.abstract_cn: 结果导向支付（RBP）被视为行动导向支付（ABP）的一种更具针对性和成本效益的替代方案。先前的研究表明，如果保护措施的经济成本和生态效益在空间上异质，当保护成本与效益之间存在正空间相关性时，RBP相对于ABP的效率增益最大。本文提出了一个农业景观的简化空间结构模型，其中保护成本和效益在空间上异质，以系统探讨RBP相对于ABP在成本效益和预算效率方面的增益，作为保护成本和效益空间分布的函数。此外，由于RBP导致监管者与农民之间生态风险分配的不同，本文还探讨了当农民保护努力所产生的生态效益不确定时，成本效益和预算效率增益如何依赖于监管者和农民的风险态度。结果尤其凸显了保护成本和效益空间变异幅度此前被低估的影响。在分析中，只有当生态效益的变异充分超过经济成本的变异时，所建模的RBP才显著优于ABP。最近提出的“基于建模结果的RBP”（作为常见的“基于观测结果的RBP”的替代方案）并未显示出额外的绩效增益，尤其无法缓解在基于观测结果的RBP与ABP之间选择时农民与监管者之间出现的风险权衡。

records.title_en: What We Know Shapes What We Grow: Environmental Information Treatment Effects on Urban Tree Choices
records.title_cn: 我们所知塑造我们所植：环境信息处理对城市树木选择的影响
records.abstract_en: The growing number of urban greening programs, and in particular street tree policies, reflects the need to adapt to changing environmental conditions in cities. Tree-planting program communication materials often include information about species’ size, origin, and aesthetic characteristics, but typically lack information about species’ contribution to local environmental quality. Here, in a best-worst scaling experiment that elicits public rankings of different tree species, I investigate the influence of introducing information about drought tolerance and ability to support local biodiversity on most preferred species selection. Results show that public preferences for street tree species are sensitive to environmental information provision. Respondents initially preferred trees with higher watering requirements, but this effect was reversed following a treatment introducing information about drought tolerance. In addition, preferences for biodiversity-supporting trees were strengthened following the intervention. In Western Australia, where preference elicitation is often part of residential street tree species selection, explicitly providing environmental information can enable more informed decision-making for enhanced social wellbeing, while also helping cities adapt to water-use restrictions and manage biodiversity decline.
records.abstract_cn: 城市绿化项目，特别是街道树木政策的日益增多，反映了城市适应不断变化的环境条件的需要。植树项目的传播材料通常包含关于树种大小、起源和美学特征的信息，但通常缺乏关于树种对当地环境质量贡献的信息。在此，通过一项最佳-最差标度实验，该实验引出公众对不同树种的排名，我研究了引入关于耐旱性和支持当地生物多样性能力的信息对最偏好树种选择的影响。结果表明，公众对街道树种的偏好对环境信息提供敏感。受访者最初偏好需水量较高的树木，但在引入耐旱性信息的处理后，这一效应被逆转。此外，在干预后，对支持生物多样性的树木的偏好得到加强。在西澳大利亚，偏好引出通常是住宅街道树种选择的一部分，明确提供环境信息可以使决策更加知情，从而增强社会福祉，同时也有助于城市适应水资源使用限制和管理生物多样性下降。

records.title_en: The Two-Edged Sword of Altruism in Willingness to Pay for Water Infrastructure and Affordability Programs
records.title_cn: 利他主义在水基础设施与可负担性项目支付意愿中的双刃剑
records.abstract_en: Aging water and sewer infrastructure in the United States poses significant health and environmental risks. While higher water and sewer rates can finance infrastructure replacement, they may also exacerbate affordability challenges for low-income households. This study employs a choice experiment to estimate public valuation of infrastructure replacement programs and statewide water affordability programs that ensure water and sewer access for low-income households. The study also explores if altruistic preferences and perceptions about beneficiaries’ water use influence program support and develops a novel measure of altruism suitable for online surveys. Analysis of survey responses from 1,732 Michigan and Ohio residents reveals strong public support for infrastructure replacement programs that improve health and environmental outcomes. Altruists have a higher willingness to pay (WTP) than non-altruists for both infrastructure replacement and affordability programs. Paternalistic altruists, that is, altruists who care about consumption of specific goods such as water and sewer, have higher marginal WTP for addressing deteriorating health effects from aging infrastructure. While altruists show higher WTP for affordability programs compared to non-altruists, their WTP can be lower if altruists have concerns that beneficiaries of a water affordability program will waste water. Policy implications include making the impact of aging infrastructure tangible, addressing wastefulness concerns, and incentive-based affordability programs for viable water and sewer programs.
records.abstract_cn: 美国老化的供水和污水基础设施对健康和环境构成重大风险。虽然提高水费和污水费可以为基础设施更换提供资金，但也可能加剧低收入家庭的可负担性挑战。本研究采用选择实验来评估公众对基础设施更换项目和确保低收入家庭获得供水和污水服务的全州水可负担性项目的估值。研究还探讨了利他偏好和对受益者用水量的感知是否影响项目支持，并开发了一种适用于在线调查的新型利他主义衡量方法。对来自1,732名密歇根州和俄亥俄州居民调查回复的分析显示，公众对改善健康和环境结果的基础设施更换项目有强烈支持。利他主义者对基础设施更换和可负担性项目均比非利他主义者有更高的支付意愿（WTP）。家长式利他主义者，即关心特定商品（如供水和污水）消费的利他主义者，对解决老化基础设施导致的健康恶化影响具有更高的边际支付意愿。虽然利他主义者对可负担性项目的支付意愿高于非利他主义者，但如果利他主义者担心水可负担性项目的受益者会浪费水，他们的支付意愿可能会更低。政策含义包括使老化基础设施的影响变得切实可见、解决浪费担忧，以及为可行的供水和污水项目提供基于激励的可负担性计划。

records.title_en: Occupational Heat Stress and Employment Dynamics in Italy
records.title_cn: 职业热应激与意大利就业动态
records.abstract_en: This paper adopts an occupation-based approach to analyse the impact of heatwaves on short-run local employment dynamics in Italy. Using quarterly province-level panel data combined with occupational survey information, econometric analyses show that prolonged heatwaves significantly reduce local employment rates, with largest effects among workers in positions more exposed to heat stress. Employment losses are substantial among top-exposure occupations in agriculture and construction, but notable effects also emerge in relatively less exposed jobs, particularly in hospitality and trade. Interestingly, comparing absolute vs. relative heatwaves provide evidence of local adaptation, more limited in agriculture than in construction and services. Further, the decomposition between unemployment and inactivity shows that labour-supply adjustments are crucial in construction and play an important role in both agriculture and hospitality. Results are robust to specifications accounting for impact persistency and non-linearity, as well as to alternative temperature measures.
records.abstract_cn: 本文采用基于职业的方法分析热浪对意大利短期地方就业动态的影响。利用季度省级面板数据结合职业调查信息，计量经济分析表明，持续热浪显著降低了地方就业率，其中对热应激暴露程度较高的职位上的工人影响最大。在农业和建筑业的最高暴露职业中，就业损失显著，但在相对暴露较少的职业中也出现了显著影响，尤其是在酒店业和贸易业。有趣的是，绝对热浪与相对热浪的比较提供了地方适应的证据，农业中的适应程度比建筑业和服务业更为有限。此外，失业与非经济活动之间的分解显示，劳动力供给调整在建筑业中至关重要，并在农业和酒店业中发挥重要作用。结果对于考虑影响持续性和非线性的规格以及替代温度测量方法均具有稳健性。

records.title_en: Sectoral Cost-Benefit Analysis for Clean Technology Demonstrators: Insights for Decarbonizing Hard-to-Abate Industries
records.title_cn: 清洁技术示范项目的部门级成本效益分析：对难以减排行业脱碳的启示
records.abstract_en: Adopting disruptive technologies to decarbonize hard-to-abate industrial sectors requires experimentation through demonstration (pilot) projects. However, from an economic perspective, the potential long-term benefits and the challenges of designing effective public policies are often overlooked in standard valuations of these projects. This paper demonstrates that conducting cost-benefit analysis (CBA) at the sectoral level offers valuable insights to address these issues. It accounts for knowledge spillovers from the pilot project across the industry and incorporates technical changes in value-added cost components of adjacent activities. Such an analysis identifies the optimal trajectory for decarbonizing the sector. Our proposed CBA framework also determines the relevant abatement cost for the pilot project, a critical indicator for public policy. Applied to France’s large-scale, high-quality container glass sector, the CBA estimates an abatement cost of approximately €200/tCO 2 for the pilot deploying a decarbonized hybrid technology—45% lower than previous standard approaches. Furthermore, we demonstrate that subsidizing the pilot project, combined with a commitment to transfer knowledge to follower plants, is sufficient to achieve the social optimum, provided governments implement an emissions tax that internalizes environmental costs. This approach can be extended to other hard-to-abate sectors, enabling the early deployment of disruptive innovations and facilitating the design of effective public policies.
records.abstract_cn: 采用颠覆性技术以实现难以减排工业部门的脱碳，需要通过示范（试点）项目进行实验。然而，从经济角度来看，这些项目的潜在长期效益和设计有效公共政策的挑战，在标准评估中往往被忽视。本文证明，在部门层面进行成本效益分析（CBA）为解决这些问题提供了宝贵的见解。该分析考虑了试点项目在整个行业中的知识溢出效应，并纳入了相邻活动增值成本组成部分的技术变化。此类分析确定了该部门脱碳的最优路径。我们提出的CBA框架还确定了试点项目的相关减排成本，这是公共政策的关键指标。应用于法国大规模、高质量的容器玻璃行业，CBA估计，采用脱碳混合技术的试点项目的减排成本约为€200/tCO 2，比以往标准方法低45%%。此外，我们证明，补贴试点项目，并承诺将知识转移给后续工厂，足以实现社会最优，前提是政府实施将环境成本内部化的排放税。这种方法可以扩展到其他难以减排的行业，促进颠覆性创新的早期部署，并有助于设计有效的公共政策。

records.title_en: Adaptation in Target-Based International Environmental Agreements
records.title_cn: 基于目标的国际环境协议中的适应性
records.abstract_en: In this paper, we examine the impact of adaptive investments on international environmental agreements that, like the current Paris Agreement, have a bottom-up nature, with signatory countries committing to a common emission target (T-agreement). Furthermore, we contrast the effectiveness of the T-agreement with that of an agreement in which signatory countries act as a coalition and make their decisions jointly (J-agreement). Under a T-agreement, the strategic relationships between countries’ emissions, as well as between adaptation and mitigation, align with the results found in the literature on J-agreements. However, the impact of adaptation and of the number of countries participating to the agreement differ significantly. These results offer new insights into the interplay between emissions, adaptation, and participation in the context of international environmental agreements, and they highlight the critical role played by the agreement’s structure and substance.
records.abstract_cn: 在本文中，我们考察了适应性投资对国际环境协议的影响，这些协议如当前的巴黎协定一样，具有自下而上的性质，签署国承诺共同排放目标（T-协议）。此外，我们将T-协议的有效性与签署国作为联盟共同决策的协议（J-协议）的有效性进行对比。在T-协议下，国家排放之间以及适应与减缓之间的战略关系与J-协议文献中的发现一致。然而，适应性和参与协议国家数量的影响显著不同。这些结果为国际环境协议背景下排放、适应和参与之间的相互作用提供了新的见解，并强调了协议结构和实质内容的关键作用。

records.title_en: Pigou’s Advice and Sisyphus’ Warning: Carbon Pricing with Non-Permanent Carbon Dioxide Removal
records.title_cn: 庇古的建议与西西弗斯的警告：非永久性二氧化碳移除下的碳定价
records.abstract_en: This paper develops a welfare and public economics perspective on optimal policies for carbon removal and storage (CDR) in permanent and non-permanent sinks. Non-permanent CDR reduces mitigation costs, even though the stored carbon is released into the atmosphere eventually. It may serve as bridge technology until permanent CDR becomes available. In contrast to permanent removals, non-permanent CDR does not reduce the optimal long-run temperature level. Its valuation differs from the social cost of carbon since a social cost of carbon removal arises from marginal damages caused by emissions released from non-permanent storage. We discuss three policy regimes that ensure optimal deployment of non-permanent CDR in terms of their informational and institutional requirements for monitoring, liability, and financing.
records.abstract_cn: 本文从福利和公共经济学视角出发，探讨了在永久性和非永久性碳汇中进行碳移除与封存（CDR）的最优政策。非永久性CDR虽最终会将封存的碳释放到大气中，但仍能降低减缓成本，并可作为过渡技术，直至永久性CDR可用。与永久性移除不同，非永久性CDR不会降低最优长期温度水平。其估值不同于碳的社会成本，因为碳移除的社会成本源于非永久性封存释放的排放所造成的边际损害。我们讨论了三种政策机制，以确保非永久性CDR的最优部署，并从监测、责任和融资方面的信息与制度要求进行了分析。

records.title_en: Information, Distance and Firms’ Responses: Evidence from Polluting Monitoring in China
records.title_cn: 信息、距离与企业响应：来自中国污染监测的证据
records.abstract_en: This paper explores the unintended consequences of an automated air quality monitoring program aimed at enhancing air quality information disclosure in China. Using a difference-in-differences (DiD) model, we analyze the spatial effects of automated monitoring on the production activities of polluting firms located at different distances from monitoring stations but within the same city. Our findings indicate that automated monitoring has resulted in polluting firms located farther from monitors achieving higher production levels. We provide evidence suggesting that these spatial effects are driven by the strategic responses of local governments, which is to impose stricter regulations on polluting firms closer to monitoring stations. In addition, polluting firms’ input-related measures and land transaction behaviors also exhibit spatial variations that related to their distance from monitors. Our findings enrich the understanding of local strategic behaviors under top-down regulations and offer valuable insights for improving compliance and enforcement efforts in developing countries.
records.abstract_cn: 本文探讨了中国旨在提升空气质量信息公开的自动化空气质量监测项目所带来的意外后果。利用双重差分（DiD）模型，我们分析了自动化监测对位于同一城市内、距离监测站不同距离的污染企业生产活动的空间效应。我们的研究结果表明，自动化监测导致距离监测站较远的污染企业实现了更高的生产水平。我们提供的证据表明，这些空间效应是由地方政府的策略性响应所驱动的，即对靠近监测站的污染企业实施更严格的监管。此外，污染企业的投入相关措施和土地交易行为也表现出与其距离监测站远近相关的空间差异。我们的发现丰富了对自上而下监管下地方策略行为的理解，并为改善发展中国家的合规与执法工作提供了有价值的见解。

records.title_en: Sovereign Debt Sustainability, The Carbon Budget, and Climate Damages
records.title_cn: 主权债务可持续性、碳预算与气候损害
records.abstract_en: Climate risks present a substantial challenge to sovereign debt sustainability and fiscal space. The economic costs associated with mitigation efforts and physical damages can hinder growth, making sovereign debt repayment more difficult. An effective measure for capturing these phenomena is the so-called fiscal limit: the maximum debt-to-GDP ratio that can be sustained without incurring default risk. This paper calculates fiscal limits for 31 advanced economies under various transition scenarios. Three main results emerge from the analysis. First, the impact of greenhouse gas emission reductions, aligned with Paris Agreement carbon budgets, lowers fiscal limits in the short term. However, it does not generally determine whether a country shifts from sovereign debt sustainability to unsustainability, except when inefficiently managed for some high-debt economies, such as Italy. Additionally, the emission reduction trajectory depends on the objective of the government maximization programme (welfare vs. debt sustainability) and this affects fiscal limits. Finally, accounting for climate damages and global coordination in the transition appears critical. Without collective efforts to reduce emissions and mitigate climate damages, fiscal limits are projected to decline sharply over the long term for all countries, including those making successful transition efforts. These findings emphasize that the only viable path to maintaining sustainable debt is a global, collaborative, well managed, and timely transition.
records.abstract_cn: 气候风险对主权债务可持续性和财政空间构成了重大挑战。与减缓措施和物理损害相关的经济成本可能阻碍增长，使主权债务偿还更加困难。捕捉这些现象的一个有效指标是所谓的财政极限：在不产生违约风险的情况下可以维持的最大债务与GDP之比。本文计算了31个发达经济体在不同转型情景下的财政极限。分析得出三个主要结果。首先，与《巴黎协定》碳预算一致的温室气体减排影响，短期内降低了财政极限。然而，这通常并不决定一个国家是否从主权债务可持续性转向不可持续性，除非在管理效率低下的情况下，对于一些高债务经济体，如意大利。此外，减排轨迹取决于政府最大化计划的目标（福利与债务可持续性），这影响了财政极限。最后，考虑气候损害和转型中的全球协调似乎至关重要。如果没有集体努力减少排放和减轻气候损害，预计所有国家的财政极限将在长期内急剧下降，包括那些成功进行转型努力的国家。这些发现强调，维持可持续债务的唯一可行路径是全球性的、协作性的、管理良好的和及时的转型。

records.title_en: The role of household and community infrastructures in mitigating energy poverty in Africa: Between and within urban and rural areas
records.title_cn: 家庭与社区基础设施在缓解非洲能源贫困中的作用：城乡之间及城乡内部
records.abstract_en: Energy poverty persists as a critical challenge across African countries, and infrastructural conditions have become important in mitigating its severity. This study examines associations between energy poverty and infrastructures at the household and community levels in 28 African countries. We construct multidimensional energy poverty (MEP) and infrastructure indices and visualize their spatial patterns using a Bayesian hierarchical model. Regression models estimate the effects of multilevel infrastructure conditions on household MEP. To account for variation in infrastructure–MEP relationships across urbanizing contexts, we conduct subgroup analyses across four settlement types: large cities, small and medium-sized cities, rural towns, and rural villages. Spatial analysis shows substantial disparities in MEP that align closely with patterns of infrastructure conditions. Regression results reveal that higher levels of household and community infrastructures are associated with lower MEP, and the relationship is stronger for community infrastructure. The magnitude of these associations varies across settlement types. Community infrastructure has a larger effect on MEP in rural towns and villages, whereas household infrastructure has a larger effect on MEP in large cities. In small and medium-sized cities, the effect sizes of household and community infrastructures are comparable. Nighttime light intensity used as a proxy for broader electrification environments is also associated with lower MEP. These findings suggest that multilevel infrastructures are critical for alleviating energy poverty, and their roles differ across settlement contexts. Policy implications include the importance of cross-sectoral infrastructure planning responsive to settlement conditions, with particular attention to marginalized populations across urbanizing and rural areas.
records.abstract_cn: 能源贫困在非洲各国仍然是一个严峻挑战，基础设施条件在缓解其严重性方面变得重要。本研究考察了28个非洲国家中家庭和社区层面的能源贫困与基础设施之间的关联。我们构建了多维能源贫困（MEP）和基础设施指数，并使用贝叶斯分层模型可视化其空间格局。回归模型估计了多层次基础设施条件对家庭MEP的影响。为考虑城市化背景下基础设施与MEP关系的差异，我们按四种聚落类型进行了亚组分析：大城市、中小城市、农村城镇和农村村庄。空间分析显示，MEP存在显著差异，且与基础设施条件的格局密切吻合。回归结果显示，较高水平的家庭和社区基础设施与较低的MEP相关，且社区基础设施的关系更强。这些关联的幅度因聚落类型而异。社区基础设施对农村城镇和村庄的MEP影响较大，而家庭基础设施对大城市的MEP影响较大。在中小城市，家庭和社区基础设施的效应大小相当。夜间灯光强度作为更广泛电气化环境的代理指标，也与较低的MEP相关。这些发现表明，多层次基础设施对于缓解能源贫困至关重要，且其作用因聚落环境而异。政策含义包括跨部门基础设施规划的重要性，需响应聚落条件，特别关注城市化地区和农村地区的边缘化人群。

records.title_en: Price vs policy: The impact of cost uncertainty on decarbonization pathways
records.title_cn: 价格与政策：成本不确定性对脱碳路径的影响
records.abstract_en: The future costs of many low-carbon power generation technologies are highly uncertain. Capturing these uncertainties for current and emerging technologies can help to understand potential policy impacts and the roles that emerging technologies could play. Energy system studies often use a scenario-based approach, which requires modelers to choose specific values from the range of possibilities, which can bias results and report unlikely scenarios. This paper combines a stochastic capital-cost forecasting methodology, based on Wright’s law of experiential learning, with a range of cost values for emerging technologies. The set of inputs generated is linked with the COPPER power system capacity expansion model to generate a database of 400 model runs, using 100 sampled combinations of cost input parameters and four policy scenarios. The impacts of policy on future emissions, system costs and generation mixes are presented. The incorporation of uncertainty into the model demonstrates the consistent deployment of transmission across all scenarios, in contrast with the inconsistent deployment of emerging technologies. This study finds that neither the carbon tax nor proposed clean electricity regulations achieve power-system decarbonization by 2050 across all scenarios. The results from this study are consistent with the results of national and provincial energy studies in Canada, however some results were outliers compared to the full distribution of potential model outcomes. These findings underscore the critical need to incorporate uncertainty into power system models, particularly when discussing policies and emerging technologies.
records.abstract_cn: 许多低碳发电技术的未来成本高度不确定。捕捉当前和新兴技术的这些不确定性有助于理解潜在的政策影响以及新兴技术可能发挥的作用。能源系统研究通常采用基于情景的方法，这要求建模者从可能性范围中选择特定值，这可能导致结果偏差并报告不太可能的情景。本文结合了基于赖特经验学习定律的随机资本成本预测方法与新兴技术的一系列成本值。生成的输入集与COPPER电力系统容量扩展模型相连接，生成了一个包含400次模型运行的数据库，使用了100个成本输入参数的抽样组合和四种政策情景。本文展示了政策对未来排放、系统成本和发电组合的影响。将不确定性纳入模型表明，在所有情景中输电设施的一致部署，与新兴技术的不一致部署形成对比。本研究发现，无论是碳税还是拟议的清洁电力法规，都无法在2050年前在所有情景中实现电力系统的脱碳。本研究的结果与加拿大国家和省级能源研究的结果一致，但某些结果相对于潜在模型结果的完整分布而言属于异常值。这些发现强调了将不确定性纳入电力系统模型的迫切需要，特别是在讨论政策和新兴技术时。

records.title_en: Robust functional principal component analysis for detecting anomalous behaviors in electricity markets
records.title_cn: 稳健函数主成分分析在电力市场异常行为检测中的应用
records.abstract_en: This paper introduces a novel methodological framework to detect potentially manipulative behaviors in deregulated electricity markets using robust statistical tools. The work focuses on identifying outlying bidding patterns in daily auction microdata by modeling the shape of supply curves, rather than relying solely on price data, to better capture strategic market behavior.
