These findings show how higher wages may curb corruption, but also foster the use of violence as an alternative tool to influence policymaking. (JEL D72, D73, J31, K42)
records.abstract_cn: 在存在既使用贿赂又使用暴力的犯罪集团的情况下，政治家工资对腐败的影响是什么？利用断点回归设计以及三种不同的腐败代理指标，我们发现，薪酬更高的意大利政治家更有可能促进采购中的透明度和竞争，但也更有可能遭受犯罪袭击。工资效应在三年后消退，且是由在位者行为变化而非选拔改善所驱动。这些发现表明，更高的工资可能抑制腐败，但也可能促使暴力作为影响政策制定的替代工具被使用。(JEL D72, D73, J31, K42)

records.title_en: Polling Place Location and the Costs of Voting
records.title_cn: 投票站位置与投票成本
records.abstract_en: We study how distance to one’s polling place affects the likelihood of voting using a geographic regression discontinuity design with data from Pennsylvania and Georgia. A one-mile increase in distance to the polling place reduces the likelihood of voting in person by 1 to 3 percentage points. Effects are two to three times higher among those closest to the polling place. When available, voters substitute to mail-in voting as distance to the polling place increases. In counterfactual exercises, we identify turnout-maximizing polling places. Some precincts have large potential gains in turnout, even when choosing from existing buildings. (JEL D72, K16, R23)
records.abstract_cn: 我们利用宾夕法尼亚州和佐治亚州的数据，采用地理回归不连续设计，研究到投票站的距离如何影响投票的可能性。到投票站的距离每增加一英里，亲自投票的可能性就会降低1到3个百分点。在距离投票站最近的人群中，这种影响要高出两到三倍。当可以选择时，随着到投票站距离的增加，选民会转向邮寄投票。在反事实模拟中，我们确定了能够最大化投票率的投票站。即使从现有建筑中选择，一些选区的投票率也有很大的潜在提升空间。（JEL D72, K16, R23）

records.title_en: Hacked to Pieces? The Effects of Ransomware Attacks on Hospitals and Patients
records.title_cn: 被黑客肢解？勒索软件攻击对医院和患者的影响
records.abstract_en: As cybercriminals increasingly target health care, hospitals face the growing threat of ransomware attacks. Ransomware is a type of malicious software that prevents users from accessing electronic systems and demands a ransom to restore access. We create and link a database of hospital ransomware attacks to Medicare claims data. We quantify the effects of ransomware attacks on hospital operations and patient outcomes. Ransomware attacks decrease hospital volume by 17–24 percent during the initial attack week, with recovery occurring within 3 weeks. Among patients already admitted to the hospital when a ransomware attack begins, in-hospital mortality increases by 34–38 percent. (JEL D83, I12, I13, K42)
records.abstract_cn: 随着网络犯罪分子日益瞄准医疗保健领域，医院面临日益增长的勒索软件攻击威胁。勒索软件是一种恶意软件，阻止用户访问电子系统并要求支付赎金以恢复访问。我们创建并链接了一个医院勒索软件攻击数据库与医疗保险索赔数据。我们量化了勒索软件攻击对医院运营和患者结果的影响。勒索软件攻击在初始攻击周内使医院就诊量减少17-24%，并在3周内恢复。在勒索软件攻击开始时已住院的患者中，院内死亡率增加了34-38%。（JEL D83, I12, I13, K42）

records.title_en: Invisible Wounds: How Mental Disability Benefits Shape Veteran Well-Being
records.title_cn: 无形的创伤：精神残疾补助如何影响退伍军人的福祉
records.abstract_en: We study impacts of VA disability compensation on the health and well-being of the large and rapidly growing population of veterans claiming mental disorders. We leverage quasi-random assignment of veterans to medical examiners with varying assessing tendencies. An additional $1,000 per year decreases food insecurity and homelessness by 4.1 and 1.3 percent over 5 years. Health care utilization increases, with greater engagement in preventive care. We estimate precise null average effects on health and mortality. Those on the margin of claim denial experience worse outcomes on average than other applicants, with suggestive evidence of large treatment effects for this subpopulation. (JEL I12, I31, I38, J14)
records.abstract_cn: 我们研究了VA残疾补偿对声称患有精神障碍的退伍军人（这一庞大且快速增长的人群）健康与福祉的影响。我们利用退伍军人被准随机分配到评估倾向各异的医疗检查员这一机制。每年额外增加1,000美元，在4.1年内使食品不安全和无家可归率分别降低1.3%和5。医疗保健利用增加，预防性护理参与度更高。我们估计健康与死亡率上的精确零平均效应。处于索赔被拒边缘的个体平均结果比其他申请者更差，且有提示性证据表明这一亚群体存在较大的处理效应。(JEL I12, I31, I38, J14)

records.title_en: Connections during Democratic Transitions: Insights from the Political Purge in Post-WWII France
records.title_cn: 民主转型中的关系网络：二战后法国政治清洗的启示
records.abstract_en: We examine how connections shaped transitional justice during France’s post-WWII democratic transition. Parliamentarians who had supported the Vichy regime faced a two-stage purge process involving two courts. Using a difference-in-differences strategy, we find that law graduates—an influential group with ties to one of the courts—had a 10 to 14 percentage point higher acquittal rate. We analyze 17,589 documents in individual defendants’ files to explain this difference. According to this analysis, indirect connections—connections through third parties—enabled transmission of information to the judges, highlighting how connected elite groups can navigate transitions despite institutional safeguards. (JEL D72, D83, K41, N44)
records.abstract_cn: 我们研究了在法国二战后民主转型期间，关系网络如何塑造了过渡时期司法。曾支持维希政权的议员面临涉及两个法院的两阶段清洗过程。通过使用双重差分策略，我们发现法律毕业生——一个与其中一个法院有联系的有影响力群体——其无罪释放率高出10至14个百分点。我们分析了个人被告档案中的17,589份文件以解释这一差异。根据这一分析，间接联系——通过第三方建立的联系——使得信息能够传递给法官，突显了尽管存在制度保障，有联系的精英群体如何在转型中游刃有余。（JEL D72, D83, K41, N44）

records.title_en: Sources of Limited Consideration and Market Power in E-Commerce
records.title_cn: 电子商务中有限考虑与市场势力的来源
records.abstract_en: This article develops techniques for the empirical analysis of repeated sequential search over unordered alternatives using data on consumer search processes. I use these techniques to assess why consumers conduct little search in e-commerce and often pay significantly above the minimum available price for a product. Search costs could explain these facts, as could pre-search seller differentiation: Consumers with low search costs may not visit stores they dislike based on information known before search. I find that seller differentiation is primarily responsible for limited consideration and market power. (JEL D11, D21, D43, D83, L81)
records.abstract_cn: 本文开发了利用消费者搜索过程数据进行无序备选项重复顺序搜索实证分析的技术。我运用这些技术来评估为何消费者在电子商务中搜索甚少，且常常支付远高于产品最低可得价格的价格。搜索成本可以解释这些事实，搜索前的卖方差异化同样可以：搜索成本较低的消费者可能不会访问他们在搜索前基于已知信息而不喜欢的商店。我发现卖方差异化是导致有限考虑和市场势力的主要原因。(JEL D11, D21, D43, D83, L81)

records.title_en: Backward Induction Reasoning beyond Backward Induction
records.title_cn: 超越逆向归纳的逆向归纳推理
records.abstract_en: Backward induction (BI) is only defined for perfect information games, but its logic is also invoked in many concepts for imperfect or incomplete information games. Yet, the meaning of BI reasoning is not clear in these settings, and we lack a way to capture the essence of BI without assuming equilibrium. We introduce backward rationalizability, a nonequilibrium solution concept for incomplete information games, which we argue distills the logic of BI reasoning. We show several of its properties and discuss a few applications, including a new version of Lipnowski and Sadler’s (2019) peer-confirming equilibrium. (JEL C72, C73, D83)
records.abstract_cn: 逆向归纳（BI）仅针对完全信息博弈定义，但其逻辑也被许多不完全或不完美信息博弈的概念所引用。然而，在这些设定中，BI推理的含义并不清晰，我们缺乏一种在不假设均衡的情况下捕捉BI本质的方法。我们引入了逆向可理性化，这是一个针对不完全信息博弈的非均衡解概念，我们认为它提炼了BI推理的逻辑。我们展示了其若干性质，并讨论了几个应用，包括Lipnowski和Sadler（2019）的同伴确认均衡的一个新版本。（JEL C72, C73, D83）

records.title_en: Power, Property Rights, and the Dynamics of Local Wealth Appropriation
records.title_cn: 权力、产权与地方财富侵占的动态
records.abstract_en: We examine the dynamic connections between local wealth inequality and the local politics of property rights. A jurisdiction comprises a politically dominant in-group and a marginalized out-group. At each date, the jurisdiction exploits weaknesses in due process rights under the legal system to redistribute property claims away from the out-group and toward the in-group. It combines takings and zoning with the leveraging of public assets to deter legal challenges. This leverage varies over time and depends on status quo effects and asymmetries in legal treatment of assets. The results show how local politics and policies are linked to wealth disparities. (JEL D31, D72, H13, H77, K11, P14, R52)
records.abstract_cn: 我们考察了地方财富不平等与地方产权政治之间的动态联系。一个辖区由政治上占主导地位的内群体和被边缘化的外群体组成。在每个时期，辖区利用法律体系中正当程序权利的弱点，将财产权利从外群体重新分配向内群体。它结合征收和区划，并利用公共资产来阻止法律挑战。这种杠杆随时间变化，并取决于现状效应和资产法律待遇的不对称性。结果表明地方政治和政策如何与财富差距相关联。(JEL D31, D72, H13, H77, K11, P14, R52)

records.title_en: Attitudes toward Success and Failure
records.title_cn: 对成功与失败的态度
records.abstract_en: Individuals often attach a special meaning to attaining a certain goal, and getting past a threshold marks the difference between success and failure. In this paper, we take a standard expected utility (EU) setting with an exogenous reference point that separates success from failure and define attitudes toward success and failure as features of preferences over lotteries. The distinctive feature of our definitions is that they concern a local reversal of the decision-maker’s risk attitude across the reference point. Our findings provide a unified view of several well-known models of reference-dependent preferences and suggest new forms of comparative statics exercises. (JEL D11, D44, D81, D91)
records.abstract_cn: 个体往往对达成某一特定目标赋予特殊意义，而跨越某一门槛则标志着成功与失败的差异。在本文中，我们采用一个带有外生参照点的标准期望效用（EU）框架，该参照点将成功与失败区分开来，并将对成功与失败的态度定义为对彩票偏好的特征。我们定义的特殊之处在于，它们涉及决策者风险态度在参照点处的局部逆转。我们的发现为几种著名的参照依赖偏好模型提供了统一的视角，并提出了比较静态分析的新形式。（JEL D11, D44, D81, D91）

records.title_en: Behavioral Communities and the Atomic Structure of Networks
records.title_cn: 行为社群与网络的原子结构
records.abstract_en: When people coordinate their behaviors with their friends—e.g., choosing whether to adopt a new technology, protest against a government, attend university—divisions within a social network can lead to contrasting norms of behavior in different parts of the network. We define a society’s atoms to be groups of people who adopt the same behavior in every equilibrium. We show that the atoms are at least as coarse as blocks in stochastic block models, and that using knowledge of the atoms to seed the diffusion of a behavior significantly increases diffusion compared to seeding based on standard community detection algorithms. (JEL D85, D91, Z13)
records.abstract_cn: 当人们与朋友协调行为时——例如，选择是否采用新技术、抗议政府、上大学——社交网络内的分裂可能导致网络不同部分出现对比鲜明的行为规范。我们将社会的原子定义为在每一个均衡中都采取相同行为的群体。我们证明，这些原子至少与随机块模型中的块一样粗糙，并且利用原子的知识来播种行为的传播，与基于标准社群检测算法的播种相比，显著增加了传播。(JEL D85, D91, Z13)

records.title_en: On Dynamic Pricing
records.title_cn: 论动态定价
records.abstract_en: This paper builds a theory of dynamic pricing for the sale of timed goods. The main friction is private and evolving valuation of the buyer prior to the date of consumption, which follows a Poisson process. A combination of membership fees and continuously increasing prices induces a threshold response from the buyer, endogenously segmenting the market along timing of purchase. This pricing mechanism achieves the deterministic global optimum. The tools developed here are shown to be useful in thinking about global incentives in dynamic mechanisms, and mapping dynamic pricing to the classic taxonomy of consumer-producer surplus and deadweight loss. (JEL D21, D82, D86)
records.abstract_cn: 本文构建了一个关于限时商品销售动态定价的理论。主要摩擦在于买方在消费日期之前私人且不断变化的估值，该估值遵循泊松过程。会员费与持续上涨的价格相结合，诱导买方产生阈值反应，从而在购买时机上内生地细分市场。这种定价机制实现了确定性的全局最优。本文开发的工具被证明在思考动态机制中的全局激励以及将动态定价映射到经典的消费者-生产者剩余和死重损失分类方面是有用的。（JEL D21, D82, D86）

records.title_en: Cardinality and Utilitarianism through Social Interactions
records.title_cn: 基数性与功利主义：基于社会互动的视角
records.abstract_en: We provide axioms that relate the preferences of each group in a society to the preferences of the subgroups contained in them. These axioms yield cardinal utility indices for each individual and a representation of group preferences as the group-dependent weighted sum of the utility indices of the members of that group. We show that these weights are group independent whenever one additional axiom and a mild linear independence assumption are satisfied. (JEL D11, D71, D81, D83)
records.abstract_cn: 我们提供了一些公理，将社会中每个群体的偏好与其所包含的子群体的偏好联系起来。这些公理为每个个体产生基数效用指数，并将群体偏好表示为该群体成员效用指数的群体依赖加权和。我们证明，当满足一个额外的公理和一个温和的线性无关假设时，这些权重是群体独立的。（JEL D11, D71, D81, D83）

records.title_en: The Limits of Limited Commitment
records.title_cn: 有限承诺的界限
records.abstract_en: We study limited strategic leadership. A collection of subsets covering the leader’s action space determines her commitment opportunities. We characterize the outcomes resulting from all possible commitment structures of this kind. If the commitment structure is an interval partition, then the leader’s payoff is bounded by her Stackelberg and Cournot payoffs. Under general commitment structures, the leader may obtain a payoff that is less than her lowest Cournot payoff. We apply our results to a textbook duopoly model and characterize the commitment structures leading to consumer- and producer-optimal outcomes. (JEL C72, D43)
records.abstract_cn: 我们研究有限战略领导力。覆盖领导者行动空间的一组子集决定了她的承诺机会。我们刻画了所有此类承诺结构可能产生的结果。如果承诺结构是区间划分，则领导者的收益受其斯塔克尔伯格和古诺收益的约束。在一般承诺结构下，领导者可能获得低于其最低古诺收益的收益。我们将结果应用于教科书式双寡头模型，并刻画了导致消费者和生产者最优结果的承诺结构。（JEL C72, D43）

records.title_en: Asymmetric Models of Sales
records.title_cn: 销售的不对称模型
records.abstract_en: We generalize the captive-and-shopper model of sales to allow asymmetries in production costs and captive audiences, in oligopoly. Bothkinds of asymmetry determine the firms that compete (via randomized sales) to serve the price-comparing shoppers, while other firms exploit their captive audiences. In contrast to a model with symmetric costs (but asymmetric captive audiences), there are natural situations in which more than two firms use sales by engaging in pairwisebattles across distinct price intervals. We also study the choice of production technologies via innovation and extensions to consider costly acquisitions of captives and shoppers, and captives’ choice of captor. (JEL D11, D21, D43, L14, O31)
records.abstract_cn: 我们推广了销售中的俘虏与购物者模型，以允许寡头垄断中生产成本和俘虏受众的不对称性。两种不对称性决定了哪些企业通过随机销售竞争以服务比较价格的购物者，而其他企业则利用其俘虏受众。与成本对称（但俘虏受众不对称）的模型相比，存在自然情形，其中超过两家企业通过在不同价格区间进行成对竞争来使用销售策略。我们还研究了通过创新选择生产技术，并扩展至考虑获取俘虏和购物者的成本，以及俘虏对俘获者的选择。(JEL D11, D21, D43, L14, O31)

records.title_en: How to Allocate Money?
records.title_cn: 如何分配资金？
records.abstract_en: I study a simple equity-efficiency problem: A designer allocates a fixed amount of money to a population of agents differing in privately observed marginal values for money. She can only screen by imposing an “ordeal”—that is, by allocating more money to agents who engage in a socially wasteful activity (such as queuing or filling out forms). Giving a lumpsum transfer is outperformed by an ordeal mechanism when agents with the lowest money-denominated cost of engaging in the wasteful activity have an expected value for money that exceeds the average value by more than a factor of two. (JEL D63, D82, H23, I38)
records.abstract_cn: 我研究一个简单的公平-效率问题：设计者将固定金额的资金分配给一群代理人，这些代理人对资金的私人观察边际价值各不相同。她只能通过施加“磨难”——即，将更多资金分配给从事社会浪费活动（如排队或填写表格）的代理人——来进行筛选。当从事浪费活动的最低货币成本代理人对资金的预期价值超过平均水平两倍以上时，磨难机制优于一次性转移支付。（JEL D63, D82, H23, I38）

records.title_en: Preemptive Entry and Technology Diffusion: The Market for Drive‐In Theaters
records.title_cn: 先发进入与技术扩散：汽车影院市场
records.abstract_en: This article studies entry preemption in new industries. We first test a key prediction of dynamic entry games: Entry preemption is most relevant in intermediate‐sized markets, where firms face highest uncertainty about future entry. Using US drive‐in theater market (1945–1957) data, we find robust evidence for this non‐monotonic relationship between market size and early entry probability. We then estimate a dynamic entry game, and quantify preemption effects through counterfactual analysis. Preemptive motives increase early entry by up to 40% in mid‐size markets, raising entry costs by 5% and reducing firms' expected value by 1%.
records.abstract_cn: 本文研究新行业中的进入先占行为。我们首先检验动态进入博弈的一个关键预测：进入先占在中等规模市场中最为相关，因为企业面临未来进入的不确定性最高。利用美国汽车影院市场（1945-1957年）的数据，我们发现了市场规模与早期进入概率之间这种非单调关系的稳健证据。然后，我们估计了一个动态进入博弈，并通过反事实分析量化先占效应。先占动机使中等规模市场的早期进入增加高达40%，使进入成本提高5%，并使企业预期价值降低1%。

records.title_en: Mergers in the Presence of Adverse Selection
records.title_cn: 存在逆向选择时的并购
records.abstract_en: In the presence of adverse selection, mergers can increase welfare through a reduction in inefficient sorting. I characterize the sorting externality internalized between merging firms in a tractable discrete choice model. Mergers benefit consumers when the firms are small, willingness to pay is moderately increasing in cost, and consumer costs are skewed. Applying the model to the non‐group health insurance market, 13% of potential mergers would improve consumer surplus. In markets where the sorting distortion exceeds $5 per person, nearly one‐third of mergers improve consumer surplus, highlighting the importance of considering adverse selection in merger evaluation.
records.abstract_cn: 在存在逆向选择的情况下，并购可以通过减少低效的分类来提高福利。我在一个易于处理的离散选择模型中刻画了并购企业之间内化的分类外部性。当企业规模较小、支付意愿随成本适度增加且消费者成本偏斜时，并购使消费者受益。将该模型应用于非团体健康保险市场，13%的潜在并购将改善消费者剩余。在分类扭曲超过每人5美元的市场中，近三分之一的并购改善了消费者剩余，这凸显了在并购评估中考虑逆向选择的重要性。

records.title_en: Cleaner but Volatile Energy? The Effect of Coal Plant Retirement on Market Competition in the Wholesale Electricity Market
records.title_cn: 更清洁但更波动的能源？煤电厂退役对电力批发市场竞争的影响
records.abstract_en: The energy transition from coal to gas is reshaping the power sector to rely more on gas generation, which is cleaner but has more variable input costs. Using counterfactual analysis, I study the competitive effects of this transition, by considering several transition paths that differ in the types of firms involved in retiring coal plants and investing in gas plants. I show that the variable nature of the marginal cost of gas generation creates an environment in which market power could increase after the transition. However, the transition's impact on competition depends on the characteristics of the firms investing in new gas generation; the adverse impact is mitigated under a well‐planned transition that leads to a more competitive industry structure.
records.abstract_cn: 从煤炭向天然气的能源转型正在重塑电力行业，使其更加依赖天然气发电，这更清洁但投入成本波动更大。通过反事实分析，我研究了这一转型的竞争效应，考虑了若干条不同的转型路径，这些路径在退役煤电厂和投资天然气电厂的企业类型上有所不同。我表明，天然气发电边际成本的波动性创造了一种环境，在这种环境中，转型后市场势力可能增强。然而，转型对竞争的影响取决于投资新建天然气发电企业的特征；在精心规划的转型下，不利影响会得到缓解，这种转型会带来更具竞争性的行业结构。

records.title_en: The Incidence of Coarse Certification: Evidence From the ENERGY STAR Program
records.title_cn: 粗略认证的影响：来自能源之星计划的证据
records.abstract_en: A coarse certification provides simple but incomplete information. Its rationale is to help consumers trade off dimensions of quality that are complex and lack salience. In imperfectly competitive markets, it may induce excess bunching at the certification requirement, crowd out quality, and facilitate price discrimination. Who will ultimately benefit from a coarse certification thus depends on the degree of market power firms can exercise as well as on consumers' sophistication in responding to such information. I use a structural econometric model of the U.S. appliance market to illustrate these insights using the ENERGY STAR certification as a case study.
records.abstract_cn: 粗略认证提供简单但不完整的信息。其基本原理是帮助消费者在复杂且缺乏显著性的质量维度之间进行权衡。在不完全竞争市场中，它可能导致在认证要求处出现过度聚集，挤出质量，并促进价格歧视。因此，谁最终将从粗略认证中受益，取决于企业能够行使的市场力量程度以及消费者对此类信息反应的成熟度。我使用美国家电市场的结构计量经济学模型，以能源之星认证为案例研究来说明这些见解。

records.title_en: Consumer Search, Firm Heterogeneity, and Platform Design
records.title_cn: 消费者搜索、企业异质性与平台设计
records.abstract_en: We study the optimal design of a monopoly platform that interacts with heterogeneous firms and consumers who face uncertainty about product values and prices. Consumers search randomly among firms recommended by the platform. The platform designs a menu of contracts tailored to different firm types and allocates consumer visits across these firms. We show that the optimal platform design creates a “superstar effect,” whereby high‐type firms capture a disproportionately large market share, and improves consumer welfare relative to the no‐design benchmark.
records.abstract_cn: 我们研究了一个垄断平台的最优设计，该平台与异质性企业以及面临产品价值和价格不确定性的消费者互动。消费者在平台推荐的企业中进行随机搜索。平台设计了一套针对不同企业类型的合同菜单，并在这些企业之间分配消费者的访问。我们表明，最优平台设计会产生一种“超级明星效应”，即高类型企业占据不成比例的巨大市场份额，并且相对于无设计基准，改善了消费者福利。

records.title_en: What Causes Geographic Variation in Drug Prescribing? Evidence from Physician Migration
records.title_cn: 什么导致药物处方的地理差异？来自医生迁移的证据
records.abstract_en: In this article, we examine the importance of individual physicians in explaining the significant variation in prescription drug spending in Medicare Part D. By tracking prescribing behavior before and after physician relocations, we find that movers' prescribing converges toward the average of their new location. However, this convergence is far from complete, highlighting the importance of idiosyncratic physician‐specific factors. Overall, these physician‐specific factors explain about 60 to 70 percent of the cross‐sectional variation in prescription drug spending, suggesting that physicians are one of the most important supply‐side determinants of this variation. We investigate several potential mechanisms behind this partial convergence.
records.abstract_cn: 在本文中，我们考察了在Medicare D部分处方药支出显著差异中，个体医生的重要性。通过追踪医生迁移前后的处方行为，我们发现迁移者的处方行为向其新所在地的平均水平收敛。然而，这种收敛远非完全，凸显了医生特有因素的独特重要性。总体而言，这些医生特有因素解释了处方药支出横截面差异的约60至70%，表明医生是这一差异最重要的供给侧决定因素之一。我们调查了这种部分收敛背后的几种潜在机制。

records.title_en: Pulp Friction: The Value of Quantity Contracts in Decentralized Markets
records.title_cn: 纸浆摩擦：分散市场中数量合同的价值
records.abstract_en: Firms in decentralized markets often trade using quantity contracts, agreements specifying quantity prior to the point of sale. These contracts are valuable because they provide quantity assurance, as trading frictions could prevent a buyer and seller from matching in the spot market. However, quantity contracts prevent sellers from optimally allocating production across buyers after market conditions realize. Using proprietary invoice data, we estimate a model of quantity contracts in the pulp and paper industry. The average value of a quantity contract is 10% of profits, but would be 55% larger if sellers could optimally allocate production after market conditions realize.
records.abstract_cn: 分散市场中的企业经常使用数量合同进行交易，即在销售点之前规定数量的协议。这些合同之所以有价值，是因为它们提供了数量保证，因为交易摩擦可能阻止买方和卖方在现货市场匹配。然而，数量合同阻止卖方在市场条件实现后最优地在买方之间分配生产。利用专有的发票数据，我们估计了纸浆和造纸行业中数量合同的模型。数量合同的平均价值为利润的10%，但如果卖方能够在市场条件实现后最优地分配生产，这一价值将增加55%。

records.title_en: Peer Learning, Enforcement, and Reputation
records.title_cn: 同行学习、执法与声誉
records.abstract_en: We study a two‐period learning model where a sequentially rational regulator builds a reputation for strict enforcement and self‐interested firms test the regulator's enforcement propensity through their misconduct. In the transparent setting, where misconduct and enforcement are observable between the firms, the regulator's reputation concern endogenously creates positive or negative enforcement externalities between the firms. When the reputation concern is strong, the enforcement externalities are negative and dominate the information externalities, encouraging misconduct. Otherwise, both externalities are positive and deter misconduct. Although a strong reputation always benefits the regulator in the opaque setting, it often backfires in a transparent setting.
records.abstract_cn: 我们研究了一个两期学习模型，其中具有序贯理性的监管者建立严格执法的声誉，而自利的企业通过其不当行为来测试监管者的执法倾向。在透明环境中，企业之间的不当行为和执法是可观察的，监管者的声誉关切内生地产生了企业之间的正或负执法外部性。当声誉关切强烈时，执法外部性为负并主导信息外部性，鼓励不当行为。否则，两种外部性均为正并阻止不当行为。尽管在非透明环境中强大的声誉总是有利于监管者，但在透明环境中它常常适得其反。

records.title_en: Nonlinear Pricing in Oligopoly: How Brand Preferences Shape Market Outcomes
records.title_cn: 寡头市场中的非线性定价：品牌偏好如何塑造市场结果
records.abstract_en: We study oligopolistic competition by firms practicing second‐degree price discrimination. In line with the literature on demand estimation, our theory allows consumers' propensity to switch brands to vary with tastes for product quality. If low‐type consumers are sufficiently more (respectively, less) prone to switch brands than are high types, (i) quality provision is inefficiently low at the bottom (respectively, high at the top) of the product line, and (ii) informational rents are positive (respectively, negative) for high types and negative (respectively, positive) for low types. Interestingly, we show that an increase in the number of competing firms may decrease welfare (by tightening incentive constraints), so much so that monopoly may be welfare superior to oligopoly. Pure‐strategy equilibria fail to exist, resulting in price‐quality dispersion across firms, whenever the propensity to switch brands is sufficiently different across consumers types.
records.abstract_cn: 我们研究实行二级价格歧视的企业的寡头竞争。与需求估计文献一致，我们的理论允许消费者转换品牌的倾向随其对产品质量的品味而变化。如果低类型消费者比高类型消费者更（或更不）倾向于转换品牌，那么（i）产品线底部的质量供给低效地低（或顶部的质量供给低效地高），并且（ii）高类型的信息租金为正（或负），低类型的信息租金为负（或正）。有趣的是，我们表明，竞争企业数量的增加可能降低福利（通过收紧激励约束），以至于垄断可能优于寡头。当消费者类型之间转换品牌的倾向差异足够大时，纯策略均衡不存在，导致企业间的价格-质量离散。

records.title_en: Buyer's Hidden Search With Continuous Intensity: The Seller‐Optimal Mechanism and a Perverse Effect
records.title_cn: 买方连续强度下的隐藏搜索：卖方最优机制与一个反常效应
records.abstract_en: We adopt a dynamic mechanism design approach to study how a revenue‐maximizing seller should sell an indivisible object when a buyer with a private value can search for an outside option with continuous‐intensity choices. We find that lowering the buyer's search cost definitely reduces the seller's revenue when the buyer's search decision is binary, as in Armstrong and Zhou (2016). In contrast, with continuous search intensity, a counterintuitive effect may arise: lowering the buyer's search cost function can, under mild conditions, actually increase the seller's revenue.
records.abstract_cn: 我们采用动态机制设计方法，研究当具有私人价值的买方可以以连续强度选择搜索外部选项时，追求收入最大化的卖方应如何出售不可分割物品。我们发现，当买方的搜索决策是二元的，如Armstrong和Zhou（2016）所述，降低买方的搜索成本必然减少卖方的收入。相反，在连续搜索强度下，可能出现一个反直觉的效应：在温和条件下，降低买方的搜索成本函数实际上可能增加卖方的收入。

records.title_en: Price Discrimination With Manipulable Observables
records.title_cn: 可操纵可观测变量下的价格歧视
records.abstract_en: This article studies price discrimination by a seller who uses data on observables that buyers can control (or manipulate) at a cost. If the seller's discriminatory prices are offered covertly, equilibrium market segmentation is always coarse, resulting in limited price discrimination. In contrast, if prices must be transparently posted, every buyer pays a personalized price in equilibrium, though this does not always reduce buyer or social welfare. The analysis sheds new light on calls for transparency in how sellers utilize consumer data to customize prices and highlights potential issues with assessing welfare using (only) observed prices, pricing conduct, and market coverage.
records.abstract_cn: 本文研究了一个卖方利用买方可以以一定成本控制（或操纵）的可观测数据来实施价格歧视的情况。如果卖方的歧视性价格是隐蔽提供的，均衡市场细分总是粗糙的，导致有限的价格歧视。相反，如果价格必须透明公布，均衡中每个买方都支付个性化价格，尽管这并不总是降低买方或社会福利。该分析为要求卖方利用消费者数据定制价格时提高透明度的呼声提供了新的视角，并强调了仅使用（观察到的）价格、定价行为和市场覆盖率来评估福利的潜在问题。

records.title_en: Market Effects of Brand Search Advertising
records.title_cn: 品牌搜索广告的市场效应
records.abstract_en: We study the market effects of sponsored search auctions for advertising space on searches for brands. In our model, firms simultaneously choose the price of their product and the bids for the advertising auctions triggered by their own and rivals' brand keywords search. In any symmetric equilibrium, each firm wins its own keyword auction, and relative to a no‐ads benchmark, online advertising raises the winning brand's marginal cost and ultimately market prices. Only in an environment with strong initial asymmetries do we find that brand advertising might be beneficial.
records.abstract_cn: 我们研究了品牌搜索中赞助搜索拍卖对广告空间的市场效应。在我们的模型中，企业同时选择其产品价格以及由其自身和竞争对手的品牌关键词搜索触发的广告拍卖的出价。在任何对称均衡中，每个企业赢得其自身的关键词拍卖，并且相对于无广告基准，在线广告提高了获胜品牌的边际成本，并最终提高了市场价格。只有在初始不对称性较强的环境中，我们才发现品牌广告可能是有益的。

records.title_en: Welfare Effects of Trade Associations: The Case of the Chilean Salmon Export Industry
records.title_cn: 行业协会的福利效应：以智利三文鱼出口产业为例
records.abstract_en: This article examines the welfare consequences of a trade association in an exporting country on consumers in destination countries. We estimate a structural model of the Chilean Salmon exporting industry that endogenizes firms' pricing and export decisions. Our results show that the trade association has a positive effect on consumer utility and involves higher marginal costs of production, consistent with higher quality products. Reduced form analysis estimates price effects associated with trade association membership of 3 to 8 percent. Our counterfactual analysis reveals that eliminating the trade association would reduce consumer welfare by 1.7 billion USD in destination countries.
records.abstract_cn: 本文考察了出口国行业协会对目的地国家消费者的福利影响。我们估计了一个智利三文鱼出口产业的结构模型，该模型内生化了企业的定价和出口决策。我们的结果表明，行业协会对消费者效用有正向影响，并涉及更高的边际生产成本，这与更高质量的产品一致。简化形式分析估计了与行业协会会员资格相关的价格效应为3至8%。我们的反事实分析显示，取消行业协会将使目的地国家的消费者福利减少1.7十亿美元。

records.title_en: The Competitive Effects of Mergers with Cournot Competition
records.title_cn: 古诺竞争下并购的竞争效应
records.abstract_en: This article provides a full characterization of the competitive effects of horizontal mergers in the Cournot model with heterogeneous firms and constant marginal costs. We show that price effects depend only on the smaller merging firm's market share and the number of firms but are independent of the distribution of market shares among other firms. Standard concentration measures, instead, are often misleading. We also provide simple—yet general—closed‐form solutions for merger effects based on pre‐merger parameters. Moreover, we extend the model to study the combination of output and input market power and relate our results to the Merger Guidelines.
records.abstract_cn: 本文全面刻画了在具有异质性企业和恒定边际成本的古诺模型中横向并购的竞争效应。我们表明，价格效应仅取决于较小的并购企业的市场份额和企业数量，而与其他企业市场份额的分布无关。相反，标准的集中度衡量指标往往具有误导性。我们还基于并购前参数，提供了简单但通用的并购效应闭式解。此外，我们扩展了模型以研究产出和投入市场势力的结合，并将我们的结果与《并购指南》相关联。

records.title_en: Output Quality, Productivity, and Demand: Evidence from the Chinese Steel Industry
records.title_cn: 产出质量、生产率与需求：来自中国钢铁行业的证据
records.abstract_en: Unobserved objective output quality complicates the analysis of firm productivity and demand because higher‐quality products entail higher costs but offer greater consumption benefits. Using a panel of firms with output quality data, we decompose quantity‐based productivity into fundamental productivity and the costs of quality, and separate the demand residual into fundamental demand and quality benefits. Fundamental demand accounts for most revenue variation, whereas quality's revenue‐enhancing benefits are largely offset by its costs. During the 2008 global financial crisis, shifts in quality diverged from changes in fundamental productivity and demand, highlighting the role of quality in assessing firm and industry performance.
records.abstract_cn: 未观测到的客观产出质量使企业生产率和需求的分析复杂化，因为更高质量的产品带来更高成本，但也提供更大的消费效益。利用具有产出质量数据的企业面板，我们将基于数量的生产率分解为基础生产率和质量成本，并将需求残差分解为基础需求和质量效益。基础需求解释了大部分收入变动，而质量带来的收入提升效益在很大程度上被其成本所抵消。在2008年全球金融危机期间，质量的变动与基础生产率和需求的变化出现分化，凸显了质量在评估企业和行业绩效中的作用。

records.title_en: Reinventing reproductive labor: childcare in rural China under collectivization (1956–1961)
records.title_cn: 重塑再生产劳动：集体化时期中国农村的儿童照护（1956-1961）
records.abstract_en: In rural China, early childrearing was traditionally unpaid, invisible reproductive labor confined to the household. During the peak of collectivization (1956–1961), this labor was not only socialized but also partially reclassified. Drawing on feminist theories of reproductive and gendered labor as well as the history of women and childhood, this article examines how rural childcare facilities—especially kindergartens—emerged under severe material constraints and redefined childcare as a hybrid of manual, emotional, and intellectual labor embedded within the socialist state. Using grassroots sources from Mianchi County in central China, including county archives and oral history interviews, this microhistory reveals how institutionalized childcare reshaped everyday life and labor relations. Preschool workers—primarily rural women with little formal training—took on responsibilities in pedagogy, physical care, and emotional support, shifting childcare from domestic duty to a semi-professional, state-supported role. Even in fragmented and modest forms, these early institutions advanced socialist modernization by transforming gender roles, expanding early education, and redefining motherhood and family life. By reframing reproductive labor as a site of labor transformation, this study offers a new lens on how collectivist regimes—especially through gendered labor divisions—recoded childcare as both a developmental and political project in twentieth-century China.
records.abstract_cn: 在中国农村，早期育儿传统上是一种无酬、不可见的再生产劳动，局限于家庭内部。在集体化高峰期（1956-1961），这种劳动不仅被社会化，而且部分地被重新分类。借鉴女性主义关于再生产劳动和性别化劳动的理论，以及妇女和儿童历史的研究，本文考察了农村儿童照护设施——尤其是幼儿园——如何在严重的物质约束下出现，并将儿童照护重新定义为嵌入社会主义国家中的手工、情感和智力劳动的混合体。利用中国中部渑池县的基层资料，包括县档案馆和口述历史访谈，这一微观历史揭示了制度化的儿童照护如何重塑了日常生活和劳动关系。学前工作者——主要是缺乏正规培训的农村妇女——承担了教学、身体照护和情感支持方面的责任，将儿童照护从家庭职责转变为半职业化、国家支持的角色。即使以零散和有限的形式，这些早期机构通过改变性别角色、扩展早期教育以及重新定义母职和家庭生活，推进了社会主义现代化。通过将再生产劳动重新定位为劳动转型的场所，本研究为理解集体主义政权——尤其是通过性别化劳动分工——如何在二十世纪中国将儿童照护重新编码为发展性和政治性项目提供了新的视角。

records.title_en: Digital financial inclusion and transitory consumption: Household-level evidence from India
records.title_cn: 数字普惠金融与暂时性消费：来自印度的家庭层面证据
records.abstract_en: Recent developments in FinTech have made financial inclusion a policy priority across the globe. Ex-ante, it is not clear whether the effect of digital financial inclusion on households would be similar to traditional inclusion. Using data from household surveys from India, we explore the relationship between financial inclusion and transitory consumption. Our results suggest that, unlike traditional inclusion, digital financial inclusion is associated with higher transitory consumption. However, when considering the distribution of wealth, we find that the association between transitory consumption and digital financial inclusion is stronger at lower levels of wealth. Finally, we explain this heterogeneous effect of digital and traditional financial inclusion by showing that households with traditional financial inclusion experience a greater reduction in borrowing costs compared to those with digital financial inclusion. The oversensitivity of consumption due to digital inclusion highlights the need for digital literacy and policies aimed at curbing predatory and unfair lending practices.
records.abstract_cn: 金融科技的最新发展使普惠金融成为全球政策优先事项。事前，数字普惠金融对家庭的影响是否与传统普惠金融相似尚不明确。利用印度的家庭调查数据，我们探讨了普惠金融与暂时性消费之间的关系。我们的结果表明，与传统普惠金融不同，数字普惠金融与更高的暂时性消费相关。然而，在考虑财富分布时，我们发现暂时性消费与数字普惠金融之间的关联在较低财富水平上更强。最后，我们通过显示拥有传统普惠金融的家庭相比拥有数字普惠金融的家庭在借贷成本上经历更大的降低，来解释数字和传统普惠金融的这种异质性效应。由于数字普惠金融导致的消费过度敏感性，凸显了数字素养以及旨在遏制掠夺性和不公平贷款行为的政策的必要性。

records.title_en: Rebuilding after disaster in Haiti: effects of expecting external, diaspora, and local support
records.title_cn: 海地灾后重建：外部、侨民与本地支持预期的影响
records.abstract_en: Communities throughout the world face escalating risks from hurricanes, earthquakes, many of which are intensified by climate change. Global housing stocks are disproportionately vulnerable to these risks, with losses that can permanently reverse decades of development. The ideal disaster risk reduction strategy, in which homeowners “build better before” disaster strikes, has proven challenging, making efforts to “build back better” after disasters more pragmatic, though still difficult. We examine how homeowner expectations of support shape resilient rebuilding after disasters and how their actions vary after earthquakes and hurricanes in one of the most challenging post-disaster contexts, Haiti.
records.abstract_cn: 全球各地的社区正面临飓风、地震等日益加剧的风险，其中许多风险因气候变化而增强。全球住房存量对这些风险的脆弱性尤为突出，其损失可能永久性地逆转数十年的发展成果。理想的减少灾害风险策略，即房主在灾害发生前“更好地建造”，已被证明颇具挑战性，这使得灾后“更好地重建”的努力更为务实，尽管仍然困难重重。我们考察了房主对支持的预期如何影响灾后韧性重建，以及他们在海地这一最具挑战性的灾后情境中，在地震和飓风后的行为如何变化。

records.title_en: The double-edged impact of e-commerce participation on farm’s Income: Evidence from China
records.title_cn: 电子商务参与对农场收入的双刃影响：来自中国的证据
records.abstract_en: E-commerce (EC) is widely hailed as a solution to spatial and temporal frictions, yet farm-level evidence on income gains, dynamics, and spillovers remains limited. Using a representative panel dataset of 10,282 farms in China from 2020 to 2023, this study reveals the double-edged nature of EC. We find that while EC participation raises farm income, the relationship between income and the share of EC sales follows an inverted-U pattern. Benefits are short-term, concentrated in the first two years, and significantly larger for farms with risk-tolerant managers, cooperative structures, and those in wealthier counties. Mechanism analysis traces income gains to expanded sales scope and volume rather than to price increases, and are complemented by diversification in upstream supply channels. However, local EC penetration crowds out offline farms through lower prices and weakened bargaining power. Yet, accounting for this, the aggregate regional impact remains positive. These findings provide critical insights for designing digital agriculture policies that leverage EC’s potential while mitigating its inequitable spillovers.
records.abstract_cn: 电子商务（EC）被广泛认为是时空摩擦的解决方案，但农场层面关于收入增长、动态和溢出效应的证据仍然有限。本研究使用2020至2023中国10,282农场的代表性面板数据集，揭示了电子商务的双刃性质。我们发现，虽然 EC 参与提高了农场收入，但收入与 EC 销售份额之间的关系遵循倒 U 型模式。效益是短期的，集中在前两年，对于具有风险承受能力、合作结构的农场和较富裕县的农场来说，效益要大得多。机制分析将收入增长归因于销售范围和数量的扩大，而不是价格上涨，并辅之以上游供应渠道的多元化。然而，当地电子商务的渗透通过较低的价格和削弱的议价能力排挤了线下农场。然而，考虑到这一点，总体区域影响仍然是积极的。这些发现为设计数字农业政策提供了重要的见解，这些政策可以充分利用电子商务的潜力，同时减轻其不公平的溢出效应。

records.title_en: Substitute or complement? Quantity–quality effects of agricultural production diversity and market access on diets
records.title_cn: 替代还是互补？农业生产多样性与市场准入对膳食的数量-质量效应
records.abstract_en: In many developing countries, rural households meet their food needs through both self-production and market purchases, but evidence on the relative and joint roles of these channels in shaping dietary diversity and dietary quality remains limited. Using household panel data from rural China spanning 2004–2011, we provide micro-level evidence from a major developing-country context to examine the quantity–quality effects of agricultural production diversity, market access, and their interaction on dietary diversity and dietary quality. Fixed-effect models combined with an instrumental-variable strategy are used to address potential endogeneity. We find that both greater production diversity and improved market access enhance dietary diversity and dietary quality. A one-standard-deviation increase in agricultural production diversity raises the dietary diversity score and the Chinese Healthy Eating Index by 0.5 and 0.71 standard deviations, respectively. Similarly, reducing the distance to markets by one standard deviation increases both outcomes by 0.03 standard deviations. Further analysis reveals an overall substitution relationship between production diversity and market access in improving dietary outcomes. The marginal contribution of production diversity on dietary diversity and quality diminishes as market access improves, and vice versa. At the food-group level, however, functional complementarity exists between these two channels for soybeans and nuts, vegetables, and aquatic products. Diversified production supports higher intake of these foods when market access is limited, while better market access attenuates reliance on self-produced items by expanding access to a broader set of foods. Taken together, the findings highlight the continued importance of agricultural production diversification in improving diets where markets are thin, and underscore the critical role of improving market conditions, particularly in regions such as Africa and South Asia with persistently high market frictions.
records.abstract_cn: 在许多发展中国家，农村家庭通过自产和市场购买两种途径满足食物需求，但关于这两种途径在塑造膳食多样性和膳食质量方面的相对及联合作用的证据仍然有限。利用中国农村2004-2011年的家庭面板数据，我们从一个主要发展中国家的背景下提供了微观层面的证据，以检验农业生产多样性、市场准入及其交互作用对膳食多样性和膳食质量的数量-质量效应。采用固定效应模型结合工具变量策略来处理潜在的内生性问题。我们发现，更高的生产多样性和改善的市场准入都能提升膳食多样性和膳食质量。农业生产多样性每增加一个标准差，膳食多样性评分和中国健康饮食指数分别提高0.5和0.71个标准差。同样，到市场的距离每减少一个标准差，这两个结果均提高0.03个标准差。进一步分析揭示了生产多样性与市场准入在改善膳食结果方面总体上存在替代关系。随着市场准入的改善，生产多样性对膳食多样性和质量的边际贡献递减，反之亦然。然而，在食物组层面，这两种渠道在大豆和坚果、蔬菜以及水产品方面存在功能性互补。当市场准入受限时，多样化生产支持这些食物的更高摄入量，而更好的市场准入通过扩大获取更广泛食物的途径，减少了对自产物品的依赖。综合来看，研究结果强调了在市场薄弱地区，农业生产多样化对改善膳食的持续重要性，并强调了改善市场条件的至关重要的作用，尤其是在非洲和南亚等市场摩擦持续较高的地区。

records.title_en: Assessing distribution disputes over land expropriation compensation in China’s macro-regions using the conflict analysis model
records.title_cn: 基于冲突分析模型评估中国宏观区域土地征收补偿分配纠纷
records.abstract_en: China’s rapid urbanisation has required extensive rural land expropriation, generating widespread distribution conflicts with important implications for fairness. Because Chinese law prohibits private land ownership, rural land is collectively owned by village collectives, which are responsible for distributing expropriation compensation to their members. This institutional arrangement complicates the expropriation process and creates opportunities for rent-seeking by local cadres and officials. Drawing on the Credibility Thesis and using the Conflict Analysis Model (CAM), this study examines the complexity of distribution conflicts related to land expropriation. Using a dataset of court cases (n = 1,759) and indicators such as category, source, frequency, intensity and outcome of conflicts, this research provides a detailed understanding of the underlying issues. Findings show that conflicts over land expropriation primarily centre on eligibility for compensation and on the methods and procedures through which compensation is allocated. Notably, eligibility-related conflicts are frequently triggered by marital norms (over 71 percent). These conflicts stem from the practice of treating married women as married-out of the village, which excludes them from compensation and triggers frequent disputes. Legal cases involving contract management rights also have the highest appeal rates and often result in outcomes that are unfavourable to farmers. By contrast, conflicts over compensation methods and procedures generally lead to judgements more favourable to farmers, with only a minority of cases appealed to higher courts. Overall, disputes concerning compensation methods and procedures are relatively limited, reflecting higher credibility. In contrast, eligibility-related conflicts, especially those concerning contract management rights, are more intense and indicate lower credibility. These results demonstrate the effectiveness of CAM for analysing China’s land-based distribution conflicts. It also provides a framework for studying similar disputes in contexts where eligibility rules remain ambiguous and compensation methods and procedures are weakly institutionalised.
records.abstract_cn: 中国快速城市化进程需要大量征收农村土地，由此产生了广泛的分配冲突，对公平性具有重要影响。由于中国法律禁止私人土地所有权，农村土地由村集体共同所有，村集体负责向其成员分配征收补偿。这一制度安排使征收过程复杂化，并为地方干部和官员的寻租行为创造了机会。本研究借鉴可信度理论，运用冲突分析模型（CAM），考察了与土地征收相关的分配冲突的复杂性。利用法院案件数据集（n = 1,759）以及冲突类别、来源、频率、强度和结果等指标，本研究深入揭示了潜在问题。研究发现，土地征收冲突主要围绕补偿资格以及补偿分配的方法和程序展开。值得注意的是，与资格相关的冲突经常由婚姻规范引发（超过71%）。这些冲突源于将已婚女性视为已嫁出村的做法，这将其排除在补偿之外，并引发频繁纠纷。涉及承包经营权的法律案件上诉率最高，且结果往往对农民不利。相比之下，关于补偿方法和程序的冲突通常导致对农民更有利的判决，只有少数案件上诉至上级法院。总体而言，涉及补偿方法和程序的纠纷相对有限，反映了较高的可信度。相反，与资格相关的冲突，尤其是涉及承包经营权的冲突，更为激烈，表明可信度较低。这些结果证明了CAM在分析中国土地分配冲突方面的有效性，也为在资格规则模糊且补偿方法和程序制度化薄弱的情境下研究类似纠纷提供了框架。

records.title_en: Can dollarization mitigate the macroeconomic cost of populism? Lessons from Latin America
records.title_cn: 美元化能否减轻民粹主义的宏观经济成本？来自拉丁美洲的经验教训
records.abstract_en: This study examines whether dollarization can mitigate the negative macroeconomic impact of populist policies. We initially consider this question using a cross-country dataset that includes many countries. The results from System Generalized Method of Moments (GMM) and staggered Difference-in-Differences (DiD) estimation point to dollarization’s mitigating effect on populist policies. However, some complications in the data induce noise and make our estimates less precise. As a follow-up, we present a series of theoretical and empirical approaches to test our hypothesis within a case study comparing Argentina and Ecuador. Both countries adopted similar populist policies almost simultaneously under different currency regimes: the former with its own currency and the latter having the dollar as legal tender. These results consistently suggest that the adverse macroeconomic effects of populism are less severe under official dollarization, highlighting an important potential benefit of this currency regime for countries that are incapable of establishing and/or maintaining their central bank independence.
records.abstract_cn: 本研究考察美元化是否能减轻民粹主义政策对宏观经济的负面影响。我们首先使用包含多个国家的跨国数据集来考虑这一问题。系统广义矩估计（GMM）和交错双重差分（DiD）估计的结果表明，美元化对民粹主义政策具有缓解作用。然而，数据中的一些复杂性引入了噪声，使我们的估计不够精确。作为后续，我们提出了一系列理论和实证方法，在比较阿根廷和厄瓜多尔的案例研究中检验我们的假设。这两个国家在几乎相同的时间采用了相似的民粹主义政策，但处于不同的货币制度下：前者使用本国货币，后者以美元为法定货币。这些结果一致表明，在官方美元化下，民粹主义的不利宏观经济影响较轻，突显了这种货币制度对于无法建立和/或维持其中央银行独立性的国家的一个潜在重要好处。

records.title_en: Increasing responsiveness of civil servants. A field experiment on freedom of information compliance
records.title_cn: 提高公务员的响应性：关于信息自由合规性的实地实验
records.abstract_en: Previous research has examined the impact of financial incentives on public sector performance, but there is limited evidence on how non-financial incentives influence civil servants’ behavior—particularly in encouraging compliance with secondary tasks such as responding to freedom-of-information (FOI) requests. Although these tasks are not formally linked to performance evaluations, they are essential for promoting government transparency and building public trust. To address this gap, we conducted a field experiment in the City of Buenos Aires, Argentina, where we redesigned the FOI request notice to incorporate behavioral insights—such as salience, clarity, deterrence, and social norms— expected to increase civil servants’ compliance. Although the intervention did not significantly increase overall compliance, it substantially shifted the timing of responses: the proportion submitted exactly on the FOI law’s final deadline rose by 10.7 pp (a 200% increase). This finding suggests that the stronger adherence to the deadlines created by making them more salient outweighed any potential reduction in response time from the other behavioral elements in the redesigned notice. We also found evidence of (i) intra-agency spillovers, showing that the notices changed the civil servants’ information set, and (ii) higher compliance as a result of our intervention when agencies were not simultaneously exposed to government-led training workshops. This study contributes to the literature on civil servant performance, non-financial incentives, and transparency initiatives, highlighting the potential of low-cost, easily scalable interventions to improve bureaucratic responsiveness in developing countries.
records.abstract_cn: 以往的研究考察了财政激励对公共部门绩效的影响，但关于非财政激励如何影响公务员行为——特别是鼓励其遵守诸如回应信息自由（FOI）请求等次要任务——的证据有限。尽管这些任务并未正式与绩效评估挂钩，但它们对于促进政府透明度和建立公众信任至关重要。为弥补这一空白，我们在阿根廷布宜诺斯艾利斯市进行了一项实地实验，重新设计了FOI请求通知，融入了行为洞察——如显著性、清晰性、威慑和社会规范——预期能提高公务员的合规性。尽管干预并未显著提高整体合规性，但它大幅改变了响应的时间：恰好按FOI法最终截止日期提交的比例上升了10.7个百分点（增加了200%）。这一发现表明，通过提高截止日期的显著性而增强的对截止日期的遵守，超过了重新设计通知中其他行为元素可能带来的响应时间减少。我们还发现了（i）机构内部溢出效应的证据，表明通知改变了公务员的信息集，以及（ii）当机构未同时参与政府主导的培训讲习班时，我们的干预带来了更高的合规性。本研究为关于公务员绩效、非财政激励和透明度倡议的文献做出了贡献，强调了低成本、易于扩展的干预措施在改善发展中国家官僚响应性方面的潜力。

records.title_en: Exploring synergistic pathways between urbanization, water use efficiency, and renewable energy adoption in enhancing food security in Sub-Saharan Africa: A causal analysis using temporal causal modeling
records.title_cn: 探索城市化、水资源利用效率与可再生能源采用在提升撒哈拉以南非洲粮食安全中的协同路径：基于时间因果模型的因果分析
records.abstract_en: The Global South has experienced rapid urban expansion in recent decades, driven by population growth and rural-to-urban migration. This rapid urbanization presents both significant challenges and opportunities. On one hand, it creates momentum for innovation, particularly in enhancing water use efficiency, accelerating the adoption of renewable energy, and advancing infrastructure development. On the other hand, it places increasing pressure on essential resources such as water, food, and energy. This increasing pressure consequently leads to the need for integrated, resource-efficient systems as the region grapples with energy poverty, water scarcity, and food insecurity. However, empirical studies exploring the synergistic pathways among water use efficiency, renewable energy adoption, and urbanization in achieving food security remain limited. Therefore, this study uses Sub-Saharan Africa (SSA) as a case study to explore synergistic causal pathways between urbanization, renewable energy use, water use efficiency, food supply, and food prices using a panel dataset of 15 demographically dynamic SSA countries from 2000 to 2022. We employed Common Correlated Effects and Temporal Causal Models to estimate long-run panel elasticities and establish mutual causal synergies among urbanization, water use efficiency, and renewable energy in achieving food security. The findings indicate that urbanization drives food prices while also advancing improvements in water use efficiency and renewable energy adoption, which in turn enhance food security. Both water use efficiency and renewable energy use individually and interactively contribute to improved food security outcomes. Moreover, renewable energy use and water use efficiency also promote urbanization, which in turn mediates and reinforces their effects on food security. Furthermore, results of the scenario analysis indicate that improvements in water use efficiency contribute to food stability. These findings underscore the positive role of urbanization in catalyzing renewable energy adoption and water use efficiency, which together enhance food security outcomes.
records.abstract_cn: 全球南方近几十年来经历了快速的城市扩张，这由人口增长和农村向城市迁移所驱动。这种快速城市化既带来了重大挑战，也带来了机遇。一方面，它为创新创造了动力，特别是在提高水资源利用效率、加速可再生能源采用和推进基础设施发展方面。另一方面，它对水、食物和能源等基本资源施加了越来越大的压力。这种日益增长的压力因此导致了对综合、资源高效系统的需求，因为该地区正面临能源贫困、水资源短缺和粮食不安全的问题。然而，探索水资源利用效率、可再生能源采用和城市化在实现粮食安全方面的协同路径的实证研究仍然有限。因此，本研究以撒哈拉以南非洲（SSA）为案例，使用从2000年到2022年的15个人口动态变化的SSA国家的面板数据集，探讨城市化、可再生能源使用、水资源利用效率、粮食供应和粮食价格之间的协同因果路径。我们采用了共同相关效应和时间因果模型来估计长期面板弹性，并建立城市化、水资源利用效率和可再生能源在实现粮食安全中的相互因果协同作用。研究结果表明，城市化推动了粮食价格，同时也促进了水资源利用效率和可再生能源采用的改进，这反过来又增强了粮食安全。水资源利用效率和可再生能源使用单独及交互地有助于改善粮食安全结果。此外，可再生能源使用和水资源利用效率也促进了城市化，这反过来又中介并强化了它们对粮食安全的影响。进一步地，情景分析的结果表明，水资源利用效率的改进有助于粮食稳定。这些发现强调了城市化在催化可再生能源采用和水资源利用效率方面的积极作用，这些共同增强了粮食安全结果。

records.title_en: Rethinking development as structural transformation: a new structural economics perspective
records.title_cn: 将发展重新思考为结构转型：新结构经济学视角
records.abstract_en: The past decade has witnessed a trend towards micro-level development interventions as witnessed in the increasing deployment of randomized controlled trials in the field of development economics. Despite the merits of this micro-level approach, it fails to address structural challenges and does not build capacities necessary to achieve structural transformation. The present paper starts with the diagnosis of the merits and limitations of the micro-level approach to development interventions and then makes the case for the imperative of bringing structural transformation back to the research agenda. It then examines the theoretical insights that New Structural Economics as a third wave of development thinking after the World War II brings to the study on structural transformation. Finally, it offers policy recommendations on financing Sustainable Development Goals through the lens of conceptualizing development as structural transformation.
records.abstract_cn: 过去十年见证了向微观层面发展干预措施的趋势，这体现在发展经济学领域中随机对照试验的日益增多。尽管这种微观层面的方法有其优点，但它未能解决结构性挑战，也未建立实现结构转型所需的能力。本文首先诊断了微观层面发展干预方法的优点与局限性，然后论证了将结构转型重新纳入研究议程的必要性。接着，本文考察了新结构经济学作为二战后发展思想的第三次浪潮，为结构转型研究带来的理论见解。最后，本文通过将发展概念化为结构转型的视角，为资助可持续发展目标提供了政策建议。

records.title_en: Electoral cycles in female sterilization
records.title_cn: 女性绝育中的选举周期
records.abstract_en: Many women across the world face substantial challenges in obtaining access to family planning—an important problem emphasized by the Sustainable Development Goals. The present study explores electoral cycles in female sterilization, the most prevalent contraceptive method in the world. We focus on Brazil, a country where many women have unmet demands for sterilization and often queue for many months or even years for their surgeries. Qualitative evidence suggests that local politicians distort the provision of publicly funded tubal ligation surgeries for political purposes. We analyze the universe of tubal ligation surgeries performed by the public health system, using regression analysis to examine variation across Brazilian municipalities in 1998–2019. We find that female sterilizations increase 8.8% during municipal election years. Moreover, they surge during electoral campaigns: female sterilizations increase 30.5% in the three months before municipal elections. Findings are similar when adjusting for overall hospitalizations, which rise less than 1% during municipal elections. Female sterilizations have more pronounced electoral cycles than do other elective surgeries (including vasectomies), and no cycles are detected for emergency surgeries. Electoral cycles in female sterilization are concentrated among nonwhite Brazilians, who face substantial health disparities. Female sterilizations increase far more during municipal than national elections, and they spike especially in poor municipalities and in the Northeast region. More broadly, our findings suggest that Brazilian politicians distort the public provision of contraception, an important issue not least because family planning is widely deemed a basic human right.
records.abstract_cn: 世界各地的许多女性在获得计划生育服务方面面临重大挑战——这是可持续发展目标强调的一个重要问题。本研究探讨了女性绝育中的选举周期，女性绝育是世界上最普遍的避孕方法。我们聚焦于巴西，这个国家许多女性对绝育有未满足的需求，常常需要排队数月甚至数年才能接受手术。定性证据表明，地方政客出于政治目的扭曲了公共资助的输卵管结扎手术的提供。我们分析了公共卫生系统实施的所有输卵管结扎手术，使用回归分析考察巴西各市在1998-2019年间的差异。我们发现，在市选举年，女性绝育手术增加了8.8%。此外，它们在选举活动期间激增：在市选举前三个月，女性绝育手术增加了30.5%。在调整总住院人数后，结果相似，总住院人数在市选举期间上升不到1%。女性绝育比其他择期手术（包括输精管切除术）具有更明显的选举周期，而急诊手术未检测到周期。女性绝育中的选举周期集中在非白人巴西人中，他们面临显著的健康差距。女性绝育在市选举期间的增加远多于国家选举，并且在贫困市和东北部地区尤其激增。更广泛地说，我们的研究结果表明，巴西政客扭曲了避孕措施的公共提供，这是一个重要问题，尤其是因为计划生育被广泛视为一项基本人权。

records.title_en: Past stateness, present strength: How (the lack of) state experience shapes today’s fragile states
records.title_cn: 过去的国家性，当前的力量：国家经验（或缺乏）如何塑造当今的脆弱国家
records.abstract_en: Supporting state capacity is a priority for the international community, yet the record of internationally supported statebuilding to date has been mixed. A key question for continuing research concerns the factors influencing more versus less successful interventions. We show that experience of past ‘stateness’ is crucial in understanding contemporary state fragility and statebuilding. Extending beyond previous work, we introduce the concept of past stateness, consider theoretically its relationship to contemporary fragility, and explore this relationship empirically, drawing on cross-national data and newly developed indicators. In line with our expectations, descriptive and inferential analysis shows that lack of experience in the past century with two core features of stateness—monopoly of violence and existence of a professional bureaucracy—predicts chronic fragility today. This association is mainly driven by monopoly of violence rather than existence of a professional bureaucracy. Our analysis sheds new light on the underlying heterogeneity among states today labelled as ‘fragile’. From a policy perspective, a key implication is that, in designing interventions, the most relevant experiences are likely to be from other countries with similar stateness legacies, rather than from ‘fragile states’ more generally. Our analysis does not imply that statebuilding is impossible in contexts with weak stateness legacies, but it does underscore the challenges of this and the importance of setting expectations appropriately.
records.abstract_cn: 支持国家能力是国际社会的优先事项，然而迄今为止，国际支持的国家建设记录好坏参半。持续研究的一个关键问题涉及影响干预成功与否的因素。我们表明，过去的“国家性”经验对于理解当代国家脆弱性和国家建设至关重要。在先前工作的基础上，我们引入了过去国家性的概念，从理论上考虑其与当代脆弱性的关系，并利用跨国数据和新开发的指标实证探索这一关系。与我们的预期一致，描述性和推断性分析表明，在过去一个世纪中缺乏国家性的两个核心特征——暴力垄断和职业官僚制的存在——预示着当今的慢性脆弱性。这种关联主要由暴力垄断驱动，而非职业官僚制的存在。我们的分析为当今被标记为“脆弱”的国家之间的潜在异质性提供了新的视角。从政策角度看，一个关键含义是，在设计干预措施时，最相关的经验可能来自具有类似国家性遗产的其他国家，而非泛泛的“脆弱国家”。我们的分析并不意味着在国家性遗产薄弱的环境中国家建设是不可能的，但它确实强调了这一挑战以及适当设定期望的重要性。

records.title_en: A trapped green industrial policy? The challenges to lithium and green hydrogen development in Chile
records.title_cn: 受困的绿色产业政策？智利锂和绿色氢能开发面临的挑战
records.abstract_en: This article examines the challenges of implementing Green Industrial Policy (GIP) in resource-dependent economies through a comparative analysis of lithium and green hydrogen sectors in Chile. Both sectors are presented as strategic opportunities to diversify the productive matrix, foster technological upgrading, and advance a sustainable development model. However, progress has been limited with such policies failing to build solid pathways towards transformative outcomes. Drawing on interviews with policymakers, industry actors and civil society representatives, along with document analysis, we trace how institutional traps shape policy trajectories from design to implementation. We show that in Chile, such traps have produced policies that are “industrial” only on paper and “green” mainly in discourse: lithium remains locked into extractive dynamics with weak value-adding linkages, while green hydrogen is still at a pilot stage, with uncertain demand, contested sustainability credentials, and heavy dependence on foreign investment. These findings reveal that institutional traps are not mere implementation failures but mechanisms that systematically tend to reproduce extractivist logics and new dependencies, even under ostensibly transformative policy frameworks. By tracing how these traps emerge and evolve, the article highlights the structural constraints facing GIPs in dependent economies and contributes to understanding why such policies often fail to escape path-dependent trajectories. More broadly, our analysis underscores the limits of the green transition as a transformative project in the global South, where institutional legacies and global power relations continue to constrain policy autonomy and development outcomes.
records.abstract_cn: 本文通过比较分析智利的锂和绿色氢能部门，考察了资源依赖型经济体实施绿色产业政策（GIP）所面临的挑战。这两个部门都被视为实现生产矩阵多元化、促进技术升级和推进可持续发展模式的战略机遇。然而，进展有限，此类政策未能为变革性成果建立坚实的路径。基于对政策制定者、行业参与者和民间社会代表的访谈以及文献分析，我们追溯了制度陷阱如何从设计到实施塑造政策轨迹。我们表明，在智利，这些陷阱所产生的政策在纸面上是“产业性的”，在话语上主要是“绿色的”：锂仍然锁定在采掘动态中，增值联系薄弱，而绿色氢能仍处于试点阶段，需求不确定，可持续性信誉受到质疑，且严重依赖外国投资。这些发现揭示，制度陷阱不仅仅是实施失败，而是在表面上具有变革性的政策框架下，系统性地倾向于再生产采掘主义逻辑和新依赖性的机制。通过追溯这些陷阱如何出现和演变，本文强调了依赖型经济体中绿色产业政策面临的结构性约束，并有助于理解为什么此类政策往往无法摆脱路径依赖的轨迹。更广泛地说，我们的分析强调了绿色转型作为全球南方变革性项目的局限性，在那里，制度遗产和全球权力关系继续制约政策自主性和发展成果。

records.title_en: Institutional capacities for GVC-oriented policies
records.title_cn: 面向全球价值链政策的制度能力
records.abstract_en: In this paper we propose a concept of GVC-oriented policy, that includes both policies for GVC participation and value capture, and we discuss the institutional capacities required to design and implement these policy tasks. The framework is then tested with selected illustrative and conceptual theory building evidence from emerging countries.
records.abstract_cn: 在本文中，我们提出了一个面向全球价值链（GVC）政策的概念，该概念既包括促进GVC参与的政策，也包括价值获取的政策，并讨论了设计和实施这些政策任务所需的制度能力。随后，我们利用来自新兴国家的选择性说明性和概念性理论构建证据对该框架进行了检验。

records.title_en: Good for business, not so much for the environment? Entry into importing and the energy intensity of Indian plants
records.title_cn: 对商业有利，对环境却未必？进口进入与印度工厂的能源强度
records.abstract_en: The global fragmentation of production has important implications for the environment. As emerging economies increase their participation in trade, scale effects increase environmental impacts worldwide. Yet at the same time, access to international markets might help offset these impacts by increasing the efficiency of production. Existing literature suggests that trading firms tend to be more energy efficient than non-traders. However, this literature does not take into account the effect of firms’ product baskets. In this paper, we leverage a rich plant- and product-level database from India to investigate the effects of importing on plant-level environmental outcomes. We first construct a measure of energy efficiency that is net of effects arising from plants’ product baskets. We then use an event study set up to compare outcomes between importers and future importers at the time of their entry into import markets. Our design takes advantage of plants’ staggered entry into importing to address issues of selection. Our findings suggest that after they start importing, plants experience a temporary increase in their energy intensity—particularly in low- and medium-tech sectors. Plants which start importing also grow larger and more productive, and diversify their product baskets. These finding suggests that there is an environmental cost to learning and product diversification.
records.abstract_cn: 生产的全球碎片化对环境具有重要影响。随着新兴经济体增加其贸易参与度，规模效应在全球范围内增加了环境影响。然而，与此同时，进入国际市场可能通过提高生产效率来抵消这些影响。现有文献表明，贸易企业往往比非贸易企业更具能源效率。然而，这些文献并未考虑企业产品组合的影响。在本文中，我们利用来自印度的丰富工厂和产品层面数据库，研究进口对工厂层面环境结果的影响。我们首先构建了一个能源效率衡量指标，该指标剔除了工厂产品组合带来的影响。然后，我们采用事件研究设计，比较进口商和未来进口商在进入进口市场时的结果。我们的设计利用工厂进入进口的错开时间来解决选择性问题。我们的研究结果表明，在开始进口后，工厂的能源强度会暂时增加——尤其是在低技术和中技术部门。开始进口的工厂也规模更大、生产率更高，并使其产品组合多样化。这些发现表明，学习和产品多样化存在环境成本。

records.title_en: Shocks and reconfiguration in global value chains: A complex network perspective on the global south
records.title_cn: 全球价值链中的冲击与重构：基于全球南方的复杂网络视角
records.abstract_en: The growing interconnectedness of supply linkages has amplified the transmission of external shocks through Global Value Chains (GVCs), most notably during the COVID-19 pandemic, raising concerns about the vulnerability of global production systems. However, existing evidence largely focuses on advanced economies, leaving limited systematic analysis of how disruptions reshape production networks in the Global South. This paper addresses this gap by examining how shocks between 2018 and 2022 reconfigured trade-in-value-added linkages in two labor-intensive sectors—Food & Beverages and Textiles & Wearing Apparel—that are central to export performance in many developing countries.
records.abstract_cn: 供应关联日益紧密，放大了外部冲击通过全球价值链（GVCs）的传导，尤其是在COVID-19大流行期间，引发了对全球生产系统脆弱性的担忧。然而，现有证据主要集中在发达经济体，对冲击如何重塑全球南方生产网络的系统性分析有限。本文通过考察2018至2022年间冲击如何重构两个劳动密集型部门——食品与饮料以及纺织与服装——中的贸易增加值关联来填补这一空白，这两个部门对许多发展中国家的出口表现至关重要。

records.title_en: Education on the cheap and early child development: Evidence from the free compulsory education reform in rural China
records.title_cn: 廉价教育与幼儿发展：来自中国农村免费义务教育改革的证据
records.abstract_en: This paper examines how maternal exposure to China’s free compulsory education reform (FCER) affects children’s early childhood development (ECD) between 11 and 30 months old. We join individual-level survey data with provincial-level statistics on education from two economically disadvantaged rural provinces. Using a cohort-based difference-in-differences approach, we exploit birth-cohort and regional differences in exposure to the reform. We find that children whose mothers experienced the FCER exhibit significant gains in overall, cognitive, language, and motor development measured by the Caregiver Reported Early Development Instruments. The effect on language development is stronger among children from rich households. Potential mechanisms were explored: The FCER may improve children’s home environments by improving maternal education, enhancing parenting knowledge and practices, and increasing spending on ECD.
records.abstract_cn: 本文考察了母亲接触中国免费义务教育改革（FCER）对11至30个月大儿童早期发展（ECD）的影响。我们将个体层面调查数据与来自两个经济欠发达农村省份的省级教育统计相结合。采用基于队列的双重差分方法，利用出生队列和地区在改革暴露程度上的差异。我们发现，母亲经历过FCER的儿童在整体、认知、语言和运动发展方面表现出显著提升，这些发展通过照护者报告的早期发展工具进行测量。语言发展的影响在富裕家庭儿童中更为显著。潜在机制被探讨：FCER可能通过提高母亲教育水平、增强育儿知识和实践以及增加对ECD的支出来改善儿童的家庭环境。

records.title_en: Gun violence and the political economy of forced labor investigations in Brazil
records.title_cn: 枪支暴力与巴西强迫劳动调查的政治经济学
records.abstract_en: This paper examines how gun violence affects the efficiency of Brazil’s specialized government team that investigates forced labor. We develop a rational-choice model in which violence distorts informational signals: gun-related incidents generate more third-party complaints, creating misleading leads and reducing investigative accuracy. This signal-distortion mechanism increases the number of investigations but lowers their precision if the level of slavery remains constant, thereby expanding opportunities for forced labor in equilibrium. Empirically, we employ a shift–share design that combines small-arms trade data with local exposure to violence. The results show that greater gun availability raises both forced labor investigations and confirmed cases, consistent with the model’s predictions. Heterogeneous treatment effect analyses indicate that this mechanism operates mainly under conditions of high state capacity or intense violence, when enforcement depends most on reliable information.
records.abstract_cn: 本文考察枪支暴力如何影响巴西专门调查强迫劳动的政府团队的效率。我们构建了一个理性选择模型，其中暴力扭曲了信息信号：枪支相关事件产生更多第三方投诉，造成误导性线索并降低调查准确性。这种信号扭曲机制增加了调查数量，但在奴隶制水平保持不变的情况下降低了其精确度，从而在均衡中扩大了强迫劳动的机会。在实证方面，我们采用了一种将小武器贸易数据与当地暴力暴露相结合的份额-份额设计。结果表明，枪支可得性的增加同时提高了强迫劳动调查和确认案件的数量，与模型的预测一致。异质性处理效应分析表明，这一机制主要在高国家能力或激烈暴力的条件下运作，此时执法最依赖于可靠信息。

records.title_en: Teetering on the brink of debt and hunger: Empirical examination of the linkages between external debt and food security in Africa
records.title_cn: 在债务与饥饿的边缘摇摇欲坠：非洲外债与粮食安全之间联系的实证研究
records.abstract_en: Debt accumulation and food insecurity are two pressing challenges confronting developing countries, yet evidence on their link remains limited, particularly in Africa. This study uses balanced panel data from 32 African countries (2012–2022) to examine how external debt stock and servicing affect food security. Results support the notion that “the dose makes the poison”: higher debt stock undermines food security, with effects differing across its dimensions. Elevated debt stock is also associated with higher child stunting, reflecting long-term nutritional risks. Debt servicing has an even stronger negative effect, worsening availability, affordability, safety and quality of food, as well as child nutrition. Disaggregated analysis shows that debt sources matter: multilateral loans improve food security and reduce stunting, while bilateral and private loans have the opposite effect. These adverse effects persist across income levels, food-import dependency and infrastructural development, though with varying intensity. The findings highlight the need for African countries to balance external borrowing with effective debt management and channel borrowed funds into productive, sustainability-enhancing investments that strengthen food systems and protect vulnerable populations, particularly children.
records.abstract_cn: 债务积累和粮食不安全是发展中国家面临的两大紧迫挑战，然而关于它们之间联系的证据仍然有限，尤其是在非洲。本研究使用来自32个非洲国家（2012-2022年）的平衡面板数据，考察外债存量和偿债如何影响粮食安全。结果支持“剂量决定毒性”的观点：较高的债务存量削弱粮食安全，且其影响在不同维度上有所差异。较高的债务存量还与儿童发育迟缓率上升相关，反映出长期的营养风险。偿债的负面影响更为强烈，恶化了粮食的可得性、可负担性、安全性和质量，以及儿童营养状况。分类分析显示，债务来源至关重要：多边贷款改善粮食安全并减少发育迟缓，而双边和私人贷款则产生相反效果。这些不利影响在收入水平、粮食进口依赖和基础设施发展方面持续存在，尽管强度有所不同。研究结果强调，非洲国家需要在外部借款与有效债务管理之间取得平衡，并将借入资金引导至生产性、增强可持续性的投资中，以加强粮食系统并保护弱势群体，尤其是儿童。

records.title_en: Does crisis lending help China win friends and influence people?
records.title_cn: 危机贷款是否帮助中国赢得朋友并影响他人？
records.abstract_en: China has recently emerged as an international lender of last resort to economies in distress. Beijing’s crisis loans have both economic and geopolitical objectives, which include deepening economic integration with recipient countries and increasing political support for China on the international stage. We examine whether making China’s crisis lending salient influences public support for stronger economic ties with China. We fielded survey experiments in three countries that have received emergency financial assistance from Beijing – Argentina, Turkey, and Russia – randomly reminding some respondents about this assistance. On average, priming respondents about Chinese crisis lending does not increase support for stronger economic ties with China. To probe whether the null average effects mask countervailing responses, we conduct exploratory subgroup analyses by political alignment. These analyses suggest that reminders about Chinese crisis lending can polarize attitudes; specifically, they reduce support for economic cooperation with China among those who oppose their country’s incumbent government. Thus, rather than uniformly improving its image, being primed to think about Chinese lending worsens the country’s standing as an economic partner among some segments of the population. This suggests that, when it comes to public opinion, there are important limits to China’s “bailout” diplomacy.
records.abstract_cn: 中国最近已成为陷入困境经济体的国际最后贷款人。北京的危机贷款既有经济目标也有地缘政治目标，包括深化与受援国的经济一体化，以及在国际舞台上增加对中国的政治支持。我们考察了使中国的危机贷款变得突出是否会影响公众对与中国加强经济联系的支持。我们在三个接受过北京紧急财政援助的国家——阿根廷、土耳其和俄罗斯——进行了调查实验，随机提醒一些受访者关于这一援助。平均而言，提醒受访者关于中国危机贷款并不会增加对与中国加强经济联系的支持。为了探究平均效应为零是否掩盖了相反的反应，我们按政治立场进行了探索性的亚组分析。这些分析表明，关于中国危机贷款的提醒可能使态度极化；具体来说，它们降低了那些反对本国现任政府的人对中国经济合作的支持。因此，并非统一改善其形象，被提醒思考中国贷款反而恶化了该国作为经济伙伴在某些人群中的形象。这表明，在公众舆论方面，中国的“救助”外交存在重要限制。

records.title_en: Who should be served first? Multidimensional prioritization in a Bolivian cash transfer program
records.title_cn: 谁应优先获得服务？玻利维亚现金转移项目中的多维优先排序
records.abstract_en: Social protection programs in developing countries often rely on broad eligibility criteria that overlook the heterogeneity of beneficiaries’ deprivation profiles. We propose an ex-ante microsimulation framework to evaluate the efficiency of conditional cash transfer (CCT) allocation rules in reducing multidimensional poverty. Applied to Bolivia’s flagship CCT, Bono Juancito Pinto, using 2022 household survey data, we compare the current, uniform allocation rule against counterfactual prioritarian rules that concentrate resources first on households with the highest burden of overlapping deprivations. BJP has the explicit aim to reduce poverty in the long run, and we show that while it is generally effective, its impact can be considerably amplified under prioritarian rules. This efficiency is driven by a poverty reduction mechanism that resolves program targeted outcomes among the most deprived and may pull some of these households out of multidimensional poverty. While our framework takes the program’s eligibility criteria and associated exclusion errors as given, we demonstrate that a multidimensional lens for resource allocation can mitigate the fiscal inefficiencies of inclusion errors.
records.abstract_cn: 发展中国家的社会保护项目通常依赖宽泛的资格标准，忽视了受益者贫困状况的异质性。我们提出了一个事前微观模拟框架，以评估有条件现金转移（CCT）分配规则在减少多维贫困方面的效率。将该框架应用于玻利维亚旗舰CCT项目——胡安西托·平托奖金，利用2022年住户调查数据，我们将当前统一的分配规则与反事实的优先主义规则进行比较，后者将资源首先集中于重叠剥夺负担最高的家庭。BJP明确旨在长期减少贫困，我们表明，尽管其总体有效，但在优先主义规则下其影响可显著放大。这种效率源于一种减贫机制，该机制解决了最贫困者中项目目标结果的问题，并可能使其中一些家庭摆脱多维贫困。虽然我们的框架将项目的资格标准及相关排斥错误视为既定条件，但我们证明，多维视角下的资源分配可以缓解包容性错误带来的财政低效问题。

records.title_en: Beyond the tap: the limited value of democracy for delivering universal safe water access in low- and middle-income countries
records.title_cn: 超越水龙头：民主在低收入和中等收入国家实现普遍安全饮水方面的有限价值
records.abstract_en: Despite a large volume of scholarly literature examining the relationship between democracy and public service provision, few studies have directly tested its impact on safe water access—a foundational component of human development. This paper investigates whether democratic governance confers advantages in expanding access not simply to “basic” water, but to water available on premises and free from fecal and priority chemical contamination in low- and middle-income countries between 2000 and 2024. We theorize that especially in low information environments, citizens tend to focus more on the (under)provision of highly visible public services, and as a result, the power of democratic accountability will be relatively stronger for basic water. By contrast, citizens are less likely to know whether their water is safe to drink, and ensuring water safety frequently poses political challenges for governments. We conduct global sensitivity analyses of 39,000 cross-national regressions with multiple measures of democracy and water access. In the majority of our estimates, we find that democracy is positively associated with access to basic water, but weakly so, and not at conventional levels of statistical significance. By contrast, democracy is negatively associated with safe water access, and to the greatest extent in recent years. Our findings challenge the notion that democratic pressures will propel universal safe water access and suggest that more deliberately designed accountability mechanisms may be needed to achieve this goal.
records.abstract_cn: 尽管有大量学术文献研究民主与公共服务供给之间的关系，但很少有研究直接检验其对安全饮水获取的影响——这是人类发展的基础组成部分。本文考察了在2000年至2024年间，民主治理是否在低收入和中等收入国家中，不仅扩大了“基本”水的获取，还扩大了场所内可用且无粪便和优先化学污染的水的获取优势。我们理论化认为，尤其在信息环境较差的情况下，公民往往更关注高度可见的公共服务的（不足）供给，因此，民主问责的力量对于基本水而言相对更强。相比之下，公民不太可能知道他们的水是否安全可饮，而确保水安全常常给政府带来政治挑战。我们对39,000个跨国回归进行了全球敏感性分析，采用了多种民主和水获取的衡量指标。在我们的大多数估计中，我们发现民主与基本水的获取呈正相关，但相关性较弱，且未达到常规统计显著性水平。相反，民主与安全饮水的获取呈负相关，并且在近年来的影响最为显著。我们的发现挑战了民主压力将推动普遍安全饮水获取的观点，并表明可能需要更精心设计的问责机制来实现这一目标。

records.title_en: Weak by design: How agribusiness organize in congress to trap environmental reforms in Brazil and Chile
records.title_cn: 设计上的薄弱：农业企业如何在国会中组织以阻碍巴西和智利的环境改革
records.abstract_en: Scholars have emphasized the prevalence of weak institutions as an explanation for disappointing developmental outcomes in Latin America, focusing on low enforcement as a key cause of institutional weakness. This paper shows, by contrast, how institutional weakness can result from design features that make regulations, even those that are fully enforced, ineffective. I analyze the design and passage of two heavily contested environmental reforms, the Brazilian New Forest Code enacted in 2012 and the Chilean Water Code reform passed in 2022, documenting how, in the two countries, economic actors bearing the costs of environmental reforms organized in the legislative arena to influence the design of regulations in a way that mitigated their compliance costs. I process-trace each bill’s formulation, debate and passage to show how agribusiness embedded in the letter of the law design features that severely limited the capacity of these new regulations to accomplish their statutory goal of protecting natural resources. Evidence for my process tracing comes from the archival analysis of multiple sources—legislative debates, roll call data, producers’ associations’ publications, and newspaper articles—and elite interviews. By analyzing a country with ideologically cohesive legislative coalitions (Chile) and another with extreme party system fragmentation and programmatically loose parties (Brazil), I contribute to the business politics literature showing how economic elites can organize successfully in the legislative arena to block or dilute institutional reforms that threaten their interests under different institutional contexts. My empirical findings contribute to developmental and environmental studies and can inform policymakers by showing how environmental degradation may result not from lack of regulation or enforcement but from the intentional design of weak institutions.
records.abstract_cn: 学者们强调薄弱制度的存在是拉丁美洲发展成果不佳的一个解释，重点关注执法不力作为制度薄弱的关键原因。本文相反地展示了制度薄弱如何源于设计特征，这些特征使得法规即使得到完全执行也无效。我分析了两项备受争议的环境改革的设计和通过过程，即巴西于2012年颁布的新森林法和智利于2022年通过的水法改革，记录了两国中承担环境改革成本的经济行为者如何在立法领域组织起来，以影响法规设计，从而减轻其合规成本。我对每项法案的制定、辩论和通过进行了过程追踪，展示了农业企业如何将严重限制这些新法规实现其保护自然资源法定目标的能力的设计特征嵌入法律条文。我的过程追踪证据来自对多种来源的档案分析——立法辩论、唱名表决数据、生产者协会出版物和报纸文章——以及精英访谈。通过分析一个具有意识形态凝聚力立法联盟的国家（智利）和另一个政党体系极度碎片化且政党纲领松散的国家（巴西），我为商业政治文献做出贡献，展示了在不同制度背景下，经济精英如何在立法领域成功组织以阻止或稀释威胁其利益的制度改革。我的实证发现有助于发展研究和环境研究，并可通过展示环境退化可能并非源于缺乏法规或执法，而是源于薄弱制度的有意设计，为政策制定者提供信息。

records.title_en: Open for business: mapping private sector investment incentives in Sub-Saharan Africa
records.title_cn: 开放营商：撒哈拉以南非洲私营部门投资激励措施图谱
records.abstract_en: Over the last 25 years, governments across Sub-Saharan Africa have undertaken extensive reforms to foster private investment and promote economic growth. This paper examines the region’s contemporary investment promotion landscape by analyzing national-level policy frameworks in 46 countries. It centers on the following question: How do states balance the benefits that they offer to attract investors with the performance requirements that they mandate to advance local development objectives? The study employs a cross-sectional comparative approach with two principal outcomes. First, it produces a comprehensive database of policy briefs that document each country’s legal investment framework. Second, it introduces the Matrix of Investment Regimes—a novel analytical tool that systematically classifies investment regimes across four key variables: minimum investment value, job creation requirements, corporate income tax reductions, and benefit periods. The study finds that while nearly all countries offer significant fiscal incentives, few impose strong conditionalities. A large cluster of countries provides generous investor benefits with limited obligations, whereas only a handful adopt a high-conditionality/high-incentive model aimed at reciprocal benefits. This imbalance reflects a regional trend toward liberalization that may undermine inclusive and sustainable development. The tools developed in this study serve as a steppingstone for future comparative designs assessing the social, economic, and environmental impacts of corporate agents through strategically selected country cases. The findings are relevant to scholars and policymakers alike, informing future efforts to align investment promotion with equitable development objectives.
records.abstract_cn: 在过去25年中，撒哈拉以南非洲各国政府进行了广泛的改革，以促进私人投资和推动经济增长。本文通过分析46个国家的国家层面政策框架，审视该地区当代的投资促进格局。研究聚焦于以下问题：各国如何在为吸引投资者而提供的优惠与为推进地方发展目标而规定的绩效要求之间取得平衡？研究采用横截面比较方法，得出两个主要成果。首先，编制了一份全面的政策简报数据库，记录每个国家的法律投资框架。其次，引入了投资制度矩阵——一种新颖的分析工具，系统地将投资制度按四个关键变量进行分类：最低投资额、就业创造要求、企业所得税减免和优惠期限。研究发现，尽管几乎所有国家都提供显著的财政激励，但很少有国家施加严格的条件限制。大量国家提供慷慨的投资者优惠但附带义务有限，而只有少数国家采用高条件/高激励模式以追求互惠利益。这种不平衡反映了该地区趋向自由化的趋势，可能削弱包容性和可持续发展。本研究开发的工具为未来通过战略选择国家案例评估企业行为者社会、经济和环境影响的比较设计奠定了基础。研究结果对学者和政策制定者均有参考价值，为未来将投资促进与公平发展目标相结合的努力提供信息。

records.title_en: Sibling correlations in schooling around the world: A new database
records.title_cn: 全球教育程度的兄弟姐妹相关性：一个新数据库
records.abstract_en: We estimate sibling correlations in schooling (i.e., the fraction of inequality in educational outcomes attributable to factors shared by siblings) for 128 countries, which account for 94% of the world’s population. With this new database, we document several findings. In the average country in our sample, at least 56% of the inequality in schooling can be attributed to factors shared by siblings, with estimated sibling correlations ranging from as low as 0.15 to as high as 0.87 across individual samples. There are significant regional differences, with Europe and Central Asia showing the lowest and South Asia the highest levels of sibling correlation. There is also substantial heterogeneity within some regions. The average sibling correlation has been decreasing across cohorts; in some regions, however, it has stagnated. At the global level, educational mobility appears strongly correlated with several social and economic variables.
records.abstract_cn: 我们估算了128个国家的教育程度兄弟姐妹相关性（即教育成果不平等中可归因于兄弟姐妹共同因素的比例），这些国家占世界人口的94%。利用这一新数据库，我们记录了若干发现。在我们样本的平均国家中，至少56%的教育不平等可归因于兄弟姐妹共同因素，各样本中估计的兄弟姐妹相关性从低至0.15到高达0.87不等。存在显著的区域差异，欧洲和中亚的兄弟姐妹相关性水平最低，而南亚最高。一些区域内也存在显著的异质性。平均兄弟姐妹相关性随队列递减；然而，在某些区域，这一趋势已停滞。在全球层面，教育流动性似乎与多个社会和经济变量密切相关。

records.title_en: The Indigenous land titling trap: adaptive practices and the limits of climate governance
records.title_cn: 原住民土地所有权陷阱：适应性实践与气候治理的边界
records.abstract_en: This article examines why Indigenous land titling, widely promoted as an enabling condition for climate action, advances without closing persistent gaps in territorial recognition. It conceptualizes this paradox as a climate titling institutional trap, in which reforms progress through adaptive practices yet remain embedded in territorial governance configurations that constrain their transformative potential.
